1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';

1→export const fileToDataURL = (file: File): Promise<string> =>
     2→  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     3→    const reader = new FileReader();
     4→    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
     5→    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
     6→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
     7→  });
     8→
     9→export const dataURLtoFile = (
    10→  dataUrl: string,
    11→  filename: string,
    12→  fileType?: string
    13→): File | null => {
    14→  try {
    15→    const [metadata, payload] = dataUrl.split(',');
    16→    if (!metadata || !payload) {
    17→      throw new Error('Invalid Data URL format');
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    const mimeMatch = metadata.match(/:(.*?);/);
    21→    const mimeType =
    22→      fileType ||
    23→      (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) ||
    24→      'application/octet-stream';
    25→    const decodedPayload = atob(payload);
    26→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(decodedPayload.length);
    27→
    28→    for (let i = 0; i < decodedPayload.length; i += 1) {
    29→      bytes[i] = decodedPayload.charCodeAt(i);
    30→    }
    31→
    32→    return new File([bytes], filename, { type: mimeType });
    33→  } catch {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→};

    45→  }
    46→

    48→}

    69→export function useAdjustedTaskDetails({

   109→  });

   115→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   116→    const isTaskCreatedVariant = activeVariant && variantParams && (

   124→      const sourceTaskId = typeof variantParams.source_task_id === 'string' ? variantParams.source_task_id : undefined;
   125→      const hasMatchingTaskData = taskDetailsData?.taskId === sourceTaskId && taskDetailsData?.task?.params;
   126→
   127→      // Determine the best source of task params:
   128→      // 1. If taskDetailsData matches, use its params (already have full data)
   129→      // 2. If we fetched the source task, use its params

   156→      return {

   159→          taskType: effectiveTaskType,
   160→          params: effectiveParams,

     4→export type LoraMode = 'none' | 'in-scene' | 'next-scene' | 'custom';
     5→
     6→interface UseEditModeLorasReturn {
     7→  // Mode selection for automatic LoRAs
     8→  loraMode: LoraMode;
     9→  setLoraMode: (mode: LoraMode) => void;
    10→  
    11→  // Custom URL support
    12→  customLoraUrl: string;
    13→  setCustomLoraUrl: (url: string) => void;
    14→  
    15→  // The computed LoRAs based on mode
    16→  editModeLoras: Array<{ url: string; strength: number }> | undefined;
    17→  
    18→  // Legacy boolean support for backward compatibility
    19→  isInSceneBoostEnabled: boolean;
    20→  setIsInSceneBoostEnabled: (enabled: boolean) => void;
    21→}
    22→
    23→/**
    24→ * Hook to manage LoRA mode state for image editing operations
    25→ * Supports: In-Scene, Next Scene, Custom, or None
    26→ * Used by both inpainting and magic edit modes
    27→ */
    28→export const useEditModeLoras = (): UseEditModeLorasReturn => {
    29→  const [loraMode, setLoraMode] = useState<LoraMode>('none'); // Default to no preset LoRA
    30→  const [customLoraUrl, setCustomLoraUrl] = useState<string>('');
    31→
    32→  // Legacy boolean support - map to new lora mode
    33→  const isInSceneBoostEnabled = loraMode !== 'none';
    34→  const setIsInSceneBoostEnabled = (enabled: boolean) => {
    35→    setLoraMode(enabled ? 'in-scene' : 'none');
    36→  };
    37→
    38→  // Build loras array based on selected mode
    39→  const editModeLoras = useMemo(() => {
    40→    switch (loraMode) {
    41→      case 'in-scene':
    42→        return [{
    43→          url: EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS['in-scene'],
    44→          strength: 1.0
    45→        }];
    46→      case 'next-scene':
    47→        return [{
    48→          url: EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS['next-scene'],
    49→          strength: 1.0
    50→        }];
    51→      case 'custom':
    52→        // Only return custom lora if URL is provided
    53→        return customLoraUrl.trim() ? [{
    54→          url: customLoraUrl.trim(),
    55→          strength: 1.0
    56→        }] : undefined;
    57→      case 'none':
    58→      default:
    59→        return undefined;
    60→    }
    61→  }, [loraMode, customLoraUrl]);
    62→
    63→  return {
    64→    // Mode selection
    65→    loraMode,
    66→    setLoraMode,
    67→    // Custom URL
    68→    customLoraUrl,
    69→    setCustomLoraUrl,
    70→    // Computed LoRAs
    71→    editModeLoras,
    72→    // Legacy boolean support
    73→    isInSceneBoostEnabled,
    74→    setIsInSceneBoostEnabled,
    75→  };
    76→};
    77→

     3→const Slot = React.forwardRef<HTMLElement, React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>>(
     4→  ({ children, ...props }, forwardedRef) => {
     5→    if (!React.isValidElement(children)) {
     6→      return null;
     7→    }
     8→
     9→    const child = children as React.ReactElement<Record<string, unknown>> & {
    10→      ref?: React.Ref<HTMLElement>;
    11→    };
    12→
    13→    return React.cloneElement(child, {
    14→      ...mergeProps(props, child.props),
    15→      ref: forwardedRef ? composeRefs(forwardedRef, child.ref) : child.ref,
    16→    } as Record<string, unknown>);
    17→  }
    18→);
    19→
    20→Slot.displayName = 'Slot';
    21→
    22→function mergeProps(
    23→  slotProps: Record<string, unknown>,
    24→  childProps: Record<string, unknown>
    25→): Record<string, unknown> {
    26→  const overrideProps: Record<string, unknown> = { ...childProps };
    27→
    28→  for (const propName in childProps) {
    29→    const slotPropValue = slotProps[propName];
    30→    const childPropValue = childProps[propName];
    31→
    32→    const isHandler = /^on[A-Z]/.test(propName);
    33→    if (isHandler) {
    34→      if (typeof slotPropValue === 'function' && typeof childPropValue === 'function') {
    35→        overrideProps[propName] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
    36→          (childPropValue as (...eventArgs: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
    37→          (slotPropValue as (...eventArgs: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
    38→        };
    39→      } else if (typeof slotPropValue === 'function') {
    40→        overrideProps[propName] = slotPropValue;
    41→      }
    42→    } else if (propName === 'style') {
    43→      const slotStyle = typeof slotPropValue === 'object' && slotPropValue ? slotPropValue : {};
    44→      const childStyle = typeof childPropValue === 'object' && childPropValue ? childPropValue : {};
    45→      overrideProps[propName] = { ...slotStyle, ...childStyle };
    46→    } else if (propName === 'className') {
    47→      overrideProps[propName] = [slotPropValue, childPropValue].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    48→    }
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  return { ...slotProps, ...overrideProps };
    52→}
    53→
    54→function composeRefs<T>(...refs: (React.Ref<T> | undefined | null)[]): React.RefCallback<T> {
    55→  return (node) => {
    56→    refs.forEach((ref) => {
    57→      if (typeof ref === 'function') {

    59→      } else if (ref != null) {
    60→        (ref as React.MutableRefObject<T | null>).current = node;
    61→      }
    62→    });
    63→  };
    64→}

1→import * as React from 'react';
     2→import { Check, Loader2, Mic, Square, Wand2 } from 'lucide-react';
     3→import type { TextProcessingState } from '@/shared/components/ui/hooks/useAIInputTextPopover';
     4→
     5→type AIInputMode = 'voice' | 'text';
     6→
     7→interface VisualStateInput {
     8→  mode: AIInputMode;
     9→  voiceState: string;
    10→  textState: TextProcessingState;
    11→  hasExistingContent: boolean;
    12→}
    13→
    14→export function getMainIcon({
    15→  mode,
    16→  voiceState,
    17→  textState,
    18→}: VisualStateInput): React.ReactNode {
    19→  if (mode === 'voice') {
    20→    switch (voiceState) {
    21→      case 'recording':
    22→        return <Square className="h-3 w-3 fill-current" />;
    23→      case 'processing':
    24→        return <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />;
    25→      default:
    26→        return <Mic className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />;
    27→    }
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  switch (textState) {
    31→    case 'processing':
    32→      return <Loader2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 animate-spin" />;
    33→    case 'success':
    34→      return <Check className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />;
    35→    default:
    36→      return <Wand2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />;
    37→  }
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function getTooltipText({
    41→  mode,
    42→  voiceState,
    43→  hasExistingContent,
    44→}: VisualStateInput): string {
    45→  if (mode === 'voice') {
    46→    switch (voiceState) {
    47→      case 'recording':
    48→        return 'Stop recording';
    49→      case 'processing':
    50→        return 'Processing...';
    51→      default:
    52→        return hasExistingContent
    53→          ? 'Voice input to create/edit prompt'
    54→          : 'Voice input to create prompt';
    55→    }
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  return hasExistingContent
    59→    ? 'Type instructions to create/edit prompt'
    60→    : 'Type instructions to create prompt';
    61→}
    62→
    63→export function getButtonStyles({
    64→  mode,
    65→  voiceState,
    66→  textState,
    67→}: VisualStateInput): string {
    68→  if (mode === 'voice') {
    69→    if (voiceState === 'recording') {
    70→      return 'bg-red-500 text-white hover:bg-red-600';
    71→    }
    72→  } else {
    73→    if (textState === 'open' || textState === 'processing') {
    74→      return 'bg-purple-500 text-white hover:bg-purple-600';
    75→    }
    76→    if (textState === 'success') {
    77→      return 'bg-green-500 text-white hover:bg-green-600';
    78→    }
    79→  }
    80→  return 'bg-muted/80 hover:bg-muted text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground';
    81→}
    82→

Only what you observe directly in the code informs your scores.\n\nRULES:\n1. Only emit findings you are confident about. When unsure, skip entirely.\n2. Every finding MUST include at least one entry in related_files as evidence.\n3. Every finding MUST include a concrete, actionable suggestion.\n4. Be specific: \"processData is vague \u2014 callers use it for invoice reconciliation, rename to reconcileInvoice\" NOT \"naming could be better.\"\n5. If a dimension has no defects, give it a high assessment score and return zero findings for that dimension. Do NOT manufacture findings to justify a score.\n10. If your impression is uncertain, score conservatively and explain the uncertainty; optimistic scoring without evidence is considered gaming.\n13.     23→export function useAutoTopupState({ initialPurchaseAmount }: UseAutoTopupStateProps): UseAutoTopupStateReturn {

    44→      if (autoTopupPreferences.amount && autoTopupPreferences.amount !== 50) {

    73→    const { setupCompleted } = autoTopupPreferences;
    74→    const enabled = localAutoTopupEnabled;
    75→
    76→    if (enabled && setupCompleted) return 'active';
    77→    if (!enabled && setupCompleted) return 'setup-but-disabled';
    78→    if (enabled && !setupCompleted) return 'enabled-but-not-setup';
    79→    return 'not-setup';
    80→  }, [autoTopupPreferences, localAutoTopupEnabled]);
    81→
    82→  const handleAutoTopupToggle = (enabled: boolean) => {
    83→    const previousEnabled = localAutoTopupEnabled;
    84→    setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(enabled);
    85→
    86→    const saveData = {
    87→      enabled,
    88→      amount: purchaseAmount,
    89→      threshold: localAutoTopupThreshold,
    90→    };
    91→    updateAutoTopup(saveData, {
    92→      onError: () => {
    93→        setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(previousEnabled);
    94→      },
    95→    });
    96→  };
    97→
    98→  const handleAutoTopupThresholdChange = (threshold: number) => {
    99→    setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(threshold);
   100→
   101→    // Debounce the save
   102→    if (thresholdDebounceRef.current) {
   103→      clearTimeout(thresholdDebounceRef.current);
   104→    }
   105→    thresholdDebounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   106→      updateAutoTopup({
   107→        enabled: localAutoTopupEnabled,
   108→        amount: purchaseAmount,
   109→        threshold,
   110→      });
   111→    }, 500);
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const handlePurchaseAmountChange = (amount: number) => {
   115→    const previousAmount = purchaseAmount;
   116→    const previousThreshold = localAutoTopupThreshold;
   117→    setPurchaseAmount(amount);
   118→
   119→    if (localAutoTopupEnabled) {
   120→      const newThreshold = Math.max(1, Math.floor(amount / 5));
   121→
   122→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(newThreshold);
   123→
   124→      updateAutoTopup({
   125→        enabled: localAutoTopupEnabled,
   126→        amount: amount,
   127→        threshold: newThreshold,
   128→      }, {
   129→        onError: () => {
   130→          setPurchaseAmount(previousAmount);
   131→          setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(previousThreshold);
   132→        },
   133→      });
   134→    }
   135→  };
   136→
   137→  return {
   138→    purchaseAmount,
   139→    localAutoTopupEnabled,
   140→    localAutoTopupThreshold,
   141→    autoTopupState,
   142→    isUpdatingAutoTopup,
   143→    handlePurchaseAmountChange,
   144→    handleAutoTopupToggle,
   145→    handleAutoTopupThresholdChange,
   146→  };
   147→}

     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';

     6→
     7→interface UseGenerationDetailsOptions {
     8→  taskId?: string;
     9→  task?: Task;
    10→  inputImages?: string[];
    11→  projectId?: string | null;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseGenerationDetailsResult {
    15→  task: Task | undefined;
    16→  inputImages: string[];
    17→  isLoading: boolean;
    18→  isError: boolean;
    19→}
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Hook for fetching and preparing task data for GenerationDetails
    23→ *
    24→ * Handles:
    25→ * - Fetching task data by ID if provided
    26→ * - Using directly provided task if available
    27→ * - Deriving input images from task params
    28→ */
    29→export function useGenerationDetails({
    30→  taskId,
    31→  task: taskProp,
    32→  inputImages: inputImagesProp,
    33→  projectId,
    34→}: UseGenerationDetailsOptions): UseGenerationDetailsResult {
    35→  // Fetch task data if taskId is provided and no task prop
    36→  const { data: fetchedTask, isLoading, isError } = useGetTask(taskId || '', projectId);
    37→
    38→  // Use provided task or fetched task
    39→  const task = taskProp || fetchedTask;
    40→
    41→  // Derive input images from task if not explicitly provided
    42→  const inputImages = useMemo(() => {
    43→    if (inputImagesProp && inputImagesProp.length > 0) {
    44→      return inputImagesProp;
    45→    }
    46→    if (!task?.params) return [];
    47→    // Parse params if needed
    48→    let params: Record<string, unknown>;
    49→    try {
    50→      params = typeof task.params === 'string' ? JSON.parse(task.params) : task.params;
    51→    } catch (error) {
    52→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    53→        context: 'useGenerationDetails.parseTaskParams',
    54→        showToast: false,
    55→        logData: { taskId: task?.id, hasStringParams: typeof task?.params === 'string' },
    56→      });
    57→      return [];
    58→    }
    59→    return deriveInputImages(params);
    60→  }, [inputImagesProp, task]);
    61→
    62→  return {
    63→    task,
    64→    inputImages,
    65→    isLoading: taskId ? isLoading && !taskProp : false,
    66→    isError: taskId ? isError && !taskProp : false,
    67→  };
    68→}

    78→async function uploadLoraFilesToTempStorage(input: {
    79→  loraFiles: LoraFiles;
    80→  userId: string;
    81→  setUploadProgress: (progress: UploadProgress) => void;
    82→  uploadToTempStorage: (file: File, userId: string) => Promise<string>;
    83→}): Promise<TempStoragePaths | null> {
    84→  const { loraFiles, userId, setUploadProgress, uploadToTempStorage } = input;
    85→  const isMultiStage = !!(loraFiles.highNoise || loraFiles.lowNoise);
    86→  const storagePaths: TempStoragePaths = {};
    87→
    88→  if (isMultiStage) {
    89→    if (loraFiles.highNoise) {
    90→      setUploadProgress({
    91→        stage: 'uploading-high-noise',
    92→        message: 'Uploading high noise LoRA file...',
    93→        progress: 10,
    94→      });
    95→      storagePaths.highNoise = await uploadToTempStorage(loraFiles.highNoise, userId);
    96→    }
    97→
    98→    if (loraFiles.lowNoise) {
    99→      setUploadProgress({
   100→        stage: 'uploading-low-noise',
   101→        message: 'Uploading low noise LoRA file...',
   102→        progress: loraFiles.highNoise ? 20 : 10,
   103→      });
   104→      storagePaths.lowNoise = await uploadToTempStorage(loraFiles.lowNoise, userId);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    return storagePaths;
   108→  }
   109→
   110→  if (loraFiles.single) {
   111→    setUploadProgress({
   112→      stage: 'uploading-lora',
   113→      message: 'Uploading LoRA file...',
   114→      progress: 10,
   115→    });
   116→    storagePaths.single = await uploadToTempStorage(loraFiles.single, userId);
   117→    return storagePaths;
   118→  }
   119→
   120→  return null;

   122→
   123→async function uploadSampleVideosToTempStorage(input: {
   124→  sampleVideos: File[];
   125→  userId: string;
   126→  setUploadProgress: (progress: UploadProgress) => void;
   127→  uploadToTempStorage: (file: File, userId: string) => Promise<string>;
   128→}): Promise<SampleVideoMeta[]> {
   129→  const { sampleVideos, userId, setUploadProgress, uploadToTempStorage } = input;
   130→  const sampleVideoMeta: SampleVideoMeta[] = [];
   131→
   132→  if (sampleVideos.length === 0) {
   133→    return sampleVideoMeta;
   134→  }
   135→
   136→  setUploadProgress({
   137→    stage: 'uploading-samples',
   138→    message: `Uploading sample videos (0/${sampleVideos.length})...`,
   139→    progress: 30,
   140→  });
   141→
   142→  for (let i = 0; i < sampleVideos.length; i++) {
   143→    const video = sampleVideos[i];
   144→    setUploadProgress({
   145→      stage: 'uploading-samples',
   146→      message: `Uploading sample videos (${i + 1}/${sampleVideos.length})...`,
   147→      progress: 30 + (i / sampleVideos.length) * 20,
   148→    });
   149→
   150→    const storagePath = await uploadToTempStorage(video, userId);
   151→    sampleVideoMeta.push({
   152→      storagePath,
   153→      originalFileName: video.name,
   154→    });
   155→  }
   156→
   157→  return sampleVideoMeta;
   158→}
   159→
   160→async function invokeHuggingFaceUpload(input: {
   161→  storagePaths: TempStoragePaths;
   162→  loraDetails: LoraDetails;
   163→  sampleVideoMeta: SampleVideoMeta[];
   164→  options: { isPrivate?: boolean; repoName?: string };
   165→}): Promise<HuggingFaceUploadResponse> {
   166→  const formData = new FormData();
   167→  formData.append('loraStoragePaths', JSON.stringify(input.storagePaths));
   168→  formData.append('loraDetails', JSON.stringify(input.loraDetails));
   169→  formData.append('sampleVideos', JSON.stringify(input.sampleVideoMeta));
   170→
   171→  if (input.options.isPrivate !== undefined) {
   172→    formData.append('isPrivate', String(input.options.isPrivate));
   173→  }
   174→  if (input.options.repoName) {
   175→    formData.append('repoName', input.options.repoName);
   176→  }
   177→
   178→  const { data, error } = await supabase().functions.invoke('huggingface-upload', {
   179→    body: formData,
   180→  });
   181→
   182→  if (error) {
   183→    throw new Error(error.message || 'Edge function error');
   184→  }
   185→
   186→  if (!data?.success) {
   187→    throw new Error(data?.error || 'Upload failed');
   188→  }
   189→
   190→  return data;
   191→}

   205→/**
   206→ * Hook to handle uploading LoRA files to HuggingFace via our Edge Function
   207→ */
   208→export function useHuggingFaceUpload() {
   209→  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState<UploadProgress>({
   210→    stage: 'idle',
   211→    message: '',
   212→  });
   213→
   214→  /**
   215→   * Upload a file to the temporary storage bucket
   216→   */
   217→  const uploadToTempStorage = async (file: File, userId: string): Promise<string> => {
   218→    const fileName = `${crypto.randomUUID()}-${file.name}`;
   219→    const filePath = `${userId}/${fileName}`;
   220→    const { error } = await supabase().storage
   221→      .from('temporary')
   222→      .upload(filePath, file, {
   223→        cacheControl: '3600',
   224→        upsert: false,
   225→      });
   226→
   227→    if (error) {
   228→      throw new Error(`Failed to upload file: ${error.message}`);
   229→    }
   230→
   231→    return filePath;
   232→  };
   233→
   234→  /**
   235→   * Upload LoRA file(s) and optionally sample videos to HuggingFace.
   236→   * Supports both single-stage (one file) and multi-stage (high_noise + low_noise) LoRAs.
   237→   */
   238→  const uploadToHuggingFace = async (
   239→    loraFiles: LoraFiles,
   240→    loraDetails: LoraDetails,
   241→    sampleVideos: File[] = [],
   242→    options: {
   243→      isPrivate?: boolean;
   244→      repoName?: string;
   245→    } = {}
   246→  ): Promise<UploadResult> => {
   247→    try {
   248→      const { data: { user } } = await supabase().auth.getUser();
   249→      if (!user) {
   250→        return { success: false, error: 'Not authenticated' };
   251→      }
   252→
   253→      const storagePaths = await uploadLoraFilesToTempStorage({
   254→        loraFiles,
   255→        userId: user.id,
   256→        setUploadProgress,
   257→        uploadToTempStorage,
   258→      });
   259→
   260→      if (!storagePaths) {
   261→        return { success: false, error: 'No LoRA file provided' };
   262→      }
   263→
   264→      const sampleVideoMeta = await uploadSampleVideosToTempStorage({
   265→        sampleVideos,
   266→        userId: user.id,
   267→        setUploadProgress,
   268→        uploadToTempStorage,
   269→      });
   270→
   271→      setUploadProgress({
   272→        stage: 'processing',
   273→        message: 'Uploading to HuggingFace...',
   274→        progress: 60,
   275→      });
   276→
   277→      const response = await invokeHuggingFaceUpload({
   278→        storagePaths,
   279→        loraDetails,
   280→        sampleVideoMeta,
   281→        options,
   282→      });
   283→
   284→      setUploadProgress({
   285→        stage: 'complete',
   286→        message: 'Upload complete!',
   287→        progress: 100,
   288→      });
   289→
   290→      return mapUploadSuccess(response);
   291→    } catch (err) {
   292→      const errorMessage = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Unknown error';
   293→      setUploadProgress({
   294→        stage: 'error',
   295→        message: errorMessage,
   296→      });
   297→      return { success: false, error: errorMessage };
   298→    }
   299→  };
   300→
   301→  const resetProgress = () => {
   302→    setUploadProgress({ stage: 'idle', message: '' });
   303→  };
   304→
   305→  return {
   306→    uploadToHuggingFace,
   307→    uploadProgress,
   308→    resetProgress,
   309→    isUploading: uploadStages().includes(uploadProgress.stage),
   310→  };
   311→}
   312→

   187→            onScaleChange={onRepositionScaleChange}
   188→            onRotationChange={onRepositionRotationChange}
   189→            onFlipH={onRepositionFlipH}
   190→            onFlipV={onRepositionFlipV}
   191→            onReset={onRepositionReset}
   192→            variant={variant}
   193→          />
   194→        )}
   195→
   196→        {/* Common Controls - Undo & Clear (only for inpaint and annotate modes) */}
   197→        {(editMode === 'inpaint' || editMode === 'annotate') && (
   198→          <UndoClearButtons
   199→            onUndo={handleUndo}
   200→            onClear={handleClearMask}
   201→            disabled={brushStrokes.length === 0}
   202→            variant={variant}
   203→          />
   204→        )}
   205→      </div>
   206→
   207→      {/* Position Toggle Button - at bottom when panel is at top */}
   208→      {panelPosition === 'top' && (
   209→        <PositionToggleButton
   210→          direction="down"
   211→          onClick={() => onSetPanelPosition('bottom')}
   212→        />
   213→      )}
   214→    </div>
   215→  );
   216→};

1→import type { AppError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
     2→import {
     3→  reportError,
     4→  type ErrorReportOptions,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/coreReporter';
     6→import { presentRuntimeError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeErrorPresenter';
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}

     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +

    16→): number {

    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }

   394→                  displayHeight={displaySize.height}
   395→                  strokes={brushStrokes}
   396→                  isEraseMode={isEraseMode}
   397→                  brushSize={brushSize}
   398→                  annotationMode={annotationMode}
   399→                  isInpaintMode={isInpaintMode}
   400→                  isAnnotateMode={isAnnotateMode}
   401→                  editMode={editMode as 'text' | 'inpaint' | 'annotate' | 'reposition' | 'img2img'}
   402→                  onStrokeComplete={onStrokeComplete}
   403→                  onStrokesChange={onStrokesChange}
   404→                  onSelectionChange={onSelectionChange}
   405→                  onTextModeHint={onTextModeHint}
   406→                />
   407→              </div>
   408→            )}
   409→          </div>
   410→
   411→          {/* Preload full image in background when showing thumbnail */}
   412→          {thumbUrl && thumbUrl !== effectiveImageUrl && !fullImageLoaded && (
   413→            <img
   414→              src={effectiveImageUrl}
   415→              alt=""
   416→              className="hidden"
   417→              onLoad={(e) => {
   418→                const img = e.target as HTMLImageElement;
   419→                setFullImageLoaded(true);
   420→                onImageLoad?.({
   421→                  width: img.naturalWidth,
   422→                  height: img.naturalHeight
   423→                });
   424→              }}
   425→              onError={() => {
   426→                normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(`Full image preload failed: ${effectiveImageUrl}`), {
   427→                  context: `${debugContext}.onPreloadError`,
   428→                  showToast: false,
   429→                  logData: { url: effectiveImageUrl },
   430→                });
   431→                // Still try to show thumbnail
   432→              }}
   433→            />
   434→          )}
   435→
   436→          {/* Reposition mode overlays (bounds outline, zoom buttons, rotation handles) */}
   437→          {isRepositionMode && (
   438→            <RepositionOverlay
   439→              displaySize={displaySize}
   440→              imageOffset={imageOffset}
   441→              repositionTransformStyle={repositionTransformStyle}
   442→              repositionScale={repositionScale}
   443→              variant={variant}
   444→              handlesOverlayRef={handlesOverlayRef}
   445→              onRepositionScaleChange={onRepositionScaleChange}
   446→              onRepositionRotationChange={onRepositionRotationChange}
   447→              handleCornerRotateStart={handleCornerRotateStart}
   448→              handleCornerRotateMove={handleCornerRotateMove}
   449→              handleCornerRotateEnd={handleCornerRotateEnd}
   450→            />
   451→          )}
   452→
   453→          {/* Saving State Overlay */}
   454→          {isSaving && (
   455→            <div className={`absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center z-10 bg-black/50 backdrop-blur-sm ${variant === 'regular-centered' ? 'rounded' : ''}`}>
   456→              <div className="text-center text-white bg-black/80 rounded-lg p-4 backdrop-blur-sm border border-white/20">
   457→                <div className={`animate-spin rounded-full border-b-2 border-white mx-auto ${variant === 'mobile-stacked' ? 'h-10 w-10 mb-2' : 'h-12 w-12 mb-3'}`}></div>
   458→                <p className={`font-medium ${variant === 'mobile-stacked' ? 'text-base' : 'text-lg'}`}>Saving flipped image...</p>
   459→                <p className={`text-white/70 mt-1 ${variant === 'mobile-stacked' ? 'text-xs' : 'text-sm'}`}>Please wait</p>
   460→              </div>
   461→            </div>
   462→          )}
   463→
   464→        </div>
   465→      )}
   466→    </div>
   467→  );
   468→};
   469→

   273→/**
   274→ * Shared delete mutation factory for generations and variants.
   275→ * @internal
   276→ */
   277→function useDeleteFromTable(table: 'generations' | 'generation_variants', entityLabel: string) {
   278→  return useMutation({
   279→    mutationFn: async (input: ScopedGenerationInput | ScopedVariantInput) => {
   280→      const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   281→        input.projectId,
   282→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.projectScope`,
   283→      );
   284→
   285→      if (table === 'generations') {
   286→        await verifyGenerationScope(
   287→          input.id,
   288→          projectId,
   289→          `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   290→        );
   291→
   292→        const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   293→          id: input.id,
   294→          projectId,
   295→        });
   296→
   297→        if (error) {
   298→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   299→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   300→            showToast: false,
   301→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   302→          });
   303→        }
   304→
   305→        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   306→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   307→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   308→            showToast: false,
   309→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   310→          });
   311→        }
   312→
   313→        return;
   314→      }
   315→
   316→      const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   317→        input.id,
   318→        projectId,
   319→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   320→      );
   321→      const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   322→        id: input.id,
   323→        generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   324→      });
   325→
   326→      if (error) {
   327→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   328→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   329→          showToast: false,
   330→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   331→        });
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   335→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   336→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   337→          showToast: false,
   338→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   339→        });
   340→      }
   341→    },
   342→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   343→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→        context: `useDelete${entityLabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + entityLabel.slice(1)}`,
   345→        toastTitle: `Failed to delete ${entityLabel}`,
   346→      });
   347→    },
   348→  });
   349→}
   350→
   351→export function useDeleteGeneration() {
   352→  return useDeleteFromTable('generations', 'generation');
   353→}
   354→
   355→/**
   356→ * Delete a variant from generation_variants table.
   357→ * Use this for edit tools (edit-images, edit-video, character-animate) that create variants.
   358→ */
   359→export function useDeleteVariant() {
   360→  return useDeleteFromTable('generation_variants', 'variant');
   361→}
   362→
   363→export function useUpdateGenerationLocation() {
   364→  return useMutation({
   365→    mutationFn: ({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId }: { id: string; location: string; thumbUrl?: string; projectId: string }) => {
   366→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });
   367→    },
   368→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   369→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useUpdateGenerationLocation', toastTitle: 'Failed to update generation' });
   370→    },
   371→  });
   372→}
   373→
   374→export function useCreateGeneration() {
   375→  return useMutation({
   376→    mutationFn: createGeneration,
   377→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   378→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useCreateGeneration', toastTitle: 'Failed to create generation' });
   379→    },
   380→  });
   381→}
   382→
   383→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {
   384→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   385→
   386→  return useMutation({
   387→    mutationFn: ({ id, starred, projectId }: { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }) => {
   388→      return toggleGenerationStar({ id, starred, projectId });
   389→    },
   390→    onMutate: async ({ id, starred, shotId }) => {
   391→      return applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, {
   392→        generationId: id,
   393→        starred,
   394→        shotId,
   395→      });
   396→    },
   397→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   398→      rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, context);
   399→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToggleGenerationStar', toastTitle: 'Failed to toggle star' });
   400→    },
   401→    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
   402→      // Emit custom event so Timeline knows to refetch star data
   403→      if (variables.shotId) {
   404→        dispatchAppEvent('generation-star-updated', {
   405→          generationId: variables.id, shotId: variables.shotId!, starred: variables.starred,
   406→        });
   407→      }
   408→    },
   409→  });
   410→}
   411→

   162→/**
   163→ * Create a new generation using direct Supabase call.
   164→ * @internal Used by useCreateGeneration hook.
   165→ */
   166→async function createGeneration(params: {
   167→  imageUrl: string;
   168→  fileName: string;
   169→  fileType: string;
   170→  fileSize: number;
   171→  projectId: string;
   172→  prompt: string;
   173→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
   174→  /** Resolution in "WIDTHxHEIGHT" format (e.g., "1920x1080") */
   175→  resolution?: string;
   176→  /** Standard aspect ratio (e.g., "16:9") */
   177→  aspectRatio?: string;
   178→}): Promise<GenerationRow> {
   179→  const generationParams: Record<string, Json | undefined> = {
   180→    prompt: params.prompt,
   181→    source: 'external_upload',
   182→    original_filename: params.fileName,
   183→    file_type: params.fileType,
   184→    file_size: params.fileSize,
   185→  };
   186→
   187→  // Add dimension params if provided
   188→  if (params.resolution) {
   189→    generationParams.resolution = params.resolution;
   190→  }
   191→  if (params.aspectRatio) {
   192→    generationParams.aspect_ratio = params.aspectRatio;
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  const { data, error } = await createGenerationRecord({
   196→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   197→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   198→    fileType: params.fileType || 'image',
   199→    projectId: params.projectId,
   200→    generationParams,
   201→  });
   202→
   203→  if (error || !data) {
   204→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error ?? new Error('Failed to create generation'), {
   205→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createGeneration',
   206→      showToast: false,
   207→      logData: { projectId: params.projectId },
   208→    });
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  // Create the original variant for this generation
   212→  const { error: variantError } = await createGenerationPrimaryVariant({
   213→    generationId: data.id,
   214→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   215→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   216→    generationParams,
   217→    variantType: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  if (variantError) {
   221→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(variantError, {
   222→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createVariant',
   223→      showToast: false,
   224→    });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  return data;
   228→}

   234→async function toggleGenerationStar(params: ScopedGenerationInput & { starred: boolean }): Promise<void> {

   262→      {
   263→        context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.noRows',
   264→        showToast: false,
   265→        logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   266→      },

   271→// ===== Mutation Hooks =====
   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Shared delete mutation factory for generations and variants.
   275→ * @internal
   276→ */
   277→function useDeleteFromTable(table: 'generations' | 'generation_variants', entityLabel: string) {
   278→  return useMutation({
   279→    mutationFn: async (input: ScopedGenerationInput | ScopedVariantInput) => {
   280→      const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   281→        input.projectId,
   282→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.projectScope`,
   283→      );
   284→
   285→      if (table === 'generations') {
   286→        await verifyGenerationScope(
   287→          input.id,
   288→          projectId,
   289→          `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   290→        );
   291→
   292→        const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   293→          id: input.id,
   294→          projectId,
   295→        });
   296→
   297→        if (error) {
   298→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   299→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   300→            showToast: false,
   301→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   302→          });
   303→        }
   304→
   305→        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   306→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   307→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   308→            showToast: false,
   309→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   310→          });
   311→        }
   312→
   313→        return;
   314→      }
   315→
   316→      const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   317→        input.id,
   318→        projectId,
   319→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   320→      );
   321→      const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   322→        id: input.id,
   323→        generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   324→      });
   325→
   326→      if (error) {
   327→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   328→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   329→          showToast: false,
   330→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   331→        });
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   335→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   336→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   337→          showToast: false,
   338→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   339→        });
   340→      }
   341→    },
   342→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   343→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→        context: `useDelete${entityLabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + entityLabel.slice(1)}`,
   345→        toastTitle: `Failed to delete ${entityLabel}`,
   346→      });
   347→    },
   348→  });
   349→}
   350→
   351→export function useDeleteGeneration() {
   352→  return useDeleteFromTable('generations', 'generation');
   353→}
   354→
   355→/**
   356→ * Delete a variant from generation_variants table.
   357→ * Use this for edit tools (edit-images, edit-video, character-animate) that create variants.
   358→ */
   359→export function useDeleteVariant() {
   360→  return useDeleteFromTable('generation_variants', 'variant');
   361→}

   366→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });
   367→    },

   370→    },

   379→    },

   383→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {
   384→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   385→
   386→  return useMutation({
   387→    mutationFn: ({ id, starred, projectId }: { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }) => {
   388→      return toggleGenerationStar({ id, starred, projectId });
   389→    },
   390→    onMutate: async ({ id, starred, shotId }) => {
   391→      return applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, {
   392→        generationId: id,
   393→        starred,
   394→        shotId,
   395→      });
   396→    },
   397→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   398→      rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, context);
   399→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToggleGenerationStar', toastTitle: 'Failed to toggle star' });
   400→    },
   401→    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {

   403→      if (variables.shotId) {
   404→        dispatchAppEvent('generation-star-updated', {
   405→          generationId: variables.id, shotId: variables.shotId!, starred: variables.starred,
   406→        });
   407→      }
   408→    },
   409→  });
   410→}

1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→

1→export const fileToDataURL = (file: File): Promise<string> =>
     2→  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     3→    const reader = new FileReader();
     4→    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
     5→    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
     6→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
     7→  });
     8→
     9→export const dataURLtoFile = (
    10→  dataUrl: string,
    11→  filename: string,
    12→  fileType?: string
    13→): File | null => {
    14→  try {
    15→    const [metadata, payload] = dataUrl.split(',');
    16→    if (!metadata || !payload) {
    17→      throw new Error('Invalid Data URL format');
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    const mimeMatch = metadata.match(/:(.*?);/);
    21→    const mimeType =
    22→      fileType ||
    23→      (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) ||
    24→      'application/octet-stream';
    25→    const decodedPayload = atob(payload);
    26→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(decodedPayload.length);
    27→
    28→    for (let i = 0; i < decodedPayload.length; i += 1) {
    29→      bytes[i] = decodedPayload.charCodeAt(i);
    30→    }
    31→
    32→    return new File([bytes], filename, { type: mimeType });
    33→  } catch {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→};
    37→

    45→---
    46→
    47→## Tech Stack
    48→
    49→| Layer | Technology | Purpose |
    50→|-------|------------|---------|
    51→| **Frontend** | React + Vite + TypeScript | SPA framework & build tooling |
    52→| **Styling** | TailwindCSS + shadcn-ui | Utility CSS with container queries (`@container`) |
    53→| **Backend** | Supabase (Postgres + Edge Functions) | Database, auth, storage, serverless workers |
    54→
    55→**Dev server:** `http://localhost:2222` • **Package managers:** npm (default) or bun
    56→
    57→---
    58→
    59→## Directory Structure
    60→
    61→| Path | Purpose | Key Files |
    62→|------|---------|-----------|
    63→| `/src/app` | App bootstrap & routing | `main.tsx` → `App.tsx` → `routes.tsx` → `Layout.tsx` |
    64→| `/src/pages` | Top-level pages | `HomePage`, `ShotsPage`, `ArtPage`, `SharePage`, `NotFoundPage`, payment pages |
    65→| `/src/tools` | Feature modules | Each tool: `pages/`, `components/`, `hooks/`, `settings.ts` |
    66→| `/src/shared` | Shared code | `components/ui/` (shadcn), `hooks/`, `contexts/`, `lib/` |
    67→| `/supabase/functions` | Edge Functions | Task processing, payments, AI integration |
    68→| `/supabase/migrations` | DB migrations | Schema changes (use `db push --linked`) |
    69→| Root | Build configs | `vite.config.ts`, `tailwind.config.ts`, `railway.toml` |
    70→
    71→---
    72→
    73→## Core Concepts
    74→
    75→### Tools
    76→Tools live in `/src/tools/{tool-name}/` following a consistent structure. See [adding_new_tool.md](docs/structure_detail/adding_new_tool.md).
    77→
    78→**Active tools:** Image Generation, Video Travel, Animate Characters, Edit Images, Edit Video, Join Clips, Training Data Helper
    79→
    80→### Shots & Generations
    81→- **Generations** = gallery items (images/videos produced by AI tasks)
    82→- **Shots** = containers that organize generations into a timeline
    83→- **`shot_generations`** = join table with position + metadata (pair prompts, timeline frame)
    84→- Data access: `useShotImages(shotId)` → see [data_fetching.md](docs/structure_detail/data_fetching.md)
    85→
    86→### Settings Resolution
    87→Priority: **shot → project → user → defaults**. See [settings_system.md](docs/structure_detail/settings_system.md).
    88→
    89→### Task System
    90→Async queue for AI workloads: client creates task → DB trigger → worker polls → Edge Function completes.
    91→See [task_worker_lifecycle.md](docs/structure_detail/task_worker_lifecycle.md).
    92→
    93→### Realtime
    94→Smart polling + Supabase realtime subscriptions. Connected = no polling; disconnected = 15s fallback.
    95→See [realtime_system.md](docs/structure_detail/realtime_system.md).
    96→
    97→---
    98→
    99→## Key Utilities
   100→

1→/**
     2→ * ModeSelector Component
     3→ *
     4→ * A responsive mode selector that automatically switches to icon-only mode
     5→ * when there isn't enough space to display text labels without truncation.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import React, { useRef, useEffect, useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { cn } from '@/shared/components/ui/contracts/cn';
    10→import { Tooltip, TooltipContent, TooltipTrigger } from '@/shared/components/ui/tooltip';
    11→
    12→interface ModeSelectorItem {
    13→  id: string;
    14→  label: string;
    15→  icon: React.ReactNode;
    16→  onClick: () => void;
    17→}
    18→
    19→interface ModeSelectorProps {
    20→  items: ModeSelectorItem[];
    21→  activeId: string;
    22→  className?: string;
    23→}
    24→
    25→export const ModeSelector: React.FC<ModeSelectorProps> = ({
    26→  items,
    27→  activeId,
    28→  className,
    29→}) => {
    30→  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    31→  const measureRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    32→  const [showIconsOnly, setShowIconsOnly] = useState(false);
    33→
    34→  // Calculate minimum width needed for text mode
    35→  // Each button needs: icon (14px) + gap (6px) + text width + padding (24px horizontal)
    36→  // Plus gaps between buttons
    37→  const checkIfTextFits = useCallback(() => {
    38→    const container = containerRef.current;
    39→    const measureDiv = measureRef.current;
    40→    if (!container || !measureDiv) return;
    41→
    42→    // Get the available width (container width minus padding and gaps)
    43→    const containerWidth = container.clientWidth;
    44→    const padding = 8; // p-1 = 4px each side
    45→    const gaps = (items.length - 1) * 4; // gap-1 = 4px between items
    46→    const availableWidth = containerWidth - padding - gaps;
    47→
    48→    // Measure the hidden text spans to get required width
    49→    const spans = measureDiv.querySelectorAll('span');
    50→    let totalRequiredWidth = 0;
    51→
    52→    spans.forEach((span) => {
    53→      // Each button needs: padding (24px) + icon (14px) + gap (6px) + text width
    54→      const textWidth = span.scrollWidth;
    55→      const buttonWidth = 24 + 14 + 6 + textWidth;
    56→      totalRequiredWidth += buttonWidth;
    57→    });
    58→
    59→    // If we need more width than available, show icons only
    60→    const needsIconsOnly = totalRequiredWidth > availableWidth;
    61→    setShowIconsOnly(needsIconsOnly);
    62→  }, [items]);
    63→
    64→  useEffect(() => {
    65→    const container = containerRef.current;
    66→    if (!container) return;
    67→
    68→    // Initial check
    69→    checkIfTextFits();
    70→
    71→    // Set up ResizeObserver
    72→    const resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
    73→      checkIfTextFits();
    74→    });
    75→
    76→    resizeObserver.observe(container);
    77→
    78→    return () => {
    79→      resizeObserver.disconnect();
    80→    };
    81→  }, [checkIfTextFits]);
    82→
    83→  return (
    84→    <>
    85→      {/* Hidden measurement div - always renders text to measure */}
    86→      <div
    87→        ref={measureRef}
    88→        className="absolute opacity-0 pointer-events-none whitespace-nowrap text-sm"
    89→        aria-hidden="true"
    90→      >
    91→        {items.map((item) => (
    92→          <span key={item.id} className="inline-block px-1">
    93→            {item.label}
    94→          </span>
    95→        ))}
    96→      </div>
    97→
    98→      {/* Visible selector */}
    99→      <div
   100→        ref={containerRef}
   101→        className={cn(
   102→          "flex gap-1 border border-border rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-muted/30 p-1",
   103→          className
   104→        )}
   105→      >
   106→        {items.map((item) => {
   107→          const button = (
   108→            <button
   109→              key={item.id}
   110→              onClick={item.onClick}
   111→              className={cn(
   112→                "flex-1 min-w-0 flex items-center justify-center transition-all rounded overflow-hidden",
   113→                showIconsOnly ? "p-2" : "gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 text-sm",
   114→                activeId === item.id
   115→                  ? "bg-background text-foreground font-medium shadow-sm"
   116→                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted/50"
   117→              )}
   118→            >
   119→              <span className={cn("flex-shrink-0", showIconsOnly ? "[&>svg]:h-4 [&>svg]:w-4" : "[&>svg]:h-3.5 [&>svg]:w-3.5")}>
   120→                {item.icon}
   121→              </span>
   122→              {!showIconsOnly && (
   123→                <span className="truncate">
   124→                  {item.label}
   125→                </span>
   126→              )}
   127→            </button>
   128→          );
   129→
   130→          // Wrap in tooltip when showing icons only
   131→          if (showIconsOnly) {
   132→            return (
   133→              <Tooltip key={item.id}>
   134→                <TooltipTrigger asChild>
   135→                  {button}
   136→                </TooltipTrigger>
   137→                <TooltipContent side="bottom" className="text-xs">
   138→                  {item.label}
   139→                </TooltipContent>
   140→              </Tooltip>
   141→            );
   142→          }
   143→
   144→          return button;
   145→        })}
   146→      </div>
   147→    </>
   148→  );
   149→};
   150→

     3→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';

    29→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    30→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    31→    return projectId;
    32→  }
    33→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    34→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    35→    return selectedProjectId;
    36→  }
    37→  return null;
    38→}
    39→
    40→/**
    41→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    42→ */
    43→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    44→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    45→  generationIds: string[],
    46→  projectId: string | null,
    47→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    48→) {
    49→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    50→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    51→  const {
    52→    batchSize = 5,
    53→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    54→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    55→  } = options;
    56→
    57→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    58→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    59→
    60→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    61→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    62→
    63→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    64→
    65→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    66→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    67→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    68→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    69→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    70→        cacheEntry,
    71→      );
    72→
    73→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    74→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    76→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    77→          showToast: false,
    78→        });
    79→      }
    80→
    81→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    82→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    83→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    84→          queryFn: async () => {
    85→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    86→              .from('tasks')
    87→              .select('*')
    88→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    89→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    90→              .single();
    91→
    92→            if (error) throw error;
    93→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    94→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    95→            }
    96→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    97→          },
    98→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    99→        }));
   100→      }
   101→    });
   102→
   103→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   104→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   108→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   114→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   115→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   116→  projectId: string | null,
   117→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   118→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   119→
   120→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   121→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   122→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   123→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   124→    );
   125→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   126→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   127→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   128→      : null;
   129→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   130→
   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   137→    };
   138→  });
   139→}

   335→  const promptToEnhance = enhancedPrompt?.trim() || effectiveSettings.prompt?.trim() || '';
   336→  const buildParams = buildSubmitParamsBuilder(effectiveSettings, task, images);
   337→

   339→  onGenerateStarted?.();

   398→export function useInlineEditState(
   399→  media: GenerationRow,
   400→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   417→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   418→      : undefined,
   419→  });
   420→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   421→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   422→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   423→  };
   424→  const {
   425→    inpaintingState,
   426→    transformState,
   427→    generationState,
   428→    imageEditValue,
   429→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   430→    env,
   431→    persistence,
   432→    inpainting,
   433→    magic,
   434→    reposition,
   435→    img2img,
   436→    starToggle,
   437→    handleDownload,
   438→  });
   439→  return {
   440→    media,
   441→    canvasEnvironment: {
   442→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   443→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   444→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   445→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   446→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   447→      effectiveImageUrl,
   448→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   449→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   450→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   451→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   452→    },
   453→    inpaintingState,
   454→    transformState,
   455→    generationState,
   456→    variants: {
   457→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   458→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   459→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   460→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   461→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   462→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   463→    },
   464→    sourceGenerationData,
   465→    availableLoras,
   466→    imageEditValue,
   467→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   468→}

   398→export function useInlineEditState(
   399→  media: GenerationRow,
   400→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   417→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   418→      : undefined,
   419→  });
   420→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   421→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   422→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   423→  };
   424→  const {
   425→    inpaintingState,
   426→    transformState,
   427→    generationState,
   428→    imageEditValue,
   429→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   430→    env,
   431→    persistence,
   432→    inpainting,
   433→    magic,
   434→    reposition,
   435→    img2img,
   436→    starToggle,
   437→    handleDownload,
   438→  });
   439→  return {
   440→    media,
   441→    canvasEnvironment: {
   442→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   443→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   444→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   445→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   446→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   447→      effectiveImageUrl,
   448→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   449→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   450→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   451→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   452→    },
   453→    inpaintingState,
   454→    transformState,
   455→    generationState,
   456→    variants: {
   457→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   458→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   459→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   460→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   461→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   462→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   463→    },
   464→    sourceGenerationData,
   465→    availableLoras,
   466→    imageEditValue,
   467→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   468→}

    37→  isGeneratingImg2Img: false,

    53→interface ImageEditStatusProviderProps {

1→/**
     2→ * useAdjustedTaskDetails - Fetches variant source task and computes adjusted task details
     3→ *
     4→ * For variants created by tasks, shows the variant's source task params
     5→ * instead of the original generation's task. Preserves onApplySettingsFromTask.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     9→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
    12→import { VARIANT_TYPE } from '@/shared/constants/variantTypes';
    13→import {
    14→  getSourceTaskIdLegacyCompatible,
    15→  hasOrchestratorDetails,
    16→} from '@/shared/lib/taskIdHelpers';
    17→import type { TaskDetailsData } from '../types';
    18→import type { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
    19→
    20→// Helper to derive input images from task params
    21→function deriveInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    22→  const images: string[] = [];
    23→
    24→  // Check various param locations for input images
    25→  const orchestratorDetails = params.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    26→
    27→  // Direct input_images array
    28→  if (Array.isArray(params.input_images)) {
    29→    images.push(...params.input_images.filter((img): img is string => typeof img === 'string'));
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  // Orchestrator details input_images
    33→  if (orchestratorDetails && Array.isArray(orchestratorDetails.input_images)) {
    34→    images.push(...orchestratorDetails.input_images.filter((img): img is string => typeof img === 'string'));
    35→  }
    36→
    37→  // Start/end image URLs
    38→  if (typeof params.start_image_url === 'string') images.push(params.start_image_url);
    39→  if (typeof params.end_image_url === 'string') images.push(params.end_image_url);
    40→
    41→  // Orchestrator start/end
    42→  if (orchestratorDetails) {
    43→    if (typeof orchestratorDetails.start_image_url === 'string') images.push(orchestratorDetails.start_image_url);
    44→    if (typeof orchestratorDetails.end_image_url === 'string') images.push(orchestratorDetails.end_image_url);
    45→  }
    46→
    47→  return [...new Set(images)]; // Dedupe
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface UseAdjustedTaskDetailsProps {
    51→  projectId?: string | null;
    52→  activeVariant: {
    53→    id: string;
    54→    params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    55→    variant_type?: string | null;
    56→    created_at?: string;
    57→    is_primary?: boolean | null;
    58→  } | null;
    59→  taskDetailsData: TaskDetailsData | undefined;
    60→  isLoadingVariants: boolean;
    61→  initialVariantId: string | undefined;
    62→}
    63→
    64→interface UseAdjustedTaskDetailsReturn {
    65→  adjustedTaskDetailsData: TaskDetailsData | undefined;
    66→  isLoadingVariantTask: boolean;
    67→}
    68→
    69→export function useAdjustedTaskDetails({
    70→  projectId,
    71→  activeVariant,
    72→  taskDetailsData,
    73→  isLoadingVariants,
    74→  initialVariantId,
    75→}: UseAdjustedTaskDetailsProps): UseAdjustedTaskDetailsReturn {
    76→  // Extract source_task_id and check if variant already has orchestrator_details
    77→  const { variantSourceTaskId, variantHasOrchestratorDetails } = useMemo(() => {
    78→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    79→    return {
    80→      variantSourceTaskId: getSourceTaskIdLegacyCompatible(variantParams),
    81→      variantHasOrchestratorDetails: hasOrchestratorDetails(variantParams),
    82→    };
    83→  }, [activeVariant?.params]);
    84→
    85→  // Fetch the variant's source task when it differs from taskDetailsData
    86→  // Skip fetch if variant already has orchestrator_details (e.g., clip_join variants)
    87→  // NOTE: Uses ['tasks', 'single', taskId] query key to share cache with usePrefetchTaskData
    88→  const { data: variantSourceTask, isLoading: isLoadingVariantTask } = useQuery({
    89→    [REDACTED](variantSourceTaskId ?? '', projectId ?? null),
    90→    queryFn: async () => {
    91→      if (!variantSourceTaskId || !projectId) return null;
    92→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('tasks')
    93→        .select('*')
    94→        .eq('id', variantSourceTaskId)
    95→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
    96→        .single();
    97→      if (error) {
    98→        console.error('[VariantTaskDetails] Error fetching source task:', error);
    99→        return null;
   100→      }
   101→      return data;
   102→    },
   103→    // Don't fetch if: no task ID, already have matching taskDetailsData, or variant has orchestrator_details
   104→    enabled: !!variantSourceTaskId
   105→      && !!projectId
   106→      && variantSourceTaskId !== taskDetailsData?.taskId
   107→      && !variantHasOrchestratorDetails,
   108→    staleTime: Infinity, // Task data is immutable - cache forever (matches prefetch)
   109→  });
   110→
   111→  // For variants, show the variant's source task params instead of the original task
   112→  // But ALWAYS preserve onApplySettingsFromTask so the Apply button shows
   113→  const adjustedTaskDetailsData = useMemo(() => {
   114→    // Check if we're viewing a variant that was created by a task (has source_task_id in params)
   115→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   116→    const isTaskCreatedVariant = activeVariant && variantParams && (
   117→      variantParams.source_task_id ||
   118→      variantParams.created_from ||
   119→      (activeVariant.variant_type && activeVariant.variant_type !== VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL)
   120→    );
   121→
   122→    if (isTaskCreatedVariant && variantParams) {
   123→      // Check if taskDetailsData already has the correct task (e.g., when opened from TasksPane)
   124→      const sourceTaskId = typeof variantParams.source_task_id === 'string' ? variantParams.source_task_id : undefined;
   125→      const hasMatchingTaskData = taskDetailsData?.taskId === sourceTaskId && taskDetailsData?.task?.params;
   126→
   127→      // Determine the best source of task params:
   128→      // 1. If taskDetailsData matches, use its params (already have full data)
   129→      // 2. If we fetched the source task, use its params
   130→      // 3. Fall back to variant params (may be incomplete)
   131→      // IMPORTANT: Use variant_type for display (e.g., 'clip_join'), NOT tool_type
   132→      // tool_type is the tool that launched the task (e.g., 'travel-between-images'),
   133→      // which is different from what kind of variant this is
   134→      let effectiveParams = variantParams;
   135→      const effectiveTaskType = activeVariant.variant_type || 'variant';
   136→
   137→      if (hasMatchingTaskData) {
   138→        effectiveParams = (taskDetailsData.task?.params ?? variantParams) as Record<string, unknown>;
   139→      } else if (!variantParams.orchestrator_details && variantSourceTask?.params) {
   140→        // Only use fetched task params if variant doesn't already have orchestrator_details
   141→        // clip_join variants store orchestrator_details directly, so we don't want to overwrite
   142→        try {
   143→          effectiveParams = typeof variantSourceTask.params === 'string'
   144→            ? JSON.parse(variantSourceTask.params)
   145→            : variantSourceTask.params;
   146→        } catch {
   147→          // Keep variantParams as fallback on parse failure
   148→        }
   149→      }
   150→      // Otherwise keep variantParams which may already have orchestrator_details (e.g., clip_join)
   151→
   152→      // Extract input images using shared utility
   153→      // This handles segment tasks (only segment images) vs full timeline tasks
   154→      const variantInputImages = deriveInputImages(effectiveParams);
   155→
   156→      return {
   157→        task: {
   158→          id: activeVariant.id,
   159→          taskType: effectiveTaskType,
   160→          params: effectiveParams,
   161→          status: 'Complete' as Task['status'],
   162→          createdAt: activeVariant.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
   163→          projectId: '',
   164→        } as Task,
   165→        isLoading: isLoadingVariantTask,
   166→        error: null,
   167→        inputImages: variantInputImages,
   168→        taskId: sourceTaskId ?? activeVariant.id,
   169→        // ALWAYS preserve onApplySettingsFromTask so Apply button shows for all variants
   170→        onApplySettingsFromTask: taskDetailsData?.onApplySettingsFromTask,
   171→      };
   172→    }
   173→
   174→    // If variants are still loading AND we don't have task data yet, show loading
   175→    // But if we already have task data cached, show it immediately rather than blocking on variants
   176→    // This provides better UX when task data is prefetched/cached
   177→    // ALSO check if we're waiting for initialVariantId to be applied (clicked a specific variant)
   178→    const waitingForInitialVariant = initialVariantId &&
   179→      (!activeVariant || activeVariant.id !== initialVariantId);
   180→
   181→    // Only override to loading if:
   182→    // 1. Waiting for a specific variant (user clicked a variant)
   183→    // 2. Variants loading AND no active variant AND task details still loading
   184→    //    (If task details finished - either has task or knows there's none - don't block on variants)
   185→    const shouldShowLoading = waitingForInitialVariant ||
   186→      (isLoadingVariants && !activeVariant && taskDetailsData?.isLoading);
   187→
   188→    if (shouldShowLoading) {
   189→      return taskDetailsData ? { ...taskDetailsData, isLoading: true } : taskDetailsData;
   190→    }
   191→
   192→    // For all other cases, use the generation's task details as-is
   193→    return taskDetailsData;
   194→  }, [taskDetailsData, activeVariant, variantSourceTask, isLoadingVariantTask, isLoadingVariants, initialVariantId]);
   195→
   196→  return {
   197→    adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   198→    isLoadingVariantTask,
   199→  };
   200→}
   201→

1→import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS } from '@/domains/lora/lib/loraUtils';
     3→
     4→export type LoraMode = 'none' | 'in-scene' | 'next-scene' | 'custom';
     5→
     6→interface UseEditModeLorasReturn {
     7→  // Mode selection for automatic LoRAs
     8→  loraMode: LoraMode;
     9→  setLoraMode: (mode: LoraMode) => void;
    10→  
    11→  // Custom URL support
    12→  customLoraUrl: string;
    13→  setCustomLoraUrl: (url: string) => void;
    14→  
    15→  // The computed LoRAs based on mode
    16→  editModeLoras: Array<{ url: string; strength: number }> | undefined;
    17→  
    18→  // Legacy boolean support for backward compatibility
    19→  isInSceneBoostEnabled: boolean;
    20→  setIsInSceneBoostEnabled: (enabled: boolean) => void;
    21→}
    22→
    23→/**
    24→ * Hook to manage LoRA mode state for image editing operations
    25→ * Supports: In-Scene, Next Scene, Custom, or None
    26→ * Used by both inpainting and magic edit modes
    27→ */
    28→export const useEditModeLoras = (): UseEditModeLorasReturn => {
    29→  const [loraMode, setLoraMode] = useState<LoraMode>('none'); // Default to no preset LoRA
    30→  const [customLoraUrl, setCustomLoraUrl] = useState<string>('');
    31→
    32→  // Legacy boolean support - map to new lora mode
    33→  const isInSceneBoostEnabled = loraMode !== 'none';
    34→  const setIsInSceneBoostEnabled = (enabled: boolean) => {
    35→    setLoraMode(enabled ? 'in-scene' : 'none');
    36→  };
    37→
    38→  // Build loras array based on selected mode
    39→  const editModeLoras = useMemo(() => {
    40→    switch (loraMode) {
    41→      case 'in-scene':
    42→        return [{
    43→          url: EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS['in-scene'],
    44→          strength: 1.0
    45→        }];
    46→      case 'next-scene':
    47→        return [{
    48→          url: EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS['next-scene'],
    49→          strength: 1.0
    50→        }];
    51→      case 'custom':
    52→        // Only return custom lora if URL is provided
    53→        return customLoraUrl.trim() ? [{
    54→          url: customLoraUrl.trim(),
    55→          strength: 1.0
    56→        }] : undefined;
    57→      case 'none':
    58→      default:
    59→        return undefined;
    60→    }
    61→  }, [loraMode, customLoraUrl]);
    62→
    63→  return {
    64→    // Mode selection
    65→    loraMode,
    66→    setLoraMode,
    67→    // Custom URL
    68→    customLoraUrl,
    69→    setCustomLoraUrl,
    70→    // Computed LoRAs
    71→    editModeLoras,
    72→    // Legacy boolean support
    73→    isInSceneBoostEnabled,
    74→    setIsInSceneBoostEnabled,
    75→  };
    76→};
    77→
