1→/**
     2→ * usePanelModeRestore Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles automatic restoration of edit/info panel mode when media changes.
     5→ * If the user was last in edit mode, automatically re-enters edit mode.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useRef, useEffect } from 'react';
     9→
    10→interface UsePanelModeRestoreProps {
    11→  /** Current media ID for tracking changes */
    12→  mediaId: string;
    13→  /** Persisted panel mode from last used settings */
    14→  persistedPanelMode: 'edit' | 'info' | null | undefined;
    15→  /** Whether currently in special edit mode (image) */
    16→  isSpecialEditMode: boolean;
    17→  /** Whether currently in video edit mode */
    18→  isInVideoEditMode: boolean;
    19→  /** Whether initial video trim mode was requested */
    20→  initialVideoTrimMode?: boolean;
    21→  /** Whether initial edit active was requested (explicit mode set, skip restore) */
    22→  initialEditActive?: boolean;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface UseVideoPanelModeRestoreProps extends UsePanelModeRestoreProps {
    26→  isVideo: true;
    27→  /** Handler to enter video edit mode */
    28→  handleEnterVideoEditMode: () => void;
    29→}
    30→
    31→interface UseImagePanelModeRestoreProps extends UsePanelModeRestoreProps {
    32→  isVideo: false;
    33→  /** Handler to enter magic edit mode (image) */
    34→  handleEnterMagicEditMode: () => void;
    35→}
    36→
    37→interface UsePanelModeRestoreReturn {
    38→  /** Whether panel mode has been restored for current media */
    39→  hasRestoredPanelMode: boolean;
    40→}
    41→
    42→/**
    43→ * Automatically restores the last used panel mode (edit/info) when opening a media item.
    44→ * Prevents loops by tracking restoration per-media and respecting explicit modes.
    45→ */
    46→export function usePanelModeRestore({
    47→  mediaId,
    48→  persistedPanelMode,
    49→  isVideo,
    50→  isSpecialEditMode,
    51→  isInVideoEditMode,
    52→  initialVideoTrimMode,
    53→  initialEditActive,
    54→  ...modeHandlers
    55→}: UseVideoPanelModeRestoreProps | UseImagePanelModeRestoreProps): UsePanelModeRestoreReturn {
    56→  const hasRestoredPanelModeRef = useRef(false);
    57→  const enterEditMode = isVideo
    58→    ? modeHandlers.handleEnterVideoEditMode
    59→    : modeHandlers.handleEnterMagicEditMode;
    60→
    61→  // Main restoration effect
    62→  useEffect(() => {
    63→
    64→    // Only restore once per media (prevent loops)
    65→    if (hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current) {
    66→      return;
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    // Don't restore if initialVideoTrimMode or initialEditActive is set (explicit modes take precedence)
    70→    if (initialVideoTrimMode || initialEditActive) {
    71→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    72→      return;
    73→    }
    74→
    75→    // Don't restore if already in edit mode
    76→    if (isSpecialEditMode || isInVideoEditMode) {
    77→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    78→      return;
    79→    }
    80→
    81→    if (persistedPanelMode === 'edit') {
    82→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    83→      setTimeout(() => enterEditMode(), 0);
    84→    } else {
    85→      hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = true;
    86→    }
    87→  }, [
    88→    persistedPanelMode,
    89→    enterEditMode,
    90→    initialVideoTrimMode,
    91→    initialEditActive,
    92→    isSpecialEditMode,
    93→    isInVideoEditMode,
    94→  ]);
    95→
    96→  // Reset restore flag when media changes
    97→  useEffect(() => {
    98→    hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current = false;
    99→  }, [mediaId]);
   100→
   101→  return {
   102→    hasRestoredPanelMode: hasRestoredPanelModeRef.current,
   103→  };
   104→}
   105→

1→/**
     2→ * useReplaceInShot Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Handles swapping timeline position from a parent generation to the current image.
     5→ * Used when user wants to replace a parent image in the timeline with a derived image.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→
    12→interface UseReplaceInShotProps {
    13→  /** Callback to close the lightbox after successful replacement */
    14→  onClose: () => void;
    15→}
    16→
    17→interface UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    18→  /**
    19→   * Replace parent's timeline position with current image
    20→   * @param parentGenerationId - ID of the parent generation to remove from timeline
    21→   * @param currentMediaId - ID of the current media to place in timeline
    22→   * @param parentTimelineFrame - Timeline frame position to use
    23→   * @param shotId - Shot ID for the replacement
    24→   */
    25→  handleReplaceInShot: (
    26→    parentGenerationId: string,
    27→    currentMediaId: string,
    28→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    29→    shotId: string
    30→  ) => Promise<void>;
    31→}
    32→
    33→export function useReplaceInShot({
    34→  onClose,
    35→}: UseReplaceInShotProps): UseReplaceInShotReturn {
    36→  const handleReplaceInShot = useCallback(async (
    37→    parentGenerationId: string,
    38→    currentMediaId: string,
    39→    parentTimelineFrame: number,
    40→    shotIdParam: string
    41→  ) => {
    42→
    43→    try {
    44→      // 1. Remove timeline_frame from parent's shot_generation record
    45→      const { error: removeError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    46→        .update({ timeline_frame: null })
    47→        .eq('generation_id', parentGenerationId)
    48→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam);
    49→
    50→      if (removeError) throw removeError;
    51→
    52→      // 2. Update or create shot_generation for current image with the timeline_frame
    53→      // First check if current image already has a shot_generation for this shot
    54→      const { data: existingAssoc } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    55→        .select('id')
    56→        .eq('generation_id', currentMediaId)
    57→        .eq('shot_id', shotIdParam)
    58→        .single();
    59→
    60→      if (existingAssoc) {
    61→        // Update existing
    62→        const { error: updateError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    63→          .update({
    64→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
    65→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
    66→          })
    67→          .eq('id', existingAssoc.id);
    68→
    69→        if (updateError) throw updateError;
    70→      } else {
    71→        // Create new
    72→        const { error: createError } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    73→          .insert({
    74→            shot_id: shotIdParam,
    75→            generation_id: currentMediaId,
    76→            timeline_frame: parentTimelineFrame,
    77→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'replace_parent' }
    78→          });
    79→
    80→        if (createError) throw createError;
    81→      }
    82→
    83→      // Close lightbox to force refresh when reopened
    84→      onClose();
    85→    } catch (error) {
    86→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useReplaceInShot', showToast: false });
    87→      throw error;
    88→    }
    89→  }, [onClose]);
    90→
    91→  return { handleReplaceInShot };
    92→}
    93→

     4→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';

    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteSegmentHandler(
    19→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    20→  setDeletingSegmentId: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string | null>>,

1→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from 'react';
     3→import type { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     4→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     5→import {
     6→  operationFailure,
     7→  operationSuccess,
     8→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
     9→import {
    10→  deleteSegmentGenerationGroup,
    11→  syncSegmentDeletionCaches,
    12→} from '../services/segmentDeletionService';
    13→
    14→interface SegmentDeleteOperationResult {
    15→  deleted: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteSegmentHandler(
    19→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    20→  setDeletingSegmentId: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string | null>>,
    21→  projectId?: string,
    22→) {
    23→  return useCallback(async (generationId: string) => {
    24→    if (!projectId) {
    25→      return operationFailure(new Error('Project scope is required for segment deletion'), {
    26→        policy: 'fail_closed',
    27→        recoverable: false,
    28→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_missing_project_scope',
    29→        message: 'Project scope is required for segment deletion',
    30→      });
    31→    }
    32→
    33→    setDeletingSegmentId(generationId);
    34→    try {
    35→      const deletion = await deleteSegmentGenerationGroup({
    36→        generationId,
    37→        projectId,
    38→      });
    39→
    40→      if (!deletion.deleted) {
    41→        return operationSuccess(
    42→          { deleted: false } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    43→          { policy: 'best_effort' },
    44→        );
    45→      }
    46→
    47→      await syncSegmentDeletionCaches({
    48→        queryClient,
    49→        projectId,
    50→        parentGenerationId: deletion.parentGenerationId,
    51→        idsToDelete: deletion.idsToDelete,
    52→      });
    53→
    54→      return operationSuccess(
    55→        { deleted: true } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    56→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
    57→      );
    58→    } catch (error) {
    59→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    60→        context: 'SegmentDelete',
    61→        toastTitle: 'Failed to delete segment',
    62→      });
    63→      return operationFailure(error, {
    64→        policy: 'best_effort',
    65→        recoverable: true,
    66→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_failed',
    67→        message: 'Failed to delete segment',
    68→      });
    69→    } finally {
    70→      setDeletingSegmentId(null);
    71→    }
    72→  }, [projectId, queryClient, setDeletingSegmentId]);
    73→}
    74→

1→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP = 4;
     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→

1→import { useCallback, useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { GenerationRow, Shot } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     3→import { QuickCreateSuccess, ShotOption } from '../types';
     4→import { useQuickShotCreate } from '@/shared/hooks/useQuickShotCreate';
     5→import { getGenerationId } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaTypeHelpers';
     6→
     7→interface UseShotCreationProps {
     8→  media: GenerationRow;
     9→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    10→  allShots: ShotOption[];
    11→  onNavigateToShot?: (shot: Shot, options?: { isNewlyCreated?: boolean }) => void;
    12→  onClose: () => void;
    13→  onShotChange?: (shotId: string) => void;
    14→}
    15→
    16→interface UseShotCreationReturn {
    17→  isCreatingShot: boolean;
    18→  quickCreateSuccess: QuickCreateSuccess;
    19→  handleQuickCreateAndAdd: () => Promise<void>;
    20→  handleQuickCreateSuccess: () => void;
    21→}
    22→
    23→/**
    24→ * Hook for managing quick shot creation with image in MediaLightbox
    25→ * 
    26→ * This is a thin wrapper around useQuickShotCreate that:
    27→ * 1. Handles the generation_id vs id distinction (when viewing from ShotImagesEditor,
    28→ *    media.id is the shot_generations.id, not the actual generations.id)
    29→ * 2. Uses custom navigation via onNavigateToShot callback instead of internal navigation
    30→ */
    31→export const useShotCreation = ({
    32→  media,
    33→  allShots,
    34→  onNavigateToShot,
    35→  onClose,
    36→  onShotChange,
    37→}: UseShotCreationProps): UseShotCreationReturn => {
    38→  // CRITICAL: When viewing from ShotImagesEditor, media.id is the shot_generations.id (join table ID)
    39→  // We need to use media.generation_id (actual generations table ID) for creating new shot associations
    40→  const actualGenerationId = useMemo(() => {
    41→    const genId = getGenerationId(media);
    42→    return genId;
    43→  }, [media]);
    44→
    45→  // Use the consolidated hook
    46→  const {
    47→    isCreatingShot,
    48→    quickCreateSuccess,
    49→    handleQuickCreateAndAdd,
    50→    clearQuickCreateSuccess,
    51→  } = useQuickShotCreate({
    52→    generationId: actualGenerationId ?? media.id,
    53→    shots: allShots,
    54→    onShotChange,
    55→    // Don't use the hook's built-in navigation - we have custom navigation via onNavigateToShot
    56→    onClose: undefined,
    57→  });
    58→
    59→  // Custom navigation handler that uses onNavigateToShot callback
    60→  const handleQuickCreateSuccess = useCallback(() => {
    61→
    62→    if (quickCreateSuccess.shotId && onNavigateToShot) {
    63→      // Try to find the shot in the list first
    64→      const shotOption = allShots?.find(s => s.id === quickCreateSuccess.shotId);
    65→
    66→      // Close the lightbox first
    67→      onClose();
    68→
    69→      if (shotOption) {
    70→        // Build a minimal Shot object compatible with navigation
    71→        const minimalShot: Shot = {
    72→          id: shotOption.id,
    73→          name: shotOption.name,
    74→          images: [],
    75→          position: 0,
    76→        };
    77→        onNavigateToShot(minimalShot, { isNewlyCreated: true });
    78→      } else {
    79→        // Fallback when shot not in list yet
    80→        const minimalShot: Shot = {
    81→          id: quickCreateSuccess.shotId,
    82→          name: quickCreateSuccess.shotName || 'Shot',
    83→          images: [],
    84→          position: 0,
    85→        };
    86→        onNavigateToShot(minimalShot, { isNewlyCreated: true });
    87→      }
    88→    }
    89→
    90→    // Always clear the success state (prevents the header from sticking on "Visit Shot")
    91→    clearQuickCreateSuccess();
    92→  }, [quickCreateSuccess, onNavigateToShot, onClose, allShots, clearQuickCreateSuccess]);
    93→
    94→  return {
    95→    isCreatingShot,
    96→    quickCreateSuccess,
    97→    handleQuickCreateAndAdd,
    98→    handleQuickCreateSuccess,
    99→  };
   100→};
   101→

    36→  onAddToShot?: (targetShotId: string, generationId: string, imageUrl?: string, thumbUrl?: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    37→  onAddToShotWithoutPosition?: (targetShotId: string, generationId: string, imageUrl?: string, thumbUrl?: string) => Promise<boolean>;
    38→  onShowTick?: (imageId: string) => void;
    39→  onShowSecondaryTick?: (imageId: string) => void;
    40→  onOptimisticPositioned?: (mediaId: string, shotId: string) => void;
    41→  onOptimisticUnpositioned?: (mediaId: string, shotId: string) => void;
    42→}
    43→
    44→interface UseShotPositioningReturn {
    45→  isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot: boolean;
    46→  isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition: boolean;
    47→  handleAddToShot: () => Promise<void>;
    48→  handleAddToShotWithoutPosition: () => Promise<void>;
    49→}
    50→
    51→/**
    52→ * Hook for managing shot positioning logic
    53→ * Handles checking if media is positioned/associated with shots and navigation
    54→ */
    55→export const useShotPositioning = ({
    56→  media,
    57→  selectedShotId,
    58→  allShots,
    59→  positionedInSelectedShot,
    60→  associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot,
    61→  optimisticPositionedIds,
    62→  optimisticUnpositionedIds,
    63→  onNavigateToShot,
    64→  onClose,
    65→  onAddToShot,
    66→  onAddToShotWithoutPosition,
    67→  onShowTick,
    68→  onShowSecondaryTick,
    69→  onOptimisticPositioned,
    70→  onOptimisticUnpositioned,
    71→}: UseShotPositioningProps): UseShotPositioningReturn => {
    72→  const { navigateToShot } = useShotNavigation();
    73→  
    74→  // IMPORTANT: Use generation_id (actual generations.id) when available, falling back to id
    75→  // For ShotImageManager/Timeline images, id is shot_generations.id but generation_id is the actual generation ID
    76→  const actualGenerationId = getGenerationId(media);
    77→  const generationIdForActions = actualGenerationId ?? media.id;
    78→
    79→  const isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot = useMemo(() => {
    80→    if (!selectedShotId || !media.id) return false;
    81→
    82→    const compositeKey = `${media.id}:${selectedShotId}`;
    83→
    84→    // Check optimistic state first (most up-to-date and shot-specific)
    85→    const hasComposite = optimisticPositionedIds?.has(compositeKey);
    86→    
    87→    // Optimistic state takes precedence - if we have a composite key match, trust it
    88→    if (hasComposite) {
    89→      return true;
    90→    }
    91→    
    92→    // CRITICAL: Don't trust simple keys when we have a selectedShotId - simple keys are not shot-specific!
    93→    // Simple keys mean "added to SOME shot" but we don't know which one, so they're ambiguous.
    94→    // Only use simple keys as a last resort if we can't determine shot-specific state.
    95→    
    96→    // Trust the override from parent component (ShotImageManagerDesktop)
    97→    // The parent already verified the media is in the selected shot using props.shotId comparison
    98→    // Don't re-verify using media.shot_id since the image objects may not have shot_id populated
    99→    if (typeof positionedInSelectedShot === 'boolean') {
   100→      return positionedInSelectedShot;
   101→    }
   102→    
   103→    // Check if this media is positioned in the selected shot
   104→    // First check single shot association
   105→    const mediaExt = media as GenerationRow & MediaWithShotFields;
   106→    if (mediaExt.shot_id === selectedShotId) {
   107→      const result = mediaExt.position !== null && mediaExt.position !== undefined;
   108→      return result;
   109→    }
   110→
   111→    // Check multiple shot associations
   112→    const allShotAssociations = mediaExt.all_shot_associations;
   113→    if (allShotAssociations && Array.isArray(allShotAssociations)) {
   114→      const matchingAssociation = allShotAssociations.find(
   115→        (assoc: ShotAssociation) => assoc.shot_id === selectedShotId
   116→      );
   117→      const result = !!(matchingAssociation &&
   118→             matchingAssociation.position !== null &&
   119→             matchingAssociation.position !== undefined);
   120→      return result;
   121→    }
   122→    
   123→    return false;
   124→  }, [selectedShotId, media, optimisticPositionedIds, positionedInSelectedShot]);
   125→
   126→  // Navigate to the selected shot (shared by both handlers)
   127→  const navigateToSelectedShot = () => {
   128→    if (!selectedShotId) return;
   129→    const targetShotOption = allShots.find(s => s.id === selectedShotId);
   130→    const minimalShot: Shot = {
   131→      id: targetShotOption?.id || selectedShotId,
   132→      name: targetShotOption?.name || 'Shot',
   133→      images: [],
   134→      position: 0,
   135→    };
   136→    if (onNavigateToShot) {
   137→      onNavigateToShot(minimalShot);
   138→    } else {
   139→      onClose();
   140→      navigateToShot(minimalShot);
   141→    }
   142→  };
   143→
   144→  // Resolve media URLs (shared by both handlers)
   145→  const resolveMediaUrls = () => {
   146→    const mediaWithUrls = media as GenerationRow & MediaWithShotFields;
   147→    const imageUrl = getMediaUrl(mediaWithUrls) || media.imageUrl;
   148→    const thumbUrl = getThumbnailUrl(mediaWithUrls) || media.thumbUrl || imageUrl;
   149→    return { imageUrl, thumbUrl };
   150→  };
   151→
   152→  // Internal helper shared by both add-to-shot handlers
   153→  const executeAddToShot = async (
   154→    addFn: ((targetShotId: string, generationId: string, imageUrl?: string, thumbUrl?: string) => Promise<boolean>) | undefined,
   155→    isAlreadyInShot: boolean,
   156→    onShowFeedback: ((imageId: string) => void) | undefined,
   157→    onOptimistic: ((mediaId: string, shotId: string) => void) | undefined,
   158→  ) => {
   159→    if (!addFn || !selectedShotId) return;
   160→
   161→    if (isAlreadyInShot) {
   162→      navigateToSelectedShot();
   163→      return;
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    const { imageUrl, thumbUrl } = resolveMediaUrls();
   167→
   168→    // CRITICAL: Pass selectedShotId (the dropdown value) as targetShotId
   169→    // Use actualGenerationId (generations.id) not media.id (which might be shot_generations.id)
   170→    const success = await addFn(selectedShotId, generationIdForActions, imageUrl, thumbUrl);
   171→    if (success) {
   172→      onShowFeedback?.(generationIdForActions);
   173→      // Pass selectedShotId so optimistic state can use composite keys (mediaId:shotId)
   174→      onOptimistic?.(generationIdForActions, selectedShotId);
   175→    }
   176→  };
   177→
   178→  const handleAddToShot = () => executeAddToShot(
   179→    onAddToShot, isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot, onShowTick, onOptimisticPositioned
   180→  );
   181→
   182→  // Check if image is already associated with the selected shot WITHOUT position
   183→  const isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition = useMemo(() => {
   184→    if (!selectedShotId || !media.id) return false;
   185→
   186→    // Prefer override from gallery source
   187→    if (typeof associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot === 'boolean') {
   188→      // Check for composite key (mediaId:shotId) first, then fallback to simple mediaId
   189→      const compositeKey = `${media.id}:${selectedShotId}`;
   190→      const hasComposite = optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(compositeKey);
   191→      const hasSimple = optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(media.id);
   192→      return associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot || !!hasComposite || !!hasSimple;
   193→    }
   194→    
   195→    // Check optimistic state first - try composite key (mediaId:shotId), then fallback to simple mediaId
   196→    const compositeKey = `${media.id}:${selectedShotId}`;
   197→    if (optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(compositeKey)) return true;
   198→    if (optimisticUnpositionedIds?.has(media.id)) return true;
   199→    
   200→    // Check if this media is associated with the selected shot without position
   201→    // First check single shot association
   202→    const mediaExtAssoc = media as GenerationRow & MediaWithShotFields;
   203→    if (mediaExtAssoc.shot_id === selectedShotId) {
   204→      return mediaExtAssoc.position === null || mediaExtAssoc.position === undefined;
   205→    }
   206→
   207→    // Check multiple shot associations
   208→    const assocShotAssociations = mediaExtAssoc.all_shot_associations;
   209→    if (assocShotAssociations && Array.isArray(assocShotAssociations)) {
   210→      const matchingAssociation = assocShotAssociations.find(
   211→        (assoc: ShotAssociation) => assoc.shot_id === selectedShotId
   212→      );
   213→      return !!(matchingAssociation &&
   214→             (matchingAssociation.position === null || matchingAssociation.position === undefined));
   215→    }
   216→    
   217→    return false;
   218→  }, [selectedShotId, media, optimisticUnpositionedIds, associatedWithoutPositionInSelectedShot]);
   219→
   220→  const handleAddToShotWithoutPosition = () => executeAddToShot(
   221→    onAddToShotWithoutPosition, isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition, onShowSecondaryTick, onOptimisticUnpositioned
   222→  );
   223→
   224→  return {
   225→    isAlreadyPositionedInSelectedShot,
   226→    isAlreadyAssociatedWithoutPosition,
   227→    handleAddToShot,
   228→    handleAddToShotWithoutPosition,
   229→  };
   230→};
   231→

1→/**
     2→ * Centralized storage path utilities for Edge Functions
     3→ * 
     4→ * This is a copy of src/shared/lib/storagePaths.ts for use in Deno edge functions.
     5→ * Keep these in sync when making changes!
     6→ * 
     7→ * Path Structure:
     8→ *   {userId}/uploads/         - All media files (images + videos)
     9→ *   {userId}/thumbnails/      - All generated thumbnails
    10→ *   {userId}/tasks/{taskId}/  - Task/worker outputs via pre-signed URLs
    11→ */
    12→
    13→/**
    14→ * Generate a unique filename with timestamp and random string
    15→ */
    16→export function generateUniqueFilename(extension: string): string {
    17→  const timestamp = Date.now();
    18→  const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10);
    19→  return `${timestamp}-${randomStr}.${extension}`;
    20→}
    21→
    22→/**
    23→ * Generate a unique thumbnail filename
    24→ */
    25→export function generateThumbnailFilename(): string {
    26→  const timestamp = Date.now();
    27→  const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);
    28→  return `thumb_${timestamp}_${randomStr}.jpg`;
    29→}
    30→
    31→/**
    32→ * Get file extension from filename, with MIME type fallback
    33→ */
    34→export function getFileExtension(
    35→  filename: string,
    36→  mimeType?: string,
    37→  defaultExt: string = 'bin'
    38→): string {
    39→  // Handle URLs and query/hash suffixes from signed object paths.
    40→  const cleanName = filename
    41→    .split('?')[0]
    42→    .split('#')[0]
    43→    .split('/')
    44→    .pop() ?? filename;
    45→  const dotIndex = cleanName.lastIndexOf('.');
    46→  if (dotIndex > 0 && dotIndex < cleanName.length - 1) {
    47→    return cleanName.slice(dotIndex + 1).toLowerCase();
    48→  }
    49→  
    50→  // Fallback to MIME type
    51→  if (mimeType) {
    52→    const mimeExt = mimeType.split('/')[1]?.split(';')[0]?.replace('jpeg', 'jpg');
    53→    if (mimeExt) return mimeExt;
    54→  }
    55→  
    56→  return defaultExt;
    57→}
    58→
    59→/**
    60→ * Storage path builders - all paths are user-namespaced for security
    61→ */
    62→export const storagePaths = {

    66→  upload: (userId: string, filename: string): string =>

     6→
     7→/** Billing-relevant fields from task_types, joined via FK */
     8→interface TaskTypeConfig {
     9→  id: string;

    18→interface TaskWithProject {

    35→
    36→type TaskParseResult =
    37→  | { ok: true; task: TaskWithProject }

    40→function asNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {
    41→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;

    43→
    44→export function parseTaskCostParams(value: unknown): TaskCostParams {
    45→  const record = asObjectRecord(value) ?? {};
    46→  const parsed: TaskCostParams = {};
    47→
    48→  const resolution = asString(record.resolution);
    49→  if (resolution) {
    50→    parsed.resolution = resolution;
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  const frameCount = asNumber(record.frame_count);
    54→  if (frameCount !== undefined) {
    55→    parsed.frame_count = frameCount;
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  const modelType = asString(record.model_type);
    59→  if (modelType) {
    60→    parsed.model_type = modelType;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const result = asObjectRecord(record.result);
    64→  if (result) {
    65→    parsed.result = result as VideoEnhanceResult;
    66→  }
    67→
    68→  for (const [key, rawValue] of Object.entries(record)) {
    69→    // Never re-inject known billing keys unless they pass explicit normalization.
    70→    if (key === 'resolution' || key === 'frame_count' || key === 'model_type' || key === 'result') {
    71→      continue;
    72→    }
    73→    parsed[key] = rawValue;
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  return parsed;
    77→}
    78→
    79→export function parseTaskWithProject(value: unknown): TaskParseResult {
    80→  const task = asObjectRecord(value);
    81→  if (!task) {
    82→    return {
    83→      ok: false,
    84→      failure: {
    85→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
    86→        message: "Task payload is not an object",
    87→        details: { received_type: typeof value },
    88→      },
    89→    };
    90→  }

    92→  const id = asString(task.id);
    93→  const taskType = asString(task.task_type);
    94→  const projectId = asString(task.project_id);
    95→  if (!id || !taskType || !projectId) {
    96→    return {
    97→      ok: false,
    98→      failure: {
    99→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
   100→        message: "Task payload missing required fields: id, task_type, or project_id",
   101→        details: {
   102→          has_id: !!id,
   103→          has_task_type: !!taskType,
   104→          has_project_id: !!projectId,
   105→        },
   106→      },
   107→    };
   108→  }

   111→  const projectRecord = asObjectRecord(projectsRaw)
   112→    ?? (Array.isArray(projectsRaw) ? asObjectRecord(projectsRaw[0]) : null);
   113→  const userId = asString(projectRecord?.user_id);
   114→  if (!userId) {
   115→    return {
   116→      ok: false,
   117→      failure: {
   118→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
   119→        message: "Task payload missing projects.user_id",
   120→        details: {
   121→          projects_type: Array.isArray(projectsRaw) ? "array" : typeof projectsRaw,
   122→          has_projects_user_id: false,
   123→        },
   124→      },
   125→    };
   126→  }
   127→
   128→  const params = parseTaskCostParams(task.params);
   129→  const status = asString(task.status) ?? "unknown";
   130→
   131→  // Extract task_types FK join (PostgREST returns object or null)
   132→  let taskTypeConfig: TaskTypeConfig | null = null;
   133→  const ttRaw = asObjectRecord(task.task_types);

   135→    const ttId = asString(ttRaw.id);
   136→    const billingType = asString(ttRaw.billing_type);
   137→    if (ttId && billingType) {
   138→      taskTypeConfig = {
   139→        id: ttId,
   140→        billing_type: billingType,
   141→        base_cost_per_second: typeof ttRaw.base_cost_per_second === 'number' ? ttRaw.base_cost_per_second : 0,
   142→        unit_cost: typeof ttRaw.unit_cost === 'number' ? ttRaw.unit_cost : 0,
   143→        cost_factors: asObjectRecord(ttRaw.cost_factors) as CostFactors | null,
   144→        is_active: ttRaw.is_active === true,
   145→      };
   146→    }
   147→  }
   148→
   149→  return {
   150→    ok: true,
   151→    task: {
   152→      id,
   153→      task_type: taskType,
   154→      params,
   155→      status,
   156→      generation_started_at: asString(task.generation_started_at),
   157→      generation_processed_at: asString(task.generation_processed_at),
   158→      project_id: projectId,
   159→      projects: { user_id: userId },

   161→    },
   162→  };
   163→}

   194→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
   195→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
   196→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
   197→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
   198→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
   199→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
   200→};
   201→
   202→interface VideoEnhanceResult {
   203→  interpolation_compute_seconds?: number;
   204→  output_width?: number;
   205→  output_height?: number;
   206→  output_frames?: number;
   207→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   208→}
   209→
   210→interface VideoEnhanceBreakdown {
   211→  interpolation?: { compute_seconds: number; cost_per_second: number; cost: number };
   212→  upscale?: { output_width: number; output_height: number; output_frames: number; megapixels: number; cost_per_megapixel: number; cost: number };
   213→}
   214→
   215→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
   216→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
   217→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: VideoEnhanceResult): { cost: number; breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   218→  let totalCost = 0;
   219→  const breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown = {};
   220→
   221→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
   222→  const result = taskParams?.result || taskParams;
   223→
   224→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
   225→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
   226→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
   227→    totalCost += filmCost;
   228→    breakdown.interpolation = {
   229→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
   230→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
   231→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   232→    };
   233→  }
   234→
   235→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
   236→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
   237→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
   238→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
   239→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
   240→    breakdown.upscale = {
   241→      output_width: result.output_width,
   242→      output_height: result.output_height,
   243→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
   244→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
   245→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
   246→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   247→    };
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  return {
   251→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   252→    breakdown,
   253→  };
   254→}
   255→
   256→interface CostFactors {
   257→  resolution?: Record<string, number>;
   258→  frameCount?: number;
   259→  modelType?: Record<string, number>;
   260→}
   261→
   262→interface TaskCostParams {
   263→  resolution?: string;
   264→  frame_count?: number;
   265→  model_type?: string;
   266→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   267→  [key: string]: unknown;
   268→}
   269→
   270→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
   271→export function calculateTaskCost(
   272→  taskType: string,
   273→  billingType: string,
   274→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
   275→  unitCost: number,
   276→  durationSeconds: number,
   277→  costFactors: CostFactors | null,
   278→  taskParams: TaskCostParams
   279→): { cost: number; breakdown?: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   280→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
   281→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   282→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
   283→  }
   284→
   285→  let totalCost;
   286→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   287→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
   288→  } else {
   289→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   290→  }
   291→
   292→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
   293→  if (costFactors) {
   294→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
   295→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
   296→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
   297→    }
   298→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   299→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   300→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   301→      } else {
   302→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   303→      }
   304→    }
   305→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   306→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   307→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   308→    }
   309→  }
   310→
   311→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   312→}

   152→
   153→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   154→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows updated while enforcing generation project scope'), {
   155→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.noRows',
   156→      showToast: false,
   157→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId },
   158→    });
   159→  }
   160→}
   161→
   162→/**
   163→ * Create a new generation using direct Supabase call.
   164→ * @internal Used by useCreateGeneration hook.
   165→ */
   166→async function createGeneration(params: {
   167→  imageUrl: string;
   168→  fileName: string;
   169→  fileType: string;
   170→  fileSize: number;
   171→  projectId: string;
   172→  prompt: string;
   173→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
   174→  /** Resolution in "WIDTHxHEIGHT" format (e.g., "1920x1080") */
   175→  resolution?: string;
   176→  /** Standard aspect ratio (e.g., "16:9") */
   177→  aspectRatio?: string;
   178→}): Promise<GenerationRow> {
   179→  const generationParams: Record<string, Json | undefined> = {
   180→    prompt: params.prompt,
   181→    source: 'external_upload',
   182→    original_filename: params.fileName,
   183→    file_type: params.fileType,
   184→    file_size: params.fileSize,
   185→  };
   186→
   187→  // Add dimension params if provided
   188→  if (params.resolution) {
   189→    generationParams.resolution = params.resolution;
   190→  }
   191→  if (params.aspectRatio) {
   192→    generationParams.aspect_ratio = params.aspectRatio;
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  const { data, error } = await createGenerationRecord({
   196→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   197→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   198→    fileType: params.fileType || 'image',
   199→    projectId: params.projectId,
   200→    generationParams,
   201→  });
   202→
   203→  if (error || !data) {
   204→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error ?? new Error('Failed to create generation'), {
   205→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createGeneration',
   206→      showToast: false,
   207→      logData: { projectId: params.projectId },
   208→    });
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  // Create the original variant for this generation
   212→  const { error: variantError } = await createGenerationPrimaryVariant({
   213→    generationId: data.id,
   214→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   215→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   216→    generationParams,
   217→    variantType: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  if (variantError) {
   221→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(variantError, {
   222→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createVariant',
   223→      showToast: false,
   224→    });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  return data;
   228→}
   229→
   230→/**
   231→ * Star/unstar a generation using direct Supabase call.
   232→ * @internal Used by useToggleGenerationStar hook.
   233→ */
   234→async function toggleGenerationStar(params: ScopedGenerationInput & { starred: boolean }): Promise<void> {
   235→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   236→    params.projectId,
   237→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.projectScope',
   238→  );
   239→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   240→    params.id,
   241→    projectId,
   242→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.scopeValidation',
   243→  );
   244→
   245→  const { data, error } = await updateGenerationStarByScope({
   246→    id: params.id,
   247→    projectId,
   248→    starred: params.starred,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  if (error) {
   252→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   253→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar',
   254→      showToast: false,
   255→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   260→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
   261→      new Error('No rows updated while toggling generation star (possible RLS policy issue)'),
   262→      {
   263→        context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.noRows',
   264→        showToast: false,
   265→        logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   266→      },
   267→    );
   268→  }
   269→}
   270→
   271→// ===== Mutation Hooks =====
   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Shared delete mutation factory for generations and variants.
   275→ * @internal
   276→ */
   277→function useDeleteFromTable(table: 'generations' | 'generation_variants', entityLabel: string) {
   278→  return useMutation({
   279→    mutationFn: async (input: ScopedGenerationInput | ScopedVariantInput) => {
   280→      const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   281→        input.projectId,
   282→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.projectScope`,
   283→      );
   284→
   285→      if (table === 'generations') {
   286→        await verifyGenerationScope(
   287→          input.id,
   288→          projectId,
   289→          `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   290→        );
   291→
   292→        const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   293→          id: input.id,
   294→          projectId,
   295→        });
   296→
   297→        if (error) {
   298→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   299→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   300→            showToast: false,
   301→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   302→          });
   303→        }
   304→
   305→        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   306→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   307→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   308→            showToast: false,
   309→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   310→          });
   311→        }
   312→
   313→        return;
   314→      }
   315→
   316→      const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   317→        input.id,
   318→        projectId,
   319→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   320→      );
   321→      const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   322→        id: input.id,
   323→        generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   324→      });
   325→
   326→      if (error) {
   327→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   328→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   329→          showToast: false,
   330→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   331→        });
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   335→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   336→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   337→          showToast: false,
   338→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   339→        });
   340→      }
   341→    },
   342→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   343→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→        context: `useDelete${entityLabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + entityLabel.slice(1)}`,
   345→        toastTitle: `Failed to delete ${entityLabel}`,
   346→      });
   347→    },
   348→  });
   349→}
   350→
   351→export function useDeleteGeneration() {
   352→  return useDeleteFromTable('generations', 'generation');
   353→}
   354→
   355→/**
   356→ * Delete a variant from generation_variants table.
   357→ * Use this for edit tools (edit-images, edit-video, character-animate) that create variants.
   358→ */
   359→export function useDeleteVariant() {
   360→  return useDeleteFromTable('generation_variants', 'variant');
   361→}

   363→export function useUpdateGenerationLocation() {
   364→  return useMutation({
   365→    mutationFn: ({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId }: { id: string; location: string; thumbUrl?: string; projectId: string }) => {
   366→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });
   367→    },
   368→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   369→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useUpdateGenerationLocation', toastTitle: 'Failed to update generation' });
   370→    },
   371→  });
   372→}
   373→
   374→export function useCreateGeneration() {
   375→  return useMutation({
   376→    mutationFn: createGeneration,
   377→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   378→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useCreateGeneration', toastTitle: 'Failed to create generation' });
   379→    },
   380→  });
   381→}
   382→
   383→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {
   384→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   385→
   386→  return useMutation({
   387→    mutationFn: ({ id, starred, projectId }: { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }) => {
   388→      return toggleGenerationStar({ id, starred, projectId });
   389→    },
   390→    onMutate: async ({ id, starred, shotId }) => {
   391→      return applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, {
   392→        generationId: id,
   393→        starred,
   394→        shotId,
   395→      });
   396→    },
   397→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   398→      rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, context);
   399→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToggleGenerationStar', toastTitle: 'Failed to toggle star' });
   400→    },
   401→    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
   402→      // Emit custom event so Timeline knows to refetch star data
   403→      if (variables.shotId) {
   404→        dispatchAppEvent('generation-star-updated', {
   405→          generationId: variables.id, shotId: variables.shotId!, starred: variables.starred,
   406→        });
   407→      }
   408→    },
   409→  });
   410→}

1→import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
     2→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     3→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     5→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
     6→
     7→interface UseSourceGenerationParams {
     8→  media: GenerationRow;
     9→  onOpenExternalGeneration?: (generationId: string, derivedContext?: string[]) => Promise<void>;
    10→}
    11→
    12→export interface SourceVariantData {
    13→  id: string;
    14→  location: string;
    15→  thumbnail_url: string | null;
    16→  variant_type: string | null;
    17→  is_primary: boolean;
    18→}
    19→
    20→/** Enriched generation data with shot associations */
    21→interface SourceGenerationWithAssociations extends GenerationRow {
    22→  all_shot_associations: Array<{ shot_id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface UseSourceGenerationReturn {
    26→  sourceGenerationData: SourceGenerationWithAssociations | null;
    27→  sourcePrimaryVariant: SourceVariantData | null;
    28→}
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Hook to fetch and manage source generation (based_on) data
    32→ * Fetches the generation that this media was derived from, plus its primary variant
    33→ */
    34→export const useSourceGeneration = ({
    35→  media
    36→}: UseSourceGenerationParams): UseSourceGenerationReturn => {
    37→  const [sourceGenerationData, setSourceGenerationData] = useState<SourceGenerationWithAssociations | null>(null);
    38→  const [sourcePrimaryVariant, setSourcePrimaryVariant] = useState<SourceVariantData | null>(null);
    39→  const metadataBasedOnId = (media.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.based_on as string | undefined;
    40→
    41→  useEffect(() => {
    42→    const basedOnId = media.based_on;
    43→    const basedOnFromMetadata = metadataBasedOnId;
    44→
    45→    // Check both direct field and metadata
    46→    const effectiveBasedOnId = basedOnId || basedOnFromMetadata;
    47→    
    48→    if (!effectiveBasedOnId) {
    49→      setSourceGenerationData(null);
    50→      setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
    51→      return;
    52→    }
    53→    
    54→    const fetchSourceGeneration = async () => {
    55→      try {
    56→        // Fetch source generation with shot associations and primary variant
    57→        // Use left join (no !inner) so we get the generation even if it's not in any shot
    58→        const { data, error } = await supabase().from('generations')
    59→          .select(`
    60→            *,
    61→            generation_variants!generation_variants_generation_id_fkey(
    62→              id,
    63→              location,
    64→              thumbnail_url,
    65→              variant_type,
    66→              is_primary
    67→            )
    68→          `)
    69→          .eq('id', effectiveBasedOnId)
    70→          .maybeSingle();
    71→
    72→        if (error) throw error;
    73→
    74→        if (data) {
    75→          // Extract shot associations from joined data
    76→          const joinedData = data as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    77→          const shotAssociations = expandShotData(
    78→            joinedData.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
    79→          );
    80→          const variants = (joinedData.generation_variants || []) as SourceVariantData[];
    81→          
    82→          // Find primary variant
    83→          const primaryVariant = variants.find((v) => v.is_primary) || null;
    84→          
    85→          // Add shot associations to the data for easy access
    86→          const enrichedData: SourceGenerationWithAssociations = {
    87→            ...data as unknown as GenerationRow,
    88→            all_shot_associations: shotAssociations,
    89→          };
    90→
    91→          setSourceGenerationData(enrichedData);
    92→          setSourcePrimaryVariant(primaryVariant);
    93→        } else {
    94→          setSourceGenerationData(null);
    95→          setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
    96→        }
    97→      } catch (error) {
    98→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useSourceGeneration', showToast: false });
    99→        // Don't show toast - this is a non-critical feature
   100→        setSourceGenerationData(null);
   101→        setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
   102→      }
   103→    };
   104→    
   105→    void fetchSourceGeneration();
   106→  }, [media.based_on, metadataBasedOnId]);
   107→
   108→  return {
   109→    sourceGenerationData,
   110→    sourcePrimaryVariant
   111→  };
   112→};
   113→

1→// deno-lint-ignore-file
     2→/**
     3→ * System Logger for Edge Functions
     4→ *
     5→ * Logs to both console (for immediate visibility) AND system_logs table (for persistence/querying).
     6→ * Uses a buffer pattern to batch database writes for efficiency.
     7→ *
     8→ * Usage:
     9→ *   const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, 'my-function-name');
    10→ *   logger.info('Processing request', { task_id, shot_id });
    11→ *   logger.error('Something failed', { task_id, error: err.message });
    12→ *   await logger.flush(); // Call before returning response
    13→ */
    14→
    15→import type { SupabaseClient } from './supabaseClient.ts';
    16→
    17→type LogLevel = 'DEBUG' | 'INFO' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR' | 'CRITICAL';
    18→
    19→interface LogContext {
    20→  task_id?: string;
    21→  shot_id?: string;
    22→  user_id?: string;
    23→  [key: string]: unknown;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface BufferedLog {
    27→  timestamp: string;
    28→  source_type: string;
    29→  source_id: string;
    30→  log_level: LogLevel;
    31→  message: string;
    32→  task_id: string | null;
    33→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
    34→}
    35→
    36→export class SystemLogger {
    37→  private supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient;
    38→  private functionName: string;
    39→  private logPrefix: string;
    40→  private logBuffer: BufferedLog[] = [];
    41→  private defaultTaskId: string | null = null;
    42→
    43→  constructor(supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient, functionName: string, defaultTaskId?: string) {
    44→    this.supabaseAdmin = supabaseAdmin;
    45→    this.functionName = functionName;
    46→    this.logPrefix = `[${functionName.toUpperCase()}]`;
    47→    this.defaultTaskId = defaultTaskId || null;
    48→  }
    49→
    50→  /**
    51→   * Set a default task_id that will be used for all subsequent logs
    52→   * Useful when you learn the task_id after construction
    53→   */
    54→  setDefaultTaskId(taskId: string | null) {
    55→    this.defaultTaskId = taskId;
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  private addToBuffer(level: LogLevel, message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    59→    const { task_id, ...metadata } = context || {};
    60→    
    61→    this.logBuffer.push({
    62→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    63→      source_type: 'edge_function',
    64→      source_id: this.functionName,
    65→      log_level: level,
    66→      message,
    67→      task_id: task_id || this.defaultTaskId,
    68→      metadata
    69→    });
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  debug(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    73→    console.log(`${this.logPrefix} ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    74→    this.addToBuffer('DEBUG', message, context);
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  info(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    78→    console.log(`${this.logPrefix} ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    79→    this.addToBuffer('INFO', message, context);
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  warn(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    83→    console.warn(`${this.logPrefix} ⚠️ ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    84→    this.addToBuffer('WARNING', message, context);
    85→  }
    86→
    87→  error(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    88→    console.error(`${this.logPrefix} ❌ ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    89→    this.addToBuffer('ERROR', message, context);
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  critical(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    93→    console.error(`${this.logPrefix} 🔥 CRITICAL: ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    94→    this.addToBuffer('CRITICAL', message, context);
    95→  }
    96→
    97→  /**
    98→   * Flush all buffered logs to the database
    99→   * Call this before returning your response!
   100→   */
   101→  async flush(): Promise<{ inserted: number; errors: number }> {
   102→    if (this.logBuffer.length === 0) {
   103→      return { inserted: 0, errors: 0 };
   104→    }
   105→
   106→    try {
   107→      const { data, error } = await this.supabaseAdmin
   108→        .rpc('func_insert_logs_batch', { logs: this.logBuffer });
   109→
   110→      if (error) {
   111→        console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Failed to flush ${this.logBuffer.length} logs to database:`, error.message);
   112→        // Don't clear buffer on error - logs are lost but at least console has them
   113→        return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   114→      }
   115→
   116→      const result = data || { inserted: this.logBuffer.length, errors: 0 };
   117→      const bufferSize = this.logBuffer.length;
   118→      this.logBuffer = []; // Clear buffer after successful flush
   119→      
   120→      console.log(`${this.logPrefix} Flushed ${bufferSize} logs to database`);
   121→      return { inserted: result.inserted || bufferSize, errors: result.errors || 0 };
   122→    } catch (e: unknown) {
   123→      console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Exception flushing logs:`, e?.message || e);
   124→      return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   125→    }
   126→  }
   127→
   128→  /**
   129→   * Get the current buffer size (useful for debugging)
   130→   */
   131→  getBufferSize(): number {
   132→    return this.logBuffer.length;
   133→  }
   134→}
   135→

1→/**
     2→ * DataFreshnessManager - Single source of truth for data freshness and polling decisions
     3→ *
     4→ * This class centralizes all decisions about:
     5→ * - Whether data is fresh (based on realtime events)
     6→ * - What polling intervals React Query should use
     7→ * - Realtime connection health status
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    11→import { registerDebugGlobal } from '@/shared/runtime/debugRegistry';
    12→
    13→type QueryKeyLike = readonly unknown[];
    14→type RealtimeStatus = 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error';
    15→type PollingInterval = number | false; // false = no polling
    16→type FreshnessSubscriber = () => void;
    17→
    18→function serializeQueryKey(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): string {
    19→  return JSON.stringify(queryKey);
    20→}
    21→
    22→function markQueryKeysFresh(
    23→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    24→  queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[],
    25→  now: number,
    26→): void {
    27→  queryKeys.forEach((queryKey) => {
    28→    lastEventTimes.set(serializeQueryKey(queryKey), now);
    29→  });
    30→}
    31→
    32→function getLastEventTime(
    33→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    34→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    35→): number | undefined {
    36→  return lastEventTimes.get(serializeQueryKey(queryKey));
    37→}
    38→
    39→function isQueryFresh(
    40→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    41→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    42→  freshnessThreshold: number,
    43→  now: number,
    44→): boolean {
    45→  const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(lastEventTimes, queryKey);
    46→  if (!lastEvent) {
    47→    return false;
    48→  }

   126→    // Notify subscribers that data freshness has changed

   129→
   130→  /**
   131→   * Get the appropriate polling interval for a query
   132→   * Returns false to disable polling when realtime is working well
   133→   */

   135→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   136→    const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey);
   137→    const now = Date.now();
   138→    const timeSinceStatusChange = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   139→
   140→    // If realtime is connected, trust it after it's been stable
   141→    if (this.state.realtimeStatus === 'connected') {

   143→      if (timeSinceStatusChange < 30000) {
   144→        return 30000; // 30 seconds - wait for realtime to prove it's stable
   145→      }

   147→      // If realtime has been stable for >30 seconds, trust it.
   148→      // "No events" just means "nothing changed" — not "realtime is broken".
   149→
   150→      if (lastEvent) {
   151→        const eventAge = now - lastEvent;
   152→
   153→        if (eventAge < 60000) { // Events within 1 minute
   154→          return false; // Disable polling — realtime is working
   155→        } else if (eventAge < 3 * 60 * 1000) { // Events within 3 minutes
   156→          return 60000; // 60 seconds - light backup polling
   157→        }
   158→      }
   159→
   160→      // Realtime stable for >30s but no events — this is normal when idle.
   161→      // Use very light polling as a safety net only.
   162→      if (timeSinceStatusChange > 5 * 60 * 1000) {
   163→        // Realtime been stable for >5 minutes - fully trust it
   164→        return false; // Disable polling — realtime is stable, idle is OK
   165→      } else {
   166→        // Realtime stable for 30s-5min - use safety net polling
   167→        return 60000; // 60 seconds - safety net while realtime proves long-term stability
   168→      }
   169→    }
   170→
   171→    // If realtime is disconnected or errored, use GRADUATED backoff polling
   172→    // to prevent thundering herd and connection overload

   179→      failureInfo.count >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   180→
   181→    let pollingInterval: number;

   185→      pollingInterval = 60_000; // 60 seconds
   186→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 30_000) {
   187→      // First 30 seconds: 15s polling (give realtime time to reconnect)
   188→      pollingInterval = 15_000;
   189→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 2 * 60_000) {
   190→      // 30s - 2 minutes: 30s polling
   191→      pollingInterval = 30_000;
   192→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 5 * 60_000) {

   194→      pollingInterval = 45_000;
   195→    } else {

   203→  /**
   204→   * Report a fetch failure for circuit breaker tracking
   205→   */
   206→  onFetchFailure(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, error: Error) {
   207→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   208→    const now = Date.now();
   209→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   210→
   211→    // Reset count if last failure was too long ago
   212→    const shouldReset = existing && (now - existing.lastFailure) > this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS;
   213→
   214→    const newCount = shouldReset ? 1 : (existing?.count || 0) + 1;
   215→    this.state.fetchFailures.set(key, { count: newCount, lastFailure: now });
   216→
   217→    const isCircuitBreakerTriggered = newCount >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   218→
   219→    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);
   220→
   221→    // Notify subscribers so polling intervals can adjust
   222→    if (isCircuitBreakerTriggered) {
   223→      this.notifySubscribers();
   224→
   225→      // Show user-facing error toast (throttled to prevent spam)
   226→      if (now - this.lastErrorToastTime > this.ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) {
   227→        this.lastErrorToastTime = now;
   228→
   229→        this.reportCircuitBreakerError({
   230→          queryKey: key,
   231→          failureCount: newCount,
   232→          errorType,
   233→          error,
   234→        });
   235→      }
   236→    }
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  private reportCircuitBreakerError(input: {
   240→    queryKey: string;
   241→    failureCount: number;
   242→    errorType: string;
   243→    error: Error;
   244→  }) {
   245→    const userMessage = this.getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(input.errorType, input.failureCount);
   246→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Data may be outdated. Will retry automatically.'), {
   247→      context: 'DataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure',
   248→      toastTitle: userMessage,
   249→      showToast: true,
   250→      logData: {
   251→        [REDACTED](input.queryKey),
   252→        failureCount: input.failureCount,
   253→        errorType: input.errorType,
   254→        errorMessage: input.error.message,
   255→      },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  /**
   260→   * Get a user-friendly error message based on error type
   261→   */
   262→  private getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(errorType: string, failureCount: number): string {
   263→    switch (errorType) {
   264→      case 'CONNECTION_CLOSED':
   265→      case 'NETWORK_ERROR':
   266→        return 'Connection issue detected';
   267→      case 'TIMEOUT':
   268→        return 'Server is slow to respond';
   269→      case 'RATE_LIMITED':
   270→        return 'Too many requests - slowing down';
   271→      case 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE':
   272→        return 'Service temporarily unavailable';
   273→      case 'AUTH_ERROR':
   274→        return 'Authentication issue - try refreshing';
   275→      default:
   276→        return `Connection issues (${failureCount} failures)`;
   277→    }
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Report a successful fetch (resets circuit breaker)
   282→   */
   283→  onFetchSuccess(queryKey: QueryKeyLike) {
   284→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   285→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   286→
   287→    if (existing && existing.count > 0) {
   288→      // Reset failure count on success
   289→      this.state.fetchFailures.delete(key);
   290→    }
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  /**
   294→   * Classify error type for better logging and handling
   295→   */
   296→  private classifyError(error: Error): string {
   297→    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
   298→
   299→    if (message.includes('connection_closed') || message.includes('err_connection_closed')) {
   300→      return 'CONNECTION_CLOSED';
   301→    }
   302→    if (message.includes('failed to fetch') || message.includes('network')) {
   303→      return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
   304→    }
   305→    if (message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('timed out')) {
   306→      return 'TIMEOUT';
   307→    }
   308→    if (message.includes('abort')) {
   309→      return 'ABORTED';
   310→    }
   311→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {
   312→      return 'AUTH_ERROR';
   313→    }
   314→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   315→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   316→    }
   317→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   318→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   321→  }
   322→
   323→  /**
   324→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   325→   */
   326→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   327→    return isQueryFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey, freshnessThreshold, Date.now());
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   332→   */
   333→  getDiagnostics() {
   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }
   364→
   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}
   385→
   386→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   387→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();
   388→
   389→/** Dev-only helper for wiring debug globals during app bootstrap. */
   390→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {
   391→  if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {
   392→    return;
   393→  }
   394→
   395→  registerDebugGlobal(
   396→    '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__',
   397→    dataFreshnessManager,
   398→    'DataFreshnessManager',
   399→  );
   400→}

   248→      toastTitle: userMessage,
   249→      showToast: true,
   250→      logData: {
   251→        [REDACTED](input.queryKey),
   252→        failureCount: input.failureCount,
   253→        errorType: input.errorType,
   254→        errorMessage: input.error.message,
   255→      },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  /**
   260→   * Get a user-friendly error message based on error type
   261→   */
   262→  private getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(errorType: string, failureCount: number): string {
   263→    switch (errorType) {
   264→      case 'CONNECTION_CLOSED':
   265→      case 'NETWORK_ERROR':
   266→        return 'Connection issue detected';
   267→      case 'TIMEOUT':
   268→        return 'Server is slow to respond';
   269→      case 'RATE_LIMITED':
   270→        return 'Too many requests - slowing down';
   271→      case 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE':
   272→        return 'Service temporarily unavailable';
   273→      case 'AUTH_ERROR':
   274→        return 'Authentication issue - try refreshing';
   275→      default:
   276→        return `Connection issues (${failureCount} failures)`;
   277→    }
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Report a successful fetch (resets circuit breaker)
   282→   */
   283→  onFetchSuccess(queryKey: QueryKeyLike) {
   284→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   285→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   286→
   287→    if (existing && existing.count > 0) {
   288→      // Reset failure count on success
   289→      this.state.fetchFailures.delete(key);
   290→    }
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  /**
   294→   * Classify error type for better logging and handling
   295→   */
   296→  private classifyError(error: Error): string {
   297→    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
   298→
   299→    if (message.includes('connection_closed') || message.includes('err_connection_closed')) {
   300→      return 'CONNECTION_CLOSED';
   301→    }
   302→    if (message.includes('failed to fetch') || message.includes('network')) {
   303→      return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
   304→    }
   305→    if (message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('timed out')) {
   306→      return 'TIMEOUT';
   307→    }
   308→    if (message.includes('abort')) {
   309→      return 'ABORTED';
   310→    }
   311→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {
   312→      return 'AUTH_ERROR';
   313→    }
   314→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   315→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   316→    }
   317→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   318→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   321→  }
   322→
   323→  /**
   324→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   325→   */
   326→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   327→    return isQueryFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey, freshnessThreshold, Date.now());
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   332→   */
   333→  getDiagnostics() {
   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }
   364→
   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}

   386→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   387→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();
   388→
   389→/** Dev-only helper for wiring debug globals during app bootstrap. */
   390→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {
   391→  if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {

   393→  }

   395→  registerDebugGlobal(
   396→    '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__',
   397→    dataFreshnessManager,
   398→    'DataFreshnessManager',

    85→          recoverable: false,

    87→        });
    88→      }

   145→        return jsonResponse({ summary, usage: resp.usage });
   146→      }
   147→      case "enhance_segment_prompt": {
   148→        // Enhance a single segment prompt using OpenAI GPT-5 Mini
   149→        // Uses motion-focused prompt template for video transitions
   150→        const prompt = String(body.prompt ?? "");
   151→        const _temperature = Number(body.temperature ?? 0.7);
   152→
   153→        if (!prompt.trim()) {
   154→          return jsonResponse({ error: "prompt is required" }, 400);
   155→        }
   156→
   157→        if (!openaiApiKey) {
   158→          return jsonResponse({ error: "OpenAI API key not configured" }, 500);
   159→        }
   160→
   161→        const systemMsg = ENHANCE_SEGMENT_SYSTEM_PROMPT;
   162→        const userMsg = buildEnhanceSegmentUserPrompt(prompt);
   163→
   164→        try {
   165→          const response = await fetch("https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions", {
   166→            method: "POST",
   167→            headers: {
   168→              "Authorization": `Bearer ${openaiApiKey}`,
   169→              "Content-Type": "application/json",
   170→            },
   171→            body: JSON.stringify({
   172→              model: "gpt-5-mini",
   173→              messages: [
   174→                { role: "system", content: systemMsg },
   175→                { role: "user", content: userMsg },
   176→              ],
   177→              max_completion_tokens: 16000,
   178→            }),
   179→          });
   180→
   181→          if (!response.ok) {
   182→            const errorText = await response.text();
   183→            console.error(`[ai-prompt] OpenAI API error:`, response.status, errorText);
   184→            return jsonResponse({ error: "OpenAI API error", details: errorText }, response.status);
   185→          }
   186→
   187→          const data = await response.json();
   188→
   189→          const enhancedPrompt = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || prompt;
   190→
   191→          return jsonResponse({
   192→            enhanced_prompt: enhancedPrompt,
   193→            usage: data.usage,
   194→          });
   195→        } catch (fetchError: unknown) {
   196→          const message = fetchError instanceof Error ? fetchError.message : String(fetchError);
   197→          console.error(`[ai-prompt] OpenAI fetch error:`, message);
   198→          return jsonResponse({ error: "Failed to call OpenAI API", details: message }, 500);
   199→        }
   200→      }
   201→      default:
   202→        return jsonResponse({ error: `Unknown task: ${task}` }, 400);
   203→    }
   204→  } catch (err: unknown) {
   205→    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
   206→    console.error(`[ai-prompt] Error handling task ${task}:`, message);
   207→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Internal server error", details: message }, 500);
   208→  }
   209→}); 
   210→
