    13→  previousShotsQueries: Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>;
    14→  previousAllShotGenerationsQueries: Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>;
    15→}
    16→
    17→interface UnifiedGenerationListData {
    18→  items: GenerationRow[];
    19→}
    20→
    21→function isUnifiedGenerationListData(data: unknown): data is UnifiedGenerationListData {
    22→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || !('items' in data)) {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→  const candidate = data as { items?: unknown };
    26→  return Array.isArray(candidate.items);
    27→}
    28→
    29→export async function applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(
    30→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    31→  input: GenerationStarOptimisticUpdateInput,
    32→): Promise<GenerationStarOptimisticContext> {
    33→  await Promise.all([
    34→    queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED] }),
    35→    queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED] }),
    36→    queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED] }),
    37→  ]);
    38→
    39→  const previousGenerationsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    40→  const previousShotsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    41→  const previousAllShotGenerationsQueries = new Map<readonly unknown[], unknown>();
    42→
    43→  const generationsQueries = queryClient.getQueriesData({ [REDACTED] });
    44→  generationsQueries.forEach(([queryKey, data]) => {
    45→    if (!isUnifiedGenerationListData(data)) {
    46→      return;
    47→    }
    48→
    49→    previousGenerationsQueries.set(queryKey, data);
    50→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, {
    51→      ...data,
    52→      items: data.items.map((generation) => (
    53→        generation.id === input.generationId ? { ...generation, starred: input.starred } : generation
    54→      )),
    55→    });
    56→  });
    57→
    58→  const shotsQueries = queryClient.getQueriesData({ [REDACTED] });
    59→  shotsQueries.forEach(([queryKey, data]) => {
    60→    if (!Array.isArray(data)) {
    61→      return;
    62→    }
    63→
    64→    previousShotsQueries.set(queryKey, data);
    65→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKey, (data as Shot[]).map((shot) => {
    66→      if (!shot.images) {
    67→        return shot;
    68→      }
    69→      return {
    70→        ...shot,
    71→        images: shot.images.map((image) => (
    72→          image.id === input.generationId ? { ...image, starred: input.starred } : image
    73→        )),
    74→      };
    75→    }));
    76→  });
    77→
    78→  if (input.shotId) {
    79→    const [REDACTED](input.shotId);
    80→    const previousShotData = queryClient.getQueryData(shotQueryKey);
    81→    if (Array.isArray(previousShotData)) {
    82→      previousAllShotGenerationsQueries.set(shotQueryKey, previousShotData);
    83→      queryClient.setQueryData(
    84→        shotQueryKey,
    85→        (previousShotData as GenerationRow[]).map((generation) => (
    86→          generation.id === input.generationId ? { ...generation, starred: input.starred } : generation
    87→        )),
    88→      );
    89→    }
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  return {
    93→    previousGenerationsQueries,
    94→    previousShotsQueries,
    95→    previousAllShotGenerationsQueries,
    96→  };
    97→}
    98→
    99→export function rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(
   100→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   101→  context?: GenerationStarOptimisticContext,
   102→): void {
   103→  if (!context) {
   104→    return;
   105→  }
   106→
   107→  context.previousGenerationsQueries.forEach((data, key) => {
   108→    queryClient.setQueryData(key, data);
   109→  });
   110→  context.previousShotsQueries.forEach((data, key) => {
   111→    queryClient.setQueryData(key, data);
   112→  });
   113→  context.previousAllShotGenerationsQueries.forEach((data, key) => {
   114→    queryClient.setQueryData(key, data);
   115→  });
   116→}
   117→

   398→export function useInlineEditState(
   399→  media: GenerationRow,
   400→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   417→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   418→      : undefined,
   419→  });
   420→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   421→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   422→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   423→  };
   424→  const {
   425→    inpaintingState,
   426→    transformState,
   427→    generationState,
   428→    imageEditValue,
   429→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   430→    env,
   431→    persistence,
   432→    inpainting,
   433→    magic,
   434→    reposition,
   435→    img2img,
   436→    starToggle,
   437→    handleDownload,
   438→  });
   439→  return {
   440→    media,
   441→    canvasEnvironment: {
   442→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   443→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   444→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   445→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   446→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   447→      effectiveImageUrl,
   448→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   449→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   450→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   451→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   452→    },
   453→    inpaintingState,
   454→    transformState,
   455→    generationState,
   456→    variants: {
   457→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   458→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   459→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   460→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   461→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   462→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   463→    },
   464→    sourceGenerationData,
   465→    availableLoras,
   466→    imageEditValue,
   467→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   468→}

   315→function useLightboxNavigationModel(
   316→  core: SharedLightboxCoreProps,
   317→  navigation: SharedLightboxNavigationProps,
   318→) {
   319→  const { onClose, readOnly } = core;

   329→    onNext: handleSlotNavNext,
   330→    onPrevious: handleSlotNavPrev,
   331→    onClose,
   332→  });
   333→  const swipeNavigation = useSwipeNavigation({
   334→    onSwipeLeft: () => {
   335→      if (hasNext) handleSlotNavNext();
   336→    },
   337→    onSwipeRight: () => {
   338→      if (hasPrevious) handleSlotNavPrev();
   339→    },

   341→    hasNext,

   345→  });
   346→
   347→  return {
   348→    safeClose,
   349→    activateClickShield,
   350→    swipeNavigation,
   351→  };
   352→}

   101→export function collectTravelStructureLegacyUsage(
   102→  value: unknown,
   103→): TravelStructureLegacyUsage {
   104→  const record = value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value)
   105→    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
   106→    : {};
   107→
   108→  const topLevelFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_TOP_LEVEL_FIELDS.filter(
   109→    (field) => record[field] !== undefined,
   110→  );
   111→
   112→  const structureVideos = Array.isArray(record.structure_videos)
   113→    ? record.structure_videos
   114→    : [];
   115→  const structureVideoFields = LEGACY_TRAVEL_STRUCTURE_VIDEO_FIELDS.filter((field) =>
   116→    structureVideos.some((entry) => hasLegacyField(entry, field)),
   117→  );
   118→
   119→  return { topLevelFields, structureVideoFields };
   120→}
   121→
   122→export function enforceTravelStructureLegacyPolicy(
   123→  usage: TravelStructureLegacyUsage,
   124→  options?: {
   125→    context?: string;
   126→    enforcement?: 'warn' | 'throw' | 'auto';
   127→  },
   128→): boolean {
   129→  const usedFields = [...usage.topLevelFields, ...usage.structureVideoFields];
   130→  if (usedFields.length === 0) {
   131→    return false;
   132→  }
   133→
   134→  const details = usedFields.join(', ');
   135→  return signalPastRemovalTargetUsage({
   136→    alias: 'travel_between_images.legacy_structure_fields',
   137→    policy: legacyStructurePolicy,
   138→    remediation: `Migrate to structure_guidance + canonical structure_videos. Legacy fields seen: ${details}.` +
   139→      (options?.context ? ` Context: ${options.context}.` : ''),
   140→    enforcement: options?.enforcement ?? 'auto',
   141→  });
   142→}

   150→  value: unknown,
   151→  options: LegacyStructureVideoMigrationOptions,
   152→): MigratedLegacyStructureVideo[] {
   153→  const settings = asRecord(value);
   154→  if (!settings) {

   163→  );
   164→  const topLevelMotionStrength = parseNumber(
   165→    settings.structure_video_motion_strength ?? settings.motionStrength,
   166→  );
   167→  const topLevelUni3cEndPercent = parseNumber(settings.uni3c_end_percent);
   168→
   169→  const rawStructureVideos = Array.isArray(settings.structure_videos)
   170→    ? settings.structure_videos
   171→    : null;
   172→  if (rawStructureVideos) {
   173→    return rawStructureVideos
   174→      .map((entry) => {
   175→        const record = asRecord(entry);
   176→        if (!record) {
   177→          return null;
   178→        }
   179→
   180→        const path = parseString(record.path);
   181→        if (!path) {
   182→          return null;
   183→        }
   184→
   185→        const metadata = asRecord(record.metadata);
   186→        const resourceId = parseString(record.resource_id);

   191→          treatment: parseTreatment(record.treatment) ?? topLevelTreatment ?? options.defaultVideoTreatment,
   192→          motion_strength: parseNumber(record.motion_strength) ?? topLevelMotionStrength ?? options.defaultMotionStrength,
   193→          structure_type: parseStructureType(record.structure_type) ?? topLevelStructureType ?? options.defaultStructureType,

   195→          metadata: metadata as VideoMetadata | null ?? null,
   196→          resource_id: resourceId ?? null,
   197→        } satisfies MigratedLegacyStructureVideo;

1→import type { QueryClient, QueryKey } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     2→import { Shot, GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     3→import { queryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys';
     4→
     5→function getShotsProjectPrefix(projectId: string): readonly QueryKey {
     6→  return [...queryKeys.shots.all, projectId] as const;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getShotListQueries(queryClient: QueryClient, projectId: string) {
    10→  return queryClient.getQueriesData<Shot[]>({
    11→    [REDACTED](projectId),
    12→  });
    13→}
    14→
    15→/**
    16→ * @param onlyExisting - If true, only update caches that already exist.
    17→ *                       If false (default), will create cache entries if needed.
    18→ */
    19→export function updateAllShotsCaches(
    20→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    21→  projectId: string,
    22→  updater: (old: Shot[] | undefined) => Shot[],
    23→  onlyExisting: boolean = false
    24→): void {
    25→  const cachedQueries = getShotListQueries(queryClient, projectId);
    26→  if (cachedQueries.length === 0) {
    27→    if (!onlyExisting) {
    28→      queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>(
    29→        queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0),
    30→        (old) => updater(old)
    31→      );
    32→    }
    33→    return;
    34→  }
    35→
    36→  cachedQueries.forEach(([key, existing]) => {
    37→    if (onlyExisting && existing === undefined) {
    38→      return;
    39→    }
    40→    queryClient.setQueryData<Shot[]>(key, (old) => updater(old));
    41→  });
    42→}
    43→
    44→export function rollbackShotsCaches(
    45→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    46→  projectId: string,
    47→  previous: Shot[] | undefined
    48→): void {
    49→  if (!previous) return;
    50→  const cachedQueries = getShotListQueries(queryClient, projectId);
    51→  if (cachedQueries.length === 0) {
    52→    queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.shots.list(projectId, 0), previous);
    53→    return;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  cachedQueries.forEach(([key]) => {
    57→    queryClient.setQueryData(key, previous);
    58→  });
    59→}
    60→
    61→export async function cancelShotsQueries(
    62→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    63→  projectId: string
    64→): Promise<void> {
    65→  await queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED](projectId) });
    66→}
    67→
    68→export function findShotsCache(
    69→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    70→  projectId: string
    71→): Shot[] | undefined {
    72→  const cachedQueries = getShotListQueries(queryClient, projectId);
    73→  for (const [, data] of cachedQueries) {
    74→    if (data && data.length > 0) {
    75→      return data;
    76→    }
    77→  }
    78→  for (const [, data] of cachedQueries) {
    79→    if (data !== undefined) {
    80→      return data;
    81→    }
    82→  }
    83→  return undefined;
    84→}
    85→
    86→export function rollbackShotGenerationsCache(
    87→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    88→  shotId: string,
    89→  previous: GenerationRow[] | undefined
    90→): void {
    91→  if (!previous) return;
    92→  queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), previous);
    93→}
    94→
    95→export async function cancelShotGenerationsQuery(
    96→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    97→  shotId: string
    98→): Promise<void> {
    99→  await queryClient.cancelQueries({ [REDACTED](shotId) });

1→import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { useAutoTopup } from '@/shared/hooks/billing/useAutoTopup';
     3→import type { AutoTopupState } from '../types';
     4→
     5→interface UseAutoTopupStateProps {
     6→  initialPurchaseAmount: number;
     7→}
     8→
     9→interface UseAutoTopupStateReturn {
    10→  // State
    11→  purchaseAmount: number;
    12→  localAutoTopupEnabled: boolean;
    13→  localAutoTopupThreshold: number;
    14→  autoTopupState: AutoTopupState;
    15→  isUpdatingAutoTopup: boolean;
    16→
    17→  // Handlers
    18→  handlePurchaseAmountChange: (amount: number) => void;
    19→  handleAutoTopupToggle: (enabled: boolean) => void;
    20→  handleAutoTopupThresholdChange: (threshold: number) => void;
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function useAutoTopupState({ initialPurchaseAmount }: UseAutoTopupStateProps): UseAutoTopupStateReturn {
    24→  const {
    25→    preferences: autoTopupPreferences,
    26→    updatePreferences: updateAutoTopup,
    27→    isUpdatingPreferences: isUpdatingAutoTopup,
    28→  } = useAutoTopup();
    29→
    30→  const [purchaseAmount, setPurchaseAmount] = useState(initialPurchaseAmount);
    31→  const [localAutoTopupEnabled, setLocalAutoTopupEnabled] = useState(true);
    32→  const [localAutoTopupThreshold, setLocalAutoTopupThreshold] = useState(10);
    33→  const [hasInitialized, setHasInitialized] = useState(false);
    34→
    35→  // Debounce timer for threshold changes
    36→  const thresholdDebounceRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    37→
    38→  // Initialize from server preferences
    39→  useEffect(() => {
    40→    if (autoTopupPreferences && !hasInitialized) {
    41→      setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(autoTopupPreferences.enabled);
    42→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(autoTopupPreferences.threshold || 10);
    43→
    44→      if (autoTopupPreferences.amount && autoTopupPreferences.amount !== 50) {
    45→        setPurchaseAmount(autoTopupPreferences.amount);
    46→      }
    47→
    48→      setHasInitialized(true);
    49→    }
    50→  }, [autoTopupPreferences, hasInitialized]);
    51→
    52→  // Auto-update threshold for new users when purchase amount changes
    53→  useEffect(() => {
    54→    if (hasInitialized && autoTopupPreferences && autoTopupPreferences.threshold === 10 && purchaseAmount !== 50) {
    55→      const defaultThreshold = Math.max(1, Math.floor(purchaseAmount / 5));
    56→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(defaultThreshold);
    57→    }
    58→  }, [purchaseAmount, hasInitialized, autoTopupPreferences]);
    59→
    60→  // Cleanup debounce timer on unmount
    61→  useEffect(() => {
    62→    return () => {
    63→      if (thresholdDebounceRef.current) {
    64→        clearTimeout(thresholdDebounceRef.current);
    65→      }
    66→    };
    67→  }, []);
    68→
    69→  // Computed auto-top-up state
    70→  const autoTopupState = useMemo((): AutoTopupState => {
    71→    if (!autoTopupPreferences) return 'loading';
    72→
    73→    const { setupCompleted } = autoTopupPreferences;
    74→    const enabled = localAutoTopupEnabled;
    75→
    76→    if (enabled && setupCompleted) return 'active';
    77→    if (!enabled && setupCompleted) return 'setup-but-disabled';
    78→    if (enabled && !setupCompleted) return 'enabled-but-not-setup';
    79→    return 'not-setup';
    80→  }, [autoTopupPreferences, localAutoTopupEnabled]);
    81→
    82→  const handleAutoTopupToggle = (enabled: boolean) => {
    83→    const previousEnabled = localAutoTopupEnabled;
    84→    setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(enabled);
    85→
    86→    const saveData = {
    87→      enabled,
    88→      amount: purchaseAmount,
    89→      threshold: localAutoTopupThreshold,
    90→    };
    91→    updateAutoTopup(saveData, {
    92→      onError: () => {
    93→        setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(previousEnabled);
    94→      },
    95→    });
    96→  };
    97→
    98→  const handleAutoTopupThresholdChange = (threshold: number) => {
    99→    setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(threshold);
   100→
   101→    // Debounce the save
   102→    if (thresholdDebounceRef.current) {
   103→      clearTimeout(thresholdDebounceRef.current);
   104→    }
   105→    thresholdDebounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
   106→      updateAutoTopup({
   107→        enabled: localAutoTopupEnabled,
   108→        amount: purchaseAmount,
   109→        threshold,
   110→      });
   111→    }, 500);
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const handlePurchaseAmountChange = (amount: number) => {
   115→    const previousAmount = purchaseAmount;
   116→    const previousThreshold = localAutoTopupThreshold;
   117→    setPurchaseAmount(amount);
   118→
   119→    if (localAutoTopupEnabled) {
   120→      const newThreshold = Math.max(1, Math.floor(amount / 5));
   121→
   122→      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(newThreshold);
   123→
   124→      updateAutoTopup({
   125→        enabled: localAutoTopupEnabled,
   126→        amount: amount,
   127→        threshold: newThreshold,
   128→      }, {
   129→        onError: () => {
   130→          setPurchaseAmount(previousAmount);
   131→          setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(previousThreshold);
   132→        },
   133→      });
   134→    }
   135→  };
   136→
   137→  return {
   138→    purchaseAmount,
   139→    localAutoTopupEnabled,
   140→    localAutoTopupThreshold,
   141→    autoTopupState,
   142→    isUpdatingAutoTopup,
   143→    handlePurchaseAmountChange,
   144→    handleAutoTopupToggle,
   145→    handleAutoTopupThresholdChange,
   146→  };
   147→}
   148→

1→import { useState, useRef, useCallback } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Horizontal pointer-swipe navigation with edge resistance and scroll-safe gesture locking.
     5→ */
     6→
     7→interface UseSwipeNavigationProps {
     8→  /** Called when user swipes left (navigate to next) */
     9→  onSwipeLeft?: () => void;
    10→  /** Called when user swipes right (navigate to previous) */
    11→  onSwipeRight?: () => void;
    12→  /** Disable swipe gestures entirely */
    13→  disabled?: boolean;
    14→  /** Minimum distance in pixels to trigger navigation (default: 50) */
    15→  threshold?: number;
    16→  /** Minimum velocity (px/ms) for quick flick gestures (default: 0.3) */
    17→  velocityThreshold?: number;
    18→  /** Whether there's a next item (affects elastic resistance) */
    19→  hasNext?: boolean;
    20→  /** Whether there's a previous item (affects elastic resistance) */
    21→  hasPrevious?: boolean;
    22→  /** Maximum offset for elastic resistance when at edge (default: 80) */
    23→  maxElasticOffset?: number;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface UseSwipeNavigationReturn {
    27→  /** Handlers to spread on the swipeable element */
    28→  swipeHandlers: {
    29→    onPointerDown: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    30→    onPointerMove: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    31→    onPointerUp: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    32→    onPointerCancel: (e: React.PointerEvent) => void;
    33→  };
    34→  /** Current horizontal offset for visual feedback (in pixels) */
    35→  swipeOffset: number;
    36→  /** Whether the user is actively swiping */
    37→  isSwiping: boolean;
    38→}
    39→
    40→interface SwipeState {
    41→  startX: number;
    42→  startY: number;
    43→  startTime: number;
    44→  currentX: number;
    45→  pointerId: number;
    46→  isLocked: boolean; // Once we determine direction, lock it
    47→  isHorizontal: boolean | null; // null = undetermined, true = horizontal, false = vertical
    48→}
    49→
    50→function isInteractiveElement(el: HTMLElement | null): boolean {
    51→  const interactiveTags = ['BUTTON', 'INPUT', 'TEXTAREA', 'SELECT', 'A', 'VIDEO', 'CANVAS'];
    52→  const interactiveRoles = ['button', 'slider', 'textbox', 'link', 'scrollbar'];
    53→  
    54→  let current: HTMLElement | null = el;
    55→  while (current) {
    56→    if (interactiveTags.includes(current.tagName)) {
    57→      return true;
    58→    }
    59→
    60→    const role = current.getAttribute('role');
    61→    if (role && interactiveRoles.includes(role)) {
    62→      return true;
    63→    }
    64→
    65→    if (current.getAttribute('data-no-swipe') === 'true') {
    66→      return true;
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    if (current.getAttribute('data-scrollable') === 'true') {
    70→      return true;
    71→    }
    72→
    73→    const style = window.getComputedStyle(current);
    74→    if (
    75→      (style.overflowY === 'scroll' || style.overflowY === 'auto') &&
    76→      current.scrollHeight > current.clientHeight
    77→    ) {
    78→      return true;
    79→    }
    80→
    81→    if (current.tagName === 'CANVAS') {
    82→      return true;
    83→    }
    84→
    85→    if (current.getAttribute('data-scroll-area-viewport')) {
    86→      return true;
    87→    }
    88→
    89→    current = current.parentElement;
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  return false;
    93→}
    94→
    95→export function useSwipeNavigation({
    96→  onSwipeLeft,
    97→  onSwipeRight,
    98→  disabled = false,
    99→  threshold = 50,
   100→  velocityThreshold = 0.3,
   101→  hasNext = true,
   102→  hasPrevious = true,
   103→  maxElasticOffset = 80,
   104→}: UseSwipeNavigationProps): UseSwipeNavigationReturn {
   105→  const [swipeOffset, setSwipeOffset] = useState(0);
   106→  const [isSwiping, setIsSwiping] = useState(false);
   107→  const swipeStateRef = useRef<SwipeState | null>(null);
   108→
   109→  const applyElasticResistance = useCallback((deltaX: number): number => {
   110→    if (deltaX > 0 && !hasPrevious) {
   111→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * Math.min(maxElasticOffset, Math.abs(deltaX) * 0.3);
   112→    }
   113→
   114→    if (deltaX < 0 && !hasNext) {
   115→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * Math.min(maxElasticOffset, Math.abs(deltaX) * 0.3);
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    const maxNormalOffset = 150;
   119→    if (Math.abs(deltaX) > maxNormalOffset) {
   120→      const excess = Math.abs(deltaX) - maxNormalOffset;
   121→      return Math.sign(deltaX) * (maxNormalOffset + excess * 0.2);
   122→    }
   123→    
   124→    return deltaX;
   125→  }, [hasNext, hasPrevious, maxElasticOffset]);
   126→  
   127→  const handlePointerDown = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   128→    if (disabled) return;
   129→    if (!e.isPrimary) return;
   130→
   131→    const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
   132→    if (isInteractiveElement(target)) {
   133→      return;
   134→    }
   135→    
   136→    swipeStateRef.current = {
   137→      startX: e.clientX,
   138→      startY: e.clientY,
   139→      startTime: Date.now(),
   140→      currentX: e.clientX,
   141→      pointerId: e.pointerId,
   142→      isLocked: false,
   143→      isHorizontal: null,
   144→    };
   145→
   146→    try {
   147→      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).setPointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   148→    } catch {
   149→    }
   150→  }, [disabled]);
   151→  
   152→  const handlePointerMove = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   153→    const state = swipeStateRef.current;
   154→    if (!state || !e.isPrimary || state.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
   155→    
   156→    const deltaX = e.clientX - state.startX;
   157→    const deltaY = e.clientY - state.startY;
   158→    const absDeltaX = Math.abs(deltaX);
   159→    const absDeltaY = Math.abs(deltaY);
   160→
   161→    if (!state.isLocked && (absDeltaX > 10 || absDeltaY > 10)) {
   162→      state.isHorizontal = absDeltaX > absDeltaY * 0.8;
   163→      state.isLocked = true;
   164→
   165→      if (!state.isHorizontal) {
   166→        swipeStateRef.current = null;
   167→        setSwipeOffset(0);
   168→        setIsSwiping(false);
   169→        try {
   170→          (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   171→        } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   172→        return;
   173→      }
   174→    }
   175→
   176→    if (state.isLocked && state.isHorizontal) {
   177→      e.preventDefault();
   178→      state.currentX = e.clientX;
   179→      const resistedOffset = applyElasticResistance(deltaX);
   180→      setSwipeOffset(resistedOffset);
   181→      setIsSwiping(true);
   182→    }
   183→  }, [applyElasticResistance]);
   184→  
   185→  const handlePointerUp = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   186→    const state = swipeStateRef.current;
   187→    if (!state || !e.isPrimary || state.pointerId !== e.pointerId) return;
   188→    
   189→    const deltaX = e.clientX - state.startX;
   190→    const duration = Math.max(Date.now() - state.startTime, 1);
   191→    const velocity = Math.abs(deltaX) / duration;
   192→    const absDeltaX = Math.abs(deltaX);
   193→
   194→    if (state.isLocked && state.isHorizontal) {
   195→      const metDistanceThreshold = absDeltaX >= threshold;
   196→      const metVelocityThreshold = velocity >= velocityThreshold && absDeltaX > 20;
   197→
   198→      if (metDistanceThreshold || metVelocityThreshold) {
   199→        if (deltaX < 0 && hasNext) {
   200→          onSwipeLeft?.();
   201→        } else if (deltaX > 0 && hasPrevious) {
   202→          onSwipeRight?.();
   203→        }
   204→      }
   205→    }
   206→
   207→    try {
   208→      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   209→    } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   210→
   211→    swipeStateRef.current = null;
   212→    setSwipeOffset(0);
   213→    setIsSwiping(false);
   214→  }, [threshold, velocityThreshold, hasNext, hasPrevious, onSwipeLeft, onSwipeRight]);
   215→  
   216→  const handlePointerCancel = useCallback((e: React.PointerEvent) => {
   217→    try {
   218→      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).releasePointerCapture(e.pointerId);
   219→    } catch { /* intentionally ignored */ }
   220→
   221→    swipeStateRef.current = null;
   222→    setSwipeOffset(0);
   223→    setIsSwiping(false);
   224→  }, []);
   225→  
   226→  return {
   227→    swipeHandlers: {
   228→      onPointerDown: handlePointerDown,
   229→      onPointerMove: handlePointerMove,
   230→      onPointerUp: handlePointerUp,
   231→      onPointerCancel: handlePointerCancel,
   232→    },
   233→    swipeOffset,
   234→    isSwiping,
   235→  };
   236→}

1→/**
     2→ * PreloadingService - Unified coordinator for all image preloading
     3→ *
     4→ * This is the single source of truth for:
     5→ * 1. Preload queue management (network concurrency)
     6→ * 2. Lifecycle coordination (project switch, deletions, connection changes)
     7→ *
     8→ * The tracker (tracker.ts) is the source of truth for what's been loaded.
     9→ * This service coordinates preloading and lifecycle events.
    10→ */

    16→import {

    29→import { dataFreshnessManager } from '@/shared/realtime/DataFreshnessManager';
    30→
    31→// =============================================================================
    32→// SERVICE
    33→// =============================================================================
    34→
    35→class PreloadingService {
    36→  private state: PreloadingServiceState = {
    37→    currentProjectId: null,
    38→    isConnected: true,
    39→    isPaused: false,
    40→  };
    41→
    42→  private queue: PreloadQueue;
    43→  private config: PreloadConfig;
    44→  private subscribers = new Set<PreloadingSubscriber>();
    45→
    46→  // Singleton
    47→  private static instance: PreloadingService | null = null;
    48→
    49→  static getInstance(): PreloadingService {
    50→    if (!PreloadingService.instance) {
    51→      PreloadingService.instance = new PreloadingService();
    52→    }
    53→    return PreloadingService.instance;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  private constructor() {
    57→    this.config = getPreloadConfig();
    58→    this.queue = new PreloadQueue(this.config.maxConcurrent);
    59→
    60→    // Subscribe to connection status changes from DataFreshnessManager
    61→    this.subscribeToConnectionStatus();
    62→
    63→  }
    64→
    65→  /**
    66→   * Subscribe to DataFreshnessManager to track connection status.
    67→   */
    68→  private subscribeToConnectionStatus(): void {
    69→    // Get initial status
    70→    const initialDiagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    71→    this.state.isConnected = initialDiagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    72→
    73→    // Subscribe to changes
    74→    dataFreshnessManager.subscribe(() => {
    75→      const diagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    76→      const isConnected = diagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    77→
    78→      if (isConnected !== this.state.isConnected) {
    79→        this.onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected);
    80→      }
    81→    });
    82→  }
    83→
    84→  // ===========================================================================
    85→  // LIFECYCLE EVENTS
    86→  // ===========================================================================
    87→
    88→  /**
    89→   * Called when the selected project changes.
    90→   * Clears all preloading state for the old project.
    91→   */
    92→  onProjectChange(projectId: string | null): void {
    93→    if (projectId === this.state.currentProjectId) {
    94→      return;
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    const previousProject = this.state.currentProjectId;
    98→
    99→    // Clear queue
   100→    this.queue.clear();
   101→
   102→    // Clear load tracker (single source of truth for what's loaded)
   103→    const clearedCount = clearAllLoadedImages('project switch');
   104→
   105→    this.state.currentProjectId = projectId;
   106→
   107→    this.emit({
   108→      type: 'project-changed',
   109→      data: { from: previousProject, to: projectId, clearedCount },
   110→    });
   111→  }

   115→   * Removes them from the load tracker.

   117→  onGenerationsDeleted(generationIds: string[]): void {
   118→    if (generationIds.length === 0) return;
   119→
   120→    // Remove from load tracker (the source of truth)
   121→    const clearedCount = clearLoadedImages(
   122→      generationIds.map((id) => ({ id }))
   123→    );
   124→
   125→    this.emit({
   126→      type: 'generations-deleted',
   127→      data: { ids: generationIds, clearedCount },
   128→    });

   137→

   139→

   154→  pause(): void {

   156→    this.state.isPaused = true;
   157→    this.queue.clear();
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  /**
   161→   * Resume preloading.
   162→   */
   163→  resume(): void {
   164→    if (!this.state.isPaused) return;
   165→    this.state.isPaused = false;
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  // ===========================================================================
   169→  // PRELOADING API
   170→  // ===========================================================================
   171→
   172→  /**
   173→   * Preload a batch of images.
   174→   * Uses the shared queue to avoid overwhelming the network.
   175→   */
   176→  async preloadImages(

   178→    priority: number = PRIORITY.normal

   189→  /**
   190→   * Get the current config.
   191→   */
   192→  getConfig(): PreloadConfig {
   193→    return this.config;
   194→  }
   195→
   196→  // ===========================================================================
   197→  // SUBSCRIPTION
   198→  // ===========================================================================
   199→
   200→  subscribe(callback: PreloadingSubscriber): () => void {
   201→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   202→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   203→  }
   204→
   205→  private emit(event: PreloadingEvent): void {
   206→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   207→      try {
   208→        callback(event);

   211→      }
   212→    });
   213→  }

   215→  // ===========================================================================
   216→  // DEBUGGING

   218→

   220→    state: PreloadingServiceState;
   221→    queue: { size: number; active: number };
   222→    tracker: ReturnType<typeof getLoadTrackerStats>;
   223→  } {

   228→        active: this.queue.activeCount,
   229→      },
   230→      tracker: getLoadTrackerStats(),
   231→    };
   232→  }

1→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { useGetTask } from '@/shared/hooks/tasks/useTasks';
     3→import { deriveInputImages } from '@/shared/lib/taskParamsUtils';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     6→
     7→interface UseGenerationDetailsOptions {
     8→  taskId?: string;
     9→  task?: Task;
    10→  inputImages?: string[];
    11→  projectId?: string | null;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseGenerationDetailsResult {
    15→  task: Task | undefined;
    16→  inputImages: string[];
    17→  isLoading: boolean;
    18→  isError: boolean;
    19→}
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Hook for fetching and preparing task data for GenerationDetails
    23→ *
    24→ * Handles:
    25→ * - Fetching task data by ID if provided
    26→ * - Using directly provided task if available
    27→ * - Deriving input images from task params
    28→ */
    29→export function useGenerationDetails({
    30→  taskId,
    31→  task: taskProp,
    32→  inputImages: inputImagesProp,
    33→  projectId,
    34→}: UseGenerationDetailsOptions): UseGenerationDetailsResult {
    35→  // Fetch task data if taskId is provided and no task prop
    36→  const { data: fetchedTask, isLoading, isError } = useGetTask(taskId || '', projectId);
    37→
    38→  // Use provided task or fetched task
    39→  const task = taskProp || fetchedTask;
    40→
    41→  // Derive input images from task if not explicitly provided
    42→  const inputImages = useMemo(() => {
    43→    if (inputImagesProp && inputImagesProp.length > 0) {
    44→      return inputImagesProp;
    45→    }
    46→    if (!task?.params) return [];
    47→    // Parse params if needed
    48→    let params: Record<string, unknown>;
    49→    try {
    50→      params = typeof task.params === 'string' ? JSON.parse(task.params) : task.params;
    51→    } catch (error) {
    52→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    53→        context: 'useGenerationDetails.parseTaskParams',
    54→        showToast: false,
    55→        logData: { taskId: task?.id, hasStringParams: typeof task?.params === 'string' },
    56→      });
    57→      return [];
    58→    }
    59→    return deriveInputImages(params);
    60→  }, [inputImagesProp, task]);
    61→
    62→  return {
    63→    task,
    64→    inputImages,
    65→    isLoading: taskId ? isLoading && !taskProp : false,
    66→    isError: taskId ? isError && !taskProp : false,
    67→  };
    68→}
    69→

1→/**
     2→ * useVariantPromotion - Handles promoting variants to standalone generations
     3→ *
     4→ * Manages variant promotion (creating standalone generation from a variant)
     5→ * and adding variants as new generations to shots with timeline positioning.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useState, useCallback } from 'react';
     9→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/runtime/sonner';
    10→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    11→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    12→import { usePromoteVariantToGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/variants/usePromoteVariantToGeneration';
    13→import { useAddImageToShot } from '@/shared/hooks/shots';
    14→
    15→interface UseVariantPromotionProps {
    16→  selectedProjectId: string | null;
    17→}
    18→
    19→interface UseVariantPromotionReturn {
    20→  promoteSuccess: boolean;
    21→  isPromoting: boolean;
    22→  handlePromoteToGeneration: (variantId: string) => Promise<void>;
    23→  handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot: (
    24→    shotId: string,
    25→    variantId: string,
    26→    currentTimelineFrame?: number
    27→  ) => Promise<boolean>;
    28→}
    29→
    30→export function useVariantPromotion({
    31→  selectedProjectId,
    32→}: UseVariantPromotionProps): UseVariantPromotionReturn {
    33→  const promoteVariantMutation = usePromoteVariantToGeneration();
    34→  const addImageToShotMutation = useAddImageToShot();
    35→  const [promoteSuccess, setPromoteSuccess] = useState(false);
    36→
    37→  // Handler for "Make new image" button in VariantSelector
    38→  const handlePromoteToGeneration = useCallback(async (variantId: string) => {
    39→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    40→      toast.error('No project selected');
    41→      return;
    42→    }
    43→
    44→    setPromoteSuccess(false);
    45→
    46→    try {
    47→      await promoteVariantMutation.mutateAsync({
    48→        variantId,
    49→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
    50→      });
    51→
    52→      setPromoteSuccess(true);
    53→      setTimeout(() => setPromoteSuccess(false), 2000);
    54→    } catch (error) {
    55→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: true });
    56→    }
    57→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, selectedProjectId]);
    58→
    59→  // Handler for "Add as new image to shot" button in ShotSelectorControls
    60→  // Positions new image between current and next item in the TARGET shot
    61→  const handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot = useCallback(async (
    62→    shotId: string,
    63→    variantId: string,
    64→    currentTimelineFrame?: number
    65→  ): Promise<boolean> => {
    66→    if (!selectedProjectId) {
    67→      toast.error('No project selected');
    68→      return false;
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    try {
    72→      // 1. Create the generation from the variant
    73→      const newGen = await promoteVariantMutation.mutateAsync({
    74→        variantId,
    75→        projectId: selectedProjectId,
    76→      });
    77→
    78→      // 2. Calculate target timeline frame by querying the TARGET shot's items
    79→      let targetTimelineFrame: number | undefined;
    80→      if (currentTimelineFrame !== undefined) {
    81→        // Query all items in the target shot to find next item and calculate average spacing
    82→        const { data: allShotItems } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
    83→          .select('timeline_frame')
    84→          .eq('shot_id', shotId)
    85→          .not('timeline_frame', 'is', null)
    86→          .order('timeline_frame', { ascending: true });
    87→
    88→        const frames = (allShotItems || [])
    89→          .map(item => item.timeline_frame as number)
    90→          .filter(f => f !== null && f !== undefined);
    91→
    92→        // Find the next item after current position
    93→        const nextTimelineFrame = frames.find(f => f > currentTimelineFrame);
    94→
    95→        if (nextTimelineFrame !== undefined && nextTimelineFrame > currentTimelineFrame) {
    96→          // Place in the middle between current and next
    97→          targetTimelineFrame = Math.floor((currentTimelineFrame + nextTimelineFrame) / 2);
    98→          // If middle would be same as current (consecutive frames), use current + 1
    99→          if (targetTimelineFrame === currentTimelineFrame) {
   100→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   101→          }
   102→        } else {
   103→          // No next item in shot - calculate average spacing and use that
   104→          if (frames.length >= 2) {
   105→            // Calculate average gap between consecutive frames
   106→            let totalGap = 0;
   107→            for (let i = 1; i < frames.length; i++) {
   108→              totalGap += frames[i] - frames[i - 1];
   109→            }
   110→            const averageGap = Math.round(totalGap / (frames.length - 1));
   111→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + Math.max(1, averageGap);
   112→          } else {
   113→            // Only one item in shot, use current + 1
   114→            targetTimelineFrame = currentTimelineFrame + 1;
   115→          }
   116→        }
   117→      }
   118→
   119→      // 3. Add to shot
   120→      await addImageToShotMutation.mutateAsync({
   121→        shot_id: shotId,
   122→        generation_id: newGen.id,
   123→        project_id: selectedProjectId,
   124→        imageUrl: newGen.location,
   125→        thumbUrl: newGen.thumbnail_url || undefined,
   126→        timelineFrame: targetTimelineFrame,
   127→      });
   128→      return true;
   129→    } catch (error) {
   130→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useVariantPromotion', showToast: true });
   131→      return false;
   132→    }
   133→  }, [promoteVariantMutation, addImageToShotMutation, selectedProjectId]);
   134→
   135→  return {
   136→    promoteSuccess,
   137→    isPromoting: promoteVariantMutation.isPending,
   138→    handlePromoteToGeneration,
   139→    handleAddVariantAsNewGenerationToShot,
   140→  };
   141→}
   142→

    19→export const CreateProjectModal: React.FC<CreateProjectModalProps> = ({ isOpen, onOpenChange, initialName }) => {
    20→  const [projectName, setProjectName] = useState(initialName || '');

    22→  const { addNewProject, isCreatingProject, projects, selectedProjectId } = useProject();

    27→  
    28→  // Update default aspect ratio when modal opens or current project changes
    29→  useEffect(() => {
    30→    if (isOpen && currentProject?.aspectRatio) {
    31→      setAspectRatio(currentProject.aspectRatio);
    32→    }
    33→  }, [isOpen, currentProject?.aspectRatio]);
    34→  
    35→  // Set initial name when modal opens with one provided, or reset when closing
    36→  useEffect(() => {
    37→    if (isOpen) {
    38→      // When opening, set to initialName if provided, otherwise reset
    39→      setProjectName(initialName || '');
    40→    }
    41→  }, [isOpen, initialName]);
    42→
    43→  const handleCreateProject = async () => {
    44→    let finalProjectName = projectName.trim();
    45→    // If user didn't enter a name, pick a random dummy name that's not already used
    46→    if (!finalProjectName) {
    47→      const existingNamesLower = projects.map(p => p.name.toLowerCase());
    48→
    49→      // Try up to dummy names list length times to find a unique one
    50→      const maxTries = 10;
    51→      let tries = 0;
    52→      let candidateName = '';
    53→      while (tries < maxTries) {
    54→        candidateName = getRandomDummyName();
    55→        if (!existingNamesLower.includes(candidateName.toLowerCase())) {
    56→          break;
    57→        }
    58→        tries++;
    59→      }
    60→
    61→      // As a fallback, append a random number to guarantee uniqueness
    62→      if (existingNamesLower.includes(candidateName.toLowerCase())) {
    63→        candidateName = `${candidateName} ${Math.floor(Math.random() * 1000)}`;
    64→      }
    65→
    66→      finalProjectName = candidateName;
    67→    }
    68→
    69→    if (!aspectRatio) {
    70→      toast.error("Please select an aspect ratio.");

    72→    }

    98→          isLoading={isCreatingProject}
    99→          disabled={!aspectRatio}
   100→        />
   101→      }
   102→    >
   103→      <div className="grid gap-4 py-3">

   114→            maxLength={30}

1→interface BuildVideoLightboxLayoutStateInput {
     2→  isMobile: boolean;
     3→  isFormOnlyMode: boolean;
     4→  isTabletOrLarger: boolean;
     5→  isPortraitMode: boolean;
     6→  shouldShowSidePanel: boolean;
     7→  isAnyVideoEditMode: boolean;
     8→  hasSegmentVideo: boolean;
     9→  showTaskDetails: boolean;
    10→  isSegmentSlotMode: boolean;
    11→  effectiveTasksPaneOpen: boolean;
    12→  isTasksPaneLocked: boolean;
    13→}
    14→
    15→interface VideoLightboxLayoutState {
    16→  shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim: boolean;
    17→  showPanel: boolean;
    18→  needsFullscreenLayout: boolean;
    19→  needsTasksPaneOffset: boolean;
    20→  panelVariant: 'desktop' | 'mobile';
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function buildVideoLightboxLayoutState(
    24→  input: BuildVideoLightboxLayoutStateInput,
    25→): VideoLightboxLayoutState {
    26→  const shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim = input.shouldShowSidePanel
    27→    || ((!input.isPortraitMode && input.isTabletOrLarger) && input.isAnyVideoEditMode);
    28→
    29→  const showPanel = shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim
    30→    || ((input.showTaskDetails || input.isAnyVideoEditMode || (input.isSegmentSlotMode && input.hasSegmentVideo)) && input.isMobile);
    31→
    32→  const needsFullscreenLayout = input.isMobile
    33→    || input.isFormOnlyMode
    34→    || input.shouldShowSidePanel
    35→    || shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim;
    36→
    37→  const needsTasksPaneOffset = needsFullscreenLayout
    38→    && (input.effectiveTasksPaneOpen || input.isTasksPaneLocked)
    39→    && !input.isPortraitMode
    40→    && input.isTabletOrLarger;
    41→
    42→  const panelVariant = (shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim && !input.isMobile)
    43→    ? 'desktop'
    44→    : 'mobile';
    45→
    46→  return {
    47→    shouldShowSidePanelWithTrim,
    48→    showPanel,
    49→    needsFullscreenLayout,
    50→    needsTasksPaneOffset,
    51→    panelVariant,
    52→  };
    53→}
    54→

    86→/**
    87→ * Unified edit settings persistence hook
    88→ *
    89→ * Coordinates:
    90→ * 1. Per-generation settings (generations.params.ui.editSettings)
    91→ * 2. "Last used" settings (useToolSettings + localStorage)
    92→ *
    93→ * Loading behavior:
    94→ * - If generation has persisted settings → use those (including prompt)
    95→ * - If no persisted settings → use "last used" (prompt = '')
    96→ *
    97→ * Saving behavior:
    98→ * - All changes save to generation
    99→ * - Non-prompt changes also update "last used"
   100→ */
   101→export function useEditSettingsPersistence({
   102→  generationId,
   103→  projectId,
   104→  enabled = true,
   105→}: UseEditSettingsPersistenceProps): UseEditSettingsPersistenceReturn {
   106→  // Per-generation settings
   107→  const generationSettings = useGenerationEditSettings({
   108→    generationId,
   109→    enabled,
   110→  });
   111→
   112→  // "Last used" settings
   113→  const lastUsedSettings = useLastUsedEditSettings({
   114→    projectId,
   115→    enabled,
   116→  });
   117→
   118→  // Track initialization state
   119→  const hasInitializedRef = useRef(false);
   120→  const lastGenerationIdRef = useRef<string | null>(null);
   121→  const [isReady, setIsReady] = useState(false);
   122→
   123→  // Reset initialization on generation change
   124→  useEffect(() => {
   125→    if (generationId !== lastGenerationIdRef.current) {
   126→      hasInitializedRef.current = false;
   127→      lastGenerationIdRef.current = generationId;
   128→      setIsReady(false);
   129→    }
   130→  }, [generationId]);
   131→
   132→  // Extract stable references for the initialization effect
   133→  const { isLoading: genIsLoading, hasPersistedSettings, initializeFromLastUsed } = generationSettings;
   134→  const { lastUsed } = lastUsedSettings;
   135→
   136→  // Initialize from "last used" when generation loads without persisted settings
   137→  useEffect(() => {
   138→    if (!genIsLoading && !hasInitializedRef.current && !hasPersistedSettings && generationId) {
   139→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   140→      // Apply "last used" settings (without prompt)
   141→      initializeFromLastUsed(lastUsed);
   142→      setIsReady(true);
   143→    } else if (!genIsLoading && !hasInitializedRef.current && hasPersistedSettings) {
   144→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
   145→      setIsReady(true);
   146→    }
   147→  }, [generationId, genIsLoading, hasPersistedSettings, initializeFromLastUsed, lastUsed]);
   148→
   149→  // Compute effective values
   150→  // editMode is ALWAYS from lastUsed (user-level, not per-generation) so it stays consistent across images/videos
   151→  // Other settings like prompt, loraMode are per-generation
   152→  const effectiveSettings = useMemo(() => {
   153→    if (generationSettings.isLoading) {
   154→      // Still loading, use defaults but editMode from lastUsed
   155→      return {
   156→        ...DEFAULT_EDIT_SETTINGS,
   157→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   158→      };
   159→    }
   160→
   161→    if (generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings) {
   162→      // Has persisted settings, use them BUT override editMode with lastUsed (user-level)
   163→      return {
   164→        ...generationSettings.settings,
   165→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   166→      };
   167→    }
   168→
   169→    // No persisted settings yet.
   170→    // Before the coordinator finishes initialization, we use lastUsed as defaults.
   171→    // After initialization, always prefer the live generationSettings state so controls
   172→    // (like the Img2Img strength slider) never feel "locked" while the debounced save runs.
   173→    if (!isReady) {
   174→      return {
   175→        editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   176→        loraMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.loraMode,
   177→        customLoraUrl: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.customLoraUrl,
   178→        numGenerations: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.numGenerations,
   179→        prompt: generationSettings.settings.prompt || '',
   180→        img2imgPrompt: generationSettings.settings.img2imgPrompt || '',
   181→        img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: generationSettings.settings.img2imgPromptHasBeenSet || false,
   182→        img2imgStrength: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.img2imgStrength,
   183→        img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.img2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   184→        advancedSettings: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS,
   185→        enhanceSettings: generationSettings.settings.enhanceSettings ?? DEFAULT_ENHANCE_SETTINGS,
   186→        qwenEditModel: generationSettings.settings.qwenEditModel ?? DEFAULT_EDIT_SETTINGS.qwenEditModel,
   187→        createAsGeneration: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.createAsGeneration,
   188→      };
   189→    }
   190→
   191→    // Initialized: use the live per-generation state BUT override editMode with lastUsed (user-level)
   192→    return {
   193→      ...generationSettings.settings,
   194→      editMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.editMode,
   195→    };
   196→  }, [
   197→    isReady,
   198→    generationSettings.isLoading,
   199→    generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings,
   200→    generationSettings.settings,
   201→    lastUsedSettings.lastUsed,
   202→  ]);
   203→
   204→  // Extract stable function references to avoid recreating callbacks on every render
   205→  // (the parent objects are recreated each render, but these functions are stable)
   206→  const { updateLastUsed } = lastUsedSettings;
   207→  const {
   208→    setLoraMode: genSetLoraMode,
   209→    setCustomLoraUrl: genSetCustomLoraUrl,
   210→    setNumGenerations: genSetNumGenerations,
   211→    setPrompt: genSetPrompt,
   212→    setQwenEditModel: genSetQwenEditModel,
   213→    setImg2imgPrompt: genSetImg2imgPrompt,
   214→    setImg2imgStrength: genSetImg2imgStrength,
   215→    setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion: genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   216→    setAdvancedSettings: genSetAdvancedSettings,
   217→    setEnhanceSettings: genSetEnhanceSettings,
   218→    setCreateAsGeneration: genSetCreateAsGeneration,
   219→  } = generationSettings;
   220→
   221→  // Wrapper setters that also update "last used" (except prompt)
   222→  // editMode is user-level only (not per-generation) so it stays consistent across images/videos
   223→  const setEditMode = useCallback((mode: EditMode) => {
   224→    updateLastUsed({ editMode: mode });
   225→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   226→
   227→  const setLoraMode = useCallback((mode: LoraMode) => {
   228→    genSetLoraMode(mode);
   229→    updateLastUsed({ loraMode: mode });
   230→  }, [genSetLoraMode, updateLastUsed]);
   231→
   232→  const setCustomLoraUrl = useCallback((url: string) => {
   233→    genSetCustomLoraUrl(url);
   234→    updateLastUsed({ customLoraUrl: url });
   235→  }, [genSetCustomLoraUrl, updateLastUsed]);
   236→
   237→  const setNumGenerations = useCallback((num: number) => {
   238→    genSetNumGenerations(num);
   239→    updateLastUsed({ numGenerations: num });
   240→  }, [genSetNumGenerations, updateLastUsed]);
   241→
   242→  // Prompt only saves to generation (never to "last used")
   243→  const setPrompt = useCallback((prompt: string) => {
   244→    genSetPrompt(prompt);
   245→  }, [genSetPrompt]);
   246→
   247→  // Model selection (saves to generation, cloud mode only)
   248→  const setQwenEditModel = useCallback((model: QwenEditModel) => {
   249→    genSetQwenEditModel(model);
   250→  }, [genSetQwenEditModel]);
   251→
   252→  // Img2Img prompt only saves to generation (never to "last used")
   253→  const setImg2imgPrompt = useCallback((prompt: string) => {
   254→    genSetImg2imgPrompt(prompt);
   255→  }, [genSetImg2imgPrompt]);
   256→
   257→  // Img2Img setters (save to both generation and "last used")
   258→  const setImg2imgStrength = useCallback((strength: number) => {
   259→    genSetImg2imgStrength(strength);
   260→    updateLastUsed({ img2imgStrength: strength });
   261→  }, [genSetImg2imgStrength, updateLastUsed]);
   262→
   263→  const setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion = useCallback((enabled: boolean) => {
   264→    genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion(enabled);
   265→    updateLastUsed({ img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: enabled });
   266→  }, [genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion, updateLastUsed]);
   267→
   268→  // Advanced settings setter (merges with existing, saves to both generation and "last used")
   269→  const setAdvancedSettings = useCallback((updates: Partial<EditAdvancedSettings>) => {
   270→    genSetAdvancedSettings(updates);
   271→    // Merge updates with current advancedSettings for lastUsed
   272→    const currentAdvanced = effectiveSettings.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS;
   273→    updateLastUsed({ advancedSettings: { ...currentAdvanced, ...updates } });
   274→  }, [genSetAdvancedSettings, updateLastUsed, effectiveSettings.advancedSettings]);
   275→
   276→  // Video enhance settings setter (per-generation only, not "last used")
   277→  const setEnhanceSettings = useCallback((updates: Partial<VideoEnhanceSettings>) => {
   278→    genSetEnhanceSettings(updates);
   279→  }, [genSetEnhanceSettings]);
   280→
   281→  // Generation options setter (saves to both generation and "last used")
   282→  const setCreateAsGeneration = useCallback((value: boolean) => {
   283→    genSetCreateAsGeneration(value);
   284→    updateLastUsed({ createAsGeneration: value });
   285→  }, [genSetCreateAsGeneration, updateLastUsed]);
   286→
   287→  // Video/Panel mode setters (only save to "last used", not per-generation)
   288→  const setVideoEditSubMode = useCallback((mode: VideoEditSubMode) => {
   289→    updateLastUsed({ videoEditSubMode: mode });
   290→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   291→
   292→  const setPanelMode = useCallback((mode: PanelMode) => {
   293→    updateLastUsed({ panelMode: mode });
   294→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   295→
   296→  // Computed LoRAs based on mode (replaces useEditModeLoras logic)
   297→  const loraMode = effectiveSettings.loraMode;
   298→  const customLoraUrl = effectiveSettings.customLoraUrl;
   299→  const editModeLoras = useMemo(() => {
   300→
   301→    switch (loraMode) {
   302→      case 'in-scene':
   303→        return [{ url: EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS['in-scene'], strength: 1.0 }];
   304→      case 'next-scene':
   305→        return [{ url: EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS['next-scene'], strength: 1.0 }];
   306→      case 'custom':
   307→        return customLoraUrl.trim()
   308→          ? [{ url: customLoraUrl.trim(), strength: 1.0 }]
   309→          : undefined;
   310→      case 'none':
   311→      default:
   312→        return undefined;
   313→    }
   314→  }, [loraMode, customLoraUrl]);
   315→
   316→  // Legacy compatibility
   317→  const isInSceneBoostEnabled = effectiveSettings.loraMode !== 'none';
   318→  const setIsInSceneBoostEnabled = (enabled: boolean) => {
   319→    setLoraMode(enabled ? 'in-scene' : 'none');
   320→  };
   321→
   322→  return {
   323→    // Current values (using effective settings to avoid race condition)
   324→    editMode: effectiveSettings.editMode,
   325→    loraMode: effectiveSettings.loraMode,
   326→    customLoraUrl: effectiveSettings.customLoraUrl,
   327→    numGenerations: effectiveSettings.numGenerations,
   328→    prompt: effectiveSettings.prompt,
   329→    // Img2Img values
   330→    img2imgPrompt: effectiveSettings.img2imgPrompt,
   331→    img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: effectiveSettings.img2imgPromptHasBeenSet,
   332→    img2imgStrength: effectiveSettings.img2imgStrength,
   333→    img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: effectiveSettings.img2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   334→    // Advanced settings (hires fix config)
   335→    advancedSettings: effectiveSettings.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS,
   336→    // Video enhance settings (interpolation/upscaling)
   337→    enhanceSettings: effectiveSettings.enhanceSettings ?? DEFAULT_ENHANCE_SETTINGS,
   338→    // Model selection for cloud mode
   339→    qwenEditModel: effectiveSettings.qwenEditModel ?? 'qwen-edit',
   340→    // Generation options
   341→    createAsGeneration: effectiveSettings.createAsGeneration ?? false,
   342→
   343→    // Setters
   344→    setEditMode,
   345→    setLoraMode,
   346→    setCustomLoraUrl,
   347→    setNumGenerations,
   348→    setPrompt,
   349→    setQwenEditModel,
   350→    // Img2Img setters
   351→    setImg2imgPrompt,
   352→    setImg2imgStrength,
   353→    setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   354→    // Advanced settings setter
   355→    setAdvancedSettings,
   356→    // Video enhance settings setter
   357→    setEnhanceSettings,
   358→    // Generation options setter
   359→    setCreateAsGeneration,
   360→
   361→    // Video/Panel mode (from "last used")
   362→    videoEditSubMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.videoEditSubMode,
   363→    panelMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.panelMode,
   364→    setVideoEditSubMode,
   365→    setPanelMode,
   366→
   367→    // Computed
   368→    editModeLoras,
   369→
   370→    // Legacy
   371→    isInSceneBoostEnabled,
   372→    setIsInSceneBoostEnabled,
   373→
   374→    // State
   375→    isLoading: generationSettings.isLoading,
   376→    isReady,
   377→    hasPersistedSettings: generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings,
   378→  };
   379→}
   380→
   381→// Re-export types for convenience
   382→export type { EditMode, LoraMode, QwenEditModel, EditAdvancedSettings, VideoEnhanceSettings, GenerationEditSettings, LastUsedEditSettings, VideoEditSubMode, PanelMode };
   383→

    10→export type { SupabaseClientAccessResult };

    12→export interface SupabaseClientRegistry {
    13→  getClientResult: () => SupabaseClientAccessResult;

    15→
    16→/** Runtime bootstrap entrypoint for app startup. */
    17→export function initializeSupabase() {
    18→  return initializeSupabaseClientRuntime();
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    22→  try {
    23→    const client = initializeSupabase();
    24→    return { ok: true, client };
    25→  } catch (error) {
    26→    return { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(error) };
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→/** Runtime accessor that never throws; callers can branch on initialization state. */
    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    32→  const result = getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult();
    33→  return result.ok ? result : { ok: false, error: normalizeSupabaseError(result.error) };

    37→  getClientResult: getSupabaseClientResult,
    38→};
    39→
    40→/** Runtime accessor for initialized app runtime. Throws if bootstrap has not run. */
    41→export function getSupabaseClient() {

    43→  if (!result.ok) {
    44→    throw result.error;

   139→function drawStar(
   140→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   141→  star: Star,

   151→    gradient.addColorStop(0.3, `rgba(255, 146, 115, ${pulseOpacity * 0.6})`);
   152→    gradient.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255, 166, 135, 0)');
   153→

   155→    ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, glowSize * 3, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   156→    ctx.fill();
   157→
   158→    ctx.beginPath();
   159→    ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 126, 95, ${pulseOpacity})`;
   160→    ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   161→    ctx.fill();
   162→    return;
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${pulseOpacity})`;
   166→  ctx.arc(star.x, star.y, star.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   167→  ctx.fill();
   168→}
   169→
   170→function updateAndDrawStars(
   171→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   172→  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
   173→  stars: Star[],
   174→  parallaxX: number,
   175→  parallaxY: number,
   176→  time: number
   177→): void {
   178→  stars.forEach((star, index) => {
   179→    const isClaudeStar = index === stars.length - 1;
   180→
   181→    star.baseX = wrapPosition(star.baseX + star.vx, canvas.width, 50);
   182→    star.baseY = wrapPosition(star.baseY + star.vy, canvas.height, 50);
   183→
   184→    const depth = star.size * 0.5;
   185→    star.x = star.baseX - parallaxX * depth;
   186→    star.y = star.baseY - parallaxY * depth;
   187→
   188→    const pulseOpacity = Math.max(
   189→      0,
   190→      Math.min(1, star.opacity + Math.sin(time * star.twinkleSpeed + star.twinklePhase) * 0.3)

   192→
   193→    drawStar(ctx, star, pulseOpacity, isClaudeStar);
   194→  });
   195→}
   196→
   197→function calculateWanderingMasterOpacity(startTime: number, now: number): number {
   198→  const timeSinceStart = now - startTime;
   199→  if (timeSinceStart < WANDERING_FADE_DELAY_MS) {
   200→    return 0;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  return Math.min(1, (timeSinceStart - WANDERING_FADE_DELAY_MS) / WANDERING_FADE_DURATION_MS);
   204→}
   205→
   206→function updateAndDrawWanderingGroups(
   207→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   208→  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
   209→  groups: WanderingGroup[],
   210→  now: number,
   211→  time: number,
   212→  masterOpacity: number
   213→): void {
   214→  for (const group of groups) {
   215→    group.vx += (group.targetVx - group.vx) * 0.01;
   216→    group.vy += (group.targetVy - group.vy) * 0.01;
   217→
   218→    group.cx = wrapPosition(group.cx + group.vx, canvas.width, 100);
   219→    group.cy = wrapPosition(group.cy + group.vy, canvas.height, 100);
   220→
   221→    if (now > group.nextDirectionChange) {
   222→      group.targetVx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * group.speed;
   223→      group.targetVy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * group.speed;
   224→      group.nextDirectionChange =
   225→        now + DIRECTION_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * DIRECTION_CHANGE_RANGE_MS;
   226→    }
   227→
   228→    group.opacity += (group.targetOpacity - group.opacity) * group.fadeSpeed * 16;
   229→
   230→    if (now > group.nextFadeChange) {
   231→      group.targetOpacity = Math.random() < 0.3 ? 0.05 : 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25;
   232→      group.nextFadeChange = now + FADE_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * FADE_CHANGE_RANGE_MS;
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    for (const particle of group.particles) {
   236→      const particleX = group.cx + particle.offsetX;
   237→      const particleY = group.cy + particle.offsetY;
   238→
   239→      if (
   240→        particleX < -50 ||
   241→        particleX > canvas.width + 50 ||
   242→        particleY < -50 ||
   243→        particleY > canvas.height + 50
   244→      ) {
   245→        continue;
   246→      }
   247→
   248→      const twinkle = 0.8 + Math.sin(time * 0.001 + particle.phase) * 0.2;
   249→      const particleOpacity = group.opacity * twinkle * masterOpacity;
   250→
   251→      ctx.beginPath();
   252→      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${particleOpacity})`;
   253→      ctx.arc(particleX, particleY, particle.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   254→      ctx.fill();
   255→    }
   256→  }
   257→}
   258→
   259→function useConstellationAnimation(canvasRef: RefObject<HTMLCanvasElement>): void {
   260→  const starsRef = useRef<Star[]>([]);
   261→  const wanderingGroupsRef = useRef<WanderingGroup[]>([]);
   262→  const wanderingFadeInRef = useRef({ startTime: 0 });
   263→  const animationFrameRef = useRef<number>();
   264→  const mouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   265→  const smoothMouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   266→  const dimensionsRef = useRef({ width: 0, height: 0 });
   267→
   268→  useEffect(() => {
   269→    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
   270→    if (!canvas) return;
   271→
   272→    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
   273→    if (!context) return;
   274→
   275→    const initializeScene = () => {
   276→      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
   277→      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
   278→
   279→      dimensionsRef.current = { width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height };
   280→      mouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   281→      smoothMouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   282→
   283→      starsRef.current = initializeStars(canvas.width, canvas.height);
   284→      wanderingGroupsRef.current = createWanderingGroups(
   285→        canvas.width,
   286→        canvas.height,
   287→        performance.now()
   288→      );
   289→      wanderingFadeInRef.current = { startTime: performance.now() };
   290→    };
   291→
   292→    const handleMouseMove = (event: MouseEvent) => {
   293→      mouseRef.current = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
   294→    };
   295→
   296→    const drawFrame = (time: number) => {
   297→      context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   298→
   299→      const lerpFactor = 0.05;
   300→      smoothMouseRef.current.x += (mouseRef.current.x - smoothMouseRef.current.x) * lerpFactor;
   301→      smoothMouseRef.current.y += (mouseRef.current.y - smoothMouseRef.current.y) * lerpFactor;
   302→
   303→      const parallaxX =
   304→        (smoothMouseRef.current.x - dimensionsRef.current.width / 2) * 0.02;
   305→      const parallaxY =
   306→        (smoothMouseRef.current.y - dimensionsRef.current.height / 2) * 0.02;
   307→
   308→      updateAndDrawStars(
   309→        context,
   310→        canvas,
   311→        starsRef.current,
   312→        parallaxX,
   313→        parallaxY,
   314→        time
   315→      );
   316→
   317→      const now = performance.now();
   318→      const masterOpacity = calculateWanderingMasterOpacity(
   319→        wanderingFadeInRef.current.startTime,
   320→        now
   321→      );
   322→
   323→      if (masterOpacity > 0) {
   324→        updateAndDrawWanderingGroups(
   325→          context,
   326→          canvas,
   327→          wanderingGroupsRef.current,
   328→          now,
   329→          time,
   330→          masterOpacity
   331→        );
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   335→    };
   336→
   337→    initializeScene();
   338→
   339→    window.addEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   340→    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   341→    animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   342→
   343→    return () => {
   344→      window.removeEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   345→      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   346→
   347→      if (animationFrameRef.current) {
   348→        cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameRef.current);
   349→      }
   350→    };
   351→  }, [canvasRef]);
   352→}
   353→
   354→export const ConstellationCanvas = () => {
   355→  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
   356→
   357→  useConstellationAnimation(canvasRef);
   358→
   359→  return (
   360→    <canvas
   361→      ref={canvasRef}
   362→      className="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none"
   363→      style={{
   364→        zIndex: 3,
   365→        mixBlendMode: 'screen',
   366→        opacity: 0.6,
   367→      }}
   368→    />
   369→  );
   370→};
   371→

1→import React, { createContext, useMemo } from 'react';
     2→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import type { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import {
     6→  preloadGenerationTaskMappings,
     7→  mergeGenerationsWithTaskData,
     8→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskCache';
     9→import { getProjectSelectionFallbackId } from '@/shared/contexts/projectSelectionStore';
    10→
    11→// ================================================================
    12→// GENERATION-TASK INTEGRATION CONTEXT
    13→// ================================================================
    14→// This context provides a centralized way for components to work with
    15→// both generation and task data seamlessly. It handles background
    16→// preloading and cache management automatically.
    17→
    18→interface GenerationTaskContextValue {
    19→  // Methods for working with generation-task relationships
    20→  preloadTaskMappings: (generationIds: string[]) => Promise<void>;
    21→  enhanceWithTaskData: (generations: GenerationRow[]) => (GenerationRow & { taskId?: string | null; taskData?: Task | null })[];
    22→  
    23→  // Configuration
    24→  isPreloadingEnabled: boolean;
    25→  setPreloadingEnabled: (enabled: boolean) => void;
    26→}
    27→
    28→const GenerationTaskContext = createContext<GenerationTaskContextValue | null>(null);
    29→
    30→interface GenerationTaskProviderProps {
    31→  children: React.ReactNode;
    32→  
    33→  // Configuration options
    34→  enableBackgroundPreloading?: boolean;
    35→  preloadBatchSize?: number;
    36→  preloadDelay?: number;
    37→}
    38→
    39→export function GenerationTaskProvider({ 
    40→  children, 
    41→  enableBackgroundPreloading = true,
    42→  preloadBatchSize = 5,
    43→  preloadDelay = 200 
    44→}: GenerationTaskProviderProps) {
    45→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    46→  const [isPreloadingEnabled, setPreloadingEnabled] = React.useState(enableBackgroundPreloading);
    47→
    48→  const preloadTaskMappings = React.useCallback(async (generationIds: string[]) => {
    49→    if (!isPreloadingEnabled || generationIds.length === 0) return;
    50→    const projectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    51→
    52→    try {
    53→      await preloadGenerationTaskMappings(queryClient, generationIds, projectId, {
    54→        batchSize: preloadBatchSize,
    55→        delayBetweenBatches: preloadDelay,
    56→        preloadFullTaskData: true, // Preload full task data for better UX
    57→      });
    58→    } catch {
    59→      // Best effort preloading: the main UI can still function without prefetched task data.
    60→    }
    61→  }, [queryClient, isPreloadingEnabled, preloadBatchSize, preloadDelay]);
    62→
    63→  const enhanceWithTaskData = React.useCallback((generations: GenerationRow[]) => {
    64→    const projectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    65→    return mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(generations, queryClient, projectId);
    66→  }, [queryClient]);
    67→
    68→  // Memoize context value to prevent unnecessary re-renders of consumers
    69→  const contextValue = useMemo<GenerationTaskContextValue>(() => ({
    70→    preloadTaskMappings,
    71→    enhanceWithTaskData,
    72→    isPreloadingEnabled,
    73→    setPreloadingEnabled,
    74→  }), [preloadTaskMappings, enhanceWithTaskData, isPreloadingEnabled, setPreloadingEnabled]);
    75→
    76→  return (
    77→    <GenerationTaskContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
    78→      {children}
    79→    </GenerationTaskContext.Provider>
    80→  );
    81→}
    82→

    10→/**
    11→ * Title text with a gold spotlight effect that follows the mouse cursor,

    14→export const GoldSpotlight: React.FC = () => {
    15→  const [titleHover, setTitleHover] = useState({ x: 0, y: 0, active: false });
    16→  const [goldTrail, setGoldTrail] = useState<TrailPoint[]>([]);
    17→  const titleRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    18→  const trailIdRef = useRef(0);
    19→
    20→  // Handle mouse move over title for gold spotlight effect with trailing fade
    21→  const handleTitleMouseMove = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
    22→    if (!titleRef.current) return;
    23→    const rect = titleRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
    24→    const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
    25→    const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
    26→
    27→    setTitleHover({ x, y, active: true });
    28→
    29→    // Add a trail point
    30→    const newId = trailIdRef.current++;
    31→    setGoldTrail(prev => [...prev, { x, y, opacity: 1, id: newId }]); // Points only removed when fully faded
    32→  };
    33→
    34→  const handleTitleMouseLeave = () => {
    35→    setTitleHover(prev => ({ ...prev, active: false }));

    51→  }, [goldTrail.length]);

    53→  return (

     2→import { getSupabaseClientResult } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import {
     4→  operationFailure,
     5→  operationSuccess,
     6→  type OperationResult,
     7→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
     8→import { getStorageItem, removeStorageItems } from './storage';
     9→import { runAuthSupabaseOperation } from './runAuthSupabaseOperation';
    10→
    11→const REFERRAL_KEYS = [
    12→  'referralCode',
    13→  'referralSessionId',
    14→  'referralFingerprint',
    15→  'referralTimestamp',
    16→] as const;
    17→
    18→export function useAuthReferralFinalize() {
    19→  return useCallback(async (): Promise<OperationResult<{ finalized: boolean }>> => {
    20→    const supabaseResult = getSupabaseClientResult();
    21→    if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
    22→      return operationFailure(supabaseResult.error, {
    23→        policy: 'degrade',
    24→        recoverable: true,
    25→        errorCode: 'supabase_runtime_uninitialized',
    26→        message: 'Supabase runtime is not initialized while finalizing referrals.',
    27→      });
    28→    }
    29→    const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
    30→    const referralSessionId = getStorageItem(
    31→      'referralSessionId',
    32→      'useAuthReferralFinalize.read.referralSessionId',
    33→    );
    34→    const referralFingerprint = getStorageItem(
    35→      'referralFingerprint',
    36→      'useAuthReferralFinalize.read.referralFingerprint',
    37→    );
    38→    const referralCode = getStorageItem(
    39→      'referralCode',
    40→      'useAuthReferralFinalize.read.referralCode',
    41→    );
    42→
    43→    if (!referralCode || !referralSessionId || !referralFingerprint) {
    44→      return operationSuccess({ finalized: false });
    45→    }
    46→
    47→    return runAuthSupabaseOperation({
    48→      context: 'useAuthReferralFinalize.finalize',
    49→      errorCode: 'referral_finalize_failed',
    50→      showToast: false,
    51→      run: async () => {
    52→        const { error } = await supabase.rpc('create_referral_from_session', {
    53→          p_session_id: referralSessionId,
    54→          p_fingerprint: referralFingerprint,
    55→        });
    56→        if (error) {
    57→          throw error;
    58→        }
    59→        removeStorageItems(REFERRAL_KEYS, 'useAuthReferralFinalize.cleanup');
    60→        return { finalized: true };
    61→      },
    62→    });
    63→  }, []);
    64→}
