```
    36→  | { type: 'SET_ALL_FORM_FIELDS'; fields: FormFields }
    37→  | { type: 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG'; config: PhaseConfig }
    38→  | { type: 'UPDATE_PHASE_CONFIG_FIELD'; field: keyof PhaseConfig; value: PhaseConfig[keyof PhaseConfig] }
    39→  | { type: 'UPDATE_PHASE'; phaseIdx: number; updates: Partial<PhaseConfig['phases'][0]> }
    40→  | { type: 'UPDATE_PHASE_LORA'; phaseIdx: number; loraIdx: number; updates: Partial<{ url: string; multiplier: string }> }
    41→  | { type: 'ADD_LORA_TO_PHASE'; phaseIdx: number; url: string; multiplier: string }
    42→  | { type: 'REMOVE_LORA_FROM_PHASE'; phaseIdx: number; loraIdx: number }
    43→  | { type: 'SET_GENERATION_TYPE_MODE'; mode: 'i2v' | 'vace' }
    44→  | { type: 'SET_SUBMISSION_STATE'; isSubmitting: boolean }
    45→  | { type: 'RESET_FORM'; defaultIsPublic: boolean; phaseConfig: PhaseConfig };
    46→function formReducer(state: FormState, action: FormAction): FormState {
    47→  switch (action.type) {
    48→    case 'SET_FORM_FIELD':
    49→      return { ...state, fields: { ...state.fields, [action.field]: action.value } };
    50→    case 'SET_FORM_FIELDS':
    51→      return { ...state, fields: { ...state.fields, ...action.fields } };
    52→    case 'SET_ALL_FORM_FIELDS':
    53→      return { ...state, fields: action.fields };
    54→    case 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG':
    55→      return { ...state, editablePhaseConfig: action.config };
    56→    case 'UPDATE_PHASE_CONFIG_FIELD':
    57→      return {
    58→        ...state,
    59→        editablePhaseConfig: {
    60→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
    61→          [action.field]: action.value,
    62→        },
    63→      };
    64→    case 'UPDATE_PHASE':
    65→      return {
    66→        ...state,
    67→        editablePhaseConfig: {
    68→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
    69→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((phase, index) =>
    70→            index === action.phaseIdx ? { ...phase, ...action.updates } : phase,
    71→          ),
    72→        },
    73→      };
    74→    case 'UPDATE_PHASE_LORA':
    75→      return {
    76→        ...state,
    77→        editablePhaseConfig: {
    78→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
    79→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((phase, phaseIndex) => {
    80→            if (phaseIndex !== action.phaseIdx) {
    81→              return phase;
    82→            }
    83→            return {
    84→              ...phase,
    85→              loras: phase.loras.map((lora, loraIndex) =>
    86→                loraIndex === action.loraIdx ? { ...lora, ...action.updates } : lora,
    87→              ),
    88→            };
    89→          }),
    90→        },
    91→      };
    92→    case 'ADD_LORA_TO_PHASE':
    93→      return {
    94→        ...state,
    95→        editablePhaseConfig: {
    96→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
    97→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((phase, phaseIndex) => {
    98→            if (phaseIndex !== action.phaseIdx) {
    99→              return phase;
   100→            }
   101→            return {
   102→              ...phase,
   103→              loras: [
   104→                ...phase.loras.filter((lora) => lora.url?.trim()),
   105→                { url: action.url, multiplier: action.multiplier },
   106→              ],
   107→            };
   108→          }),
   109→        },
   110→      };
   111→    case 'REMOVE_LORA_FROM_PHASE':
   112→      return {
   113→        ...state,
   114→        editablePhaseConfig: {
   115→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
   116→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((phase, phaseIndex) => {
   117→            if (phaseIndex !== action.phaseIdx) {
   118→              return phase;
   119→            }
   120→            return {
   121→              ...phase,
   122→              loras: phase.loras.filter((_, loraIndex) => loraIndex !== action.loraIdx),
   123→            };
   124→          }),
   125→        },
   126→      };
   127→    case 'SET_GENERATION_TYPE_MODE':
   128→      return { ...state, generationTypeMode: action.mode };
   129→    case 'SET_SUBMISSION_STATE':
   130→      return { ...state, isSubmitting: action.isSubmitting };
   131→    case 'RESET_FORM':
   132→      return {
   133→        ...state,
   134→        fields: {
   135→          name: '',
   136→          description: '',
   137→          created_by_is_you: true,
   138→          created_by_username: '',
   139→          is_public: action.defaultIsPublic,
   140→          basePrompt: '',
   141→          negativePrompt: '',
   142→          textBeforePrompts: '',
   143→          textAfterPrompts: '',
   144→          enhancePrompt: false,
   145→          durationFrames: 60,
   146→        },
   147→        editablePhaseConfig: action.phaseConfig,
   148→      };
   149→    default:
   150→      return state;
   151→  }
   152→}
   153→function createAddPresetTabInitialState(
   154→  editingPreset: AddNewTabProps['editingPreset'],
   155→  isOverwriting: boolean,
   156→  currentPhaseConfig: PhaseConfig | undefined,
   157→  currentSettings: AddNewTabProps['currentSettings'],
   158→  initialGenerationTypeMode: 'i2v' | 'vace',
   159→  defaultIsPublic: boolean,
   160→): FormState {
   161→  const generationTypeMode = editingPreset?.metadata?.generationTypeMode && !isOverwriting
   162→    ? editingPreset.metadata.generationTypeMode
   163→    : initialGenerationTypeMode;
   164→  const editablePhaseConfig = editingPreset?.metadata?.phaseConfig && !isOverwriting
   165→    ? editingPreset.metadata.phaseConfig
   166→    : currentPhaseConfig || DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG;
   167→  return {
   168→    fields: {
   169→      name: generatePresetName(),
   170→      description: '',
   171→      created_by_is_you: true,
   172→      created_by_username: '',
   173→      is_public: defaultIsPublic,
   174→      basePrompt: currentSettings?.basePrompt || '',
   175→      negativePrompt: currentSettings?.negativePrompt || '',
   176→      textBeforePrompts: currentSettings?.textBeforePrompts || '',
   177→      textAfterPrompts: currentSettings?.textAfterPrompts || '',
   178→      enhancePrompt: currentSettings?.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   179→      durationFrames: currentSettings?.durationFrames || 60,
   180→    },
   181→    editablePhaseConfig,
   182→    generationTypeMode,
   183→    isSubmitting: false,
   184→  };
   185→}
   186→export function useAddNewPresetTabController({
   187→  createResource,
   188→  updateResource,
   189→  onSwitchToBrowse,
   190→  currentPhaseConfig,
   191→  editingPreset,
   192→  onClearEdit,
   193→  currentSettings,
   194→  isOverwriting = false,
   195→  generationTypeMode: initialGenerationTypeMode = 'i2v',
   196→  defaultIsPublic,
   197→}: AddNewTabProps) {
   198→  const isEditMode = Boolean(editingPreset);
   199→  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
   200→    formReducer,
   201→    {
   202→      editingPreset,
   203→      isOverwriting,
   204→      currentPhaseConfig,
   205→      currentSettings,
   206→      initialGenerationTypeMode,
   207→      defaultIsPublic,
   208→    },
   209→    (args) => createAddPresetTabInitialState(
   210→      args.editingPreset,
   211→      args.isOverwriting,
   212→      args.currentPhaseConfig,
   213→      args.currentSettings,
   214→      args.initialGenerationTypeMode,
   215→      args.defaultIsPublic,
   216→    ),
   217→  );
   218→  const { fields: addForm, editablePhaseConfig, generationTypeMode, isSubmitting } = state;
   219→  const sampleFilesHook = usePresetSampleFiles();
   220→  const updatePhaseConfig = useCallback(
   221→    <K extends keyof PhaseConfig>(field: K, value: PhaseConfig[K]) => {
   222→      dispatch({ type: 'UPDATE_PHASE_CONFIG_FIELD', field, value });
   223→    },
   224→    [],
   225→  );
   226→  const updatePhase = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, updates: Partial<PhaseConfig['phases'][0]>) => {
   227→    dispatch({ type: 'UPDATE_PHASE', phaseIdx, updates });
   228→  }, []);
   229→  const updatePhaseLora = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, loraIdx: number, updates: Partial<{ url: string; multiplier: string }>) => {
   230→    dispatch({ type: 'UPDATE_PHASE_LORA', phaseIdx, loraIdx, updates });
   231→  }, []);
   232→  const addLoraToPhase = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, url: string = '', multiplier: string = '1.0') => {
   233→    dispatch({ type: 'ADD_LORA_TO_PHASE', phaseIdx, url, multiplier });
   234→  }, []);
   235→  const removeLoraFromPhase = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, loraIdx: number) => {
   236→    dispatch({ type: 'REMOVE_LORA_FROM_PHASE', phaseIdx, loraIdx });
   237→  }, []);
   238→  const resetForm = useCallback(() => {
   239→    dispatch({
   240→      type: 'RESET_FORM',
   241→      defaultIsPublic,
   242→      phaseConfig: currentPhaseConfig || DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG,
   243→    });
   244→    sampleFilesHook.resetSampleFiles();
   245→  }, [currentPhaseConfig, defaultIsPublic, sampleFilesHook]);
   246→  useEffect(() => {
   247→    if (editingPreset?.metadata?.phaseConfig) {
   248→      if (!isOverwriting) {
   249→        dispatch({ type: 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG', config: editingPreset.metadata.phaseConfig });
   250→        if (editingPreset.metadata.generationTypeMode) {
   251→          dispatch({ type: 'SET_GENERATION_TYPE_MODE', mode: editingPreset.metadata.generationTypeMode });
   252→        }
   253→      } else {
   254→        dispatch({ type: 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG', config: currentPhaseConfig || DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG });
   255→        dispatch({ type: 'SET_GENERATION_TYPE_MODE', mode: initialGenerationTypeMode });
   256→      }
   257→    } else if (currentPhaseConfig) {
   258→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG', config: currentPhaseConfig });
   259→    } else {
   260→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG', config: DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG });
   261→    }
   262→  }, [editingPreset, isOverwriting, currentPhaseConfig, initialGenerationTypeMode]);
   263→  useEffect(() => {
   264→    if (!editingPreset && currentSettings) {
   265→      dispatch({
   266→        type: 'SET_FORM_FIELDS',
   267→        fields: {
   268→          name: generatePresetName(),
   269→          basePrompt: currentSettings.basePrompt || '',
   270→          negativePrompt: currentSettings.negativePrompt || '',
   271→          textBeforePrompts: currentSettings.textBeforePrompts || '',
   272→          textAfterPrompts: currentSettings.textAfterPrompts || '',
   273→          enhancePrompt: currentSettings.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   274→          durationFrames: currentSettings.durationFrames || 60,
   275→        },
   276→      });
   277→      if (currentSettings.lastGeneratedVideoUrl) {
   278→        sampleFilesHook.setInitialVideo(currentSettings.lastGeneratedVideoUrl);
   279→      }
   280→    }
   281→  }, [currentSettings, editingPreset, sampleFilesHook]);
   282→  useEffect(() => {
   283→    if (editingPreset && editingPreset.metadata) {
   284→      const metadata = editingPreset.metadata;
   285→      if (isOverwriting && currentSettings) {
   286→        dispatch({
   287→          type: 'SET_ALL_FORM_FIELDS',
   288→          fields: {
   289→            name: metadata.name || '',
   290→            description: metadata.description || '',
   291→            created_by_is_you: metadata.created_by?.is_you ?? true,
   292→            created_by_username: metadata.created_by?.username || '',
   293→            is_public: metadata.is_public ?? true,
   294→            basePrompt: currentSettings.basePrompt || '',
   295→            negativePrompt: currentSettings.negativePrompt || '',
   296→            textBeforePrompts: currentSettings.textBeforePrompts || '',
   297→            textAfterPrompts: currentSettings.textAfterPrompts || '',
   298→            enhancePrompt: currentSettings.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   299→            durationFrames: currentSettings.durationFrames || 60,
   300→          },
   301→        });
   302→        sampleFilesHook.resetSampleFiles();
   303→      } else {
   304→        dispatch({
   305→          type: 'SET_ALL_FORM_FIELDS',
   306→          fields: {
   307→            name: metadata.name || '',
   308→            description: metadata.description || '',
   309→            created_by_is_you: metadata.created_by?.is_you ?? true,
   310→            created_by_username: metadata.created_by?.username || '',
   311→            is_public: metadata.is_public ?? true,
   312→            basePrompt: metadata.basePrompt || '',
   313→            negativePrompt: metadata.negativePrompt || '',
   314→            textBeforePrompts: metadata.textBeforePrompts || '',
   315→            textAfterPrompts: metadata.textAfterPrompts || '',
   316→            enhancePrompt: metadata.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   317→            durationFrames: metadata.durationFrames || 60,
   318→          },
   319→        });
   320→      }
   321→      sampleFilesHook.resetSampleFiles();
   322→      if (isOverwriting && currentSettings?.lastGeneratedVideoUrl) {

   324→      } else if (!isOverwriting) {
   325→        sampleFilesHook.setInitialVideo(null);
   326→      }
   327→    }
   328→  }, [editingPreset, isOverwriting, currentSettings, sampleFilesHook]);
   329→  const handleFormChange = useCallback((field: string, value: string | boolean | number) => {
   330→    dispatch({ type: 'SET_FORM_FIELD', field, value });
   331→  }, []);
   332→  const handleCancelEdit = useCallback(() => {
   333→    onClearEdit();
   334→    resetForm();
   335→  }, [onClearEdit, resetForm]);
   336→  const handleSubmit = useCallback(async () => {
   337→    if (!addForm.name.trim()) {

   340→    }
   341→    if (!editablePhaseConfig) {
   342→      toast.error('No phase config available to save');
   343→      return;
   344→    }
   345→    dispatch({ type: 'SET_SUBMISSION_STATE', isSubmitting: true });
   346→    try {
   347→      const uploadedSamples: Array<{ url: string; type: 'image' | 'video'; alt_text?: string }> = [];
   348→      for (const file of sampleFilesHook.sampleFiles) {
   349→        const uploadedUrl = await uploadImageToStorage(file);
   350→        uploadedSamples.push({
   351→          url: uploadedUrl,
   352→          type: file.type.startsWith('video/') ? 'video' : 'image',
   353→          alt_text: file.name,
   354→        });
   355→      }
   356→      const existingSamples = isEditMode
   357→        ? (editingPreset?.metadata.sample_generations || []).filter(
   358→            (sample) => !sampleFilesHook.deletedExistingSampleUrls.includes(sample.url),
   359→          )
   360→        : [];
   361→      const initialSample = ((!isEditMode || isOverwriting) && sampleFilesHook.initialVideoSample && !sampleFilesHook.initialVideoDeleted)
   362→        ? [{ url: sampleFilesHook.initialVideoSample, type: 'video' as const, alt_text: 'Latest video generation' }]
   363→        : [];
   364→      const finalSamples = [...initialSample, ...existingSamples, ...uploadedSamples];
   365→      let mainGeneration: string | undefined;
   366→      if ((!isEditMode || isOverwriting) && sampleFilesHook.initialVideoSample && !sampleFilesHook.initialVideoDeleted) {
   367→        mainGeneration = sampleFilesHook.initialVideoSample;
   368→      } else if (uploadedSamples.length > 0 && uploadedSamples[sampleFilesHook.mainGenerationIndex]) {
   369→        mainGeneration = uploadedSamples[sampleFilesHook.mainGenerationIndex].url;
   370→      } else if (isEditMode && editingPreset?.metadata.main_generation && !sampleFilesHook.deletedExistingSampleUrls.includes(editingPreset.metadata.main_generation)) {
   371→        mainGeneration = editingPreset.metadata.main_generation;
   372→      } else if (finalSamples.length > 0) {
   373→        mainGeneration = finalSamples[0].url;
   374→      }
   375→      const presetMetadata: PhaseConfigMetadata = {
   376→        name: addForm.name,
   377→        description: addForm.description,
   378→        phaseConfig: editablePhaseConfig,
   379→        created_by: {

   381→          username: addForm.created_by_is_you ? undefined : addForm.created_by_username,
   382→        },
   383→        is_public: addForm.is_public,
   384→        sample_generations: finalSamples.length > 0 ? finalSamples : undefined,
   385→        main_generation: mainGeneration,

   422→    editingPreset,
   423→    currentSettings,
```

```
   312→
   313→export const useUpdateShotImageOrder = () => {
   314→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   315→
   316→  return useMutation({
   317→    mutationFn: async ({
   318→      updates,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      shotId,
   321→    }: {
   322→      updates: { shot_id: string; generation_id: string; timeline_frame: number }[];
   323→      projectId: string;
   324→      shotId: string;
   325→    }) => {
   326→      const promises = updates.map(update =>
   327→        supabase().from('shot_generations')
   328→          .update({ timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame })
   329→          .eq('shot_id', update.shot_id)
   330→          .eq('generation_id', update.generation_id)
   331→      );
   332→
   333→      const results = await Promise.all(promises);
   334→
   335→      const errors = results.filter(r => r.error);
   336→      if (errors.length > 0) {
   337→        throw new Error(`Reorder failed: ${errors.map(e => e.error?.message).join(', ')}`);
   338→      }

   340→      return { projectId, shotId, updates };

   343→    onMutate: async (variables) => {

   349→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)
   350→      );
   351→
   352→      if (previousFastGens) {
   353→        const updatedGens = previousFastGens.map(gen => {
   354→          const update = updates.find(u => u.generation_id === gen.generation_id);
   355→          if (update) {
   356→            return { ...gen, timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame };
   357→          }
   358→          return gen;
   359→        });
   360→
   361→        updatedGens.sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame || 0) - (b.timeline_frame || 0));
   362→        queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), updatedGens);
   363→      }
   364→
   365→      return { previousFastGens, shotId };
   366→    },
   367→
   368→    onError: (_err: Error, _variables, context) => {

   371→      }

   380→      });

   382→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId) });
   383→    },
   384→  });
```

```
   203→      shotGenerationId: string;
   204→      projectId: string;
   205→      /** When deleting the first item, shift remaining items back */
   206→      shiftItems?: Array<{ id: string; newFrame: number }>;
   207→    }) => {
   208→      if (!shotId || !shotGenerationId || !projectId) {
   209→        throw new Error(`Missing required parameters`);
   210→      }
   211→
   212→      const { error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   213→        .update({ timeline_frame: null })
   214→        .eq('id', shotGenerationId);
   215→
   216→      if (error) {
   217→        throw error;
   218→      }
   219→
   220→      // Persist frame shifts (optimistic update already applied in onMutate)
   221→      if (shiftItems && shiftItems.length > 0) {
   222→        await persistTimelineFrameBatch({
   223→          shotId,
   224→          updates: shiftItems.map((item) => ({
   225→            shotGenerationId: item.id,
   226→            timelineFrame: item.newFrame,
   227→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'remove-shift' },
   228→          })),
   229→          operationLabel: 'remove-image-shift',
   230→          timeoutOperationName: 'remove-image-shift-rpc',
   231→          logPrefix: '[ShotGenerationMutations]',
   232→          log,
   233→        });
   234→      }

   236→      return { shotId, shotGenerationId, projectId };
   237→    },

   239→    onMutate: async (variables) => {

   242→      await cancelShotsQueries(queryClient, projectId);
   243→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shotId);
   244→
   245→      const previousShots = findShotsCache(queryClient, projectId);
   246→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   247→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)

   251→      const shiftMap = new Map(shiftItems?.map(s => [s.id, s.newFrame]) ?? []);
   252→
   253→      // Optimistically: set timeline_frame = null on deleted item + shift remaining
   254→      if (previousFastGens) {

   256→          queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId),
   257→          previousFastGens.map(g => {

   259→            const shifted = shiftMap.get(g.id);
   260→            if (shifted !== undefined) return { ...g, timeline_frame: shifted };
   261→            return g;
   262→          })
   263→        );
   264→      }

   271→                ...shot,
   272→                images: (shot.images ?? []).map(img => {
   273→                  if (img.id === shotGenerationId) return { ...img, timeline_frame: null };
   274→                  const shifted = shiftMap.get(img.id);
   275→                  if (shifted !== undefined) return { ...img, timeline_frame: shifted };
   276→                  return img;
   277→                }),
   278→              };
   279→            }
   280→            return shot;
   281→          })
   282→        );
   283→      }
   284→
   285→      return { previousShots, previousFastGens, projectId, shotId };
   286→    },
   287→
   288→    onError: (err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   289→      if (context?.previousShots && context.projectId) {
   290→        rollbackShotsCaches(queryClient, context.projectId, context.previousShots);
   291→      }
   292→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   293→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   294→      }
   295→
   296→      toast.error(`Failed to remove image from timeline: ${err.message}`);
   297→    },
   298→
   299→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   300→      // Invalidate segment queries
   301→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   302→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   303→        [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId),
   304→      });
   305→    },
   306→  });
   307→};
   308→
   309→// ============================================================================
   310→// UPDATE SHOT IMAGE ORDER
   311→// ============================================================================
   312→
   313→export const useUpdateShotImageOrder = () => {
   314→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   315→
   316→  return useMutation({
   317→    mutationFn: async ({
   318→      updates,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      shotId,
   321→    }: {
   322→      updates: { shot_id: string; generation_id: string; timeline_frame: number }[];
   323→      projectId: string;
   324→      shotId: string;
   325→    }) => {
   326→      const promises = updates.map(update =>
   327→        supabase().from('shot_generations')
   328→          .update({ timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame })
   329→          .eq('shot_id', update.shot_id)
   330→          .eq('generation_id', update.generation_id)
   331→      );
   332→
   333→      const results = await Promise.all(promises);
   334→
   335→      const errors = results.filter(r => r.error);
   336→      if (errors.length > 0) {
   337→        throw new Error(`Reorder failed: ${errors.map(e => e.error?.message).join(', ')}`);
   338→      }
   339→
   340→      return { projectId, shotId, updates };
   341→    },
   342→
   343→    onMutate: async (variables) => {
   344→      const { updates, shotId } = variables;
   345→
   346→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shotId);
   347→
   348→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   349→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)
   350→      );
   351→
   352→      if (previousFastGens) {
   353→        const updatedGens = previousFastGens.map(gen => {
   354→          const update = updates.find(u => u.generation_id === gen.generation_id);
   355→          if (update) {
   356→            return { ...gen, timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame };
   357→          }
   358→          return gen;
   359→        });
   360→
   361→        updatedGens.sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame || 0) - (b.timeline_frame || 0));
   362→        queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), updatedGens);
   363→      }
   364→
   365→      return { previousFastGens, shotId };
   366→    },
   367→
   368→    onError: (_err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   369→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   370→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   371→      }
   372→
   373→      toast.error('Failed to reorder images');
   374→    },
   375→
   376→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   377→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   378→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   379→        predicate: query => query.queryKey[0] === 'source-slot-generations',
   380→      });
   381→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   382→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId) });
   383→    },
   384→  });
   385→};
   386→
   387→// ============================================================================
```

```
1→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP = 4;
     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→
```

```
1→import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback, RefObject } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type EventType = 'click' | 'mousedown' | 'touchstart';
     4→
     5→interface UseClickOutsideOptions {
     6→  /** Event type(s) to listen for (default: ['mousedown']) */
     7→  events?: EventType[];
     8→  /** Whether the hook is enabled (default: true) */
     9→  enabled?: boolean;
    10→  /** Delay before attaching listeners (ms) - prevents catching the click that opened the element */
    11→  delay?: number;
    12→  /** Use capture phase for event listeners */
    13→  capture?: boolean;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Hook that calls a callback when user clicks/touches outside the referenced element.
    18→ *
    19→ * @param callback - Function to call when click outside is detected
    20→ * @param options - Configuration options
    21→ * @returns ref - Attach this to the element you want to detect clicks outside of
    22→ *
    23→ * @example
    24→ * // Basic usage - click outside to close
    25→ * const ref = useClickOutside(() => setIsOpen(false));
    26→ * return <div ref={ref}>...</div>;
    27→ *
    28→ * @example
    29→ * // With options - touch support for iPad
    30→ * const ref = useClickOutside(
    31→ *   () => setSelectedEndpoint(null),
    32→ *   { events: ['touchstart'], enabled: isTablet && selectedEndpoint !== null }
    33→ * );
    34→ *
    35→ * @example
    36→ * // With existing ref
    37→ * const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    38→ * useClickOutside(() => setIsActive(false), { enabled: isActive }, containerRef);
    39→ */
    40→export function useClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>(
    41→  callback: () => void,
    42→  options: UseClickOutsideOptions = {},
    43→  existingRef?: RefObject<T>
    44→): RefObject<T> {
    45→  const {
    46→    events = ['mousedown'],
    47→    enabled = true,
    48→    delay = 0,
    49→    capture = false,
    50→  } = options;
    51→
    52→  const internalRef = useRef<T>(null);
    53→  const ref = existingRef || internalRef;
    54→  const callbackRef = useRef(callback);
    55→
    56→  // Keep callback ref up to date
    57→  useEffect(() => {
    58→    callbackRef.current = callback;
    59→  }, [callback]);
    60→
    61→  const handleEvent = useCallback((event: Event) => {
    62→    if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
    63→      callbackRef.current();
    64→    }
    65→  }, [ref]);
    66→
    67→  useEffect(() => {
    68→    if (!enabled) return;
    69→
    70→    const subscribe = () => {
    71→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    72→        document.addEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    73→      });
    74→    };
    75→
    76→    const unsubscribe = () => {
    77→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    78→        document.removeEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    79→      });
    80→    };
    81→
    82→    // Delay subscription to avoid catching the event that triggered this state
    83→    const timeoutId = delay > 0 ? setTimeout(subscribe, delay) : null;
    84→    if (!timeoutId) subscribe();
    85→
    86→    return () => {
    87→      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    88→      unsubscribe();
    89→    };
    90→  }, [enabled, events, handleEvent, delay, capture]);
    91→
    92→  return ref;
    93→}
    94→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Best-effort clipboard write that never throws.
     3→ * Returns true when the write succeeds.
     4→ */
     5→export async function writeClipboardTextSafe(
     6→  text: string,
     7→  options: { allowExecCommandFallback?: boolean } = {},
     8→): Promise<boolean> {
     9→  if (!text) {
    10→    return false;
    11→  }
    12→
    13→  if (typeof navigator !== 'undefined' && navigator.clipboard?.writeText) {
    14→    try {
    15→      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(text);
    16→      return true;
    17→    } catch {
    18→      // fall through to optional fallback
    19→    }
    20→  }
    21→
    22→  if (!options.allowExecCommandFallback || typeof document === 'undefined') {
    23→    return false;
    24→  }
    25→
    26→  let textarea: HTMLTextAreaElement | null = null;
    27→  try {
    28→    textarea = document.createElement('textarea');
    29→    textarea.value = text;
    30→    textarea.style.position = 'fixed';
    31→    textarea.style.left = '-9999px';
    32→    document.body.appendChild(textarea);
    33→    textarea.select();
    34→    return document.execCommand('copy') === true;
    35→  } catch {
    36→    return false;
    37→  } finally {
    38→    if (textarea?.parentNode) {
    39→      textarea.parentNode.removeChild(textarea);
    40→    }
    41→  }
    42→}
    43→
```

```
1→import * as React from "react"
     2→import { useUserUIState } from "@/shared/hooks/useUserUIState"
     3→import { requireContextValue } from './contextGuard';
     4→
     5→export type AIInputMode = "voice" | "text"
     6→
     7→interface AIInputModeContextValue {
     8→  mode: AIInputMode
     9→  setMode: (mode: AIInputMode) => void
    10→  isLoading: boolean
    11→}
    12→
    13→const AIInputModeContext = React.createContext<AIInputModeContextValue | null>(null)
    14→
    15→export function AIInputModeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
    16→  const { value, update, isLoading } = useUserUIState('aiInputMode', { mode: 'voice' })
    17→
    18→  const setMode = React.useCallback((mode: AIInputMode) => {
    19→    update({ mode })
    20→  }, [update])
    21→
    22→  // Memoize context value to prevent unnecessary re-renders of consumers
    23→  const contextValue = React.useMemo(() => ({
    24→    mode: value.mode,
    25→    setMode,
    26→    isLoading
    27→  }), [value.mode, setMode, isLoading])
    28→
    29→  return (
    30→    <AIInputModeContext.Provider value={contextValue}>
    31→      {children}
    32→    </AIInputModeContext.Provider>
    33→  )
    34→}
    35→
    36→export function useAIInputMode() {
    37→  return requireContextValue(
    38→    React.useContext(AIInputModeContext),
    39→    'useAIInputMode',
    40→    'AIInputModeProvider',
    41→  );
    42→}
```

```
     3→const CHANNEL_FLAGS = {
     4→  cache: 'tasksPaneDebug',

     8→type DebugChannel = keyof typeof CHANNEL_FLAGS;
     9→type DebugFlag = Parameters<typeof debugConfig.isEnabled>[0];
    10→
    11→const overrides: Partial<Record<DebugChannel, boolean>> = {};
    12→
    13→const isDev = Boolean(import.meta.env.DEV);
    14→
    15→function channelFlag(channel: DebugChannel): DebugFlag {
    16→  return CHANNEL_FLAGS[channel];
    17→}
    18→
    19→function isChannelEnabled(channel: DebugChannel): boolean {
    20→  if (!isDev) {
    21→    return false;
    22→  }
    23→
    24→  const override = overrides[channel];
    25→  if (override !== undefined) {
    26→    return override;
    27→  }
    28→
    29→  return debugConfig.isEnabled(channelFlag(channel));

    46→}
    47→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * useLineageChain Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Fetches the full lineage chain for a variant by following the `source_variant_id` field in params.
     5→ * Returns an array ordered from oldest ancestor to newest (the provided variant).

    45→
    46→type LineageScopeFailureStatus = Exclude<VariantProjectScopeStatus, 'ok'>;
    47→
    48→class LineageScopeError extends Error {
    49→  readonly status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    50→  readonly variantId: string;
    51→  readonly projectId: string;
    52→  readonly queryError?: string;
    53→
    54→  constructor(params: {
    55→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    56→    variantId: string;
    57→    projectId: string;
    58→    queryError?: string;
    59→    message: string;
    60→  }) {
    61→    super(params.message);
    62→    this.name = 'LineageScopeError';
    63→    this.status = params.status;
    64→    this.variantId = params.variantId;
    65→    this.projectId = params.projectId;
    66→    this.queryError = params.queryError;
    67→  }
    68→}
    69→
    70→function isLineageScopeError(error: unknown): error is LineageScopeError {
    71→  return error instanceof LineageScopeError;
    72→}
    73→
    74→function readSourceVariantId(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
    75→  return typeof params?.source_variant_id === 'string' ? params.source_variant_id : null;
    76→}
    77→
    78→function buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scopeStatus: string, queryError?: string): string {
    79→  switch (scopeStatus) {
    80→    case 'scope_mismatch':
    81→      return 'Variant exists but does not belong to the active project scope';
    82→    case 'missing_project_scope':
    83→      return 'Variant does not have project scope metadata';
    84→    case 'missing_variant':
    85→      return 'Variant not found';
    86→    case 'missing_generation':
    87→      return 'Variant generation was not found';
    88→    case 'query_failed':
    89→      return `Variant scope lookup failed${queryError ? `: ${queryError}` : ''}`;
    90→    default:
    91→      return `Variant scope validation failed (${scopeStatus})`;
    92→  }
    93→}
    94→
    95→function toLineageScopeError(
    96→  error: unknown,
    97→  fallback: {
    98→    variantId: string;
    99→    projectId: string;
   100→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
   101→    queryError?: string;
   102→  },
   103→): LineageScopeError {
   104→  if (isLineageScopeError(error)) {
   105→    return error;
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  const message = error instanceof Error
   109→    ? error.message
   110→    : buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(fallback.status, fallback.queryError);
   111→
   112→  return new LineageScopeError({
   113→    ...fallback,
   114→    message,
   115→  });
   116→}
   117→
   118→async function fetchVariantById(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<VariantRecord> {
   119→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
   120→  if (scope.status !== 'ok' || !scope.generationId) {
   121→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   122→      status: scope.status as LineageScopeFailureStatus,
   123→      variantId,
   124→      projectId,
   125→      queryError: scope.queryError,
   126→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scope.status, scope.queryError),
   127→    });
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseClient().from('generation_variants')
   131→    .select('id, generation_id, params, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, variant_type')
   132→    .eq('id', variantId)
   133→    .eq('generation_id', scope.generationId)
   134→    .single();
   135→
   136→  if (error) {
   137→    throw toLineageScopeError(error, {
   138→      status: 'query_failed',
   139→      variantId,
   140→      projectId,
   141→      queryError: error.message,
   142→    });
   143→  }
   144→
   145→  if (!data) {
   146→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   147→      status: 'missing_variant',
   148→      variantId,
   149→      projectId,
   150→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage('missing_variant'),
   151→    });
   152→  }
   153→  return data as VariantRecord;
   154→}
   155→
   156→/**
   157→ * Recursively fetch the lineage chain for a variant.
   158→ * Follows `params.source_variant_id` across generation boundaries.
   159→ */
   160→async function fetchLineageChain(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<LineageItem[]> {
   161→  const chain: LineageItem[] = [];
   162→  const visited = new Set<string>();
   163→  let currentId: string | null = variantId;
   164→
   165→  while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
   166→    visited.add(currentId);
   167→    const variant = await fetchVariantById(currentId, projectId);
   168→
   169→    chain.unshift({
   170→      id: variant.id,
   171→      imageUrl: variant.location,
   172→      thumbnailUrl: variant.thumbnail_url,
   173→      createdAt: variant.created_at,
   174→      type: 'variant',
   175→      variantType: variant.variant_type,
   176→    });
   177→    currentId = readSourceVariantId(variant.params);
   178→  }
   179→
   180→  return chain;
   181→}
   182→
   183→/**
   184→ * Hook to fetch the full lineage chain for a variant.
   185→ *
   186→ * @param variantId - The variant ID to fetch lineage for
   187→ * @param projectId - Project scope required for lineage traversal
   188→ * @returns Object with chain (oldest to newest), loading state, and whether there's lineage
   189→ */
   190→export function useLineageChain(variantId: string | null, projectId: string | null): LineageChainResult {
   191→  const { data: chain = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery<LineageItem[], LineageScopeError>({
   192→    queryKey: [...generationQueryKeys.lineageChain(variantId!), projectId ?? '__no-project__'],
   193→    queryFn: async () => {
   194→      try {
   195→        return await fetchLineageChain(variantId!, projectId!);
   196→      } catch (caughtError) {
   197→        const normalizedError = toLineageScopeError(caughtError, {
   198→          status: 'query_failed',
   199→          variantId: variantId!,
   200→          projectId: projectId!,
   201→        });
   202→        normalizeAndPresentError(normalizedError, {
   203→          context: 'useLineageChain',
   204→          showToast: false,
   205→          logData: {
   206→            variantId: normalizedError.variantId,
   207→            projectId: normalizedError.projectId,
   208→            status: normalizedError.status,
   209→            queryError: normalizedError.queryError,
   210→          },
   211→        });
   212→        throw normalizedError;
   213→      }
   214→    },
   215→    enabled: !!variantId && !!projectId,
   216→    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes - lineage doesn't change
   217→    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  return {
   221→    chain,
   222→    isLoading,
   223→    // Has lineage if chain has more than 1 item (the current variant + at least one ancestor)
   224→    hasLineage: chain.length > 1,
   225→    error: error ?? null,
   226→  };
   227→}
   228→
   229→/**
   230→ * Count the lineage chain length for a variant.
   231→ * Returns the number of ancestors (0 if no lineage, 1+ if has ancestors).
   232→ * This fetches directly without caching - use sparingly for initial checks.
   233→ *
   234→ * Reuses fetchLineageChain to avoid duplicating the traversal logic.
   235→ */
   236→export async function getLineageDepth(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<number> {
   237→  const chain = await fetchLineageChain(variantId, projectId);
   238→  // chain includes the variant itself; ancestors = chain length - 1
   239→  return Math.max(0, chain.length - 1);
   240→}
```

```
1→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP = 4;
     2→const FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET = 1;
     3→
     4→export function quantizeTotalFrames(total: number, minTotal: number = 17): number {
     5→  const quantized =
     6→    Math.round((total - FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET) / FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP) *
     7→      FRAME_QUANTIZATION_STEP +
     8→    FRAME_QUANTIZATION_OFFSET;
     9→  return Math.max(minTotal, quantized);
    10→}
    11→
    12→export function getQuantizedGap(
    13→  desiredGap: number,
    14→  context: number,
    15→  minTotal: number = 17
    16→): number {
    17→  const total = context * 2 + desiredGap;
    18→  const quantizedTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(total, minTotal);
    19→  const gap = quantizedTotal - context * 2;
    20→
    21→  if (gap >= 1) {
    22→    return gap;
    23→  }
    24→
    25→  const minimumTotalWithPositiveGap = context * 2 + 1;
    26→  const validTotal = quantizeTotalFrames(minimumTotalWithPositiveGap, minTotal);
    27→  return validTotal - context * 2;
    28→}
    29→
```

```
1→export const fileToDataURL = (file: File): Promise<string> =>
     2→  new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
     3→    const reader = new FileReader();
     4→    reader.onload = () => resolve(reader.result as string);
     5→    reader.onerror = (error) => reject(error);
     6→    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
     7→  });
     8→
     9→export const dataURLtoFile = (
    10→  dataUrl: string,
    11→  filename: string,
    12→  fileType?: string
    13→): File | null => {
    14→  try {
    15→    const [metadata, payload] = dataUrl.split(',');
    16→    if (!metadata || !payload) {
    17→      throw new Error('Invalid Data URL format');
    18→    }
    19→
    20→    const mimeMatch = metadata.match(/:(.*?);/);
    21→    const mimeType =
    22→      fileType ||
    23→      (mimeMatch && mimeMatch[1]) ||
    24→      'application/octet-stream';
    25→    const decodedPayload = atob(payload);
    26→    const bytes = new Uint8Array(decodedPayload.length);
    27→
    28→    for (let i = 0; i < decodedPayload.length; i += 1) {
    29→      bytes[i] = decodedPayload.charCodeAt(i);
    30→    }
    31→
    32→    return new File([bytes], filename, { type: mimeType });
    33→  } catch {
    34→    return null;
    35→  }
    36→};
    37→
```

```
   115→  const { projectId, status, limit = 50, offset = 0, taskType, allProjects, allProjectIds } = params;
   116→  const page = Math.floor(offset / limit) + 1;
   117→  const effectiveProjectId: string | null = projectId ?? null;
   118→  const cacheProjectKey = allProjects ? 'all' : effectiveProjectId;
   119→  const safeCacheProjectKey = cacheProjectKey ?? '__no-project__';
   120→  const visibleTaskTypes = getVisibleTaskTypes();
   121→  const smartPollingConfig = useSmartPollingConfig(taskQueryKeys.paginated(safeCacheProjectKey));
   122→
   123→  const query = useQuery<PaginatedTasksResponse, Error>({
   124→    queryKey: [...taskQueryKeys.paginated(safeCacheProjectKey), page, limit, status, taskType],
   125→    queryFn: createPaginatedTasksQueryFn({
   126→      allProjects,
   127→      allProjectIds,
   128→      effectiveProjectId,
   129→      status,
   130→      taskType,
   131→      visibleTaskTypes,
   132→      limit,
   133→      offset,
   134→      page,
   135→    }, safeCacheProjectKey),
   136→    enabled: allProjects ? !!allProjectIds?.length : !!effectiveProjectId,
   137→    placeholderData: keepPreviousData,
   138→    ...QUERY_PRESETS.realtimeBacked,
   139→    ...smartPollingConfig,
   140→    refetchIntervalInBackground: true,
   141→    retry: STANDARD_RETRY,
   142→    retryDelay: STANDARD_RETRY_DELAY,
   143→  });
   144→
   145→  useProcessingRefetchGuard(status, query);
   146→
   147→  return query;
   148→};
   149→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Generation Mutations
     3→ * ====================
     4→ *
     5→ * Mutation hooks for creating, updating, deleting, and starring generations.
     6→ * Extracted from useProjectGenerations.ts to separate query and mutation concerns.
     7→ *
     8→ * ## Exports
     9→ * - `useDeleteGeneration` — Delete a generation
    10→ * - `useDeleteVariant` — Delete a variant from generation_variants
    11→ * - `useUpdateGenerationLocation` — Update a generation's location/thumbnail
    12→ * - `useCreateGeneration` — Create a new generation (external upload)
    13→ * - `useToggleGenerationStar` — Star/unstar with optimistic updates
    14→ *
    15→ * @module useGenerationMutations
    16→ */
    17→
    18→import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    19→import type { Json } from '@/integrations/supabase/jsonTypes';
    20→import {
    21→  createGenerationPrimaryVariant,
    22→  createGenerationRecord,
    23→  deleteGenerationByScope,
    24→  deleteGenerationVariantByScope,
    25→  updateGenerationLocationByScope,
    26→  updateGenerationStarByScope,
    27→} from '@/integrations/supabase/repositories/generationMutationsRepository';
    28→import {
    29→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow,
    30→  normalizeAndPresentError,
    31→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    32→import { dispatchAppEvent } from '@/shared/lib/typedEvents';
    33→import { VARIANT_TYPE } from '@/shared/constants/variantTypes';
    34→import {
    35→  applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate,
    36→  rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate,
    37→} from '@/shared/hooks/invalidation/generationStarCacheCoordinator';
    38→import {
    39→  resolveGenerationProjectScope,
    40→  resolveVariantProjectScope,
    41→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    42→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    43→
    44→// ===== Helper Functions (internal) =====
    45→
    46→interface ScopedGenerationInput {
    47→  id: string;
    48→  projectId: string;
    49→}
    50→
    51→interface ScopedVariantInput {
    52→  id: string;
    53→  projectId: string;
    54→}
    55→
    56→function ensureProjectScope(projectId: string | undefined, context: string): string {
    57→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    58→    return projectId;
    59→  }
    60→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('Mutation requires project scope'), {
    61→    context,
    62→    showToast: false,
    63→    logData: { reason: 'missing_project_scope' },
    64→  });
    65→}
    66→
    67→async function verifyGenerationScope(generationId: string, projectId: string, context: string): Promise<void> {
    68→  const scope = await resolveGenerationProjectScope(generationId, projectId);
    69→  if (scope.status === 'ok') {
    70→    return;
    71→  }
    72→
    73→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
    74→    new Error(`Generation scope validation failed (${scope.status})`),
    75→    {
    76→      context,
    77→      showToast: false,
    78→      logData: {
    79→        generationId,
    80→        projectId,
    81→        scopeStatus: scope.status,
    82→        queryError: scope.queryError,
    83→      },
    84→    },
    85→  );
    86→}
    87→
    88→async function verifyVariantScope(
    89→  variantId: string,
    90→  projectId: string,
    91→  context: string,
    92→): Promise<{ generationId: string }> {
    93→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
    94→  if (scope.status === 'ok' && scope.generationId) {
    95→    return { generationId: scope.generationId };
    96→  }
    97→
    98→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
    99→    new Error(`Variant scope validation failed (${scope.status})`),
   100→    {
   101→      context,
   102→      showToast: false,
   103→      logData: {
   104→        variantId,
   105→        projectId,
   106→        generationId: scope.generationId,
   107→        scopeStatus: scope.status,
   108→        queryError: scope.queryError,
   109→      },
   110→    },
   111→  );
   112→}
   113→
   114→/**
   115→ * Update generation location using direct Supabase call.
   116→ * @internal Used by useUpdateGenerationLocation hook.
   117→ */
   118→async function updateGenerationLocation(
   119→  params: ScopedGenerationInput & { location: string; thumbUrl?: string },
   120→): Promise<void> {
   121→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   122→    params.projectId,
   123→    'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.projectScope',
   124→  );
   125→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   126→    params.id,
   127→    projectId,
   128→    'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.scopeValidation',
   129→  );
   130→
   131→  const updateData: { location: string; thumbnail_url?: string } = { location: params.location };
   132→
   133→  // If thumbUrl is provided, update it as well (important for flipped images)
   134→  if (params.thumbUrl) {
   135→    updateData.thumbnail_url = params.thumbUrl;
   136→  }
   137→
   138→  const { data, error } = await updateGenerationLocationByScope({
   139→    id: params.id,
   140→    projectId,
   141→    location: updateData.location,
   142→    thumbnailUrl: updateData.thumbnail_url,
   143→  });
   144→
   145→  if (error) {
   146→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   147→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation',
   148→      showToast: false,
   149→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId },
   150→    });
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   154→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows updated while enforcing generation project scope'), {
   155→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.updateGenerationLocation.noRows',
   156→      showToast: false,
   157→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId },
   158→    });
   159→  }
   160→}
   161→
   162→/**
   163→ * Create a new generation using direct Supabase call.
   164→ * @internal Used by useCreateGeneration hook.
   165→ */
   166→async function createGeneration(params: {
   167→  imageUrl: string;
   168→  fileName: string;
   169→  fileType: string;
   170→  fileSize: number;
   171→  projectId: string;
   172→  prompt: string;
   173→  thumbnailUrl?: string;
   174→  /** Resolution in "WIDTHxHEIGHT" format (e.g., "1920x1080") */
   175→  resolution?: string;
   176→  /** Standard aspect ratio (e.g., "16:9") */
   177→  aspectRatio?: string;
   178→}): Promise<GenerationRow> {
   179→  const generationParams: Record<string, Json | undefined> = {
   180→    prompt: params.prompt,
   181→    source: 'external_upload',
   182→    original_filename: params.fileName,
   183→    file_type: params.fileType,
   184→    file_size: params.fileSize,
   185→  };
   186→
   187→  // Add dimension params if provided
   188→  if (params.resolution) {
   189→    generationParams.resolution = params.resolution;
   190→  }
   191→  if (params.aspectRatio) {
   192→    generationParams.aspect_ratio = params.aspectRatio;
   193→  }
   194→
   195→  const { data, error } = await createGenerationRecord({
   196→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   197→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   198→    fileType: params.fileType || 'image',
   199→    projectId: params.projectId,
   200→    generationParams,
   201→  });
   202→
   203→  if (error || !data) {
   204→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error ?? new Error('Failed to create generation'), {
   205→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createGeneration',
   206→      showToast: false,
   207→      logData: { projectId: params.projectId },
   208→    });
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  // Create the original variant for this generation
   212→  const { error: variantError } = await createGenerationPrimaryVariant({
   213→    generationId: data.id,
   214→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   215→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   216→    generationParams,
   217→    variantType: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  if (variantError) {
   221→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(variantError, {
   222→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createVariant',
   223→      showToast: false,
   224→    });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  return data;
   228→}
   229→
   230→/**
   231→ * Star/unstar a generation using direct Supabase call.
   232→ * @internal Used by useToggleGenerationStar hook.
   233→ */
   234→async function toggleGenerationStar(params: ScopedGenerationInput & { starred: boolean }): Promise<void> {
   235→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   236→    params.projectId,
   237→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.projectScope',
   238→  );
   239→  await verifyGenerationScope(

   244→
   245→  const { data, error } = await updateGenerationStarByScope({
   246→    id: params.id,
```

```
    18→ * - Prevent "AbortError" from cancelled queries

    26→  const [isDraggingInTimeline, setIsDraggingInTimeline] = useState(false);

    40→    // Clear flag after timeline has had time to complete position updates
    41→    // 100ms is enough for React's batch updates + timeline's immediate state updates
    42→    operationTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    43→      setIsShotOperationInProgress(false);
    44→      operationTimeoutRef.current = null;
    45→    }, 100);
    46→  }, []);
    47→
    48→  // Cleanup timeout on unmount
    49→  useEffect(() => {
    50→    return () => {
    51→      if (operationTimeoutRef.current) {
    52→        clearTimeout(operationTimeoutRef.current);
    53→      }
    54→    };
    55→  }, []);
    56→
    57→  return {
    58→    isShotOperationInProgress,
    59→    isDraggingInTimeline,
    60→    setIsDraggingInTimeline,
    61→    signalShotOperation,
    62→  };
    63→}
```

```
1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
     6→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     7→import { getProjectSelectionFallbackId } from '@/shared/contexts/projectSelectionStore';
     8→import { isTaskDbRow, mapTaskDbRowToTask } from '@/shared/lib/taskRowMapper';
     9→import {
    10→  getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations,
    11→  toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    12→  type GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    13→  type GenerationTaskMappingStatus,
    14→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    15→
    16→interface PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions {
    17→  batchSize?: number;
    18→  delayBetweenBatches?: number;
    19→  preloadFullTaskData?: boolean;
    20→}
    21→
    22→interface GenerationWithTaskData extends GenerationRow {
    23→  taskId?: string | null;
    24→  taskData?: Task | null;
    25→  taskMappingStatus?: GenerationTaskMappingStatus;
    26→  taskMappingError?: string;
    27→}
    28→
    29→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    30→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    31→    return projectId;
    32→  }
    33→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    34→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    35→    return selectedProjectId;
    36→  }
    37→  return null;
    38→}
    39→
    40→/**
    41→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    42→ */
    43→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    44→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    45→  generationIds: string[],
    46→  projectId: string | null,
    47→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    48→) {
    49→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    50→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    51→  const {
    52→    batchSize = 5,
    53→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    54→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    55→  } = options;
    56→
    57→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    58→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    59→
    60→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    61→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    62→
    63→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    64→
    65→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    66→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    67→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    68→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    69→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    70→        cacheEntry,
    71→      );
    72→
    73→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    74→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    76→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    77→          showToast: false,
    78→        });
    79→      }
    80→
    81→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    82→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    83→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    84→          queryFn: async () => {
    85→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    86→              .from('tasks')
    87→              .select('*')
    88→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    89→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    90→              .single();
    91→
    92→            if (error) throw error;
    93→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    94→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    95→            }
    96→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    97→          },
    98→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    99→        }));
   100→      }
   101→    });
   102→
   103→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   104→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   108→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   114→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   115→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   116→  projectId: string | null,
   117→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   118→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   119→
   120→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   121→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   122→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   123→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   124→    );
   125→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   126→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   127→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   128→      : null;
   129→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   130→
   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   137→    };
   138→  });
   139→}
   140→
```

```
    67→function useSegmentController(
    68→  props: ShotImageManagerProps,
    69→  currentImages: GenerationRow[],
    70→): SegmentController {
    71→  const localShotGenPositions = useMemo(() => {
    72→    if (props.generationMode === 'timeline') {
    73→      return undefined;
    74→    }
    75→
    76→    const orderedImages = currentImages.filter(
    77→      (image) => isPositioned(image) && !isVideoGeneration(image)

    79→    if (orderedImages.length === 0) {
    80→      return undefined;
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    const positions = new Map<string, number>();
    84→    orderedImages.forEach((image, index) => {
    85→      if (image.id) {

    88→    });
    89→    return positions;
    90→  }, [currentImages, props.generationMode]);

    92→  const shouldFetchSegments = props.generationMode !== 'timeline' &&
    93→    (!props.segmentSlots || (localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0));
    94→
    95→  const hookResult = useSegmentOutputsForShot(
    96→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.shotId || null : null,
    97→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.projectId || null : null,
    98→    shouldFetchSegments ? localShotGenPositions : undefined
    99→  );
   100→
   101→  const segmentSlots = (localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0)
   102→    ? (hookResult.segmentSlots.length > 0 ? hookResult.segmentSlots : props.segmentSlots ?? [])
   103→    : (props.segmentSlots ?? hookResult.segmentSlots);
   104→
   105→  const selectedParentId = hookResult.selectedParentId;
   106→  const { hasPendingTask } = usePendingSegmentTasks(
   107→    props.generationMode !== 'timeline' ? props.shotId || null : null,
   108→    props.generationMode !== 'timeline' ? props.projectId || null : null
   109→  );
   110→
   111→  const segmentLightbox = useSegmentLightboxState(segmentSlots, props.onPairClick);
   112→
   113→  return {
   114→    segmentSlots,
   115→    selectedParentId,
   116→    hasPendingTask,
   117→    segmentLightbox,
   118→  };
   119→}
   120→
   121→function useSegmentLightboxState(
   122→  segmentSlots: SegmentSlot[],
   123→  onPairClick?: ShotImageManagerProps['onPairClick']
   124→): SegmentLightboxState {
   125→  const [segmentLightboxIndex, setSegmentLightboxIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
   126→
   127→  const handleSegmentClick = useCallback((slotIndex: number) => {
   128→    const slot = segmentSlots[slotIndex];
   129→    if (onPairClick && slot) {
   130→      onPairClick(slot.index);
   131→      return;
   132→    }
   133→
   134→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(slotIndex);
   135→  }, [onPairClick, segmentSlots]);
   136→
   137→  const currentSegmentSlot = segmentLightboxIndex !== null ? segmentSlots[segmentLightboxIndex] : null;
   138→  const currentSegmentMedia = currentSegmentSlot?.type === 'child'
   139→    ? currentSegmentSlot.child
   140→    : null;
   141→
   142→  const segmentChildSlotIndices = useMemo(
   143→    () =>
   144→      segmentSlots
   145→        .map((slot, idx) => (slot.type === 'child' && slot.child.location ? idx : null))
   146→        .filter((idx): idx is number => idx !== null),
   147→    [segmentSlots]
   148→  );
   149→
   150→  const handleSegmentLightboxNext = useCallback(() => {
   151→    if (segmentLightboxIndex === null || segmentChildSlotIndices.length === 0) {
   152→      return;

   154→
   155→    const currentPos = segmentChildSlotIndices.indexOf(segmentLightboxIndex);
   156→    const nextPos = (currentPos + 1) % segmentChildSlotIndices.length;
   157→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(segmentChildSlotIndices[nextPos]);
   158→  }, [segmentChildSlotIndices, segmentLightboxIndex]);
   159→
   160→  const handleSegmentLightboxPrev = useCallback(() => {
   161→    if (segmentLightboxIndex === null || segmentChildSlotIndices.length === 0) {
   162→      return;
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    const currentPos = segmentChildSlotIndices.indexOf(segmentLightboxIndex);
   166→    const prevPos = (currentPos - 1 + segmentChildSlotIndices.length) % segmentChildSlotIndices.length;
   167→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(segmentChildSlotIndices[prevPos]);
   168→  }, [segmentChildSlotIndices, segmentLightboxIndex]);
   169→
   170→  const closeSegmentLightbox = useCallback(() => {
   171→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(null);
   172→  }, []);

   174→  return {
   175→    segmentLightboxIndex,
   176→    currentSegmentSlot,
   177→    currentSegmentMedia,
   178→    segmentChildSlotIndices,
   179→    handleSegmentClick,
   180→    handleSegmentLightboxNext,
   181→    handleSegmentLightboxPrev,

   183→  };
```

```
1→import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
     2→import { abbreviateRelativeTime, formatRelativeDuration } from '@/shared/lib/timeFormatting';
     3→import { useLiveRelativeTimestamp } from './useLiveRelativeTimestamp';
     4→
     5→type RelativeTimestampPreset = 'default' | 'task' | 'processing' | 'completed';
     6→
     7→interface UseUpdatingTimestampOptions {
     8→  date?: string | Date | null;
     9→  abbreviate?: (str: string) => string;
    10→  disabled?: boolean;
    11→  preset?: RelativeTimestampPreset;
    12→}
    13→
    14→const relativeTimestampFormatters: Record<
    15→  RelativeTimestampPreset,
    16→  (date: Date, abbreviate: (str: string) => string) => string
    17→> = {
    18→  default: (date, abbreviate) => abbreviate(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true })),
    19→  task: (date) => {
    20→    const abbreviated = abbreviateRelativeTime(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true }));
    21→    return abbreviated || '<1 min ago';
    22→  },
    23→  processing: (date) => `Processing for ${formatRelativeDuration(date, { includeDays: false })}`,
    24→  completed: (date) => `Completed ${formatRelativeDuration(date)} ago`,
    25→};
    26→
    27→export function useRelativeTimestamp({
    28→  date,
    29→  abbreviate = abbreviateRelativeTime,
    30→  disabled = false,
    31→  preset = 'default',
    32→}: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    33→  const formatter = relativeTimestampFormatters[preset];
    34→
    35→  return useLiveRelativeTimestamp({
    36→    dateInput: date,
    37→    disabled,
    38→    formatter: (parsedDate) => formatter(parsedDate, abbreviate),
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function useTaskTimestamp(date?: string | Date | null) {
    43→  return useRelativeTimestamp({
    44→    date,
    45→    preset: 'task',
    46→  });
    47→}
    48→
```

```
1→import type { Json } from '@/integrations/supabase/jsonTypes';

     3→import {

     9→} from '@/shared/services/projects/projectSetupRepository';
    10→
    11→async function copyTemplateToNewUser(newProjectId: string, newShotId: string): Promise<void> {
    12→  const { error } = await rpcCopyOnboardingTemplate(newProjectId, newShotId);
    13→
    14→  if (error) {
    15→    throw error;
    16→  }
    17→}
    18→
    19→export async function cleanupFailedProjectSetup(projectId: string, userId: string): Promise<void> {
    20→  const { error } = await deleteProjectByIdForUser(projectId, userId);
    21→
    22→  if (error) {
    23→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    24→      context: 'projectSetupService.cleanupFailedProjectSetup',
    25→      showToast: false,
    26→    });
    27→  }
    28→}
    29→
    30→export async function createDefaultShotForProject(
    31→  projectId: string,
    32→  options?: {
    33→    initialSettings?: Record<string, Json | undefined>;
    34→    isFirstProject?: boolean;
    35→  },
    36→): Promise<string> {
    37→  const isFirstProject = options?.isFirstProject === true;
    38→  const shotName = isFirstProject ? 'Getting Started' : 'Default Shot';
    39→
    40→  const { data: shot, error } = await insertDefaultShotForProject(
    41→    projectId,
    42→    shotName,
    43→    options?.initialSettings || {},
    44→  );
    45→
    46→  if (error) {
    47→    throw error;
    48→  }
    49→  if (!shot?.id) {
    50→    throw new Error('Default shot creation returned no shot id');
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  if (isFirstProject) {
    54→    await copyTemplateToNewUser(projectId, shot.id);
    55→  }
    56→
    57→  return shot.id;
    58→}
    59→
    60→export async function ensureUserRecordExists(userId: string): Promise<void> {
    61→  const { data: existingUser } = await fetchUserById(userId);
    62→
    63→  if (!existingUser) {
    64→    const { error: userError } = await rpcCreateUserRecordIfNotExists();
    65→    if (userError) {

    67→        context: 'projectSetupService.ensureUserRecordExists',
    68→        showToast: false,
    69→      });
    70→    }
    71→  }
    72→}
    73→
    74→export async function createDefaultShotWithRollback(
```

```
     4→/** @publicContract Runtime error normalization/logging facade. */
     5→export interface ErrorReportOptions {
     6→  context: string;
     7→  logData?: Record<string, unknown>;
     8→  onError?: (error: AppError) => void;
     9→}
    10→
    11→/** Normalize and log only. Does not trigger toast side effects. */
    12→export function reportError(error: unknown, options: ErrorReportOptions): AppError {
    13→  const { context, logData, onError } = options;
    14→  const appError = normalizeAndLogError(error, { context, logData });
    15→  onError?.(appError);
    16→  return appError;
    17→}
    18→
    19→export function reportAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: ErrorReportOptions): never {
    20→  throw reportError(error, options);
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Stable Skeleton Visibility Hook
     3→ * 
     4→ * Prevents rapid skeleton flicker when multiple queries resolve at different times.
     5→ * Shows skeleton immediately when loading starts, delays hiding slightly to prevent toggle flicker.
     6→ * 
     7→ * @see VideoTravelToolPage.tsx - Main page component that uses this hook
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
    11→
    12→/**
    13→ * Hook that stabilizes skeleton visibility to avoid rapid flicker.
    14→ * 
    15→ * @param isLoading - Current loading state from queries
    16→ * @param hideDelay - Delay in ms before hiding skeleton (default: 120ms)
    17→ * @returns Whether to show the skeleton (stabilized)
    18→ */
    19→export const useStableSkeletonVisibility = (
    20→  isLoading: boolean,
    21→  hideDelay: number = 120
    22→): boolean => {
    23→  const [showStableSkeleton, setShowStableSkeleton] = useState<boolean>(false);
    24→  const hideTimeoutRef = useRef<number | null>(null);
    25→  const lastLoadingStateRef = useRef<boolean>(false);
    26→  
    27→  useEffect(() => {
    28→    // Only update skeleton state if loading state actually changed
    29→    if (isLoading !== lastLoadingStateRef.current) {
    30→      lastLoadingStateRef.current = isLoading;
    31→      
    32→      if (isLoading) {
    33→        // Immediately show the skeleton when entering loading
    34→        if (hideTimeoutRef.current) {
    35→          window.clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    36→          hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    37→        }
    38→        setShowStableSkeleton(true);
    39→      } else {
    40→        // Delay hiding slightly to prevent rapid toggle flicker
    41→        hideTimeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
    42→          setShowStableSkeleton(false);
    43→          hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    44→        }, hideDelay);
    45→      }
    46→    }
    47→    
    48→    return () => {
    49→      if (hideTimeoutRef.current) {
    50→        window.clearTimeout(hideTimeoutRef.current);
    51→        hideTimeoutRef.current = null;
    52→      }
    53→    };
    54→  }, [isLoading, hideDelay]);
    55→
    56→  return showStableSkeleton;
    57→};
    58→
```

```
    69→    | 'videoEditSubMode'
    70→    | 'handleEnterVideoTrimMode'

    73→    | 'handleEnterVideoEnhanceMode'

    87→interface VideoEditPanelProps {
    88→  /** Layout variant */

    90→
    91→  /** Whether cloud mode is enabled (shows enhance mode) */

   103→  // Task ID for copy functionality

   110→export const VideoEditPanel: React.FC<VideoEditPanelProps> = ({
   111→  variant,
   112→  isCloudMode,
   113→  trim,
   114→  replace,
   115→  // Regenerate props (specialized)
   116→  regenerateFormProps,

   119→  taskId,
   120→  // Optional state overrides

   128→  const contextCore = useLightboxCoreSafe();
   129→  const contextVideoEdit = useVideoEditSafe();
   130→  const contextVariants = useLightboxVariantsSafe();
   131→
   132→  // Core state
   133→  const { onClose } = stateOverrides?.coreState ?? contextCore;
   134→
   135→  // Video edit state
   136→  const {
   137→    videoEditSubMode,
   138→    handleEnterVideoTrimMode: onEnterTrimMode,
   139→    handleEnterVideoReplaceMode: onEnterReplaceMode,
   140→    handleEnterVideoRegenerateMode: onEnterRegenerateMode,

   148→    activeVariant,
   149→    handleVariantSelect: onVariantSelect,
   150→    handleMakePrimary: onMakePrimary,
   151→    isLoadingVariants,
   152→    onLoadVariantSettings,
   153→    handleDeleteVariant: onDeleteVariant,
   154→  } = stateOverrides?.variantsState ?? contextVariants;
   155→
   156→  const activeVariantId = activeVariant?.id || null;
   157→  // Mode selector items for video editing
   158→  const modeSelectorItems = [
   159→    {
   160→      id: 'trim',
   161→      label: 'Trim',
   162→      icon: <Scissors />,
   163→      onClick: onEnterTrimMode,
   164→    },
   165→    {
   166→      id: 'replace',
   167→      label: 'Replace',
   168→      icon: <RefreshCw />,
   169→      onClick: onEnterReplaceMode,
   170→    },
   171→    ...(regenerateFormProps ? [{
   172→      id: 'regenerate',
   173→      label: 'Regenerate',
   174→      icon: <RotateCcw />,
   175→      onClick: onEnterRegenerateMode,
   176→    }] : []),
   177→    // Enhance mode - only shown when cloud mode is enabled
   178→    ...(isCloudMode ? [{
   179→      id: 'enhance',
   180→      label: 'Enhance',
   181→      icon: <ArrowUp />,
   182→      onClick: onEnterEnhanceMode,
   183→    }] : []),
   184→  ];
   185→
   186→  const modeSelector = (
   187→    <ModeSelector
   188→      items={modeSelectorItems}
   189→      activeId={videoEditSubMode ?? 'trim'}
   190→    />
   191→  );
   192→
   193→  return (
   194→    <EditPanelLayout
   195→      variant={variant}
   196→      onClose={onClose}
   197→      onExitEditMode={onExitVideoEditMode}
   198→      modeSelector={modeSelector}
   199→      taskId={taskId}
   200→      variants={variants}
   201→      activeVariantId={activeVariantId}
   202→      onVariantSelect={onVariantSelect}
   203→      onMakePrimary={onMakePrimary}
   204→      isLoadingVariants={isLoadingVariants}
   205→      onLoadVariantSettings={onLoadVariantSettings}
   206→      onDeleteVariant={onDeleteVariant}
   207→    >
   208→      {/* Sub-mode content */}
   209→      {videoEditSubMode === 'trim' && (
   210→        <TrimControlsPanel
   211→          trimState={trim.trimState}
   212→          onStartTrimChange={trim.onStartTrimChange}
   213→          onEndTrimChange={trim.onEndTrimChange}
   214→          onResetTrim={trim.onResetTrim}
   215→          trimmedDuration={trim.trimmedDuration}
   216→          hasTrimChanges={trim.hasTrimChanges}
   217→          onSave={trim.onSaveTrim}
   218→          isSaving={trim.isSavingTrim}
   219→          saveProgress={trim.trimSaveProgress}
   220→          saveError={trim.trimSaveError}
   221→          saveSuccess={trim.trimSaveSuccess}
   222→          onClose={onClose}
   223→          variant={variant}
   224→          videoUrl={trim.videoUrl}
   225→          currentTime={trim.trimCurrentTime}
   226→          videoRef={trim.trimVideoRef}
   227→          hideHeader
```
