   229→      )}
   230→      {videoEditSubMode === 'replace' && (
   231→        <VideoPortionEditor
   232→          settings={{
   233→            gapFrames: replace.videoEditing.editSettings.settings.gapFrameCount,
   234→            setGapFrames: (val) => replace.videoEditing.editSettings.updateField('gapFrameCount', val),
   235→            contextFrames: replace.videoEditing.editSettings.settings.contextFrameCount,
   236→            setContextFrames: (val) => {
   237→              const maxGap = Math.max(1, 81 - (val * 2));
   238→              const gapFrames = replace.videoEditing.editSettings.settings.gapFrameCount;
   239→              const newGapFrames = gapFrames > maxGap ? maxGap : gapFrames;
   240→              replace.videoEditing.editSettings.updateFields({
   241→                contextFrameCount: val,
   242→                gapFrameCount: newGapFrames
   243→              });
   244→            },
   245→            maxContextFrames: replace.videoEditing.maxContextFrames,
   246→            negativePrompt: replace.videoEditing.editSettings.settings.negativePrompt || '',
   247→            setNegativePrompt: (val) => replace.videoEditing.editSettings.updateField('negativePrompt', val),
   248→            enhancePrompt: replace.videoEditing.editSettings.settings.enhancePrompt,
   249→            setEnhancePrompt: (val) => replace.videoEditing.editSettings.updateField('enhancePrompt', val),
   250→          }}
   251→          selections={{
   252→            selections: replace.videoEditing.selections,
   253→            onUpdateSelectionSettings: replace.videoEditing.handleUpdateSelectionSettings,
   254→            onAddSelection: replace.videoEditing.handleAddSelection,
   255→            onRemoveSelection: replace.videoEditing.handleRemoveSelection,
   256→            videoUrl: trim.videoUrl,
   257→            fps: 16,
   258→          }}
   259→          lora={{
   260→            availableLoras: replace.videoEditing.availableLoras,
   261→            projectId: replace.projectId ?? null,
   262→            loraManager: replace.videoEditing.loraManager,
   263→          }}
   264→          motion={{
   265→            motionMode: (replace.videoEditing.editSettings.settings.motionMode || 'basic') as 'basic' | 'advanced',
   266→            onMotionModeChange: (mode) => replace.videoEditing.editSettings.updateField('motionMode', mode),
   267→            phaseConfig: replace.videoEditing.editSettings.settings.phaseConfig ?? DEFAULT_VACE_PHASE_CONFIG,
   268→            onPhaseConfigChange: (config) => replace.videoEditing.editSettings.updateField('phaseConfig', config),
   269→            randomSeed: replace.videoEditing.editSettings.settings.randomSeed ?? true,
   270→            onRandomSeedChange: (val) => replace.videoEditing.editSettings.updateField('randomSeed', val),
   271→            selectedPhasePresetId: replace.videoEditing.editSettings.settings.selectedPhasePresetId ?? null,
   272→            onPhasePresetSelect: (presetId, config) => {
   273→              replace.videoEditing.editSettings.updateFields({
   274→                selectedPhasePresetId: presetId,
   275→                phaseConfig: config,
   276→              });
   277→            },
   278→            onPhasePresetRemove: () => {
   279→              replace.videoEditing.editSettings.updateField('selectedPhasePresetId', null);
   280→            },
   281→          }}
   282→          actions={{
   283→            onGenerate: replace.videoEditing.handleGenerate,
   284→            isGenerating: replace.videoEditing.isGenerating,
   285→            generateSuccess: replace.videoEditing.generateSuccess,
   286→            isGenerateDisabled: !replace.videoEditing.isValid,
   287→            validationErrors: replace.videoEditing.validationErrors,
   288→          }}
   289→          stateOverrides={{ hideHeader: true }}
   290→        />
   291→      )}
   292→      {videoEditSubMode === 'regenerate' && regenerateFormProps && (
   293→        <SegmentRegenerateForm {...regenerateFormProps} />
   294→      )}
   295→      {videoEditSubMode === 'enhance' && enhance && (
   296→        <VideoEnhanceForm
   297→          settings={enhance.settings}
   298→          onUpdateSetting={enhance.onUpdateSetting}
   299→          onGenerate={enhance.onGenerate}
   300→          isGenerating={enhance.isGenerating ?? false}
   301→          generateSuccess={enhance.generateSuccess ?? false}
   302→          canSubmit={enhance.canSubmit ?? false}
   303→          variant={variant}
   304→          videoUrl={trim.videoUrl}
   305→        />
   306→      )}
   307→    </EditPanelLayout>
   308→  );
   309→};

    24→
    25→interface AdjacentPreloadContext {

    37→
    38→const defaultOnError: AdjacentPreloadErrorHandler = (context, error, logData) => {
    39→  normalizeAndPresentError(error, {

    45→
    46→function extractLoadedImageIds(data: unknown): Array<{ id: string }> {
    47→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object') {
    48→    return [];
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  const maybeItems = (data as { items?: unknown }).items;
    52→  if (!Array.isArray(maybeItems)) {
    53→    return [];
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  return maybeItems
    57→    .map((item) => {
    58→      if (!item || typeof item !== 'object') {
    59→        return null;
    60→      }
    61→      const id = (item as { id?: unknown }).id;
    62→      return typeof id === 'string' ? { id } : null;
    63→    })
    64→    .filter((item): item is { id: string } => item !== null);
    65→}
    66→
    67→export function cleanupDistantGenerationPages(
    68→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    69→  projectId: string,
    70→  currentPage: number,
    71→  keepRange: number = 2,
    72→): void {
    73→  const allQueries = queryClient.getQueryCache().getAll();
    74→
    75→  allQueries.forEach((query) => {
    76→    const key = query.queryKey;
    77→    if (!Array.isArray(key)) return;
    78→
    79→    if (!isUnifiedProjectGenerationsKey(key, projectId)) {
    80→      return;
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    const page = extractUnifiedProjectGenerationsPage(key, projectId);
    84→    if (page !== null && Math.abs(page - currentPage) > keepRange) {
    85→      const loadedImageIds = extractLoadedImageIds(query.state?.data);
    86→      if (loadedImageIds.length > 0) {
    87→        clearLoadedImages(loadedImageIds);
    88→      }
    89→      queryClient.removeQueries({ queryKey: query.queryKey });
    90→    }
    91→  });
    92→}

    94→export function scheduleAdjacentGenerationPagePreload({
    95→  queryClient,
    96→  projectId,
    97→  currentPage,
    98→  totalPages,
    99→  hasMorePages,
   100→  itemsPerPage,

   102→  filtersString,

   104→  onError = defaultOnError,

   107→
   108→  const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
   109→    await prefetchAdjacentGenerationPages({
   110→      queryClient,
   111→      projectId,
   112→      currentPage,
   113→      totalPages,
   114→      hasMorePages,
   115→      itemsPerPage,
   116→      filters,
   117→      filtersString,
   118→      keepRange,
   119→      onError,
   120→    });
   121→  }, config.debounceMs);
   122→
   123→  return () => {
   124→    clearTimeout(timer);
   125→  };
   126→}

   128→async function prefetchPage(
   129→  context: AdjacentPreloadContext,
   130→  page: number,
   131→  priority: number,
   132→  errorContext: string,
   133→): Promise<void> {
   134→  const {
   135→    queryClient,
   136→    projectId,
   137→    itemsPerPage,
   138→    filters,
   139→    filtersString,
   140→    onError = defaultOnError,
   141→  } = context;
   142→
   143→  try {
   144→    await queryClient.prefetchQuery({
   145→      [REDACTED](
   146→        projectId,
   147→        page,
   148→        itemsPerPage,
   149→        filtersString,
   150→      ),
   151→      queryFn: () =>
   152→        fetchGenerations(
   153→          projectId,
   154→          itemsPerPage,
   155→          (page - 1) * itemsPerPage,
   156→          filters,
   157→        ),
   158→      staleTime: 30_000,
   159→    });
   160→
   161→    const cached = queryClient.getQueryData<PaginatedResponse>(
   162→      unifiedGenerationQueryKeys.byProject(projectId, page, itemsPerPage, filtersString),
   163→    );
   164→    if (cached?.items) {
   165→      preloadingService.preloadImages(cached.items, priority);
   166→    }
   167→  } catch (error) {
   168→    onError(errorContext, error, { projectId, page });
   169→  }
   170→}
   171→
   172→export async function prefetchAdjacentGenerationPages(context: AdjacentPreloadContext): Promise<void> {
   173→  const {
   174→    currentPage,
   175→    totalPages,
   176→    hasMorePages,
   177→    keepRange = 2,
   178→  } = context;
   179→
   180→  const hasPrevPage = currentPage > 1;
   181→  const hasNextPage = totalPages === null
   182→    ? hasMorePages
   183→    : currentPage < totalPages;
   184→
   185→  if (hasNextPage) {
   186→    await prefetchPage(context, currentPage + 1, PRIORITY_VALUES.high, 'useAdjacentPagePreloader.prefetchNext');
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  if (hasPrevPage) {
   190→    await prefetchPage(context, currentPage - 1, PRIORITY_VALUES.normal, 'useAdjacentPagePreloader.prefetchPrevious');
   191→  }
   192→
   193→  cleanupDistantGenerationPages(context.queryClient, context.projectId, context.currentPage, keepRange);
   194→}

1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→import { QueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     3→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
     5→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
     6→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     7→import { getProjectSelectionFallbackId } from '@/shared/contexts/projectSelectionStore';
     8→import { isTaskDbRow, mapTaskDbRowToTask } from '@/shared/lib/taskRowMapper';
     9→import {
    10→  getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations,
    11→  toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    12→  type GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry,
    13→  type GenerationTaskMappingStatus,
    14→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    15→
    16→interface PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions {
    17→  batchSize?: number;
    18→  delayBetweenBatches?: number;
    19→  preloadFullTaskData?: boolean;
    20→}
    21→
    22→interface GenerationWithTaskData extends GenerationRow {
    23→  taskId?: string | null;
    24→  taskData?: Task | null;
    25→  taskMappingStatus?: GenerationTaskMappingStatus;
    26→  taskMappingError?: string;
    27→}
    28→
    29→function resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId: string | null): string | null {
    30→  if (projectId && projectId.trim().length > 0) {
    31→    return projectId;
    32→  }
    33→  const selectedProjectId = getProjectSelectionFallbackId();
    34→  if (selectedProjectId && selectedProjectId.trim().length > 0) {
    35→    return selectedProjectId;
    36→  }
    37→  return null;
    38→}
    39→
    40→/**
    41→ * Preload task mappings for a batch of generations in the background.
    42→ */
    43→export async function preloadGenerationTaskMappings(
    44→  queryClient: QueryClient,
    45→  generationIds: string[],
    46→  projectId: string | null,
    47→  options: PreloadGenerationTaskMappingsOptions = {},
    48→) {
    49→  const supabase = getSupabaseClient();
    50→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
    51→  const {
    52→    batchSize = 5,
    53→    delayBetweenBatches = 200,
    54→    preloadFullTaskData = false,
    55→  } = options;
    56→
    57→  for (let i = 0; i < generationIds.length; i += batchSize) {
    58→    const batch = generationIds.slice(i, i + batchSize);
    59→
    60→    const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(batch, { projectId: effectiveProjectId ?? undefined });
    61→    let reportedBatchQueryFailure = false;
    62→
    63→    const prefetchTasks: Array<Promise<unknown>> = [];
    64→
    65→    batch.forEach((generationId) => {
    66→      const mapping = mappings.get(generationId);
    67→      const cacheEntry = toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(mapping);
    68→      queryClient.setQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
    69→        taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
    70→        cacheEntry,
    71→      );
    72→
    73→      if (!reportedBatchQueryFailure && cacheEntry.status === 'query_failed' && cacheEntry.queryError) {
    74→        reportedBatchQueryFailure = true;
    75→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(cacheEntry.queryError), {
    76→          context: 'GenerationTaskCache',
    77→          showToast: false,
    78→        });
    79→      }
    80→
    81→      if (preloadFullTaskData && effectiveProjectId && cacheEntry.taskId && cacheEntry.status === 'ok') {
    82→        prefetchTasks.push(queryClient.prefetchQuery({
    83→          [REDACTED](cacheEntry.taskId, effectiveProjectId),
    84→          queryFn: async () => {
    85→            const { data, error } = await supabase
    86→              .from('tasks')
    87→              .select('*')
    88→              .eq('id', cacheEntry.taskId)
    89→              .eq('project_id', effectiveProjectId)
    90→              .single();
    91→
    92→            if (error) throw error;
    93→            if (!isTaskDbRow(data)) {
    94→              throw new Error('Task row has unexpected shape');
    95→            }
    96→            return mapTaskDbRowToTask(data);
    97→          },
    98→          staleTime: 2 * 60 * 1000,
    99→        }));
   100→      }
   101→    });
   102→
   103→    if (prefetchTasks.length > 0) {
   104→      await Promise.all(prefetchTasks);
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    if (i + batchSize < generationIds.length) {
   108→      await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, delayBetweenBatches));
   109→    }
   110→  }
   111→}
   112→
   113→export function mergeGenerationsWithTaskData(
   114→  generations: GenerationRow[],
   115→  queryClient: QueryClient,
   116→  projectId: string | null,
   117→): GenerationWithTaskData[] {
   118→  const effectiveProjectId = resolveTaskScopeProjectId(projectId);
   119→
   120→  return generations.map((generation) => {
   121→    const generationId = generation.generation_id ?? generation.id;
   122→    const cachedMapping = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry>(
   123→      taskQueryKeys.generationMapping(generationId),
   124→    );
   125→    const taskId = cachedMapping?.taskId || null;
   126→    const taskData = (taskId && effectiveProjectId)
   127→      ? queryClient.getQueryData<Task>(taskQueryKeys.single(taskId, effectiveProjectId))
   128→      : null;
   129→    const taskMappingStatus = cachedMapping?.status ?? (taskId ? 'ok' : 'not_loaded');
   130→
   131→    return {
   132→      ...generation,
   133→      taskId,
   134→      taskData,
   135→      taskMappingStatus,
   136→      ...(cachedMapping?.queryError ? { taskMappingError: cachedMapping.queryError } : {}),
   137→    };
   138→  });
   139→}
   140→

   199→    projectId: params.projectId,
   200→    generationParams,
   201→  });
   202→
   203→  if (error || !data) {
   204→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error ?? new Error('Failed to create generation'), {
   205→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createGeneration',
   206→      showToast: false,
   207→      logData: { projectId: params.projectId },
   208→    });
   209→  }
   210→
   211→  // Create the original variant for this generation
   212→  const { error: variantError } = await createGenerationPrimaryVariant({
   213→    generationId: data.id,
   214→    imageUrl: params.imageUrl,
   215→    thumbnailUrl: params.thumbnailUrl || params.imageUrl,
   216→    generationParams,
   217→    variantType: VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL,
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  if (variantError) {
   221→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(variantError, {
   222→      context: 'useCreateGeneration.createVariant',
   223→      showToast: false,
   224→    });
   225→  }
   226→
   227→  return data;
   228→}
   229→
   230→/**
   231→ * Star/unstar a generation using direct Supabase call.
   232→ * @internal Used by useToggleGenerationStar hook.
   233→ */
   234→async function toggleGenerationStar(params: ScopedGenerationInput & { starred: boolean }): Promise<void> {
   235→  const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   236→    params.projectId,
   237→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.projectScope',
   238→  );
   239→  await verifyGenerationScope(
   240→    params.id,
   241→    projectId,
   242→    'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.scopeValidation',
   243→  );
   244→
   245→  const { data, error } = await updateGenerationStarByScope({
   246→    id: params.id,
   247→    projectId,
   248→    starred: params.starred,
   249→  });
   250→
   251→  if (error) {
   252→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   253→      context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar',
   254→      showToast: false,
   255→      logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   260→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(
   261→      new Error('No rows updated while toggling generation star (possible RLS policy issue)'),
   262→      {
   263→        context: 'useGenerationMutations.toggleGenerationStar.noRows',
   264→        showToast: false,
   265→        logData: { generationId: params.id, projectId, starred: params.starred },
   266→      },
   267→    );
   268→  }
   269→}
   270→
   271→// ===== Mutation Hooks =====
   272→
   273→/**
   274→ * Shared delete mutation factory for generations and variants.
   275→ * @internal
   276→ */
   277→function useDeleteFromTable(table: 'generations' | 'generation_variants', entityLabel: string) {
   278→  return useMutation({
   279→    mutationFn: async (input: ScopedGenerationInput | ScopedVariantInput) => {
   280→      const projectId = ensureProjectScope(
   281→        input.projectId,
   282→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.projectScope`,
   283→      );
   284→
   285→      if (table === 'generations') {
   286→        await verifyGenerationScope(
   287→          input.id,
   288→          projectId,
   289→          `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   290→        );
   291→
   292→        const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationByScope({
   293→          id: input.id,
   294→          projectId,
   295→        });
   296→
   297→        if (error) {
   298→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   299→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   300→            showToast: false,
   301→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   302→          });
   303→        }
   304→
   305→        if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   306→          normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing generation scope'), {
   307→            context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   308→            showToast: false,
   309→            logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel },
   310→          });
   311→        }
   312→
   313→        return;
   314→      }
   315→
   316→      const variantScope = await verifyVariantScope(
   317→        input.id,
   318→        projectId,
   319→        `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.scopeValidation`,
   320→      );
   321→      const { data, error } = await deleteGenerationVariantByScope({
   322→        id: input.id,
   323→        generationId: variantScope.generationId,
   324→      });
   325→
   326→      if (error) {
   327→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error, {
   328→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}`,
   329→          showToast: false,
   330→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   331→        });
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      if (!data || data.length === 0) {
   335→        normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error('No rows deleted while enforcing variant scope'), {
   336→          context: `useGenerationMutations.useDeleteFromTable.${table}.noRows`,
   337→          showToast: false,
   338→          logData: { id: input.id, projectId, entityLabel, generationId: variantScope.generationId },
   339→        });
   340→      }
   341→    },
   342→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   343→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   344→        context: `useDelete${entityLabel.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + entityLabel.slice(1)}`,
   345→        toastTitle: `Failed to delete ${entityLabel}`,
   346→      });
   347→    },
   348→  });
   349→}
   350→
   351→export function useDeleteGeneration() {
   352→  return useDeleteFromTable('generations', 'generation');
   353→}
   354→
   355→/**
   356→ * Delete a variant from generation_variants table.
   357→ * Use this for edit tools (edit-images, edit-video, character-animate) that create variants.
   358→ */
   359→export function useDeleteVariant() {
   360→  return useDeleteFromTable('generation_variants', 'variant');
   361→}
   362→
   363→export function useUpdateGenerationLocation() {
   364→  return useMutation({
   365→    mutationFn: ({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId }: { id: string; location: string; thumbUrl?: string; projectId: string }) => {
   366→      return updateGenerationLocation({ id, location, thumbUrl, projectId });
   367→    },
   368→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   369→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useUpdateGenerationLocation', toastTitle: 'Failed to update generation' });
   370→    },
   371→  });
   372→}
   373→
   374→export function useCreateGeneration() {
   375→  return useMutation({
   376→    mutationFn: createGeneration,
   377→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   378→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useCreateGeneration', toastTitle: 'Failed to create generation' });
   379→    },
   380→  });
   381→}
   382→
   383→export function useToggleGenerationStar() {
   384→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   385→
   386→  return useMutation({
   387→    mutationFn: ({ id, starred, projectId }: { id: string; starred: boolean; projectId: string; shotId?: string }) => {
   388→      return toggleGenerationStar({ id, starred, projectId });
   389→    },
   390→    onMutate: async ({ id, starred, shotId }) => {
   391→      return applyOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, {
   392→        generationId: id,
   393→        starred,
   394→        shotId,
   395→      });
   396→    },
   397→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   398→      rollbackOptimisticGenerationStarUpdate(queryClient, context);
   399→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useToggleGenerationStar', toastTitle: 'Failed to toggle star' });
   400→    },
   401→    onSuccess: (_data, variables) => {
   402→      // Emit custom event so Timeline knows to refetch star data
   403→      if (variables.shotId) {
   404→        dispatchAppEvent('generation-star-updated', {
   405→          generationId: variables.id, shotId: variables.shotId!, starred: variables.starred,
   406→        });
   407→      }
   408→    },
   409→  });
   410→}

1→/**
     2→ * Standardized error types for the application
     3→ *
     4→ * These error classes help distinguish between different error categories,
     5→ * enabling better error handling, user messaging, and logging.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→/**
     9→ * Base application error with additional context
    10→ */
    11→export class AppError extends Error {
    12→  /** Whether this error should be shown to the user via toast */
    13→  public readonly showToast: boolean;
    14→  /** Additional context for logging */
    15→  public readonly context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    16→  /** Original error if this wraps another error */
    17→  public readonly cause?: Error;
    18→
    19→  constructor(
    20→    message: string,
    21→    options?: {
    22→      showToast?: boolean;
    23→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    24→      cause?: Error;
    25→    }
    26→  ) {
    27→    super(message);
    28→    this.name = 'AppError';
    29→    this.showToast = options?.showToast ?? true;
    30→    this.context = options?.context;
    31→    this.cause = options?.cause;
    32→  }
    33→}
    34→
    35→/**
    36→ * Network-related errors (fetch failures, timeouts, offline)
    37→ * These are often transient and may benefit from retry
    38→ */
    39→export class NetworkError extends AppError {
    40→  /** Whether the user appears to be offline */
    41→  public readonly isOffline: boolean;
    42→  /** Whether this was a timeout */
    43→  public readonly isTimeout: boolean;
    44→
    45→  constructor(
    46→    message: string,
    47→    options?: {
    48→      isOffline?: boolean;
    49→      isTimeout?: boolean;
    50→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    51→      cause?: Error;
    52→    }
    53→  ) {
    54→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
    55→    this.name = 'NetworkError';
    56→    this.isOffline = options?.isOffline ?? !navigator.onLine;
    57→    this.isTimeout = options?.isTimeout ?? false;
    58→  }
    59→
    60→  static fromError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, unknown>): NetworkError {
    61→    const isTimeout = error.name === 'AbortError' || error.message.includes('timeout');
    62→    const isOffline = !navigator.onLine;
    63→
    64→    let message = 'Network request failed';
    65→    if (isOffline) {
    66→      message = 'You appear to be offline. Please check your connection.';
    67→    } else if (isTimeout) {
    68→      message = 'Request timed out. Please try again.';
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    return new NetworkError(message, { isOffline, isTimeout, context, cause: error });
    72→  }
    73→}
    74→
    75→/**
    76→ * Authentication/authorization errors
    77→ * User needs to log in or doesn't have permission
    78→ */
    79→export class AuthError extends AppError {
    80→  /** Whether the user needs to log in (vs lacking permission) */
    81→  public readonly needsLogin: boolean;
    82→
    83→  constructor(
    84→    message: string,
    85→    options?: {
    86→      needsLogin?: boolean;
    87→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
    88→      cause?: Error;
    89→    }
    90→  ) {
    91→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
    92→    this.name = 'AuthError';
    93→    this.needsLogin = options?.needsLogin ?? true;
    94→  }
    95→
    96→  static fromError(error: Error, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AuthError {
    97→    const message = error.message.toLowerCase();
    98→    const needsLogin = message.includes('unauthorized') || message.includes('not authenticated');
    99→
   100→    return new AuthError(
   101→      needsLogin ? 'Please log in to continue' : 'You don\'t have permission for this action',
   102→      { needsLogin, context, cause: error }
   103→    );
   104→  }
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Validation errors (invalid input, missing required fields)
   109→ * These are user errors that can be corrected
   110→ */
   111→export class ValidationError extends AppError {
   112→  /** The field that failed validation, if applicable */
   113→  public readonly field?: string;
   114→
   115→  constructor(
   116→    message: string,
   117→    options?: {
   118→      field?: string;
   119→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   120→      cause?: Error;
   121→    }
   122→  ) {
   123→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
   124→    this.name = 'ValidationError';
   125→    this.field = options?.field;
   126→  }
   127→}
   128→
   129→/**
   130→ * Server/API errors (5xx responses, unexpected server behavior)
   131→ * These are typically not the user's fault
   132→ */
   133→export class ServerError extends AppError {
   134→  /** HTTP status code if available */
   135→  public readonly statusCode?: number;
   136→
   137→  constructor(
   138→    message: string,
   139→    options?: {
   140→      statusCode?: number;
   141→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   142→      cause?: Error;
   143→    }
   144→  ) {
   145→    super(message, { showToast: true, ...options });
   146→    this.name = 'ServerError';
   147→    this.statusCode = options?.statusCode;
   148→  }
   149→}
   150→
   151→/**
   152→ * Errors that should be silently logged (not shown to user)
   153→ * Use for expected failures like localStorage unavailable, optional features
   154→ */
   155→export class SilentError extends AppError {
   156→  constructor(
   157→    message: string,
   158→    options?: {
   159→      context?: Record<string, unknown>;
   160→      cause?: Error;
   161→    }
   162→  ) {
   163→    super(message, { showToast: false, ...options });
   164→    this.name = 'SilentError';
   165→  }
   166→}
   167→
   168→/**
   169→ * Type guard to check if an error is one of our app errors
   170→ */
   171→export function isAppError(error: unknown): error is AppError {
   172→  return error instanceof AppError;
   173→}
   174→
   175→/**
   176→ * Type guard to check if an error is a network error
   177→ */
   178→export function isNetworkError(error: unknown): error is NetworkError {
   179→  return error instanceof NetworkError;
   180→}
   181→
   182→/**
   183→ * Type guard to check if an error is an auth error
   184→ */
   185→export function isAuthError(error: unknown): error is AuthError {
   186→  return error instanceof AuthError;
   187→}
   188→
   189→/**
   190→ * Categorize an unknown error into an appropriate AppError type
   191→ */
   192→export function categorizeError(error: unknown, context?: Record<string, unknown>): AppError {
   193→  // Already an AppError
   194→  if (isAppError(error)) {
   195→    return error;
   196→  }
   197→
   198→  // Convert to Error if needed
   199→  const err = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
   200→  const message = err.message.toLowerCase();
   201→
   202→  // Network errors
   203→  if (
   204→    err.name === 'AbortError' ||
   205→    message.includes('network') ||
   206→    message.includes('fetch') ||
   207→    message.includes('timeout') ||
   208→    message.includes('failed to fetch') ||
   209→    !navigator.onLine
   210→  ) {
   211→    return NetworkError.fromError(err, context);
   212→  }
   213→
   214→  // Auth errors
   215→  if (
   216→    message.includes('unauthorized') ||
   217→    message.includes('forbidden') ||
   218→    message.includes('not authenticated') ||
   219→    message.includes('authentication required')
   220→  ) {
   221→    return AuthError.fromError(err, context);
   222→  }
   223→
   224→  // Validation errors

1→import { useState, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from 'react';
     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Hook for showing something temporarily with auto-hide.
     5→ *
     6→ * Useful for transient UI hints, tooltips, or feedback that should
     7→ * appear briefly then disappear automatically.
     8→ *
     9→ * @param duration - How long to show before auto-hiding (ms), default 2000
    10→ * @returns { isVisible, show, hide }
    11→ *
    12→ * @example
    13→ * const hint = useTemporaryVisibility(2000);
    14→ *
    15→ * // Show the hint (auto-hides after 2s)
    16→ * hint.show();
    17→ *
    18→ * // Manually hide early
    19→ * hint.hide();
    20→ *
    21→ * // In JSX
    22→ * {hint.isVisible && <div>Temporary hint!</div>}
    23→ */
    24→export function useTemporaryVisibility(duration = 2000) {
    25→  const [isVisible, setIsVisible] = useState(false);
    26→  const timeoutRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);
    27→
    28→  const clearPendingTimeout = useCallback(() => {
    29→    if (timeoutRef.current) {
    30→      clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    31→      timeoutRef.current = null;
    32→    }
    33→  }, []);
    34→
    35→  const show = useCallback(() => {
    36→    setIsVisible(true);
    37→    clearPendingTimeout();
    38→    timeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
    39→      setIsVisible(false);
    40→      timeoutRef.current = null;
    41→    }, duration);
    42→  }, [duration, clearPendingTimeout]);
    43→
    44→  const hide = useCallback(() => {
    45→    setIsVisible(false);
    46→    clearPendingTimeout();
    47→  }, [clearPendingTimeout]);
    48→
    49→  // Cleanup on unmount
    50→  useEffect(() => {
    51→    return () => clearPendingTimeout();
    52→  }, [clearPendingTimeout]);
    53→
    54→  return { isVisible, show, hide };
    55→}
    56→

   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   417→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)

     9→const POSTGREST_NO_ROWS_CODE = 'PGRST116';

    11→function isNoRowsPostgrestError(error: unknown): boolean {
    12→  if (!error || typeof error !== 'object') {
    13→    return false;
    14→  }
    15→  const candidate = error as { code?: unknown; message?: unknown };
    16→  if (candidate.code === POSTGREST_NO_ROWS_CODE) {
    17→    return true;
    18→  }
    19→  return typeof candidate.message === 'string' && /0 rows/i.test(candidate.message);
    20→}

    78→export async function resolveGenerationProjectScope(

    97→    .eq('id', generationId)

   139→

   141→    generationId,

   239→export async function getPrimaryTaskIdForGeneration(
   240→  generationId: string,
   241→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   242→): Promise<GenerationTaskMapping> {
   243→  const mappings = await getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations([generationId], options);
   244→  return mappings.get(generationId) ?? {
   245→    generationId,
   246→    taskId: null,
   247→    status: 'missing_generation',
   248→  };
   249→}
   250→
   251→export async function getPrimaryTaskMappingsForGenerations(
   252→  generationIds: string[],
   253→  options?: GenerationTaskRepositoryOptions,
   254→): Promise<Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>> {
   255→  if (generationIds.length === 0) {
   256→    return new Map();
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  const requestedIds = Array.from(new Set(generationIds));
   260→  const supabaseResult = (options?.supabaseRegistry ?? supabaseClientRegistry).getClientResult();
   261→  if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
   262→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   263→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   264→      failures.set(generationId, {
   265→        generationId,
   266→        taskId: null,
   267→        status: 'query_failed',
   268→        queryError: supabaseResult.error.message,
   269→      });
   270→    });
   271→    return failures;
   272→  }
   273→
   274→  const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
   275→  const query = supabase
   276→    .from('generations')
   277→    .select('id, tasks, project_id')
   278→    .in('id', requestedIds);
   279→
   280→  const { data, error } = await query;
   281→
   282→  if (error) {
   283→    const failures = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   284→    requestedIds.forEach((generationId) => {
   285→      failures.set(generationId, {
   286→        generationId,
   287→        taskId: null,
   288→        status: 'query_failed',
   289→        queryError: error.message,
   290→      });
   291→    });
   292→    return failures;
   293→  }
   294→
   295→  const rowsById = new Map((data || []).map((row) => [row.id, row]));
   296→
   297→  const mappings = new Map<string, GenerationTaskMapping>();
   298→  for (const generationId of requestedIds) {
   299→    const row = rowsById.get(generationId);
   300→
   301→    if (!row) {
   302→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   303→        generationId,
   304→        taskId: null,
   305→        status: 'missing_generation',
   306→      });
   307→      continue;
   308→    }
   309→
   310→    if (options?.projectId && row.project_id !== options.projectId) {
   311→      mappings.set(generationId, {
   312→        generationId,
   313→        taskId: null,
   314→        status: 'scope_mismatch',
   315→      });
   316→      continue;
   317→    }
   318→
   319→    const parsed = parseGenerationTaskId(row.tasks);
   320→    mappings.set(generationId, {
   321→      generationId,
   322→      taskId: parsed.taskId,
   323→      status: parsed.status,
   324→    });
   325→  }
   326→
   327→  return mappings;
   328→}
   329→
   330→export function toGenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry(
   331→  mapping: GenerationTaskMapping | undefined,
   332→): GenerationTaskMappingCacheEntry {
   333→  return {
   334→    taskId: mapping?.taskId ?? null,
   335→    status: mapping?.status ?? 'not_loaded',
   336→    ...(mapping?.queryError ? { queryError: mapping.queryError } : {}),
   337→  };
   338→}

    16→export interface AuthResult {

    28→export interface AuthOptions {

    32→
    33→/**
    34→ * Authenticates a request using Bearer token (Service Role Key, JWT, or PAT)
    35→ *
    36→ * This function handles authentication methods:
    37→ * 1. Service Role Key - Direct match with SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
    38→ * 2. Personal Access Token (PAT) - Looked up in user_api_tokens table
    39→ * 3. JWT User Auth (optional) - Extract user ID from JWT payload.sub
    40→ *
    41→ * NOTE: We intentionally do NOT accept JWTs with service_role claims.
    42→ * Only the actual service key can be used for service role access.
    43→ * This prevents unsigned/forged JWTs from gaining elevated privileges.
    44→ *
    45→ * @param req - The incoming HTTP request
    46→ * @param supabaseAdmin - Supabase admin client for database queries
    47→ * @param logPrefix - Optional prefix for log messages (e.g., "[FUNCTION-NAME]")
    48→ * @param options - Optional settings for auth behavior
    49→ * @returns AuthResult with authentication details
    50→ */
    51→export async function authenticateRequest(
    52→  req: Request,
    53→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient,
    54→  logPrefix: string = "[AUTH]",
    55→  options: AuthOptions = {}
    56→): Promise<AuthResult> {
    57→  // Extract authorization header
    58→  const authHeader = req.headers.get("Authorization");
    59→  if (!authHeader?.startsWith("Bearer ")) {
    60→    return {
    61→      isServiceRole: false,
    62→      userId: null,
    63→      success: false,
    64→      error: "Missing or invalid Authorization header",
    65→      statusCode: 401
    66→    };
    67→  }
    68→
    69→  const [REDACTED](7); // Remove "Bearer " prefix
    70→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get("SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY");
    71→
    72→  if (!serviceKey) {
    73→    console.error(`${logPrefix} Missing SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY environment variable`);
    74→    return {
    75→      isServiceRole: false,
    76→      userId: null,
    77→      success: false,
    78→      error: "Server configuration error",
    79→      statusCode: 500
    80→    };
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  // 1) Check if token matches service-role key directly (SECURE)
    84→  if (token === serviceKey) {
    85→    return {
    86→      isServiceRole: true,
    87→      userId: null,
    88→      success: true
    89→    };
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  // 2) If JWT user auth is enabled, verify JWT and extract user ID
    93→  if (options.allowJwtUserAuth) {
    94→    try {
    95→      const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin.auth.getUser(token);
    96→      const user = data?.user;
    97→      if (!error && user) {
    98→        const roleCandidate = typeof user.role === "string"
    99→          ? user.role

   106→          return {

   109→            success: true,

   113→      }
   114→    } catch {

   116→    }
   117→  }
   118→
   119→  // 3) Personal Access Token (PAT) - look up in user_api_tokens table (SECURE)
   120→
   121→  const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin

   123→    .select("user_id")

   126→
   127→  if (error || !data) {

   135→    };
   136→  }
   137→
   138→  const userId = data.user_id;
   139→  return {

   141→    userId,
   142→    success: true
   143→  };
   144→}

   160→): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; statusCode?: number; projectId?: string }> {

     2→ * useAdjustedTaskDetails - Fetches variant source task and computes adjusted task details
     3→ *
     4→ * For variants created by tasks, shows the variant's source task params
     5→ * instead of the original generation's task. Preserves onApplySettingsFromTask.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→import { useMemo } from 'react';
     9→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
    12→import { VARIANT_TYPE } from '@/shared/constants/variantTypes';
    13→import {
    14→  getSourceTaskIdLegacyCompatible,
    15→  hasOrchestratorDetails,
    16→} from '@/shared/lib/taskIdHelpers';
    17→import type { TaskDetailsData } from '../types';
    18→import type { Task } from '@/types/tasks';
    19→
    20→// Helper to derive input images from task params
    21→function deriveInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    22→  const images: string[] = [];
    23→
    24→  // Check various param locations for input images
    25→  const orchestratorDetails = params.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    26→
    27→  // Direct input_images array
    28→  if (Array.isArray(params.input_images)) {
    29→    images.push(...params.input_images.filter((img): img is string => typeof img === 'string'));
    30→  }
    31→
    32→  // Orchestrator details input_images
    33→  if (orchestratorDetails && Array.isArray(orchestratorDetails.input_images)) {
    34→    images.push(...orchestratorDetails.input_images.filter((img): img is string => typeof img === 'string'));
    35→  }
    36→
    37→  // Start/end image URLs
    38→  if (typeof params.start_image_url === 'string') images.push(params.start_image_url);
    39→  if (typeof params.end_image_url === 'string') images.push(params.end_image_url);
    40→
    41→  // Orchestrator start/end
    42→  if (orchestratorDetails) {
    43→    if (typeof orchestratorDetails.start_image_url === 'string') images.push(orchestratorDetails.start_image_url);
    44→    if (typeof orchestratorDetails.end_image_url === 'string') images.push(orchestratorDetails.end_image_url);
    45→  }
    46→
    47→  return [...new Set(images)]; // Dedupe
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface UseAdjustedTaskDetailsProps {
    51→  projectId?: string | null;
    52→  activeVariant: {
    53→    id: string;
    54→    params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
    55→    variant_type?: string | null;
    56→    created_at?: string;
    57→    is_primary?: boolean | null;
    58→  } | null;
    59→  taskDetailsData: TaskDetailsData | undefined;
    60→  isLoadingVariants: boolean;
    61→  initialVariantId: string | undefined;
    62→}
    63→
    64→interface UseAdjustedTaskDetailsReturn {
    65→  adjustedTaskDetailsData: TaskDetailsData | undefined;
    66→  isLoadingVariantTask: boolean;
    67→}
    68→
    69→export function useAdjustedTaskDetails({
    70→  projectId,
    71→  activeVariant,
    72→  taskDetailsData,
    73→  isLoadingVariants,
    74→  initialVariantId,
    75→}: UseAdjustedTaskDetailsProps): UseAdjustedTaskDetailsReturn {
    76→  // Extract source_task_id and check if variant already has orchestrator_details
    77→  const { variantSourceTaskId, variantHasOrchestratorDetails } = useMemo(() => {
    78→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    79→    return {
    80→      variantSourceTaskId: getSourceTaskIdLegacyCompatible(variantParams),
    81→      variantHasOrchestratorDetails: hasOrchestratorDetails(variantParams),
    82→    };
    83→  }, [activeVariant?.params]);
    84→
    85→  // Fetch the variant's source task when it differs from taskDetailsData
    86→  // Skip fetch if variant already has orchestrator_details (e.g., clip_join variants)
    87→  // NOTE: Uses ['tasks', 'single', taskId] query key to share cache with usePrefetchTaskData
    88→  const { data: variantSourceTask, isLoading: isLoadingVariantTask } = useQuery({
    89→    [REDACTED](variantSourceTaskId ?? '', projectId ?? null),
    90→    queryFn: async () => {
    91→      if (!variantSourceTaskId || !projectId) return null;
    92→      const { data, error } = await supabase().from('tasks')
    93→        .select('*')
    94→        .eq('id', variantSourceTaskId)
    95→        .eq('project_id', projectId)
    96→        .single();
    97→      if (error) {
    98→        console.error('[VariantTaskDetails] Error fetching source task:', error);
    99→        return null;
   100→      }
   101→      return data;
   102→    },
   103→    // Don't fetch if: no task ID, already have matching taskDetailsData, or variant has orchestrator_details
   104→    enabled: !!variantSourceTaskId
   105→      && !!projectId
   106→      && variantSourceTaskId !== taskDetailsData?.taskId
   107→      && !variantHasOrchestratorDetails,
   108→    staleTime: Infinity, // Task data is immutable - cache forever (matches prefetch)
   109→  });
   110→
   111→  // For variants, show the variant's source task params instead of the original task
   112→  // But ALWAYS preserve onApplySettingsFromTask so the Apply button shows
   113→  const adjustedTaskDetailsData = useMemo(() => {
   114→    // Check if we're viewing a variant that was created by a task (has source_task_id in params)
   115→    const variantParams = activeVariant?.params as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   116→    const isTaskCreatedVariant = activeVariant && variantParams && (
   117→      variantParams.source_task_id ||
   118→      variantParams.created_from ||
   119→      (activeVariant.variant_type && activeVariant.variant_type !== VARIANT_TYPE.ORIGINAL)
   120→    );
   121→
   122→    if (isTaskCreatedVariant && variantParams) {
   123→      // Check if taskDetailsData already has the correct task (e.g., when opened from TasksPane)
   124→      const sourceTaskId = typeof variantParams.source_task_id === 'string' ? variantParams.source_task_id : undefined;
   125→      const hasMatchingTaskData = taskDetailsData?.taskId === sourceTaskId && taskDetailsData?.task?.params;
   126→
   127→      // Determine the best source of task params:
   128→      // 1. If taskDetailsData matches, use its params (already have full data)
   129→      // 2. If we fetched the source task, use its params
   130→      // 3. Fall back to variant params (may be incomplete)
   131→      // IMPORTANT: Use variant_type for display (e.g., 'clip_join'), NOT tool_type
   132→      // tool_type is the tool that launched the task (e.g., 'travel-between-images'),
   133→      // which is different from what kind of variant this is
   134→      let effectiveParams = variantParams;
   135→      const effectiveTaskType = activeVariant.variant_type || 'variant';
   136→
   137→      if (hasMatchingTaskData) {
   138→        effectiveParams = (taskDetailsData.task?.params ?? variantParams) as Record<string, unknown>;
   139→      } else if (!variantParams.orchestrator_details && variantSourceTask?.params) {
   140→        // Only use fetched task params if variant doesn't already have orchestrator_details
   141→        // clip_join variants store orchestrator_details directly, so we don't want to overwrite
   142→        try {
   143→          effectiveParams = typeof variantSourceTask.params === 'string'
   144→            ? JSON.parse(variantSourceTask.params)
   145→            : variantSourceTask.params;
   146→        } catch {
   147→          // Keep variantParams as fallback on parse failure
   148→        }
   149→      }
   150→      // Otherwise keep variantParams which may already have orchestrator_details (e.g., clip_join)
   151→
   152→      // Extract input images using shared utility
   153→      // This handles segment tasks (only segment images) vs full timeline tasks
   154→      const variantInputImages = deriveInputImages(effectiveParams);
   155→
   156→      return {
   157→        task: {
   158→          id: activeVariant.id,
   159→          taskType: effectiveTaskType,
   160→          params: effectiveParams,
   161→          status: 'Complete' as Task['status'],
   162→          createdAt: activeVariant.created_at || new Date().toISOString(),
   163→          projectId: '',
   164→        } as Task,
   165→        isLoading: isLoadingVariantTask,
   166→        error: null,
   167→        inputImages: variantInputImages,
   168→        taskId: sourceTaskId ?? activeVariant.id,
   169→        // ALWAYS preserve onApplySettingsFromTask so Apply button shows for all variants
   170→        onApplySettingsFromTask: taskDetailsData?.onApplySettingsFromTask,
   171→      };
   172→    }
   173→
   174→    // If variants are still loading AND we don't have task data yet, show loading
   175→    // But if we already have task data cached, show it immediately rather than blocking on variants
   176→    // This provides better UX when task data is prefetched/cached
   177→    // ALSO check if we're waiting for initialVariantId to be applied (clicked a specific variant)
   178→    const waitingForInitialVariant = initialVariantId &&
   179→      (!activeVariant || activeVariant.id !== initialVariantId);
   180→
   181→    // Only override to loading if:
   182→    // 1. Waiting for a specific variant (user clicked a variant)
   183→    // 2. Variants loading AND no active variant AND task details still loading
   184→    //    (If task details finished - either has task or knows there's none - don't block on variants)
   185→    const shouldShowLoading = waitingForInitialVariant ||
   186→      (isLoadingVariants && !activeVariant && taskDetailsData?.isLoading);
   187→
   188→    if (shouldShowLoading) {
   189→      return taskDetailsData ? { ...taskDetailsData, isLoading: true } : taskDetailsData;
   190→    }
   191→
   192→    // For all other cases, use the generation's task details as-is
   193→    return taskDetailsData;
   194→  }, [taskDetailsData, activeVariant, variantSourceTask, isLoadingVariantTask, isLoadingVariants, initialVariantId]);
   195→
   196→  return {
   197→    adjustedTaskDetailsData,
   198→    isLoadingVariantTask,
   199→  };
   200→}
   201→

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    24→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    25→import { stripQueryParameters } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    26→import { TOOL_IDS, isToolId } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    27→import { ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';
    32→import { asRecord, asString, firstString } from '@/shared/lib/jsonNarrowing';
    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    36→ */
    37→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    38→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    39→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    40→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    41→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    42→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    43→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    44→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    45→  degraded?: boolean;
    46→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    47→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    48→}
    49→
    50→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    51→  return {
    52→    derivedCounts: {},
    53→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    54→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→/**
    59→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    60→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    61→ *
    62→ * Queries both:
    63→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    64→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    65→ *
    66→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    67→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    68→ */
    69→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    70→  generationIds: string[]
    71→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    72→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    73→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    74→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    78→
    79→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    80→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    81→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    82→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    83→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    84→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    85→
    86→  if (variantCountsError) {
    87→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    88→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    89→      cause: variantCountsError,
    90→    });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  if (variantCountsData) {
    94→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    95→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    96→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    97→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    98→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    99→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
   100→      }
   101→    }
   102→  }
   103→
   104→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   109→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   110→ */
   111→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   112→  generationIds: string[]
   113→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   114→  try {
   115→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   116→  } catch (error) {
   117→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   118→    return {
   119→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   120→      degraded: true,
   121→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   122→    };
   123→  }
   124→}

   201→/**
   202→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   203→ */
   204→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   205→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   206→
   207→  const originalParams = asRecord(params.originalParams);
   208→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   209→  const metadataBlock = asRecord(params.metadata);
   210→
   211→  return firstString(
   212→    orchestratorDetails?.prompt,
   213→    params.prompt,
   214→    metadataBlock?.prompt,
   215→  ) ?? 'No prompt';
   216→}

   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = asRecord(item.params?.originalParams);
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   231→    const fullPayload = asRecord(item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   232→    const originalFullPayload = asRecord(originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl = firstString(
   235→      item.params?.thumbnailUrl,
   236→      orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url,
   237→      fullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   238→      originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   239→    ) ?? undefined;
   240→  }
   241→  
   242→  // Final fallback to main URL
   243→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   244→}
   245→
   246→/**
   247→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   248→ */
   249→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   250→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   251→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   252→}

   254→/**
   255→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   256→ * 
   257→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   258→ * 
   259→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query

   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}

   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {

   284→  }

   290→

   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {

   297→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   298→    prompt,
   299→    metadata: {
   300→      ...(item.params || {}),
   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   318→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   319→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   320→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   321→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   325→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(asRecord(item.shot_data));
   326→  
   327→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   328→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   329→    return {
   330→      ...baseItem,
   331→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   332→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   333→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   334→    };
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   345→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   346→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   347→      };
   348→    }
   349→    
   350→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}
   476→

    31→export function getSupabaseClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {

1→export type OperationFailurePolicy = 'fail_closed' | 'fail_open' | 'degrade' | 'best_effort';
     2→
     3→interface OperationSuccess<T> {
     4→  ok: true;
     5→  value: T;
     6→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
     7→  recoverable: false;
     8→}
     9→
    10→export interface OperationFailure {
    11→  ok: false;
    12→  error: Error;
    13→  message: string;
    14→  recoverable: boolean;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  errorCode: string;
    17→  cause?: unknown;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→export class OperationResultError extends Error {
    23→  errorCode: string;
    24→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    25→  recoverable: boolean;
    26→  cause?: unknown;
    27→
    28→  constructor(options: {
    29→    message: string;
    30→    errorCode: string;
    31→    policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    32→    recoverable: boolean;
    33→    cause?: unknown;
    34→    sourceError?: Error;
    35→  }) {
    36→    super(options.message);
    37→    this.name = 'OperationResultError';
    38→    this.errorCode = options.errorCode;
    39→    this.policy = options.policy;
    40→    this.recoverable = options.recoverable;
    41→    this.cause = options.cause;
    42→
    43→    // Preserve the original stack for easier debugging when available.
    44→    if (options.sourceError?.stack) {
    45→      this.stack = options.sourceError.stack;
    46→    }
    47→  }
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    51→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    52→}
    53→
    54→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    55→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    56→  recoverable?: boolean;
    57→  errorCode?: string;
    58→  message?: string;
    59→  cause?: unknown;
    60→}
    61→
    62→export function operationSuccess<T>(value: T, options?: OperationSuccessOptions): OperationSuccess<T> {
    63→  return {
    64→    ok: true,
    65→    value,
    66→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    67→    recoverable: false,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→export function operationFailure(error: unknown, options?: OperationFailureOptions): OperationFailure {
    72→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    73→  return {
    74→    ok: false,
    75→    error: normalizedError,
    76→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    77→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    78→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    79→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    80→    ...(options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause: options.cause } : {}),
    81→  };
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Convert a structured operation failure into an Error while preserving machine-readable metadata.
    86→ */
    87→export function toOperationResultError(failure: OperationFailure): OperationResultError {
    88→  return new OperationResultError({
    89→    message: failure.message,
    90→    errorCode: failure.errorCode,
    91→    policy: failure.policy,
    92→    recoverable: failure.recoverable,
    93→    cause: failure.cause,
    94→    sourceError: failure.error,
    95→  });
    96→}

    16→import { jsonResponse } from './http.ts';

    18→type BodyParseMode = 'none' | 'strict' | 'loose';
    19→type ErrorResponseFormat = 'json' | 'text';
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Shared runtime options that disable Supabase auth session management.
    23→ * Use in edge functions that handle their own auth (PAT, JWT, service-role).
    24→ */
    25→export const NO_SESSION_RUNTIME_OPTIONS: Pick<EdgeBootstrapOptions, 'runtimeOptions'> = {

    28→      auth: {
    29→        autoRefreshToken: false,

    36→export interface EdgeBootstrapOptions {

    53→export interface EdgeRequestContext<TBody extends Record<string, unknown>> {

    56→  supabaseAdmin: EdgeRuntime['supabaseAdmin'];
    57→  logger: EdgeRuntime['logger'];

    60→
    61→type EdgeBootstrapResult<TBody extends Record<string, unknown>> =
    62→  | { ok: true; value: EdgeRequestContext<TBody> }
    63→  | { ok: false; response: Response };
    64→
    65→function deriveErrorCode(message: string, status: number): string {
    66→  const normalized = message.trim().toLowerCase();
    67→  if (normalized === 'method not allowed' || status === 405) {
    68→    return 'method_not_allowed';
    69→  }
    70→  if (normalized === 'authentication failed' || status === 401) {
    71→    return 'authentication_failed';
    72→  }
    73→  if (
    74→    normalized === 'unauthorized - service role required'
    75→    || (normalized.includes('unauthorized') && normalized.includes('service role'))
    76→  ) {
    77→    return 'service_role_required';
    78→  }
    79→  if (normalized === 'internal server error' || status >= 500) {
    80→    return 'internal_server_error';
    81→  }
    82→  if (status === 403) {
    83→    return 'forbidden';
    84→  }
    85→  return 'request_failed';
    86→}
    87→
    88→function isRecoverableStatus(status: number): boolean {
    89→  return status >= 500 || status === 429;
    90→}
    91→
    92→function buildErrorResponse(
    93→  message: string,
    94→  status: number,
    95→  format: ErrorResponseFormat,
    96→  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>,
    97→): Response {
    98→  if (format === 'text') {
    99→    return new Response(message, {
   100→      status,
   101→      headers: extraHeaders,
   102→    });
   103→  }
   104→  return edgeErrorResponse(
   105→    {
   106→      errorCode: deriveErrorCode(message, status),
   107→      message,
   108→      recoverable: isRecoverableStatus(status),
   109→    },
   110→    status,
   111→    extraHeaders,
   112→  );
   113→}
   114→
   115→function parseMode(options: EdgeBootstrapOptions): BodyParseMode {
   116→  return options.parseBody ?? 'none';
   117→}
   118→
   119→function methodFor(options: EdgeBootstrapOptions): string {
   120→  return options.method ?? 'POST';
   121→}
   122→
   123→function authIsRequired(options: EdgeBootstrapOptions): boolean {
   124→  return options.auth?.required ?? true;
   125→}
   126→
   127→function errorFormat(options: EdgeBootstrapOptions): ErrorResponseFormat {
   128→  return options.errorResponseFormat ?? 'json';
   129→}
   130→
   131→/**
   132→ * Shared bootstrap for edge handlers:
   133→ * - OPTIONS short-circuit
   134→ * - method guard
   135→ * - runtime initialization
   136→ * - optional JSON body parsing
   137→ * - optional authentication + service-role policy
   138→ */
   139→export async function bootstrapEdgeHandler<TBody extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>>(
   140→  req: Request,
   141→  options: EdgeBootstrapOptions,
   142→): Promise<EdgeBootstrapResult<TBody>> {
   143→  const method = methodFor(options);
   144→  const format = errorFormat(options);
   145→  const corsPreflight = options.corsPreflight ?? true;
   146→
   147→  if (corsPreflight && req.method === 'OPTIONS') {
   148→    return {
   149→      ok: false,
   150→      response: jsonResponse({ ok: true }),
   151→    };
   152→  }
   153→
   154→  const runtimeResult = initEdgeRuntime(
   155→    options.functionName,
   156→    options.logPrefix,
   157→    options.runtimeOptions,
   158→  );
   159→  if (!runtimeResult.ok) {
   160→    return {
   161→      ok: false,
   162→      response: operationFailureResponse(runtimeResult, 500),
   163→    };
   164→  }
   165→
   166→  const { supabaseAdmin, logger } = runtimeResult.value;
   167→
   168→  if (req.method !== method) {
   169→    logger.warn('Method not allowed', { method: req.method });
   170→    await logger.flush();
   171→    return {
   172→      ok: false,
   173→      response: buildErrorResponse('Method not allowed', 405, format, { Allow: method }),
   174→    };
   175→  }
   176→
   177→  let body: Record<string, unknown> = {};
   178→
   179→  if (parseMode(options) === 'strict') {
   180→    const parsedBody = await parseJsonBodyStrict(req, logger, {
   181→      message: options.invalidJsonMessage,
   182→      nonObjectMessage: options.invalidJsonShapeMessage,
   183→    });
   184→    if (!parsedBody.ok) {
   185→      return {
   186→        ok: false,
   187→        response: format === 'text'
   188→          ? buildErrorResponse(parsedBody.message, 400, 'text')
   189→          : parseJsonFailureResponse(parsedBody),
   190→      };
   191→    }
   192→    body = parsedBody.value;
   193→  } else if (parseMode(options) === 'loose') {
   194→    const parsedBody = await parseJsonBody(req, logger, {
   195→      mode: 'loose',
   196→      message: options.invalidJsonMessage,
   197→      nonObjectMessage: options.invalidJsonShapeMessage,
   198→    });
   199→    if (!parsedBody.ok) {
   200→      return {
   201→        ok: false,
   202→        response: format === 'text'
   203→          ? buildErrorResponse(parsedBody.message, 400, 'text')
   204→          : parseJsonFailureResponse(parsedBody),
   205→      };
   206→    }
   207→    body = parsedBody.value;
   208→  }
   209→
   210→  let auth: AuthResult | null = null;
   211→  if (authIsRequired(options)) {
   212→    auth = await authenticateRequest(
   213→      req,
   214→      supabaseAdmin,
   215→      options.logPrefix,
   216→      options.auth?.options ?? {},
   217→    );
   218→    if (!auth.success) {
   219→      return {
   220→        ok: false,
   221→        response: buildErrorResponse(
   222→          auth.error || 'Authentication failed',
   223→          auth.statusCode || 401,
   224→          format,
   225→        ),
   226→      };
   227→    }
   228→
   229→    if (options.auth?.requireServiceRole && !auth.isServiceRole) {
   230→      return {
   231→        ok: false,
   232→        response: buildErrorResponse('Unauthorized - service role required', 403, format),
   233→      };
   234→    }
   235→  }
   236→
   237→  return {
   238→    ok: true,
   239→    value: {
   240→      req,
   241→      body: body as TBody,
   242→      supabaseAdmin,
   243→      logger,
   244→      auth,
   245→    },
   246→  };
   247→}
   248→
   249→function toErrorMessage(error: unknown): string {
   250→  if (error instanceof Error) {
   251→    return error.message;
   252→  }
   253→  return String(error);
   254→}
   255→
   256→/**
   257→ * High-level request wrapper that standardizes edge endpoint choreography:
   258→ * bootstrap -> handler -> unified unexpected-error response -> guaranteed flush.
   259→ */
   260→export async function withEdgeRequest<TBody extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>>(
   261→  req: Request,
   262→  options: EdgeBootstrapOptions,
   263→  handler: (context: EdgeRequestContext<TBody>) => Promise<Response>,
   264→): Promise<Response> {
   265→  const bootstrap = await bootstrapEdgeHandler<TBody>(req, options);
   266→  if (!bootstrap.ok) {
   267→    return bootstrap.response;
   268→  }
   269→
   270→  const context = bootstrap.value;
   271→  try {
   272→    return await handler(context);
   273→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   274→    context.logger.critical('Unexpected error', {
   275→      error: toErrorMessage(error),
   276→    });
   277→    return buildErrorResponse('Internal server error', 500, errorFormat(options));
   278→  } finally {
   279→    await context.logger.flush();
   280→  }
   281→}
   282→

   355→      onMouseLeave={useDesktopBehavior && isOpen && !isLocked ? handlePaneLeave : undefined}
   356→      {...containerEventHandlers}
   357→    >
   358→      {buttons.map(renderButton)}
   359→    </div>
   360→  );
   361→
   362→  return content;
   363→};
   364→
   365→export { PaneControlTab };
   366→
