```
1→import { isAbortError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errorUtils';
     2→
     3→// --- Timeline write logging ---
     4→
     5→type TimelineWritePhase = 'queued' | 'start' | 'end';
     6→
     7→interface TimelineWriteEventMeta {
     8→  shotId: string;
     9→  operation: string;
    10→  waitMs: number;
    11→  durationMs: number;
    12→  queueDepth: number;
    13→  requestId: number;
    14→  blockedByOperation?: string | null;
    15→  blockedByDurationMs?: number | null;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export type TimelineWriteEventHandler = (phase: TimelineWritePhase, meta: TimelineWriteEventMeta) => void;
    19→
    20→interface TimelineWriteLoggerOptions {
    21→  logPrefix: string;
    22→  log?: (...args: Parameters<typeof console.log>) => void;
    23→}
    24→
    25→function shortTimelineId(value: string | null | undefined): string | null {
    26→  return value ? value.slice(0, 8) : null;
    27→}
    28→
    29→/**
    30→ * Shared queue-phase logger for timeline write serialization.
    31→ * Keeps queue observability structure consistent across timeline hooks.
    32→ */
    33→export function createTimelineWriteQueueLogger(options: TimelineWriteLoggerOptions): TimelineWriteEventHandler {
    34→  const log = options.log ?? console.log;
    35→  return (phase, meta) => {
    36→    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    37→      shotId: shortTimelineId(meta.shotId),
    38→      requestId: meta.requestId,
    39→      operation: meta.operation,
    40→      waitMs: meta.waitMs,
    41→      queueDepth: meta.queueDepth,
    42→      blockedByOperation: meta.blockedByOperation ?? null,
    43→      blockedByDurationMs: meta.blockedByDurationMs ?? null,
    44→    };
    45→
    46→    if (phase !== 'start') {
    47→      payload.durationMs = meta.durationMs;
    48→    }
    49→
    50→    log(`${options.logPrefix} write queue ${phase}`, payload);
    51→  };
    52→}
    53→
    54→// --- Timeline write timeout ---
    55→
    56→const DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS = 15_000;
    57→const TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE = 'TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT';
    58→
    59→interface TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions {
    60→  timeoutMs?: number;
    61→  onTimeout?: (meta: { operation: string; timeoutMs: number; pendingMs: number }) => void;
    62→  upstreamSignal?: AbortSignal;
    63→}
    64→
    65→class TimelineWriteTimeoutError extends Error {
    66→  readonly code = TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE;
    67→
    68→  constructor(operation: string, timeoutMs: number, cause?: unknown) {
    69→    super(`Timeline write "${operation}" timed out after ${timeoutMs}ms`);
    70→    this.name = 'TimelineWriteTimeoutError';
    71→    if (cause !== undefined) {
    72→      (this as { cause?: unknown }).cause = cause;
    73→    }
    74→  }
    75→}
    76→
    77→export function isTimelineWriteTimeoutError(error: unknown): error is TimelineWriteTimeoutError {
    78→  return (
    79→    error instanceof TimelineWriteTimeoutError
    80→    || (
    81→      typeof error === 'object'
    82→      && error !== null
    83→      && 'code' in error
    84→      && (error as { code?: unknown }).code === TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_CODE
    85→    )
    86→  );
    87→}
    88→
    89→export async function runTimelineWriteWithTimeout<T>(
    90→  operation: string,
    91→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
    92→  options?: TimelineWriteTimeoutOptions,
    93→): Promise<T> {
    94→  const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_TIMELINE_WRITE_TIMEOUT_MS;
    95→  const startedAt = Date.now();
    96→  const controller = new AbortController();
    97→  let timedOut = false;
    98→  let abortedByUpstream = false;
    99→
   100→  const upstreamSignal = options?.upstreamSignal;
   101→  const handleUpstreamAbort = () => {
   102→    abortedByUpstream = true;
   103→    controller.abort();
   104→  };
   105→  if (upstreamSignal) {
   106→    if (upstreamSignal.aborted) {
   107→      handleUpstreamAbort();
   108→    } else {
   109→      upstreamSignal.addEventListener('abort', handleUpstreamAbort, { once: true });
   110→    }
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => {
   114→    timedOut = true;
   115→    options?.onTimeout?.({
   116→      operation,
   117→      timeoutMs,
   118→      pendingMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   119→    });
   120→    controller.abort();
   121→  }, timeoutMs);
   122→
   123→  try {
   124→    return await task(controller.signal);
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    if (timedOut || (abortedByUpstream && controller.signal.aborted) || (controller.signal.aborted && isAbortError(error))) {
   127→      throw new TimelineWriteTimeoutError(operation, timeoutMs, error);
   128→    }
   129→    throw error;
   130→  } finally {
   131→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
   132→    if (upstreamSignal) {
   133→      upstreamSignal.removeEventListener('abort', handleUpstreamAbort);
   134→    }
   135→  }
   136→}
   137→
   138→// --- Serialized timeline write queue ---
   139→
   140→const shotWriteTail = new Map<string, Promise<void>>();
   141→const shotWriteDepth = new Map<string, number>();
   142→const shotWriteActive = new Map<string, { requestId: number; operation: string; startedAt: number }>();
   143→let writeRequestCounter = 0;
   144→const DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
   145→
   146→interface TimelineSerializedWriteOptions {
   147→  timeoutMs?: number;
   148→  onTimeout?: (meta: {
   149→    shotId: string;
   150→    operation: string;
   151→    timeoutMs: number;
   152→    pendingMs: number;
   153→    requestId: number;
   154→  }) => void;
   155→}
   156→
   157→/**
   158→ * Returns true if any serialized timeline write is active or queued for the
   159→ * given shot. Both the timeline drag path and the batch editor path go through
   160→ * runSerializedTimelineWrite, so this covers all writes across both paths.
   161→ * Used by useTimelinePositions.syncFromDatabase to suppress stale syncs while
   162→ * the batch editor is writing (the batch editor does not set isLockedRef, so
   163→ * without this check a background refetch during the midpoint RPC would snap
   164→ * positions back to pre-edit values).
   165→ */
   166→export function isTimelineWriteActive(shotId: string): boolean {
   167→  return (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) > 0;
   168→}
   169→
   170→/**
   171→ * Serialize timeline writes per shot to avoid overlapping updates from
   172→ * different UI flows (batch reorder, timeline drag, etc.).
   173→ */
   174→export async function runSerializedTimelineWrite<T>(
   175→  shotId: string,
   176→  operation: string,
   177→  task: (signal: AbortSignal) => Promise<T>,
   178→  onEvent?: TimelineWriteEventHandler,
   179→  options?: TimelineSerializedWriteOptions,
   180→): Promise<T> {
   181→  const requestId = ++writeRequestCounter;
   182→  const queuedAt = Date.now();
   183→  const previousTail = shotWriteTail.get(shotId) ?? Promise.resolve();
   184→  const nextDepth = (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 0) + 1;
   185→  shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, nextDepth);
   186→  const blockedBy = shotWriteActive.get(shotId);
   187→  const blockedByDurationMs = blockedBy ? Math.max(0, queuedAt - blockedBy.startedAt) : null;
   188→
   189→  onEvent?.('queued', {
   190→    shotId,
   191→    operation,
   192→    waitMs: 0,
   193→    durationMs: 0,
   194→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, nextDepth - 1),
   195→    requestId,
   196→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   197→    blockedByDurationMs,
   198→  });
   199→
   200→  let releaseTail!: () => void;
   201→  const currentTail = new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
   202→    releaseTail = resolve;
   203→  });
   204→
   205→  const chainedTail = previousTail.catch(() => undefined).then(() => currentTail);
   206→  shotWriteTail.set(shotId, chainedTail);
   207→
   208→  await previousTail.catch(() => undefined);
   209→
   210→  const startedAt = Date.now();
   211→  shotWriteActive.set(shotId, {
   212→    requestId,
   213→    operation,
   214→    startedAt,
   215→  });
   216→  onEvent?.('start', {
   217→    shotId,
   218→    operation,
   219→    waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   220→    durationMs: 0,
   221→    queueDepth: Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1),
   222→    requestId,
   223→    blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   224→    blockedByDurationMs,
   225→  });
   226→
   227→  try {
   228→    const timeoutMs = options?.timeoutMs ?? DEFAULT_SERIALIZED_TIMELINE_TASK_TIMEOUT_MS;
   229→    return await runTimelineWriteWithTimeout(
   230→      operation,
   231→      task,
   232→      {
   233→        timeoutMs,
   234→        onTimeout: ({ pendingMs }) => {
   235→          options?.onTimeout?.({
   236→            shotId,
   237→            operation,
   238→            timeoutMs,
   239→            pendingMs,
   240→            requestId,
   241→          });
   242→        },
   243→      },
   244→    );
   245→  } finally {
   246→    releaseTail();
   247→
   248→    const remainingDepth = Math.max(0, (shotWriteDepth.get(shotId) ?? 1) - 1);
   249→    if (remainingDepth === 0) {
   250→      shotWriteDepth.delete(shotId);
   251→    } else {
   252→      shotWriteDepth.set(shotId, remainingDepth);
   253→    }
   254→
   255→    if (shotWriteTail.get(shotId) === chainedTail) {
   256→      shotWriteTail.delete(shotId);
   257→    }
   258→    if (shotWriteActive.get(shotId)?.requestId === requestId) {
   259→      shotWriteActive.delete(shotId);
   260→    }
   261→
   262→    onEvent?.('end', {
   263→      shotId,
   264→      operation,
   265→      waitMs: startedAt - queuedAt,
   266→      durationMs: Date.now() - startedAt,
   267→      queueDepth: Math.max(0, remainingDepth - 1),
   268→      requestId,
   269→      blockedByOperation: blockedBy?.operation ?? null,
   270→      blockedByDurationMs,
   271→    });
   272→  }
   273→}
```

```
     5→/**
     6→ * Check if an error is retryable (network-related but not auth/server errors)
     7→ * @internal - only used within this file

     9→function isRetryableNetworkError(err: unknown): boolean {
    10→  const message = (err as Error)?.message?.toLowerCase() || '';

    14→    message.includes('network error') ||

    18→  const isServerError = message.includes('unauthorized') ||
    19→    message.includes('forbidden') ||
    20→    message.includes('not found') ||
    21→    message.includes('quota') ||
    22→    status === 401 ||
    23→    status === 403 ||
    24→    status === 404;
    25→
    26→  return isNetworkError && !isServerError;
    27→}
```

```
    14→      ...mergeProps(props, child.props),
    15→      ref: forwardedRef ? composeRefs(forwardedRef, child.ref) : child.ref,
    16→    } as Record<string, unknown>);
    17→  }
    18→);
    19→
    20→Slot.displayName = 'Slot';

    22→function mergeProps(
    23→  slotProps: Record<string, unknown>,
    24→  childProps: Record<string, unknown>
    25→): Record<string, unknown> {
    26→  const overrideProps: Record<string, unknown> = { ...childProps };
    27→
    28→  for (const propName in childProps) {
    29→    const slotPropValue = slotProps[propName];
    30→    const childPropValue = childProps[propName];
    31→
    32→    const isHandler = /^on[A-Z]/.test(propName);
    33→    if (isHandler) {
    34→      if (typeof slotPropValue === 'function' && typeof childPropValue === 'function') {
    35→        overrideProps[propName] = (...args: unknown[]) => {
    36→          (childPropValue as (...eventArgs: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
    37→          (slotPropValue as (...eventArgs: unknown[]) => void)(...args);
    38→        };
    39→      } else if (typeof slotPropValue === 'function') {
    40→        overrideProps[propName] = slotPropValue;
    41→      }
    42→    } else if (propName === 'style') {
    43→      const slotStyle = typeof slotPropValue === 'object' && slotPropValue ? slotPropValue : {};
    44→      const childStyle = typeof childPropValue === 'object' && childPropValue ? childPropValue : {};
    45→      overrideProps[propName] = { ...slotStyle, ...childStyle };
    46→    } else if (propName === 'className') {
    47→      overrideProps[propName] = [slotPropValue, childPropValue].filter(Boolean).join(' ');
    48→    }
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  return { ...slotProps, ...overrideProps };
    52→}
    53→
    54→function composeRefs<T>(...refs: (React.Ref<T> | undefined | null)[]): React.RefCallback<T> {
    55→  return (node) => {
    56→    refs.forEach((ref) => {
    57→      if (typeof ref === 'function') {
    58→        ref(node);
    59→      } else if (ref != null) {
    60→        (ref as React.MutableRefObject<T | null>).current = node;
    61→      }
    62→    });
    63→  };
    64→}

    66→export { Slot };
```

```
    24→type RawEventCallback = (event: RawDatabaseEvent) => void;
    25→export class RealtimeConnection {
    26→  private channel: RealtimeChannel | null = null;
    27→  private state: ConnectionState = { ...INITIAL_CONNECTION_STATE };
    28→  private config: RealtimeConfig;

    30→  private subscribeTimeout: NodeJS.Timeout | null = null;
    31→  private statusCallbacks = new Set<ConnectionStatusCallback>();
    32→  private eventCallbacks = new Set<RawEventCallback>();
    33→  private unsubAuthHeal: (() => void) | null = null;
    34→  private activeConnectSequence = 0;
    35→  private connectInFlight: Promise<boolean> | null = null;
    36→  private connectInFlightProjectId: string | null = null;
    37→  constructor(config: Partial<RealtimeConfig> = {}) {

    39→    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    40→      this.unsubAuthHeal = listenAppEvent('realtime:auth-heal', () => this.handleAuthHeal());
    41→    }

    43→  /**
    44→   * Connect to a project's realtime channel.
    45→   * If already connected to a different project, disconnects first.
    46→   */
    47→  async connect(projectId: string): Promise<boolean> {
    48→    if (this.state.projectId === projectId && this.state.status === 'connected') {
    49→      return true;
    50→    }
    51→    if (this.state.projectId && this.state.projectId !== projectId) {

    56→  /**

    71→    this.setState({

    74→      error: null,
    75→      reconnectAttempt: 0,

    80→  /**

    86→  /**

    94→  /**

   101→  /**

   104→  reset(): void {

   121→  private startConnect(projectId: string): Promise<boolean> {
   122→    if (this.connectInFlight && this.connectInFlightProjectId === projectId) {
   123→      return this.connectInFlight;
   124→    }
   125→    this.clearTimeouts();
   126→    const connectSequence = this.activeConnectSequence + 1;
   127→    this.activeConnectSequence = connectSequence;
   128→    const connectPromise = this.doConnect(projectId, connectSequence);
   129→    this.connectInFlight = connectPromise;
   130→    this.connectInFlightProjectId = projectId;
   131→    void connectPromise.finally(() => {

   134→        this.connectInFlightProjectId = null;

   139→  private isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence: number): boolean {
   140→    return connectSequence === this.activeConnectSequence;

   142→  private async doConnect(projectId: string, connectSequence: number): Promise<boolean> {
   143→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   144→      return false;
   145→    }
   146→    this.setState({
   147→      status: 'connecting',
   148→      projectId,
   149→      error: null,
   150→      reconnectAttempt: 0,
   151→      nextRetryAt: null,
   152→    });
   153→    try {
   154→      const { data: { session }, error: sessionError } = await getSupabaseClient().auth.getSession();
   155→      if (sessionError || !session?.user) {

   157→        normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(errorMsg), {
   158→          context: 'RealtimeConnection.authCheck',
   159→          showToast: false,
   160→          logData: {
   161→            hasSession: !!session,
   162→            hasUser: !!session?.user,
   163→          },
   164→        });
   165→        this.setState({
   166→          status: 'failed',
   167→          error: errorMsg,
   168→        });
   169→        dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', errorMsg);
   170→        return false;
   171→      }
   172→      if (session.access_token) {
   173→        getSupabaseClient().realtime.setAuth(session.access_token);
   174→      }

   176→      const errorMsg = error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Auth check failed';
   177→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
   178→        context: 'RealtimeConnection.authSessionFetch',
   179→        showToast: false,
   180→      });
   181→      this.setState({
   182→        status: 'failed',
   183→        error: errorMsg,
   184→      });
   185→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', errorMsg);
   186→      return false;
   187→    }
   188→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   189→      return false;
   190→    }
   191→    const topic = `task-updates:${projectId}`;
   192→    const channel = getSupabaseClient().channel(topic);
   193→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   194→      void channel.unsubscribe().catch(() => {
   195→      });
   196→      return false;
   197→    }
   198→    this.channel = channel;
   199→    this.setupEventHandlers(projectId, channel);
   200→    return new Promise((resolve) => {
   201→      let settled = false;
   202→      const settle = (result: boolean) => {
   203→        if (settled) {
   204→          return;
   205→        }
   206→        settled = true;
   207→        resolve(result);
   208→      };
   209→      const subscribeTimeout = setTimeout(() => {
   210→        if (this.subscribeTimeout === subscribeTimeout) {
   211→          this.subscribeTimeout = null;
   212→        }
   213→        if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   214→          settle(false);
   215→          return;
   216→        }
   217→        this.handleSubscribeFailure('Timeout', projectId, connectSequence);
   218→        settle(false);
   219→      }, this.config.subscribeTimeout);
   220→      this.subscribeTimeout = subscribeTimeout;
   221→      channel.subscribe((status: string) => {
   222→        if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   223→          void channel.unsubscribe().catch(() => {
   224→          });
   225→          return;
   226→        }
   227→        if (this.subscribeTimeout === subscribeTimeout) {
   228→          clearTimeout(subscribeTimeout);
   229→          this.subscribeTimeout = null;
   230→        }
   231→        if (status === 'SUBSCRIBED') {
   232→          this.setState({
   233→            status: 'connected',
   234→            error: null,
   235→            reconnectAttempt: 0,
   236→            nextRetryAt: null,
   237→          });
   238→          dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('connected', 'Connected');
   239→          settle(true);
   240→        } else if (status === 'CHANNEL_ERROR' || status === 'TIMED_OUT') {
   241→          this.handleSubscribeFailure(status, projectId, connectSequence);
   242→          settle(false);
   243→        }
   244→      });
   245→    });

   247→  private setupEventHandlers(projectId: string, channel: RealtimeChannel): void {
   248→    channel
   249→      .on('postgres_changes',
   250→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'tasks', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   251→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('tasks', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   252→      )
   253→      .on('postgres_changes',
   254→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'tasks', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   255→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('tasks', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   256→      );
   257→    channel
   258→      .on('postgres_changes',
   259→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'generations', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   260→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generations', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   261→      )
   262→      .on('postgres_changes',
   263→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'generations', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   264→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generations', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   265→      )
   266→      .on('postgres_changes',
   267→        { event: 'DELETE', schema: 'public', table: 'generations', filter: `project_id=eq.${projectId}` },
   268→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generations', 'DELETE', payload.old, null)
   269→      );
   270→    channel
   271→      .on('postgres_changes',
   272→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'shot_generations' },
   273→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('shot_generations', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   274→      )
   275→      .on('postgres_changes',
   276→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'shot_generations' },
   277→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('shot_generations', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   278→      )
   279→      .on('postgres_changes',
   280→        { event: 'DELETE', schema: 'public', table: 'shot_generations' },
   281→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('shot_generations', 'DELETE', payload.old, null)
   282→      );
   283→    channel
   284→      .on('postgres_changes',
   285→        { event: 'INSERT', schema: 'public', table: 'generation_variants' },
   286→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generation_variants', 'INSERT', payload.new, null)
   287→      )
   288→      .on('postgres_changes',
   289→        { event: 'UPDATE', schema: 'public', table: 'generation_variants' },
   290→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generation_variants', 'UPDATE', payload.new, payload.old)
   291→      )
   292→      .on('postgres_changes',
   293→        { event: 'DELETE', schema: 'public', table: 'generation_variants' },
   294→        (payload) => this.emitEvent('generation_variants', 'DELETE', payload.old, null)
   295→      );
   296→  }
   297→  private emitEvent(
   298→    table: DatabaseTable,
   299→    eventType: DatabaseEventType,
   300→    newRecord: unknown,
   301→    oldRecord: unknown
   302→  ): void {
   303→    const event: RawDatabaseEvent = {
   304→      table,
   305→      eventType,
   306→      new: newRecord as Record<string, unknown>,
   307→      old: oldRecord as Partial<Record<string, unknown>> | null,
   308→      receivedAt: Date.now(),
   309→    };
   310→    this.eventCallbacks.forEach((callback) => {
   311→      try {
   312→        callback(event);
   313→      } catch (error) {
   314→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'RealtimeConnection.eventCallback', showToast: false });
   315→      }
   316→    });
   317→  }
   318→  private handleSubscribeFailure(reason: string, projectId: string, connectSequence: number): void {
   319→    if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(connectSequence)) {
   320→      return;
   321→    }
   322→    const attempt = this.state.reconnectAttempt + 1;
   323→    const isExhausted = attempt > this.config.maxReconnectAttempts;
   324→    if (isExhausted) {
   325→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Max reconnect attempts reached'), {
   326→        context: 'RealtimeConnection.handleSubscribeFailure',
   327→        showToast: false,
   328→        logData: { reason, attempt, maxReconnectAttempts: this.config.maxReconnectAttempts },
   329→      });
   330→      this.setState({
   331→        status: 'failed',
   332→        error: `Connection failed after ${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts} attempts: ${reason}`,
   333→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   334→        nextRetryAt: null,
   335→      });
   336→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', 'Max reconnect attempts reached');
   337→    } else {
   338→      const delay = Math.min(
   339→        this.config.baseReconnectDelay * Math.pow(2, attempt - 1),
   340→        this.config.maxReconnectDelay
   341→      );
   342→      const nextRetryAt = Date.now() + delay;
   343→      console.warn(
   344→        `[RealtimeConnection] Subscribe failed: ${reason}. ` +
   345→        `Retrying in ${delay}ms (attempt ${attempt}/${this.config.maxReconnectAttempts})`
   346→      );
   347→      this.setState({
   348→        status: 'reconnecting',
   349→        error: reason,
   350→        reconnectAttempt: attempt,
   351→        nextRetryAt,
   352→      });
   353→      dataFreshnessManager.onRealtimeStatusChange('error', `Reconnecting: ${reason}`);
   354→      this.scheduleReconnect(projectId, delay, connectSequence);
   355→    }
   356→  }
   357→  private scheduleReconnect(projectId: string, delay: number, failedConnectSequence: number): void {
   358→    this.clearTimeouts();
   359→    this.reconnectTimeout = setTimeout(async () => {
   360→      this.reconnectTimeout = null;
   361→      if (!this.isCurrentConnectAttempt(failedConnectSequence)) {
   362→        return;
   363→      }
   364→      if (this.channel) {
   365→        try {
   366→          await this.channel.unsubscribe();
   367→        } catch {
   368→        }
   369→        this.channel = null;
   370→      }
   371→      await this.startConnect(projectId);
   372→    }, delay);
   373→  }
   374→  private handleAuthHeal = (): void => {
   375→    if (
   376→      this.state.projectId &&
   377→      (this.state.status === 'reconnecting' || this.state.status === 'failed')
   378→    ) {
   379→      this.setState({ reconnectAttempt: 0 });
   380→      void this.startConnect(this.state.projectId);
   381→    }
   382→  };
   383→  private setState(updates: Partial<ConnectionState>): void {
   384→    const prevStatus = this.state.status;
   385→    this.state = {
   386→      ...this.state,
   387→      ...updates,
   388→      statusChangedAt: updates.status && updates.status !== prevStatus
   389→        ? Date.now()
   390→        : this.state.statusChangedAt,
   391→    };
   392→    const snapshot = this.getState();
   393→    this.statusCallbacks.forEach((callback) => {
   394→      try {
   395→        callback(snapshot);
   396→      } catch (error) {
   397→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'RealtimeConnection.statusCallback', showToast: false });
   398→      }
   399→    });
   400→  }
   401→  private clearTimeouts(): void {
   402→    if (this.reconnectTimeout) {
   403→      clearTimeout(this.reconnectTimeout);
   404→      this.reconnectTimeout = null;
   405→    }
   406→    if (this.subscribeTimeout) {
   407→      clearTimeout(this.subscribeTimeout);
   408→      this.subscribeTimeout = null;
   409→    }
   410→  }
   411→}
   412→let realtimeConnectionInstance: RealtimeConnection | null = null;
   413→/**
   414→ * Lazily create the app-wide realtime connection instance.
   415→ *
   416→ * Avoiding eager module-level construction prevents constructor side effects
   417→ * from being tied to import order.
   418→ */
   419→export function getRealtimeConnection(): RealtimeConnection {

   422→  }
   423→  return realtimeConnectionInstance;
   424→}

   427→  if (realtimeConnectionInstance) {

   429→  }

   431→}
```

```
1→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     2→
     3→type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
     4→type SettingsScopeTableName = 'users' | 'projects' | 'shots';
     5→
     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';
    12→    case 'shot':
    13→      return 'shots';
    14→  }
    15→}
    16→
    17→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    18→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    19→  return getSupabaseClient()
    20→    .from(tableName)
    21→    .select('settings')
    22→    .eq('id', id)
    23→    .single();
    24→}
    25→
    26→export function callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc(
    27→  tableName: SettingsScopeTableName,
    28→  id: string,
    29→  toolId: string,
    30→  settings: Record<string, unknown>,
    31→) {
    32→  return getSupabaseClient().rpc('update_tool_settings_atomic', {
    33→    p_table_name: tableName,
    34→    p_id: id,
    35→    p_tool_id: toolId,
    36→    p_settings: settings,
    37→  });
    38→}
    39→
```

```
1→/**
     2→ * Centralized storage path utilities for Edge Functions
     3→ * 
     4→ * This is a copy of src/shared/lib/storagePaths.ts for use in Deno edge functions.
     5→ * Keep these in sync when making changes!
     6→ * 
     7→ * Path Structure:
     8→ *   {userId}/uploads/         - All media files (images + videos)
     9→ *   {userId}/thumbnails/      - All generated thumbnails
    10→ *   {userId}/tasks/{taskId}/  - Task/worker outputs via pre-signed URLs
    11→ */
    12→
    13→/**
    14→ * Generate a unique filename with timestamp and random string
    15→ */
    16→export function generateUniqueFilename(extension: string): string {
    17→  const timestamp = Date.now();
    18→  const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 10);
    19→  return `${timestamp}-${randomStr}.${extension}`;
    20→}
    21→
    22→/**
    23→ * Generate a unique thumbnail filename
    24→ */
    25→export function generateThumbnailFilename(): string {
    26→  const timestamp = Date.now();
    27→  const randomStr = Math.random().toString(36).substring(2, 8);
    28→  return `thumb_${timestamp}_${randomStr}.jpg`;
    29→}
    30→
    31→/**
    32→ * Get file extension from filename, with MIME type fallback
    33→ */
    34→export function getFileExtension(
    35→  filename: string,
    36→  mimeType?: string,
    37→  defaultExt: string = 'bin'
    38→): string {
    39→  // Handle URLs and query/hash suffixes from signed object paths.
    40→  const cleanName = filename
    41→    .split('?')[0]
    42→    .split('#')[0]
    43→    .split('/')
    44→    .pop() ?? filename;
    45→  const dotIndex = cleanName.lastIndexOf('.');
    46→  if (dotIndex > 0 && dotIndex < cleanName.length - 1) {
    47→    return cleanName.slice(dotIndex + 1).toLowerCase();
    48→  }
    49→  
    50→  // Fallback to MIME type
    51→  if (mimeType) {
    52→    const mimeExt = mimeType.split('/')[1]?.split(';')[0]?.replace('jpeg', 'jpg');
    53→    if (mimeExt) return mimeExt;
    54→  }
    55→  
    56→  return defaultExt;
    57→}
    58→
    59→/**
    60→ * Storage path builders - all paths are user-namespaced for security

    66→  upload: (userId: string, filename: string): string =>
```

```
1→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/runtime/sonner';
     3→import type { PromptEntry } from '../../types';
     4→import type { PromptRoutingResult } from './types';
     5→import { isAutoGeneratedShortPrompt, toShortPrompt } from '../../lib/promptUtils';
     6→
     7→interface PromptHandlersInput {
     8→  prompts: PromptEntry[];
     9→  setPrompts: PromptRoutingResult['setPrompts'];
    10→  markAsInteracted: () => void;
    11→  generatePromptId: () => string;
    12→}
    13→
    14→export function usePromptHandlers(input: PromptHandlersInput) {
    15→  const { prompts, setPrompts, markAsInteracted, generatePromptId } = input;
    16→
    17→  const handleAddPrompt = useCallback(() => {
    18→    markAsInteracted();
    19→    const newPrompt = {
    20→      id: generatePromptId(),
    21→      fullPrompt: '',
    22→      shortPrompt: `Prompt ${prompts.length + 1}`,
    23→    };
    24→
    25→    setPrompts((prev) => [...prev, newPrompt]);
    26→  }, [markAsInteracted, generatePromptId, prompts.length, setPrompts]);
    27→
    28→  const handleUpdatePrompt = useCallback(
    29→    (id: string, field: 'fullPrompt' | 'shortPrompt', value: string) => {
    30→      markAsInteracted();
    31→
    32→      setPrompts((prev) =>
    33→        prev.map((prompt) => {
    34→          if (prompt.id !== id) {
    35→            return prompt;
    36→          }
    37→
    38→          const updatedPrompt = { ...prompt, [field]: value };
    39→          if (
    40→            field === 'fullPrompt' &&
    41→            isAutoGeneratedShortPrompt(updatedPrompt.shortPrompt, prompt.fullPrompt)
    42→          ) {
    43→            updatedPrompt.shortPrompt = toShortPrompt(value);
    44→          }
    45→
    46→          return updatedPrompt;
    47→        })
    48→      );
    49→    },
    50→    [markAsInteracted, setPrompts]
    51→  );
    52→
    53→  const handleRemovePrompt = useCallback(
    54→    (id: string) => {
    55→      markAsInteracted();
    56→
    57→      if (prompts.length <= 1) {
    58→        toast.error('Cannot remove the last prompt.');
    59→        return;
    60→      }
    61→
    62→      setPrompts((prev) => prev.filter((prompt) => prompt.id !== id));
    63→    },
    64→    [markAsInteracted, prompts.length, setPrompts]
    65→  );
    66→
    67→  const handleDeleteAllPrompts = useCallback(() => {
    68→    markAsInteracted();
    69→    setPrompts([{ id: generatePromptId(), fullPrompt: '', shortPrompt: 'Prompt 1' }]);
    70→  }, [markAsInteracted, generatePromptId, setPrompts]);
    71→
    72→  const handleSavePromptsFromModal = useCallback(
    73→    (updatedPrompts: PromptEntry[]) => {
    74→      markAsInteracted();
    75→
    76→      const seenIds = new Set<string>();
    77→      const sanitizedPrompts = updatedPrompts.map((prompt) => {
    78→        let id = prompt.id && !seenIds.has(prompt.id) ? prompt.id : '';
    79→        if (!id) {
    80→          id = generatePromptId();
    81→        }
    82→
    83→        seenIds.add(id);
    84→
    85→        return {
    86→          ...prompt,
    87→          id,
    88→          shortPrompt: prompt.shortPrompt || toShortPrompt(prompt.fullPrompt),
    89→        };
    90→      });
    91→
    92→      setPrompts(sanitizedPrompts);
    93→    },
    94→    [markAsInteracted, generatePromptId, setPrompts]
    95→  );
    96→
    97→  return {
    98→    handleAddPrompt,
    99→    handleUpdatePrompt,
   100→    handleRemovePrompt,
   101→    handleDeleteAllPrompts,
   102→    handleSavePromptsFromModal,
   103→  };
   104→}
   105→
```

```
1→// deno-lint-ignore-file
     2→/**
     3→ * System Logger for Edge Functions
     4→ *
     5→ * Logs to both console (for immediate visibility) AND system_logs table (for persistence/querying).
     6→ * Uses a buffer pattern to batch database writes for efficiency.
     7→ *
     8→ * Usage:
     9→ *   const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, 'my-function-name');
    10→ *   logger.info('Processing request', { task_id, shot_id });
    11→ *   logger.error('Something failed', { task_id, error: err.message });
    12→ *   await logger.flush(); // Call before returning response
    13→ */
    14→
    15→import type { SupabaseClient } from './supabaseClient.ts';
    16→
    17→type LogLevel = 'DEBUG' | 'INFO' | 'WARNING' | 'ERROR' | 'CRITICAL';
    18→
    19→interface LogContext {
    20→  task_id?: string;
    21→  shot_id?: string;
    22→  user_id?: string;
    23→  [key: string]: unknown;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface BufferedLog {
    27→  timestamp: string;
    28→  source_type: string;
    29→  source_id: string;
    30→  log_level: LogLevel;
    31→  message: string;
    32→  task_id: string | null;
    33→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>;
    34→}
    35→
    36→export class SystemLogger {
    37→  private supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient;
    38→  private functionName: string;
    39→  private logPrefix: string;
    40→  private logBuffer: BufferedLog[] = [];
    41→  private defaultTaskId: string | null = null;
    42→
    43→  constructor(supabaseAdmin: SupabaseClient, functionName: string, defaultTaskId?: string) {
    44→    this.supabaseAdmin = supabaseAdmin;
    45→    this.functionName = functionName;
    46→    this.logPrefix = `[${functionName.toUpperCase()}]`;
    47→    this.defaultTaskId = defaultTaskId || null;
    48→  }
    49→
    50→  /**
    51→   * Set a default task_id that will be used for all subsequent logs
    52→   * Useful when you learn the task_id after construction
    53→   */
    54→  setDefaultTaskId(taskId: string | null) {
    55→    this.defaultTaskId = taskId;
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  private addToBuffer(level: LogLevel, message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    59→    const { task_id, ...metadata } = context || {};
    60→    
    61→    this.logBuffer.push({
    62→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
    63→      source_type: 'edge_function',
    64→      source_id: this.functionName,
    65→      log_level: level,
    66→      message,
    67→      task_id: task_id || this.defaultTaskId,
    68→      metadata
    69→    });
    70→  }
    71→
    72→  debug(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    73→    console.log(`${this.logPrefix} ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    74→    this.addToBuffer('DEBUG', message, context);
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  info(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    78→    console.log(`${this.logPrefix} ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    79→    this.addToBuffer('INFO', message, context);
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  warn(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    83→    console.warn(`${this.logPrefix} ⚠️ ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    84→    this.addToBuffer('WARNING', message, context);
    85→  }
    86→
    87→  error(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    88→    console.error(`${this.logPrefix} ❌ ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    89→    this.addToBuffer('ERROR', message, context);
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  critical(message: string, context?: LogContext) {
    93→    console.error(`${this.logPrefix} 🔥 CRITICAL: ${message}`, context ? JSON.stringify(context) : '');
    94→    this.addToBuffer('CRITICAL', message, context);
    95→  }
    96→
    97→  /**
    98→   * Flush all buffered logs to the database
    99→   * Call this before returning your response!
   100→   */
   101→  async flush(): Promise<{ inserted: number; errors: number }> {
   102→    if (this.logBuffer.length === 0) {
   103→      return { inserted: 0, errors: 0 };
   104→    }
   105→
   106→    try {
   107→      const { data, error } = await this.supabaseAdmin
   108→        .rpc('func_insert_logs_batch', { logs: this.logBuffer });
   109→
   110→      if (error) {
   111→        console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Failed to flush ${this.logBuffer.length} logs to database:`, error.message);
   112→        // Don't clear buffer on error - logs are lost but at least console has them
   113→        return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   114→      }
   115→
   116→      const result = data || { inserted: this.logBuffer.length, errors: 0 };
   117→      const bufferSize = this.logBuffer.length;
   118→      this.logBuffer = []; // Clear buffer after successful flush
   119→      
   120→      console.log(`${this.logPrefix} Flushed ${bufferSize} logs to database`);
   121→      return { inserted: result.inserted || bufferSize, errors: result.errors || 0 };
   122→    } catch (e: unknown) {
   123→      console.error(`${this.logPrefix} Exception flushing logs:`, e?.message || e);
   124→      return { inserted: 0, errors: this.logBuffer.length };
   125→    }
   126→  }
   127→
   128→  /**
   129→   * Get the current buffer size (useful for debugging)
   130→   */
   131→  getBufferSize(): number {
   132→    return this.logBuffer.length;
   133→  }
   134→}
   135→
```

```
1→export function getStoredPromptCount(effectiveShotId: string): number {
     2→  try {
     3→    if (typeof window !== 'undefined') {
     4→      const shotSpecificKey = `ig:lastPromptCount:${effectiveShotId}`;
     5→      const stored =
     6→        window.sessionStorage.getItem(shotSpecificKey) ||
     7→        window.sessionStorage.getItem('ig:lastPromptCount');
     8→
     9→      const parsed = stored ? Number.parseInt(stored, 10) : 1;
    10→      return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? parsed : 1;
    11→    }
    12→  } catch {
    13→    // Ignore sessionStorage errors.
    14→  }
    15→
    16→  return 1;
    17→}
```

```
1→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import type { Dispatch, SetStateAction } from 'react';
     3→import type { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
     4→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     5→import {
     6→  operationFailure,
     7→  operationSuccess,
     8→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
     9→import {
    10→  deleteSegmentGenerationGroup,
    11→  syncSegmentDeletionCaches,
    12→} from '../services/segmentDeletionService';
    13→
    14→interface SegmentDeleteOperationResult {
    15→  deleted: boolean;
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function useDeleteSegmentHandler(
    19→  queryClient: ReturnType<typeof useQueryClient>,
    20→  setDeletingSegmentId: Dispatch<SetStateAction<string | null>>,
    21→  projectId?: string,
    22→) {
    23→  return useCallback(async (generationId: string) => {
    24→    if (!projectId) {
    25→      return operationFailure(new Error('Project scope is required for segment deletion'), {
    26→        policy: 'fail_closed',
    27→        recoverable: false,
    28→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_missing_project_scope',
    29→        message: 'Project scope is required for segment deletion',
    30→      });
    31→    }
    32→
    33→    setDeletingSegmentId(generationId);
    34→    try {
    35→      const deletion = await deleteSegmentGenerationGroup({
    36→        generationId,
    37→        projectId,
    38→      });
    39→
    40→      if (!deletion.deleted) {
    41→        return operationSuccess(
    42→          { deleted: false } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    43→          { policy: 'best_effort' },
    44→        );
    45→      }
    46→
    47→      await syncSegmentDeletionCaches({
    48→        queryClient,
    49→        projectId,
    50→        parentGenerationId: deletion.parentGenerationId,
    51→        idsToDelete: deletion.idsToDelete,
    52→      });
    53→
    54→      return operationSuccess(
    55→        { deleted: true } satisfies SegmentDeleteOperationResult,
    56→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
    57→      );
    58→    } catch (error) {
    59→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, {
    60→        context: 'SegmentDelete',
    61→        toastTitle: 'Failed to delete segment',
    62→      });
    63→      return operationFailure(error, {
    64→        policy: 'best_effort',
    65→        recoverable: true,
    66→        errorCode: 'shot_editor_segment_delete_failed',
    67→        message: 'Failed to delete segment',
    68→      });
    69→    } finally {
    70→      setDeletingSegmentId(null);
    71→    }
    72→  }, [projectId, queryClient, setDeletingSegmentId]);
    73→}
    74→
```

```
   193→            usage: data.usage,
   194→          });
   195→        } catch (fetchError: unknown) {
   196→          const message = fetchError instanceof Error ? fetchError.message : String(fetchError);
   197→          console.error(`[ai-prompt] OpenAI fetch error:`, message);
   198→          return jsonResponse({ error: "Failed to call OpenAI API", details: message }, 500);
   199→        }
   200→      }
   201→      default:
   202→        return jsonResponse({ error: `Unknown task: ${task}` }, 400);
   203→    }
   204→  } catch (err: unknown) {
   205→    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
   206→    console.error(`[ai-prompt] Error handling task ${task}:`, message);
   207→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Internal server error", details: message }, 500);
   208→  }
   209→}); 
   210→
```

```
   194→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
   195→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
   196→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
   197→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
   198→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
   199→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
   200→};
   201→
   202→interface VideoEnhanceResult {
   203→  interpolation_compute_seconds?: number;
   204→  output_width?: number;
   205→  output_height?: number;
   206→  output_frames?: number;
   207→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   208→}
   209→
   210→interface VideoEnhanceBreakdown {
   211→  interpolation?: { compute_seconds: number; cost_per_second: number; cost: number };
   212→  upscale?: { output_width: number; output_height: number; output_frames: number; megapixels: number; cost_per_megapixel: number; cost: number };
   213→}
   214→
   215→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
   216→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
   217→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: VideoEnhanceResult): { cost: number; breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   218→  let totalCost = 0;
   219→  const breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown = {};
   220→
   221→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
   222→  const result = taskParams?.result || taskParams;
   223→
   224→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
   225→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
   226→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
   227→    totalCost += filmCost;
   228→    breakdown.interpolation = {
   229→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
   230→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
   231→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   232→    };
   233→  }
   234→
   235→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
   236→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
   237→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
   238→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
   239→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
   240→    breakdown.upscale = {
   241→      output_width: result.output_width,
   242→      output_height: result.output_height,
   243→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
   244→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
   245→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
   246→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   247→    };
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  return {
   251→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   252→    breakdown,
   253→  };
   254→}
   255→
   256→interface CostFactors {
   257→  resolution?: Record<string, number>;
   258→  frameCount?: number;
   259→  modelType?: Record<string, number>;
   260→}
   261→
   262→interface TaskCostParams {
   263→  resolution?: string;
   264→  frame_count?: number;
   265→  model_type?: string;
   266→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   267→  [key: string]: unknown;
   268→}
   269→
   270→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
   271→export function calculateTaskCost(
   272→  taskType: string,
   273→  billingType: string,
   274→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
   275→  unitCost: number,
   276→  durationSeconds: number,
   277→  costFactors: CostFactors | null,
   278→  taskParams: TaskCostParams
   279→): { cost: number; breakdown?: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   280→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
   281→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   282→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
   283→  }
   284→
   285→  let totalCost;
   286→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   287→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
   288→  } else {
   289→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   290→  }
   291→
   292→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
   293→  if (costFactors) {
   294→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
   295→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
   296→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
   297→    }
   298→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   299→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   300→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   301→      } else {
   302→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   303→      }
   304→    }
   305→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   306→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   307→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   308→    }
   309→  }
   310→
   311→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   312→}
   313→
```

```
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  const modelType = asString(record.model_type);
    59→  if (modelType) {
    60→    parsed.model_type = modelType;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const result = asObjectRecord(record.result);
    64→  if (result) {
    65→    parsed.result = result as VideoEnhanceResult;
    66→  }
    67→
    68→  for (const [key, rawValue] of Object.entries(record)) {
    69→    // Never re-inject known billing keys unless they pass explicit normalization.
    70→    if (key === 'resolution' || key === 'frame_count' || key === 'model_type' || key === 'result') {
    71→      continue;
    72→    }
    73→    parsed[key] = rawValue;
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  return parsed;
    77→}
    78→
    79→export function parseTaskWithProject(value: unknown): TaskParseResult {
    80→  const task = asObjectRecord(value);
    81→  if (!task) {
    82→    return {
    83→      ok: false,
    84→      failure: {
    85→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
    86→        message: "Task payload is not an object",
    87→        details: { received_type: typeof value },
    88→      },
    89→    };
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  const id = asString(task.id);
    93→  const taskType = asString(task.task_type);
    94→  const projectId = asString(task.project_id);
    95→  if (!id || !taskType || !projectId) {
    96→    return {
    97→      ok: false,
    98→      failure: {
    99→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
   100→        message: "Task payload missing required fields: id, task_type, or project_id",
   101→        details: {
   102→          has_id: !!id,
   103→          has_task_type: !!taskType,
   104→          has_project_id: !!projectId,
   105→        },
   106→      },
   107→    };
   108→  }
   109→
   110→  const projectsRaw = task.projects;
   111→  const projectRecord = asObjectRecord(projectsRaw)
   112→    ?? (Array.isArray(projectsRaw) ? asObjectRecord(projectsRaw[0]) : null);
   113→  const userId = asString(projectRecord?.user_id);
   114→  if (!userId) {
   115→    return {
   116→      ok: false,
   117→      failure: {
   118→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
   119→        message: "Task payload missing projects.user_id",
   120→        details: {
   121→          projects_type: Array.isArray(projectsRaw) ? "array" : typeof projectsRaw,
   122→          has_projects_user_id: false,
   123→        },
   124→      },
   125→    };
   126→  }
   127→
   128→  const params = parseTaskCostParams(task.params);
   129→  const status = asString(task.status) ?? "unknown";
   130→
   131→  // Extract task_types FK join (PostgREST returns object or null)
   132→  let taskTypeConfig: TaskTypeConfig | null = null;
   133→  const ttRaw = asObjectRecord(task.task_types);
   134→  if (ttRaw) {
   135→    const ttId = asString(ttRaw.id);
   136→    const billingType = asString(ttRaw.billing_type);
   137→    if (ttId && billingType) {
   138→      taskTypeConfig = {
   139→        id: ttId,
   140→        billing_type: billingType,
   141→        base_cost_per_second: typeof ttRaw.base_cost_per_second === 'number' ? ttRaw.base_cost_per_second : 0,
   142→        unit_cost: typeof ttRaw.unit_cost === 'number' ? ttRaw.unit_cost : 0,
   143→        cost_factors: asObjectRecord(ttRaw.cost_factors) as CostFactors | null,
   144→        is_active: ttRaw.is_active === true,
   145→      };
   146→    }
   147→  }
   148→
   149→  return {
   150→    ok: true,
   151→    task: {
   152→      id,
   153→      task_type: taskType,
   154→      params,
   155→      status,
   156→      generation_started_at: asString(task.generation_started_at),
   157→      generation_processed_at: asString(task.generation_processed_at),
   158→      project_id: projectId,
   159→      projects: { user_id: userId },
   160→      task_type_config: taskTypeConfig,
   161→    },
   162→  };
   163→}

   165→// Helper for standard JSON responses with CORS headers
   166→export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200) {
   167→  return new Response(JSON.stringify(body), {
   168→    status,
   169→    headers: {

   178→export function errorResponse(
   179→  errorCode: string,
   180→  message: string,

   184→  return edgeErrorResponse(

   190→    },

   192→}
   193→
   194→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
   195→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
   196→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
   197→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
   198→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
   199→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
   200→};
   201→
   202→interface VideoEnhanceResult {
   203→  interpolation_compute_seconds?: number;
   204→  output_width?: number;
   205→  output_height?: number;
   206→  output_frames?: number;
   207→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   208→}
   209→
   210→interface VideoEnhanceBreakdown {
   211→  interpolation?: { compute_seconds: number; cost_per_second: number; cost: number };
   212→  upscale?: { output_width: number; output_height: number; output_frames: number; megapixels: number; cost_per_megapixel: number; cost: number };
   213→}
   214→
   215→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
   216→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
   217→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: VideoEnhanceResult): { cost: number; breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   218→  let totalCost = 0;
   219→  const breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown = {};
   220→
   221→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
   222→  const result = taskParams?.result || taskParams;
   223→
   224→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
   225→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
   226→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
   227→    totalCost += filmCost;
   228→    breakdown.interpolation = {
   229→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
   230→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
   231→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   232→    };
   233→  }
   234→
   235→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
   236→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
   237→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
   238→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
   239→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
   240→    breakdown.upscale = {
   241→      output_width: result.output_width,
   242→      output_height: result.output_height,
   243→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
   244→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
   245→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
   246→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   247→    };
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  return {
   251→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   252→    breakdown,
   253→  };
   254→}
   255→
   256→interface CostFactors {
   257→  resolution?: Record<string, number>;
   258→  frameCount?: number;
   259→  modelType?: Record<string, number>;
   260→}
   261→
   262→interface TaskCostParams {
   263→  resolution?: string;
   264→  frame_count?: number;
   265→  model_type?: string;
   266→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   267→  [key: string]: unknown;
   268→}
   269→
   270→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
   271→export function calculateTaskCost(
   272→  taskType: string,
   273→  billingType: string,
   274→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
   275→  unitCost: number,
   276→  durationSeconds: number,
   277→  costFactors: CostFactors | null,
   278→  taskParams: TaskCostParams
   279→): { cost: number; breakdown?: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   280→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
   281→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   282→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
   283→  }
   284→
   285→  let totalCost;
   286→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   287→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
   288→  } else {
   289→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   290→  }
   291→
   292→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
   293→  if (costFactors) {
   294→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
   295→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
   296→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
   297→    }
   298→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   299→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   300→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   301→      } else {
   302→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   303→      }
   304→    }
   305→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   306→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   307→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   308→    }
   309→  }
   310→
   311→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   312→}
   313→
```

```
     2→import { TOOL_IDS } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
     3→
     4→interface UseMediaGalleryDebugToolsOptions {
     5→  currentToolType?: string;

    11→
    12→export function useMediaGalleryDebugTools(options: UseMediaGalleryDebugToolsOptions): void {
    13→  const {
    14→    currentToolType,
    15→    filtersMediaType,
    16→    defaultFiltersMediaType,
    17→    imagesLength,
    18→    isMobile,
    19→  } = options;
    20→
    21→  const videoGalleryDebugRef = useRef({ lastImagesLength: 0 });
    22→
    23→  useEffect(() => {
    24→    if (!import.meta.env.DEV) {
    25→      return;
    26→    }
    27→
    28→    const mediaType = filtersMediaType ?? defaultFiltersMediaType ?? 'all';
    29→    const isVideoGallery = currentToolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES && mediaType === 'video';
    30→    if (!isVideoGallery) {
    31→      return;
    32→    }
    33→
    34→    if (videoGalleryDebugRef.current.lastImagesLength !== imagesLength) {
    35→      videoGalleryDebugRef.current.lastImagesLength = imagesLength;
    36→    }
    37→  }, [currentToolType, defaultFiltersMediaType, filtersMediaType, imagesLength]);
    38→
    39→  useEffect(() => {
    40→    if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {
    41→      return;
    42→    }
    43→
    44→    window.debugMobile = () => {
    45→      const freshIsMobile = window.innerWidth < 768;
    46→      return {
    47→        isMobile: freshIsMobile,
    48→        hookReportedMobile: isMobile,
    49→        windowWidth: window.innerWidth,
    50→        windowHeight: window.innerHeight,
    51→        touchSupported: 'ontouchstart' in window,
    52→      };
    53→    };
    54→
    55→    return () => {
    56→      delete window.debugMobile;
    57→    };
    58→  }, [isMobile]);
```

```
1→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { getSupabaseClientResult } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     3→import {
     4→  operationFailure,
     5→  operationSuccess,
     6→  type OperationResult,
     7→} from '@/shared/lib/operationResult';
     8→import { getStorageItem, removeStorageItems } from './storage';
     9→import { runAuthSupabaseOperation } from './runAuthSupabaseOperation';
    10→
    11→const REFERRAL_KEYS = [
    12→  'referralCode',
    13→  'referralSessionId',
    14→  'referralFingerprint',
    15→  'referralTimestamp',
    16→] as const;
    17→
    18→export function useAuthReferralFinalize() {
    19→  return useCallback(async (): Promise<OperationResult<{ finalized: boolean }>> => {
    20→    const supabaseResult = getSupabaseClientResult();
    21→    if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
    22→      return operationFailure(supabaseResult.error, {
    23→        policy: 'degrade',
    24→        recoverable: true,
    25→        errorCode: 'supabase_runtime_uninitialized',
    26→        message: 'Supabase runtime is not initialized while finalizing referrals.',
    27→      });
    28→    }
    29→    const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
    30→    const referralSessionId = getStorageItem(
    31→      'referralSessionId',
    32→      'useAuthReferralFinalize.read.referralSessionId',
    33→    );
    34→    const referralFingerprint = getStorageItem(
    35→      'referralFingerprint',
    36→      'useAuthReferralFinalize.read.referralFingerprint',
    37→    );
    38→    const referralCode = getStorageItem(
    39→      'referralCode',
    40→      'useAuthReferralFinalize.read.referralCode',
    41→    );
    42→
    43→    if (!referralCode || !referralSessionId || !referralFingerprint) {
    44→      return operationSuccess({ finalized: false });
    45→    }
    46→
    47→    return runAuthSupabaseOperation({
    48→      context: 'useAuthReferralFinalize.finalize',
    49→      errorCode: 'referral_finalize_failed',
    50→      showToast: false,
    51→      run: async () => {
    52→        const { error } = await supabase.rpc('create_referral_from_session', {
    53→          p_session_id: referralSessionId,
    54→          p_fingerprint: referralFingerprint,
    55→        });
    56→        if (error) {
    57→          throw error;
    58→        }
    59→        removeStorageItems(REFERRAL_KEYS, 'useAuthReferralFinalize.cleanup');
    60→        return { finalized: true };
    61→      },
    62→    });
    63→  }, []);
    64→}
    65→
```

```
1→/**
```
```
     2→ * Shared utilities for extracting data from task params
     3→ *
     4→ * This module provides a single source of truth for parsing task parameters,
     5→ * ensuring consistent behavior across TasksPane, MediaLightbox, and other components.

    16→/**
    17→ * Parse task params, handling both string and object formats
    18→ */
    19→export function parseTaskParams(params: string | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {
    20→  if (!params) return {};
    21→  if (typeof params === 'string') {
    22→    try {
    23→      const parsed = JSON.parse(params);
    24→      return asRecord(parsed) ?? {};
    25→    } catch {
    26→      return {};
    27→    }
    28→  }
    29→  return asRecord(params) ?? {};
    30→}
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Derive input images from task params
    34→ *
    35→ * For segment tasks (has segment_index): Only returns segment-specific images
    36→ * For orchestrated tasks: Returns all images from orchestrator
    37→ * For other tasks: Checks various image field locations
    38→ *
    39→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
    40→ * @returns Array of image URLs
    41→ */
    42→export function deriveInputImages(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    43→  const params = parsedParams;
    44→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
    45→    const travelImages = deriveTravelInputImages(params);
    46→    if (travelImages.length > 0) {
    47→      return travelImages;
    48→    }
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
    52→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
    53→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
    54→
    55→  // Check if this is a segment task (individual segment of a larger generation)
    56→  const isSegmentTask = params?.segment_index !== undefined;
    57→
    58→  // For segment tasks, ONLY use segment-specific images (not the full orchestrator list)
    59→  if (isSegmentTask) {
    60→    // Priority: individual_segment_params > top-level input_image_paths_resolved
    61→    if (Array.isArray(segmentParams?.input_image_paths_resolved) && segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.length > 0) {
    62→      return segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    63→    }
    64→    // Fallback to start/end image URLs
    65→    if (segmentParams?.start_image_url || segmentParams?.end_image_url) {
    66→      const urls: string[] = [];
    67→      if (typeof segmentParams?.start_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.start_image_url);
    68→      if (typeof segmentParams?.end_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.end_image_url);
    69→      return urls;
    70→    }
    71→    // Fallback to top-level (which should be segment-specific for segment tasks)
    72→    if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    73→      return params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    74→    }
    75→    return [];

    83→  if (typeof params?.image === 'string') urls.push(params.image);
    84→  if (typeof params?.input_image === 'string') urls.push(params.input_image);
    85→  if (typeof params?.init_image === 'string') urls.push(params.init_image);
    86→  if (typeof params?.control_image === 'string') urls.push(params.control_image);
    87→  if (Array.isArray(params?.images)) urls.push(...params.images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    88→  if (Array.isArray(params?.input_images)) urls.push(...params.input_images.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    89→  if (typeof params?.mask_url === 'string') urls.push(params.mask_url);
    90→
    91→  // Travel/video task paths - orchestrator details contain all images for full timeline
    92→  if (Array.isArray(orchestratorDetails?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    93→    urls.push(...orchestratorDetails.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    94→  } else if (Array.isArray(orchestratorPayload?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    95→    urls.push(...orchestratorPayload.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    96→  } else if (Array.isArray(params?.input_image_paths_resolved)) {
    97→    urls.push(...params.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string'));
    98→  }
    99→
   100→  return Array.from(new Set(urls.filter(Boolean)));
   101→}
   102→
   103→/**
   104→ * Extract prompt from task params
   105→ *
   106→ * For segment tasks: Checks individual_segment_params first
   107→ * For orchestrated tasks: Checks orchestrator details
   108→ * For other tasks: Falls back to top-level prompt
   109→ *
   110→ * Prefers enhanced_prompts_expanded over base_prompts_expanded when available,
   111→ * as enhanced prompts contain the AI-improved version of the user's prompt.
   112→ *
   113→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
   114→ * @returns The prompt string or null
   115→ */
   116→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   117→  const params = parsedParams;
   118→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
   119→    return deriveTravelPrompt(params);
   120→  }
   121→
   122→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   123→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   124→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
   125→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   126→
   127→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   128→
   129→  // For segment tasks, try to get enhanced prompt first
   130→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   131→    // Check for enhanced prompt - can be singular field or in expanded array
   132→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   133→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   134→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   135→      segmentParams?.enhanced_prompt,
   136→      params.enhanced_prompt,
   137→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[segmentIndex],
   138→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[segmentIndex],
   139→    );
   140→    if (enhancedPrompt) return enhancedPrompt;
   141→
   142→    // Fall back to base prompt
   143→    return (
   144→      pickFirstString(
   145→        segmentParams?.base_prompt,
   146→        params.base_prompt,
   147→        params.prompt,
   148→        orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   149→      ) ?? null
   150→    );
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  // For full timeline/orchestrated tasks
   154→  // The global base_prompt is what the user typed in the prompt field.
   155→  // Per-pair overrides (base_prompts_expanded) are segment-specific and shouldn't
   156→  // be shown as the task-level prompt — they're misleading when the user explicitly
   157→  // cleared the global prompt.
   158→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   159→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   160→  return (
   161→    pickFirstString(
   162→      orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   163→      orchestratorPayload?.base_prompt,
   164→      params.base_prompt,
   165→      params.prompt,
   166→      // Fall back to enhanced prompts (AI-improved) but NOT base_prompts_expanded
   167→      // which are per-pair overrides, not task-level prompts.
   168→      enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[0],
   169→      enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[0],
   170→    ) ?? null
   171→  );
   172→}
   173→
   174→/**
   175→ * Check if a task type is an image edit task
   176→ */
   177→export function isImageEditTaskType(taskType: string | undefined): boolean {
   178→  const IMAGE_EDIT_TASK_TYPES = [
   179→    'z_image_turbo_i2i',
   180→    'image_inpaint',
   181→    'qwen_image_edit',
   182→    'magic_edit',
   183→    'kontext_image_edit',
   184→    'flux_image_edit',

   186→  ];
   187→  return IMAGE_EDIT_TASK_TYPES.includes(taskType || '');

   190→/**

   197→/**

   204→/**
   205→ * LoRA info extracted from task params

   207→interface LoraInfo {
   208→  url: string;
   209→  strength: number;
   210→  displayName: string;
   211→}
   212→
   213→/**
   214→ * Extract LoRAs from task params (checks multiple locations)
   215→ */
   216→export function extractLoras(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): LoraInfo[] {
   217→  const params = parsedParams;
   218→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   219→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   220→
   221→  // Check for array format (image edit tasks use this)
   222→  const lorasArray = params.loras || orchestratorDetails?.loras || orchestratorPayload?.loras;
   223→  if (Array.isArray(lorasArray) && lorasArray.length > 0) {
   224→    return lorasArray
   225→      .map((lora): LoraInfo | null => {
   226→        const loraRecord = asRecord(lora);
   227→        if (!loraRecord) return null;
   228→        const url = asString(loraRecord.url) ?? '';
   229→        const parsedStrength = toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.strength) ?? toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.multiplier) ?? 1;
   230→        return {
   231→          url,
   232→          strength: parsedStrength,
   233→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   234→        };
   235→      })
   236→      .filter((lora): lora is LoraInfo => lora !== null);
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  // Check for object format (video tasks use additional_loras)
   240→  const additionalLoras = params.additional_loras || orchestratorDetails?.additional_loras || orchestratorPayload?.additional_loras;
   241→  if (additionalLoras && typeof additionalLoras === 'object' && Object.keys(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   242→    return Object.entries(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).map(([url, strength]) => ({
   243→      url,
   244→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   245→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   246→    }));
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return [];
   250→}
   251→
   252→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {
   253→  const fileName = url.split('/').pop() || 'Unknown';
   254→  return fileName.replace(/\.(safetensors|ckpt|pt)$/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
   255→}
   256→
   257→const TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   258→  'individualSegmentParams',
   259→  'taskViewContract',
   260→  'familyContract',
   261→  'rawParams',
   262→];
   263→
   264→const TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   265→  'taskViewContract',
   266→  'familyContract',
   267→  'orchestratorDetails',
   268→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   269→  'rawParams',
   270→];
   271→
   272→const TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   273→  'taskViewContract',
   274→  'familyContract',
   275→  'individualSegmentParams',
   276→  'orchestratorDetails',
   277→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   278→  'rawParams',
   279→];
   280→
   281→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   282→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));
   283→}
   284→
   285→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
   286→  const familyContract = asRecord(params.task_family_contract);
   287→  return (
   288→    params.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   289→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   290→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   291→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   292→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   293→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   294→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   295→  );
   296→}
   297→
   298→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   299→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   300→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   301→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   302→
   303→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   304→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   306→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   307→    }
   308→
   309→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   310→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   311→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   312→  }
   313→
   314→  const timelineSources = [
   315→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   316→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   317→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   318→  ];
   319→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {
   320→    if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {
   321→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(candidate);
   322→    }
   323→  }
   324→
   325→  return [];
   326→}
   327→
   328→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   329→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   330→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   331→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   332→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   333→
   334→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   335→    const enhancedPromptsExpanded = reader.pickStringArray('enhanced_prompts_expanded', [
   336→      'orchestratorDetails',
   337→      'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   338→      'rawParams',
   339→    ]);
   340→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   341→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   342→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   343→    );
   344→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   345→      return enhancedPrompt;
   346→    }
   347→
   348→    return (
   349→      pickFirstString(
   350→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   351→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   352→      ) ?? null
   353→    );
   354→  }
   355→
   356→  return (
   357→    pickFirstString(
   358→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   359→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   360→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   361→    ) ?? null
   362→  );
   363→}
   364→
   365→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   366→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   367→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   368→  return numeric;
   369→}
   370→
   371→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   372→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   373→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   374→}
```

```
    37→export interface DerivedCountsResult {

    40→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    41→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    42→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */

    50→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    51→  return {
    52→    derivedCounts: {},
```
