```
    57→
    58→/**
    59→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    60→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    61→ *
    62→ * Queries both:
    63→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    64→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    65→ *
    66→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    67→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    68→ */
    69→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    70→  generationIds: string[]
    71→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    72→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    73→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    74→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    78→
    79→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    80→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    81→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    82→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    83→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    84→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    85→
    86→  if (variantCountsError) {
    87→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    88→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    89→      cause: variantCountsError,
    90→    });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  if (variantCountsData) {
    94→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    95→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    96→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    97→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    98→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    99→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
   100→      }
   101→    }
   102→  }
   103→
   104→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   105→}

   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {

   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking

   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,

   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access

   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip

   342→      return {

   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));

   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {

   366→    return {

   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}
```

```
1→const EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
     2→const STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
     3→
     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {
    17→    return input.url;
    18→  }
    19→  return String(input);
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    91→  const { signal, cleanup } = composeAbortSignals(
    92→    controller.signal,
    93→    callerSignal,
    94→  );
    95→
    96→  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal }).finally(() => {
    97→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    98→    cleanup();
    99→  });
   100→}
   101→
```

```
    10→
    11→type OAuthIntentCacheResult = OperationResult<{ cached: boolean }>;
    12→
    13→function cacheOAuthIntentFlag(): OAuthIntentCacheResult {
    14→  try {
    15→    localStorage.setItem('oauthInProgress', 'true');
    16→    return operationSuccess({ cached: true }, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    17→  } catch (error) {
    18→    return operationFailure(error, {
    19→      policy: 'degrade',
    20→      recoverable: true,
    21→      errorCode: 'oauth_intent_cache_failed',
    22→      message: 'Unable to cache OAuth intent in local storage.',
    23→      cause: error,
    24→    });
    25→  }
    26→}
    27→
    28→export function useDiscordSignIn() {
    29→  return useCallback(async () => {
    30→    const supabaseResult = getSupabaseClientResult();
    31→    if (!supabaseResult.ok) {
    32→      return operationFailure(supabaseResult.error, {
    33→        policy: 'degrade',
    34→        recoverable: true,
    35→        errorCode: 'supabase_runtime_uninitialized',
    36→        message: 'Supabase runtime is not initialized yet.',
    37→      });
    38→    }
    39→    const supabase = supabaseResult.client;
    40→    const intentCacheResult = cacheOAuthIntentFlag();
    41→    if (!intentCacheResult.ok) {
    42→      normalizeAndPresentError(intentCacheResult.error, {
    43→        context: 'useDiscordSignIn.cacheOauthIntent',
    44→        showToast: false,
    45→        logData: {
    46→          errorCode: intentCacheResult.errorCode,
    47→          policy: intentCacheResult.policy,
    48→          recoverable: intentCacheResult.recoverable,
    49→        },
    50→      });
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    const oauthStartResult = await runAuthSupabaseOperation({
    54→      context: 'useDiscordSignIn.startOAuth',
    55→      errorCode: 'discord_oauth_start_failed',
    56→      showToast: true,
    57→      toastTitle: 'Failed to start Discord sign-in. Please try again.',
    58→      run: async () => {
    59→        const { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOAuth({
    60→          provider: 'discord',
    61→          options: {
    62→            redirectTo: window.location.origin,
    63→          },
    64→        });
    65→
    66→        if (error) {
    67→          throw error;
    68→        }
    69→
    70→        return { started: true as const };
    71→      },
    72→    });
    73→
    74→    if (!oauthStartResult.ok) {
    75→      return oauthStartResult;
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    return operationSuccess(
    79→      {
    80→        ...oauthStartResult.value,
    81→        oauthIntentCached: intentCacheResult.ok,
    82→      },
    83→      {
    84→        policy: intentCacheResult.ok ? oauthStartResult.policy : 'degrade',
    85→      },
    86→    );
    87→  }, []);
    88→}
```

```
    13→import { useDragAndDrop } from './hooks/useDragAndDrop';
    14→import { useExternalGenerations } from './hooks/useExternalGenerations';
    15→import { useLightbox } from './hooks/useLightbox';
    16→import { useMobileGestures } from './hooks/useMobileGestures';
    17→import { useOptimisticOrder } from './hooks/useOptimisticOrder';
    18→import { useSelection } from './hooks/useSelection';
    19→import { getFramePositionForIndex } from './utils/image-utils';
    20→import type { ShotImageManagerProps } from './types';
    21→
    22→type SegmentOutputHookResult = ReturnType<typeof useSegmentOutputsForShot>;
    23→type SegmentSlot = SegmentOutputHookResult['segmentSlots'][number];
    24→
    25→interface SegmentLightboxState {
    26→  segmentLightboxIndex: number | null;
    27→  currentSegmentSlot: SegmentSlot | null;
    28→  currentSegmentMedia: GenerationRow | null;
    29→  segmentChildSlotIndices: number[];
    30→  handleSegmentClick: (slotIndex: number) => void;
    31→  handleSegmentLightboxNext: () => void;
    32→  handleSegmentLightboxPrev: () => void;
    33→  closeSegmentLightbox: () => void;
    34→}
    35→
    36→interface SelectionOrderController {
    37→  optimistic: ReturnType<typeof useOptimisticOrder>;
    38→  selection: ReturnType<typeof useSelection>;
    39→  dragAndDrop: ReturnType<typeof useDragAndDrop>;
    40→  batchOps: ReturnType<typeof useBatchOperations>;
    41→  mobileGestures: ReturnType<typeof useMobileGestures>;
    42→  getFramePosition: (index: number) => number | undefined;
    43→}
    44→
    45→interface NavigationController {
    46→  lightbox: ReturnType<typeof useLightbox>;
    47→  externalGens: ReturnType<typeof useExternalGenerations>;
    48→  shotSelector: {
    49→    lightboxSelectedShotId: string | undefined;
    50→    setLightboxSelectedShotId: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<string | undefined>>;
    51→  };
    52→}
    53→
    54→interface SegmentController {
    55→  segmentSlots: SegmentSlot[];
    56→  selectedParentId: string | null;
    57→  hasPendingTask: (pairShotGenerationId: string | null | undefined) => boolean;
    58→  segmentLightbox: SegmentLightboxState;
    59→}
    60→
    61→interface ShotImageManagerContainerState {
    62→  selectionOrder: SelectionOrderController;
    63→  navigation: NavigationController;
    64→  segments: SegmentController;

    66→
    67→function useSegmentController(
    68→  props: ShotImageManagerProps,
    69→  currentImages: GenerationRow[],
    70→): SegmentController {
    71→  const localShotGenPositions = useMemo(() => {
    72→    if (props.generationMode === 'timeline') {
    73→      return undefined;
    74→    }
    75→
    76→    const orderedImages = currentImages.filter(
    77→      (image) => isPositioned(image) && !isVideoGeneration(image)
    78→    );
    79→    if (orderedImages.length === 0) {
    80→      return undefined;
    81→    }
    82→
    83→    const positions = new Map<string, number>();
    84→    orderedImages.forEach((image, index) => {
    85→      if (image.id) {
    86→        positions.set(image.id, index);
    87→      }
    88→    });
    89→    return positions;
    90→  }, [currentImages, props.generationMode]);
    91→
    92→  const shouldFetchSegments = props.generationMode !== 'timeline' &&
    93→    (!props.segmentSlots || (localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0));
    94→
    95→  const hookResult = useSegmentOutputsForShot(
    96→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.shotId || null : null,
    97→    shouldFetchSegments ? props.projectId || null : null,
    98→    shouldFetchSegments ? localShotGenPositions : undefined
    99→  );
   100→
   101→  const segmentSlots = (localShotGenPositions && localShotGenPositions.size > 0)
   102→    ? (hookResult.segmentSlots.length > 0 ? hookResult.segmentSlots : props.segmentSlots ?? [])
   103→    : (props.segmentSlots ?? hookResult.segmentSlots);
   104→
   105→  const selectedParentId = hookResult.selectedParentId;
   106→  const { hasPendingTask } = usePendingSegmentTasks(
   107→    props.generationMode !== 'timeline' ? props.shotId || null : null,
   108→    props.generationMode !== 'timeline' ? props.projectId || null : null
   109→  );
   110→
   111→  const segmentLightbox = useSegmentLightboxState(segmentSlots, props.onPairClick);
   112→
   113→  return {
   114→    segmentSlots,
   115→    selectedParentId,
   116→    hasPendingTask,
   117→    segmentLightbox,
   118→  };
   119→}
   120→
   121→function useSegmentLightboxState(
   122→  segmentSlots: SegmentSlot[],
   123→  onPairClick?: ShotImageManagerProps['onPairClick']
   124→): SegmentLightboxState {
   125→  const [segmentLightboxIndex, setSegmentLightboxIndex] = useState<number | null>(null);
   126→
   127→  const handleSegmentClick = useCallback((slotIndex: number) => {
   128→    const slot = segmentSlots[slotIndex];
   129→    if (onPairClick && slot) {
   130→      onPairClick(slot.index);
   131→      return;
   132→    }
   133→
   134→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(slotIndex);
   135→  }, [onPairClick, segmentSlots]);
   136→
   137→  const currentSegmentSlot = segmentLightboxIndex !== null ? segmentSlots[segmentLightboxIndex] : null;
   138→  const currentSegmentMedia = currentSegmentSlot?.type === 'child'
   139→    ? currentSegmentSlot.child
   140→    : null;
   141→
   142→  const segmentChildSlotIndices = useMemo(
   143→    () =>
   144→      segmentSlots
   145→        .map((slot, idx) => (slot.type === 'child' && slot.child.location ? idx : null))
   146→        .filter((idx): idx is number => idx !== null),
   147→    [segmentSlots]
   148→  );
   149→
   150→  const handleSegmentLightboxNext = useCallback(() => {
   151→    if (segmentLightboxIndex === null || segmentChildSlotIndices.length === 0) {
   152→      return;
   153→    }
   154→
   155→    const currentPos = segmentChildSlotIndices.indexOf(segmentLightboxIndex);
   156→    const nextPos = (currentPos + 1) % segmentChildSlotIndices.length;
   157→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(segmentChildSlotIndices[nextPos]);
   158→  }, [segmentChildSlotIndices, segmentLightboxIndex]);
   159→
   160→  const handleSegmentLightboxPrev = useCallback(() => {
   161→    if (segmentLightboxIndex === null || segmentChildSlotIndices.length === 0) {
   162→      return;
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    const currentPos = segmentChildSlotIndices.indexOf(segmentLightboxIndex);
   166→    const prevPos = (currentPos - 1 + segmentChildSlotIndices.length) % segmentChildSlotIndices.length;
   167→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(segmentChildSlotIndices[prevPos]);
   168→  }, [segmentChildSlotIndices, segmentLightboxIndex]);
   169→
   170→  const closeSegmentLightbox = useCallback(() => {
   171→    setSegmentLightboxIndex(null);
   172→  }, []);
   173→
   174→  return {
   175→    segmentLightboxIndex,
   176→    currentSegmentSlot,
   177→    currentSegmentMedia,
   178→    segmentChildSlotIndices,
   179→    handleSegmentClick,
   180→    handleSegmentLightboxNext,
   181→    handleSegmentLightboxPrev,
   182→    closeSegmentLightbox,
   183→  };
   184→}
   185→
   186→function useShotImageManagerContainerState(
   187→  props: ShotImageManagerProps,
   188→  isMobile: boolean
   189→): ShotImageManagerContainerState {
   190→  const optimistic = useOptimisticOrder({ images: props.images });
   191→  const setLightboxIndexRef = useRef<(index: number) => void>(() => {});
   192→
   193→  const externalGens = useExternalGenerations({
   194→    selectedShotId: props.selectedShotId,
   195→    optimisticOrder: optimistic.optimisticOrder,
   196→    images: props.images,
   197→    setLightboxIndexRef,
   198→  });
   199→
   200→  const [lightboxSelectedShotId, setLightboxSelectedShotId] = useState<string | undefined>(props.selectedShotId);
   201→
   202→  const selection = useSelection({
   203→    images: optimistic.optimisticOrder,
   204→    isMobile,
   205→    generationMode: props.generationMode,
   206→    onSelectionChange: props.onSelectionChange,
   207→  });
   208→
   209→  const lightbox = useLightbox({
   210→    images: optimistic.optimisticOrder,
   211→    externalGenerations: externalGens.externalGenerations,
   212→    tempDerivedGenerations: externalGens.tempDerivedGenerations,
   213→    derivedNavContext: externalGens.derivedNavContext,
   214→    handleOpenExternalGeneration: externalGens.handleOpenExternalGeneration,
   215→  });
   216→  const segments = useSegmentController(props, lightbox.currentImages);
   217→
   218→  useEffect(() => {
   219→    setLightboxIndexRef.current = lightbox.setLightboxIndex;
   220→  }, [lightbox.setLightboxIndex]);
   221→
   222→  const dragAndDrop = useDragAndDrop({
   223→    images: lightbox.currentImages,
   224→    selectedIds: selection.selectedIds,
   225→    onImageReorder: props.onImageReorder,
   226→    isMobile,
   227→    setSelectedIds: selection.setSelectedIds,
   228→    setLastSelectedIndex: selection.setLastSelectedIndex,
   229→    setOptimisticOrder: optimistic.setOptimisticOrder,
   230→    setIsOptimisticUpdate: optimistic.setIsOptimisticUpdate,
   231→    setReconciliationId: optimistic.setReconciliationId,
   232→    onDragStateChange: props.onDragStateChange,
   233→  });
   234→
   235→  const batchOps = useBatchOperations({
   236→    currentImages: lightbox.currentImages,
   237→    onImageDelete: props.onImageDelete,
   238→    onBatchImageDelete: props.onBatchImageDelete,
   239→    onSelectionChange: props.onSelectionChange,
   240→    setSelectedIds: selection.setSelectedIds,
   241→    setMobileSelectedIds: selection.setMobileSelectedIds,
   242→    setLastSelectedIndex: selection.setLastSelectedIndex,
   243→  });
   244→
   245→  const mobileGestures = useMobileGestures({
   246→    currentImages: lightbox.currentImages,
   247→    mobileSelectedIds: selection.mobileSelectedIds,
   248→    onImageReorder: props.onImageReorder,
   249→    setMobileSelectedIds: selection.setMobileSelectedIds,
   250→    setLightboxIndex: lightbox.setLightboxIndex,
   251→  });
   252→
   253→  const getFramePosition = useMemo(
   254→    () => (index: number) =>
   255→      getFramePositionForIndex(
   256→        index,
   257→        lightbox.currentImages,
   258→        props.batchVideoFrames || DEFAULT_BATCH_VIDEO_FRAMES
   259→      ),
   260→    [lightbox.currentImages, props.batchVideoFrames]
   261→  );
   262→
   263→  const selectionOrder: SelectionOrderController = {
   264→    optimistic,
   265→    selection,
   266→    dragAndDrop,
   267→    batchOps,
   268→    mobileGestures,
   269→    getFramePosition,
   270→  };
   271→
   272→  const navigation: NavigationController = {
   273→    lightbox,
   274→    externalGens,
   275→    shotSelector: {
   276→      lightboxSelectedShotId,
   277→      setLightboxSelectedShotId,
   278→    },
   279→  };
   280→
   281→  return {
   282→    selectionOrder,
   283→    navigation,
   284→    segments,
   285→  };
   286→}
   287→
   288→/**
   289→ * Main container component for ShotImageManager
   290→ *
   291→ * CRITICAL: All hooks MUST be called before any early returns to satisfy Rules of Hooks.
   292→ * This prevents hook ordering violations that occur when responsive breakpoints change.
   293→ */
   294→export const ShotImageManagerContainer: React.FC<ShotImageManagerProps> = (props) => {
   295→  const isMobile = useIsMobile();
   296→  const state = useShotImageManagerContainerState(props, isMobile);
   297→
   298→  if (!props.images || props.images.length === 0) {
   299→    return (
   300→      <EmptyState
   301→        onImageUpload={props.onImageUpload}
   302→        isUploadingImage={props.isUploadingImage}
   303→        shotId={props.selectedShotId}
   304→        onGenerationDrop={props.onGenerationDrop
   305→          ? (generationId, imageUrl, thumbUrl) =>
   306→              props.onGenerationDrop!(generationId, imageUrl, thumbUrl, 0)
   307→          : undefined}
   308→      />
   309→    );
   310→  }
   311→
   312→  if (isMobile && props.generationMode !== 'timeline') {
   313→    return (
   314→      <>
   315→        <ShotImageManagerMobileWrapper
   316→          {...props}
   317→          selection={state.selectionOrder.selection}
   318→          lightbox={state.navigation.lightbox}
   319→          batchOps={state.selectionOrder.batchOps}
   320→          mobileGestures={state.selectionOrder.mobileGestures}
   321→          optimistic={state.selectionOrder.optimistic}
   322→          externalGens={state.navigation.externalGens}
   323→          lightboxSelectedShotId={state.navigation.shotSelector.lightboxSelectedShotId}
   324→          setLightboxSelectedShotId={state.navigation.shotSelector.setLightboxSelectedShotId}
   325→          segmentSlots={state.segments.segmentSlots}
   326→          onSegmentClick={state.segments.segmentLightbox.handleSegmentClick}
   327→          hasPendingTask={state.segments.hasPendingTask}
   328→          onSegmentDelete={props.onSegmentDelete}
   329→          deletingSegmentId={props.deletingSegmentId}
   330→        />
   331→
   332→        {state.segments.segmentLightbox.currentSegmentMedia && (
   333→          <MediaLightbox
   334→            media={state.segments.segmentLightbox.currentSegmentMedia}
   335→            parentGenerationIdOverride={state.segments.selectedParentId || undefined}
   336→            onClose={state.segments.segmentLightbox.closeSegmentLightbox}
   337→            navigation={{
   338→              onNext: state.segments.segmentLightbox.handleSegmentLightboxNext,
   339→              onPrevious: state.segments.segmentLightbox.handleSegmentLightboxPrev,
   340→              showNavigation: true,
   341→              hasNext: state.segments.segmentLightbox.segmentChildSlotIndices.length > 1,
   342→              hasPrevious: state.segments.segmentLightbox.segmentChildSlotIndices.length > 1,
   343→            }}
   344→            features={{
   345→              showImageEditTools: false,
   346→              showDownload: true,
   347→              showTaskDetails: true,
   348→            }}
   349→            actions={{
   350→              starred: state.segments.segmentLightbox.currentSegmentMedia.starred ?? false,
   351→            }}
   352→            shotId={props.shotId}
   353→            readOnly={props.readOnly}
   354→            videoProps={{
   355→              fetchVariantsForSelf: true,
   356→              currentSegmentImages: {
   357→                startShotGenerationId: state.segments.segmentLightbox.currentSegmentSlot?.pairShotGenerationId,
   358→              },
   359→            }}
   360→          />
   361→        )}
   362→      </>
   363→    );
   364→  }
   365→
   366→  return (
   367→    <>
   368→      <ShotImageManagerDesktop
   369→        {...props}
   370→        selection={state.selectionOrder.selection}
   371→        dragAndDrop={state.selectionOrder.dragAndDrop}
   372→        lightbox={state.navigation.lightbox}
   373→        batchOps={state.selectionOrder.batchOps}
   374→        optimistic={state.selectionOrder.optimistic}
   375→        externalGens={state.navigation.externalGens}
   376→        getFramePosition={state.selectionOrder.getFramePosition}
   377→        lightboxSelectedShotId={state.navigation.shotSelector.lightboxSelectedShotId}
   378→        setLightboxSelectedShotId={state.navigation.shotSelector.setLightboxSelectedShotId}
   379→        segmentSlots={state.segments.segmentSlots}
   380→        onSegmentClick={state.segments.segmentLightbox.handleSegmentClick}
   381→        hasPendingTask={state.segments.hasPendingTask}
   382→        onSegmentDelete={props.onSegmentDelete}
   383→        deletingSegmentId={props.deletingSegmentId}
   384→      />
   385→
   386→      {state.segments.segmentLightbox.currentSegmentMedia && (

   389→          parentGenerationIdOverride={state.segments.selectedParentId || undefined}

   391→          navigation={{
```

```
   171→            body: JSON.stringify({
   172→              model: "gpt-5-mini",
   173→              messages: [
   174→                { role: "system", content: systemMsg },
   175→                { role: "user", content: userMsg },
   176→              ],
   177→              max_completion_tokens: 16000,
   178→            }),
   179→          });
   180→
   181→          if (!response.ok) {
   182→            const errorText = await response.text();
   183→            console.error(`[ai-prompt] OpenAI API error:`, response.status, errorText);
   184→            return jsonResponse({ error: "OpenAI API error", details: errorText }, response.status);
   185→          }
   186→
   187→          const data = await response.json();
   188→
   189→          const enhancedPrompt = data.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || prompt;
   190→
   191→          return jsonResponse({
   192→            enhanced_prompt: enhancedPrompt,
   193→            usage: data.usage,
   194→          });
   195→        } catch (fetchError: unknown) {
   196→          const message = fetchError instanceof Error ? fetchError.message : String(fetchError);
   197→          console.error(`[ai-prompt] OpenAI fetch error:`, message);
   198→          return jsonResponse({ error: "Failed to call OpenAI API", details: message }, 500);
   199→        }
   200→      }
   201→      default:
   202→        return jsonResponse({ error: `Unknown task: ${task}` }, 400);
   203→    }
   204→  } catch (err: unknown) {
   205→    const message = err instanceof Error ? err.message : String(err);
   206→    console.error(`[ai-prompt] Error handling task ${task}:`, message);
   207→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Internal server error", details: message }, 500);
   208→  }
   209→});
```

```
1→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import type { ImageTransform } from './types';
     3→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { getMediaUrl } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaTypeHelpers';
     5→
     6→interface UseCanvasTransformProps {
     7→  transform: ImageTransform;
     8→  imageDimensions: { width: number; height: number } | null;
     9→  media: GenerationRow;
    10→  /** Active variant's image URL - use this instead of media.url when editing a variant */
    11→  activeVariantLocation?: string | null;
    12→}
    13→
    14→interface UseCanvasTransformReturn {
    15→  /** Get CSS transform style for preview rendering */
    16→  getTransformStyle: () => React.CSSProperties;
    17→  /** Create a canvas with the transformed image at source resolution */
    18→  createTransformedCanvas: () => Promise<HTMLCanvasElement>;
    19→}
    20→
    21→/**
    22→ * Hook for CSS transform generation and canvas manipulation.
    23→ * Handles both preview rendering (CSS) and actual canvas transformation (for saving/uploading).
    24→ */
    25→export function useCanvasTransform({
    26→  transform,
    27→  imageDimensions,
    28→  media,
    29→  activeVariantLocation,
    30→}: UseCanvasTransformProps): UseCanvasTransformReturn {
    31→  // Get CSS transform style for rendering preview
    32→  const getTransformStyle = useCallback((): React.CSSProperties => {
    33→    const scaleX = transform.flipH ? -transform.scale : transform.scale;
    34→    const scaleY = transform.flipV ? -transform.scale : transform.scale;
    35→
    36→    // Use percentage-based CSS transforms directly
    37→    // This ensures the preview matches the saved result regardless of display scaling
    38→    // translateX/translateY are already percentages (0-100)
    39→    // CSS translate() with % is relative to the element's own dimensions
    40→    return {
    41→      transform: `translate(${transform.translateX}%, ${transform.translateY}%) scale(${scaleX}, ${scaleY}) rotate(${transform.rotation}deg)`,
    42→      transformOrigin: 'center center',
    43→    };
    44→  }, [transform]);
    45→
    46→  // Helper function to create transformed canvas
    47→  const createTransformedCanvas = useCallback(async (): Promise<HTMLCanvasElement> => {
    48→    if (!imageDimensions) {
    49→      throw new Error('Missing image dimensions');
    50→    }
    51→
    52→    // Get the source image - use variant URL if editing a variant
    53→    const mediaUrl = getMediaUrl(media) || media.imageUrl;
    54→    const sourceUrl = activeVariantLocation || mediaUrl;
    55→    if (!sourceUrl) {
    56→      throw new Error('Missing source URL');
    57→    }
    58→
    59→    // Load the source image
    60→    const img = new Image();
    61→    img.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    62→
    63→    await new Promise<void>((resolve, reject) => {
    64→      img.onload = () => resolve();
    65→      img.onerror = () => reject(new Error('Failed to load image'));
    66→      img.src = sourceUrl;
    67→    });
    68→
    69→    // Use actual source image dimensions for output quality
    70→    // The output canvas matches the source image size to avoid quality loss
    71→    const sourceWidth = img.naturalWidth;
    72→    const sourceHeight = img.naturalHeight;
    73→
    74→    // Create transformed image canvas at source resolution
    75→    const transformedCanvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    76→    transformedCanvas.width = sourceWidth;
    77→    transformedCanvas.height = sourceHeight;
    78→    const transformedCtx = transformedCanvas.getContext('2d');
    79→
    80→    if (!transformedCtx) {
    81→      throw new Error('Could not create canvas context');
    82→    }
    83→
    84→    // Clear canvas with transparent background
    85→    // Note: We keep it transparent here so mask generation can use alpha channel.
    86→    // The green/black fill happens later when preparing the image for upload.
    87→    transformedCtx.clearRect(0, 0, sourceWidth, sourceHeight);
    88→
    89→    // Apply transform and draw image
    90→    transformedCtx.save();
    91→
    92→    // Move to center of output canvas
    93→    transformedCtx.translate(sourceWidth / 2, sourceHeight / 2);
    94→
    95→    // Apply user transforms - translateX/translateY are percentages of the displayed dimensions
    96→    // Convert to pixels in source image space
    97→    const translateXPx = (transform.translateX / 100) * sourceWidth;
    98→    const translateYPx = (transform.translateY / 100) * sourceHeight;
    99→    transformedCtx.translate(translateXPx, translateYPx);
   100→
   101→    // Apply scale with flip
   102→    const scaleX = transform.flipH ? -transform.scale : transform.scale;
   103→    const scaleY = transform.flipV ? -transform.scale : transform.scale;
   104→    transformedCtx.scale(scaleX, scaleY);
   105→
   106→    transformedCtx.rotate((transform.rotation * Math.PI) / 180);
   107→
   108→    // Draw image centered at source dimensions
   109→    transformedCtx.drawImage(
   110→      img,
   111→      -sourceWidth / 2,
   112→      -sourceHeight / 2,
   113→      sourceWidth,
   114→      sourceHeight
   115→    );
   116→
   117→    transformedCtx.restore();
   118→
   119→    return transformedCanvas;
   120→  }, [imageDimensions, media, transform, activeVariantLocation]);
   121→
   122→  return {
   123→    getTransformStyle,
   124→    createTransformedCanvas,
   125→  };
   126→}
   127→
```

```
   271→/**
   272→ * Find sibling segment tasks using run_id (preferred) or orchestrator_task_id (fallback)

   274→async function findSiblingSegments(
   275→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   276→  segmentType: string,
   277→  projectId: string,
   278→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   279→  orchestratorRunId: string | null

   282→    const runIdRows = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   283→      supabase,

   286→      select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   287→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   288→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   289→    });
   290→    if (runIdRows.length > 0) {
   291→      return runIdRows;
   292→    }
   293→  }
   294→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   295→    supabase,
   296→    taskType: segmentType,
   297→    projectId,
   298→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   299→    orchestratorTaskId,
   300→    contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   301→  });
   302→  return orchestratorRows;

   304→/**
   305→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   306→ */
   307→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   308→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   309→  finalStepType: string,
   310→  projectId: string,
   311→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   312→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   313→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   314→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   315→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   316→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   317→      supabase,
   318→      taskType: finalStepType,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      select: "id, status",
   321→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   322→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   323→    });
   324→  }
   325→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   326→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   327→      supabase,
   328→      taskType: finalStepType,
   329→      projectId,
   330→      select: "id, status",
   331→      orchestratorTaskId,
   332→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   333→    });
   334→  }
   335→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   336→    return 'not_found';
   337→  }
   338→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   339→    return 'failed';
   340→  }
   341→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Complete')) {
   342→    return 'complete';
   343→  }
   344→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Queued' || task.status === 'In Progress')) {
   345→    return 'pending';
   346→  }
   347→  return 'unknown';
   348→}

   378→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   379→      metadata: {
   380→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   381→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   382→          ? updateOrchError.message
   383→          : String(updateOrchError),
   384→      },
   385→      cause: updateOrchError,
   386→    });
   387→  }
   388→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   389→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   390→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   391→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   392→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   393→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   394→    });
   395→  }
   396→}
   397→/**
   398→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   399→ */
   400→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   401→  params: {
   402→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   403→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   404→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   405→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   406→    publicUrl: string;
   407→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   408→    supabaseUrl: string;
   409→    serviceKey: string;
   410→    logger?: {
   411→      warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   412→      error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   413→    };
   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {
   416→  const {
   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: "Complete",
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   438→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   439→  };
   440→  if (isFinalStep) {
   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   448→    .select('id');
   449→  if (updateOrchError) {
   450→    throw new CompletionError({
   451→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   452→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   453→      recoverable: true,
   454→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   455→      metadata: {
   456→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   457→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→    });
   469→    return;
   470→  }
   471→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   472→    supabaseUrl,
   473→    serviceKey,
   474→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   475→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   476→  });
   477→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   478→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   479→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   480→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   481→    supabase,
   482→    orchestratorTaskId,
   483→    existingResultData,
   484→    billingOutcome,
   485→    billingDecision,
   486→    logger,
   487→  );
   488→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   489→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   490→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   491→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   492→      billing_result: billingResult,
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→}
   496→
```

```
    95→function InlineEditCanvas({ variant, model, media }: InlineEditCanvasProps) {
    96→  const isMobileVariant = variant === 'mobile';

    98→  return (

   121→      )}
   122→
   123→      {model.isSpecialEditMode && (
   124→        <FloatingToolControls
   125→          variant={isMobileVariant ? "mobile" : "tablet"}
   126→        />
   127→      )}
   128→
   129→      <TopRightControls

   131→        handleDownload={model.generation.handleDownload}

   134→      <BottomLeftControls

   145→}

   147→// ============================================================================
   148→// InlineEditSidebar — EditModePanel or fallback placeholder
   149→// ============================================================================

   185→function buildInlineEditSidebarModel(state: InlineEditStateResult): InlineEditSidebarModel {
```

```
1→import { formatDistanceToNow } from 'date-fns';
     2→import { abbreviateRelativeTime, formatRelativeDuration } from '@/shared/lib/timeFormatting';
     3→import { useLiveRelativeTimestamp } from './useLiveRelativeTimestamp';
     4→
     5→type RelativeTimestampPreset = 'default' | 'task' | 'processing' | 'completed';
     6→
     7→interface UseUpdatingTimestampOptions {
     8→  date?: string | Date | null;
     9→  abbreviate?: (str: string) => string;
    10→  disabled?: boolean;
    11→  preset?: RelativeTimestampPreset;
    12→}
    13→
    14→const relativeTimestampFormatters: Record<
    15→  RelativeTimestampPreset,
    16→  (date: Date, abbreviate: (str: string) => string) => string
    17→> = {
    18→  default: (date, abbreviate) => abbreviate(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true })),
    19→  task: (date) => {
    20→    const abbreviated = abbreviateRelativeTime(formatDistanceToNow(date, { addSuffix: true }));
    21→    return abbreviated || '<1 min ago';
    22→  },
    23→  processing: (date) => `Processing for ${formatRelativeDuration(date, { includeDays: false })}`,
    24→  completed: (date) => `Completed ${formatRelativeDuration(date)} ago`,
    25→};
    26→
    27→export function useRelativeTimestamp({
    28→  date,
    29→  abbreviate = abbreviateRelativeTime,
    30→  disabled = false,
    31→  preset = 'default',
    32→}: UseUpdatingTimestampOptions = {}): string | null {
    33→  const formatter = relativeTimestampFormatters[preset];
    34→
    35→  return useLiveRelativeTimestamp({
    36→    dateInput: date,
    37→    disabled,
    38→    formatter: (parsedDate) => formatter(parsedDate, abbreviate),
    39→  });
    40→}
    41→
    42→export function useTaskTimestamp(date?: string | Date | null) {
    43→  return useRelativeTimestamp({
    44→    date,
    45→    preset: 'task',
    46→  });
    47→}
    48→
```

```
1→# Frontend Architecture Patterns
     2→
     3→---
     4→
     5→## State Management
     6→
     7→No Redux/Zustand. State flows through specific layers:
     8→
     9→| Layer | Tool | Purpose |
    10→|-------|------|---------|
    11→| **Server state** | React Query | Remote data (shots, generations, settings) |
    12→| **Query keys** | `queryKeys` registry (`shared/lib/queryKeys.ts`) | Single source of truth for all cache keys |
    13→| **Global UI state** | React Context | Cross-component state (selected project, current shot) |
    14→| **Persisted UI state** | `useUserUIState` | Preferences saved to user settings |
    15→| **Local state** | `useState`/`useReducer` | Component-internal state |
    16→| **URL state** | React Router | Route params, query strings |
    17→
    18→### Query Key Convention
    19→
    20→Keys use **nouns**, **kebab-case** for multi-word, scoped **broad-to-specific**:
    21→`['shots', projectId]` not `[projectId, 'shots']`.
    22→
    23→All keys live in `queryKeys` object. Invalidation goes through hooks in `shared/hooks/invalidation/`, never raw `queryClient.invalidateQueries`.
    24→
    25→---
    26→
    27→## Contexts
    28→
    29→| Context | Provider location |
    30→|---------|-------------------|
    31→| `AuthContext` | `App.tsx` (top-level) |
    32→| `ProjectContext` | `App.tsx` (inside auth) |
    33→| `UserSettingsContext` | `App.tsx` (inside auth) |
    34→| `ShotsContext` | Project route layout |
    35→| `CurrentShotContext` | Shot route layout |
    36→| `PanesContext` | Shot route layout |
    37→| `GenerationTaskContext` | Tool pages |
    38→| `AIInputModeContext` | Tool pages |
    39→| `IncomingTasksContext` | Project route layout |
    40→| `ToolPageHeaderContext` | Tool page layout |
    41→| `LastAffectedShotContext` | Project route layout |
    42→
    43→### Provider nesting order matters
    44→
    45→See `App.tsx` for the hierarchy. Providers that depend on others must be nested inside them (e.g., `ProjectContext` inside `AuthContext`).
    46→
    47→---
    48→
    49→## Cross-Cutting Systems (details in dedicated docs)
    50→
    51→| System | Doc |
    52→|--------|-----|
    53→| Settings (scope cascade, persistence) | [settings_system.md](settings_system.md) |
    54→| Error handling (typed errors, `handleError()`) | [error_handling.md](error_handling.md) |
    55→| Realtime (subscriptions, batching, invalidation) | [realtime_system.md](realtime_system.md) |
    56→| Performance (memoization, preloading, debouncing) | [performance_system.md](performance_system.md) |
    57→| Task creation (validate, transform, insert) | [unified_task_creation.md](unified_task_creation.md) |
    58→| Image loading (progressive, lazy, preload) | [image_loading_system.md](image_loading_system.md) |
    59→| Tool module structure | [adding_new_tool.md](../adding_new_tool.md) |
    60→| Shared utilities (ModalContainer, ConfirmDialog) | [shared_utilities.md](shared_utilities.md) |
    61→
    62→---
    63→
    64→## Shared Components Worth Knowing
    65→
    66→`ModalContainer`, `ConfirmDialog` -- See [shared_utilities.md](shared_utilities.md).
    67→
    68→---
    69→
    70→## Feature Checklist
    71→
    72→When building a new feature:
    73→
    74→- [ ] **Context needed?** Only if state is used by 3+ unrelated components.
    75→- [ ] **Hook extraction?** If logic is reused or complex (>20 lines)
    76→- [ ] **Query keys?** Add to `queryKeys` registry in `shared/lib/queryKeys.ts`
    77→- [ ] **Invalidation?** Use hooks from `shared/hooks/invalidation/`
    78→- [ ] **Error handling?** Use `handleError()` with typed errors
    79→- [ ] **Settings?** Use `useToolSettings` with scope cascade
    80→- [ ] **Types?** Add to `src/types/` if used across files
```

```
    21→serve(async (req) => {

    33→  if (!bootstrap.ok) {

    36→
    37→  const discordWebhookUrl = Deno.env.get("DISCORD_STATS_WEBHOOK_URL");

    39→  if (!discordWebhookUrl) {
    40→    return new Response("DISCORD_STATS_WEBHOOK_URL not configured", { status: 500 });
    41→  }
    42→
    43→  const { supabaseAdmin, logger } = bootstrap.value;
    44→
    45→  try {
    46→    logger.info("Starting daily stats collection");
    47→
    48→    // Query completed tasks grouped by day, categorized into 3 buckets
    49→    const { data: dailyStats, error: statsError } = await supabaseAdmin.rpc(
    50→      "func_daily_task_stats"
    51→    );
    52→
    53→    // Task type name → bucket classification (derived from task_types table)
    54→    const IMAGE_GENERATED_TYPES = new Set([
    55→      "wan_2_2_t2i", "single_image", "qwen_image_style", "qwen_image",
    56→      "qwen_image_2512", "z_image_turbo",
    57→    ]);
    58→    const IMAGE_EDITED_TYPES = new Set([
    59→      "image_inpaint", "image_upscale", "image-upscale", "annotated_image_edit",
    60→      "edit_travel_flux", "magic_edit", "image_edit", "qwen_image_edit", "z_image_turbo_i2i",
    61→    ]);
    62→    const VIDEO_GENERATED_TYPES = new Set([

    64→      "join_clips_orchestrator", "travel_orchestrator", "edit_video_orchestrator",
    65→      "join_final_stitch",

    67→
    68→    let buckets: DayBucket[];
    69→
    70→    if (statsError || !dailyStats) {
    71→      logger.warn("RPC func_daily_task_stats not available, using direct query", {
    72→        error: statsError?.message,
    73→      });
    74→
    75→      // Paginate to fetch all completed tasks (default limit is 1000)
    76→      const PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
    77→      const allTasks: { created_at: string; task_type: string }[] = [];
    78→      let offset = 0;
    79→      while (true) {
    80→        const { data: page, error: rawError } = await supabaseAdmin
    81→          .from("tasks")

    95→      // Aggregate in memory
    96→      const dayMap = new Map<string, DayBucket>();

   137→      cumEdit += b.images_edited;
   138→      cumVid += b.videos_generated;
   139→      chartData.push({ date: b.date, images_generated: cumImg, images_edited: cumEdit, videos_generated: cumVid });
   140→    }
   141→
   142→    // Calculate yesterday's stats
   143→    const yesterday = new Date();
   144→    yesterday.setUTCDate(yesterday.getUTCDate() - 1);
   145→    const yesterdayStr = yesterday.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
   146→    const yesterdayStats = buckets.find((b) => b.date === yesterdayStr) || {
   147→      date: yesterdayStr,
   148→      images_generated: 0,
   149→      images_edited: 0,
   150→      videos_generated: 0,
   151→    };
   152→
   153→    // Calculate all-time totals
   154→    const totals = buckets.reduce(
   155→      (acc, b) => ({
   156→        images_generated: acc.images_generated + b.images_generated,
   157→        images_edited: acc.images_edited + b.images_edited,
   158→        videos_generated: acc.videos_generated + b.videos_generated,
   159→      }),
   160→      { images_generated: 0, images_edited: 0, videos_generated: 0 }
   161→    );
   162→
   163→    // Generate chart via QuickChart.io
   164→    const chartUrl = await generateChart(chartData, shouldAggregateWeekly);
   165→
   166→    // Format date for title
   167→    const titleDate = yesterday.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
   168→      month: "short",
   169→      day: "numeric",
   170→      year: "numeric",
   171→      timeZone: "UTC",
   172→    });
   173→
   174→    // Post to Discord
   175→    const embed = {
   176→      title: `Daily Stats — ${titleDate}`,
   177→      color: 0x6366f1, // indigo
   178→      fields: [
   179→        {
   180→          name: "Images Generated",
   181→          value: `**${yesterdayStats.images_generated.toLocaleString()}**`,
   182→          inline: true,
   183→        },
   184→        {
   185→          name: "Images Edited",
   186→          value: `**${yesterdayStats.images_edited.toLocaleString()}**`,
   187→          inline: true,
   188→        },
   189→        {
   190→          name: "Videos Generated",
   191→          value: `**${yesterdayStats.videos_generated.toLocaleString()}**`,
   192→          inline: true,
   193→        },
   194→      ],
   195→      image: chartUrl ? { url: chartUrl } : undefined,
   196→      footer: {
   197→        text: `All time: ${totals.images_generated.toLocaleString()} imgs generated · ${totals.images_edited.toLocaleString()} imgs edited · ${totals.videos_generated.toLocaleString()} videos`,
   198→      },
   199→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
   200→    };
   201→
   202→    const discordPayload = { embeds: [embed] };
   203→
   204→    const discordRes = await fetch(discordWebhookUrl, {
   205→      method: "POST",
   206→      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
   207→      body: JSON.stringify(discordPayload),
   208→    });
   209→
   210→    if (!discordRes.ok) {
   211→      const errText = await discordRes.text();
   212→      throw new Error(`Discord webhook failed (${discordRes.status}): ${errText}`);
   213→    }
   214→
   215→    logger.info("Discord message sent successfully", {
   216→      yesterday_images_gen: yesterdayStats.images_generated,
   217→      yesterday_images_edit: yesterdayStats.images_edited,
   218→      yesterday_videos: yesterdayStats.videos_generated,
   219→      chart_url: chartUrl,
   220→    });
   221→    await logger.flush();
   222→
   223→    return new Response(
   224→      JSON.stringify({
   225→        success: true,
   226→        yesterday: yesterdayStats,
   227→        totals,
   228→        chart_url: chartUrl,
   229→      }),
   230→      { status: 200, headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" } }
   231→    );
   232→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   233→    const message = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
   234→    logger.error("Failed to generate/send daily stats", { error: message });
   235→    await logger.flush();
   236→    return new Response(`Error: ${message}`, { status: 500 });
   237→  }
   238→});
   239→
   240→/**
   241→ * Aggregate daily buckets into weekly buckets (Mon-Sun weeks)
   242→ */
   243→function aggregateByWeek(buckets: DayBucket[]): DayBucket[] {
   244→  const weekMap = new Map<string, DayBucket>();
   245→
   246→  for (const bucket of buckets) {
   247→    const date = new Date(bucket.date + "T00:00:00Z");
   248→    // Get Monday of this week
   249→    const day = date.getUTCDay();
   250→    const diff = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day; // Monday = 1
   251→    const monday = new Date(date);
   252→    monday.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + diff);
   253→    const [REDACTED]().substring(0, 10);
   254→
   255→    if (!weekMap.has(weekKey)) {
   256→      weekMap.set(weekKey, { date: weekKey, images_generated: 0, images_edited: 0, videos_generated: 0 });
   257→    }
   258→    const week = weekMap.get(weekKey)!;
   259→    week.images_generated += bucket.images_generated;
   260→    week.images_edited += bucket.images_edited;
   261→    week.videos_generated += bucket.videos_generated;
   262→  }
   263→
   264→  return Array.from(weekMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
   265→}
   266→
   267→/**
   268→ * Generate a chart image URL via QuickChart.io
   269→ */
   270→async function generateChart(
   271→  data: DayBucket[],
   272→  _isWeekly: boolean
   273→): Promise<string | null> {
   274→  const labels = data.map((d) => {
   275→    const date = new Date(d.date + "T00:00:00Z");
   276→    return date.toLocaleDateString("en-US", {
   277→      month: "short",
   278→      day: "numeric",
   279→      timeZone: "UTC",
   280→    });
   281→  });
   282→
   283→  const chartConfig = {
   284→    type: "line",
   285→    data: {
   286→      labels,
   287→      datasets: [
   288→        {
   289→          label: "Images Generated",
   290→          data: data.map((d) => d.images_generated),
   291→          borderColor: COLORS.imagesGenerated.border,
   292→          backgroundColor: COLORS.imagesGenerated.bg.replace("0.85", "0.15"),
   293→          borderWidth: 2,
   294→          fill: true,
   295→          tension: 0.3,
   296→          pointRadius: 0,
   297→        },
   298→        {
   299→          label: "Images Edited",
   300→          data: data.map((d) => d.images_edited),
   301→          borderColor: COLORS.imagesEdited.border,
   302→          backgroundColor: COLORS.imagesEdited.bg.replace("0.85", "0.15"),
   303→          borderWidth: 2,
   304→          fill: true,
   305→          tension: 0.3,
   306→          pointRadius: 0,
   307→        },
   308→        {
   309→          label: "Videos Generated",
   310→          data: data.map((d) => d.videos_generated),
   311→          borderColor: COLORS.videosGenerated.border,
   312→          backgroundColor: COLORS.videosGenerated.bg.replace("0.85", "0.15"),
   313→          borderWidth: 2,
   314→          fill: true,
   315→          tension: 0.3,
   316→          pointRadius: 0,
   317→        },
   318→      ],
   319→    },
   320→    options: {
   321→      plugins: {
   322→        title: {
   323→          display: false,
   324→        },
   325→        legend: {
   326→          position: "bottom",
   327→          labels: {
   328→            color: "#cbd5e1",
   329→            padding: 16,
   330→            usePointStyle: true,
   331→            pointStyle: "circle",
   332→            font: { size: 11 },
   333→          },
   334→        },
   335→      },
   336→      scales: {

   338→          ticks: { color: "#64748b", maxRotation: 45, font: { size: 10 } },
   339→          grid: { display: false },
   340→        },
   341→        y: {
   342→          ticks: { color: "#64748b", font: { size: 10 } },
   343→          grid: { color: "rgba(148, 163, 184, 0.08)" },
   344→          beginAtZero: true,
   345→        },
   346→      },
   347→    },
   348→  };
   349→
   350→  try {
   351→    const res = await fetch("https://quickchart.io/chart/create", {
   352→      method: "POST",
   353→      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
   354→      body: JSON.stringify({
   355→        backgroundColor: "#1a1a2e",
   356→        width: 800,
   357→        height: 350,
   358→        format: "png",
   359→        chart: chartConfig,
   360→      }),
   361→    });
   362→
   363→    if (!res.ok) {
   364→      console.error(`${LOG_PREFIX} QuickChart error: ${res.status}`);
   365→      return null;
   366→    }
   367→
   368→    const result = await res.json();
   369→    return result.url || null;
   370→  } catch (err) {
   371→    console.error(`${LOG_PREFIX} QuickChart request failed:`, err);
   372→    return null;
   373→  }
   374→}
```

```
    69→
    70→  useEffect(() => {
    71→    if (isRunning && !hasInitializedRef.current) {
    72→      hasInitializedRef.current = true;
    73→      setStepIndex(0);
    74→      setIsPaused(false);
    75→      resetAllPaneLocks();
    76→    } else if (!isRunning) {
    77→      hasInitializedRef.current = false;
    78→    }
    79→  }, [isRunning, resetAllPaneLocks]);
    80→
    81→  return { stepIndex, setStepIndex, isPaused, setIsPaused };
    82→}
    83→
    84→function useSpotlightClickAdvance(input: {
    85→  isRunning: boolean;
    86→  isPaused: boolean;
    87→  stepIndex: number;
    88→  setStepIndex: (value: number) => void;
    89→  setIsPaused: (value: boolean) => void;
    90→  setIsTasksPaneLocked: (locked: boolean) => void;
    91→  scheduleTimeout: ScheduleTimeout;
    92→}) {
    93→  const {
    94→    isRunning,
    95→    isPaused,
    96→    stepIndex,
    97→    setStepIndex,
    98→    setIsPaused,
    99→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   100→    scheduleTimeout,
   101→  } = input;
   102→
   103→  useEffect(() => {
   104→    if (!isRunning || isPaused) {
   105→      return;
   106→    }
   107→
   108→    const currentStep = tourSteps[stepIndex];
   109→    if (!currentStep?.spotlightClicks) {
   110→      return;
   111→    }
   112→
   113→    const target = document.querySelector(currentStep.target as string);
   114→    if (!target) {
   115→      return;
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    const handleClick = () => {
   119→      const nextIndex = stepIndex + 1;
   120→
   121→      if (stepIndex === TOUR_STEPS.OPEN_FIRST_SHOT) {
   122→        pauseThenAdvance(nextIndex, setStepIndex, setIsPaused, LONG_DELAY_MS, scheduleTimeout);
   123→        return;
   124→      }
   125→
   126→      if (stepIndex === TOUR_STEPS.TASKS_PANE) {
   127→        setIsTasksPaneLocked(true);
   128→        pauseThenAdvance(nextIndex, setStepIndex, setIsPaused, SHORT_DELAY_MS, scheduleTimeout);
   129→        return;
   130→      }
   131→
   132→      if (stepIndex === TOUR_STEPS.OPEN_GALLERY || stepIndex === TOUR_STEPS.GENERATE_IMAGES) {
   133→        pauseThenAdvance(nextIndex, setStepIndex, setIsPaused, SHORT_DELAY_MS, scheduleTimeout);
   134→        return;
   135→      }
   136→
   137→      setStepIndex(nextIndex);
   138→    };
   139→
   140→    target.addEventListener('click', handleClick);
   141→    return () => target.removeEventListener('click', handleClick);
   142→  }, [isPaused, isRunning, scheduleTimeout, setIsPaused, setIsTasksPaneLocked, setStepIndex, stepIndex]);
   143→}
   144→
   145→function useJoyrideCallback(input: {
   146→  completeTour: () => void;
   147→  skipTour: () => void;
   148→  setIsGenerationsPaneLocked: (locked: boolean) => void;
   149→  setIsTasksPaneLocked: (locked: boolean) => void;
   150→  setStepIndex: (value: number) => void;
   151→  setIsPaused: (value: boolean) => void;
   152→  navigate: (path: string) => void;
   153→  scheduleTimeout: ScheduleTimeout;
   154→}) {
   155→  const {
   156→    completeTour,
   157→    skipTour,
   158→    setIsGenerationsPaneLocked,
   159→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   160→    setStepIndex,
   161→    setIsPaused,
   162→    navigate,
   163→    scheduleTimeout,
   164→  } = input;
   165→
   166→  return useCallback((data: CallBackProps) => {
   167→    const { status, index, type, action } = data;
   168→
   169→    if (type === EVENTS.STEP_AFTER || type === EVENTS.TARGET_NOT_FOUND) {
   170→      const nextIndex = index + (action === ACTIONS.PREV ? -1 : 1);
   171→
   172→      if (index === TOUR_STEPS.OPEN_GALLERY && action !== ACTIONS.PREV) {
   173→        setIsGenerationsPaneLocked(true);
   174→        pauseThenAdvance(nextIndex, setStepIndex, setIsPaused, SHORT_DELAY_MS, scheduleTimeout);
   175→      } else if (index === TOUR_STEPS.GALLERY_SECTION && action !== ACTIONS.PREV) {
   176→        setStepIndex(nextIndex);
   177→      } else if (index === TOUR_STEPS.GENERATE_IMAGES && action !== ACTIONS.PREV) {
   178→        dispatchTourEvent('openGenerationModal');
   179→        pauseThenAdvance(nextIndex, setStepIndex, setIsPaused, SHORT_DELAY_MS, scheduleTimeout);
   180→      } else if (index === TOUR_STEPS.HOW_IT_WORKS && action !== ACTIONS.PREV) {
   181→        dispatchTourEvent('closeGenerationModal');
   182→        setIsGenerationsPaneLocked(false);
   183→        setIsPaused(true);
   184→        scheduleTimeout(() => {
   185→          const waitForTarget = () => {
   186→            const target = document.querySelector('[data-tour="first-shot"]');
   187→            if (target) {
   188→              setStepIndex(nextIndex);
   189→              scheduleTimeout(() => setIsPaused(false), 100);
   190→            } else {
   191→              scheduleTimeout(waitForTarget, 100);
   192→            }
   193→          };
   194→          waitForTarget();
   195→        }, WAIT_FOR_TARGET_DELAY_MS);
   196→      } else if (index === TOUR_STEPS.OPEN_FIRST_SHOT && action !== ACTIONS.PREV) {
   197→        const firstShot = document.querySelector('[data-tour="first-shot"]') as HTMLElement;
   198→        if (firstShot) {
   199→          firstShot.click();
   200→        }
   201→        pauseThenAdvance(nextIndex, setStepIndex, setIsPaused, LONG_DELAY_MS, scheduleTimeout);
   202→      } else if (index === TOUR_STEPS.TASKS_PANE && action !== ACTIONS.PREV) {
   203→        setIsTasksPaneLocked(true);
   204→        pauseThenAdvance(nextIndex, setStepIndex, setIsPaused, SHORT_DELAY_MS, scheduleTimeout);
   205→      } else {
   206→        setStepIndex(nextIndex);
   207→      }
   208→    }
   209→
   210→    if (status === STATUS.FINISHED) {
   211→      completeTour();
   212→      navigate(TOOL_ROUTES.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES);
   213→    } else if (status === STATUS.SKIPPED) {
   214→      skipTour();
   215→    }
   216→  }, [
   217→    completeTour,
   218→    navigate,
   219→    setIsGenerationsPaneLocked,
   220→    setIsPaused,
   221→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   222→    setStepIndex,
   223→    scheduleTimeout,
   224→    skipTour,
   225→  ]);
   226→}
   227→
   228→export function ProductTour() {
   229→  const { isRunning, completeTour, skipTour } = useProductTour();
   230→  const { setIsGenerationsPaneLocked, setIsTasksPaneLocked, resetAllPaneLocks } = usePanes();
   231→  const navigate = useNavigate();
   232→  const { scheduleTimeout, clearScheduledTimeouts } = useManagedTimeouts();
   233→  const { stepIndex, setStepIndex, isPaused, setIsPaused } = useTourProgressState(
   234→    isRunning,
   235→    resetAllPaneLocks
   236→  );
   237→
   238→  useEffect(() => {
   239→    if (!isRunning) {
   240→      clearScheduledTimeouts();
   241→    }
   242→  }, [clearScheduledTimeouts, isRunning]);
   243→
   244→  useSpotlightClickAdvance({
   245→    isRunning,
   246→    isPaused,
   247→    stepIndex,
   248→    setStepIndex,
   249→    setIsPaused,
   250→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   251→    scheduleTimeout,
   252→  });
   253→
   254→  const handleCallback = useJoyrideCallback({
   255→    completeTour,
   256→    skipTour,
   257→    setIsGenerationsPaneLocked,
   258→    setIsTasksPaneLocked,
   259→    setStepIndex,
   260→    setIsPaused,
   261→    navigate,
   262→    scheduleTimeout,
   263→  });
   264→
   265→  if (!isRunning) {
   266→    return null;
   267→  }
   268→
   269→  return (
   270→    <Joyride
   271→      steps={tourSteps}
   272→      run={isRunning && !isPaused}
   273→      stepIndex={stepIndex}
   274→      continuous
   275→      scrollToFirstStep
   276→      showSkipButton
   277→      showProgress
   278→      disableCloseOnEsc={false}
   279→      disableOverlayClose
   280→      callback={handleCallback}
   281→      tooltipComponent={CustomTooltip}
   282→      styles={{
   283→        options: {
   284→          zIndex: 100010,
   285→          arrowColor: 'hsl(var(--background))',
   286→        },
   287→        spotlight: {
   288→          borderRadius: 8,
   289→          transition: 'opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease',
   290→        },
   291→        overlay: {
   292→          backgroundColor: 'hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.5)',
   293→          transition: 'opacity 0.3s ease',
   294→        },
   295→      }}
   296→      floaterProps={{
   297→        styles: {
   298→          floater: {
   299→            filter: 'drop-shadow(0 4px 12px hsl(0 0% 0% / 0.15))',
   300→            transition: 'opacity 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease',
   301→          },
   302→        },
   303→      }}
   304→    />
   305→  );
   306→}
```

```
   274→async function findSiblingSegments(

   294→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({

   298→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",

   312→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   313→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   314→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   315→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   316→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   317→      supabase,
   318→      taskType: finalStepType,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      select: "id, status",
   321→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   322→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   323→    });
   324→  }
   325→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   326→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   327→      supabase,
   328→      taskType: finalStepType,
   329→      projectId,
   330→      select: "id, status",
   331→      orchestratorTaskId,
   332→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   333→    });
   334→  }
   335→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   336→    return 'not_found';
   337→  }
   338→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   339→    return 'failed';
   340→  }
   341→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Complete')) {
   342→    return 'complete';
   343→  }
   344→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Queued' || task.status === 'In Progress')) {
   345→    return 'pending';
   346→  }
   347→  return 'unknown';
   348→}
   349→/**
   350→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   351→ */
   352→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   353→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   354→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   355→  failedSegments: number,
   356→  totalSegments: number,
   357→  errorMessage?: string,
   358→  logger?: {
   359→    warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   360→    error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   361→  },
   362→): Promise<void> {
   363→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   364→    .from("tasks")
   365→    .update({
   366→      status: "Failed",
   367→      error_message: errorMessage ?? `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   368→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   369→    })
   370→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   371→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   372→    .select('id');
   373→  if (updateOrchError) {
   374→    throw new CompletionError({
   375→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_failed_update_failed',
   376→      context: 'markOrchestratorFailed',
   377→      recoverable: true,
   378→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   379→      metadata: {
   380→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   381→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   382→          ? updateOrchError.message
   383→          : String(updateOrchError),
   384→      },
   385→      cause: updateOrchError,
   386→    });
   387→  }
   388→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   389→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   390→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   391→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   392→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   393→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   394→    });
   395→  }
   396→}
   397→/**
   398→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   399→ */
   400→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   401→  params: {
   402→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   403→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   404→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   405→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   406→    publicUrl: string;
   407→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   408→    supabaseUrl: string;
   409→    serviceKey: string;
   410→    logger?: {
   411→      warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   412→      error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   413→    };
   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {
   416→  const {
   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: "Complete",
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   438→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   439→  };
   440→  if (isFinalStep) {
   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   448→    .select('id');
   449→  if (updateOrchError) {
   450→    throw new CompletionError({
   451→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   452→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   453→      recoverable: true,
   454→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   455→      metadata: {
   456→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   457→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→    });
   469→    return;
   470→  }
   471→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   472→    supabaseUrl,
   473→    serviceKey,
   474→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   475→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   476→  });
   477→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   478→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   479→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   480→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   481→    supabase,
   482→    orchestratorTaskId,
   483→    existingResultData,
   484→    billingOutcome,
   485→    billingDecision,
   486→    logger,
   487→  );
   488→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   489→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   490→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   491→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   492→      billing_result: billingResult,
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→}
   496→
```
