   403→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   404→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   405→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   406→    publicUrl: string;
   407→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   408→    supabaseUrl: string;
   409→    serviceKey: string;
   410→    logger?: {
   411→      warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   412→      error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   413→    };
   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {
   416→  const {
   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: "Complete",
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   438→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   439→  };
   440→  if (isFinalStep) {
   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   448→    .select('id');
   449→  if (updateOrchError) {
   450→    throw new CompletionError({
   451→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   452→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   453→      recoverable: true,
   454→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   455→      metadata: {
   456→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   457→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→    });
   469→    return;
   470→  }
   471→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   472→    supabaseUrl,
   473→    serviceKey,
   474→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   475→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   476→  });
   477→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   478→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   479→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   480→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   481→    supabase,
   482→    orchestratorTaskId,
   483→    existingResultData,
   484→    billingOutcome,
   485→    billingDecision,
   486→    logger,
   487→  );
   488→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   489→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   490→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   491→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   492→      billing_result: billingResult,
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→}
   496→

    39→interface GenerationRef {

    46→
    47→interface CompletedTaskData {
    48→  category?: string;
    49→  task_type?: string;

    51→  project_id?: string;

    54→
    55→interface GenerationRouteParams {
    56→  basedOn: string | null;
    57→  createAsGeneration: boolean;
    58→  childGenerationId: string | null;
    59→  parentGenerationId: string | null;
    60→  childOrder: number | null;

    63→}
    64→
    65→interface GenerationHandlerContext {
    66→  supabase: SupabaseClient;
    67→  taskId: string;
    68→  taskData: CompletedTaskData;
    69→  publicUrl: string;
    70→  thumbnailUrl: string | null;
    71→  logger?: unknown;

    77→
    78→type GenerationRouteAttempt =
    79→  | 'variant_on_child'
    80→  | 'variant_on_parent'
    81→  | 'child_generation'
    82→  | 'standalone';
    83→
    84→function toGenerationRef(value: unknown): GenerationRef | null {
    85→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
    86→    return null;
    87→  }
    88→
    89→  const candidate = value as { id?: unknown };
    90→  if (typeof candidate.id !== 'string' || candidate.id.length === 0) {
    91→    return null;
    92→  }
    93→
    94→  return { id: candidate.id };
    95→}
    96→
    97→function normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData: unknown): CompletedTaskData {
    98→  const record = asObjectOrEmpty(taskData);
    99→  return {
   100→    category: typeof record.category === 'string' ? record.category : undefined,
   101→    task_type: typeof record.task_type === 'string' ? record.task_type : undefined,
   102→    tool_type: typeof record.tool_type === 'string' ? record.tool_type : undefined,
   103→    project_id: typeof record.project_id === 'string' ? record.project_id : undefined,
   104→    params: asObjectOrEmpty(record.params),
   105→  };
   106→}
   107→
   108→function getGenerationSkipReason(taskData: CompletedTaskData): GenerationSkipReason | null {
   109→  if (taskData.category === 'orchestration') {
   110→    return 'orchestration_task';
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  if (taskData.params.skip_generation === true) {
   114→    return 'skip_generation_flag';
   115→  }
   116→
   117→  return null;
   118→}
   119→
   120→function resolveGenerationRouteParams(taskData: CompletedTaskData): GenerationRouteParams {
   121→  const params = taskData.params;
   122→  const payloadSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   123→
   124→  const basedOn = extractBasedOn(params);
   125→  const createAsGeneration = (
   126→    params.create_as_generation === true
   127→    || payloadSnapshot.orchestrationContract.create_as_generation === true
   128→  );
   129→
   130→  const childGenerationId = resolveSnapshotChildGenerationId(payloadSnapshot);
   131→  const parentGenerationId = resolveSnapshotParentGenerationId(payloadSnapshot);
   132→  const childOrder = resolveSnapshotChildOrder(payloadSnapshot);
   133→  const isSingleItem = resolveSnapshotIsSingleItem(payloadSnapshot);
   134→
   135→  const isStitchTask = taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.TRAVEL_STITCH
   136→    || taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.JOIN_FINAL_STITCH;
   137→
   138→  return {
   139→    basedOn,
   140→    createAsGeneration,
   141→    childGenerationId,
   142→    parentGenerationId,
   143→    childOrder,
   144→    isSingleItem,
   145→    isStitchTask,
   146→  };
   147→}
   148→
   149→function classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams: GenerationRouteParams): GenerationRouteAttempt[] {
   150→  const attempts: GenerationRouteAttempt[] = [];
   151→
   152→  if (routeParams.childGenerationId) {
   153→    attempts.push('variant_on_child');
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  if (routeParams.isStitchTask && routeParams.parentGenerationId) {
   157→    attempts.push('variant_on_parent');
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  if (routeParams.parentGenerationId) {
   161→    attempts.push('child_generation');
   162→  }
   163→
   164→  attempts.push('standalone');
   165→  return attempts;
   166→}
   167→
   168→async function executeGenerationRouteAttempt(
   169→  attempt: GenerationRouteAttempt,
   170→  ctx: GenerationHandlerContext,
   171→): Promise<GenerationRef | null> {
   172→  switch (attempt) {
   173→    case 'variant_on_child':
   174→      return toGenerationRef(await handleVariantOnChild(ctx));
   175→    case 'variant_on_parent':
   176→      return toGenerationRef(await handleVariantOnParent(ctx));
   177→    case 'child_generation':
   178→      return toGenerationRef(await handleChildGeneration(ctx));
   179→    case 'standalone':
   180→      return toGenerationRef(await handleStandaloneGeneration(ctx));
   181→  }
   182→}
   183→
   184→/**
   185→ * Main function to create generation from completed task
   186→ *
   187→ * PARAMS-DRIVEN ROUTING - all 6 cases in one place:
   188→ * 1. Regeneration: existing generation for this task → add variant
   189→ * 2. Variant on source: based_on present → variant on that generation
   190→ * 3. Variant on child: child_generation_id present → variant on existing child
   191→ * 4. Stitch task: travel_stitch/join_final_stitch → variant on parent
   192→ * 5. Child generation: parent_generation_id present → child under parent
   193→ * 6. Standalone: neither → independent generation
   194→ *
   195→ * Single-item detection: is_single_item param OR (is_first_segment && is_last_segment)
   196→ * Child order: child_order OR segment_index OR join_index
   197→ */
   198→export async function createGenerationFromTask(
   199→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   200→  taskId: string,
   201→  taskData: unknown,
   202→  publicUrl: string,
   203→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   204→  logger?: unknown,
   205→  authContext: CompletionAuthContext,
   206→): Promise<GenerationCreationOutcome> {
   207→  assertCompletionAuthContext(authContext, 'createGenerationFromTask');
   208→
   209→  const normalizedTaskData = normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData);
   210→  const skipReason = getGenerationSkipReason(normalizedTaskData);
   211→  if (skipReason) {
   212→    return { status: 'skipped', reason: skipReason };
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  const routeParams = resolveGenerationRouteParams(normalizedTaskData);
   216→
   217→  logger?.debug("Generation routing", {
   218→    task_id: taskId,
   219→    based_on: routeParams.basedOn,
   220→    child_generation_id: routeParams.childGenerationId,
   221→    parent_generation_id: routeParams.parentGenerationId,
   222→    child_order: routeParams.childOrder,
   223→    is_single_item: routeParams.isSingleItem,
   224→    is_stitch_task: routeParams.isStitchTask,
   225→  });
   226→
   227→  try {
   228→    const existingGenerationRaw = await findExistingGeneration(supabase, taskId);
   229→    const existingGeneration = toGenerationRef(existingGenerationRaw);
   230→    if (existingGenerationRaw && !existingGeneration) {
   231→      throw new CompletionError({
   232→        code: 'generation_existing_shape_invalid',
   233→        context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   234→        recoverable: false,
   235→        message: `Existing generation lookup returned an invalid shape for task ${taskId}`,
   236→        metadata: { task_id: taskId },
   237→      });
   238→    }
   239→
   240→    if (existingGeneration) {
   241→      const generation = await handleRegeneration(
   242→        supabase,
   243→        taskId,
   244→        normalizedTaskData,
   245→        existingGeneration,
   246→        publicUrl,
   247→        thumbnailUrl,
   248→        logger,
   249→      );
   250→      return { status: 'created', generation };
   251→    }
   252→
   253→    if (routeParams.basedOn && !routeParams.createAsGeneration) {
   254→      const success = await handleVariantCreation(
   255→        supabase,
   256→        taskId,
   257→        normalizedTaskData,
   258→        routeParams.basedOn,
   259→        publicUrl,
   260→        thumbnailUrl,
   261→      );
   262→      if (success) {
   263→        return { status: 'created', generation: { id: routeParams.basedOn } };
   264→      }
   265→    }
   266→
   267→    const handlerContext: GenerationHandlerContext = {
   268→      supabase,
   269→      taskId,
   270→      taskData: normalizedTaskData,
   271→      publicUrl,
   272→      thumbnailUrl: thumbnailUrl || null,
   273→      logger,
   274→      childGenerationId: routeParams.childGenerationId ?? undefined,
   275→      parentGenerationId: routeParams.parentGenerationId ?? undefined,
   276→      childOrder: routeParams.childOrder,
   277→      isSingleItem: routeParams.isSingleItem,
   278→    };
   279→
   280→    for (const attempt of classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams)) {
   281→      const generation = await executeGenerationRouteAttempt(attempt, handlerContext);
   282→      if (generation) {
   283→        return { status: 'created', generation };
   284→      }
   285→    }
   286→
   287→    throw new CompletionError({
   288→      code: 'generation_route_no_result',
   289→      context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   290→      recoverable: false,
   291→      message: `No generation route produced a result for task ${taskId}`,
   292→      metadata: {
   293→        task_id: taskId,
   294→        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
   295→        route_attempts: classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams),
   296→      },
   297→    });
   298→
   299→  } catch (error) {
   300→    const normalizedError = toCompletionError(error, {
   301→      code: 'generation_completion_failed',
   302→      context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   303→      recoverable: true,
   304→      message: `Failed to create generation for task ${taskId}`,
   305→      metadata: {
   306→        task_id: taskId,
   307→        task_type: normalizedTaskData.task_type,
   308→      },
   309→    });
   310→    logger?.error("Error creating generation", {
   311→      task_id: taskId,
   312→      error: normalizedError.message,
   313→      error_code: normalizedError.code,
   314→      recoverable: normalizedError.recoverable,
   315→      error_context: normalizedError.context,
   316→      error_metadata: normalizedError.metadata,
   317→    });
   318→    throw normalizedError;
   319→  }
   320→}
   321→
   322→/**
   323→ * Handle regeneration case - task already has a generation, create new variant
   324→ */
   325→async function handleRegeneration(
   326→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   327→  taskId: string,
   328→  taskData: CompletedTaskData,
   329→  existingGeneration: GenerationRef,
   330→  publicUrl: string,
   331→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   332→  logger?: unknown
   333→): Promise<GenerationRef> {
   334→  logger?.info("Existing generation found - creating regenerated variant", {
   335→    task_id: taskId,
   336→    existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   337→    action: "create_regenerated_variant"
   338→  });
   339→
   340→  const variantParams = {
   341→    ...taskData.params,
   342→    source_task_id: taskId,
   343→    created_from: 'task_completion',
   344→    tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   345→  };
   346→
   347→  await createVariant(
   348→    supabase,
   349→    existingGeneration.id,
   350→    publicUrl,
   351→    thumbnailUrl || null,
   352→    variantParams,
   353→    true,
   354→    'regenerated',
   355→    null
   356→  );
   357→
   358→  const { shotId, addInPosition } = extractShotAndPosition(taskData.params);
   359→  if (shotId) {
   360→    await linkGenerationToShot(supabase, shotId, existingGeneration.id, addInPosition);
   361→  }
   362→
   363→  const { error: markGenerationCreatedError } = await supabase
   364→    .from('tasks')
   365→    .update({ generation_created: true })
   366→    .eq('id', taskId);
   367→
   368→  if (markGenerationCreatedError) {
   369→    throw new CompletionError({
   370→      code: 'regeneration_generation_created_update_failed',

   198→export async function createGenerationFromTask(

   322→/**
   323→ * Handle regeneration case - task already has a generation, create new variant
   324→ */
   325→async function handleRegeneration(
   326→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   327→  taskId: string,
   328→  taskData: CompletedTaskData,
   329→  existingGeneration: GenerationRef,
   330→  publicUrl: string,
   331→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,

   335→    task_id: taskId,
   336→    existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   337→    action: "create_regenerated_variant"
   338→  });
   339→
   340→  const variantParams = {
   341→    ...taskData.params,
   342→    source_task_id: taskId,
   343→    created_from: 'task_completion',
   344→    tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   345→  };

   348→    supabase,
   349→    existingGeneration.id,
   350→    publicUrl,
   351→    thumbnailUrl || null,
   352→    variantParams,

   354→    'regenerated',

   361→  }

   377→      },

   379→    });
   380→  }

   382→  return existingGeneration;
   383→}

   398→export function useInlineEditState(
   399→  media: GenerationRow,
   400→  onNavigateToGeneration?: (generationId: string) => Promise<void>,
   401→): InlineEditStateResult {
   402→  const env = useInlineEditEnvironment(media);
   403→  const persistence = useInlineEditPersistence(env.actualGenerationId, env.selectedProjectId);
   404→  const activeVariant = persistence.variants.activeVariant;
   405→  const effectiveImageUrl = activeVariant?.location || env.effectiveImageUrl;
   406→  useEffect(() => {
   407→    env.setUpscaleActiveVariant(activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id);
   408→  }, [env, activeVariant?.location, activeVariant?.id]);
   409→  const { data: availableLoras } = usePublicLoras();
   410→  const { inpainting, magic } = useInlineEditInpaintingAndMagic(media, env, persistence);
   411→  const reposition = useInlineEditReposition(media, env, inpainting, persistence);
   412→  const img2img = useInlineEditImg2Img(media, env, persistence, availableLoras);
   413→  useInlineEditSettingsSync(env.actualGenerationId, persistence.editSettings, inpainting);
   414→  const { sourceGenerationData } = useSourceGeneration({
   415→    media,
   416→    onOpenExternalGeneration: onNavigateToGeneration
   417→      ? async (id) => onNavigateToGeneration(id)
   418→      : undefined,
   419→  });
   420→  const starToggle = useStarToggle({ media });
   421→  const handleDownload = async () => {
   422→    await downloadMedia(effectiveImageUrl, media.id, env.isVideo, media.contentType);
   423→  };
   424→  const {
   425→    inpaintingState,
   426→    transformState,
   427→    generationState,
   428→    imageEditValue,
   429→  } = buildInlineEditStateModels({
   430→    env,
   431→    persistence,
   432→    inpainting,
   433→    magic,
   434→    reposition,
   435→    img2img,
   436→    starToggle,
   437→    handleDownload,
   438→  });
   439→  return {
   440→    media,
   441→    canvasEnvironment: {
   442→      isMobile: env.isMobile,
   443→      selectedProjectId: env.selectedProjectId,
   444→      isCloudMode: env.isCloudMode,
   445→      isVideo: env.isVideo,
   446→      imageContainerRef: env.imageContainerRef,
   447→      effectiveImageUrl,
   448→      imageDimensions: env.imageDimensions,
   449→      setImageDimensions: env.setImageDimensions,
   450→      isUpscaling: env.isUpscaling,
   451→      handleUpscale: env.handleUpscale,
   452→    },
   453→    inpaintingState,
   454→    transformState,
   455→    generationState,
   456→    variants: {
   457→      variants: persistence.variants.variants,
   458→      activeVariant: persistence.variants.activeVariant,
   459→      isLoading: persistence.variants.isLoading,
   460→      setActiveVariantId: persistence.variants.setActiveVariantId,
   461→      setPrimaryVariant: persistence.variants.setPrimaryVariant,
   462→      deleteVariant: persistence.variants.deleteVariant,
   463→    },
   464→    sourceGenerationData,
   465→    availableLoras,
   466→    imageEditValue,
   467→  } satisfies InlineEditStateResult;
   468→}

1→/**
     2→ * useLineageChain Hook
     3→ *
     4→ * Fetches the full lineage chain for a variant by following the `source_variant_id` field in params.
     5→ * Returns an array ordered from oldest ancestor to newest (the provided variant).
     6→ *
     7→ * Note: Lineage is tracked at the variant level via params.source_variant_id,
     8→ * not at the generation level via based_on.
     9→ */
    10→
    11→import { useQuery } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    12→import { getSupabaseClient } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    13→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    14→import { generationQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/generations';
    15→import {
    16→  resolveVariantProjectScope,
    17→  type VariantProjectScopeStatus,
    18→} from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskRepository';
    19→
    20→interface LineageItem {
    21→  id: string;
    22→  imageUrl: string;
    23→  thumbnailUrl: string | null;
    24→  createdAt: string;
    25→  type: 'variant';
    26→  variantType: string | null;
    27→}
    28→
    29→interface LineageChainResult {
    30→  chain: LineageItem[];
    31→  isLoading: boolean;
    32→  hasLineage: boolean;
    33→  error: LineageScopeError | null;
    34→}
    35→
    36→interface VariantRecord {
    37→  id: string;
    38→  generation_id: string;
    39→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null;

    41→  thumbnail_url: string | null;
    42→  created_at: string;
    43→  variant_type: string | null;
    44→}
    45→
    46→type LineageScopeFailureStatus = Exclude<VariantProjectScopeStatus, 'ok'>;
    47→
    48→class LineageScopeError extends Error {
    49→  readonly status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    50→  readonly variantId: string;
    51→  readonly projectId: string;
    52→  readonly queryError?: string;
    53→
    54→  constructor(params: {
    55→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
    56→    variantId: string;
    57→    projectId: string;
    58→    queryError?: string;
    59→    message: string;
    60→  }) {
    61→    super(params.message);
    62→    this.name = 'LineageScopeError';
    63→    this.status = params.status;
    64→    this.variantId = params.variantId;
    65→    this.projectId = params.projectId;
    66→    this.queryError = params.queryError;
    67→  }
    68→}
    69→
    70→function isLineageScopeError(error: unknown): error is LineageScopeError {
    71→  return error instanceof LineageScopeError;
    72→}
    73→
    74→function readSourceVariantId(params: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
    75→  return typeof params?.source_variant_id === 'string' ? params.source_variant_id : null;
    76→}
    77→
    78→function buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scopeStatus: string, queryError?: string): string {
    79→  switch (scopeStatus) {
    80→    case 'scope_mismatch':
    81→      return 'Variant exists but does not belong to the active project scope';
    82→    case 'missing_project_scope':
    83→      return 'Variant does not have project scope metadata';
    84→    case 'missing_variant':
    85→      return 'Variant not found';
    86→    case 'missing_generation':
    87→      return 'Variant generation was not found';
    88→    case 'query_failed':
    89→      return `Variant scope lookup failed${queryError ? `: ${queryError}` : ''}`;
    90→    default:
    91→      return `Variant scope validation failed (${scopeStatus})`;
    92→  }
    93→}
    94→
    95→function toLineageScopeError(
    96→  error: unknown,
    97→  fallback: {
    98→    variantId: string;
    99→    projectId: string;
   100→    status: LineageScopeFailureStatus;
   101→    queryError?: string;
   102→  },
   103→): LineageScopeError {
   104→  if (isLineageScopeError(error)) {
   105→    return error;
   106→  }
   107→
   108→  const message = error instanceof Error
   109→    ? error.message
   110→    : buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(fallback.status, fallback.queryError);
   111→
   112→  return new LineageScopeError({
   113→    ...fallback,
   114→    message,
   115→  });
   116→}

   118→async function fetchVariantById(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<VariantRecord> {
   119→  const scope = await resolveVariantProjectScope(variantId, projectId);
   120→  if (scope.status !== 'ok' || !scope.generationId) {
   121→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   122→      status: scope.status as LineageScopeFailureStatus,
   123→      variantId,
   124→      projectId,
   125→      queryError: scope.queryError,
   126→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage(scope.status, scope.queryError),
   127→    });
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseClient().from('generation_variants')
   131→    .select('id, generation_id, params, location, thumbnail_url, created_at, variant_type')
   132→    .eq('id', variantId)
   133→    .eq('generation_id', scope.generationId)
   134→    .single();
   135→
   136→  if (error) {
   137→    throw toLineageScopeError(error, {
   138→      status: 'query_failed',
   139→      variantId,
   140→      projectId,
   141→      queryError: error.message,
   142→    });
   143→  }
   144→
   145→  if (!data) {
   146→    throw new LineageScopeError({
   147→      status: 'missing_variant',
   148→      variantId,
   149→      projectId,
   150→      message: buildScopeValidationErrorMessage('missing_variant'),
   151→    });
   152→  }
   153→  return data as VariantRecord;
   154→}
   155→
   156→/**
   157→ * Recursively fetch the lineage chain for a variant.
   158→ * Follows `params.source_variant_id` across generation boundaries.
   159→ */
   160→async function fetchLineageChain(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<LineageItem[]> {
   161→  const chain: LineageItem[] = [];
   162→  const visited = new Set<string>();
   163→  let currentId: string | null = variantId;
   164→
   165→  while (currentId && !visited.has(currentId)) {
   166→    visited.add(currentId);
   167→    const variant = await fetchVariantById(currentId, projectId);
   168→
   169→    chain.unshift({
   170→      id: variant.id,
   171→      imageUrl: variant.location,
   172→      thumbnailUrl: variant.thumbnail_url,
   173→      createdAt: variant.created_at,
   174→      type: 'variant',
   175→      variantType: variant.variant_type,
   176→    });
   177→    currentId = readSourceVariantId(variant.params);
   178→  }
   179→
   180→  return chain;
   181→}
   182→
   183→/**
   184→ * Hook to fetch the full lineage chain for a variant.
   185→ *
   186→ * @param variantId - The variant ID to fetch lineage for
   187→ * @param projectId - Project scope required for lineage traversal
   188→ * @returns Object with chain (oldest to newest), loading state, and whether there's lineage
   189→ */
   190→export function useLineageChain(variantId: string | null, projectId: string | null): LineageChainResult {
   191→  const { data: chain = [], isLoading, error } = useQuery<LineageItem[], LineageScopeError>({
   192→    queryKey: [...generationQueryKeys.lineageChain(variantId!), projectId ?? '__no-project__'],
   193→    queryFn: async () => {
   194→      try {
   195→        return await fetchLineageChain(variantId!, projectId!);
   196→      } catch (caughtError) {
   197→        const normalizedError = toLineageScopeError(caughtError, {
   198→          status: 'query_failed',
   199→          variantId: variantId!,
   200→          projectId: projectId!,
   201→        });
   202→        normalizeAndPresentError(normalizedError, {
   203→          context: 'useLineageChain',
   204→          showToast: false,
   205→          logData: {
   206→            variantId: normalizedError.variantId,
   207→            projectId: normalizedError.projectId,
   208→            status: normalizedError.status,
   209→            queryError: normalizedError.queryError,
   210→          },
   211→        });
   212→        throw normalizedError;
   213→      }
   214→    },
   215→    enabled: !!variantId && !!projectId,
   216→    staleTime: 5 * 60 * 1000, // 5 minutes - lineage doesn't change
   217→    gcTime: 10 * 60 * 1000, // 10 minutes
   218→  });
   219→
   220→  return {
   221→    chain,
   222→    isLoading,
   223→    // Has lineage if chain has more than 1 item (the current variant + at least one ancestor)
   224→    hasLineage: chain.length > 1,
   225→    error: error ?? null,
   226→  };
   227→}
   228→
   229→/**
   230→ * Count the lineage chain length for a variant.
   231→ * Returns the number of ancestors (0 if no lineage, 1+ if has ancestors).
   232→ * This fetches directly without caching - use sparingly for initial checks.
   233→ *
   234→ * Reuses fetchLineageChain to avoid duplicating the traversal logic.
   235→ */
   236→export async function getLineageDepth(variantId: string, projectId: string): Promise<number> {
   237→  const chain = await fetchLineageChain(variantId, projectId);
   238→  // chain includes the variant itself; ancestors = chain length - 1
   239→  return Math.max(0, chain.length - 1);
   240→}
   241→
   242→// NOTE: Default export removed - use named export { useLineageChain } instead
   243→

1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)
     7→ * - Position calculation for drag-and-drop operations
     8→ *
     9→ * No React hooks or side effects - all functions are stateless.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/timeline/useTimelineCore';
    13→import { calculateAverageSpacing, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING } from '@/shared/lib/timelinePositionCalculator';
    14→
    15→/** Maximum allowed gap between timeline frames (5s at 16fps). */
    16→const MAX_FRAME_GAP = 81;
    17→
    18→// ============================================================================
    19→// Types
    20→// ============================================================================
    21→
    22→interface FrameUpdate {
    23→  id: string;
    24→  newFrame: number;
    25→  reason: string;
    26→}
    27→
    28→// ============================================================================
    29→// Normalization
    30→// ============================================================================
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    34→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    35→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop
    80→// ============================================================================
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Find a ShotGeneration by canonical shot_generations.id.
    84→ */
    85→export function findGeneration(
    86→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    87→  key?: string | null
    88→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    89→  if (!key) return undefined;
    90→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key);
    91→}
    92→
    93→interface DistributionContext {
    94→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];
    95→  draggedItemIds: string[];
    96→  newStartIndex: number;
    97→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    98→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   103→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).
   104→ */
   105→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   106→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   107→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];
   108→
   109→  const pushUpdate = (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => {
   110→    const normalizedFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame));
   111→    accumulateUpdates.push({ id, newFrame: normalizedFrame, reason });
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   115→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   116→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   117→
   118→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   119→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   120→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   121→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   122→    );
   123→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   124→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   125→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   126→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   127→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   128→
   129→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   130→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   131→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   132→    });
   133→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {
   134→    // At end - extend timeline using average spacing of existing items
   135→    const existingFrames = allItems
   136→      .filter(item => item.timeline_frame != null)
   137→      .map(item => item.timeline_frame!);
   138→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   139→
   140→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   141→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   142→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   143→    });
   144→  } else if (successor && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   145→    // At start - distribute between 0 and successor
   146→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame;
   147→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   148→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   149→
   150→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   151→      const newFrame = interval * (i + 1);
   152→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed from start (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   153→    });
   154→  } else {
   155→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);

1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)
     7→ * - Position calculation for drag-and-drop operations
     8→ *
     9→ * No React hooks or side effects - all functions are stateless.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/timeline/useTimelineCore';
    13→import { calculateAverageSpacing, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING } from '@/shared/lib/timelinePositionCalculator';
    14→
    15→/** Maximum allowed gap between timeline frames (5s at 16fps). */
    16→const MAX_FRAME_GAP = 81;
    17→
    18→// ============================================================================
    19→// Types
    20→// ============================================================================
    21→
    22→interface FrameUpdate {
    23→  id: string;
    24→  newFrame: number;
    25→  reason: string;
    26→}
    27→
    28→// ============================================================================
    29→// Normalization
    30→// ============================================================================
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    34→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    35→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop
    80→// ============================================================================
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Find a ShotGeneration by canonical shot_generations.id.
    84→ */
    85→export function findGeneration(
    86→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    87→  key?: string | null
    88→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    89→  if (!key) return undefined;
    90→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key);
    91→}
    92→
    93→interface DistributionContext {
    94→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];
    95→  draggedItemIds: string[];
    96→  newStartIndex: number;
    97→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    98→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   103→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).
   104→ */
   105→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   106→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   107→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];
   108→
   109→  const pushUpdate = (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => {
   110→    const normalizedFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame));
   111→    accumulateUpdates.push({ id, newFrame: normalizedFrame, reason });
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   115→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   116→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   117→
   118→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   119→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   120→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   121→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   122→    );
   123→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   124→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   125→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   126→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   127→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   128→
   129→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   130→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   131→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   132→    });
   133→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {
   134→    // At end - extend timeline using average spacing of existing items
   135→    const existingFrames = allItems
   136→      .filter(item => item.timeline_frame != null)
   137→      .map(item => item.timeline_frame!);
   138→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   139→
   140→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   141→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   142→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   143→    });
   144→  } else if (successor && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   145→    // At start - distribute between 0 and successor
   146→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame;
   147→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   148→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   149→
   150→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   151→      const newFrame = interval * (i + 1);
   152→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed from start (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   153→    });
   154→  } else {
   155→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   226→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   227→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   228→    }
   229→  });
   230→  return uniqueUpdates;
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   235→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   236→ */
   237→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   238→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   239→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   240→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   241→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   242→
   243→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   244→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   245→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   246→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   247→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   251→
   252→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   253→
   254→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   255→
   256→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   257→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   258→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   259→    if (existing) {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });
   261→    } else {
   262→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, payload);
   263→    }
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return uniqueUpdates;
   267→}

    52→      invalidCount += 1;
    53→      continue;
    54→    }

    60→      ...(typeof candidate.thumbnailUrl === 'string' && candidate.thumbnailUrl.length > 0

    63→      ...(typeof candidate.projectId === 'string' && candidate.projectId.length > 0

   141→      const scopedRecentClips = inMemoryPending.filter(
   142→        (clip) =>
   143→          now - clip.timestamp < PENDING_CLIPS_TTL_MS
   144→          && isPendingJoinClipInScope(clip, { projectId, userId }),
   145→      );

   147→        localStorage.removeItem(getPendingJoinClipsStorageKey(projectId, userId));
   148→        return operationSuccess([]);

   151→      const actions = await toPendingClipActions(scopedRecentClips, readVideoDuration);

   159→      .find((item) => typeof item.raw === 'string' && item.raw.length > 0);

   161→    if (!pendingSource || !pendingSource.raw) {
   162→      return operationSuccess([]);
   163→    }
   164→
   165→    const parsedPendingClips = parsePendingJoinClips(pendingSource.raw);
   166→    if (!parsedPendingClips) {
   167→      normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   168→        context: 'JoinClipsPage.pendingClipsInvalid',
   169→        showToast: false,
   170→        logData: { [REDACTED] },
   171→      });
   172→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   173→      return operationFailure(new Error('Invalid pending join clips payload'), {
   174→        policy: 'degrade',
   175→        errorCode: 'pending_join_clips_invalid_payload',
   176→        message: 'Invalid pending join clips payload',
   177→        recoverable: true,
   178→        cause: { [REDACTED] },
   179→      });
   180→    }
   181→
   182→    if (parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0) {

   189→          invalidEntries: parsedPendingClips.invalidCount,

   191→      });
   192→    }

   194→    const now = Date.now();
   195→    const recentClips = parsedPendingClips.entries.filter(

   197→    );
   198→    const scopedRecentClips = recentClips.filter((clip) =>
   199→      isPendingJoinClipInScope(clip, { projectId, userId }),
   200→    );
   201→
   202→    if (scopedRecentClips.length === 0) {
   203→      localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   204→      return operationSuccess([], {
   205→        ...(parsedPendingClips.invalidCount > 0 ? { policy: 'degrade' } : {}),
   206→      });
   207→    }
   208→

   210→
   211→    localStorage.removeItem(pendingSource.key);
   212→    return operationSuccess(actions, {

   217→    return operationFailure(error, {

   220→      message: 'Failed to consume pending join clips',

   222→      cause: error,
   223→    });
   224→  }
   225→}
   226→
   227→/**
   228→ * Apply pending clip actions to an existing clips array.
   229→ * Resolves each deferred action by filling the first available empty slot,
   230→ * or appending when no empty slots remain.
   231→ */
   232→export function applyPendingClipActions(
   233→  prevClips: VideoClip[],
   234→  actions: PendingClipAction[],
   235→): VideoClip[] {
   236→  let clips = [...prevClips];
   237→  // Track which indices have been filled by previous actions in this batch
   238→  const filledIndices = new Set<number>();
   239→
   240→  for (const action of actions) {
   241→    const emptyIndex = clips.findIndex(
   242→      (clip, idx) => !clip.url && !filledIndices.has(idx),
   243→    );
   244→
   245→    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
   246→      clips = clips.map((clip, idx) =>
   247→        idx === emptyIndex
   248→          ? {
   249→              ...clip,
   250→              url: action.clip.url,
   251→              posterUrl: action.clip.posterUrl,
   252→              durationSeconds: action.clip.durationSeconds,
   253→              loaded: false,
   254→              playing: false,
   255→              generationId: action.clip.generationId,
   256→            }
   257→          : clip,
   258→      );
   259→      filledIndices.add(emptyIndex);
   260→    } else {
   261→      clips = [...clips, action.clip];
   262→    }
   263→  }
   264→
   265→  return clips;
   266→}

     4→export interface TaskContext {

    22→export interface CompletionFollowUpIssue {

    27→
    28→function defaultErrorCode(status: number): string {
    29→  if (status === 401) return 'authentication_failed';
    30→  if (status === 403) return 'forbidden';
    31→  if (status === 404) return 'not_found';
    32→  if (status === 405) return 'method_not_allowed';
    33→  if (status === 429) return 'rate_limited';
    34→  if (status === 503) return 'service_unavailable';
    35→  if (status >= 500) return 'internal_server_error';
    36→  return 'request_failed';
    37→}
    38→
    39→export function completeTaskErrorResponse(
    40→  message: string,
    41→  status: number,
    42→  errorCode = defaultErrorCode(status),
    43→): Response {
    44→  return edgeErrorResponse(
    45→    {
    46→      errorCode,
    47→      message,
    48→      recoverable: status >= 500 || status === 429,
    49→    },
    50→    status,
    51→  );
    52→}
    53→
    54→function asObjectRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
    55→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
    56→    return {};
    57→  }
    58→  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
    59→}
    60→
    61→/**
    62→ * Best-effort mark a task as Failed so the UI can update immediately.
    63→ * Swallows errors — callers still return their own HTTP error response.
    64→ */
    65→export async function markTaskFailed(
    66→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
    67→  taskId: string,
    68→  errorMessage: string,
    69→): Promise<void> {
    70→  try {
    71→    await supabase.from("tasks").update({
    72→      status: "Failed",
    73→      error_message: errorMessage,
    74→      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    75→    }).eq("id", taskId).in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"]);
    76→  } catch {
    77→    // Best-effort — don't mask the original error
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→export async function persistCompletionFollowUpIssues(
    82→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
    83→  taskId: string,
    84→  existingResultData: unknown,
    85→  issues: CompletionFollowUpIssue[],
    86→): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: unknown }> {
    87→  if (issues.length === 0) {
    88→    return { ok: true };
    89→  }
    90→
    91→  const baseResultData = asObjectRecord(existingResultData);
    92→  const completionFollowUp = {
    93→    status: 'degraded',
    94→    recorded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    95→    issues,
    96→  };
    97→
    98→  const { error } = await supabase
    99→    .from('tasks')
   100→    .update({
   101→      result_data: {
   102→        ...baseResultData,
   103→        completion_follow_up: completionFollowUp,
   104→      },
   105→    })
   106→    .eq('id', taskId);
   107→
   108→  if (error) {
   109→    return { ok: false, error };
   110→  }
   111→
   112→  return { ok: true };
   113→}
   114→
   115→/**
   116→ * Fetch task context with all required fields for the completion flow.
   117→ * Uses a single query with FK join (tasks.task_type -> task_types.name).
   118→ * Returns null if task not found or on error.
   119→ */
   120→export async function fetchTaskContext(
   121→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   122→  taskId: string,
   123→  logger?: {
   124→    error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   125→  },
   126→): Promise<TaskContext | null> {
   127→  const { data: task, error } = await supabase
   128→    .from("tasks")
   129→    .select(`id, task_type, project_id, params, result_data, task_types!tasks_task_type_fkey(tool_type, category, content_type, variant_type)`)
   130→    .eq("id", taskId)
   131→    .single();
   132→
   133→  if (error || !task) {
   134→    logger?.error('Failed to fetch task context', {
   135→      task_id: taskId,
   136→      fetch_error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error),
   137→    });
   138→    return null;
   139→  }
   140→
   141→  const taskTypeInfo = task.task_types || {};
   142→
   143→  return {
   144→    id: task.id,
   145→    task_type: task.task_type,
   146→    project_id: task.project_id,
   147→    params: task.params || {},
   148→    result_data: task.result_data,
   149→    tool_type: taskTypeInfo.tool_type || 'unknown',
   150→    category: taskTypeInfo.category || 'unknown',
   151→    content_type: taskTypeInfo.content_type || 'image',
   152→    variant_type: taskTypeInfo.variant_type || null,
   153→  };
   154→}

     2→ * Shared utilities for extracting data from task params
     3→ *
     4→ * This module provides a single source of truth for parsing task parameters,
     5→ * ensuring consistent behavior across TasksPane, MediaLightbox, and other components.

    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Parse task params, handling both string and object formats
    18→ */
    19→export function parseTaskParams(params: string | Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): Record<string, unknown> {
    20→  if (!params) return {};
    21→  if (typeof params === 'string') {
    22→    try {
    23→      const parsed = JSON.parse(params);
    24→      return asRecord(parsed) ?? {};
    25→    } catch {
    26→      return {};
    27→    }
    28→  }
    29→  return asRecord(params) ?? {};
    30→}
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Derive input images from task params
    34→ *
    35→ * For segment tasks (has segment_index): Only returns segment-specific images
    36→ * For orchestrated tasks: Returns all images from orchestrator
    37→ * For other tasks: Checks various image field locations
    38→ *
    39→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
    40→ * @returns Array of image URLs
    41→ */
    42→export function deriveInputImages(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
    43→  const params = parsedParams;
    44→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
    45→    const travelImages = deriveTravelInputImages(params);
    46→    if (travelImages.length > 0) {
    47→      return travelImages;
    48→    }
    49→  }
    50→
    51→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
    52→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
    53→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
    54→
    55→  // Check if this is a segment task (individual segment of a larger generation)
    56→  const isSegmentTask = params?.segment_index !== undefined;
    57→
    58→  // For segment tasks, ONLY use segment-specific images (not the full orchestrator list)
    59→  if (isSegmentTask) {
    60→    // Priority: individual_segment_params > top-level input_image_paths_resolved
    61→    if (Array.isArray(segmentParams?.input_image_paths_resolved) && segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.length > 0) {
    62→      return segmentParams.input_image_paths_resolved.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string');
    63→    }
    64→    // Fallback to start/end image URLs
    65→    if (segmentParams?.start_image_url || segmentParams?.end_image_url) {
    66→      const urls: string[] = [];
    67→      if (typeof segmentParams?.start_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.start_image_url);
    68→      if (typeof segmentParams?.end_image_url === 'string') urls.push(segmentParams.end_image_url);
    69→      return urls;
    70→    }

   102→
   103→/**
   104→ * Extract prompt from task params

   107→ * For orchestrated tasks: Checks orchestrator details
   108→ * For other tasks: Falls back to top-level prompt
   109→ *
   110→ * Prefers enhanced_prompts_expanded over base_prompts_expanded when available,
   111→ * as enhanced prompts contain the AI-improved version of the user's prompt.
   112→ *
   113→ * @param parsedParams - Already-parsed task params object
   114→ * @returns The prompt string or null
   115→ */
   116→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   117→  const params = parsedParams;
   118→  if (isTravelTaskParams(params)) {
   119→    return deriveTravelPrompt(params);
   120→  }
   121→
   122→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   123→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   124→  const segmentParams = asRecord(params.individual_segment_params);
   125→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   126→
   127→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   128→
   129→  // For segment tasks, try to get enhanced prompt first
   130→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   131→    // Check for enhanced prompt - can be singular field or in expanded array
   132→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   133→    const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   134→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   135→      segmentParams?.enhanced_prompt,
   136→      params.enhanced_prompt,
   137→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[segmentIndex],
   138→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[segmentIndex],
   139→    );
   140→    if (enhancedPrompt) return enhancedPrompt;
   141→
   142→    // Fall back to base prompt
   143→    return (
   144→      pickFirstString(
   145→        segmentParams?.base_prompt,
   146→        params.base_prompt,
   147→        params.prompt,
   148→        orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   149→      ) ?? null
   150→    );
   151→  }
   152→
   153→  // For full timeline/orchestrated tasks
   154→  // The global base_prompt is what the user typed in the prompt field.
   155→  // Per-pair overrides (base_prompts_expanded) are segment-specific and shouldn't
   156→  // be shown as the task-level prompt — they're misleading when the user explicitly
   157→  // cleared the global prompt.
   158→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails = asStringArray(orchestratorDetails?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   159→  const enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload = asStringArray(orchestratorPayload?.enhanced_prompts_expanded);
   160→  return (
   161→    pickFirstString(
   162→      orchestratorDetails?.base_prompt,
   163→      orchestratorPayload?.base_prompt,
   164→      params.base_prompt,
   165→      params.prompt,
   166→      // Fall back to enhanced prompts (AI-improved) but NOT base_prompts_expanded
   167→      // which are per-pair overrides, not task-level prompts.
   168→      enhancedFromOrchestratorDetails?.[0],
   169→      enhancedFromOrchestratorPayload?.[0],
   170→    ) ?? null
   171→  );
   172→}

   174→/**
   175→ * Check if a task type is an image edit task
   176→ */
   177→export function isImageEditTaskType(taskType: string | undefined): boolean {
   178→  const IMAGE_EDIT_TASK_TYPES = [
   179→    'z_image_turbo_i2i',
   180→    'image_inpaint',
   181→    'qwen_image_edit',
   182→    'magic_edit',
   183→    'kontext_image_edit',
   184→    'flux_image_edit',
   185→    'annotated_image_edit',
   186→  ];
   187→  return IMAGE_EDIT_TASK_TYPES.includes(taskType || '');
   188→}
   189→
   190→/**
   191→ * Check if a task type is a video enhancement task
   192→ */
   193→export function isVideoEnhanceTaskType(taskType: string | undefined): boolean {
   194→  return taskType === 'video_enhance';
   195→}
   196→
   197→/**
   198→ * Check if a task type is an image enhancement/upscale task

   204→/**
   205→ * LoRA info extracted from task params
   206→ */
   207→interface LoraInfo {
   208→  url: string;
   209→  strength: number;
   210→  displayName: string;
   211→}
   212→
   213→/**
   214→ * Extract LoRAs from task params (checks multiple locations)
   215→ */
   216→export function extractLoras(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): LoraInfo[] {
   217→  const params = parsedParams;
   218→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   219→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   220→
   221→  // Check for array format (image edit tasks use this)
   222→  const lorasArray = params.loras || orchestratorDetails?.loras || orchestratorPayload?.loras;
   223→  if (Array.isArray(lorasArray) && lorasArray.length > 0) {
   224→    return lorasArray
   225→      .map((lora): LoraInfo | null => {
   226→        const loraRecord = asRecord(lora);
   227→        if (!loraRecord) return null;
   228→        const url = asString(loraRecord.url) ?? '';
   229→        const parsedStrength = toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.strength) ?? toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.multiplier) ?? 1;
   230→        return {
   231→          url,
   232→          strength: parsedStrength,
   233→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   234→        };
   235→      })
   236→      .filter((lora): lora is LoraInfo => lora !== null);
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  // Check for object format (video tasks use additional_loras)
   240→  const additionalLoras = params.additional_loras || orchestratorDetails?.additional_loras || orchestratorPayload?.additional_loras;
   241→  if (additionalLoras && typeof additionalLoras === 'object' && Object.keys(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   242→    return Object.entries(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).map(([url, strength]) => ({
   243→      url,
   244→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   245→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   246→    }));
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return [];
   250→}
   251→
   252→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {
   253→  const fileName = url.split('/').pop() || 'Unknown';
   254→  return fileName.replace(/\.(safetensors|ckpt|pt)$/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
   255→}
   256→
   257→const TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   258→  'individualSegmentParams',
   259→  'taskViewContract',
   260→  'familyContract',
   261→  'rawParams',
   262→];
   263→
   264→const TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   265→  'taskViewContract',
   266→  'familyContract',
   267→  'orchestratorDetails',
   268→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   269→  'rawParams',
   270→];
   271→
   272→const TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   273→  'taskViewContract',
   274→  'familyContract',
   275→  'individualSegmentParams',
   276→  'orchestratorDetails',
   277→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   278→  'rawParams',
   279→];
   280→
   281→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   282→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));
   283→}
   284→
   285→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
   286→  const familyContract = asRecord(params.task_family_contract);
   287→  return (
   288→    params.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   289→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   290→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   291→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   292→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   293→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   294→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   295→  );
   296→}
   297→
   298→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   299→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   300→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   301→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   302→
   303→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   304→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   306→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   307→    }
   308→
   309→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   310→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   311→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   312→  }
   313→
   314→  const timelineSources = [
   315→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   316→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   317→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   318→  ];
   319→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {
   320→    if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {
   321→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(candidate);
   322→    }
   323→  }
   324→
   325→  return [];
   326→}
   327→
   328→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   329→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   330→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   331→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   332→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   333→
   334→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   335→    const enhancedPromptsExpanded = reader.pickStringArray('enhanced_prompts_expanded', [
   336→      'orchestratorDetails',
   337→      'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   338→      'rawParams',
   339→    ]);
   340→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   341→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   342→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   343→    );
   344→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   345→      return enhancedPrompt;
   346→    }
   347→
   348→    return (
   349→      pickFirstString(
   350→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   351→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   352→      ) ?? null
   353→    );
   354→  }
   355→
   356→  return (
   357→    pickFirstString(
   358→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   359→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   360→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   361→    ) ?? null
   362→  );
   363→}
   364→
   365→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   366→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   367→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   368→  return numeric;
   369→}
   370→
   371→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   372→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   373→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   374→}

   229→        const parsedStrength = toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.strength) ?? toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.multiplier) ?? 1;
   230→        return {
   231→          url,
   232→          strength: parsedStrength,
   233→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   234→        };
   235→      })
   236→      .filter((lora): lora is LoraInfo => lora !== null);
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  // Check for object format (video tasks use additional_loras)
   240→  const additionalLoras = params.additional_loras || orchestratorDetails?.additional_loras || orchestratorPayload?.additional_loras;
   241→  if (additionalLoras && typeof additionalLoras === 'object' && Object.keys(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   242→    return Object.entries(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).map(([url, strength]) => ({
   243→      url,
   244→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   245→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   246→    }));
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return [];
   250→}
   251→
   252→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {
   253→  const fileName = url.split('/').pop() || 'Unknown';
   254→  return fileName.replace(/\.(safetensors|ckpt|pt)$/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
   255→}
   256→
   257→const TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   258→  'individualSegmentParams',
   259→  'taskViewContract',
   260→  'familyContract',
   261→  'rawParams',
   262→];
   263→
   264→const TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   265→  'taskViewContract',
   266→  'familyContract',
   267→  'orchestratorDetails',
   268→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   269→  'rawParams',
   270→];
   271→
   272→const TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   273→  'taskViewContract',
   274→  'familyContract',
   275→  'individualSegmentParams',
   276→  'orchestratorDetails',
   277→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   278→  'rawParams',
   279→];
   280→
   281→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   282→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));
   283→}
   284→
   285→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
   286→  const familyContract = asRecord(params.task_family_contract);
   287→  return (
   288→    params.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   289→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   290→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   291→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   292→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   293→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   294→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   295→  );
   296→}
   297→
   298→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   299→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   300→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   301→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   302→
   303→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   304→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   306→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   307→    }
   308→
   309→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   310→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   311→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   312→  }
   313→
   314→  const timelineSources = [
   315→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   316→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   317→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   318→  ];
   319→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {
   320→    if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {
   321→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(candidate);
   322→    }
   323→  }
   324→
   325→  return [];
   326→}
   327→
   328→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   329→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   330→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   331→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   332→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   333→
   334→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   335→    const enhancedPromptsExpanded = reader.pickStringArray('enhanced_prompts_expanded', [
   336→      'orchestratorDetails',
   337→      'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   338→      'rawParams',
   339→    ]);
   340→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   341→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   342→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   343→    );
   344→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   345→      return enhancedPrompt;
   346→    }
   347→
   348→    return (
   349→      pickFirstString(
   350→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   351→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   352→      ) ?? null
   353→    );
   354→  }
   355→
   356→  return (
   357→    pickFirstString(
   358→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   359→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   360→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   361→    ) ?? null
   362→  );
   363→}
   364→
   365→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   366→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   367→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   368→  return numeric;
   369→}
   370→
   371→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   372→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   373→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   374→}
