     3→type SettingsScopeIdentifier = 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
     4→type SettingsScopeTableName = 'users' | 'projects' | 'shots';
     5→
     6→export function resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier): SettingsScopeTableName {
     7→  switch (scope) {
     8→    case 'user':
     9→      return 'users';
    10→    case 'project':
    11→      return 'projects';
    12→    case 'shot':
    13→      return 'shots';
    14→  }

    17→export function selectSettingsForScope(scope: SettingsScopeIdentifier, id: string) {
    18→  const tableName = resolveSettingsScopeTable(scope);
    19→  return getSupabaseClient()
    20→    .from(tableName)
    21→    .select('settings')
    22→    .eq('id', id)
    23→    .single();
    24→}
    25→
    26→export function callUpdateToolSettingsAtomicRpc(
    27→  tableName: SettingsScopeTableName,

    31→) {

   232→export function applyPendingClipActions(
   233→  prevClips: VideoClip[],
   234→  actions: PendingClipAction[],
   235→): VideoClip[] {
   236→  let clips = [...prevClips];
   237→  // Track which indices have been filled by previous actions in this batch
   238→  const filledIndices = new Set<number>();
   239→
   240→  for (const action of actions) {
   241→    const emptyIndex = clips.findIndex(
   242→      (clip, idx) => !clip.url && !filledIndices.has(idx),
   243→    );
   244→
   245→    if (emptyIndex !== -1) {
   246→      clips = clips.map((clip, idx) =>
   247→        idx === emptyIndex
   248→          ? {
   249→              ...clip,
   250→              url: action.clip.url,
   251→              posterUrl: action.clip.posterUrl,
   252→              durationSeconds: action.clip.durationSeconds,
   253→              loaded: false,
   254→              playing: false,
   255→              generationId: action.clip.generationId,
   256→            }
   257→          : clip,
   258→      );
   259→      filledIndices.add(emptyIndex);
   260→    } else {
   261→      clips = [...clips, action.clip];
   262→    }
   263→  }
   264→
   265→  return clips;

   190→      // 30s - 2 minutes: 30s polling
   191→      pollingInterval = 30_000;
   192→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 5 * 60_000) {
   193→      // 2-5 minutes: 45s polling
   194→      pollingInterval = 45_000;
   195→    } else {
   196→      // >5 minutes: 60s polling (realtime probably has issues)
   197→      pollingInterval = 60_000;
   198→    }
   199→
   200→    return pollingInterval;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  /**
   204→   * Report a fetch failure for circuit breaker tracking
   205→   */
   206→  onFetchFailure(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, error: Error) {
   207→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   208→    const now = Date.now();
   209→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   210→
   211→    // Reset count if last failure was too long ago
   212→    const shouldReset = existing && (now - existing.lastFailure) > this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS;
   213→
   214→    const newCount = shouldReset ? 1 : (existing?.count || 0) + 1;
   215→    this.state.fetchFailures.set(key, { count: newCount, lastFailure: now });
   216→
   217→    const isCircuitBreakerTriggered = newCount >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   218→
   219→    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);
   220→
   221→    // Notify subscribers so polling intervals can adjust
   222→    if (isCircuitBreakerTriggered) {
   223→      this.notifySubscribers();
   224→
   225→      // Show user-facing error toast (throttled to prevent spam)
   226→      if (now - this.lastErrorToastTime > this.ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) {
   227→        this.lastErrorToastTime = now;
   228→
   229→        this.reportCircuitBreakerError({
   230→          queryKey: key,
   231→          failureCount: newCount,
   232→          errorType,
   233→          error,
   234→        });
   235→      }
   236→    }
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  private reportCircuitBreakerError(input: {
   240→    queryKey: string;
   241→    failureCount: number;
   242→    errorType: string;
   243→    error: Error;
   244→  }) {
   245→    const userMessage = this.getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(input.errorType, input.failureCount);
   246→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Data may be outdated. Will retry automatically.'), {
   247→      context: 'DataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure',
   248→      toastTitle: userMessage,
   249→      showToast: true,
   250→      logData: {
   251→        [REDACTED](input.queryKey),
   252→        failureCount: input.failureCount,
   253→        errorType: input.errorType,
   254→        errorMessage: input.error.message,
   255→      },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  /**
   260→   * Get a user-friendly error message based on error type
   261→   */
   262→  private getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(errorType: string, failureCount: number): string {
   263→    switch (errorType) {
   264→      case 'CONNECTION_CLOSED':
   265→      case 'NETWORK_ERROR':
   266→        return 'Connection issue detected';
   267→      case 'TIMEOUT':
   268→        return 'Server is slow to respond';
   269→      case 'RATE_LIMITED':
   270→        return 'Too many requests - slowing down';
   271→      case 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE':
   272→        return 'Service temporarily unavailable';
   273→      case 'AUTH_ERROR':
   274→        return 'Authentication issue - try refreshing';
   275→      default:
   276→        return `Connection issues (${failureCount} failures)`;
   277→    }
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Report a successful fetch (resets circuit breaker)
   282→   */
   283→  onFetchSuccess(queryKey: QueryKeyLike) {
   284→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   285→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   286→
   287→    if (existing && existing.count > 0) {
   288→      // Reset failure count on success
   289→      this.state.fetchFailures.delete(key);
   290→    }
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  /**
   294→   * Classify error type for better logging and handling
   295→   */
   296→  private classifyError(error: Error): string {
   297→    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
   298→
   299→    if (message.includes('connection_closed') || message.includes('err_connection_closed')) {
   300→      return 'CONNECTION_CLOSED';
   301→    }
   302→    if (message.includes('failed to fetch') || message.includes('network')) {
   303→      return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
   304→    }
   305→    if (message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('timed out')) {
   306→      return 'TIMEOUT';
   307→    }
   308→    if (message.includes('abort')) {
   309→      return 'ABORTED';
   310→    }
   311→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {
   312→      return 'AUTH_ERROR';
   313→    }
   314→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   315→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   316→    }
   317→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   318→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   321→  }
   322→
   323→  /**
   324→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   325→   */
   326→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   327→    return isQueryFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey, freshnessThreshold, Date.now());
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   332→   */
   333→  getDiagnostics() {
   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }
   364→
   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}
   385→
   386→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   387→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();
   388→
   389→/** Dev-only helper for wiring debug globals during app bootstrap. */
   390→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {
   391→  if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {

   395→  registerDebugGlobal(
   396→    '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__',
   397→    dataFreshnessManager,
   398→    'DataFreshnessManager',
   399→  );
   400→}

1→type ManagedDebugGlobalKey =
     2→  | '__supabase_client__'
     3→  | 'supabase'
     4→  | '__RECONNECT_SCHEDULER__'
     5→  | '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__';
     6→
     7→interface ActiveRegistration {
     8→  owner: string;
     9→  value: unknown;
    10→}
    11→
    12→const activeRegistrations = new Map<ManagedDebugGlobalKey, ActiveRegistration>();
    13→
    14→function hasWindow(): boolean {
    15→  return typeof window !== 'undefined';
    16→}
    17→
    18→export function registerDebugGlobal<K extends ManagedDebugGlobalKey>(
    19→  key: K,
    20→  value: NonNullable<Window[K]>,
    21→  owner: string,
    22→): () => void {
    23→  if (!hasWindow()) {
    24→    return () => {};
    25→  }
    26→
    27→  const globalWindow = window as Window;
    28→  const hadPrevious = Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(globalWindow, key);
    29→  const previousValue = globalWindow[key];
    30→  const previousRegistration = activeRegistrations.get(key) ?? null;
    31→
    32→  globalWindow[key] = value;
    33→  activeRegistrations.set(key, { owner, value });
    34→
    35→  let disposed = false;
    36→  return () => {
    37→    if (disposed || !hasWindow()) {
    38→      return;
    39→    }
    40→    disposed = true;
    41→
    42→    const currentRegistration = activeRegistrations.get(key);
    43→    if (!currentRegistration || currentRegistration.value !== value) {
    44→      return;
    45→    }
    46→
    47→    if (previousRegistration) {
    48→      globalWindow[key] = previousRegistration.value as Window[K];
    49→      activeRegistrations.set(key, previousRegistration);
    50→      return;
    51→    }
    52→
    53→    if (hadPrevious) {
    54→      globalWindow[key] = previousValue as Window[K];
    55→    } else {
    56→      delete (globalWindow as Partial<Record<ManagedDebugGlobalKey, unknown>>)[key];
    57→    }
    58→
    59→    activeRegistrations.delete(key);
    60→  };
    61→}
    62→
    63→export function getDebugGlobal<K extends ManagedDebugGlobalKey>(key: K): Window[K] | undefined {
    64→  if (!hasWindow()) {
    65→    return undefined;
    66→  }
    67→  return (window as Window)[key];
    68→}
    69→
    70→export function getDebugGlobalOwner([REDACTED]): string | null {
    71→  return activeRegistrations.get(key)?.owner ?? null;
    72→}
    73→

   332→  } = input;
   333→
   334→  const effectiveSettings = getSettings();

   348→    buildParams,
   349→    reportNonFatalError: onNonFatalError,

   356→    context: errorContext,

   358→    create: async () => {

     2→ * Shared billing utilities for edge functions
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes:
     5→ *  - Orchestrator/sub-task detection (extractOrchestratorRef, isSubTask)
     6→ *  - Sub-task query filter for Supabase `.or()` calls

     9→ * Consumers: calculate-task-cost, update-task-status, complete_task

    13→import { readEdgeErrorCode } from './edgeRequest.ts';
    14→import {
    15→  operationFailure,

    20→interface TaskQueryResponse {
    21→  data: unknown[] | null;
    22→  error: unknown;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface TaskQueryBuilder extends PromiseLike<TaskQueryResponse> {
    26→  eq(column: string, value: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    27→  or(filter: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    28→}
    29→
    30→interface TaskQueryClient {
    31→  from(table: string): {
    32→    select(columns: string): TaskQueryBuilder;
    33→  };
    34→}
    35→
    36→// ===== Constants =====
    37→
    38→/** UUID v4 regex — used to distinguish real orchestrator FK refs from human-readable IDs */
    39→export const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
    40→
    41→// ===== Orchestrator reference extraction =====
    42→
    43→/**
    44→ * Extract orchestrator_task_id from task params.
    45→ *
    46→ * Sub-tasks can store the orchestrator reference in multiple param paths
    47→ * depending on the task type and how they were created:
    48→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id_ref          (travel_segment)
    49→ *  - params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id  (join_clips_segment)
    50→ *  - params.originalParams.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id (legacy)
    51→ *  - params.orchestrator_task_id              (some legacy tasks)
    52→ *
    53→ * Returns the raw string value (may not be a valid UUID) or null.
    54→ */
    55→export function extractOrchestratorRef(params: unknown): string | null {
    56→  const contractOrReferencePath = extractOrchestratorRefFromParams(params);
    57→  if (contractOrReferencePath) {
    58→    return contractOrReferencePath;
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  if (!params || typeof params !== 'object') return null;
    62→
    63→  const p = params as Record<string, unknown>;
    64→  const details = p.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    65→  const originalParams = p.originalParams as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    66→  const originalDetails = originalParams?.orchestrator_details as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
    67→
    68→  return (
    69→    (p.orchestrator_task_id_ref as string) ||
    70→    (details?.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    71→    (originalDetails?.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    72→    (p.orchestrator_task_id as string) ||
    73→    null
    74→  );
    75→}
    76→
    77→/**
    78→ * Determine whether a task is a sub-task of an orchestrator.
    79→ *
    80→ * A task is a sub-task when:
    81→ *  1. Its params contain an orchestrator reference (via any of the known paths)
    82→ *  2. That reference is a valid UUID (not a human-readable orchestrator ID)
    83→ *  3. The reference is NOT the task's own ID (orchestrators store their own ID
    84→ *     in params.orchestrator_details.orchestrator_task_id for children to copy)
    85→ *
    86→ * @param params  - task.params (object, not stringified)
    87→ * @param taskId  - the task's own ID, to guard against self-references
    88→ * @returns The orchestrator task ID if this is a sub-task, or null otherwise
    89→ */
    90→export function getSubTaskOrchestratorId(params: unknown, taskId: string): string | null {
    91→  const ref = extractOrchestratorRef(params);
    92→  if (!ref) return null;
    93→  if (!UUID_REGEX.test(ref)) return null;
    94→  if (ref === taskId) return null;
    95→  return ref;
    96→}
    97→
    98→// ===== Sub-task query filter =====
    99→
   100→/**
   101→ * Build a Supabase PostgREST `.or()` filter string that finds all tasks
   102→ * whose params reference the given orchestrator task ID.
   103→ *
   104→ * Covers all four param paths where a sub-task may store the reference.
   105→ *
   106→ * Usage:
   107→ *   supabase.from('tasks').select('...').or(buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorId))
   108→ */
   109→export function buildSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   110→  return [
   111→    buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId),
   112→    buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId),
   113→  ].join(',');
   114→}
   115→
   116→export function buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   117→  return buildOrchestratorRefOrFilter(orchestratorTaskId);
   118→}
   119→
   120→export function buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId: string): string {
   121→  return [
   122→    `params->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   123→    `params->originalParams->orchestrator_details->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   124→    `params->>orchestrator_task_id.eq.${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   125→  ].join(',');
   126→}
   127→
   128→export interface CompletedSubTaskRow {
   129→  id: string;
   130→  generation_started_at: string | null;
   131→  generation_processed_at: string | null;
   132→  status: string;
   133→}
   134→
   135→export type SubTaskLookupStage = 'canonical' | 'legacy';
   136→
   137→export class SubTaskLookupError extends Error {
   138→  readonly code = 'subtask_lookup_failed';
   139→  readonly stage: SubTaskLookupStage;
   140→  readonly cause?: unknown;
   141→
   142→  constructor(stage: SubTaskLookupStage, cause: unknown) {
   143→    super(`[Billing] Failed to query ${stage} sub-task references`);
   144→    this.name = 'SubTaskLookupError';
   145→    this.stage = stage;
   146→    this.cause = cause;
   147→  }
   148→}
   149→
   150→export async function lookupCompletedSubTasksForOrchestrator(
   151→  supabaseAdmin: TaskQueryClient,
   152→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   153→): Promise<CompletedSubTaskRow[]> {
   154→  const canonicalResult = await supabaseAdmin
   155→    .from('tasks')
   156→    .select(`
   157→      id,
   158→      generation_started_at,
   159→      generation_processed_at,
   160→      status
   161→    `)
   162→    .or(buildCanonicalSubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   163→    .eq('status', 'Complete');
   164→
   165→  if (canonicalResult.error) {
   166→    throw new SubTaskLookupError('canonical', canonicalResult.error);
   167→  }
   168→
   169→  const canonicalTasks = (canonicalResult.data ?? []) as CompletedSubTaskRow[];
   170→  if (canonicalTasks.length > 0) {
   171→    return canonicalTasks;
   172→  }
   173→
   174→  const legacyResult = await supabaseAdmin
   175→    .from('tasks')
   176→    .select(`
   177→      id,
   178→      generation_started_at,
   179→      generation_processed_at,
   180→      status
   181→    `)
   182→    .or(buildLegacySubTaskFilter(orchestratorTaskId))
   183→    .eq('status', 'Complete');
   184→
   185→  if (legacyResult.error) {
   186→    throw new SubTaskLookupError('legacy', legacyResult.error);
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  const legacyTasks = (legacyResult.data ?? []) as CompletedSubTaskRow[];
   190→  if (legacyTasks.length > 0) {
   191→    return legacyTasks;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  return [];
   195→}
   196→
   197→// ===== Cost calculation trigger =====
   198→
   199→/**
   200→ * Trigger the calculate-task-cost edge function for a given task.
   201→ *
   202→ * Returns an explicit outcome so callers can branch on billing success/failure.
   203→ *
   204→ * @param supabaseUrl - The Supabase project URL
   205→ * @param serviceKey  - The service role key for authentication
   206→ * @param taskId      - The task ID to calculate cost for
   207→ * @param logTag      - Optional log tag prefix (default: 'CostCalc')
   208→ */
   209→export interface CostCalculationTriggerValue {
   210→  status: number | null;
   211→  skipped?: boolean;
   212→  cost?: number;
   213→}
   214→
   215→export type CostCalculationTriggerResult = OperationResult<CostCalculationTriggerValue>;
   216→
   217→function isObjectRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
   218→  return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
   219→}
   220→
   221→function parseJsonRecord(text: string): Record<string, unknown> | null {
   222→  if (!text.trim()) {
   223→    return null;
   224→  }
   225→  try {
   226→    const parsed = JSON.parse(text);
   227→    return isObjectRecord(parsed) ? parsed : null;
   228→  } catch {
   229→    return null;
   230→  }
   231→}
   232→
   233→export async function triggerCostCalculation(
   234→  params: {
   235→    supabaseUrl: string;
   236→    serviceKey: string;
   237→    taskId: string;
   238→    logTag?: string;
   239→  },
   240→): Promise<CostCalculationTriggerResult> {
   241→  const {
   242→    supabaseUrl,
   243→    serviceKey,
   244→    taskId,
   245→    logTag = 'CostCalc',
   246→  } = params;
   247→  try {
   248→    const costResp = await fetch(`${supabaseUrl}/functions/v1/calculate-task-cost`, {
   249→      method: "POST",
   250→      headers: {
   251→        "Authorization": `Bearer ${serviceKey}`,
   252→        "Content-Type": "application/json"
   253→      },
   254→      body: JSON.stringify({ task_id: taskId })
   255→    });
   256→
   257→    if (costResp.ok) {
   258→      const bodyText = await costResp.text();
   259→      const costData = parseJsonRecord(bodyText);
   260→      if (!costData) {
   261→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an invalid success payload`), {
   262→          policy: 'degrade',
   263→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   264→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an invalid success payload`,
   265→          recoverable: true,
   266→          cause: { status: costResp.status },
   267→        });
   268→      }
   269→
   270→      const costErrorCode = readEdgeErrorCode(costData);
   271→      if (costErrorCode) {
   272→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an error payload`), {
   273→          policy: 'degrade',
   274→          errorCode: costErrorCode,
   275→          message: typeof costData.message === 'string'
   276→            ? costData.message
   277→            : `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned an error payload`,
   278→          recoverable: true,
   279→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   280→        });
   281→      }
   282→
   283→      const skipped = costData.skipped === true;
   284→      const successFlag = costData.success;
   285→      if (!skipped && successFlag !== true) {
   286→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned success status without success=true`), {
   287→          policy: 'degrade',
   288→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   289→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation returned success status without success=true`,
   290→          recoverable: true,
   291→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   292→        });
   293→      }
   294→
   295→      const costValue = costData.cost;
   296→      if (!skipped && (typeof costValue !== 'number' || !Number.isFinite(costValue))) {
   297→        return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] Cost calculation success payload missing numeric cost`), {
   298→          policy: 'degrade',
   299→          errorCode: 'cost_calculation_invalid_response',
   300→          message: `[${logTag}] Cost calculation success payload missing numeric cost`,
   301→          recoverable: true,
   302→          cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: costData },
   303→        });
   304→      }
   305→
   306→      return operationSuccess(
   307→        {
   308→          status: costResp.status,
   309→          skipped,
   310→          cost: typeof costValue === 'number' && Number.isFinite(costValue)
   311→            ? costValue
   312→            : undefined,
   313→        },
   314→        { policy: 'best_effort' },
   315→      );
   316→    }
   317→
   318→    const errTxt = await costResp.text();
   319→    const errPayload = parseJsonRecord(errTxt);
   320→    const errorCode = readEdgeErrorCode(errPayload) ?? 'cost_calculation_failed';
   321→    const message = typeof errPayload?.message === 'string'
   322→      ? errPayload.message
   323→      : (errTxt || 'Cost calculation failed');
   324→    return operationFailure(new Error(message), {
   325→      policy: 'degrade',
   326→      errorCode,
   327→      message,
   328→      recoverable: costResp.status >= 500,
   329→      cause: { status: costResp.status, payload: errPayload ?? errTxt },
   330→    });
   331→  } catch (costErr) {
   332→    const message = costErr instanceof Error ? costErr.message : String(costErr);
   333→    return operationFailure(new Error(`[${logTag}] ${message}`), {
   334→      policy: 'degrade',
   335→      errorCode: 'cost_calculation_request_error',
   336→      message: `[${logTag}] ${message}`,
   337→      recoverable: true,
   338→      cause: costErr,
   339→    });
   340→  }
   341→}
   342→

     3→ *

    65→  /**

    92→  onProjectChange(projectId: string | null): void {

    98→
    99→    // Clear queue

   102→    // Clear load tracker (single source of truth for what's loaded)
   103→    const clearedCount = clearAllLoadedImages('project switch');

   105→    this.state.currentProjectId = projectId;

   163→  resume(): void {

   167→

   176→  async preloadImages(

1→/**
     2→ * DataFreshnessManager - Single source of truth for data freshness and polling decisions
     3→ *
     4→ * This class centralizes all decisions about:
     5→ * - Whether data is fresh (based on realtime events)
     6→ * - What polling intervals React Query should use
     7→ * - Realtime connection health status
     8→ */
     9→
    10→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    11→import { registerDebugGlobal } from '@/shared/runtime/debugRegistry';
    12→
    13→type QueryKeyLike = readonly unknown[];
    14→type RealtimeStatus = 'connected' | 'disconnected' | 'error';
    15→type PollingInterval = number | false; // false = no polling
    16→type FreshnessSubscriber = () => void;
    17→
    18→function serializeQueryKey(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): string {
    19→  return JSON.stringify(queryKey);
    20→}
    21→
    22→function markQueryKeysFresh(
    23→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    24→  queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[],
    25→  now: number,
    26→): void {
    27→  queryKeys.forEach((queryKey) => {
    28→    lastEventTimes.set(serializeQueryKey(queryKey), now);
    29→  });
    30→}
    31→
    32→function getLastEventTime(
    33→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    34→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    35→): number | undefined {
    36→  return lastEventTimes.get(serializeQueryKey(queryKey));
    37→}
    38→
    39→function isQueryFresh(
    40→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    41→  queryKey: QueryKeyLike,
    42→  freshnessThreshold: number,
    43→  now: number,
    44→): boolean {
    45→  const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(lastEventTimes, queryKey);
    46→  if (!lastEvent) {
    47→    return false;
    48→  }
    49→  return now - lastEvent < freshnessThreshold;
    50→}
    51→
    52→function buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(
    53→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>,
    54→  now: number,
    55→  parseQueryKey: (rawKey: string) => unknown,
    56→): Array<{ query: unknown; ageMs: number; ageSec: number }> {
    57→  return Array.from(lastEventTimes.entries()).map(([key, time]) => ({
    58→    query: parseQueryKey(key),
    59→    ageMs: now - time,
    60→    ageSec: Math.round((now - time) / 1000),
    61→  }));
    62→}
    63→
    64→interface DataFreshnessState {
    65→  realtimeStatus: RealtimeStatus;
    66→  lastEventTimes: Map<string, number>;
    67→  lastStatusChange: number;
    68→  /** Track consecutive fetch failures per query for circuit breaker */
    69→  fetchFailures: Map<string, { count: number; lastFailure: number }>;
    70→}
    71→
    72→class DataFreshnessManager {
    73→  private state: DataFreshnessState = {
    74→    realtimeStatus: 'disconnected',
    75→    lastEventTimes: new Map(),
    76→    lastStatusChange: Date.now(),
    77→    fetchFailures: new Map()
    78→  };
    79→
    80→  private subscribers = new Set<FreshnessSubscriber>();
    81→
    82→  // Circuit breaker settings
    83→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD = 3; // failures before backing off
    84→  private readonly CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS = 60_000; // 1 minute to reset failure count
    85→
    86→  // Toast throttling - prevent spamming error toasts
    87→  private lastErrorToastTime = 0;
    88→  private readonly ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS = 30_000; // Only show error toast every 30 seconds
    89→
    90→  private parseQueryKey(rawKey: string): unknown {
    91→    try {
    92→      return JSON.parse(rawKey);
    93→    } catch {
    94→      return rawKey;
    95→    }
    96→  }
    97→
    98→  /**
    99→   * Report realtime connection status change
   100→   */
   101→  onRealtimeStatusChange(status: RealtimeStatus, _reason?: string) {
   102→    const previousStatus = this.state.realtimeStatus;
   103→    const now = Date.now();
   104→
   105→    // Ignore duplicate status changes to keep lastStatusChange stable.
   106→    // This allows the "recently connected" grace period in getPollingInterval to actually expire.
   107→    if (previousStatus === status) {
   108→      return; // Don't update state or notify subscribers for duplicates
   109→    }
   110→
   111→    // Actual status transition - update state
   112→    this.state.realtimeStatus = status;
   113→    this.state.lastStatusChange = now;
   114→
   115→    // Notify all subscribers that polling intervals may have changed
   116→    this.notifySubscribers();
   117→  }
   118→
   119→  /**
   120→   * Report that realtime events were received for specific queries
   121→   */
   122→  onRealtimeEvent(_eventType: string, affectedQueries: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   123→    const now = Date.now();
   124→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, affectedQueries, now);
   125→
   126→    // Notify subscribers that data freshness has changed
   127→    this.notifySubscribers();
   128→  }
   129→
   130→  /**
   131→   * Get the appropriate polling interval for a query
   132→   * Returns false to disable polling when realtime is working well
   133→   */
   134→  getPollingInterval(queryKey: QueryKeyLike): PollingInterval {
   135→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   136→    const lastEvent = getLastEventTime(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey);
   137→    const now = Date.now();
   138→    const timeSinceStatusChange = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   139→
   140→    // If realtime is connected, trust it after it's been stable
   141→    if (this.state.realtimeStatus === 'connected') {
   142→      // If realtime just connected (< 30 seconds), give it time to prove it's stable
   143→      if (timeSinceStatusChange < 30000) {
   144→        return 30000; // 30 seconds - wait for realtime to prove it's stable
   145→      }
   146→
   147→      // If realtime has been stable for >30 seconds, trust it.
   148→      // "No events" just means "nothing changed" — not "realtime is broken".
   149→
   150→      if (lastEvent) {
   151→        const eventAge = now - lastEvent;
   152→
   153→        if (eventAge < 60000) { // Events within 1 minute
   154→          return false; // Disable polling — realtime is working
   155→        } else if (eventAge < 3 * 60 * 1000) { // Events within 3 minutes
   156→          return 60000; // 60 seconds - light backup polling
   157→        }
   158→      }
   159→
   160→      // Realtime stable for >30s but no events — this is normal when idle.
   161→      // Use very light polling as a safety net only.
   162→      if (timeSinceStatusChange > 5 * 60 * 1000) {
   163→        // Realtime been stable for >5 minutes - fully trust it
   164→        return false; // Disable polling — realtime is stable, idle is OK
   165→      } else {
   166→        // Realtime stable for 30s-5min - use safety net polling
   167→        return 60000; // 60 seconds - safety net while realtime proves long-term stability
   168→      }
   169→    }
   170→
   171→    // If realtime is disconnected or errored, use GRADUATED backoff polling
   172→    // to prevent thundering herd and connection overload
   173→    const disconnectedDuration = now - this.state.lastStatusChange;
   174→
   175→    // Check circuit breaker - if this query has had many failures, back off more
   176→    const failureInfo = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   177→    const hasRecentFailures = failureInfo &&
   178→      (now - failureInfo.lastFailure) < this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS &&
   179→      failureInfo.count >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   180→
   181→    let pollingInterval: number;
   182→
   183→    if (hasRecentFailures) {
   184→      // Circuit breaker triggered - use much longer interval
   185→      pollingInterval = 60_000; // 60 seconds
   186→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 30_000) {
   187→      // First 30 seconds: 15s polling (give realtime time to reconnect)
   188→      pollingInterval = 15_000;
   189→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 2 * 60_000) {
   190→      // 30s - 2 minutes: 30s polling
   191→      pollingInterval = 30_000;
   192→    } else if (disconnectedDuration < 5 * 60_000) {
   193→      // 2-5 minutes: 45s polling
   194→      pollingInterval = 45_000;
   195→    } else {
   196→      // >5 minutes: 60s polling (realtime probably has issues)
   197→      pollingInterval = 60_000;
   198→    }
   199→
   200→    return pollingInterval;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  /**
   204→   * Report a fetch failure for circuit breaker tracking
   205→   */
   206→  onFetchFailure(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, error: Error) {
   207→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   208→    const now = Date.now();
   209→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   210→
   211→    // Reset count if last failure was too long ago
   212→    const shouldReset = existing && (now - existing.lastFailure) > this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_RESET_MS;
   213→
   214→    const newCount = shouldReset ? 1 : (existing?.count || 0) + 1;
   215→    this.state.fetchFailures.set(key, { count: newCount, lastFailure: now });
   216→
   217→    const isCircuitBreakerTriggered = newCount >= this.CIRCUIT_BREAKER_THRESHOLD;
   218→
   219→    const errorType = this.classifyError(error);
   220→
   221→    // Notify subscribers so polling intervals can adjust
   222→    if (isCircuitBreakerTriggered) {
   223→      this.notifySubscribers();
   224→
   225→      // Show user-facing error toast (throttled to prevent spam)
   226→      if (now - this.lastErrorToastTime > this.ERROR_TOAST_THROTTLE_MS) {
   227→        this.lastErrorToastTime = now;
   228→
   229→        this.reportCircuitBreakerError({
   230→          queryKey: key,
   231→          failureCount: newCount,
   232→          errorType,
   233→          error,
   234→        });
   235→      }
   236→    }
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  private reportCircuitBreakerError(input: {
   240→    queryKey: string;
   241→    failureCount: number;
   242→    errorType: string;
   243→    error: Error;
   244→  }) {
   245→    const userMessage = this.getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(input.errorType, input.failureCount);
   246→    normalizeAndPresentError(new Error('Data may be outdated. Will retry automatically.'), {
   247→      context: 'DataFreshnessManager.onFetchFailure',
   248→      toastTitle: userMessage,
   249→      showToast: true,
   250→      logData: {
   251→        [REDACTED](input.queryKey),
   252→        failureCount: input.failureCount,
   253→        errorType: input.errorType,
   254→        errorMessage: input.error.message,
   255→      },
   256→    });
   257→  }
   258→
   259→  /**
   260→   * Get a user-friendly error message based on error type
   261→   */
   262→  private getUserFriendlyErrorMessage(errorType: string, failureCount: number): string {
   263→    switch (errorType) {
   264→      case 'CONNECTION_CLOSED':
   265→      case 'NETWORK_ERROR':
   266→        return 'Connection issue detected';
   267→      case 'TIMEOUT':
   268→        return 'Server is slow to respond';
   269→      case 'RATE_LIMITED':
   270→        return 'Too many requests - slowing down';
   271→      case 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE':
   272→        return 'Service temporarily unavailable';
   273→      case 'AUTH_ERROR':
   274→        return 'Authentication issue - try refreshing';
   275→      default:
   276→        return `Connection issues (${failureCount} failures)`;
   277→    }
   278→  }
   279→
   280→  /**
   281→   * Report a successful fetch (resets circuit breaker)
   282→   */
   283→  onFetchSuccess(queryKey: QueryKeyLike) {
   284→    const [REDACTED](queryKey);
   285→    const existing = this.state.fetchFailures.get(key);
   286→
   287→    if (existing && existing.count > 0) {
   288→      // Reset failure count on success
   289→      this.state.fetchFailures.delete(key);
   290→    }
   291→  }
   292→
   293→  /**
   294→   * Classify error type for better logging and handling
   295→   */
   296→  private classifyError(error: Error): string {
   297→    const message = error.message?.toLowerCase() || '';
   298→
   299→    if (message.includes('connection_closed') || message.includes('err_connection_closed')) {
   300→      return 'CONNECTION_CLOSED';
   301→    }
   302→    if (message.includes('failed to fetch') || message.includes('network')) {
   303→      return 'NETWORK_ERROR';
   304→    }
   305→    if (message.includes('timeout') || message.includes('timed out')) {
   306→      return 'TIMEOUT';
   307→    }
   308→    if (message.includes('abort')) {
   309→      return 'ABORTED';
   310→    }
   311→    if (message.includes('401') || message.includes('unauthorized')) {
   312→      return 'AUTH_ERROR';
   313→    }
   314→    if (message.includes('429') || message.includes('rate limit')) {
   315→      return 'RATE_LIMITED';
   316→    }
   317→    if (message.includes('503') || message.includes('service unavailable')) {
   318→      return 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE';
   319→    }
   320→    return 'UNKNOWN';
   321→  }
   322→
   323→  /**
   324→   * Check if data for a query is considered fresh
   325→   */
   326→  isDataFresh(queryKey: QueryKeyLike, freshnessThreshold: number = 30000): boolean {
   327→    return isQueryFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKey, freshnessThreshold, Date.now());
   328→  }
   329→
   330→  /**
   331→   * Get current freshness state for debugging
   332→   */
   333→  getDiagnostics() {
   334→    const now = Date.now();
   335→    return {
   336→      realtimeStatus: this.state.realtimeStatus,
   337→      timeSinceStatusChange: now - this.state.lastStatusChange,
   338→      trackedQueries: this.state.lastEventTimes.size,
   339→      queryAges: buildQueryAgeDiagnostics(this.state.lastEventTimes, now, this.parseQueryKey),
   340→      subscriberCount: this.subscribers.size,
   341→      timestamp: now
   342→    };
   343→  }
   344→
   345→  /**
   346→   * Subscribe to freshness changes
   347→   * Returns unsubscribe function
   348→   */
   349→  subscribe(callback: () => void): () => void {
   350→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   351→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   352→  }
   353→
   354→  /**
   355→   * Clear all event history (useful for testing or project changes)
   356→   */
   357→  reset() {
   358→    this.state.lastEventTimes.clear();
   359→    this.state.fetchFailures.clear();
   360→    this.state.realtimeStatus = 'disconnected';
   361→    this.state.lastStatusChange = Date.now();
   362→    this.notifySubscribers();
   363→  }
   364→
   365→  /**
   366→   * Manually mark queries as fresh (useful for mutations)
   367→   */
   368→  markQueriesFresh(queryKeys: readonly QueryKeyLike[]) {
   369→    const now = Date.now();
   370→    markQueryKeysFresh(this.state.lastEventTimes, queryKeys, now);
   371→
   372→    this.notifySubscribers();
   373→  }
   374→
   375→  private notifySubscribers() {
   376→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   377→      try {
   378→        callback();
   379→      } catch (error) {
   380→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'DataFreshnessManager', showToast: false });
   381→      }
   382→    });
   383→  }
   384→}
   385→
   386→// Singleton instance - single source of truth for the entire app
   387→export const dataFreshnessManager = new DataFreshnessManager();
   388→
   389→/** Dev-only helper for wiring debug globals during app bootstrap. */
   390→export function registerDataFreshnessManagerDebugGlobal(): void {
   391→  if (!import.meta.env.DEV || typeof window === 'undefined') {
   392→    return;
   393→  }
   394→
   395→  registerDebugGlobal(
   396→    '__DATA_FRESHNESS_MANAGER__',
   397→    dataFreshnessManager,

    64→      example = formData.get("example") as string || "";
    65→      existingValue = formData.get("existingValue") as string || "";
    66→
    67→      if (!audioFile) {
    68→        return jsonResponse({ error: "audio file is required" }, 400);
    69→      }
    70→
    71→      logger.info('Received audio file', { name: audioFile.name, size: audioFile.size, type: audioFile.type });
    72→    }
    73→    
    74→    if (existingValue) {
    75→      logger.info('Existing value provided', { chars: existingValue.length });
    76→    }
    77→
    78→    // Determine transcribed text - either from audio or use text instructions directly
    79→    let transcribedText: string;
    80→    
    81→    if (textInstructions) {
    82→      // Skip transcription - use text instructions directly
    83→      transcribedText = textInstructions;
    84→    } else if (audioFile) {
    85→      // Step 1: Transcribe audio using Whisper
    86→      const transcription = await groq.audio.transcriptions.create({
    87→        file: audioFile,
    88→        model: "whisper-large-v3-turbo",
    89→        temperature: 0,
    90→        response_format: "verbose_json",
    91→      });
    92→
    93→      transcribedText = transcription.text?.trim() || "";
    94→      logger.info('Transcription complete', { preview: transcribedText.substring(0, 100) });
    95→
    96→      if (!transcribedText) {
    97→        return jsonResponse({ error: "No speech detected in audio" }, 400);
    98→      }
    99→
   100→      // If task is just transcribe, return the raw text
   101→      if (task === "transcribe_only") {
   102→        return jsonResponse({ 
   103→          success: true, 
   104→          transcription: transcribedText,
   105→          usage: null 
   106→        });
   107→      }
   108→    } else {
   109→      return jsonResponse({ error: "Either audio file or textInstructions is required" }, 400);
   110→    }
   111→
   112→    // Step 2: Use the transcription to write a prompt
   113→    const systemMsg = `You are a helpful assistant that transforms spoken instructions into appropriate text for AI generation fields. You interpret the user's INTENT, not just their literal words.
   114→
   115→Key skill: Recognize when users are giving INSTRUCTIONS vs LITERAL CONTENT:
   116→- "blur, distortion, and similar quality issues" → User wants a LIST of quality issues, expand it
   117→- "something like a sunset over mountains" → User is describing what they want, elaborate on it
   118→- "make it more dramatic" → User wants you to modify existing content
   119→- "a woman walking through a forest" → This IS the content, transform it into a good prompt
   120→- "just write: a cat sitting on a windowsill" → User wants EXACT text, transcribe literally
   121→
   122→Sometimes users want direct transcription without enhancement. If they say "just", "exactly", "literally", or similar, output their words verbatim.`;
   123→
   124→    let userMsg = `Transform this spoken input into appropriate text for the given context.
   125→
   126→SPOKEN INPUT: "${transcribedText}"
   127→${existingValue ? `
   128→EXISTING CONTENT IN FIELD: "${existingValue}"
   129→(The user may want to modify, extend, or replace this based on their spoken input)
   130→` : ""}
   131→${context ? `CONTEXT (important - this tells you what kind of field this is):
   132→${context}
   133→
   134→` : ""}${example ? `EXAMPLE of what good output looks like for this field:
   135→"${example}"
   136→
   137→` : ""}INTERPRETATION GUIDELINES:
   138→- CRITICAL: Interpret the user's INTENT, not just literal words
   139→- If they say "X, Y, and similar things" or "stuff like X" or "things like X" → Generate an expanded list of similar items
   140→- If they say "and so on" or "etc" or "that kind of thing" → Expand with more examples
   141→- If they give examples followed by ellipsis or trailing off → They want more of the same type
   142→- If they're describing a scene or subject → Transform into a well-crafted prompt
   143→- If they're giving modification instructions → Apply those to the existing content
   144→${existingValue ? "- Consider how their input relates to the existing content - are they adding, modifying, or replacing?" : ""}
   145→
   146→CRITICAL FORMATTING:
   147→- Output ONLY the final text, ready to use in the field
   148→- NO commentary, explanations, or meta-text
   149→- NO quotation marks around the output
   150→- Match the expected format for the context (e.g., comma-separated list for negative prompts)
   151→- AVOID keyword stuffing like "4k, best quality, masterpiece, highly detailed" unless the user specifically requests quality tags
   152→- Ignore filler words like "um", "uh", "like", "you know" from the input
   153→- PRESERVE specific details the user mentions: names, colors, numbers, camera angles, style references
   154→- Be concise - quality prompts are typically 1-3 sentences, not paragraphs
   155→
   156→Output:`;
   157→
   158→    logger.info('Calling Kimi API...');
   159→    
   160→    let resp;
   161→    try {
   162→      resp = await groq.chat.completions.create({
   163→        model: "moonshotai/kimi-k2-instruct",
   164→        messages: [
   165→          { role: "system", content: systemMsg },
   166→          { role: "user", content: userMsg },
   167→        ],
   168→        temperature: 0.6,
   169→        max_tokens: 2048,
   170→        top_p: 1,
   171→      });
   172→      logger.info('Kimi API responded successfully');
   173→    } catch (kimiError: unknown) {
   174→      logger.error('Kimi API error', { error: kimiError?.message || String(kimiError) });
   175→      // Fall back to transcription if Kimi fails
   176→      return jsonResponse({ 
   177→        success: true, 
   178→        transcription: transcribedText,
   179→        prompt: transcribedText,
   180→        usage: null,
   181→        warning: "AI enhancement failed, returning raw transcription"
   182→      });
   183→    }
   184→
   185→    const promptText = resp.choices[0]?.message?.content?.trim() || transcribedText;
   186→    logger.info('Generated prompt', { preview: promptText.substring(0, 100) });
   187→
   188→    await logger.flush();
   189→    return jsonResponse({
   190→      success: true,
   191→      transcription: transcribedText,
   192→      prompt: promptText,
   193→      usage: resp.usage
   194→    });
   195→
   196→  } catch (err: unknown) {
   197→    logger.error('Error', { error: err?.message || String(err) });
   198→    await logger.flush();
   199→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Internal server error", details: err?.message }, 500);
   200→  }
   201→});

     4→

     7→// --- Edge runtime initialization ---

     9→export interface EdgeRuntime {

    18→export function initEdgeRuntime(

    23→  const serviceKey = Deno.env.get('SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY');

    25→
    26→  if (!serviceKey || !supabaseUrl) {

    34→  }

    36→  const supabaseAdmin = options?.clientOptions
    37→    ? createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey, options.clientOptions)
    38→    : createClient(supabaseUrl, serviceKey);
    39→  const logger = new SystemLogger(supabaseAdmin, functionName);

    43→
    44→export async function ensureRequestMethod(
    45→  req: Request,
    46→  method: string,
    47→  logger?: SystemLogger,
    48→): Promise<OperationResult<void>> {
    49→  if (req.method === method) {
    50→    return operationSuccess(undefined, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  logger?.warn('Method not allowed', { method: req.method });
    54→  if (logger) {
    55→    await logger.flush();
    56→  }
    57→  return operationFailure(new Error('Method not allowed'), {
    58→    policy: 'fail_closed',

    60→    message: 'Method not allowed',
    61→    recoverable: false,
    62→    cause: { method: req.method, allow: method },
    63→  });
    64→}
    65→
    66→// --- JSON body parsing ---
    67→
    68→function isJsonObject(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    69→  return !!value && typeof value === 'object' && !Array.isArray(value);
    70→}
    71→
    72→function coerceLooseObject(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
    73→  return isJsonObject(value) ? value : {};
    74→}
    75→
    76→export interface ParseJsonBodyOptions {
    77→  mode?: 'strict' | 'loose';
    78→  message?: string;
    79→  nonObjectMessage?: string;
    80→}
    81→
    82→export async function parseJsonBody(
    83→  req: Request,
    84→  logger?: SystemLogger,
    85→  options?: ParseJsonBodyOptions,
    86→): Promise<OperationResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
    87→  const mode = options?.mode ?? 'strict';
    88→  const message = options?.message ?? 'Invalid JSON body';
    89→  const nonObjectMessage = options?.nonObjectMessage ?? 'JSON body must be an object';
    90→
    91→  try {
    92→    const bodyText = await req.text();
    93→    if (!bodyText) {
    94→      return operationSuccess({}, { policy: 'best_effort' });
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    const parsed = JSON.parse(bodyText);
    98→    if (isJsonObject(parsed)) {
    99→      return operationSuccess(parsed, { policy: 'best_effort' });
   100→    }
   101→
   102→    if (mode === 'loose') {
   103→      logger?.debug('Non-object JSON body provided, using empty object defaults');
   104→      return operationSuccess(coerceLooseObject(parsed), { policy: 'fail_open' });
   105→    }
   106→
   107→    logger?.error(nonObjectMessage);
   108→    if (logger) {
   109→      await logger.flush();
   110→    }
   111→    return operationFailure(new Error(nonObjectMessage), {
   112→      policy: 'fail_closed',
   113→      errorCode: 'invalid_json_body_shape',
   114→      message: nonObjectMessage,
   115→      recoverable: false,
   116→      cause: parsed,
   117→    });
   118→  } catch (error) {
   119→    if (mode === 'loose') {
   120→      logger?.debug('No valid JSON body provided, using defaults');
   121→      return operationSuccess({}, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   122→    }
   123→    logger?.error(message);
   124→    if (logger) {
   125→      await logger.flush();
   126→    }
   127→    return operationFailure(error, {
   128→      policy: 'fail_closed',
   129→      errorCode: 'invalid_json_body',
   130→      message,
   131→      recoverable: false,
   132→      cause: error,
   133→    });
   134→  }
   135→}
   136→
   137→export async function parseJsonBodyStrict(
   138→  req: Request,
   139→  logger?: SystemLogger,
   140→  options?: ParseJsonBodyOptions,
   141→): Promise<OperationResult<Record<string, unknown>>> {
   142→  return parseJsonBody(req, logger, {
   143→    mode: 'strict',
   144→    message: options?.message,
   145→    nonObjectMessage: options?.nonObjectMessage,
   146→  });
   147→}

   150→
   151→export function readEdgeErrorCode(payload: Record<string, unknown> | null): string | null {
   152→  if (!payload) {
   153→    return null;
   154→  }
   155→  if (typeof payload.errorCode === 'string' && payload.errorCode.trim().length > 0) {
   156→    return payload.errorCode;
   157→  }
   158→  if (typeof payload.error === 'string' && payload.error.trim().length > 0) {
   159→    return payload.error;
   160→  }
   161→  return null;
   162→}

1→/**
     2→ * Generation routing for complete_task
     3→ *
     4→ * This file contains the main routing logic. Handlers are in generation-handlers.ts.
     5→ * File structure:
     6→ * - generation.ts: Routing (this file)
     7→ * - generation-handlers.ts: All handlers
     8→ * - generation-child.ts: Child generation + segment helpers
     9→ * - generation-core.ts: CRUD primitives
    10→ * - generation-parent.ts: Parent relationship helpers
    11→ */
    12→
    13→import type { SupabaseClient } from 'https://esm.sh/@supabase/supabase-js@2.39.7';
    14→import { extractShotAndPosition, extractBasedOn } from './params.ts';
    15→import { findExistingGeneration, createVariant, linkGenerationToShot } from './generation-core.ts';
    16→import {
    17→  handleVariantCreation,
    18→  handleVariantOnParent,
    19→  handleVariantOnChild,
    20→  handleChildGeneration,
    21→  handleStandaloneGeneration,
    22→} from './generation-handlers.ts';
    23→import { TASK_TYPES } from './constants.ts';
    24→import { assertCompletionAuthContext, type CompletionAuthContext } from './authContext.ts';
    25→import {
    26→  buildTaskPayloadSnapshot,
    27→  resolveSnapshotChildGenerationId,
    28→  resolveSnapshotChildOrder,
    29→  resolveSnapshotIsSingleItem,
    30→  resolveSnapshotParentGenerationId,
    31→} from '../_shared/taskPayloadSnapshot.ts';
    32→import { asObjectOrEmpty } from '../_shared/payloadNormalization.ts';
    33→import { CompletionError, toCompletionError } from './errors.ts';
    34→
    35→type GenerationSkipReason =
    36→  | 'orchestration_task'
    37→  | 'skip_generation_flag';
    38→
    39→interface GenerationRef {
    40→  id: string;
    41→}
    42→
    43→export type GenerationCreationOutcome =
    44→  | { status: 'skipped'; reason: GenerationSkipReason }
    45→  | { status: 'created'; generation: GenerationRef };
    46→
    47→interface CompletedTaskData {
    48→  category?: string;
    49→  task_type?: string;
    50→  tool_type?: string;
    51→  project_id?: string;
    52→  params: Record<string, unknown>;
    53→}
    54→
    55→interface GenerationRouteParams {
    56→  basedOn: string | null;
    57→  createAsGeneration: boolean;
    58→  childGenerationId: string | null;
    59→  parentGenerationId: string | null;
    60→  childOrder: number | null;
    61→  isSingleItem: boolean;
    62→  isStitchTask: boolean;
    63→}
    64→
    65→interface GenerationHandlerContext {
    66→  supabase: SupabaseClient;
    67→  taskId: string;
    68→  taskData: CompletedTaskData;
    69→  publicUrl: string;
    70→  thumbnailUrl: string | null;
    71→  logger?: unknown;
    72→  childGenerationId?: string;
    73→  parentGenerationId?: string;
    74→  childOrder?: number | null;
    75→  isSingleItem?: boolean;
    76→}
    77→
    78→type GenerationRouteAttempt =
    79→  | 'variant_on_child'
    80→  | 'variant_on_parent'
    81→  | 'child_generation'
    82→  | 'standalone';
    83→
    84→function toGenerationRef(value: unknown): GenerationRef | null {
    85→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object') {
    86→    return null;
    87→  }
    88→
    89→  const candidate = value as { id?: unknown };
    90→  if (typeof candidate.id !== 'string' || candidate.id.length === 0) {
    91→    return null;
    92→  }
    93→
    94→  return { id: candidate.id };
    95→}
    96→
    97→function normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData: unknown): CompletedTaskData {
    98→  const record = asObjectOrEmpty(taskData);
    99→  return {
   100→    category: typeof record.category === 'string' ? record.category : undefined,
   101→    task_type: typeof record.task_type === 'string' ? record.task_type : undefined,
   102→    tool_type: typeof record.tool_type === 'string' ? record.tool_type : undefined,
   103→    project_id: typeof record.project_id === 'string' ? record.project_id : undefined,
   104→    params: asObjectOrEmpty(record.params),
   105→  };
   106→}
   107→
   108→function getGenerationSkipReason(taskData: CompletedTaskData): GenerationSkipReason | null {
   109→  if (taskData.category === 'orchestration') {
   110→    return 'orchestration_task';
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  if (taskData.params.skip_generation === true) {
   114→    return 'skip_generation_flag';
   115→  }
   116→
   117→  return null;
   118→}
   119→
   120→function resolveGenerationRouteParams(taskData: CompletedTaskData): GenerationRouteParams {
   121→  const params = taskData.params;
   122→  const payloadSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   123→
   124→  const basedOn = extractBasedOn(params);
   125→  const createAsGeneration = (
   126→    params.create_as_generation === true
   127→    || payloadSnapshot.orchestrationContract.create_as_generation === true
   128→  );
   129→
   130→  const childGenerationId = resolveSnapshotChildGenerationId(payloadSnapshot);
   131→  const parentGenerationId = resolveSnapshotParentGenerationId(payloadSnapshot);
   132→  const childOrder = resolveSnapshotChildOrder(payloadSnapshot);
   133→  const isSingleItem = resolveSnapshotIsSingleItem(payloadSnapshot);
   134→
   135→  const isStitchTask = taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.TRAVEL_STITCH
   136→    || taskData.task_type === TASK_TYPES.JOIN_FINAL_STITCH;
   137→
   138→  return {
   139→    basedOn,
   140→    createAsGeneration,
   141→    childGenerationId,
   142→    parentGenerationId,
   143→    childOrder,
   144→    isSingleItem,
   145→    isStitchTask,
   146→  };
   147→}
   148→
   149→function classifyGenerationRouteAttempts(routeParams: GenerationRouteParams): GenerationRouteAttempt[] {
   150→  const attempts: GenerationRouteAttempt[] = [];
   151→
   152→  if (routeParams.childGenerationId) {
   153→    attempts.push('variant_on_child');
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  if (routeParams.isStitchTask && routeParams.parentGenerationId) {
   157→    attempts.push('variant_on_parent');
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  if (routeParams.parentGenerationId) {
   161→    attempts.push('child_generation');
   162→  }
   163→
   164→  attempts.push('standalone');
   165→  return attempts;
   166→}
   167→
   168→async function executeGenerationRouteAttempt(
   169→  attempt: GenerationRouteAttempt,
   170→  ctx: GenerationHandlerContext,
   171→): Promise<GenerationRef | null> {
   172→  switch (attempt) {
   173→    case 'variant_on_child':
   174→      return toGenerationRef(await handleVariantOnChild(ctx));
   175→    case 'variant_on_parent':
   176→      return toGenerationRef(await handleVariantOnParent(ctx));
   177→    case 'child_generation':
   178→      return toGenerationRef(await handleChildGeneration(ctx));
   179→    case 'standalone':
   180→      return toGenerationRef(await handleStandaloneGeneration(ctx));
   181→  }
   182→}
   183→
   184→/**
   185→ * Main function to create generation from completed task
   186→ *
   187→ * PARAMS-DRIVEN ROUTING - all 6 cases in one place:
   188→ * 1. Regeneration: existing generation for this task → add variant
   189→ * 2. Variant on source: based_on present → variant on that generation
   190→ * 3. Variant on child: child_generation_id present → variant on existing child
   191→ * 4. Stitch task: travel_stitch/join_final_stitch → variant on parent
   192→ * 5. Child generation: parent_generation_id present → child under parent
   193→ * 6. Standalone: neither → independent generation
   194→ *
   195→ * Single-item detection: is_single_item param OR (is_first_segment && is_last_segment)
   196→ * Child order: child_order OR segment_index OR join_index
   197→ */
   198→export async function createGenerationFromTask(
   199→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   200→  taskId: string,
   201→  taskData: unknown,
   202→  publicUrl: string,
   203→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   204→  logger?: unknown,
   205→  authContext: CompletionAuthContext,
   206→): Promise<GenerationCreationOutcome> {
   207→  assertCompletionAuthContext(authContext, 'createGenerationFromTask');
   208→
   209→  const normalizedTaskData = normalizeCompletedTaskData(taskData);
   210→  const skipReason = getGenerationSkipReason(normalizedTaskData);
   211→  if (skipReason) {
   212→    return { status: 'skipped', reason: skipReason };
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  const routeParams = resolveGenerationRouteParams(normalizedTaskData);
   216→
   217→  logger?.debug("Generation routing", {
   218→    task_id: taskId,
   219→    based_on: routeParams.basedOn,
   220→    child_generation_id: routeParams.childGenerationId,
   221→    parent_generation_id: routeParams.parentGenerationId,
   222→    child_order: routeParams.childOrder,
   223→    is_single_item: routeParams.isSingleItem,
   224→    is_stitch_task: routeParams.isStitchTask,
   225→  });
   226→
   227→  try {
   228→    const existingGenerationRaw = await findExistingGeneration(supabase, taskId);
   229→    const existingGeneration = toGenerationRef(existingGenerationRaw);
   230→    if (existingGenerationRaw && !existingGeneration) {
   231→      throw new CompletionError({
   232→        code: 'generation_existing_shape_invalid',
   233→        context: 'createGenerationFromTask',
   234→        recoverable: false,
   235→        message: `Existing generation lookup returned an invalid shape for task ${taskId}`,
   236→        metadata: { task_id: taskId },
   237→      });
   238→    }
   239→
   240→    if (existingGeneration) {
   241→      const generation = await handleRegeneration(
   242→        supabase,

   106→function parseRateLimitRpcPayload(data: unknown): RateLimitRpcPayload | null {
   107→  if (!data || typeof data !== 'object' || Array.isArray(data)) {

   111→  if (typeof record.allowed !== 'boolean') {
   112→    return null;

   118→    return null;

   124→  return {
   125→    allowed: record.allowed,
   126→    count: Math.trunc(record.count),
   127→    reset_at: record.reset_at,
   128→  };

   131→export async function checkRateLimit(
   132→  input: CheckRateLimitInput,
   133→): Promise<OperationResult<RateLimitResult>> {
   134→  const {

   137→    identifier,

   141→  const now = new Date();
   142→  const key = `${functionName}:${identifier}`;
   143→  
   144→  try {
   145→    // Use upsert with atomic increment via RPC function
   146→    // This handles race conditions properly
   147→    const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin.rpc('check_rate_limit', {
   148→      p_key: key,
   149→      p_window_seconds: config.windowSeconds,
   150→      p_max_requests: config.maxRequests
   151→    });
   152→    
   153→    if (error) {
   154→      const message = `${logPrefix} Rate limit RPC error for key "${key}"`;
   155→      const fallback = failOpenRateLimit(
   156→        now,
   157→        config,
   158→        'rpc_error',
   159→        message,
   160→        error,
   161→      );
   162→      console.error(`${logPrefix} Rate limit RPC error for key "${key}" (allowing request):`, error);
   163→      return operationSuccess(fallback, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   164→    }
   165→
   166→    const result = parseRateLimitRpcPayload(data);
   167→    if (!result) {
   168→      const message = `${logPrefix} Invalid rate limit RPC payload for key "${key}"`;
   169→      const fallback = failOpenRateLimit(
   170→        now,
   171→        config,
   172→        'invalid_rpc_payload',
   173→        message,
   174→        data,
   175→      );
   176→      console.error(`${logPrefix} Invalid rate limit RPC payload for key "${key}" (allowing request):`, data);
   177→      return operationSuccess(fallback, { policy: 'fail_open' });
   178→    }
   179→
   180→    const resetAt = new Date(result.reset_at);
   181→    const remaining = Math.max(0, config.maxRequests - result.count);
   182→    
   183→    if (!result.allowed) {
   184→      const retryAfter = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((resetAt.getTime() - now.getTime()) / 1000));
   185→      return operationSuccess({
   186→        allowed: false,
   187→        remaining: 0,
   188→        resetAt,
   189→        retryAfter,
   190→      }, {
   191→        policy: 'fail_closed',
   192→      });
   193→    }
   194→    
   195→    return operationSuccess(
   196→      {
   197→        allowed: true,
   198→        remaining,
   199→        resetAt,
   200→      },
   201→      { policy: 'best_effort' },
   202→    );
   203→  } catch (err) {
   204→    const message = `${logPrefix} Rate limit runtime error for key "${key}"`;
   205→    const fallback = failOpenRateLimit(
   206→      now,
   207→      config,
   208→      'runtime_error',
   209→      message,
   210→      err,
   211→    );

   214→  }
   215→}

   217→/**

   220→function rateLimitHeaders(result: RateLimitResult, config: RateLimitConfig): Record<string, string> {
   221→  const headers: Record<string, string> = {
   222→    'X-RateLimit-Limit': config.maxRequests.toString(),
   223→    'X-RateLimit-Remaining': result.remaining.toString(),
   224→    'X-RateLimit-Reset': Math.floor(result.resetAt.getTime() / 1000).toString(),
   225→  };
   226→  
   227→  if (result.retryAfter) {
   228→    headers['Retry-After'] = result.retryAfter.toString();
   229→  }
   230→  
   231→  return headers;
   232→}
   233→
   234→/**
   235→ * Create a 429 Too Many Requests response
   236→ */
   237→export function rateLimitResponse(result: RateLimitResult, config: RateLimitConfig): Response {
   238→  const retryAfterSuffix = typeof result.retryAfter === 'number' && result.retryAfter > 0
   239→    ? ` Please wait ${result.retryAfter} seconds before retrying.`
   240→    : ' Please retry shortly.';
   241→  return edgeErrorResponse(
   242→    {
   243→      errorCode: 'rate_limit_exceeded',
   244→      message: `Rate limit exceeded.${retryAfterSuffix}`,
   245→      recoverable: true,
   246→      retryAfter: result.retryAfter,
   247→    },
   248→    429,
   249→    rateLimitHeaders(result, config),
   250→  );
   251→}

   253→function fallbackDeniedResult(config: RateLimitConfig): RateLimitResult {
   254→  const now = new Date();
   255→  return {
   256→    allowed: false,
   257→    remaining: 0,
   258→    resetAt: new Date(now.getTime() + config.windowSeconds * 1000),
   259→    retryAfter: config.windowSeconds,
   260→  };
   261→}
   262→
   263→function extractDeniedResultFromFailure(
   264→  failure: OperationFailure,
   265→  config: RateLimitConfig,
   266→): RateLimitResult {
   267→  const decision = (failure.cause as { decision?: unknown } | undefined)?.decision;
   268→  if (decision && typeof decision === 'object' && !Array.isArray(decision)) {
   269→    const record = decision as Partial<RateLimitResult>;
   270→    if (
   271→      record.allowed === false
   272→      && record.resetAt instanceof Date
   273→      && typeof record.remaining === 'number'
   274→    ) {
   275→      return {
   276→        allowed: false,
   277→        remaining: record.remaining,
   278→        resetAt: record.resetAt,
   279→        retryAfter: record.retryAfter,
   280→      };
   281→    }
   282→  }
   283→  return fallbackDeniedResult(config);
   284→}
   285→
   286→export function isRateLimitExceededFailure(result: OperationResult<RateLimitResult>): boolean {
   287→  if (result.ok) {
   288→    return result.value.allowed === false;
   289→  }
   290→  return result.errorCode === 'rate_limit_exceeded';
   291→}
   292→
   293→export function rateLimitFailureResponse(
   294→  result: OperationFailure | DeniedRateLimitResult,
   295→  config: RateLimitConfig,
   296→): Response {
   297→  if ('allowed' in result) {
   298→    return rateLimitResponse(result, config);
   299→  }
   300→  return rateLimitResponse(extractDeniedResultFromFailure(result, config), config);
   301→}

   303→interface RateLimitLogger {
   304→  warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   305→  error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   306→  flush: () => Promise<void>;
   307→}

   309→interface EnforceRateLimitInput {
   310→  supabaseAdmin: SupabaseAdminClient;
   311→  functionName: string;
   312→  userId: string;
   313→  config: RateLimitConfig;
   314→  logger: RateLimitLogger;
   315→  logPrefix: string;
   316→  responses?: {
   317→    serviceUnavailable?: () => Response;
   318→  };
   319→}
   320→
   321→/**
   322→ * Full rate-limit enforcement: check → error response → fail_open logging.
   323→ * Returns a Response to short-circuit (exceeded or service error), or null to proceed.
   324→ *
   325→ * @param serviceUnavailableResponse Optional factory for 503 responses.
   326→ *   Defaults to a generic 503 edge error.
   327→ */
   328→export async function enforceRateLimit(
   329→  input: EnforceRateLimitInput,
   330→): Promise<Response | null> {
   331→  const {
   332→    supabaseAdmin,
   333→    functionName,
   334→    userId,
   335→    config,
   336→    logger,
   337→    logPrefix,
   338→    responses,
   339→  } = input;
   340→  const result = await checkRateLimit({
   341→    supabaseAdmin,
   342→    functionName,
   343→    identifier: userId,
   344→    config,
   345→    logPrefix,
   346→  });
   347→
   348→  // Rate limit exceeded — works for both ok (fail_closed) and !ok paths
   349→  if (isRateLimitExceededFailure(result)) {
   350→    logger.warn('Rate limit exceeded', { user_id: userId });
   351→    await logger.flush();
   352→    if (result.ok) {
   353→      return rateLimitResponse(result.value, config);
   354→    }
   355→    return rateLimitFailureResponse(result, config);
   356→  }
   357→
   358→  // Operation failure that's not rate-limit-exceeded
   359→  if (!result.ok) {
   360→    logger.error('Rate limit check failed', {
   361→      user_id: userId,
   362→      error_code: result.errorCode,
   363→      message: result.message,
   364→    });
   365→    await logger.flush();
   366→    return responses?.serviceUnavailable
   367→      ? responses.serviceUnavailable()
   368→      : edgeErrorResponse(
   369→          { errorCode: 'rate_limit_service_unavailable', message: 'Rate limit service unavailable', recoverable: true },
   370→          503,
   371→        );
   372→  }
   373→
   374→  // Success but degraded (fail_open) — proceed with warning
   375→  if (result.policy === 'fail_open') {
   376→    logger.warn('Rate limit check degraded; allowing request', {
   377→      user_id: userId,
   378→      reason: result.value.degraded?.reason,
   379→      message: result.value.degraded?.message,
   380→    });
   381→  }
   382→
   383→  return null;
   384→}

1→import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
     2→import { jsonResponse } from "../_shared/http.ts";
     3→import { bootstrapEdgeHandler, NO_SESSION_RUNTIME_OPTIONS } from "../_shared/edgeHandler.ts";
     4→import { createStripeClient } from "../_shared/autoTopupDomain.ts";
     5→
     6→/**
     7→ * Edge function: complete-auto-topup-setup
     8→ * 
     9→ * Completes auto-top-up setup by extracting payment method from checkout session
    10→ * Called after successful checkout with auto-top-up enabled
    11→ * 
    12→ * POST /functions/v1/complete-auto-topup-setup
    13→ * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <service_role_key>
    14→ * Body: { sessionId: string, userId: string }
    15→ * 
    16→ * Returns:
    17→ * - 200 OK with payment method details
    18→ * - 400 Bad Request if invalid parameters
    19→ * - 500 Internal Server Error
    20→ */
    21→serve(async (req) => {
    22→  if (!req.headers.get("authorization")) {
    23→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Authentication failed" }, 401);
    24→  }
    25→  const bootstrap = await bootstrapEdgeHandler(req, {
    26→    functionName: "complete-auto-topup-setup",
    27→    logPrefix: "[COMPLETE-AUTO-TOPUP-SETUP]",
    28→    parseBody: "strict",
    29→    auth: {
    30→      required: true,
    31→      requireServiceRole: true,
    32→    },
    33→    ...NO_SESSION_RUNTIME_OPTIONS,
    34→  });
    35→  if (!bootstrap.ok) {
    36→    return bootstrap.response;
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  const { supabaseAdmin, logger, body, auth } = bootstrap.value;
    40→  if (!auth?.isServiceRole) {
    41→    logger.error("Authentication failed");
    42→    await logger.flush();
    43→    return jsonResponse({ error: "Authentication failed" }, 401);
    44→  }
    45→  
    46→  const { sessionId, userId } = body;
    47→
    48→  if (!sessionId || !userId) {
    49→    return jsonResponse({ error: "sessionId and userId are required" }, 400);
    50→  }
    51→
    52→  try {
    53→    // ─── 4. Initialize Stripe ───────────────────────────────────────
    54→    const stripeResult = createStripeClient();
    55→    if (!stripeResult.ok) {
    56→      logger.error(stripeResult.error.logMessage);
    57→      await logger.flush();
    58→      return jsonResponse({ error: stripeResult.error.message }, 500);
    59→    }
    60→    const stripe = stripeResult.value;
    61→
    62→    // ─── 5. Retrieve checkout session and payment intent ────────────
    63→    const session = await stripe.checkout.sessions.retrieve(sessionId, {
    64→      expand: ['payment_intent', 'setup_intent']
    65→    });
    66→
    67→    if (!session.payment_intent) {
    68→      return jsonResponse({ error: "No payment intent found in session" }, 400);
    69→    }
    70→
    71→    // Get the payment intent with payment method details
    72→    const paymentIntent = await stripe.paymentIntents.retrieve(
    73→      session.payment_intent as string,
    74→      { expand: ['payment_method'] }
    75→    );
    76→
    77→    if (!paymentIntent.customer) {
    78→      return jsonResponse({ error: "No customer associated with payment intent" }, 400);
    79→    }
    80→
    81→    if (!paymentIntent.payment_method) {
    82→      return jsonResponse({ error: "No payment method found" }, 400);
    83→    }
    84→
    85→    // ─── 6. Update user with complete Stripe information ─────────────
    86→    const { error: updateError } = await supabaseAdmin
    87→      .from('users')
    88→      .update({
    89→        stripe_customer_id: paymentIntent.customer as string,
    90→        stripe_payment_method_id: paymentIntent.payment_method.id,
    91→      })
    92→      .eq('id', userId);
    93→
    94→    if (updateError) {
    95→      logger.error('Error updating user with payment method', { error: updateError.message, user_id: userId });
    96→      await logger.flush();
    97→      return jsonResponse({ error: 'Failed to save payment method' }, 500);
    98→    }
    99→
   100→    logger.info('Auto-top-up setup completed', {
   101→      user_id: userId,
   102→      sessionId,
   103→      customerId: paymentIntent.customer,
   104→      paymentMethodId: paymentIntent.payment_method.id,
   105→      paymentMethodType: paymentIntent.payment_method.type,
   106→    });
   107→
   108→    await logger.flush();
   109→    return jsonResponse({
   110→      success: true,
   111→      customerId: paymentIntent.customer,
   112→      paymentMethodId: paymentIntent.payment_method.id,
   113→      paymentMethodType: paymentIntent.payment_method.type,
   114→      message: 'Auto-top-up setup completed successfully'
   115→    });
   116→
   117→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   118→    const errorMessage = error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error);
   119→    logger.error('Error in complete-auto-topup-setup', { error: errorMessage });
   120→    
   121→    // Handle specific Stripe errors
   122→    const stripeErrorType = (error as { type?: string } | null)?.type;
   123→    if (stripeErrorType === 'StripeInvalidRequestError') {
   124→      return jsonResponse({
   125→        error: 'Invalid Stripe request',
   126→        message: errorMessage,
   127→      }, 400);
   128→    }
   129→
   130→    await logger.flush();
   131→    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Internal server error' }, 500);
   132→  }
   133→});
   134→

   101→export function useEditSettingsPersistence({

    28→function defaultErrorCode(status: number): string {
    29→  if (status === 401) return 'authentication_failed';
    30→  if (status === 403) return 'forbidden';
    31→  if (status === 404) return 'not_found';
    32→  if (status === 405) return 'method_not_allowed';
    33→  if (status === 429) return 'rate_limited';
    34→  if (status === 503) return 'service_unavailable';
    35→  if (status >= 500) return 'internal_server_error';
    36→  return 'request_failed';

    39→export function completeTaskErrorResponse(

    47→      message,
    48→      recoverable: status >= 500 || status === 429,
    49→    },
    50→    status,
    51→  );
    52→}
    53→
    54→function asObjectRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> {
    55→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
    56→    return {};
    57→  }
    58→  return value as Record<string, unknown>;
    59→}
    60→
    61→/**
    62→ * Best-effort mark a task as Failed so the UI can update immediately.
    63→ * Swallows errors — callers still return their own HTTP error response.
    64→ */
    65→export async function markTaskFailed(
    66→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
    67→  taskId: string,
    68→  errorMessage: string,
    69→): Promise<void> {
    70→  try {
    71→    await supabase.from("tasks").update({
    72→      status: "Failed",
    73→      error_message: errorMessage,
    74→      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    75→    }).eq("id", taskId).in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"]);
    76→  } catch {
    77→    // Best-effort — don't mask the original error
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→export async function persistCompletionFollowUpIssues(
    82→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
    83→  taskId: string,
    84→  existingResultData: unknown,
    85→  issues: CompletionFollowUpIssue[],
    86→): Promise<{ ok: true } | { ok: false; error: unknown }> {
    87→  if (issues.length === 0) {
    88→    return { ok: true };
    89→  }
    90→
    91→  const baseResultData = asObjectRecord(existingResultData);
    92→  const completionFollowUp = {
    93→    status: 'degraded',
    94→    recorded_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    95→    issues,
    96→  };
    97→
    98→  const { error } = await supabase
    99→    .from('tasks')
   100→    .update({
   101→      result_data: {
   102→        ...baseResultData,
   103→        completion_follow_up: completionFollowUp,
   104→      },
   105→    })
   106→    .eq('id', taskId);
   107→
   108→  if (error) {
   109→    return { ok: false, error };
   110→  }
   111→
   112→  return { ok: true };
   113→}

   115→/**
