   238→      originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   239→    ) ?? undefined;
   240→  }
   241→  
   242→  // Final fallback to main URL
   243→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   244→}
   245→
   246→/**
   247→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   248→ */
   249→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   250→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   251→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   252→}
   253→
   254→/**
   255→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   256→ * 
   257→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   258→ * 
   259→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   260→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   261→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   262→ */
   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   266→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   267→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   268→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   269→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   270→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   271→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   272→  
   273→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   274→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   275→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   282→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   283→    contentType = 'image/png';
   284→  }
   285→  
   286→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   287→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   288→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   289→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   290→
   291→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   293→    id: item.id,
   294→    url: mainUrl,
   295→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   296→    urlIdentity,
   297→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   298→    prompt,
   299→    metadata: {
   300→      ...(item.params || {}),
   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   318→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   319→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   320→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   321→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   325→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(asRecord(item.shot_data));
   326→  
   327→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   328→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   329→    return {
   330→      ...baseItem,
   331→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   332→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   333→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   334→    };
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   345→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   346→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   347→      };
   348→    }
   349→    
   350→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}
   476→

   266→ * 
   267→ * @param params - Raw join clips parameters
   268→ * @param clipSequence - Normalized list of clips in order
   269→ * @param runId - Generated run ID
   270→ * @param orchestratorTaskId - Generated orchestrator task ID
   271→ * @returns Processed orchestrator payload
   272→ */
   273→function buildJoinClipsPayload(
   274→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   275→  normalized: NormalizedJoinClipsParams,
   276→  runId: string,
   277→  orchestratorTaskId: string
   278→): Record<string, unknown> {
   279→  const clipSequence = normalized.clipSequence;
   280→  // Use provided phase config (advanced mode) or build from LoRAs (basic mode)
   281→  const phaseConfig = params.phase_config || buildJoinClipsPhaseConfig(params.loras || []);
   282→  
   283→  const orchestratorDetails: Record<string, unknown> = {
   284→    orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   285→    clip_list: clipSequence.map(clip => ({
   286→      url: clip.url,
   287→      ...(clip.name ? { name: clip.name } : {}),
   288→    })),
   289→    run_id: runId,
   290→    shot_id: params.shot_id ?? undefined, // For "Visit Shot" button in TasksPane
   291→    prompt: params.prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.prompt,
   292→    gap_frame_count: params.gap_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.gap_frame_count,
   293→    context_frame_count: params.context_frame_count ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.context_frame_count,
   294→    replace_mode: params.replace_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.replace_mode,
   295→    keep_bridging_images: params.keep_bridging_images, // Optional, defaults to undefined (backend handles default)
   296→    enhance_prompt: params.enhance_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.enhance_prompt,
   297→    model: params.model ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.model,
   298→    num_inference_steps: params.num_inference_steps ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.num_inference_steps,
   299→    guidance_scale: params.guidance_scale ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.guidance_scale,
   300→    seed: params.seed ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.seed,
   301→    negative_prompt: params.negative_prompt ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.negative_prompt,
   302→    priority: params.priority ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.priority,
   303→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   304→    // UNIFIED: Always include phase_config and advanced_mode for consistent backend processing
   305→    phase_config: phaseConfig,
   306→    advanced_mode: true,
   307→    // Motion settings for UI state restoration
   308→    motion_mode: params.motion_mode ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.motion_mode,
   309→    selected_phase_preset_id: params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? TASK_DEFAULTS.selected_phase_preset_id,
   310→  };
   311→
   312→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   313→    { from: 'resolution' },
   314→    { from: 'fps' },
   315→    { from: 'use_input_video_resolution' },
   316→    { from: 'use_input_video_fps' },
   317→    { from: 'audio_url' },
   318→  ]);
   319→
   320→  assignMappedPayloadFields(orchestratorDetails, params, [
   321→    {
   322→      from: 'vid2vid_init_strength',
   323→      include: (value) => typeof value === 'number' && value > 0,
   324→    },
   325→  ]);
   326→
   327→  if (params.loop_first_clip) {
   328→    orchestratorDetails.loop_first_clip = true;
   329→  }
   330→
   331→  // Pass based_on for variant creation when looping a clip from "Add to Join"
   332→  if (params.based_on) {
   333→    orchestratorDetails.based_on = params.based_on;
   334→  }
   335→
   336→  // Keep additional_loras for backward compatibility, but LoRAs are now primarily in phase_config
   337→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   338→    orchestratorDetails.additional_loras = mapPathLorasToStrengthRecord(params.loras);
   339→  }
   340→  
   341→  // Video edit mode - for regenerating portions of a single video
   342→  if (normalized.videoEdit) {
   343→    orchestratorDetails.video_edit_mode = true;
   344→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_url = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_url;
   345→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_fps = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_fps;
   346→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_duration = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_duration;
   347→    orchestratorDetails.source_video_total_frames = normalized.videoEdit.source_video_total_frames;
   348→    orchestratorDetails.portions_to_regenerate = normalized.videoEdit.portions_to_regenerate;
   349→  }
   350→
   351→  const totalJoins = Math.max(clipSequence.length - 1, 0);
   352→  if (totalJoins > 0) {
   353→    const perJoinOverrides: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
   354→    let hasOverrides = false;
   355→
   356→    for (let index = 0; index < totalJoins; index++) {
   357→      const joinSettings = buildJoinOverrideRecord(params.per_join_settings?.[index]);
   358→
   359→      if (Object.keys(joinSettings).length > 0) {
   360→        hasOverrides = true;
   361→        perJoinOverrides.push(joinSettings);
   362→      } else {
   363→        perJoinOverrides.push({});
   364→      }
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    if (hasOverrides) {
   368→      orchestratorDetails.per_join_settings = perJoinOverrides;
   369→    }
   370→  }
   371→
   372→  const resolutionDisplay = params.resolution
   373→    ? `${params.resolution[0]}x${params.resolution[1]}`
   374→    : undefined;
   375→
   376→  const joinMode = normalized.joinMode;
   377→
   378→  const perJoinOverridesCount = params.per_join_settings?.filter((override) =>
   379→    !!override && Object.keys(override).length > 0
   380→  ).length ?? 0;
   381→
   382→  const familyContract = buildJoinClipsFamilyContract({
   383→    mode: joinMode,
   384→    runId,
   385→    clipUrls: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   386→    overridesCount: perJoinOverridesCount,
   387→    hasAudio: Boolean(params.audio_url),
   388→  });
   389→
   390→  const payload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   391→    taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   392→    orchestratorDetails,
   393→    orchestrationInput: {
   394→      taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   395→      orchestratorTaskId,
   396→      runId,
   397→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   398→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   399→      basedOn: params.based_on,
   400→      generationRouting: 'orchestrator',
   401→      siblingLookup: 'run_id',
   402→    },
   403→    taskViewInput: {
   404→      inputImages: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   405→      prompt: params.prompt,
   406→      negativePrompt: params.negative_prompt,
   407→      modelName: params.model,
   408→      resolution: resolutionDisplay,
   409→    },
   410→    familyContract,
   411→  });
   412→
   413→  return {
   414→    ...payload,
   415→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   416→    // Only include tool_type if explicitly passed (Join Clips page passes it, ShotEditor doesn't)
   417→    ...(params.tool_type && { tool_type: params.tool_type }),
   418→  };
   419→}
   420→
   421→/**
   422→ * Creates a join clips task using the unified approach
   423→ * 
   424→ * @param params - Join clips task parameters
   425→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   426→ */
   427→export async function createCanonicalJoinClipsTask(
   428→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   429→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   430→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   431→    params,
   432→    context: 'JoinClips',
   433→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   434→      const normalized = normalizeJoinClipsParams(requestParams);
   435→      const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("join_clips_orchestrator");
   436→      const runId = requestParams.run_id ?? generateRunId();
   437→      const orchestratorPayload = buildJoinClipsPayload(
   438→        requestParams,
   439→        normalized,
   440→        runId,
   441→        orchestratorTaskId,
   442→      );
   443→
   444→      return composeTaskRequest({
   445→        source: requestParams,
   446→        taskType: 'join_clips_orchestrator',
   447→        params: orchestratorPayload,
   448→      });
   449→    },
   450→  });
   451→}
   452→
   453→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   454→

1→// Supabase config is intentionally lazy: importing this module should not throw.
     2→// Env validation happens only when callers access URL/key getters.
     3→//
     4→// Migration contract for legacy constant removal:
     5→// - Owner: platform-foundations
     6→// - Remove-by: 2026-05-31
     7→// - Gate: no remaining imports of old SUPABASE_URL/SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY symbols
     8→
     9→function requireEnv(name: string): string {
    10→  const value = import.meta.env[name] as string | undefined;
    11→  if (!value) {
    12→    throw new Error(`Missing required Supabase environment variable: ${name}`);
    13→  }
    14→  return value;
    15→}
    16→
    17→function getBooleanEnv(name: string, fallback: boolean): boolean {
    18→  const value = import.meta.env[name] as string | undefined;
    19→  if (value === undefined) return fallback;
    20→  if (value === 'true' || value === '1') return true;
    21→  if (value === 'false' || value === '0') return false;
    22→  return fallback;
    23→}
    24→
    25→let _supabaseUrl: string | undefined;
    26→/** Supabase project URL — throws on first access if VITE_SUPABASE_URL is missing. */
    27→export function getSupabaseUrl(): string {
    28→  return (_supabaseUrl ??= requireEnv('VITE_SUPABASE_URL'));
    29→}
    30→
    31→let _supabaseKey: string | undefined;
    32→/** Supabase anon/publishable key — throws on first access if VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY is missing. */
    33→export function getSupabasePublishableKey(): string {
    34→  return (_supabaseKey ??= requireEnv('VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY'));
    35→}
    36→
    37→export const __IS_DEV_ENV__ =
    38→  import.meta.env.VITE_APP_ENV === 'dev' ||
    39→  (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.location?.hostname === 'localhost');
    40→
    41→// Heavy instrumentation should default off outside debug/dev flows.
    42→export const __WS_INSTRUMENTATION_ENABLED__ = getBooleanEnv(
    43→  'VITE_DEBUG_WS_INSTRUMENTATION',
    44→  __IS_DEV_ENV__
    45→);
    46→export const __REALTIME_DOWN_FIX_ENABLED__ = getBooleanEnv(
    47→  'VITE_DEBUG_REALTIME_DOWN_FIX',
    48→  __IS_DEV_ENV__
    49→);
    50→export const __CORRUPTION_TRACE_ENABLED__ = getBooleanEnv(
    51→  'VITE_DEBUG_CORRUPTION_TRACE',
    52→  __IS_DEV_ENV__
    53→);

    87→  const skeletonBg = darkSurface ? 'bg-zinc-700/60' : 'bg-muted';
    88→
    89→  // Calculate aspect ratio for skeleton items
    90→  let aspectRatioPadding = '100%'; // Default to square (1:1)
    91→  
    92→  if (projectAspectRatio) {
    93→    const ratio = parseRatio(projectAspectRatio);
    94→    if (!isNaN(ratio)) {
    95→      const calculatedPadding = (1 / ratio) * 100; // height/width * 100
    96→      // Ensure reasonable aspect ratio bounds
    97→      const minPadding = 60; // Minimum 60% height (for very wide images)
    98→      const maxPadding = 200; // Maximum 200% height (for very tall images)
    99→      aspectRatioPadding = `${Math.min(Math.max(calculatedPadding, minPadding), maxPadding)}%`;
   100→    }
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  return (
   104→    <div className={cn('space-y-6 pb-8', className)}>
   105→      {showControls && (
   106→        <div className="mt-0 space-y-3">
   107→          {/* Pagination row - matches MediaGallery pagination section */}
   108→          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
   109→            {/* Left side - Pagination controls skeleton */}
   110→            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
   111→              <div className={cn('h-8 w-16 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   112→              <div className={cn('h-4 w-40 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   113→              <div className={cn('h-8 w-16 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   114→            </div>
   115→
   116→            {/* Right side - Starred filter skeleton */}
   117→            <div className="flex items-center gap-x-2">
   118→              <div className={cn('h-4 w-4 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   119→              <div className={cn('h-4 w-12 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   120→            </div>
   121→          </div>
   122→
   123→          {/* Filters row - matches MediaGallery filters section */}
   124→          <div className="flex justify-between items-center flex-wrap gap-y-2">
   125→            {/* Left side - Filters skeleton */}
   126→            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
   127→              {/* Shot Filter skeleton */}
   128→              <div className={cn('h-8 w-[140px] rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   129→              
   130→              {/* Search skeleton */}
   131→              <div className={cn('h-8 w-8 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   132→            </div>
   133→            
   134→            {/* Right side - Media Type Filter skeleton */}
   135→            <div className="flex items-center gap-x-1.5">
   136→              <div className={cn('h-4 w-8 rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   137→              <div className={cn('h-8 w-[100px] rounded animate-pulse', skeletonBg)} />
   138→            </div>
   139→          </div>
   140→        </div>
   141→      )}
   142→      
   143→      {/* Gallery grid skeleton */}
   144→      <div
   145→        className={fixedColumns ? cn('grid', gapClasses) : gridCols}
   146→        style={fixedColumns ? { gridTemplateColumns: `repeat(${fixedColumns}, minmax(0, 1fr))` } : undefined}
   147→      >
   148→        {Array.from({ length: count }).map((_, idx) => (
   149→          <div
   150→            key={idx}
   151→            className={cn(
   152→              'animate-pulse rounded-lg relative',
   153→              skeletonBg
   154→            )}
   155→            style={{ paddingBottom: aspectRatioPadding }}
   156→          />
   157→        ))}
   158→      </div>
   159→    </div>
   160→  );
   161→}
   162→
   163→export const SkeletonGallery = React.memo(SkeletonGalleryComponent);
   164→

1→export type OperationFailurePolicy = 'fail_closed' | 'fail_open' | 'degrade' | 'best_effort';
     2→
     3→interface OperationSuccess<T> {
     4→  ok: true;
     5→  value: T;
     6→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
     7→  recoverable: false;
     8→}
     9→
    10→export interface OperationFailure {
    11→  ok: false;
    12→  error: Error;
    13→  message: string;
    14→  recoverable: boolean;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  errorCode: string;
    17→  cause?: unknown;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→export class OperationResultError extends Error {
    23→  errorCode: string;
    24→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    25→  recoverable: boolean;
    26→  cause?: unknown;
    27→
    28→  constructor(options: {
    29→    message: string;
    30→    errorCode: string;
    31→    policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    32→    recoverable: boolean;
    33→    cause?: unknown;
    34→    sourceError?: Error;
    35→  }) {
    36→    super(options.message);
    37→    this.name = 'OperationResultError';
    38→    this.errorCode = options.errorCode;
    39→    this.policy = options.policy;
    40→    this.recoverable = options.recoverable;
    41→    this.cause = options.cause;
    42→
    43→    // Preserve the original stack for easier debugging when available.
    44→    if (options.sourceError?.stack) {
    45→      this.stack = options.sourceError.stack;
    46→    }
    47→  }
    48→}
    49→
    50→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    51→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    52→}
    53→
    54→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    55→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    56→  recoverable?: boolean;
    57→  errorCode?: string;
    58→  message?: string;
    59→  cause?: unknown;
    60→}
    61→
    62→export function operationSuccess<T>(value: T, options?: OperationSuccessOptions): OperationSuccess<T> {
    63→  return {
    64→    ok: true,
    65→    value,
    66→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    67→    recoverable: false,
    68→  };
    69→}
    70→
    71→export function operationFailure(error: unknown, options?: OperationFailureOptions): OperationFailure {
    72→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    73→  return {
    74→    ok: false,
    75→    error: normalizedError,
    76→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    77→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    78→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    79→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    80→    ...(options?.cause !== undefined ? { cause: options.cause } : {}),
    81→  };
    82→}
    83→
    84→/**
    85→ * Convert a structured operation failure into an Error while preserving machine-readable metadata.
    86→ */
    87→export function toOperationResultError(failure: OperationFailure): OperationResultError {
    88→  return new OperationResultError({
    89→    message: failure.message,
    90→    errorCode: failure.errorCode,
    91→    policy: failure.policy,
    92→    recoverable: failure.recoverable,
    93→    cause: failure.cause,
    94→    sourceError: failure.error,
    95→  });
    96→}

    76→/**
    77→ * Validates magic edit task parameters
    78→ * @param params - Parameters to validate
    79→ * @throws TaskValidationError if validation fails
    80→ */
    81→function validateMagicEditParams(params: MagicEditTaskParams): void {
    82→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'prompt', 'image_url']);
    83→
    84→  validateNonEmptyString(params.prompt, 'prompt', 'Prompt');
    85→  validateNonEmptyString(params.image_url, 'image_url', 'Image URL');
    86→  validateUrlString(params.image_url, 'image_url', 'Image URL');
    87→
    88→  if (params.seed !== undefined) {
    89→    try {
    90→      validateSeed32Bit(params.seed, 'seed');
    91→    } catch {
    92→      throw new TaskValidationError('Seed must be a 32-bit positive integer', 'seed');
    93→    }
    94→  }
    95→
    96→  if (params.max_wait_seconds !== undefined && params.max_wait_seconds < 1) {
    97→    throw new TaskValidationError('Max wait seconds must be positive', 'max_wait_seconds');
    98→  }
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Validates batch magic edit parameters
   103→ * @param params - Parameters to validate
   104→ * @throws TaskValidationError if validation fails
   105→ */
   106→function validateBatchMagicEditParams(params: BatchMagicEditTaskParams): void {
   107→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'prompt', 'image_url', 'numImages']);
   108→
   109→  // Validate numImages
   110→  if (params.numImages < 1 || params.numImages > 16) {
   111→    throw new TaskValidationError('Number of images must be between 1 and 16', 'numImages');
   112→  }
   113→
   114→  // Use single task validation for the rest
   115→  validateMagicEditParams({
   116→    project_id: params.project_id,
   117→    prompt: params.prompt,
   118→    image_url: params.image_url,
   119→    negative_prompt: params.negative_prompt,
   120→    resolution: params.resolution,
   121→    seed: params.seed,
   122→    in_scene: params.in_scene,
   123→    shot_id: params.shot_id,
   124→    output_format: params.output_format,
   125→    enable_sync_mode: params.enable_sync_mode,
   126→    max_wait_seconds: params.max_wait_seconds,
   127→    enable_base64_output: params.enable_base64_output,
   128→  });
   129→}
   130→
   131→/**
   132→ * Builds the task params for an image_edit task
   133→ * This follows the format from the example task you provided
   134→ */
   135→function buildMagicEditTaskParams(
   136→  params: MagicEditTaskParams,
   137→  finalResolution: string
   138→): Record<string, unknown> {
   139→  // Build the task params in the format expected by image_edit
   140→  const taskParams: Record<string, unknown> = {
   141→    seed: resolveSeed32Bit({ seed: params.seed, field: 'seed' }),
   142→    image: params.image_url,
   143→    prompt: params.prompt,
   144→    output_format: params.output_format ?? "jpeg",
   145→    qwen_edit_model: params.qwen_edit_model ?? 'qwen-edit',
   146→    enable_sync_mode: params.enable_sync_mode ?? false,
   147→    max_wait_seconds: params.max_wait_seconds ?? 300,
   148→    enable_base64_output: params.enable_base64_output ?? false,
   149→  };
   150→
   151→  // Add optional parameters if provided
   152→  if (params.negative_prompt) {
   153→    taskParams.negative_prompt = params.negative_prompt;
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  if (params.in_scene !== undefined) {
   157→    taskParams.in_scene = params.in_scene;
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  // Add resolution if needed (some edit models may use this)
   161→  if (finalResolution && finalResolution !== "custom") {
   162→    taskParams.resolution = finalResolution;
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  // Always add add_in_position as false for magic edit tasks (unpositioned by default)
   166→  taskParams.add_in_position = false;
   167→
   168→  // Add loras if provided
   169→  if (params.loras && params.loras.length > 0) {
   170→    taskParams.loras = params.loras;
   171→  }
   172→
   173→  setTaskLineageFields(taskParams, {
   174→    shotId: params.shot_id,
   175→    basedOn: params.based_on,
   176→    sourceVariantId: params.source_variant_id,
   177→    createAsGeneration: params.create_as_generation,
   178→    toolType: params.tool_type,
   179→  });
   180→
   181→  // Add hires fix / inference params if provided
   182→  Object.assign(taskParams, buildHiresFixParams(params.hires_fix));
   183→
   184→  return taskParams;
   185→}
   186→
   187→/**
   188→ * Creates a single magic edit task using the unified approach
   189→ * This replaces the direct call to the magic-edit edge function
   190→ * (internal use only - used by createBatchMagicEditTasks)
   191→ *
   192→ * @param params - Magic edit task parameters
   193→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   194→ */
   195→async function createMagicEditTask(params: MagicEditTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   196→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   197→    params,
   198→    context: 'MagicEdit',
   199→    validate: validateMagicEditParams,
   200→    buildTaskRequest: async (requestParams) => {
   201→      const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   202→        requestParams.project_id,
   203→        requestParams.resolution,
   204→      );
   205→
   206→      const taskParams = buildMagicEditTaskParams(requestParams, finalResolution);
   207→
   208→      return composeTaskRequest({
   209→        source: requestParams,
   210→        taskType: "qwen_image_edit",
   211→        params: taskParams,
   212→      });
   213→    },
   214→  });
   215→}
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Creates multiple magic edit tasks in parallel (batch generation)
   219→ * Used by MediaLightbox unified edit mode for creating multiple variations
   220→ * 
   221→ * @param params - Batch magic edit parameters
   222→ * @returns Promise resolving to array of created tasks
   223→ */
   224→export async function createBatchMagicEditTasks(params: BatchMagicEditTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult[]> {
   225→
   226→  try {
   227→    return await runBatchTaskPipeline({
   228→      batchParams: params,
   229→      validateBatchParams: validateBatchMagicEditParams,
   230→      buildSingleTaskParams: async (batchParams): Promise<MagicEditTaskParams[]> => {
   231→        const { resolution: finalResolution } = await resolveProjectResolution(
   232→          batchParams.project_id,
   233→          batchParams.resolution,
   234→        );
   235→
   236→        return Array.from({ length: batchParams.numImages }, (_, index) => {
   237→          const seedBase = resolveSeed32Bit({ seed: batchParams.seed, field: 'seed' });
   238→          const seed = seedBase + index;
   239→
   240→          return {
   241→            project_id: batchParams.project_id,
   242→            prompt: batchParams.prompt,
   243→            image_url: batchParams.image_url,
   244→            negative_prompt: batchParams.negative_prompt,
   245→            resolution: finalResolution,
   246→            seed,
   247→            in_scene: batchParams.in_scene,
   248→            shot_id: batchParams.shot_id,
   249→            output_format: batchParams.output_format,
   250→            enable_sync_mode: batchParams.enable_sync_mode,
   251→            max_wait_seconds: batchParams.max_wait_seconds,
   252→            enable_base64_output: batchParams.enable_base64_output,
   253→            tool_type: batchParams.tool_type,
   254→            loras: batchParams.loras,
   255→            based_on: batchParams.based_on,
   256→            source_variant_id: batchParams.source_variant_id,
   257→            create_as_generation: batchParams.create_as_generation,
   258→            hires_fix: batchParams.hires_fix,
   259→            qwen_edit_model: batchParams.qwen_edit_model,
   260→          } as MagicEditTaskParams;
   261→        });
   262→      },
   263→      createSingleTask: createMagicEditTask,
   264→      operationName: 'createBatchMagicEditTasks',
   265→    });
   266→
   267→  } catch (error) {
   268→    rethrowTaskCreationError(error, { context: 'BatchMagicEdit' });
   269→  }
   270→}
   271→
   272→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
   273→

1→/**
     2→ * Utility for extracting poster images (first frame) from video files
     3→ */
     4→
     5→/**
     6→ * Extract the first frame of a video as a Blob
     7→ * @param videoFile The video file to extract from
     8→ * @returns Promise that resolves to a Blob of the poster image (JPEG)
     9→ */
    10→export function extractVideoPosterFrame(videoFile: File): Promise<Blob> {
    11→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    12→    const video = document.createElement('video');
    13→    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    14→    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    15→
    16→    if (!ctx) {
    17→      reject(new Error('Failed to get canvas context'));
    18→      return;
    19→    }
    20→
    21→    video.preload = 'metadata';
    22→    video.muted = true;
    23→    video.playsInline = true;
    24→
    25→    // When metadata is loaded, we can get dimensions
    26→    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
    27→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    28→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    29→      
    30→      // Seek to a small time to avoid black frames at the start
    31→      video.currentTime = 0.1;
    32→    });
    33→
    34→    // When we've seeked to the right time, capture the frame
    35→    video.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
    36→      try {
    37→        // Draw the video frame to canvas
    38→        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    39→        
    40→        // Convert canvas to blob
    41→        canvas.toBlob(
    42→          (blob) => {
    43→            if (blob) {
    44→              resolve(blob);
    45→            } else {
    46→              reject(new Error('Failed to create blob from canvas'));
    47→            }
    48→            
    49→            // Cleanup
    50→            video.src = '';
    51→            URL.revokeObjectURL(video.src);
    52→          },
    53→          'image/jpeg',
    54→          0.85 // Quality
    55→        );
    56→      } catch (error) {
    57→        reject(error);
    58→      }
    59→    });
    60→
    61→    video.addEventListener('error', () => {
    62→      reject(new Error('Failed to load video'));
    63→    });
    64→
    65→    // Load the video
    66→    video.src = URL.createObjectURL(videoFile);
    67→  });
    68→}
    69→
    70→/**
    71→ * Extract the final frame of a video as a Blob
    72→ * @param videoFile The video file to extract from
    73→ * @returns Promise that resolves to a Blob of the final frame image (JPEG)
    74→ */
    75→export function extractVideoFinalFrame(videoFile: File): Promise<Blob> {
    76→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    77→    const video = document.createElement('video');
    78→    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    79→    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    80→
    81→    if (!ctx) {
    82→      reject(new Error('Failed to get canvas context'));
    83→      return;
    84→    }
    85→
    86→    video.preload = 'metadata';
    87→    video.muted = true;
    88→    video.playsInline = true;
    89→
    90→    // When metadata is loaded, we can get dimensions and duration
    91→    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
    92→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth;
    93→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight;
    94→      
    95→      // Seek to near the end (0.1 seconds before) to avoid potential issues
    96→      video.currentTime = Math.max(0, video.duration - 0.1);
    97→    });
    98→
    99→    // When we've seeked to the right time, capture the frame
   100→    video.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
   101→      try {
   102→        // Draw the video frame to canvas
   103→        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   104→        
   105→        // Convert canvas to blob
   106→        canvas.toBlob(
   107→          (blob) => {
   108→            if (blob) {
   109→              resolve(blob);
   110→            } else {
   111→              reject(new Error('Failed to create blob from canvas'));
   112→            }
   113→            
   114→            // Cleanup
   115→            video.src = '';
   116→            URL.revokeObjectURL(video.src);
   117→          },
   118→          'image/jpeg',
   119→          0.85 // Quality
   120→        );
   121→      } catch (error) {
   122→        reject(error);
   123→      }
   124→    });
   125→
   126→    video.addEventListener('error', () => {
   127→      reject(new Error('Failed to load video'));
   128→    });
   129→
   130→    // Load the video

   132→  });

1→/**
     2→ * Shot-generation link operations: add, remove, reorder images within shots.
     3→ * These operate on the shot_generations junction table.
     4→ *
     5→ * Helpers live in ./shotMutationHelpers.ts

     8→
     9→import { useMutation, useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    10→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    11→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    12→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/runtime/sonner';

    23→import {
    24→  optimisticallyRemoveFromUnifiedGenerations,
    25→} from './shotMutationHelpers';
    26→import {
    27→  applyOptimisticCaches,
    28→  replaceOptimisticItemInCache,
    29→  replaceOptimisticItemInShotsCache,
    30→  runAddImageMutation,

    33→  type AddImageToShotVariables,
    34→} from './addImageToShotHelpers';
    35→import { persistTimelineFrameBatch } from '@/shared/lib/timelineFrameBatchPersist';
    36→
    37→// Re-export useDuplicateAsNewGeneration for backwards compatibility
    38→export { useDuplicateAsNewGeneration } from './useDuplicateAsNewGeneration';
    39→
    40→// ============================================================================
    41→// ADD IMAGE TO SHOT (unified hook)
    42→// ============================================================================
    43→
    44→interface AddImageToShotContext {
    45→  previousShots: ReturnType<typeof findShotsCache> | undefined;
    46→  previousFastGens: GenerationRow[] | undefined;
    47→  project_id: string | undefined;
    48→  shot_id: string | undefined;
    49→  tempId?: string;
    50→}
    51→
    52→/**
    53→ * Add a generation to a shot.
    54→ *
    55→ * This is the unified hook that handles both positioned and unpositioned additions:
    56→ * - timelineFrame: undefined → auto-calculate position
    57→ * - timelineFrame: null → add without position (appears in unpositioned section)
    58→ * - timelineFrame: number → use explicit position
    59→ */
    60→export const useAddImageToShot = () => {
    61→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    62→
    63→  return useMutation<Record<string, unknown>, Error, AddImageToShotVariables, AddImageToShotContext>({
    64→    mutationFn: async (variables: AddImageToShotVariables) => {
    65→      const data = await runAddImageMutation(variables);
    66→      return withVariableMetadata(data, variables);
    67→    },
    68→
    69→    onMutate: async (variables): Promise<AddImageToShotContext> => {
    70→      const {
    71→        shot_id,
    72→        project_id,
    73→        imageUrl,
    74→        thumbUrl,
    75→        skipOptimistic,
    76→      } = variables;
    77→
    78→      if (!project_id) {
    79→        return { previousShots: undefined, previousFastGens: undefined, project_id: undefined, shot_id: undefined };
    80→      }
    81→
    82→      await cancelShotsQueries(queryClient, project_id);
    83→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shot_id);
    84→
    85→      const previousShots = findShotsCache(queryClient, project_id);
    86→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
    87→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shot_id)
    88→      );
    89→
    90→      let tempId: string | undefined;
    91→
    92→      // Only perform optimistic update if we have image URL and not skipped
    93→      if ((imageUrl || thumbUrl) && !skipOptimistic) {
    94→        tempId = `temp-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`;
    95→        applyOptimisticCaches(queryClient, variables, previousFastGens, tempId);
    96→      }
    97→
    98→      // Optimistically remove from unified-generations (for "items without shots" filter)
    99→      optimisticallyRemoveFromUnifiedGenerations(
   100→        queryClient,
   101→        project_id,
   102→        variables.generation_id
   103→      );
   104→
   105→      return { previousShots, previousFastGens, project_id, shot_id, tempId };
   106→    },
   107→
   108→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   109→      // Check for duplicate key constraint
   110→      const isDuplicateError =
   111→        error.message?.includes('unique_shot_generation_pair') ||
   112→        error.message?.includes('duplicate key value');
   113→
   114→      if (isDuplicateError) {
   115→        toast.error('Database error: unexpected constraint. Please try again.');
   116→        return;
   117→      }
   118→
   119→      // Rollback caches
   120→      if (context?.previousShots && context.project_id) {
   121→        rollbackShotsCaches(queryClient, context.project_id, context.previousShots);
   122→      }
   123→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shot_id) {
   124→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shot_id, context.previousFastGens);
   125→      }
   126→      if (context?.project_id) {
   127→        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   128→          [REDACTED](context.project_id),
   129→        });
   130→      }
   131→
   132→      toast.error(`Failed to add image to shot: ${toAddImageErrorMessage(error)}`);
   133→    },
   134→
   135→    onSuccess: (data, variables, context) => {
   136→      const { project_id, shot_id } = variables;
   137→
   138→      // Replace temp ID with real ID in cache
   139→      if (context?.tempId) {
   140→        replaceOptimisticItemInCache(queryClient, shot_id, context.tempId, data);
   141→        replaceOptimisticItemInShotsCache(queryClient, project_id, shot_id, context.tempId, data);
   142→      }
   143→
   144→      // Invalidate related queries
   145→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](project_id) });
   146→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id) });
   147→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   148→        [REDACTED](project_id),
   149→      });
   150→      // Invalidate byShot to ensure timeline refetches with complete data.
   151→      // Critical when the target shot's cache wasn't populated at mutation time
   152→      // (e.g., adding to a different shot than the one currently viewed),
   153→      // since no optimistic item would have been created in that case.
   154→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id) });
   155→      // Invalidate segment position map so videos reposition to match new timeline order
   156→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id) });
   157→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id, project_id) });
   158→    },
   159→  });
   160→};
   161→
   162→/**
   163→ * Add image to shot WITHOUT position.
   164→ * Backwards-compatible wrapper around useAddImageToShot.
   165→ *
   166→ * Note: This intentionally skips optimistic item creation in the shots cache
   167→ * (matching original behavior). The item will appear after realtime confirms.

   183→// ============================================================================
   184→// REMOVE IMAGE FROM SHOT
   185→// ============================================================================
   186→
   187→/**
   188→ * Remove image from shot's timeline (sets timeline_frame = NULL).
   189→ * This does NOT delete the shot_generations record - just removes the position.

   191→export const useRemoveImageFromShot = () => {
   192→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   193→  const log = import.meta.env.DEV ? (...args: Parameters<typeof console.log>) => console.log(...args) : () => {};
   194→
   195→  return useMutation({
   196→    mutationFn: async ({

   209→        throw new Error(`Missing required parameters`);
   210→      }
   211→
   212→      const { error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   213→        .update({ timeline_frame: null })
   214→        .eq('id', shotGenerationId);
   215→
   216→      if (error) {

   218→      }
   219→
   220→      // Persist frame shifts (optimistic update already applied in onMutate)

   233→        });

   236→      return { shotId, shotGenerationId, projectId };
   237→    },
   238→
   239→    onMutate: async (variables) => {
   240→      const { shotId, shotGenerationId, projectId, shiftItems } = variables;
   241→
   242→      await cancelShotsQueries(queryClient, projectId);
   243→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shotId);
   244→
   245→      const previousShots = findShotsCache(queryClient, projectId);
   246→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(

   309→// ============================================================================
   310→// UPDATE SHOT IMAGE ORDER
   311→// ============================================================================
   312→
   313→export const useUpdateShotImageOrder = () => {
   314→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   315→
   316→  return useMutation({

   323→      projectId: string;

   329→          .eq('shot_id', update.shot_id)
   330→          .eq('generation_id', update.generation_id)
   331→      );

   333→      const results = await Promise.all(promises);

   335→      const errors = results.filter(r => r.error);
   336→      if (errors.length > 0) {

   351→
   352→      if (previousFastGens) {
   353→        const updatedGens = previousFastGens.map(gen => {
   354→          const update = updates.find(u => u.generation_id === gen.generation_id);
   355→          if (update) {
   356→            return { ...gen, timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame };
   357→          }
   358→          return gen;
   359→        });
   360→
   361→        updatedGens.sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame || 0) - (b.timeline_frame || 0));
   362→        queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), updatedGens);
   363→      }
   364→
   365→      return { previousFastGens, shotId };
   366→    },
   367→
   368→    onError: (_err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   369→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   370→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   371→      }
   372→
   373→      toast.error('Failed to reorder images');
   374→    },
   375→
   376→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   377→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   378→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   379→        predicate: query => query.queryKey[0] === 'source-slot-generations',
   380→      });
   381→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   382→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId) });
   383→    },
   384→  });
   385→};
   386→
   387→// ============================================================================
   388→// POSITION EXISTING GENERATION IN SHOT
   389→// ============================================================================
   390→
   391→/**
   392→ * Position an existing generation that has NULL timeline_frame.
   393→ */
   394→export const usePositionExistingGenerationInShot = () => {
   395→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   396→
   397→  return useMutation({
   398→    mutationFn: async ({
   399→      shot_id,
   400→      generation_id,
   401→      project_id,
   402→    }: {
   403→      shot_id: string;
   404→      generation_id: string;
   405→      project_id: string;
   406→    }) => {
   407→      const { data, error } = await supabase().rpc('add_generation_to_shot', {
   408→        p_shot_id: shot_id,
   409→        p_generation_id: generation_id,
   410→        p_with_position: true,
   411→      });
   412→
   413→      if (error) {
   414→        throw error;
   415→      }
   416→
   417→      return { shot_id, generation_id, project_id, data };
   418→    },
   419→
   420→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   421→      enqueueGenerationsInvalidation(queryClient, data.shot_id, {
   422→        reason: 'add-image-to-shot',
   423→        scope: 'all',
   424→        includeShots: true,
   425→        projectId: data.project_id,
   426→        includeProjectUnified: true,
   427→      });
   428→    },
   429→
   430→    onError: (error: Error) => {
   431→      toast.error(`Failed to position image: ${error.message}`);
   432→    },
   433→  });
   434→};

   198→export async function createGenerationFromTask(

   322→/**
   323→ * Handle regeneration case - task already has a generation, create new variant
   324→ */
   325→async function handleRegeneration(
   326→  supabase: SupabaseClient,

   328→  taskData: CompletedTaskData,
   329→  existingGeneration: GenerationRef,
   330→  publicUrl: string,
   331→  thumbnailUrl: string | null | undefined,
   332→  logger?: unknown
   333→): Promise<GenerationRef> {
   334→  logger?.info("Existing generation found - creating regenerated variant", {
   335→    task_id: taskId,
   336→    existing_generation_id: existingGeneration.id,
   337→    action: "create_regenerated_variant"
   338→  });
   339→
   340→  const variantParams = {
   341→    ...taskData.params,
   342→    source_task_id: taskId,
   343→    created_from: 'task_completion',
   344→    tool_type: taskData.tool_type,
   345→  };
   346→
   347→  await createVariant(
   348→    supabase,
   349→    existingGeneration.id,
   350→    publicUrl,
   351→    thumbnailUrl || null,
   352→    variantParams,

   354→    'regenerated',
   355→    null
   356→  );

   359→  if (shotId) {
   360→    await linkGenerationToShot(supabase, shotId, existingGeneration.id, addInPosition);
   361→  }
   362→
   363→  const { error: markGenerationCreatedError } = await supabase
   364→    .from('tasks')
   365→    .update({ generation_created: true })
   366→    .eq('id', taskId);
   367→

   377→      },

   379→    });
   380→  }
   381→
   382→  return existingGeneration;
   383→}

1→/**
     2→ * Video Thumbnail Generator
     3→ *
     4→ * Extracts thumbnails from videos on the client side and uploads them to storage.

     7→
     8→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';

    25→/**
    26→ * Extracts a thumbnail from a video at a specific time
    27→ */
    28→function extractThumbnailFromVideo(
    29→  videoUrl: string,
    30→  timeInSeconds: number = 0.001
    31→): Promise<Blob> {
    32→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    33→    const video = document.createElement('video');
    34→    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    35→    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    36→
    37→    if (!ctx) {
    38→      reject(new Error('Failed to get canvas context'));
    39→      return;
    40→    }
    41→
    42→    video.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
    43→    video.preload = 'metadata';
    44→    video.muted = true;
    45→    video.playsInline = true;
    46→
    47→    // Handle video loaded
    48→    video.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
    49→      // Set canvas size to video dimensions (or max 1280px width)
    50→      const maxWidth = 1280;
    51→      const scale = Math.min(1, maxWidth / video.videoWidth);
    52→      canvas.width = video.videoWidth * scale;
    53→      canvas.height = video.videoHeight * scale;
    54→
    55→      // Seek to the desired time (or start if video is shorter)
    56→      video.currentTime = Math.min(timeInSeconds, video.duration - 0.1);
    57→    });
    58→
    59→    // Handle seeked event
    60→    video.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
    61→      try {
    62→        // Draw video frame to canvas
    63→        ctx.drawImage(video, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    64→
    65→        // Convert to blob (JPEG, 85% quality)
    66→        canvas.toBlob(
    67→          (blob) => {
    68→            video.remove();
    69→            if (blob) {
    70→              resolve(blob);
    71→            } else {
    72→              reject(new Error('Failed to create blob from canvas'));
    73→            }
    74→          },
    75→          'image/jpeg',
    76→          0.85
    77→        );
    78→      } catch (error) {
    79→        video.remove();
    80→        reject(error);
    81→      }
    82→    });
    83→
    84→    // Handle errors
    85→    video.addEventListener('error', () => {
    86→      video.remove();
    87→      reject(new Error(`Video loading failed: ${video.error?.message || 'Unknown error'}`));
    88→    });
    89→
    90→    // Start loading
    91→    video.src = getDisplayUrl(videoUrl);
    92→  });
    93→}

1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)

    15→/** Maximum allowed gap between timeline frames (5s at 16fps). */
    16→const MAX_FRAME_GAP = 81;
    17→
    18→// ============================================================================

    22→interface FrameUpdate {
    23→  id: string;
    24→  newFrame: number;
    25→  reason: string;
    26→}
    27→

    29→// Normalization

    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    34→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    35→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop
    80→// ============================================================================
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Find a ShotGeneration by canonical shot_generations.id.
    84→ */
    85→export function findGeneration(
    86→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    87→  key?: string | null
    88→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    89→  if (!key) return undefined;
    90→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key);
    91→}
    92→
    93→interface DistributionContext {
    94→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];
    95→  draggedItemIds: string[];
    96→  newStartIndex: number;
    97→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    98→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   103→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).
   104→ */
   105→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   106→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   107→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];
   108→
   109→  const pushUpdate = (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => {
   110→    const normalizedFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame));
   111→    accumulateUpdates.push({ id, newFrame: normalizedFrame, reason });
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   115→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   116→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   117→
   118→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   119→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   120→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   121→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   122→    );
   123→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   124→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   125→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   126→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   127→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   128→
   129→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   130→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   131→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   132→    });
   133→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {
   134→    // At end - extend timeline using average spacing of existing items
   135→    const existingFrames = allItems
   136→      .filter(item => item.timeline_frame != null)
   137→      .map(item => item.timeline_frame!);
   138→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   139→
   140→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   141→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   142→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   143→    });
   144→  } else if (successor && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   145→    // At start - distribute between 0 and successor
   146→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame;
   147→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   148→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   149→
   150→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   151→      const newFrame = interval * (i + 1);
   152→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed from start (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   153→    });
   154→  } else {
   155→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   226→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   227→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   228→    }
   229→  });
   230→  return uniqueUpdates;
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   235→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   236→ */
   237→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   238→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   239→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   240→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   241→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   242→
   243→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   244→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   245→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   246→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   247→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   251→
   252→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   253→
   254→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   255→
   256→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   257→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   258→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   259→    if (existing) {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });
   261→    } else {
   262→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, payload);
   263→    }
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return uniqueUpdates;
   267→}
   268→

    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    78→
    79→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    80→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    81→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    82→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    83→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    84→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    85→
    86→  if (variantCountsError) {
    87→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    88→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    89→      cause: variantCountsError,
    90→    });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  if (variantCountsData) {
    94→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    95→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    96→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    97→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    98→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    99→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
   100→      }
   101→    }
   102→  }
   103→
   104→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   109→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   110→ */
   111→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   112→  generationIds: string[]
   113→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   114→  try {
   115→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   116→  } catch (error) {
   117→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   118→    return {
   119→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   120→      degraded: true,
   121→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   122→    };
   123→  }
   124→}
   125→
   126→/**
   127→ * Raw variant record from generation_variants table (before transformation)
   128→ */
   129→export interface RawVariant {
   130→  id: string;
   131→  generation_id: string;
   132→  location: string;
   133→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   134→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   135→  variant_type?: string | null;
   136→  name?: string | null;
   137→  created_at: string;
   138→  /** Only present for derived-items queries */
