```
   140→  viewed_at?: string | null;
   141→}
   142→
   143→/**
   144→ * Raw generation record from database (before transformation)
   145→ */
   146→export interface RawGeneration {
   147→  id: string;
   148→  location: string;
   149→  thumbnail_url?: string | null;
   150→  type?: string | null;
   151→  created_at: string;
   152→  updated_at?: string | null;
   153→  params?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   154→  starred?: boolean | null;
   155→  tasks?: string[] | string | null;
   156→  based_on?: string | null;
   157→  name?: string | null;
   158→  derivedCount?: number; // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   159→  hasUnviewedVariants?: boolean; // Whether any variants have viewed_at === null (for NEW badge)
   160→  unviewedVariantCount?: number; // Count of unviewed variants
   161→  // Parent/child relationship fields
   162→  is_child?: boolean | null;
   163→  parent_generation_id?: string | null;
   164→  child_order?: number | null;
   165→  // JSONB column mapping shot_id -> array of timeline_frames
   166→  // Each generation can appear multiple times in the same shot (different positions)
   167→  // Example: { "shot_id_123": [120, 420, null] } means 3 entries: at frame 120, 420, and one unpositioned
   168→  shot_data?: Record<string, (number | null)[]>;
   169→}
   170→
   171→/**
   172→ * Raw shot_generation record from database (before transformation)
   173→ */
   174→export interface RawShotGeneration {
   175→  id: string;
   176→  shot_id: string;
   177→  generation_id: string;
   178→  timeline_frame: number | null;
   179→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   180→  created_at?: string;
   181→  generation?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   182→  generations?: RawGeneration | RawGeneration[] | null;
   183→}
   184→
   185→/**
   186→ * Options for transformation customization
   187→ */
   188→interface TransformOptions {
   189→  /** Shot image entry ID (from shot_generations table) */
   190→  shotImageEntryId?: string;
   191→  /** Timeline frame position */
   192→  timeline_frame?: number | null;
   193→  /** Additional metadata to merge */
   194→  metadata?: Record<string, unknown> | null;
   195→  /** Shot ID for filtering */
   196→  shotId?: string;
   197→  /** Whether to include verbose logging */
   198→  verbose?: boolean;
   199→}
   200→
   201→/**
   202→ * Extract prompt from various nested param structures
   203→ */
   204→function extractPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined): string {
   205→  if (!params) return 'No prompt';
   206→
   207→  const originalParams = asRecord(params.originalParams);
   208→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   209→  const metadataBlock = asRecord(params.metadata);
   210→
   211→  return firstString(
   212→    orchestratorDetails?.prompt,
   213→    params.prompt,
   214→    metadataBlock?.prompt,
   215→  ) ?? 'No prompt';
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = asRecord(item.params?.originalParams);
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   231→    const fullPayload = asRecord(item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   232→    const originalFullPayload = asRecord(originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl = firstString(
   235→      item.params?.thumbnailUrl,
   236→      orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url,
   237→      fullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   238→      originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   239→    ) ?? undefined;
   240→  }
   241→  
   242→  // Final fallback to main URL
   243→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   244→}
   245→
   246→/**
   247→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   248→ */
   249→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   250→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   251→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   252→}
   253→
   254→/**
   255→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   256→ * 
   257→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   258→ * 
   259→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   260→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   261→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   262→ */
   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   266→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   267→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   268→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   269→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   270→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   271→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   272→  
   273→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   274→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   275→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   282→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   283→    contentType = 'image/png';
   284→  }
   285→  
   286→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   287→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   288→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   289→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   290→
   291→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   293→    id: item.id,
   294→    url: mainUrl,
   295→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   296→    urlIdentity,
   297→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   298→    prompt,
   299→    metadata: {
   300→      ...(item.params || {}),
   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   318→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   319→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   320→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   321→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   325→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(asRecord(item.shot_data));
   326→  
   327→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   328→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   329→    return {
   330→      ...baseItem,
   331→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   332→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   333→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   334→    };
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   345→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   346→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   347→      };
   348→    }
   349→    
   350→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}
```

```
   170→    const expectedSegmentCountResolution = resolveExpectedSegmentCount(
   171→      taskType,
   172→      orchestratorTask.params,
   173→    );
   174→    if (expectedSegmentCountResolution.invalid) {
   175→      throw new CompletionError({

   177→        context: 'checkOrchestratorCompletion',

   184→          raw_value: expectedSegmentCountResolution.raw ?? null,
   185→        },
   186→      });
   187→    }
   188→    const segmentStats = summarizeSegmentCompletion(allSegments);
   189→    const segmentGate = evaluateSegmentCompletionGate(
   190→      expectedSegmentCountResolution.value,
   191→      segmentStats,
   192→    );
   193→    if (segmentGate.kind === 'wait') {
   194→      return;
   195→    }
   196→    if (segmentGate.kind === 'fail') {
   197→      if (segmentGate.reason === 'segments_failed') {
   198→        await markOrchestratorFailed(
   199→          supabase,
   200→          orchestratorTaskId,

   202→          segmentGate.foundSegments,

   204→          logger,
   205→        );
   206→      } else {

   208→          supabase,
   209→          orchestratorTaskId,

   213→          logger,

   216→      return;

   222→        completedTask.project_id,
   223→        orchestratorTaskId,
   224→        orchestratorRunId,
   225→      );
   226→      switch (finalStitchStatus) {
   227→        case 'pending':
   228→          return;
   229→        case 'failed':

   246→        supabase,
   247→        orchestratorTask,
   248→        orchestratorTaskId,
   249→        allSegments,
   250→        publicUrl,

   252→        supabaseUrl,
   253→        serviceKey,
   254→        logger,
   255→      },
   256→    );
   257→  } catch (error) {
   258→    throw toCompletionError(error, {

   271→/**
   272→ * Find sibling segment tasks using run_id (preferred) or orchestrator_task_id (fallback)
   273→ */
   274→async function findSiblingSegments(
   275→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   276→  segmentType: string,
   277→  projectId: string,
   278→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   279→  orchestratorRunId: string | null
   280→): Promise<SegmentTask[]> {
   281→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   282→    const runIdRows = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   283→      supabase,
   284→      taskType: segmentType,
   285→      projectId,
   286→      select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   287→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   288→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   289→    });
   290→    if (runIdRows.length > 0) {
   291→      return runIdRows;
   292→    }
   293→  }
   294→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   295→    supabase,
   296→    taskType: segmentType,
   297→    projectId,
   298→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   299→    orchestratorTaskId,
   300→    contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   301→  });
   302→  return orchestratorRows;
   303→}
   304→/**
   305→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   306→ */
   307→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   308→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   309→  finalStepType: string,
   310→  projectId: string,
   311→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   312→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   313→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   314→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   315→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   316→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   317→      supabase,
   318→      taskType: finalStepType,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      select: "id, status",
   321→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   322→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   323→    });
   324→  }
   325→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   326→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   327→      supabase,
   328→      taskType: finalStepType,
   329→      projectId,
   330→      select: "id, status",
   331→      orchestratorTaskId,
   332→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   333→    });
   334→  }
   335→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   336→    return 'not_found';
   337→  }
   338→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   339→    return 'failed';
   340→  }
   341→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Complete')) {
   342→    return 'complete';
   343→  }
   344→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Queued' || task.status === 'In Progress')) {
   345→    return 'pending';
   346→  }
   347→  return 'unknown';
   348→}
   349→/**
   350→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   351→ */
   352→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   353→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   354→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   355→  failedSegments: number,
   356→  totalSegments: number,
   357→  errorMessage?: string,
   358→  logger?: {
   359→    warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   360→    error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   361→  },
   362→): Promise<void> {
   363→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   364→    .from("tasks")
   365→    .update({
   366→      status: "Failed",
   367→      error_message: errorMessage ?? `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   368→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   369→    })
   370→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   371→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   372→    .select('id');
   373→  if (updateOrchError) {
   374→    throw new CompletionError({
   375→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_failed_update_failed',
   376→      context: 'markOrchestratorFailed',
   377→      recoverable: true,
   378→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   379→      metadata: {
   380→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   381→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   382→          ? updateOrchError.message
   383→          : String(updateOrchError),
   384→      },
   385→      cause: updateOrchError,
   386→    });
   387→  }
   388→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   389→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   390→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   391→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   392→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   393→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   394→    });
   395→  }
   396→}
   397→/**
   398→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   399→ */
   400→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   401→  params: {
   402→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   403→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   404→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   405→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   406→    publicUrl: string;
   407→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   408→    supabaseUrl: string;
   409→    serviceKey: string;
   410→    logger?: {
   411→      warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   412→      error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   413→    };
   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {
   416→  const {
   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: "Complete",
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   438→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   439→  };
   440→  if (isFinalStep) {
   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   448→    .select('id');
   449→  if (updateOrchError) {
   450→    throw new CompletionError({
   451→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   452→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   453→      recoverable: true,
   454→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   455→      metadata: {
   456→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   457→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→    });
   469→    return;
   470→  }
   471→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   472→    supabaseUrl,
   473→    serviceKey,
   474→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   475→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   476→  });
   477→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   478→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   479→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   480→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   481→    supabase,
   482→    orchestratorTaskId,
   483→    existingResultData,
   484→    billingOutcome,
   485→    billingDecision,
   486→    logger,
   487→  );
   488→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   489→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   490→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   491→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   492→      billing_result: billingResult,
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→}
   496→
```

```
   116→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {

   242→    return Object.entries(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).map(([url, strength]) => ({
   243→      url,
   244→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   245→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   246→    }));
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return [];
   250→}
   251→
   252→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {
   253→  const fileName = url.split('/').pop() || 'Unknown';
   254→  return fileName.replace(/\.(safetensors|ckpt|pt)$/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
   255→}
   256→
   257→const TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   258→  'individualSegmentParams',
   259→  'taskViewContract',
   260→  'familyContract',
   261→  'rawParams',
   262→];
   263→
   264→const TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   265→  'taskViewContract',
   266→  'familyContract',
   267→  'orchestratorDetails',
   268→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   269→  'rawParams',
   270→];
   271→
   272→const TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   273→  'taskViewContract',
   274→  'familyContract',
   275→  'individualSegmentParams',
   276→  'orchestratorDetails',
   277→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   278→  'rawParams',
   279→];
   280→
   281→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   282→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));
   283→}
   284→
   285→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
   286→  const familyContract = asRecord(params.task_family_contract);
   287→  return (
   288→    params.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   289→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   290→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   291→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   292→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   293→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   294→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   295→  );
   296→}
   297→
   298→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   299→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   300→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   301→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   302→
   303→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   304→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   306→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   307→    }
   308→
   309→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   310→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   311→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   312→  }
   313→
   314→  const timelineSources = [
   315→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   316→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   317→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   318→  ];
   319→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {
   320→    if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {
   321→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(candidate);
   322→    }
   323→  }
   324→
   325→  return [];
   326→}
   327→
   328→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   329→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   330→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   331→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   332→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   333→
   334→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   335→    const enhancedPromptsExpanded = reader.pickStringArray('enhanced_prompts_expanded', [
   336→      'orchestratorDetails',
   337→      'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   338→      'rawParams',
   339→    ]);
   340→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   341→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   342→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   343→    );
   344→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   345→      return enhancedPrompt;
   346→    }
   347→
   348→    return (
   349→      pickFirstString(
   350→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   351→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   352→      ) ?? null
   353→    );
   354→  }
   355→
   356→  return (
   357→    pickFirstString(
   358→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   359→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   360→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   361→    ) ?? null
   362→  );
   363→}
   364→
   365→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   366→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   367→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   368→  return numeric;
   369→}
   370→
   371→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   372→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   373→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   374→}
```

```
   356→    for (let index = 0; index < totalJoins; index++) {
   357→      const joinSettings = buildJoinOverrideRecord(params.per_join_settings?.[index]);
   358→
   359→      if (Object.keys(joinSettings).length > 0) {
   360→        hasOverrides = true;
   361→        perJoinOverrides.push(joinSettings);
   362→      } else {
   363→        perJoinOverrides.push({});
   364→      }
   365→    }
   366→
   367→    if (hasOverrides) {
   368→      orchestratorDetails.per_join_settings = perJoinOverrides;
   369→    }
   370→  }
   371→
   372→  const resolutionDisplay = params.resolution
   373→    ? `${params.resolution[0]}x${params.resolution[1]}`
   374→    : undefined;
   375→
   376→  const joinMode = normalized.joinMode;
   377→
   378→  const perJoinOverridesCount = params.per_join_settings?.filter((override) =>
   379→    !!override && Object.keys(override).length > 0
   380→  ).length ?? 0;
   381→
   382→  const familyContract = buildJoinClipsFamilyContract({
   383→    mode: joinMode,
   384→    runId,
   385→    clipUrls: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   386→    overridesCount: perJoinOverridesCount,
   387→    hasAudio: Boolean(params.audio_url),
   388→  });
   389→
   390→  const payload = composeTaskFamilyPayload({
   391→    taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   392→    orchestratorDetails,
   393→    orchestrationInput: {
   394→      taskFamily: 'join_clips',
   395→      orchestratorTaskId,
   396→      runId,
   397→      parentGenerationId: params.parent_generation_id,
   398→      shotId: params.shot_id,
   399→      basedOn: params.based_on,
   400→      generationRouting: 'orchestrator',
   401→      siblingLookup: 'run_id',
   402→    },
   403→    taskViewInput: {
   404→      inputImages: clipSequence.map((clip) => clip.url),
   405→      prompt: params.prompt,
   406→      negativePrompt: params.negative_prompt,
   407→      modelName: params.model,
   408→      resolution: resolutionDisplay,
   409→    },
   410→    familyContract,
   411→  });
   412→
   413→  return {
   414→    ...payload,
   415→    parent_generation_id: params.parent_generation_id,
   416→    // Only include tool_type if explicitly passed (Join Clips page passes it, ShotEditor doesn't)
   417→    ...(params.tool_type && { tool_type: params.tool_type }),
   418→  };
   419→}
   420→
   421→/**
   422→ * Creates a join clips task using the unified approach
   423→ * 
   424→ * @param params - Join clips task parameters
   425→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   426→ */
   427→export async function createCanonicalJoinClipsTask(
   428→  params: CanonicalJoinClipsTaskInput,
   429→): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   430→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   431→    params,
   432→    context: 'JoinClips',
   433→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   434→      const normalized = normalizeJoinClipsParams(requestParams);
   435→      const orchestratorTaskId = generateTaskId("join_clips_orchestrator");
   436→      const runId = requestParams.run_id ?? generateRunId();
   437→      const orchestratorPayload = buildJoinClipsPayload(
   438→        requestParams,
   439→        normalized,
   440→        runId,
   441→        orchestratorTaskId,
   442→      );
   443→
   444→      return composeTaskRequest({
   445→        source: requestParams,
   446→        taskType: 'join_clips_orchestrator',
   447→        params: orchestratorPayload,
   448→      });
   449→    },
   450→  });
   451→}
   452→
   453→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
```

```
    35→export function useImageTransform({

    39→}: UseImageTransformProps): UseImageTransformReturn {
    40→  const [transform, setTransform] = useState<ImageTransform>(DEFAULT_TRANSFORM);

    50→
    51→  // Per-variant transform cache (preserves transforms when switching variants)
    52→  const transformCacheRef = useRef<Map<string, ImageTransform>>(new Map());

    54→  const skipNextCacheRef = useRef(false);
```

```
    68→  video_quality: 'high',

    71→/**
    72→ * Default values for FlashVSR upscaling (internal use only - not exported)
    73→ */

    75→  FlashVsrUpscaleApiParams,
    76→  'upscale_factor' | 'color_fix' | 'output_quality'
    77→>> = {
    78→  upscale_factor: 2,
    79→  color_fix: true,
    80→  output_quality: 'high',
    81→};
    82→
    83→/**
    84→ * Combined video enhancement task parameters
    85→ */
    86→export interface VideoEnhanceTaskParams {
    87→  // Required
    88→  project_id: string;
    89→  video_url: string;
    90→
    91→  // Mode selection - at least one must be true
    92→  enable_interpolation: boolean;
    93→  enable_upscale: boolean;
    94→
    95→  // FILM interpolation params (used when enable_interpolation is true)
    96→  interpolation?: FilmInterpolationApiParams;
    97→
    98→  // FlashVSR upscale params (used when enable_upscale is true)
    99→  upscale?: FlashVsrUpscaleApiParams;
   100→
   101→  // Task metadata
   102→  shot_id?: string;
   103→  /** Generation ID this enhancement is based on - creates variant when set */
   104→  based_on?: string;
   105→  /** Source variant ID - track which variant was enhanced */
   106→  source_variant_id?: string;
   107→}
   108→
   109→/**
   110→ * Validates video enhancement task parameters
   111→ */
   112→function validateVideoEnhanceParams(params: VideoEnhanceTaskParams): void {
   113→  validateRequiredFields(params, ['project_id', 'video_url']);
   114→
   115→  if (!params.enable_interpolation && !params.enable_upscale) {
   116→    throw new TaskValidationError(
   117→      "At least one enhancement mode (interpolation or upscale) must be enabled",
   118→      'enable_interpolation'
   119→    );
   120→  }
   121→
   122→  // Validate interpolation params if enabled
   123→  if (params.enable_interpolation && params.interpolation?.num_frames !== undefined) {
   124→    if (params.interpolation.num_frames < 1 || params.interpolation.num_frames > 4) {
   125→      throw new TaskValidationError(
   126→        "num_frames must be between 1 and 4",
   127→        'interpolation.num_frames'
   128→      );
   129→    }
   130→  }
   131→
   132→  // Validate upscale params if enabled
   133→  if (params.enable_upscale && params.upscale?.upscale_factor !== undefined) {
   134→    if (params.upscale.upscale_factor < 1 || params.upscale.upscale_factor > 4) {
   135→      throw new TaskValidationError(
   136→        "upscale_factor must be between 1 and 4",
   137→        'upscale.upscale_factor'
   138→      );
   139→    }
   140→  }
   141→}
   142→
   143→/**
   144→ * Builds the task payload for video enhancement
   145→ */
   146→function buildVideoEnhancePayload(
   147→  params: VideoEnhanceTaskParams
   148→): Record<string, unknown> {
   149→  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
   150→    video_url: params.video_url,
   151→    enable_interpolation: params.enable_interpolation,
   152→    enable_upscale: params.enable_upscale,
   153→  };
   154→
   155→  // Add interpolation params with defaults
   156→  if (params.enable_interpolation) {
   157→    payload.interpolation = {
   158→      num_frames: params.interpolation?.num_frames ?? DEFAULT_FILM_PARAMS.num_frames,
   159→      use_calculated_fps: params.interpolation?.use_calculated_fps ?? DEFAULT_FILM_PARAMS.use_calculated_fps,
   160→      video_quality: params.interpolation?.video_quality ?? DEFAULT_FILM_PARAMS.video_quality,
   161→      // Optional params only if provided
   162→      ...(params.interpolation?.use_scene_detection !== undefined && {
   163→        use_scene_detection: params.interpolation.use_scene_detection,
   164→      }),
   165→      ...(params.interpolation?.loop !== undefined && {
   166→        loop: params.interpolation.loop,
   167→      }),
   168→      ...(params.interpolation?.fps !== undefined && {
   169→        fps: params.interpolation.fps,
   170→      }),
   171→      ...(params.interpolation?.video_write_mode !== undefined && {
   172→        video_write_mode: params.interpolation.video_write_mode,
   173→      }),
   174→    };
   175→  }
   176→
   177→  // Add upscale params with defaults
   178→  if (params.enable_upscale) {
   179→    payload.upscale = {
   180→      upscale_factor: params.upscale?.upscale_factor ?? DEFAULT_FLASHVSR_PARAMS.upscale_factor,
   181→      color_fix: params.upscale?.color_fix ?? DEFAULT_FLASHVSR_PARAMS.color_fix,
   182→      output_quality: params.upscale?.output_quality ?? DEFAULT_FLASHVSR_PARAMS.output_quality,
   183→      // Optional params only if provided
   184→      ...(params.upscale?.quality !== undefined && {
   185→        quality: params.upscale.quality,
   186→      }),
   187→      ...(params.upscale?.acceleration !== undefined && {
   188→        acceleration: params.upscale.acceleration,
   189→      }),
   190→      ...(params.upscale?.output_format !== undefined && {
   191→        output_format: params.upscale.output_format,
   192→      }),
   193→      ...(params.upscale?.output_write_mode !== undefined && {
   194→        output_write_mode: params.upscale.output_write_mode,
   195→      }),
   196→      ...(params.upscale?.preserve_audio !== undefined && {
   197→        preserve_audio: params.upscale.preserve_audio,
   198→      }),
   199→    };
   200→  }
   201→
   202→  // Add metadata
   203→  if (params.shot_id) {
   204→    payload.shot_id = params.shot_id;
   205→  }
   206→  // based_on tells complete_task to create a variant on the source generation
   207→  if (params.based_on) {
   208→    payload.based_on = params.based_on;
   209→    payload.parent_generation_id = params.based_on;
   210→    // is_primary=true makes the enhanced version the main display variant
   211→    payload.is_primary = true;
   212→  }
   213→  // source_variant_id tracks which variant was enhanced (for UI display)
   214→  if (params.source_variant_id) {
   215→    payload.source_variant_id = params.source_variant_id;
   216→  }
   217→
   218→  return payload;
   219→}
   220→
   221→/**
   222→ * Result of creating a video enhancement task
   223→ */
   224→interface VideoEnhanceTaskResult {
   225→  task: TaskCreationResult;
   226→}
   227→
   228→/**
   229→ * Creates a video enhancement task
   230→ *
   231→ * @param params - Video enhancement task parameters
   232→ * @returns Promise resolving to the created task
   233→ */
   234→export async function createVideoEnhanceTask(
   235→  params: VideoEnhanceTaskParams
   236→): Promise<VideoEnhanceTaskResult> {
   237→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({
   238→    params,
   239→    context: 'VideoEnhance',
   240→    validate: validateVideoEnhanceParams,
   241→    buildTaskRequest: (requestParams) => {
   242→      const payload = buildVideoEnhancePayload(requestParams);
   243→
   244→      return composeTaskRequest({
   245→        source: requestParams,
   246→        taskType: 'video_enhance',
   247→        params: {
   248→          tool_type: 'video-enhance',
   249→          ...payload,
   250→        },
   251→      });
   252→    },
   253→    onCreated: (task) => ({ task }),
   254→  });
   255→}
   256→
   257→// TaskValidationError is used internally - import from taskCreation.ts if needed externally
```

```
     7→
     8→export interface RuntimeErrorOptions extends ErrorReportOptions {
     9→  toastTitle?: string;
    10→  showToast?: boolean;
    11→}
    12→
    13→/** Normalize unknown errors and route them through the shared presenter. */
    14→export function normalizeAndPresentError(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): AppError {
    15→  const { context, logData, onError, toastTitle, showToast } = options;
    16→  const appError = reportError(error, { context, logData, onError });
    17→
    18→  const shouldShowToast = showToast ?? appError.showToast;
    19→  if (shouldShowToast) {
    20→    presentRuntimeError(appError, toastTitle);
    21→  }
    22→
    23→  return appError;
    24→}
    25→
    26→/** Normalize, present, then throw for caller-level control-flow stops. */
    27→export function normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(error: unknown, options: RuntimeErrorOptions): never {
    28→  throw normalizeAndPresentError(error, options);
    29→}
```

```
     9→ * Functions here handle:

    31→ */
    32→export interface PairMetadata {

    54→interface NormalizedLoraPair {
    55→  path: string;

    58→
    59→/** Convert pair_loras format (Array<{path, strength}>) to ActiveLora[] */
    60→function pairLorasToArray(pairLoras: NormalizedLoraPair[]): ActiveLora[] {
    61→  return pairLoras.map((lora) => {
    62→    const filename = lora.path.split('/').pop()?.replace('.safetensors', '') || lora.path;
    63→    return {
    64→      id: lora.path,
    65→      name: filename,
    66→      path: lora.path,
    67→      strength: lora.strength,
    68→    };
    69→  });
    70→}
    71→
    72→function normalizeLegacyLoraRecord(value: unknown): NormalizedLoraPair[] | undefined {
    73→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
    74→    return undefined;
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>);
    78→  if (entries.length === 0) {
    79→    return undefined;
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  return entries.map(([path, strength]) => ({
    83→    path,
    84→    strength: typeof strength === 'number' ? strength : 1.0,
    85→  }));
    86→}
    87→
    88→function normalizeLoraPairArray(value: unknown): NormalizedLoraPair[] | undefined {
    89→  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0) {
    90→    return undefined;
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  const normalized = value
    94→    .filter((entry): entry is { path?: unknown; strength?: unknown } => !!entry && typeof entry === 'object')
    95→    .map((entry) => {
    96→      if (typeof entry.path !== 'string') {
    97→        return null;
    98→      }
    99→      return {
   100→        path: entry.path,
   101→        strength: typeof entry.strength === 'number' ? entry.strength : 1.0,
   102→      };
   103→    })

   139→export function extractSettingsFromParams(

   158→  const seed = (params.seed ?? orchDetails.seed ?? defaults?.seed) as number | undefined;
   159→
   160→  // Extract motion settings
   161→  const motionMode = (params.motion_mode ?? orchDetails.motion_mode ?? defaults?.motionMode ?? 'basic') as 'basic' | 'advanced';
   162→  const amountOfMotion = params.amount_of_motion != null
   163→    ? Math.round((params.amount_of_motion as number) * 100) // Convert 0-1 to 0-100
   164→    : (orchDetails.amount_of_motion != null
   165→        ? Math.round((orchDetails.amount_of_motion as number) * 100)
   166→        : (defaults?.amountOfMotion ?? 50));

   168→  // Extract phase config (only if advanced mode)
   169→  let phaseConfig: PhaseConfig | undefined = undefined;
   170→  if (motionMode === 'advanced') {

   172→    if (phaseConfig) {

   176→
   177→  // Extract selected preset ID
   178→  const selectedPhasePresetId = (params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? orchDetails.selected_phase_preset_id ?? defaults?.selectedPhasePresetId ?? null) as string | null;
   179→
   180→  const normalizedLoraParams = normalizeLoraParams(params, orchDetails);
   181→  const loras = normalizedLoraParams
   182→    ? pairLorasToArray(normalizedLoraParams)
   183→    : (defaults?.loras ?? []);
   184→
   185→  const result = {
   186→    prompt,
   187→    negativePrompt,
   188→    motionMode,
   189→    amountOfMotion,
   190→    phaseConfig,
   191→    selectedPhasePresetId,
   192→    loras,
   193→    numFrames,
   194→    randomSeed,
   195→    seed,
   196→    makePrimaryVariant: defaults?.makePrimaryVariant ?? false,
   197→  };
   198→
   199→  return result;
   200→}
   201→
   202→// =============================================================================
   203→// BUILD METADATA UPDATE
   204→// =============================================================================
   205→
   206→/**
   207→ * Settings to save to pair metadata.
   208→ * Convention:
   209→ *   undefined = don't touch this field
   210→ *   null = explicitly clear (for nullable fields)
   211→ *   '' = explicitly clear override (for string fields)
   212→ *   value = set the override
   213→ */
   214→interface PairSettingsToSave {
   215→  prompt?: string;
   216→  negativePrompt?: string;
   217→  textBeforePrompts?: string;
   218→  textAfterPrompts?: string;
   219→  motionMode?: 'basic' | 'advanced';
   220→  amountOfMotion?: number;
   221→  phaseConfig?: PhaseConfig | null; // null means clear
   222→  loras?: ActiveLora[];
   223→  // Video settings
   224→  numFrames?: number;
   225→  randomSeed?: boolean;
   226→  seed?: number;
   227→  // UI state
   228→  selectedPhasePresetId?: string | null;
   229→  // Structure video overrides
   230→  structureMotionStrength?: number;
   231→  structureTreatment?: 'adjust' | 'clip';
   232→  structureUni3cEndPercent?: number;
   233→}
   234→
   235→type TextOverrideKey = 'prompt' | 'negativePrompt' | 'textBeforePrompts' | 'textAfterPrompts';
   236→
   237→function setTextOverride(
   238→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   239→  fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[],
   240→  key: TextOverrideKey,
   241→  value: string | undefined
   242→): void {
   243→  if (value === undefined) return;
   244→  if (value === '') {
   245→    fieldsToClear.push(key);
   246→    return;
   247→  }
   248→  overrides[key] = value;
   249→}
   250→
   251→function setNullableOverride<K extends keyof SegmentOverrides>(
   252→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   253→  fieldsToClear: K[],
   254→  key: K,
   255→  value: SegmentOverrides[K] | null | undefined
   256→): void {
   257→  if (value === undefined) return;
   258→  if (value === null) {
   259→    fieldsToClear.push(key);
   260→    return;
   261→  }
   262→  overrides[key] = value;
   263→}
   264→
   265→function applyPairSettingsToOverrides(
   266→  settings: PairSettingsToSave,
   267→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   268→  fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[]
   269→): void {
   270→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'prompt', settings.prompt);
   271→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'negativePrompt', settings.negativePrompt);
   272→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'textBeforePrompts', settings.textBeforePrompts);
   273→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'textAfterPrompts', settings.textAfterPrompts);
   274→
   275→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'motionMode', settings.motionMode);
   276→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'amountOfMotion', settings.amountOfMotion);
   277→
   278→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) {
   279→    if (settings.phaseConfig === null) {
   280→      fieldsToClear.push('phaseConfig');
   281→    } else {
   282→      overrides.phaseConfig = stripModeFromPhaseConfig(settings.phaseConfig);
   283→    }
   284→  }
   285→
   286→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) {
   287→    if (settings.loras === null) {
   288→      fieldsToClear.push('loras');
   289→    } else {
   290→      overrides.loras = settings.loras.map((l): LoraConfig => ({
   291→        id: l.id,
   292→        name: l.name,
   293→        path: l.path,
   294→        strength: l.strength,
   295→      }));
   296→    }
   297→  }
   298→
   299→  if (settings.randomSeed !== undefined) {
   300→    overrides.randomSeed = settings.randomSeed;
   301→  }
   302→  if (settings.seed !== undefined) {
   303→    overrides.seed = settings.seed;
   304→  }
   305→
   306→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'selectedPhasePresetId', settings.selectedPhasePresetId);
   307→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureMotionStrength', settings.structureMotionStrength);
   308→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureTreatment', settings.structureTreatment);
   309→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureUni3cEndPercent', settings.structureUni3cEndPercent);
   310→}
   311→
   312→function clearFields(
   313→  target: Record<string, unknown>,
   314→  fields: string[]
   315→): void {
   316→  fields.forEach((field) => {
   317→    delete target[field];
   318→  });
   319→}
   320→
   321→function cleanupLegacyPairMetadata(
   322→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   323→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   324→): void {
   325→  if (settings.prompt !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_prompt;
   326→  if (settings.negativePrompt !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_negative_prompt;
   327→  if (settings.motionMode !== undefined || settings.amountOfMotion !== undefined) {
   328→    delete metadata.pair_motion_settings;
   329→  }
   330→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_phase_config;
   331→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_loras;
   332→  if (settings.randomSeed !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_random_seed;
   333→  if (settings.seed !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_seed;
   334→  if (settings.selectedPhasePresetId !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_selected_phase_preset_id;
   335→}
   336→
   337→function cleanupLegacyUserOverrides(
   338→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   339→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   340→): void {
   341→  const userOverrides = metadata.user_overrides as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   342→  if (!userOverrides) return;
   343→
   344→  if (settings.motionMode !== undefined) delete userOverrides.motion_mode;
   345→  if (settings.amountOfMotion !== undefined) delete userOverrides.amount_of_motion;
   346→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) delete userOverrides.phase_config;
   347→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) delete userOverrides.additional_loras;
   348→
   349→  if (Object.keys(userOverrides).length === 0) {
   350→    delete metadata.user_overrides;
   351→  }
   352→}
   353→
   354→/**
   355→ * Build metadata update payload for saving pair settings.
   356→ *
   357→ * Writes to the new segmentOverrides format and cleans up old pair_* and
   358→ * legacy user_overrides fields from the metadata.
   359→ */
   360→export function buildMetadataUpdate(
   361→  currentMetadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   362→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   363→): Record<string, unknown> {
   364→  const overrides: SegmentOverrides = {};
   365→  const fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[] = [];
   366→  applyPairSettingsToOverrides(settings, overrides, fieldsToClear);
   367→
   368→  // Use writeSegmentOverrides to write to new format
   369→  const newMetadata = writeSegmentOverrides(currentMetadata, overrides);
   370→
   371→  // Access segmentOverrides as a mutable record for cleanup operations
   372→  const segOverrides = newMetadata.segmentOverrides as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   373→
   374→  // Handle explicit clear of phaseConfig (when switching to basic mode)
   375→  if (settings.phaseConfig === null && segOverrides) {
   376→    delete segOverrides.phaseConfig;
   377→    // Note: selectedPhasePresetId is handled independently via fieldsToClear.
   378→    // Don't cascade-delete it here — basic mode presets need to persist.
   379→  }
   380→
   381→  // Handle explicitly cleared fields ('' or null means remove override, use shot default)
   382→  if (fieldsToClear.length > 0 && segOverrides) {
   383→    clearFields(segOverrides, fieldsToClear as string[]);
   384→  }
   385→
   386→  cleanupLegacyPairMetadata(newMetadata, settings);
   387→  cleanupLegacyUserOverrides(newMetadata, settings);
   388→
   389→  return newMetadata;
   390→}
   391→
```

```
    13→export type SupabaseClientAccessResult =
    14→  | { ok: true; client: SupabaseClientInstance }
    15→  | { ok: false; error: Error };
    16→
    17→export function normalizeSupabaseError(error: unknown): Error {
    18→  return error instanceof Error ? error : new Error(String(error));
    19→}
    20→
    21→export function initializeSupabaseClientRuntime(): SupabaseClientInstance {
    22→  if (runtimeClient) {
    23→    return runtimeClient;
    24→  }
    25→

    27→    const client = createSupabaseClient();
    28→    initializeSupabaseRuntime(client);
    29→    runtimeClient = client;
    30→    runtimeError = null;
    31→    return client;
    32→  } catch (error) {
    33→    const normalized = normalizeSupabaseError(error);
    34→    runtimeClient = null;
    35→    runtimeError = normalized;
    36→    throw normalized;
    37→  }
    38→}
    39→
    40→export function getSupabaseRuntimeClientResult(): SupabaseClientAccessResult {
    41→  if (runtimeClient) {

    44→
```

```
    50→  const updatedParams = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(params || {})); // Deep clone
```

```
    44→interface AddImageToShotContext {
    45→  previousShots: ReturnType<typeof findShotsCache> | undefined;
    46→  previousFastGens: GenerationRow[] | undefined;

    52→/**
    53→ * Add a generation to a shot.
    54→ *
    55→ * This is the unified hook that handles both positioned and unpositioned additions:
    56→ * - timelineFrame: undefined → auto-calculate position
    57→ * - timelineFrame: null → add without position (appears in unpositioned section)
    58→ * - timelineFrame: number → use explicit position
    59→ */
    60→export const useAddImageToShot = () => {
    61→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    62→
    63→  return useMutation<Record<string, unknown>, Error, AddImageToShotVariables, AddImageToShotContext>({
    64→    mutationFn: async (variables: AddImageToShotVariables) => {
    65→      const data = await runAddImageMutation(variables);
    66→      return withVariableMetadata(data, variables);
    67→    },
    68→
    69→    onMutate: async (variables): Promise<AddImageToShotContext> => {
    70→      const {
    71→        shot_id,
    72→        project_id,
    73→        imageUrl,
    74→        thumbUrl,
    75→        skipOptimistic,
    76→      } = variables;
    77→
    78→      if (!project_id) {
    79→        return { previousShots: undefined, previousFastGens: undefined, project_id: undefined, shot_id: undefined };
    80→      }
    81→
    82→      await cancelShotsQueries(queryClient, project_id);
    83→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shot_id);
    84→
    85→      const previousShots = findShotsCache(queryClient, project_id);
    86→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
    87→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shot_id)
    88→      );
    89→
    90→      let tempId: string | undefined;
    91→
    92→      // Only perform optimistic update if we have image URL and not skipped
    93→      if ((imageUrl || thumbUrl) && !skipOptimistic) {
    94→        tempId = `temp-${Date.now()}-${Math.random()}`;
    95→        applyOptimisticCaches(queryClient, variables, previousFastGens, tempId);
    96→      }
    97→
    98→      // Optimistically remove from unified-generations (for "items without shots" filter)
    99→      optimisticallyRemoveFromUnifiedGenerations(
   100→        queryClient,
   101→        project_id,
   102→        variables.generation_id
   103→      );
   104→
   105→      return { previousShots, previousFastGens, project_id, shot_id, tempId };
   106→    },
   107→
   108→    onError: (error: Error, _variables, context) => {
   109→      // Check for duplicate key constraint
   110→      const isDuplicateError =
   111→        error.message?.includes('unique_shot_generation_pair') ||
   112→        error.message?.includes('duplicate key value');
   113→
   114→      if (isDuplicateError) {
   115→        toast.error('Database error: unexpected constraint. Please try again.');
   116→        return;
   117→      }
   118→
   119→      // Rollback caches
   120→      if (context?.previousShots && context.project_id) {
   121→        rollbackShotsCaches(queryClient, context.project_id, context.previousShots);
   122→      }
   123→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shot_id) {
   124→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shot_id, context.previousFastGens);
   125→      }
   126→      if (context?.project_id) {
   127→        queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   128→          [REDACTED](context.project_id),
   129→        });
   130→      }
   131→
   132→      toast.error(`Failed to add image to shot: ${toAddImageErrorMessage(error)}`);
   133→    },
   134→
   135→    onSuccess: (data, variables, context) => {
   136→      const { project_id, shot_id } = variables;
   137→
   138→      // Replace temp ID with real ID in cache
   139→      if (context?.tempId) {
   140→        replaceOptimisticItemInCache(queryClient, shot_id, context.tempId, data);
   141→        replaceOptimisticItemInShotsCache(queryClient, project_id, shot_id, context.tempId, data);
   142→      }
   143→
   144→      // Invalidate related queries
   145→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](project_id) });
   146→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id) });
   147→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   148→        [REDACTED](project_id),
   149→      });
   150→      // Invalidate byShot to ensure timeline refetches with complete data.
   151→      // Critical when the target shot's cache wasn't populated at mutation time
   152→      // (e.g., adding to a different shot than the one currently viewed),
   153→      // since no optimistic item would have been created in that case.
   154→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id) });
   155→      // Invalidate segment position map so videos reposition to match new timeline order
   156→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id) });
   157→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](shot_id, project_id) });
   158→    },
   159→  });

   183→// ============================================================================
   184→// REMOVE IMAGE FROM SHOT

   186→
   187→/**
   188→ * Remove image from shot's timeline (sets timeline_frame = NULL).
   189→ * This does NOT delete the shot_generations record - just removes the position.
   190→ */
   191→export const useRemoveImageFromShot = () => {
   192→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   193→  const log = import.meta.env.DEV ? (...args: Parameters<typeof console.log>) => console.log(...args) : () => {};
   194→
   195→  return useMutation({
   196→    mutationFn: async ({
   197→      shotId,
   198→      shotGenerationId,
   199→      projectId,
   200→      shiftItems,
   201→    }: {
   202→      shotId: string;
   203→      shotGenerationId: string;
   204→      projectId: string;
   205→      /** When deleting the first item, shift remaining items back */
   206→      shiftItems?: Array<{ id: string; newFrame: number }>;
   207→    }) => {
   208→      if (!shotId || !shotGenerationId || !projectId) {
   209→        throw new Error(`Missing required parameters`);
   210→      }
   211→
   212→      const { error } = await supabase().from('shot_generations')
   213→        .update({ timeline_frame: null })
   214→        .eq('id', shotGenerationId);
   215→
   216→      if (error) {
   217→        throw error;
   218→      }
   219→
   220→      // Persist frame shifts (optimistic update already applied in onMutate)
   221→      if (shiftItems && shiftItems.length > 0) {
   222→        await persistTimelineFrameBatch({
   223→          shotId,
   224→          updates: shiftItems.map((item) => ({
   225→            shotGenerationId: item.id,
   226→            timelineFrame: item.newFrame,
   227→            metadata: { user_positioned: true, drag_source: 'remove-shift' },
   228→          })),
   229→          operationLabel: 'remove-image-shift',
   230→          timeoutOperationName: 'remove-image-shift-rpc',
   231→          logPrefix: '[ShotGenerationMutations]',
   232→          log,
   233→        });
   234→      }
   235→
   236→      return { shotId, shotGenerationId, projectId };
   237→    },
   238→
   239→    onMutate: async (variables) => {
   240→      const { shotId, shotGenerationId, projectId, shiftItems } = variables;
   241→
   242→      await cancelShotsQueries(queryClient, projectId);
   243→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shotId);
   244→
   245→      const previousShots = findShotsCache(queryClient, projectId);
   246→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   247→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)
   248→      );
   249→
   250→      // Build a shift lookup for items that need frame updates
   251→      const shiftMap = new Map(shiftItems?.map(s => [s.id, s.newFrame]) ?? []);
   252→
   253→      // Optimistically: set timeline_frame = null on deleted item + shift remaining
   254→      if (previousFastGens) {
   255→        queryClient.setQueryData(
   256→          queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId),
   257→          previousFastGens.map(g => {
   258→            if (g.id === shotGenerationId) return { ...g, timeline_frame: null };
   259→            const shifted = shiftMap.get(g.id);
   260→            if (shifted !== undefined) return { ...g, timeline_frame: shifted };
   261→            return g;
   262→          })
   263→        );
   264→      }
   265→
   266→      if (previousShots) {
   267→        updateAllShotsCaches(queryClient, projectId, (shots = []) =>
   268→          shots.map(shot => {
   269→            if (shot.id === shotId) {
   270→              return {
   271→                ...shot,
   272→                images: (shot.images ?? []).map(img => {
   273→                  if (img.id === shotGenerationId) return { ...img, timeline_frame: null };
   274→                  const shifted = shiftMap.get(img.id);
   275→                  if (shifted !== undefined) return { ...img, timeline_frame: shifted };
   276→                  return img;
   277→                }),
   278→              };
   279→            }
   280→            return shot;
   281→          })
   282→        );
   283→      }
   284→
   285→      return { previousShots, previousFastGens, projectId, shotId };
   286→    },
   287→
   288→    onError: (err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   289→      if (context?.previousShots && context.projectId) {
   290→        rollbackShotsCaches(queryClient, context.projectId, context.previousShots);
   291→      }
   292→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   293→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   294→      }
   295→
   296→      toast.error(`Failed to remove image from timeline: ${err.message}`);
   297→    },
   298→
   299→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   300→      // Invalidate segment queries
   301→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   302→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   303→        [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId),
   304→      });
   305→    },
   306→  });
   307→};
   308→
   309→// ============================================================================
   310→// UPDATE SHOT IMAGE ORDER
   311→// ============================================================================
   312→
   313→export const useUpdateShotImageOrder = () => {
   314→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
   315→
   316→  return useMutation({
   317→    mutationFn: async ({
   318→      updates,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      shotId,
   321→    }: {
   322→      updates: { shot_id: string; generation_id: string; timeline_frame: number }[];
   323→      projectId: string;
   324→      shotId: string;
   325→    }) => {
   326→      const promises = updates.map(update =>
   327→        supabase().from('shot_generations')
   328→          .update({ timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame })
   329→          .eq('shot_id', update.shot_id)
   330→          .eq('generation_id', update.generation_id)
   331→      );
   332→
   333→      const results = await Promise.all(promises);
   334→
   335→      const errors = results.filter(r => r.error);
   336→      if (errors.length > 0) {
   337→        throw new Error(`Reorder failed: ${errors.map(e => e.error?.message).join(', ')}`);
   338→      }
   339→
   340→      return { projectId, shotId, updates };
   341→    },
   342→
   343→    onMutate: async (variables) => {
   344→      const { updates, shotId } = variables;
   345→
   346→      await cancelShotGenerationsQuery(queryClient, shotId);
   347→
   348→      const previousFastGens = queryClient.getQueryData<GenerationRow[]>(
   349→        queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId)
   350→      );
   351→
   352→      if (previousFastGens) {
   353→        const updatedGens = previousFastGens.map(gen => {
   354→          const update = updates.find(u => u.generation_id === gen.generation_id);
   355→          if (update) {
   356→            return { ...gen, timeline_frame: update.timeline_frame };
   357→          }
   358→          return gen;
   359→        });
   360→
   361→        updatedGens.sort((a, b) => (a.timeline_frame || 0) - (b.timeline_frame || 0));
   362→        queryClient.setQueryData(queryKeys.generations.byShot(shotId), updatedGens);
   363→      }
   364→
   365→      return { previousFastGens, shotId };
   366→    },
   367→
   368→    onError: (_err: Error, _variables, context) => {
   369→      if (context?.previousFastGens && context.shotId) {
   370→        rollbackShotGenerationsCache(queryClient, context.shotId, context.previousFastGens);
   371→      }
   372→
   373→      toast.error('Failed to reorder images');
   374→    },
   375→
   376→    onSuccess: (data) => {
   377→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   378→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({
   379→        predicate: query => query.queryKey[0] === 'source-slot-generations',
   380→      });
   381→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId) });
   382→      queryClient.invalidateQueries({ [REDACTED](data.shotId, data.projectId) });
   383→    },
   384→  });
   385→};
```

```
   194→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
   195→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
   196→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
   197→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
   198→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
   199→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
   200→};
   201→
   202→interface VideoEnhanceResult {
   203→  interpolation_compute_seconds?: number;
   204→  output_width?: number;
   205→  output_height?: number;
   206→  output_frames?: number;
   207→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   208→}
   209→
   210→interface VideoEnhanceBreakdown {
   211→  interpolation?: { compute_seconds: number; cost_per_second: number; cost: number };
   212→  upscale?: { output_width: number; output_height: number; output_frames: number; megapixels: number; cost_per_megapixel: number; cost: number };
   213→}
   214→
   215→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
   216→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
   217→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: VideoEnhanceResult): { cost: number; breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   218→  let totalCost = 0;
   219→  const breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown = {};
   220→
   221→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
   222→  const result = taskParams?.result || taskParams;
   223→
   224→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
   225→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
   226→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
   227→    totalCost += filmCost;
   228→    breakdown.interpolation = {
   229→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
   230→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
   231→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   232→    };
   233→  }
   234→
   235→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
   236→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
   237→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
   238→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
   239→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
   240→    breakdown.upscale = {
   241→      output_width: result.output_width,
   242→      output_height: result.output_height,
   243→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
   244→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
   245→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
   246→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   247→    };
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  return {
   251→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   252→    breakdown,
   253→  };
   254→}
   255→
   256→interface CostFactors {
   257→  resolution?: Record<string, number>;
   258→  frameCount?: number;
   259→  modelType?: Record<string, number>;
   260→}
   261→
   262→interface TaskCostParams {
   263→  resolution?: string;
   264→  frame_count?: number;
   265→  model_type?: string;
   266→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   267→  [key: string]: unknown;
   268→}
   269→
   270→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
   271→export function calculateTaskCost(
   272→  taskType: string,
   273→  billingType: string,
   274→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
   275→  unitCost: number,
   276→  durationSeconds: number,
   277→  costFactors: CostFactors | null,
   278→  taskParams: TaskCostParams
   279→): { cost: number; breakdown?: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   280→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
   281→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   282→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
   283→  }
   284→
   285→  let totalCost;
   286→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   287→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
   288→  } else {
   289→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   290→  }
   291→
   292→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
   293→  if (costFactors) {
   294→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
   295→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
   296→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
   297→    }
   298→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   299→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   300→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   301→      } else {
   302→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   303→      }
   304→    }
   305→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   306→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   307→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   308→    }
   309→  }
   310→
   311→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   312→}
```

```
   136→    if (orchError) {
   137→      throw new CompletionError({
   138→        code: 'orchestrator_fetch_failed',
   139→        context: 'checkOrchestratorCompletion',
   140→        recoverable: true,
   141→        message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Error fetching orchestrator task ${orchestratorTaskId}`,

   159→          orchestratorTask,
   160→          orchestratorTaskId,
   161→          allSegments,
   162→          publicUrl,
   163→          isFinalStep: true,
   164→          supabaseUrl,
   165→          serviceKey,
   166→        },
   167→      );
   168→      return;
   169→    }
   170→    const expectedSegmentCountResolution = resolveExpectedSegmentCount(
   171→      taskType,
   172→      orchestratorTask.params,
   173→    );
   174→    if (expectedSegmentCountResolution.invalid) {
   175→      throw new CompletionError({
   176→        code: 'orchestrator_expected_segment_count_invalid',
   177→        context: 'checkOrchestratorCompletion',
   178→        recoverable: false,
   179→        message: `Invalid expected segment count contract for orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId}`,
   180→        metadata: {
   181→          orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   182→          task_type: taskType,
   183→          source: expectedSegmentCountResolution.source ?? 'unknown',
   184→          raw_value: expectedSegmentCountResolution.raw ?? null,
   185→        },
   186→      });
   187→    }
   188→    const segmentStats = summarizeSegmentCompletion(allSegments);
   189→    const segmentGate = evaluateSegmentCompletionGate(
   190→      expectedSegmentCountResolution.value,
   191→      segmentStats,
   192→    );
   193→    if (segmentGate.kind === 'wait') {
   194→      return;
   195→    }
   196→    if (segmentGate.kind === 'fail') {
   197→      if (segmentGate.reason === 'segments_failed') {
   198→        await markOrchestratorFailed(
   199→          supabase,
   200→          orchestratorTaskId,
   201→          segmentGate.failedSegments,
   202→          segmentGate.foundSegments,
   203→          undefined,
   204→          logger,
   205→        );
   206→      } else {
   207→        await markOrchestratorFailed(
   208→          supabase,
   209→          orchestratorTaskId,
   210→          0,
   211→          segmentGate.expectedSegments,
   212→          `Only ${segmentGate.foundSegments} of ${segmentGate.expectedSegments} expected segments were found`,
   213→          logger,
   214→        );
   215→      }
   216→      return;
   217→    }
   218→    if (config.waitForFinalStepType) {
   219→      const finalStitchStatus = await checkFinalStitchStatus(
   220→        supabase,
   221→        config.waitForFinalStepType,
   222→        completedTask.project_id,
   223→        orchestratorTaskId,
   224→        orchestratorRunId,
   225→      );
   226→      switch (finalStitchStatus) {
   227→        case 'pending':
   228→          return;
   229→        case 'failed':
   230→          await markOrchestratorFailed(supabase, orchestratorTaskId, 1, 1, undefined, logger);
   231→          return;
   232→        case 'unknown':

   234→            orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   235→            final_step_type: config.waitForFinalStepType,
   236→            orchestrator_run_id: orchestratorRunId,
   237→          });
   238→          return;
   239→        case 'complete':
   240→        case 'not_found':
   241→          break;
   242→      }

   244→    await markOrchestratorComplete(

   246→        supabase,
   247→        orchestratorTask,
   248→        orchestratorTaskId,
   249→        allSegments,
   250→        publicUrl,
   251→        isFinalStep: false,
   252→        supabaseUrl,
   253→        serviceKey,
   254→        logger,
   255→      },
   256→    );

   258→    throw toCompletionError(error, {
```
