   271→/**
   272→ * Find sibling segment tasks using run_id (preferred) or orchestrator_task_id (fallback)
   273→ */
   274→async function findSiblingSegments(
   275→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   276→  segmentType: string,
   277→  projectId: string,
   278→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   279→  orchestratorRunId: string | null
   280→): Promise<SegmentTask[]> {
   281→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   282→    const runIdRows = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   283→      supabase,
   284→      taskType: segmentType,
   285→      projectId,
   286→      select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   287→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   288→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   289→    });
   290→    if (runIdRows.length > 0) {
   291→      return runIdRows;
   292→    }
   293→  }
   294→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   295→    supabase,
   296→    taskType: segmentType,
   297→    projectId,
   298→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   299→    orchestratorTaskId,
   300→    contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   301→  });
   302→  return orchestratorRows;
   303→}
   304→/**
   305→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   306→ */
   307→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   308→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   309→  finalStepType: string,
   310→  projectId: string,
   311→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   312→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   313→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   314→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   315→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   316→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   317→      supabase,
   318→      taskType: finalStepType,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      select: "id, status",
   321→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   322→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   323→    });
   324→  }
   325→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   326→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   327→      supabase,
   328→      taskType: finalStepType,
   329→      projectId,
   330→      select: "id, status",
   331→      orchestratorTaskId,
   332→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   333→    });
   334→  }
   335→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   336→    return 'not_found';
   337→  }
   338→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   339→    return 'failed';
   340→  }
   341→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Complete')) {
   342→    return 'complete';
   343→  }
   344→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Queued' || task.status === 'In Progress')) {
   345→    return 'pending';
   346→  }
   347→  return 'unknown';
   348→}
   349→/**
   350→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   351→ */
   352→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   353→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   354→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   355→  failedSegments: number,
   356→  totalSegments: number,
   357→  errorMessage?: string,
   358→  logger?: {
   359→    warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   360→    error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   361→  },
   362→): Promise<void> {
   363→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   364→    .from("tasks")
   365→    .update({
   366→      status: "Failed",
   367→      error_message: errorMessage ?? `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   368→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   369→    })
   370→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   371→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   372→    .select('id');
   373→  if (updateOrchError) {
   374→    throw new CompletionError({
   375→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_failed_update_failed',
   376→      context: 'markOrchestratorFailed',
   377→      recoverable: true,
   378→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   379→      metadata: {
   380→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   381→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   382→          ? updateOrchError.message
   383→          : String(updateOrchError),
   384→      },
   385→      cause: updateOrchError,
   386→    });
   387→  }
   388→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   389→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   390→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   391→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   392→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   393→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   394→    });
   395→  }
   396→}
   397→/**
   398→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   399→ */
   400→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   401→  params: {
   402→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   403→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   404→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   405→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   406→    publicUrl: string;
   407→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   408→    supabaseUrl: string;
   409→    serviceKey: string;
   410→    logger?: {
   411→      warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   412→      error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   413→    };
   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {
   416→  const {
   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: "Complete",
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   438→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   439→  };
   440→  if (isFinalStep) {
   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   448→    .select('id');
   449→  if (updateOrchError) {
   450→    throw new CompletionError({
   451→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   452→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   453→      recoverable: true,
   454→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   455→      metadata: {
   456→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   457→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→    });
   469→    return;
   470→  }
   471→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   472→    supabaseUrl,
   473→    serviceKey,
   474→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   475→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   476→  });
   477→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   478→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   479→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   480→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   481→    supabase,
   482→    orchestratorTaskId,
   483→    existingResultData,
   484→    billingOutcome,
   485→    billingDecision,
   486→    logger,
   487→  );
   488→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   489→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   490→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   491→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   492→      billing_result: billingResult,
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→}
   496→

    14→  is_active: boolean;

    17→/** Shape returned by tasks.select('..., projects(user_id), task_types!(...)') with joined project + task type */
    18→interface TaskWithProject {
    19→  id: string;
    20→  task_type: string;
    21→  params: TaskCostParams;
    22→  status: string;
    23→  generation_started_at: string | null;
    24→  generation_processed_at: string | null;
    25→  project_id: string;
    26→  projects: { user_id: string };
    27→  task_type_config: TaskTypeConfig | null;
    28→}

    30→interface TaskParseFailure {
    31→  errorCode: "task_shape_invalid";
    32→  message: string;
    33→  details: Record<string, unknown>;
    34→}
    35→
    36→type TaskParseResult =
    37→  | { ok: true; task: TaskWithProject }
    38→  | { ok: false; failure: TaskParseFailure };
    39→
    40→function asNumber(value: unknown): number | undefined {
    41→  return typeof value === 'number' && Number.isFinite(value) ? value : undefined;
    42→}
    43→
    44→export function parseTaskCostParams(value: unknown): TaskCostParams {
    45→  const record = asObjectRecord(value) ?? {};
    46→  const parsed: TaskCostParams = {};
    47→
    48→  const resolution = asString(record.resolution);
    49→  if (resolution) {
    50→    parsed.resolution = resolution;
    51→  }
    52→
    53→  const frameCount = asNumber(record.frame_count);
    54→  if (frameCount !== undefined) {
    55→    parsed.frame_count = frameCount;
    56→  }
    57→
    58→  const modelType = asString(record.model_type);
    59→  if (modelType) {
    60→    parsed.model_type = modelType;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const result = asObjectRecord(record.result);
    64→  if (result) {
    65→    parsed.result = result as VideoEnhanceResult;
    66→  }
    67→
    68→  for (const [key, rawValue] of Object.entries(record)) {
    69→    // Never re-inject known billing keys unless they pass explicit normalization.
    70→    if (key === 'resolution' || key === 'frame_count' || key === 'model_type' || key === 'result') {
    71→      continue;
    72→    }
    73→    parsed[key] = rawValue;
    74→  }
    75→
    76→  return parsed;
    77→}
    78→
    79→export function parseTaskWithProject(value: unknown): TaskParseResult {
    80→  const task = asObjectRecord(value);
    81→  if (!task) {
    82→    return {
    83→      ok: false,
    84→      failure: {
    85→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
    86→        message: "Task payload is not an object",
    87→        details: { received_type: typeof value },
    88→      },
    89→    };
    90→  }
    91→
    92→  const id = asString(task.id);
    93→  const taskType = asString(task.task_type);
    94→  const projectId = asString(task.project_id);
    95→  if (!id || !taskType || !projectId) {
    96→    return {
    97→      ok: false,
    98→      failure: {
    99→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
   100→        message: "Task payload missing required fields: id, task_type, or project_id",
   101→        details: {
   102→          has_id: !!id,
   103→          has_task_type: !!taskType,
   104→          has_project_id: !!projectId,
   105→        },
   106→      },
   107→    };
   108→  }
   109→
   110→  const projectsRaw = task.projects;
   111→  const projectRecord = asObjectRecord(projectsRaw)
   112→    ?? (Array.isArray(projectsRaw) ? asObjectRecord(projectsRaw[0]) : null);
   113→  const userId = asString(projectRecord?.user_id);
   114→  if (!userId) {
   115→    return {
   116→      ok: false,
   117→      failure: {
   118→        errorCode: "task_shape_invalid",
   119→        message: "Task payload missing projects.user_id",
   120→        details: {
   121→          projects_type: Array.isArray(projectsRaw) ? "array" : typeof projectsRaw,
   122→          has_projects_user_id: false,
   123→        },
   124→      },
   125→    };
   126→  }
   127→
   128→  const params = parseTaskCostParams(task.params);
   129→  const status = asString(task.status) ?? "unknown";
   130→
   131→  // Extract task_types FK join (PostgREST returns object or null)
   132→  let taskTypeConfig: TaskTypeConfig | null = null;
   133→  const ttRaw = asObjectRecord(task.task_types);
   134→  if (ttRaw) {
   135→    const ttId = asString(ttRaw.id);
   136→    const billingType = asString(ttRaw.billing_type);
   137→    if (ttId && billingType) {
   138→      taskTypeConfig = {
   139→        id: ttId,
   140→        billing_type: billingType,
   141→        base_cost_per_second: typeof ttRaw.base_cost_per_second === 'number' ? ttRaw.base_cost_per_second : 0,
   142→        unit_cost: typeof ttRaw.unit_cost === 'number' ? ttRaw.unit_cost : 0,
   143→        cost_factors: asObjectRecord(ttRaw.cost_factors) as CostFactors | null,
   144→        is_active: ttRaw.is_active === true,
   145→      };
   146→    }
   147→  }
   148→
   149→  return {
   150→    ok: true,
   151→    task: {
   152→      id,
   153→      task_type: taskType,
   154→      params,
   155→      status,
   156→      generation_started_at: asString(task.generation_started_at),
   157→      generation_processed_at: asString(task.generation_processed_at),
   158→      project_id: projectId,
   159→      projects: { user_id: userId },
   160→      task_type_config: taskTypeConfig,
   161→    },
   162→  };
   163→}

   165→// Helper for standard JSON responses with CORS headers
   166→export function jsonResponse(body: unknown, status = 200) {

   193→
   194→// Pricing constants for video_enhance task (fal.ai rates)
   195→const VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING = {
   196→  // FILM (interpolation): $0.0013 per compute second
   197→  FILM_COST_PER_SECOND: 0.0013,
   198→  // FlashVSR (upscale): $0.0005 per megapixel (width × height × frames / 1,000,000)
   199→  FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL: 0.0005,
   200→};
   201→
   202→interface VideoEnhanceResult {
   203→  interpolation_compute_seconds?: number;
   204→  output_width?: number;
   205→  output_height?: number;
   206→  output_frames?: number;
   207→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   208→}
   209→
   210→interface VideoEnhanceBreakdown {
   211→  interpolation?: { compute_seconds: number; cost_per_second: number; cost: number };
   212→  upscale?: { output_width: number; output_height: number; output_frames: number; megapixels: number; cost_per_megapixel: number; cost: number };
   213→}
   214→
   215→// Special cost calculation for video_enhance task
   216→// Combines FILM (time-based) and FlashVSR (megapixel-based) pricing
   217→function calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams: VideoEnhanceResult): { cost: number; breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   218→  let totalCost = 0;
   219→  const breakdown: VideoEnhanceBreakdown = {};
   220→
   221→  // Get result data from task params (worker should populate this)
   222→  const result = taskParams?.result || taskParams;
   223→
   224→  // FILM interpolation cost: $0.0013 per compute second
   225→  if (result?.interpolation_compute_seconds && result.interpolation_compute_seconds > 0) {
   226→    const filmCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND * result.interpolation_compute_seconds;
   227→    totalCost += filmCost;
   228→    breakdown.interpolation = {
   229→      compute_seconds: result.interpolation_compute_seconds,
   230→      cost_per_second: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FILM_COST_PER_SECOND,
   231→      cost: Math.round(filmCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   232→    };
   233→  }
   234→
   235→  // FlashVSR upscale cost: $0.0005 per megapixel
   236→  if (result?.output_width && result?.output_height && result?.output_frames) {
   237→    const megapixels = (result.output_width * result.output_height * result.output_frames) / 1_000_000;
   238→    const upscaleCost = VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL * megapixels;
   239→    totalCost += upscaleCost;
   240→    breakdown.upscale = {
   241→      output_width: result.output_width,
   242→      output_height: result.output_height,
   243→      output_frames: result.output_frames,
   244→      megapixels: Math.round(megapixels * 100) / 100,
   245→      cost_per_megapixel: VIDEO_ENHANCE_PRICING.FLASHVSR_COST_PER_MEGAPIXEL,
   246→      cost: Math.round(upscaleCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   247→    };
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  return {
   251→    cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000000) / 1000000,
   252→    breakdown,
   253→  };
   254→}
   255→
   256→interface CostFactors {
   257→  resolution?: Record<string, number>;
   258→  frameCount?: number;
   259→  modelType?: Record<string, number>;
   260→}
   261→
   262→interface TaskCostParams {
   263→  resolution?: string;
   264→  frame_count?: number;
   265→  model_type?: string;
   266→  result?: VideoEnhanceResult;
   267→  [key: string]: unknown;
   268→}
   269→
   270→// Calculate cost based on billing type and task configuration
   271→export function calculateTaskCost(
   272→  taskType: string,
   273→  billingType: string,
   274→  baseCostPerSecond: number,
   275→  unitCost: number,
   276→  durationSeconds: number,
   277→  costFactors: CostFactors | null,
   278→  taskParams: TaskCostParams
   279→): { cost: number; breakdown?: VideoEnhanceBreakdown } {
   280→  // Special case: video_enhance has compound pricing (FILM + FlashVSR)
   281→  if (taskType === 'video_enhance') {
   282→    return calculateVideoEnhanceCost(taskParams);
   283→  }
   284→
   285→  let totalCost;
   286→  if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   287→    totalCost = unitCost || 0;
   288→  } else {
   289→    totalCost = baseCostPerSecond * durationSeconds;
   290→  }
   291→
   292→  // Apply cost factors regardless of billing type
   293→  if (costFactors) {
   294→    if (costFactors.resolution && taskParams.resolution) {
   295→      const resolutionMultiplier = costFactors.resolution[taskParams.resolution] || 1;
   296→      totalCost *= resolutionMultiplier;
   297→    }
   298→    if (costFactors.frameCount && taskParams.frame_count) {
   299→      if (billingType === 'per_unit') {
   300→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count;
   301→      } else {
   302→        totalCost += costFactors.frameCount * taskParams.frame_count * durationSeconds;
   303→      }
   304→    }
   305→    if (costFactors.modelType && taskParams.model_type) {
   306→      const modelMultiplier = costFactors.modelType[taskParams.model_type] || 1;
   307→      totalCost *= modelMultiplier;
   308→    }
   309→  }
   310→
   311→  return { cost: Math.round(totalCost * 1000) / 1000 };
   312→}
   313→

    45→// Verify Stripe webhook signature
    46→async function verifyStripeSignature(payload: string, signature: string, secret: string): Promise<boolean> {
    47→  const elements = signature.split(',');
    48→  const timestamp = elements.find(element => element.startsWith('t='))?.split('=')[1];
    49→  const signatures = elements.filter(element => element.startsWith('v1='));
    50→
    51→  if (!timestamp || signatures.length === 0) {
    52→    return false;
    53→  }
    54→
    55→  const payloadForSigning = `${timestamp}.${payload}`;
    56→  const key = await crypto.subtle.importKey(
    57→    'raw',
    58→    new TextEncoder().encode(secret),
    59→    { name: 'HMAC', hash: 'SHA-256' },
    60→    false,
    61→    ['sign']
    62→  );
    63→
    64→  const signature_bytes = await crypto.subtle.sign('HMAC', key, new TextEncoder().encode(payloadForSigning));
    65→  const signature_hex = Array.from(new Uint8Array(signature_bytes))
    66→    .map(b => b.toString(16).padStart(2, '0'))
    67→    .join('');
    68→
    69→  return signatures.some(sig => sig.split('=')[1] === signature_hex);
    70→}

   208→            logger.warn('Idempotency check query failed, proceeding with insert', { error: checkError.message });
   209→          } else if (existingEntry) {
   210→            logger.info('Webhook already processed (idempotency check)', { sessionId: session.id as string });
   211→            return jsonResponse({ received: true, duplicate: true });

   213→        } catch (checkErr: unknown) {

   216→
   217→        // Insert budget purchase into ledger.
   218→        // The unique partial index guarantees no double-crediting even if two
   219→        // webhooks race past the fast-path check above.
   220→        const { data: ledgerEntry, error: ledgerError } = await supabaseAdmin

   237→        if (ledgerError) {
   238→          // Unique constraint violation = duplicate webhook (race with fast-path check).
   239→          // This is expected and safe — return success since the credit was already applied.
   240→          if (ledgerError.code === '23505') {

   309→                  original_balance: parseInt(originalBalance || '0'),
   310→                  auto_topup_trigger: true,
   311→                },
   312→              });
   313→
   314→            if (autoTopupLedgerError) {

   316→              // This is expected and safe — return success since the credit was already applied.
   317→              if (autoTopupLedgerError.code === '23505') {

   321→              logger.error('Error creating auto-top-up ledger entry', { error: autoTopupLedgerError.message });

   325→                paymentIntentId: paymentIntent.id as string,
   326→                topupAmount: parseInt(topupAmount),
   327→                dollarAmount: parseInt(topupAmount) / 100,
   328→              });
   329→            }
   330→          }
   331→        }
   332→        break;
   333→
   334→      case 'payment_intent.payment_failed':
   335→        // Handle failed auto-top-up payments
   336→        const failedPaymentIntent = event.data.object;

   374→      case 'invoice.payment_failed':

   377→        break;
   378→
   379→      default:

   381→        break;
   382→    }
   383→
   384→    await logger.flush();
   385→    return jsonResponse({ received: true });
   386→
   387→  } catch (error: unknown) {
   388→    logger.error('Error processing Stripe webhook', { error: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) });
   389→    await logger.flush();
   390→    return jsonResponse({ error: 'Internal server error' }, 500);
   391→  }

1→/**
     2→ * Shared Generation Data Transformers
     3→ * 
     4→ * SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for transforming generation data from database to UI format.
     5→ * 
     6→ * This eliminates the need to manually update transformation logic in multiple places
     7→ * when adding new fields. Instead, update once here and all consumers automatically
     8→ * get the new field.
     9→ * 
    10→ * Architecture Benefits:
    11→ * - DRY: No duplicated transformation logic across hooks/components
    12→ * - Type Safety: Centralized TypeScript types ensure consistency
    13→ * - Maintainability: Add new fields in one place instead of 5+
    14→ * - Testability: Can unit test transformations in isolation
    15→ * 
    16→ * NOTE: upscaled_url has been removed - upscaled versions are now stored as
    17→ * generation_variants with variant_type='upscaled' and become the primary variant,
    18→ * so `location` already contains the best available URL.
    19→ */
    20→
    21→import type { GeneratedImageWithMetadata } from '@/shared/components/MediaGallery/types';
    22→import type { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    23→import type { GenerationMetadata } from '@/domains/generation/types';
    24→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    25→import { stripQueryParameters } from '@/shared/lib/media/mediaUrl';
    26→import { TOOL_IDS, isToolId } from '@/shared/lib/toolIds';
    27→import { ServerError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/errors';
    28→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    29→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
    30→import { parseGenerationTaskId } from '@/shared/lib/generationTaskIdParser';
    31→import { filterUuidStrings } from '@/shared/lib/uuid';
    32→import { asRecord, asString, firstString } from '@/shared/lib/jsonNarrowing';
    33→
    34→/**
    35→ * Result type for calculateDerivedCounts
    36→ */
    37→export interface DerivedCountsResult {
    38→  /** Count of variants/derivatives per generation */
    39→  derivedCounts: Record<string, number>;
    40→  /** Whether each generation has any unviewed variants (viewed_at IS NULL) */
    41→  hasUnviewedVariants: Record<string, boolean>;
    42→  /** Count of unviewed variants per generation */
    43→  unviewedVariantCounts: Record<string, number>;
    44→  /** True when counts were intentionally returned empty due to a read-path failure. */
    45→  degraded?: boolean;
    46→  /** Machine-readable reason for degraded fallback behavior. */
    47→  errorCode?: 'query_failed';
    48→}
    49→
    50→function createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(): DerivedCountsResult {
    51→  return {
    52→    derivedCounts: {},
    53→    hasUnviewedVariants: {},
    54→    unviewedVariantCounts: {},
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→/**
    59→ * Calculate derivedCount for generations (how many variants/derivatives exist)
    60→ * Also tracks whether any variants are unviewed (for NEW badge display)
    61→ *
    62→ * Queries both:
    63→ * - generations table (based_on relationships)
    64→ * - generation_variants table (edit variants)
    65→ *
    66→ * @param generationIds - Array of generation IDs to count variants for
    67→ * @returns Object with derivedCounts and hasUnviewedVariants maps
    68→ */
    69→async function calculateDerivedCounts(
    70→  generationIds: string[]
    71→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
    72→  const persistedGenerationIds = filterUuidStrings(generationIds);
    73→  if (persistedGenerationIds.length === 0) {
    74→    return createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts } = createEmptyDerivedCountsResult();
    78→
    79→  // Only count from generation_variants table (actual variants)
    80→  // Note: We intentionally don't count based_on generations here - those are
    81→  // separate images in the gallery, not variants of this image
    82→  const { data: variantCountsData, error: variantCountsError } = await supabase().from('generation_variants')
    83→    .select('generation_id, viewed_at')
    84→    .in('generation_id', persistedGenerationIds);
    85→
    86→  if (variantCountsError) {
    87→    throw new ServerError('Failed to load variant badge counts', {
    88→      context: { generationIdsCount: generationIds.length },
    89→      cause: variantCountsError,
    90→    });
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  if (variantCountsData) {
    94→    for (const item of variantCountsData as Array<{ generation_id: string; viewed_at: string | null }>) {
    95→      const genId = item.generation_id;
    96→      derivedCounts[genId] = (derivedCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
    97→      if (item.viewed_at === null) {
    98→        hasUnviewedVariants[genId] = true;
    99→        unviewedVariantCounts[genId] = (unviewedVariantCounts[genId] || 0) + 1;
   100→      }
   101→    }
   102→  }
   103→
   104→  return { derivedCounts, hasUnviewedVariants, unviewedVariantCounts };
   105→}
   106→
   107→/**
   108→ * Fail-open variant of calculateDerivedCounts for non-critical UI surfaces.
   109→ * Keeps badge rendering resilient when counts query intermittently fails.
   110→ */
   111→export async function calculateDerivedCountsSafe(
   112→  generationIds: string[]
   113→): Promise<DerivedCountsResult> {
   114→  try {
   115→    return await calculateDerivedCounts(generationIds);
   116→  } catch (error) {
   117→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'generationTransformers.calculateDerivedCountsSafe', showToast: false });
   118→    return {
   119→      ...createEmptyDerivedCountsResult(),
   120→      degraded: true,
   121→      errorCode: 'query_failed',
   122→    };
   123→  }
   124→}

   211→  return firstString(
   212→    orchestratorDetails?.prompt,
   213→    params.prompt,
   214→    metadataBlock?.prompt,
   215→  ) ?? 'No prompt';
   216→}
   217→
   218→/**
   219→ * Extract thumbnail URL with fallback logic
   220→ * Handles special case for travel-between-images videos where thumbnail might be in params
   221→ */
   222→function extractThumbnailUrl(item: RawGeneration, mainUrl: string): string {
   223→  // Start with database thumbnail_url field
   224→  let thumbnailUrl = item.thumbnail_url;
   225→  const toolType = item.params?.tool_type;
   226→  
   227→  // If no thumbnail in database, check params for travel-between-images videos
   228→  if (!thumbnailUrl && isToolId(toolType) && toolType === TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES) {
   229→    const originalParams = asRecord(item.params?.originalParams);
   230→    const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(originalParams?.orchestrator_details);
   231→    const fullPayload = asRecord(item.params?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   232→    const originalFullPayload = asRecord(originalParams?.full_orchestrator_payload);
   233→
   234→    thumbnailUrl = firstString(
   235→      item.params?.thumbnailUrl,
   236→      orchestratorDetails?.thumbnail_url,
   237→      fullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   238→      originalFullPayload?.thumbnail_url,
   239→    ) ?? undefined;
   240→  }
   241→  
   242→  // Final fallback to main URL
   243→  return thumbnailUrl || mainUrl;
   244→}
   245→
   246→/**
   247→ * Normalize timeline_frame to position (divide by 50)
   248→ */
   249→function normalizePosition(timelineFrame: number | null | undefined): number | null {
   250→  if (timelineFrame === null || timelineFrame === undefined) return null;
   251→  return Math.floor(timelineFrame / 50);
   252→}
   253→
   254→/**
   255→ * Transform a raw generation record from database to UI format
   256→ * 
   257→ * This is the MAIN transformation function used by most hooks/components
   258→ * 
   259→ * @param item - Raw generation from database query
   260→ * @param options - Optional customization (shot context, metadata, etc.)
   261→ * @returns Transformed generation ready for UI display
   262→ */
   263→export function transformGeneration(
   264→  item: RawGeneration,
   265→  options: TransformOptions = {}
   266→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   267→  const mainUrl = item.location;
   268→  const thumbnailUrl = extractThumbnailUrl(item, mainUrl);
   269→  const taskIdParse = parseGenerationTaskId(item.tasks);
   270→  const taskId = taskIdParse.taskId;
   271→  const prompt = extractPrompt(item.params);
   272→  
   273→  // Extract content_type from params for proper download file extensions
   274→  // Stored as 'image' or 'video', convert to MIME type
   275→  const storedContentType = item.params?.content_type;
   276→  const isVideo = item.type?.includes('video') || storedContentType === 'video' || false;
   277→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   278→  if (storedContentType === 'video') {
   279→    // Default to mp4 for videos, can be overridden by URL extension
   280→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   281→  } else if (storedContentType === 'image') {
   282→    // Default to png for images, can be overridden by URL extension  
   283→    contentType = 'image/png';
   284→  }
   285→  
   286→  // Compute stable URL identities for caching/comparison
   287→  // Supabase URLs have rotating tokens but the file path is stable
   288→  const urlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(mainUrl);
   289→  const thumbUrlIdentity = stripQueryParameters(thumbnailUrl);
   290→
   291→  // Base transformation - fields common to all generations
   292→  const baseItem: GeneratedImageWithMetadata = {
   293→    id: item.id,
   294→    url: mainUrl,
   295→    thumbUrl: thumbnailUrl,
   296→    urlIdentity,
   297→    thumbUrlIdentity,
   298→    prompt,
   299→    metadata: {
   300→      ...(item.params || {}),
   301→      taskId, // Include task ID in metadata for MediaGalleryItem
   302→      taskIdStatus: taskIdParse.status, // Surface parse health to avoid silent shape drift
   303→      based_on: item.based_on, // Include based_on for lineage tracking
   304→      ...(options.metadata || {}), // Merge any additional metadata
   305→    },
   306→    createdAt: item.created_at,
   307→    updatedAt: item.updated_at,
   308→    isVideo,
   309→    contentType, // For proper download file extensions
   310→    starred: item.starred || false,
   311→    based_on: item.based_on, // Top level for easy access
   312→    position: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   313→    timeline_frame: null, // Will be set if shot context provided
   314→    name: item.name ?? asString(item.params?.name) ?? undefined,
   315→    derivedCount: item.derivedCount || 0, // Number of generations/variants based on this one
   316→    hasUnviewedVariants: item.hasUnviewedVariants || false, // For NEW badge display
   317→    unviewedVariantCount: item.unviewedVariantCount || 0, // Count for tooltip
   318→    // Parent/child relationship fields
   319→    is_child: item.is_child ?? undefined,
   320→    parent_generation_id: item.parent_generation_id ?? undefined,
   321→    child_order: item.child_order ?? undefined,
   322→  };
   323→
   324→  // Normalize JSONB shot_data into a flat association list.
   325→  const shotGenerations = expandShotData(asRecord(item.shot_data));
   326→  
   327→  // If shot context is provided via options, use it
   328→  if (options.shotImageEntryId || options.timeline_frame !== undefined) {
   329→    return {
   330→      ...baseItem,
   331→      shotImageEntryId: options.shotImageEntryId,
   332→      timeline_frame: options.timeline_frame ?? null,
   333→      position: normalizePosition(options.timeline_frame),
   334→    };
   335→  }
   336→
   337→  // Otherwise, process shot associations from query data
   338→  if (shotGenerations.length > 0) {
   339→    // Single shot optimization
   340→    if (shotGenerations.length === 1) {
   341→      const singleShot = shotGenerations[0];
   342→      return {
   343→        ...baseItem,
   344→        shot_id: singleShot.shot_id,
   345→        position: normalizePosition(singleShot.timeline_frame),
   346→        timeline_frame: singleShot.timeline_frame,
   347→      };
   348→    }
   349→    
   350→    // Multiple shots: include all associations
   351→    const allAssociations = shotGenerations.map(shotGen => ({
   352→      shot_id: shotGen.shot_id,
   353→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame,
   354→      position: normalizePosition(shotGen.timeline_frame),
   355→    }));
   356→    
   357→    // When filtering by specific shot, use that shot as primary
   358→    let primaryShot = shotGenerations[0];
   359→    if (options.shotId) {
   360→      const matchingShot = shotGenerations.find(shotGen => shotGen.shot_id === options.shotId);
   361→      if (matchingShot) {
   362→        primaryShot = matchingShot;
   363→      }
   364→    }
   365→
   366→    return {
   367→      ...baseItem,
   368→      shot_id: primaryShot.shot_id,
   369→      position: normalizePosition(primaryShot.timeline_frame),
   370→      timeline_frame: primaryShot.timeline_frame,
   371→      all_shot_associations: allAssociations,
   372→    };
   373→  }
   374→  
   375→  return baseItem;
   376→}
   377→
   378→/**
   379→ * Transform for Timeline component's specific needs
   380→ * Maps to GenerationRow format expected by Timeline
   381→ */
   382→export function transformForTimeline(
   383→  shotGen: RawShotGeneration
   384→): GenerationRow & { timeline_frame?: number } {
   385→  const gen = shotGen.generation || shotGen.generations;
   386→  const genData = Array.isArray(gen) ? gen[0] : gen;
   387→  
   388→  if (!genData) {
   389→    return {
   390→      // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   391→      id: shotGen.id,
   392→      generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   393→      // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   394→      shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   395→      timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   396→    };
   397→  }
   398→  
   399→  return {
   400→    // PRIMARY IDs: id = shot_generations.id (unique per entry), generation_id = actual generation
   401→    id: shotGen.id,
   402→    generation_id: shotGen.generation_id,
   403→    // Deprecated (backwards compat)
   404→    shotImageEntryId: shotGen.id,
   405→    imageUrl: genData.location,
   406→    thumbUrl: genData.location,
   407→    location: genData.location,
   408→    type: genData.type ?? undefined,
   409→    createdAt: genData.created_at,
   410→    timeline_frame: shotGen.timeline_frame ?? undefined,
   411→    metadata: (asRecord(shotGen.metadata) as GenerationMetadata | null) ?? undefined,
   412→    starred: genData.starred ?? false,
   413→    based_on: genData.based_on ?? undefined,
   414→    derivedCount: genData.derivedCount ?? 0,
   415→  };
   416→}
   417→
   418→/**
   419→ * Detect if a URL points to a video based on file extension.
   420→ * Used for variants which lack a `type` column.
   421→ */
   422→function isVideoUrl(url: string | null | undefined): boolean {
   423→  if (!url) return false;
   424→  const videoExtensions = ['.mp4', '.webm', '.mov', '.avi', '.mkv'];
   425→  return videoExtensions.some(ext => url.toLowerCase().includes(ext));
   426→}
   427→
   428→/**
   429→ * Transform a raw variant record from generation_variants table to UI format.
   430→ *
   431→ * Mirrors `transformGeneration` but for variants, which have a different
   432→ * schema (no `type` column, different metadata shape).
   433→ *
   434→ * @param variant - Raw variant from database query
   435→ * @param options - Optional overrides (e.g. toolType fallback)
   436→ * @returns Transformed variant ready for UI display
   437→ */
   438→export function transformVariant(
   439→  variant: RawVariant,
   440→  options?: { toolType?: string }
   441→): GeneratedImageWithMetadata {
   442→  const isVideo = isVideoUrl(variant.location);
   443→  const variantParams = asRecord(variant.params) ?? {};
   444→  const storedContentType = asString(variantParams.content_type) ?? undefined;
   445→
   446→  let contentType: string | undefined;
   447→  if (storedContentType === 'video' || isVideo) {
   448→    contentType = 'video/mp4';
   449→  } else {
   450→    contentType = 'image/png';
   451→  }
   452→
   453→  return {
   454→    id: variant.id,
   455→    url: variant.location,
   456→    thumbUrl: variant.thumbnail_url || variant.location,
   457→    isVideo,
   458→    contentType,
   459→    createdAt: variant.created_at,
   460→    starred: false, // Variants don't have starred flag
   461→    metadata: {
   462→      prompt: asString(variantParams.prompt) ?? undefined,
   463→      variant_type: variant.variant_type,
   464→      name: variant.name,
   465→      generation_id: variant.generation_id,
   466→      tool_type: asString(variantParams.tool_type) ?? options?.toolType,
   467→      created_from: asString(variantParams.created_from) ?? undefined,
   468→      source_task_id: asString(variantParams.source_task_id) ?? undefined,
   469→      content_type: storedContentType,
   470→    },
   471→    shot_id: undefined,
   472→    position: undefined,
   473→    all_shot_associations: undefined,
   474→  };
   475→}
   476→

   293→  }
   294→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   295→    supabase,
   296→    taskType: segmentType,
   297→    projectId,
   298→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   299→    orchestratorTaskId,
   300→    contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   301→  });
   302→  return orchestratorRows;
   303→}
   304→/**
   305→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   306→ */
   307→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   308→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   309→  finalStepType: string,
   310→  projectId: string,
   311→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   312→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   313→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   314→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   315→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   316→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   317→      supabase,
   318→      taskType: finalStepType,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      select: "id, status",
   321→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   322→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   323→    });
   324→  }
   325→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   326→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   327→      supabase,
   328→      taskType: finalStepType,
   329→      projectId,
   330→      select: "id, status",
   331→      orchestratorTaskId,
   332→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   333→    });
   334→  }
   335→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   336→    return 'not_found';
   337→  }
   338→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   339→    return 'failed';
   340→  }
   341→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Complete')) {
   342→    return 'complete';
   343→  }
   344→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Queued' || task.status === 'In Progress')) {
   345→    return 'pending';
   346→  }
   347→  return 'unknown';
   348→}
   349→/**
   350→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   351→ */
   352→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   353→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   354→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   355→  failedSegments: number,
   356→  totalSegments: number,
   357→  errorMessage?: string,
   358→  logger?: {
   359→    warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   360→    error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   361→  },
   362→): Promise<void> {
   363→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   364→    .from("tasks")
   365→    .update({
   366→      status: "Failed",
   367→      error_message: errorMessage ?? `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   368→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   369→    })
   370→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   371→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   372→    .select('id');
   373→  if (updateOrchError) {
   374→    throw new CompletionError({
   375→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_failed_update_failed',
   376→      context: 'markOrchestratorFailed',
   377→      recoverable: true,
   378→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   379→      metadata: {
   380→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   381→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   382→          ? updateOrchError.message
   383→          : String(updateOrchError),
   384→      },
   385→      cause: updateOrchError,
   386→    });
   387→  }
   388→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   389→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   390→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   391→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   392→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   393→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   394→    });
   395→  }
   396→}
   397→/**
   398→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   399→ */
   400→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   401→  params: {
   402→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   403→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   404→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   405→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   406→    publicUrl: string;
   407→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   408→    supabaseUrl: string;
   409→    serviceKey: string;
   410→    logger?: {
   411→      warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   412→      error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   413→    };
   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {
   416→  const {
   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: "Complete",
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   438→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   439→  };
   440→  if (isFinalStep) {
   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   448→    .select('id');
   449→  if (updateOrchError) {
   450→    throw new CompletionError({
   451→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   452→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   453→      recoverable: true,
   454→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   455→      metadata: {
   456→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   457→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→    });
   469→    return;
   470→  }
   471→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   472→    supabaseUrl,
   473→    serviceKey,
   474→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   475→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   476→  });
   477→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   478→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   479→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   480→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   481→    supabase,
   482→    orchestratorTaskId,
   483→    existingResultData,
   484→    billingOutcome,
   485→    billingDecision,
   486→    logger,
   487→  );
   488→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   489→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   490→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   491→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   492→      billing_result: billingResult,
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→}
   496→

1→export type OperationFailurePolicy = 'fail_closed' | 'fail_open' | 'degrade' | 'best_effort';
     2→
     3→export interface OperationFailure {
     4→  ok: false;
     5→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
     6→  recoverable: boolean;
     7→  error: Error;
     8→  errorCode: string;
     9→  message: string;
    10→  cause?: unknown;
    11→}
    12→
    13→export interface OperationSuccess<T = void> {
    14→  ok: true;
    15→  policy: OperationFailurePolicy;
    16→  recoverable: false;
    17→  value: T;
    18→}
    19→
    20→export type OperationResult<T = void> = OperationSuccess<T> | OperationFailure;
    21→
    22→interface OperationSuccessOptions {
    23→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface OperationFailureOptions {
    27→  policy?: OperationFailurePolicy;
    28→  recoverable?: boolean;
    29→  errorCode?: string;
    30→  message?: string;
    31→  cause?: unknown;
    32→}
    33→
    34→export function operationSuccess<T>(
    35→  value: T,
    36→  options?: OperationSuccessOptions,
    37→): OperationSuccess<T> {
    38→  return {
    39→    ok: true,
    40→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    41→    recoverable: false,
    42→    value,
    43→  };
    44→}
    45→
    46→export function operationFailure(
    47→  error: unknown,
    48→  options?: OperationFailureOptions,
    49→): OperationFailure {
    50→  const normalizedError = error instanceof Error
    51→    ? error
    52→    : new Error(options?.message ?? String(error));
    53→
    54→  return {
    55→    ok: false,
    56→    policy: options?.policy ?? 'best_effort',
    57→    recoverable: options?.recoverable ?? true,
    58→    error: normalizedError,
    59→    errorCode: options?.errorCode ?? 'operation_failed',
    60→    message: options?.message ?? normalizedError.message,
    61→    cause: options?.cause,
    62→  };
    63→}

     2→import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
     3→import { bootstrapEdgeHandler, NO_SESSION_RUNTIME_OPTIONS } from "../_shared/edgeHandler.ts";
     4→
     5→const LOG_PREFIX = "[DISCORD-DAILY-STATS]";
     6→
     7→// Chart color palette (dark-theme friendly)
     8→const COLORS = {
     9→  imagesGenerated: { bg: "rgba(129, 140, 248, 0.85)", border: "rgb(129, 140, 248)" },   // indigo-400
    10→  imagesEdited:    { bg: "rgba(251, 146, 191, 0.85)", border: "rgb(251, 146, 191)" },   // pink-300
    11→  videosGenerated: { bg: "rgba(110, 231, 183, 0.85)", border: "rgb(110, 231, 183)" },   // emerald-300
    12→};
    13→
    14→interface DayBucket {
    15→  date: string;
    16→  images_generated: number;
    17→  images_edited: number;
    18→  videos_generated: number;
    19→}
    20→
    21→serve(async (req) => {
    22→  const bootstrap = await bootstrapEdgeHandler(req, {
    23→    functionName: "discord-daily-stats",
    24→    logPrefix: LOG_PREFIX,
    25→    method: "POST",
    26→    parseBody: "none",
    27→    auth: {
    28→      required: true,
    29→      requireServiceRole: true,
    30→    },
    31→    ...NO_SESSION_RUNTIME_OPTIONS,
    32→  });
    33→  if (!bootstrap.ok) {
    34→    return bootstrap.response;
    35→  }
    36→
    37→  const discordWebhookUrl = Deno.env.get("DISCORD_STATS_WEBHOOK_URL");
    38→
    39→  if (!discordWebhookUrl) {
    40→    return new Response("DISCORD_STATS_WEBHOOK_URL not configured", { status: 500 });
    41→  }
    42→
    43→  const { supabaseAdmin, logger } = bootstrap.value;
    44→
    45→  try {
    46→    logger.info("Starting daily stats collection");
    47→
    48→    // Query completed tasks grouped by day, categorized into 3 buckets
    49→    const { data: dailyStats, error: statsError } = await supabaseAdmin.rpc(
    50→      "func_daily_task_stats"
    51→    );
    52→
    53→    // Task type name → bucket classification (derived from task_types table)
    54→    const IMAGE_GENERATED_TYPES = new Set([
    55→      "wan_2_2_t2i", "single_image", "qwen_image_style", "qwen_image",
    56→      "qwen_image_2512", "z_image_turbo",
    57→    ]);
    58→    const IMAGE_EDITED_TYPES = new Set([
    59→      "image_inpaint", "image_upscale", "image-upscale", "annotated_image_edit",
    60→      "edit_travel_flux", "magic_edit", "image_edit", "qwen_image_edit", "z_image_turbo_i2i",
    61→    ]);
    62→    const VIDEO_GENERATED_TYPES = new Set([
    63→      "animate_character", "individual_travel_segment", "video_enhance",
    64→      "join_clips_orchestrator", "travel_orchestrator", "edit_video_orchestrator",
    65→      "join_final_stitch",
    66→    ]);
    67→
    68→    let buckets: DayBucket[];
    69→
    70→    if (statsError || !dailyStats) {
    71→      logger.warn("RPC func_daily_task_stats not available, using direct query", {
    72→        error: statsError?.message,
    73→      });
    74→
    75→      // Paginate to fetch all completed tasks (default limit is 1000)
    76→      const PAGE_SIZE = 1000;
    77→      const allTasks: { created_at: string; task_type: string }[] = [];
    78→      let offset = 0;
    79→      while (true) {
    80→        const { data: page, error: rawError } = await supabaseAdmin
    81→          .from("tasks")
    82→          .select("created_at, task_type")
    83→          .eq("status", "Complete")
    84→          .gte("created_at", "2026-02-08T00:00:00Z")
    85→          .order("created_at", { ascending: true })
    86→          .range(offset, offset + PAGE_SIZE - 1);
    87→
    88→        if (rawError) throw rawError;
    89→        if (!page || page.length === 0) break;
    90→        allTasks.push(...page);
    91→        if (page.length < PAGE_SIZE) break;
    92→        offset += PAGE_SIZE;
    93→      }
    94→
    95→      // Aggregate in memory
    96→      const dayMap = new Map<string, DayBucket>();
    97→      for (const task of allTasks) {
    98→        const date = task.created_at.substring(0, 10); // YYYY-MM-DD
    99→        if (!dayMap.has(date)) {
   100→          dayMap.set(date, { date, images_generated: 0, images_edited: 0, videos_generated: 0 });
   101→        }
   102→        const bucket = dayMap.get(date)!;
   103→        const name = task.task_type;
   104→
   105→        if (IMAGE_GENERATED_TYPES.has(name)) {
   106→          bucket.images_generated++;
   107→        } else if (IMAGE_EDITED_TYPES.has(name)) {
   108→          bucket.images_edited++;
   109→        } else if (VIDEO_GENERATED_TYPES.has(name)) {
   110→          bucket.videos_generated++;
   111→        }
   112→      }
   113→
   114→      buckets = Array.from(dayMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
   115→    } else {
   116→      buckets = dailyStats;
   117→    }
   118→
   119→    if (buckets.length === 0) {
   120→      logger.info("No stats data found");
   121→      await logger.flush();
   122→      return new Response(JSON.stringify({ message: "No data" }), {
   123→        status: 200,
   124→        headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
   125→      });
   126→    }
   127→
   128→    // Determine if we should aggregate by week (>90 days of data)
   129→    const shouldAggregateWeekly = buckets.length > 90;
   130→    const periodData = shouldAggregateWeekly ? aggregateByWeek(buckets) : buckets;
   131→

   137→      cumEdit += b.images_edited;
   138→      cumVid += b.videos_generated;
   139→      chartData.push({ date: b.date, images_generated: cumImg, images_edited: cumEdit, videos_generated: cumVid });
   140→    }

   142→    // Calculate yesterday's stats

   145→    const yesterdayStr = yesterday.toISOString().substring(0, 10);
   146→    const yesterdayStats = buckets.find((b) => b.date === yesterdayStr) || {
   147→      date: yesterdayStr,

   149→      images_edited: 0,
   150→      videos_generated: 0,

   152→
   153→    // Calculate all-time totals

   158→        videos_generated: acc.videos_generated + b.videos_generated,

   164→    const chartUrl = await generateChart(chartData, shouldAggregateWeekly);

   169→      day: "numeric",
   170→      year: "numeric",
   171→      timeZone: "UTC",

   174→    // Post to Discord

   177→      color: 0x6366f1, // indigo
   178→      fields: [

   180→          name: "Images Generated",
   181→          value: `**${yesterdayStats.images_generated.toLocaleString()}**`,
   182→          inline: true,
   183→        },
   184→        {
   185→          name: "Images Edited",

   188→        },

   192→          inline: true,
   193→        },
   194→      ],
   195→      image: chartUrl ? { url: chartUrl } : undefined,
   196→      footer: {

   198→      },
   199→      timestamp: new Date().toISOString(),
   200→    };
   201→
   202→    const discordPayload = { embeds: [embed] };

   204→    const discordRes = await fetch(discordWebhookUrl, {
   205→      method: "POST",
   206→      headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
   207→      body: JSON.stringify(discordPayload),

   209→
   210→    if (!discordRes.ok) {

   213→    }

   218→      yesterday_videos: yesterdayStats.videos_generated,

   221→    await logger.flush();

   223→    return new Response(

   229→      }),

   231→    );
   232→  } catch (error: unknown) {

   234→    logger.error("Failed to generate/send daily stats", { error: message });

   240→/**
   241→ * Aggregate daily buckets into weekly buckets (Mon-Sun weeks)
   242→ */
   243→function aggregateByWeek(buckets: DayBucket[]): DayBucket[] {
   244→  const weekMap = new Map<string, DayBucket>();
   245→
   246→  for (const bucket of buckets) {
   247→    const date = new Date(bucket.date + "T00:00:00Z");
   248→    // Get Monday of this week

   250→    const diff = day === 0 ? -6 : 1 - day; // Monday = 1
   251→    const monday = new Date(date);
   252→    monday.setUTCDate(date.getUTCDate() + diff);
   253→    const [REDACTED]().substring(0, 10);

   255→    if (!weekMap.has(weekKey)) {

   258→    const week = weekMap.get(weekKey)!;
   259→    week.images_generated += bucket.images_generated;
   260→    week.images_edited += bucket.images_edited;
   261→    week.videos_generated += bucket.videos_generated;
   262→  }
   263→
   264→  return Array.from(weekMap.values()).sort((a, b) => a.date.localeCompare(b.date));
   265→}

1→/**
     2→ * Global Settings Write Queue
     3→ *
     4→ * Prevents network exhaustion by serializing and coalescing settings writes.
     5→ *
     6→ * Features:
     7→ * - Global concurrency limit (default: 1 in-flight write)
     8→ * - Per-target debouncing (coalesces rapid updates)
     9→ * - Merge-on-write (latest patch wins per field)
    10→ * - Optional AbortSignal passthrough for caller cancellation
    11→ * - Best-effort flush on page unload
    12→ *
    13→ * @see settings_system.md for the full settings architecture
    14→ */
    15→
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→
    18→export interface QueuedWrite {
    19→  scope: 'user' | 'project' | 'shot';
    20→  entityId: string;
    21→  toolId: string;
    22→  patch: Record<string, unknown>;
    23→  signal?: AbortSignal;
    24→}
    25→
    26→interface PendingWrite {
    27→  write: QueuedWrite;
    28→  resolvers: Array<{ resolve: (value: unknown) => void; reject: (error: unknown) => void }>;
    29→  timerId: NodeJS.Timeout | null;
    30→  enqueuedAt: number;
    31→}
    32→
    33→// Configuration
    34→const DEBOUNCE_MS = 300;
    35→const MAX_CONCURRENT = 1;
    36→
    37→// State
    38→const pendingByTarget = new Map<string, PendingWrite>();
    39→let inFlightCount = 0;
    40→const flushQueue: Array<{ targetKey: string; pending: PendingWrite }> = [];
    41→
    42→// The actual write function - injected to avoid circular imports
    43→let writeFunction: ((write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) | null = null;
    44→
    45→function createAbortError(): Error {
    46→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    47→    return new DOMException('Request was cancelled', 'AbortError');
    48→  }
    49→  const error = new Error('Request was cancelled');
    50→  error.name = 'AbortError';
    51→  return error;
    52→}
    53→
    54→function throwIfAborted(signal?: AbortSignal): void {
    55→  if (signal?.aborted) {
    56→    throw createAbortError();
    57→  }
    58→}
    59→
    60→/**
    61→ * Set the write function that performs the actual DB update.
    62→ * Must be called once at app init (in useToolSettings.ts).
    63→ * Also registers page-unload listeners on first call (deferred from module load).
    64→ */
    65→export function setSettingsWriteFunction(fn: (write: QueuedWrite) => Promise<unknown>) {
    66→  const isFirstInit = writeFunction === null;
    67→  writeFunction = fn;
    68→
    69→  if (isFirstInit && typeof window !== 'undefined') {
    70→    window.addEventListener('beforeunload', () => {
    71→      flushAll();
    72→    });
    73→    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', () => {
    74→      if (document.visibilityState === 'hidden') {
    75→        flushAll();
    76→      }
    77→    });
    78→  }
    79→}
    80→
    81→/**
    82→ * Create a unique key for deduplication
    83→ */
    84→function targetKey(write: QueuedWrite): string {
    85→  return `${write.scope}:${write.entityId}:${write.toolId}`;
    86→}
    87→
    88→/**
    89→ * Shallow merge (one level deep)
    90→ */
    91→function shallowMergePatch(existing: Record<string, unknown>, incoming: Record<string, unknown>): Record<string, unknown> {
    92→  return { ...existing, ...incoming };
    93→}
    94→
    95→/**
    96→ * Process the next item in the flush queue
    97→ */
    98→async function processQueue() {
    99→  if (inFlightCount >= MAX_CONCURRENT || flushQueue.length === 0) {
   100→    return;
   101→  }
   102→
   103→  const next = flushQueue.shift();
   104→  if (!next) return;
   105→
   106→  const { targetKey: key, pending } = next;
   107→  
   108→  // Remove from pending map (we're about to process it)
   109→  pendingByTarget.delete(key);
   110→  
   111→  inFlightCount++;
   112→  
   113→  try {
   114→    if (!writeFunction) {
   115→      throw new Error('[SettingsWriteQueue] Write function not initialized');
   116→    }
   117→
   118→    throwIfAborted(pending.write.signal);
   119→    const result = await writeFunction(pending.write);
   120→    
   121→    // Resolve all waiters
   122→    for (const { resolve } of pending.resolvers) {
   123→      resolve(result);
   124→    }
   125→  } catch (error) {
   126→    normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'SettingsWriteQueue', showToast: false });
   127→
   128→    // Reject all waiters
   129→    for (const { reject } of pending.resolvers) {
   130→      reject(error);
   131→    }
   132→  } finally {
   133→    inFlightCount--;
   134→    
   135→    // Process next item
   136→    processQueue();
   137→  }
   138→}
   139→
   140→/**
   141→ * Schedule a pending write for flush
   142→ */
   143→function scheduleFlush(key: string, pending: PendingWrite) {
   144→  // Clear existing timer
   145→  if (pending.timerId) {
   146→    clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   147→    pending.timerId = null;
   148→  }
   149→  
   150→  // Add to flush queue and process
   151→  flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   152→  processQueue();
   153→}
   154→
   155→/**
   156→ * Enqueue a settings write.
   157→ * 
   158→ * Returns a promise that resolves when the write completes.
   159→ * Multiple writes to the same target within the debounce window are merged.
   160→ * 
   161→ * @param write - The write to enqueue
   162→ * @param mode - 'debounced' (default) waits for debounce window; 'immediate' flushes now
   163→ */
   164→export function enqueueSettingsWrite(
   165→  write: QueuedWrite,
   166→  mode: 'debounced' | 'immediate' = 'debounced'
   167→): Promise<unknown> {
   168→  const key = targetKey(write);
   169→
   170→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
   171→    if (write.signal?.aborted) {
   172→      reject(createAbortError());
   173→      return;
   174→    }
   175→
   176→    const existing = pendingByTarget.get(key);
   177→
   178→    if (existing) {
   179→      // Merge with existing pending write
   180→      existing.write.patch = shallowMergePatch(existing.write.patch, write.patch);
   181→      if (write.signal) {
   182→        existing.write.signal = write.signal;
   183→      }
   184→      existing.resolvers.push({ resolve, reject });
   185→
   186→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   187→        // Cancel debounce timer and flush now
   188→        scheduleFlush(key, existing);
   189→      }
   190→      // else: existing timer will handle it
   191→      
   192→    } else {
   193→      // Create new pending write
   194→      const pending: PendingWrite = {
   195→        write: { ...write, patch: { ...write.patch } },
   196→        resolvers: [{ resolve, reject }],
   197→        timerId: null,
   198→        enqueuedAt: Date.now(),
   199→      };
   200→
   201→      pendingByTarget.set(key, pending);
   202→
   203→      if (mode === 'immediate') {
   204→        scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   205→      } else {
   206→        // Set debounce timer
   207→        pending.timerId = setTimeout(() => {
   208→          scheduleFlush(key, pending);
   209→        }, DEBOUNCE_MS);
   210→      }
   211→    }
   212→  });
   213→}
   214→
   215→
   216→/**
   217→ * Flush all pending writes immediately.
   218→ * Best-effort: returns without waiting.
   219→ */
   220→function flushAll(): void {
   221→  for (const [key, pending] of pendingByTarget.entries()) {
   222→    if (pending.timerId) {
   223→      clearTimeout(pending.timerId);
   224→      pending.timerId = null;
   225→    }
   226→    flushQueue.push({ targetKey: key, pending });
   227→  }
   228→  pendingByTarget.clear();
   229→  processQueue();
   230→}
   231→
   232→

    33→export function createTimelineWriteQueueLogger(options: TimelineWriteLoggerOptions): TimelineWriteEventHandler {
    34→  const log = options.log ?? console.log;
    35→  return (phase, meta) => {
    36→    const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    37→      shotId: shortTimelineId(meta.shotId),
    38→      requestId: meta.requestId,
    39→      operation: meta.operation,
    40→      waitMs: meta.waitMs,
    41→      queueDepth: meta.queueDepth,
    42→      blockedByOperation: meta.blockedByOperation ?? null,
    43→      blockedByDurationMs: meta.blockedByDurationMs ?? null,
    44→    };
    45→
    46→    if (phase !== 'start') {
    47→      payload.durationMs = meta.durationMs;
    48→    }
    49→
    50→    log(`${options.logPrefix} write queue ${phase}`, payload);

   170→function updateAndDrawStars(

   172→  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
   173→  stars: Star[],
   174→  parallaxX: number,
   175→  parallaxY: number,

   177→): void {
   178→  stars.forEach((star, index) => {
   179→    const isClaudeStar = index === stars.length - 1;

   182→    star.baseY = wrapPosition(star.baseY + star.vy, canvas.height, 50);

   185→    star.x = star.baseX - parallaxX * depth;
   186→    star.y = star.baseY - parallaxY * depth;

   197→function calculateWanderingMasterOpacity(startTime: number, now: number): number {
   198→  const timeSinceStart = now - startTime;
   199→  if (timeSinceStart < WANDERING_FADE_DELAY_MS) {
   200→    return 0;
   201→  }
   202→
   203→  return Math.min(1, (timeSinceStart - WANDERING_FADE_DELAY_MS) / WANDERING_FADE_DURATION_MS);
   204→}

   206→function updateAndDrawWanderingGroups(
   207→  ctx: CanvasRenderingContext2D,
   208→  canvas: HTMLCanvasElement,
   209→  groups: WanderingGroup[],
   210→  now: number,
   211→  time: number,
   212→  masterOpacity: number
   213→): void {
   214→  for (const group of groups) {
   215→    group.vx += (group.targetVx - group.vx) * 0.01;
   216→    group.vy += (group.targetVy - group.vy) * 0.01;
   217→
   218→    group.cx = wrapPosition(group.cx + group.vx, canvas.width, 100);
   219→    group.cy = wrapPosition(group.cy + group.vy, canvas.height, 100);

   222→      group.targetVx = (Math.random() - 0.5) * group.speed;
   223→      group.targetVy = (Math.random() - 0.5) * group.speed;
   224→      group.nextDirectionChange =
   225→        now + DIRECTION_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * DIRECTION_CHANGE_RANGE_MS;
   226→    }
   227→
   228→    group.opacity += (group.targetOpacity - group.opacity) * group.fadeSpeed * 16;
   229→
   230→    if (now > group.nextFadeChange) {
   231→      group.targetOpacity = Math.random() < 0.3 ? 0.05 : 0.15 + Math.random() * 0.25;
   232→      group.nextFadeChange = now + FADE_CHANGE_MIN_MS + Math.random() * FADE_CHANGE_RANGE_MS;
   233→    }
   234→
   235→    for (const particle of group.particles) {
   236→      const particleX = group.cx + particle.offsetX;
   237→      const particleY = group.cy + particle.offsetY;
   238→
   239→      if (
   240→        particleX < -50 ||
   241→        particleX > canvas.width + 50 ||
   242→        particleY < -50 ||
   243→        particleY > canvas.height + 50
   244→      ) {
   245→        continue;
   246→      }
   247→
   248→      const twinkle = 0.8 + Math.sin(time * 0.001 + particle.phase) * 0.2;
   249→      const particleOpacity = group.opacity * twinkle * masterOpacity;
   250→
   251→      ctx.beginPath();
   252→      ctx.fillStyle = `rgba(255, 255, 255, ${particleOpacity})`;
   253→      ctx.arc(particleX, particleY, particle.size, 0, Math.PI * 2);
   254→      ctx.fill();
   255→    }
   256→  }
   257→}
   258→
   259→function useConstellationAnimation(canvasRef: RefObject<HTMLCanvasElement>): void {
   260→  const starsRef = useRef<Star[]>([]);
   261→  const wanderingGroupsRef = useRef<WanderingGroup[]>([]);
   262→  const wanderingFadeInRef = useRef({ startTime: 0 });
   263→  const animationFrameRef = useRef<number>();
   264→  const mouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   265→  const smoothMouseRef = useRef({ x: 0, y: 0 });
   266→  const dimensionsRef = useRef({ width: 0, height: 0 });
   267→
   268→  useEffect(() => {
   269→    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
   270→    if (!canvas) return;
   271→
   272→    const context = canvas.getContext('2d');
   273→    if (!context) return;
   274→
   275→    const initializeScene = () => {
   276→      canvas.width = window.innerWidth;
   277→      canvas.height = window.innerHeight;
   278→
   279→      dimensionsRef.current = { width: canvas.width, height: canvas.height };
   280→      mouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   281→      smoothMouseRef.current = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
   282→
   283→      starsRef.current = initializeStars(canvas.width, canvas.height);
   284→      wanderingGroupsRef.current = createWanderingGroups(
   285→        canvas.width,
   286→        canvas.height,
   287→        performance.now()
   288→      );
   289→      wanderingFadeInRef.current = { startTime: performance.now() };
   290→    };
   291→
   292→    const handleMouseMove = (event: MouseEvent) => {
   293→      mouseRef.current = { x: event.clientX, y: event.clientY };
   294→    };
   295→
   296→    const drawFrame = (time: number) => {
   297→      context.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
   298→
   299→      const lerpFactor = 0.05;
   300→      smoothMouseRef.current.x += (mouseRef.current.x - smoothMouseRef.current.x) * lerpFactor;
   301→      smoothMouseRef.current.y += (mouseRef.current.y - smoothMouseRef.current.y) * lerpFactor;
   302→
   303→      const parallaxX =
   304→        (smoothMouseRef.current.x - dimensionsRef.current.width / 2) * 0.02;
   305→      const parallaxY =
   306→        (smoothMouseRef.current.y - dimensionsRef.current.height / 2) * 0.02;
   307→
   308→      updateAndDrawStars(
   309→        context,
   310→        canvas,
   311→        starsRef.current,
   312→        parallaxX,
   313→        parallaxY,
   314→        time
   315→      );
   316→
   317→      const now = performance.now();
   318→      const masterOpacity = calculateWanderingMasterOpacity(
   319→        wanderingFadeInRef.current.startTime,
   320→        now
   321→      );
   322→
   323→      if (masterOpacity > 0) {
   324→        updateAndDrawWanderingGroups(
   325→          context,
   326→          canvas,
   327→          wanderingGroupsRef.current,
   328→          now,
   329→          time,
   330→          masterOpacity
   331→        );
   332→      }
   333→
   334→      animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   335→    };
   336→
   337→    initializeScene();
   338→
   339→    window.addEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   340→    window.addEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   341→    animationFrameRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(drawFrame);
   342→
   343→    return () => {
   344→      window.removeEventListener('resize', initializeScene);
   345→      window.removeEventListener('mousemove', handleMouseMove);
   346→
   347→      if (animationFrameRef.current) {
   348→        cancelAnimationFrame(animationFrameRef.current);
   349→      }
   350→    };
   351→  }, [canvasRef]);
   352→}
   353→
   354→export const ConstellationCanvas = () => {
   355→  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement>(null);
   356→
   357→  useConstellationAnimation(canvasRef);
   358→
   359→  return (
   360→    <canvas
   361→      ref={canvasRef}
   362→      className="fixed inset-0 pointer-events-none"
   363→      style={{
   364→        zIndex: 3,
   365→        mixBlendMode: 'screen',
   366→        opacity: 0.6,
   367→      }}
   368→    />
   369→  );
   370→};

1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)
     7→ * - Position calculation for drag-and-drop operations

     9→ * No React hooks or side effects - all functions are stateless.

    11→
    12→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/timeline/useTimelineCore';
    13→import { calculateAverageSpacing, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING } from '@/shared/lib/timelinePositionCalculator';
    14→
    15→/** Maximum allowed gap between timeline frames (5s at 16fps). */
    16→const MAX_FRAME_GAP = 81;
    17→
    18→// ============================================================================
    19→// Types
    20→// ============================================================================
    21→
    22→interface FrameUpdate {
    23→  id: string;
    24→  newFrame: number;
    25→  reason: string;
    26→}
    27→
    28→// ============================================================================
    29→// Normalization
    30→// ============================================================================
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    34→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    35→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop
    80→// ============================================================================
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Find a ShotGeneration by canonical shot_generations.id.
    84→ */
    85→export function findGeneration(
    86→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    87→  key?: string | null
    88→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    89→  if (!key) return undefined;
    90→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key);
    91→}
    92→
    93→interface DistributionContext {
    94→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];
    95→  draggedItemIds: string[];
    96→  newStartIndex: number;
    97→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    98→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   103→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).
   104→ */
   105→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   106→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   107→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];
   108→
   109→  const pushUpdate = (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => {
   110→    const normalizedFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame));
   111→    accumulateUpdates.push({ id, newFrame: normalizedFrame, reason });
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   115→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   116→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   117→
   118→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   119→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   120→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   121→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   122→    );
   123→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   124→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   125→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   126→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   127→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);

   129→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   130→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   131→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   132→    });
   133→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {

   138→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   139→
   140→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   141→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   142→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
