   153→    });
   154→  } else {
   155→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   226→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   227→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   228→    }
   229→  });
   230→  return uniqueUpdates;
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   235→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   236→ */
   237→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   238→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   239→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   240→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   241→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   242→
   243→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   244→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   245→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   246→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   247→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   251→
   252→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   253→
   254→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   255→
   256→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   257→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   258→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   259→    if (existing) {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });
   261→    } else {
   262→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, payload);
   263→    }
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return uniqueUpdates;
   267→}
   268→

    21→): string {

   254→    genSetImg2imgPrompt(prompt);
   255→  }, [genSetImg2imgPrompt]);
   256→
   257→  // Img2Img setters (save to both generation and "last used")
   258→  const setImg2imgStrength = useCallback((strength: number) => {
   259→    genSetImg2imgStrength(strength);
   260→    updateLastUsed({ img2imgStrength: strength });
   261→  }, [genSetImg2imgStrength, updateLastUsed]);
   262→
   263→  const setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion = useCallback((enabled: boolean) => {
   264→    genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion(enabled);
   265→    updateLastUsed({ img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: enabled });
   266→  }, [genSetImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion, updateLastUsed]);
   267→
   268→  // Advanced settings setter (merges with existing, saves to both generation and "last used")
   269→  const setAdvancedSettings = useCallback((updates: Partial<EditAdvancedSettings>) => {
   270→    genSetAdvancedSettings(updates);
   271→    // Merge updates with current advancedSettings for lastUsed
   272→    const currentAdvanced = effectiveSettings.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS;
   273→    updateLastUsed({ advancedSettings: { ...currentAdvanced, ...updates } });
   274→  }, [genSetAdvancedSettings, updateLastUsed, effectiveSettings.advancedSettings]);
   275→
   276→  // Video enhance settings setter (per-generation only, not "last used")
   277→  const setEnhanceSettings = useCallback((updates: Partial<VideoEnhanceSettings>) => {
   278→    genSetEnhanceSettings(updates);
   279→  }, [genSetEnhanceSettings]);
   280→
   281→  // Generation options setter (saves to both generation and "last used")
   282→  const setCreateAsGeneration = useCallback((value: boolean) => {
   283→    genSetCreateAsGeneration(value);
   284→    updateLastUsed({ createAsGeneration: value });
   285→  }, [genSetCreateAsGeneration, updateLastUsed]);
   286→
   287→  // Video/Panel mode setters (only save to "last used", not per-generation)
   288→  const setVideoEditSubMode = useCallback((mode: VideoEditSubMode) => {
   289→    updateLastUsed({ videoEditSubMode: mode });
   290→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   291→
   292→  const setPanelMode = useCallback((mode: PanelMode) => {
   293→    updateLastUsed({ panelMode: mode });
   294→  }, [updateLastUsed]);
   295→
   296→  // Computed LoRAs based on mode (replaces useEditModeLoras logic)
   297→  const loraMode = effectiveSettings.loraMode;
   298→  const customLoraUrl = effectiveSettings.customLoraUrl;
   299→  const editModeLoras = useMemo(() => {
   300→
   301→    switch (loraMode) {
   302→      case 'in-scene':
   303→        return [{ url: EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS['in-scene'], strength: 1.0 }];
   304→      case 'next-scene':
   305→        return [{ url: EDIT_MODE_LORA_URLS['next-scene'], strength: 1.0 }];
   306→      case 'custom':
   307→        return customLoraUrl.trim()
   308→          ? [{ url: customLoraUrl.trim(), strength: 1.0 }]
   309→          : undefined;
   310→      case 'none':
   311→      default:
   312→        return undefined;
   313→    }
   314→  }, [loraMode, customLoraUrl]);
   315→
   316→  // Legacy compatibility
   317→  const isInSceneBoostEnabled = effectiveSettings.loraMode !== 'none';
   318→  const setIsInSceneBoostEnabled = (enabled: boolean) => {
   319→    setLoraMode(enabled ? 'in-scene' : 'none');
   320→  };
   321→
   322→  return {
   323→    // Current values (using effective settings to avoid race condition)
   324→    editMode: effectiveSettings.editMode,
   325→    loraMode: effectiveSettings.loraMode,
   326→    customLoraUrl: effectiveSettings.customLoraUrl,
   327→    numGenerations: effectiveSettings.numGenerations,
   328→    prompt: effectiveSettings.prompt,
   329→    // Img2Img values
   330→    img2imgPrompt: effectiveSettings.img2imgPrompt,
   331→    img2imgPromptHasBeenSet: effectiveSettings.img2imgPromptHasBeenSet,
   332→    img2imgStrength: effectiveSettings.img2imgStrength,
   333→    img2imgEnablePromptExpansion: effectiveSettings.img2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   334→    // Advanced settings (hires fix config)
   335→    advancedSettings: effectiveSettings.advancedSettings ?? DEFAULT_ADVANCED_SETTINGS,
   336→    // Video enhance settings (interpolation/upscaling)
   337→    enhanceSettings: effectiveSettings.enhanceSettings ?? DEFAULT_ENHANCE_SETTINGS,
   338→    // Model selection for cloud mode
   339→    qwenEditModel: effectiveSettings.qwenEditModel ?? 'qwen-edit',
   340→    // Generation options
   341→    createAsGeneration: effectiveSettings.createAsGeneration ?? false,
   342→
   343→    // Setters
   344→    setEditMode,
   345→    setLoraMode,
   346→    setCustomLoraUrl,
   347→    setNumGenerations,
   348→    setPrompt,
   349→    setQwenEditModel,
   350→    // Img2Img setters
   351→    setImg2imgPrompt,
   352→    setImg2imgStrength,
   353→    setImg2imgEnablePromptExpansion,
   354→    // Advanced settings setter
   355→    setAdvancedSettings,
   356→    // Video enhance settings setter
   357→    setEnhanceSettings,
   358→    // Generation options setter
   359→    setCreateAsGeneration,
   360→
   361→    // Video/Panel mode (from "last used")
   362→    videoEditSubMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.videoEditSubMode,
   363→    panelMode: lastUsedSettings.lastUsed.panelMode,
   364→    setVideoEditSubMode,
   365→    setPanelMode,
   366→
   367→    // Computed
   368→    editModeLoras,
   369→
   370→    // Legacy
   371→    isInSceneBoostEnabled,
   372→    setIsInSceneBoostEnabled,
   373→
   374→    // State
   375→    isLoading: generationSettings.isLoading,
   376→    isReady,
   377→    hasPersistedSettings: generationSettings.hasPersistedSettings,
   378→  };
   379→}
   380→
   381→// Re-export types for convenience
   382→export type { EditMode, LoraMode, QwenEditModel, EditAdvancedSettings, VideoEnhanceSettings, GenerationEditSettings, LastUsedEditSettings, VideoEditSubMode, PanelMode };

     8→/**
     9→ * Standardized settings inheritance for new shots
    10→ * This ensures ALL shot creation paths use the same inheritance logic
    11→ *

    13→ * inherited along with all other shot settings. No separate LoRA handling needed.

    18→interface InheritSettingsParams {

    38→  }

    43→ * Gets inherited settings for a new shot

    45→ * 
    46→ * LoRAs are included in mainSettings.selectedLoras (unified with other settings)
    47→ * Join Segments settings are inherited separately in joinSegmentsSettings
    48→ */
    49→async function getInheritedSettings(
    50→  params: InheritSettingsParams
    51→): Promise<InheritedSettings> {
    52→  const { projectId, shots } = params;
    53→  
    54→  let mainSettings: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
    55→  let uiSettings: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
    56→  let joinSegmentsSettings: Record<string, unknown> | null = null;
    57→
    58→  // 1. Try to get from localStorage (most recent active shot) - captures unsaved edits
    59→  try {
    60→    const [REDACTED](projectId);
    61→    const stored = localStorage.getItem(mainStorageKey);
    62→    if (stored) {
    63→      mainSettings = JSON.parse(stored);
    64→    }
    65→    
    66→    const [REDACTED](projectId);
    67→    const storedUI = localStorage.getItem(uiStorageKey);
    68→    if (storedUI) {
    69→      uiSettings = JSON.parse(storedUI);
    70→    }
    71→    
    72→    // Join Segments settings
    73→    const [REDACTED](projectId);
    74→    const storedJoin = localStorage.getItem(joinStorageKey);
    75→    if (storedJoin) {
    76→      joinSegmentsSettings = JSON.parse(storedJoin);
    77→    }
    78→  } catch (e) {
    79→    normalizeAndPresentError(e, { context: 'ShotSettingsInheritance', showToast: false });
    80→  }
    81→  
    82→  // 1b. If no project-specific settings AND this is a new project (no shots), try global fallback
    83→  // This enables cross-project inheritance for the first shot in a new project
    84→  const isNewProject = !shots || shots.length === 0;
    85→  if (!mainSettings && isNewProject) {
    86→    try {
    87→      const globalStored = localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEYS.GLOBAL_LAST_ACTIVE_SHOT_SETTINGS);
    88→      if (globalStored) {
    89→        mainSettings = JSON.parse(globalStored);
    90→      }
    91→

    96→          joinSegmentsSettings = JSON.parse(globalJoinStored);

   104→  // 2. If not found, fall back to latest created shot from DB
   105→  if ((!mainSettings || !joinSegmentsSettings) && shots && shots.length > 0) {
   106→    
   107→    const sortedShots = [...shots].sort((a, b) => {
   108→      const dateA = new Date(a.created_at || 0).getTime();
   109→      const dateB = new Date(b.created_at || 0).getTime();
   110→      return dateB - dateA;
   111→    });
   112→    
   113→    const latestShot = sortedShots[0];
   114→    
   115→    if (latestShot) {
   116→

   119→      }

   123→      }
   124→    }
   125→  }
   126→
   127→  // 3. Fetch project-level defaults if still missing
   128→  if (!mainSettings || !uiSettings) {
   129→    try {
   130→      const { data: projectData } = await supabase().from('projects')
   131→        .select('settings')
   132→        .eq('id', projectId)
   133→        .single();
   134→      
   135→      const projectSettings = toRecord(projectData?.settings);
   136→      if (!mainSettings && projectSettings?.[TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES]) {
   137→        mainSettings = projectSettings[TOOL_IDS.TRAVEL_BETWEEN_IMAGES] as Record<string, unknown>;
   138→      }
   139→
   140→      if (!uiSettings && projectSettings?.[SETTINGS_IDS.TRAVEL_UI_STATE]) {
   141→        uiSettings = projectSettings[SETTINGS_IDS.TRAVEL_UI_STATE] as Record<string, unknown>;
   142→      }
   143→    } catch (error) {
   144→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'ShotSettingsInheritance', showToast: false });
   145→    }
   146→  }
   147→
   148→  return {
   149→    mainSettings,
   150→    uiSettings,
   151→    joinSegmentsSettings
   152→  };
   153→}
   154→
   155→/**
   156→ * Applies inherited settings to a new shot
   157→ * Saves main settings (including LoRAs) to sessionStorage for useShotSettings to pick up
   158→ * Also saves Join Segments settings to sessionStorage for useJoinSegmentsSettings to pick up
   159→ */
   160→function applyInheritedSettings(
   161→  params: InheritSettingsParams,
   162→  inherited: InheritedSettings
   163→): Promise<void> {
   164→  const { newShotId } = params;
   165→  const { mainSettings, uiSettings, joinSegmentsSettings } = inherited;
   166→
   167→  // Save main settings to sessionStorage for useShotSettings to pick up
   168→  // LoRAs are included in mainSettings.loras
   169→  if (mainSettings || uiSettings) {
   170→    const defaultsToApply = {
   171→      ...(mainSettings || {}),
   172→      _uiSettings: uiSettings || {},
   173→      // Always start with empty prompt fields for new shots (don't inherit)
   174→      prompt: '',  // Main prompt for video generation
   175→      textBeforePrompts: '',
   176→      textAfterPrompts: '',
   177→      pairConfigs: [],
   178→    };
   179→    const [REDACTED](newShotId);
   180→    sessionStorage.setItem(storageKey, JSON.stringify(defaultsToApply));
   181→
   182→  }
   183→  
   184→  // Save Join Segments settings to sessionStorage for useJoinSegmentsSettings to pick up
   185→  if (joinSegmentsSettings) {
   186→    const joinDefaultsToApply = {
   187→      ...joinSegmentsSettings,
   188→      // Clear prompt for new shots (shot-specific, shouldn't inherit)
   189→      prompt: '',
   190→      negativePrompt: '',
   191→    };
   192→    const [REDACTED](newShotId);
   193→    sessionStorage.setItem(joinStorageKey, JSON.stringify(joinDefaultsToApply));
   194→    
   195→  }
   196→  
   197→  // NOTE: LoRAs no longer need separate DB save - they're part of mainSettings
   198→  // and will be saved by useShotSettings when it picks up from sessionStorage
   199→  return Promise.resolve();
   200→}
   201→
   202→/**
   203→ * Complete standardized inheritance flow
   204→ * Call this after creating any new shot
   205→ */
   206→export async function inheritSettingsForNewShot(
   207→  params: InheritSettingsParams
   208→): Promise<void> {
   209→  
   210→  const inherited = await getInheritedSettings(params);
   211→  await applyInheritedSettings(params, inherited);
   212→  
   213→}

     2→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     3→import { GenerationRow } from '@/domains/generation/types';
     4→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
     5→import { expandShotData } from '@/shared/lib/shotData';
     6→
     7→interface UseSourceGenerationParams {
     8→  media: GenerationRow;
     9→  onOpenExternalGeneration?: (generationId: string, derivedContext?: string[]) => Promise<void>;
    10→}
    11→
    12→export interface SourceVariantData {
    13→  id: string;
    14→  location: string;
    15→  thumbnail_url: string | null;
    16→  variant_type: string | null;
    17→  is_primary: boolean;
    18→}
    19→
    20→/** Enriched generation data with shot associations */
    21→interface SourceGenerationWithAssociations extends GenerationRow {
    22→  all_shot_associations: Array<{ shot_id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    23→}
    24→
    25→interface UseSourceGenerationReturn {
    26→  sourceGenerationData: SourceGenerationWithAssociations | null;
    27→  sourcePrimaryVariant: SourceVariantData | null;
    28→}
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Hook to fetch and manage source generation (based_on) data
    32→ * Fetches the generation that this media was derived from, plus its primary variant
    33→ */
    34→export const useSourceGeneration = ({
    35→  media
    36→}: UseSourceGenerationParams): UseSourceGenerationReturn => {
    37→  const [sourceGenerationData, setSourceGenerationData] = useState<SourceGenerationWithAssociations | null>(null);
    38→  const [sourcePrimaryVariant, setSourcePrimaryVariant] = useState<SourceVariantData | null>(null);
    39→  const metadataBasedOnId = (media.metadata as Record<string, unknown> | null)?.based_on as string | undefined;
    40→
    41→  useEffect(() => {
    42→    const basedOnId = media.based_on;
    43→    const basedOnFromMetadata = metadataBasedOnId;
    44→
    45→    // Check both direct field and metadata
    46→    const effectiveBasedOnId = basedOnId || basedOnFromMetadata;
    47→    
    48→    if (!effectiveBasedOnId) {
    49→      setSourceGenerationData(null);
    50→      setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
    51→      return;
    52→    }
    53→    
    54→    const fetchSourceGeneration = async () => {
    55→      try {
    56→        // Fetch source generation with shot associations and primary variant
    57→        // Use left join (no !inner) so we get the generation even if it's not in any shot
    58→        const { data, error } = await supabase().from('generations')
    59→          .select(`
    60→            *,
    61→            generation_variants!generation_variants_generation_id_fkey(
    62→              id,
    63→              location,
    64→              thumbnail_url,
    65→              variant_type,
    66→              is_primary
    67→            )
    68→          `)
    69→          .eq('id', effectiveBasedOnId)
    70→          .maybeSingle();
    71→
    72→        if (error) throw error;
    73→
    74→        if (data) {
    75→          // Extract shot associations from joined data
    76→          const joinedData = data as unknown as Record<string, unknown>;
    77→          const shotAssociations = expandShotData(
    78→            joinedData.shot_data as Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
    79→          );
    80→          const variants = (joinedData.generation_variants || []) as SourceVariantData[];
    81→          
    82→          // Find primary variant
    83→          const primaryVariant = variants.find((v) => v.is_primary) || null;
    84→          
    85→          // Add shot associations to the data for easy access
    86→          const enrichedData: SourceGenerationWithAssociations = {
    87→            ...data as unknown as GenerationRow,
    88→            all_shot_associations: shotAssociations,
    89→          };
    90→
    91→          setSourceGenerationData(enrichedData);
    92→          setSourcePrimaryVariant(primaryVariant);
    93→        } else {
    94→          setSourceGenerationData(null);
    95→          setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
    96→        }
    97→      } catch (error) {
    98→        normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: 'useSourceGeneration', showToast: false });
    99→        // Don't show toast - this is a non-critical feature
   100→        setSourceGenerationData(null);
   101→        setSourcePrimaryVariant(null);
   102→      }
   103→    };
   104→    
   105→    void fetchSourceGeneration();
   106→  }, [media.based_on, metadataBasedOnId]);
   107→
   108→  return {
   109→    sourceGenerationData,
   110→    sourcePrimaryVariant
   111→  };
   112→};
   113→

1→import { useCallback } from 'react';
     2→import { toast } from '@/shared/components/ui/runtime/sonner';
     3→import type { PromptEntry } from '../../types';
     4→import type { PromptRoutingResult } from './types';
     5→import { isAutoGeneratedShortPrompt, toShortPrompt } from '../../lib/promptUtils';
     6→
     7→interface PromptHandlersInput {
     8→  prompts: PromptEntry[];
     9→  setPrompts: PromptRoutingResult['setPrompts'];
    10→  markAsInteracted: () => void;
    11→  generatePromptId: () => string;
    12→}
    13→
    14→export function usePromptHandlers(input: PromptHandlersInput) {
    15→  const { prompts, setPrompts, markAsInteracted, generatePromptId } = input;
    16→
    17→  const handleAddPrompt = useCallback(() => {
    18→    markAsInteracted();
    19→    const newPrompt = {
    20→      id: generatePromptId(),
    21→      fullPrompt: '',
    22→      shortPrompt: `Prompt ${prompts.length + 1}`,
    23→    };
    24→
    25→    setPrompts((prev) => [...prev, newPrompt]);
    26→  }, [markAsInteracted, generatePromptId, prompts.length, setPrompts]);
    27→
    28→  const handleUpdatePrompt = useCallback(
    29→    (id: string, field: 'fullPrompt' | 'shortPrompt', value: string) => {
    30→      markAsInteracted();
    31→
    32→      setPrompts((prev) =>
    33→        prev.map((prompt) => {
    34→          if (prompt.id !== id) {
    35→            return prompt;
    36→          }
    37→
    38→          const updatedPrompt = { ...prompt, [field]: value };
    39→          if (
    40→            field === 'fullPrompt' &&
    41→            isAutoGeneratedShortPrompt(updatedPrompt.shortPrompt, prompt.fullPrompt)
    42→          ) {
    43→            updatedPrompt.shortPrompt = toShortPrompt(value);
    44→          }
    45→
    46→          return updatedPrompt;
    47→        })
    48→      );
    49→    },
    50→    [markAsInteracted, setPrompts]
    51→  );
    52→
    53→  const handleRemovePrompt = useCallback(
    54→    (id: string) => {
    55→      markAsInteracted();
    56→
    57→      if (prompts.length <= 1) {
    58→        toast.error('Cannot remove the last prompt.');
    59→        return;
    60→      }
    61→
    62→      setPrompts((prev) => prev.filter((prompt) => prompt.id !== id));
    63→    },
    64→    [markAsInteracted, prompts.length, setPrompts]
    65→  );
    66→
    67→  const handleDeleteAllPrompts = useCallback(() => {
    68→    markAsInteracted();
    69→    setPrompts([{ id: generatePromptId(), fullPrompt: '', shortPrompt: 'Prompt 1' }]);
    70→  }, [markAsInteracted, generatePromptId, setPrompts]);
    71→
    72→  const handleSavePromptsFromModal = useCallback(
    73→    (updatedPrompts: PromptEntry[]) => {
    74→      markAsInteracted();
    75→
    76→      const seenIds = new Set<string>();
    77→      const sanitizedPrompts = updatedPrompts.map((prompt) => {
    78→        let id = prompt.id && !seenIds.has(prompt.id) ? prompt.id : '';
    79→        if (!id) {
    80→          id = generatePromptId();
    81→        }
    82→
    83→        seenIds.add(id);
    84→
    85→        return {
    86→          ...prompt,
    87→          id,
    88→          shortPrompt: prompt.shortPrompt || toShortPrompt(prompt.fullPrompt),
    89→        };
    90→      });
    91→
    92→      setPrompts(sanitizedPrompts);
    93→    },
    94→    [markAsInteracted, generatePromptId, setPrompts]
    95→  );
    96→
    97→  return {
    98→    handleAddPrompt,
    99→    handleUpdatePrompt,
   100→    handleRemovePrompt,
   101→    handleDeleteAllPrompts,
   102→    handleSavePromptsFromModal,
   103→  };
   104→}
   105→

     2→
     3→/**
     4→ * Smart timestamp updater hook that provides live-updating relative timestamps
     5→ * with performance optimizations for galleries and task lists.
     6→ * 
     7→ * Features:
     8→ * - Automatic updates with smart intervals (30s for recent, 60s for older)
     9→ * - Only updates when component is visible (IntersectionObserver)
    10→ * - Batched updates to prevent excessive re-renders
    11→ * - Efficient memory management with cleanup
    12→ */
    13→
    14→interface TimestampUpdateOptions {
    15→  /** Date to track */
    16→  date: Date | string | null;
    17→  /** Update interval in seconds (default: smart intervals based on age) */
    18→  updateInterval?: number;
    19→  /** Whether this timestamp is currently visible (default: true) */
    20→  isVisible?: boolean;
    21→  /** Disable automatic updates (default: false) */
    22→  disabled?: boolean;
    23→}
    24→
    25→// Global timestamp manager to coordinate updates across all components
    26→class TimestampManager {
    27→  private intervals = new Map<number, Set<() => void>>();
    28→  private timers = new Map<number, NodeJS.Timeout>();
    29→  
    30→  // Smart interval selection based on timestamp age
    31→  private getUpdateInterval(date: Date): number {
    32→    const now = Date.now();
    33→    const age = now - date.getTime();
    34→    
    35→    // Less than 5 minutes old: update every 10 seconds (more responsive for fresh content)
    36→    if (age < 5 * 60 * 1000) return 10;
    37→    
    38→    // Less than 1 hour old: update every 60 seconds  
    39→    if (age < 60 * 60 * 1000) return 60;
    40→    
    41→    // Less than 1 day old: update every 5 minutes
    42→    if (age < 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000) return 300;
    43→    
    44→    // Older: update every 30 minutes
    45→    return 1800;
    46→  }
    47→  
    48→  subscribe(date: Date, callback: () => void, isVisible: boolean = true): () => void {
    49→    if (!isVisible) {
    50→      // Return no-op unsubscribe for invisible timestamps
    51→      return () => {};
    52→    }
    53→    
    54→    const interval = this.getUpdateInterval(date);
    55→    
    56→    // Get or create interval group
    57→    if (!this.intervals.has(interval)) {
    58→      this.intervals.set(interval, new Set());
    59→    }
    60→    
    61→    const callbacks = this.intervals.get(interval)!;
    62→    callbacks.add(callback);
    63→    
    64→    // Start timer if this is the first callback for this interval
    65→    if (callbacks.size === 1) {
    66→      const timer = setInterval(() => {
    67→        // Batch all callbacks for this interval
    68→        callbacks.forEach(cb => cb());
    69→      }, interval * 1000);
    70→      
    71→      this.timers.set(interval, timer);
    72→    }
    73→    
    74→    // Return unsubscribe function
    75→    return () => {
    76→      callbacks.delete(callback);
    77→      
    78→      // Clean up timer if no more callbacks
    79→      if (callbacks.size === 0) {
    80→        const timer = this.timers.get(interval);
    81→        if (timer) {
    82→          clearInterval(timer);
    83→          this.timers.delete(interval);
    84→        }
    85→        this.intervals.delete(interval);
    86→      }
    87→    };
    88→  }
    89→  
    90→  // Get current update interval for a date (for debugging)
    91→  getIntervalForDate(date: Date): number {
    92→    return this.getUpdateInterval(date);
    93→  }
    94→}
    95→
    96→// Global singleton
    97→const timestampManager = new TimestampManager();

1→const EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000;
     2→const STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000;
     3→
     4→interface ComposedSignalResult {
     5→  signal: AbortSignal;
     6→  cleanup: () => void;
     7→}
     8→
     9→function getRequestUrl(input: URL | RequestInfo): string {
    10→  if (typeof input === 'string') {
    11→    return input;
    12→  }
    13→  if (input instanceof URL) {
    14→    return input.toString();
    15→  }
    16→  if (input instanceof Request) {
    17→    return input.url;
    18→  }
    19→  return String(input);
    20→}
    21→
    22→export function composeAbortSignals(timeoutSignal: AbortSignal, callerSignal?: AbortSignal): ComposedSignalResult {
    23→  if (!callerSignal) {
    24→    return {
    25→      signal: timeoutSignal,
    26→      cleanup: () => {},
    27→    };
    28→  }
    29→
    30→  const composedController = new AbortController();
    31→  const abort = () => {
    32→    if (!composedController.signal.aborted) {
    33→      composedController.abort();
    34→    }
    35→  };
    36→
    37→  if (timeoutSignal.aborted || callerSignal.aborted) {
    38→    abort();
    39→    return {
    40→      signal: composedController.signal,
    41→      cleanup: () => {},
    42→    };
    43→  }
    44→
    45→  const onAbort = () => abort();
    46→  timeoutSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    47→  callerSignal.addEventListener('abort', onAbort, { once: true });
    48→
    49→  return {
    50→    signal: composedController.signal,
    51→    cleanup: () => {
    52→      timeoutSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    53→      callerSignal.removeEventListener('abort', onAbort);
    54→    },
    55→  };
    56→}
    57→
    58→function toAbortError(reason: unknown): Error {
    59→  if (reason instanceof Error) {
    60→    return reason;
    61→  }
    62→
    63→  const message = typeof reason === 'string'
    64→    ? reason
    65→    : 'The operation was aborted.';
    66→
    67→  if (typeof DOMException !== 'undefined') {
    68→    return new DOMException(message, 'AbortError');
    69→  }
    70→
    71→  return new Error(message);
    72→}
    73→
    74→export function fetchWithTimeout(input: URL | RequestInfo, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<Response> {
    75→  const url = getRequestUrl(input);
    76→  const isEdgeFunction = url.includes('/functions/v1/');
    77→  const isStorageUpload = url.includes('/storage/v1/object/');
    78→
    79→  if (!isEdgeFunction && !isStorageUpload) {
    80→    return fetch(input, init);
    81→  }
    82→
    83→  const callerSignal = init.signal instanceof AbortSignal ? init.signal : undefined;
    84→  if (callerSignal?.aborted) {
    85→    return Promise.reject(toAbortError(callerSignal.reason));
    86→  }
    87→
    88→  const controller = new AbortController();
    89→  const timeoutMs = isEdgeFunction ? EDGE_FUNCTION_TIMEOUT_MS : STORAGE_UPLOAD_TIMEOUT_MS;
    90→  const timeoutId = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), timeoutMs);
    91→  const { signal, cleanup } = composeAbortSignals(
    92→    controller.signal,
    93→    callerSignal,
    94→  );
    95→
    96→  return fetch(input, { ...init, signal }).finally(() => {
    97→    clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    98→    cleanup();
    99→  });
   100→}
   101→

    69→  });
    70→}
    71→
    72→function downloadBlobWithXHR(
    73→  url: string,
    74→): Promise<{ blob: Blob; responseContentType: string | null }> {
    75→  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    76→    const xhr = new XMLHttpRequest();
    77→    xhr.open('GET', url, true);
    78→    xhr.responseType = 'blob';
    79→
    80→    xhr.onload = function onLoad() {
    81→      if (this.status !== 200) {
    82→        reject(new DownloadServiceError({
    83→          code: 'http_error',
    84→          context: 'MediaGallery.downloadBlobWithXHR',
    85→          message: `Failed to fetch media: ${this.status} ${this.statusText}`,
    86→          status: this.status,
    87→          statusText: this.statusText,
    88→          url,
    89→        }));
    90→        return;
    91→      }
    92→
    93→      const response = this.response;
    94→      if (!(response instanceof Blob)) {
    95→        reject(new DownloadServiceError({
    96→          code: 'invalid_payload',
    97→          context: 'MediaGallery.downloadBlobWithXHR',
    98→          message: 'Invalid download response payload',
    99→          url,
   100→        }));
   101→        return;
   102→      }
   103→
   104→      resolve({
   105→        blob: response,
   106→        responseContentType: this.getResponseHeader('content-type'),
   107→      });
   108→    };
   109→
   110→    xhr.onerror = function onError() {
   111→      reject(new DownloadServiceError({
   112→        code: 'network_error',
   113→        context: 'MediaGallery.downloadBlobWithXHR',
   114→        message: 'Network request failed',
   115→        url,
   116→      }));
   117→    };
   118→
   119→    xhr.onabort = function onAbort() {
   120→      reject(new DownloadServiceError({
   121→        code: 'aborted',
   122→        context: 'MediaGallery.downloadBlobWithXHR',
   123→        message: 'Download request was aborted',
   124→        url,
   125→      }));
   126→    };
   127→
   128→    xhr.send();
   129→  });
   130→}
   131→
   132→function inferFileExtension(
   133→  contentType: string,
   134→  accessibleUrl: string,
   135→  isVideo: boolean,
   136→): string {
   137→  let extension = contentType.split('/')[1];
   138→  if (extension) {
   139→    extension = extension.split(';')[0].trim();
   140→  }
   141→  if (!extension || extension === 'octet-stream') {
   142→    const urlWithoutParams = accessibleUrl.split('?')[0];
   143→    const urlParts = urlWithoutParams.split('.');
   144→    extension = urlParts.length > 1 ? urlParts.pop()! : (isVideo ? 'mp4' : 'png');
   145→  }
   146→  return extension;
   147→}
   148→
   149→export async function downloadSingleMedia(
   150→  params: DownloadSingleMediaParams,
   151→): Promise<DownloadedMediaResult> {
   152→  const accessibleUrl = getDisplayUrl(params.rawUrl);
   153→  const { blob: rawBlob, responseContentType } = await downloadBlobWithXHR(accessibleUrl);
   154→  const blobContentType = params.originalContentType
   155→    || responseContentType
   156→    || (params.isVideo ? 'video/mp4' : 'image/png');
   157→  const blob = rawBlob.type === blobContentType
   158→    ? rawBlob
   159→    : new Blob([rawBlob], { type: blobContentType });
   160→
   161→  const extension = inferFileExtension(blobContentType, accessibleUrl, params.isVideo === true);
   162→  const downloadFilename = params.filename.includes('.')
   163→    ? params.filename
   164→    : `${params.filename}.${extension}`;
   165→  downloadBlobAsFile(blob, downloadFilename);
   166→  return { filename: downloadFilename };
   167→}
   168→
   169→interface DownloadStarredArchiveOptions {
   170→  images: GeneratedImageWithMetadata[];
   171→  onProgress?: (processedCount: number, totalCount: number) => void;
   172→}
   173→
   174→function inferMediaExtension(image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata, blob: Blob): string {
   175→  const contentType = blob.type || image.metadata?.content_type;
   176→  if (contentType) {
   177→    if (contentType.includes('jpeg') || contentType.includes('jpg')) return 'jpg';
   178→    if (contentType.includes('png')) return 'png';
   179→    if (contentType.includes('webp')) return 'webp';
   180→    if (contentType.includes('gif')) return 'gif';
   181→    if (image.isVideo) {
   182→      if (contentType.includes('webm')) return 'webm';
   183→      return 'mp4';
   184→    }
   185→  }
   186→  return image.isVideo ? 'mp4' : 'png';
   187→}
   188→
   189→function buildArchiveFileName(): string {
   190→  const now = new Date();
   191→  const dateStr = now.toISOString().split('T')[0].replace(/-/g, '');
   192→  return `starred-images-${dateStr}.zip`;
   193→}
   194→
   195→export async function downloadStarredMediaArchive(
   196→  options: DownloadStarredArchiveOptions,
   197→): Promise<{ count: number; archiveFilename: string }> {
   198→  const context = 'MediaGallery.downloadStarredMediaArchive';
   199→  const JSZipModule = await import('jszip');
   200→  const zip = new JSZipModule.default();
   201→
   202→  const sortedImages = [...options.images].sort((a, b) => {
   203→    const dateA = a.createdAt ? new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
   204→    const dateB = b.createdAt ? new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
   205→    if (dateA !== dateB) {
   206→      return dateA - dateB;
   207→    }
   208→    return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
   209→  });
   210→
   211→  for (let i = 0; i < sortedImages.length; i += 1) {
   212→    const image = sortedImages[i];
   213→    const accessibleImageUrl = getDisplayUrl(image.url);
   214→    let response: Response;
   215→    try {
   216→      response = await fetch(accessibleImageUrl);
   217→    } catch (error) {
   218→      throw toDownloadServiceError({
   219→        error,
   220→        context,
   221→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   222→        fallbackMessage: 'Network request failed',
   223→      });
   224→    }
   225→
   226→    if (!response.ok) {
   227→      throw new DownloadServiceError({
   228→        code: 'http_error',
   229→        context,
   230→        message: `Failed to fetch media: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`,
   231→        status: response.status,
   232→        statusText: response.statusText,
   233→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   234→      });
   235→    }
   236→
   237→    let blob: Blob;
   238→    try {
   239→      blob = await response.blob();
   240→    } catch (error) {
   241→      throw toDownloadServiceError({
   242→        error,
   243→        context,
   244→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   245→        fallbackMessage: 'Failed to read download payload',
   246→      });
   247→    }
   248→
   249→    const extension = inferMediaExtension(image, blob);
   250→    const filename = `${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${extension}`;
   251→    zip.file(filename, blob);
   252→    options.onProgress?.(i + 1, sortedImages.length);
   253→  }
   254→
   255→  const zipBlob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' });
   256→  const archiveFilename = buildArchiveFileName();
   257→  downloadBlobAsFile(zipBlob, archiveFilename);
   258→  return { count: sortedImages.length, archiveFilename };
   259→}
   260→

1→/**
     2→ * Task ID resolution helpers
     3→ *
     4→ * Centralizes the logic for extracting task IDs from variant params,
     5→ * handling legacy field names consistently.
     6→ */
     7→
     8→const UUID_REGEX = /^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;
     9→const CANONICAL_SOURCE_TASK_ID_PATHS = [
    10→  ['source_task_id'],
    11→  ['orchestration_contract', 'orchestrator_task_id'],
    12→];
    13→const LEGACY_SOURCE_TASK_ID_PATHS = [
    14→  ['orchestrator_task_id'],
    15→  ['task_id'],
    16→] as const;
    17→
    18→function readStringPath(
    19→  value: unknown,
    20→  path: readonly string[],
    21→): string | null {
    22→  let current: unknown = value;
    23→  for (const segment of path) {
    24→    if (!current || typeof current !== 'object' || Array.isArray(current)) {
    25→      return null;
    26→    }
    27→    current = (current as Record<string, unknown>)[segment];
    28→  }
    29→  return typeof current === 'string' && current.length > 0 ? current : null;
    30→}
    31→
    32→function resolveTaskIdFromPaths(
    33→  value: unknown,
    34→  paths: readonly (readonly string[])[],
    35→): string | null {
    36→  return paths
    37→    .map((path) => readStringPath(value, path))
    38→    .find((candidate): candidate is string => Boolean(candidate)) ?? null;
    39→}
    40→
    41→function asValidUuid(value: string | null): string | null {
    42→  if (!value) {
    43→    return null;
    44→  }
    45→  return UUID_REGEX.test(value) ? value : null;
    46→}
    47→
    48→/**
    49→ * Extract the source task ID from variant params.
    50→ *
    51→ * Variants can have their source task ID stored under different field names
    52→ * due to historical evolution of the param structure:
    53→ * - `source_task_id` - Current standard (preferred)
    54→ * - `orchestration_contract.orchestrator_task_id` - Canonical orchestrator contract
    55→ *
    56→ * @param params - Variant params object (typically from variant.params)
    57→ * @returns Valid UUID task ID, or null if not found/invalid
    58→ */
    59→export function getSourceTaskId(
    60→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined
    61→): string | null {
    62→  return asValidUuid(resolveTaskIdFromPaths(params, CANONICAL_SOURCE_TASK_ID_PATHS));
    63→}
    64→
    65→/**
    66→ * Legacy-compatible source task ID extraction.
    67→ * This helper is only for migration paths that still need to read old keys.

    69→export function getSourceTaskIdLegacyCompatible(
    70→  params: Record<string, unknown> | null | undefined,
    71→): string | null {

   138→  if (extension) {
   139→    extension = extension.split(';')[0].trim();
   140→  }
   141→  if (!extension || extension === 'octet-stream') {
   142→    const urlWithoutParams = accessibleUrl.split('?')[0];
   143→    const urlParts = urlWithoutParams.split('.');
   144→    extension = urlParts.length > 1 ? urlParts.pop()! : (isVideo ? 'mp4' : 'png');
   145→  }
   146→  return extension;
   147→}

   150→  params: DownloadSingleMediaParams,
   151→): Promise<DownloadedMediaResult> {
   152→  const accessibleUrl = getDisplayUrl(params.rawUrl);
   153→  const { blob: rawBlob, responseContentType } = await downloadBlobWithXHR(accessibleUrl);
   154→  const blobContentType = params.originalContentType
   155→    || responseContentType
   156→    || (params.isVideo ? 'video/mp4' : 'image/png');
   157→  const blob = rawBlob.type === blobContentType
   158→    ? rawBlob
   159→    : new Blob([rawBlob], { type: blobContentType });
   160→
   161→  const extension = inferFileExtension(blobContentType, accessibleUrl, params.isVideo === true);
   162→  const downloadFilename = params.filename.includes('.')
   163→    ? params.filename
   164→    : `${params.filename}.${extension}`;
   165→  downloadBlobAsFile(blob, downloadFilename);
   166→  return { filename: downloadFilename };
   167→}

   173→
   174→function inferMediaExtension(image: GeneratedImageWithMetadata, blob: Blob): string {
   175→  const contentType = blob.type || image.metadata?.content_type;
   176→  if (contentType) {
   177→    if (contentType.includes('jpeg') || contentType.includes('jpg')) return 'jpg';
   178→    if (contentType.includes('png')) return 'png';
   179→    if (contentType.includes('webp')) return 'webp';
   180→    if (contentType.includes('gif')) return 'gif';
   181→    if (image.isVideo) {
   182→      if (contentType.includes('webm')) return 'webm';
   183→      return 'mp4';
   184→    }
   185→  }
   186→  return image.isVideo ? 'mp4' : 'png';
   187→}
   188→
   189→function buildArchiveFileName(): string {
   190→  const now = new Date();
   191→  const dateStr = now.toISOString().split('T')[0].replace(/-/g, '');
   192→  return `starred-images-${dateStr}.zip`;
   193→}
   194→
   195→export async function downloadStarredMediaArchive(
   196→  options: DownloadStarredArchiveOptions,
   197→): Promise<{ count: number; archiveFilename: string }> {
   198→  const context = 'MediaGallery.downloadStarredMediaArchive';
   199→  const JSZipModule = await import('jszip');
   200→  const zip = new JSZipModule.default();
   201→
   202→  const sortedImages = [...options.images].sort((a, b) => {
   203→    const dateA = a.createdAt ? new Date(a.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
   204→    const dateB = b.createdAt ? new Date(b.createdAt).getTime() : 0;
   205→    if (dateA !== dateB) {
   206→      return dateA - dateB;
   207→    }
   208→    return a.id.localeCompare(b.id);
   209→  });
   210→
   211→  for (let i = 0; i < sortedImages.length; i += 1) {
   212→    const image = sortedImages[i];
   213→    const accessibleImageUrl = getDisplayUrl(image.url);
   214→    let response: Response;
   215→    try {
   216→      response = await fetch(accessibleImageUrl);
   217→    } catch (error) {
   218→      throw toDownloadServiceError({
   219→        error,
   220→        context,
   221→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   222→        fallbackMessage: 'Network request failed',
   223→      });
   224→    }
   225→
   226→    if (!response.ok) {
   227→      throw new DownloadServiceError({
   228→        code: 'http_error',
   229→        context,
   230→        message: `Failed to fetch media: ${response.status} ${response.statusText}`,
   231→        status: response.status,
   232→        statusText: response.statusText,
   233→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   234→      });
   235→    }
   236→
   237→    let blob: Blob;
   238→    try {
   239→      blob = await response.blob();
   240→    } catch (error) {
   241→      throw toDownloadServiceError({
   242→        error,
   243→        context,
   244→        url: accessibleImageUrl,
   245→        fallbackMessage: 'Failed to read download payload',
   246→      });
   247→    }
   248→
   249→    const extension = inferMediaExtension(image, blob);
   250→    const filename = `${String(i + 1).padStart(3, '0')}.${extension}`;
   251→    zip.file(filename, blob);
   252→    options.onProgress?.(i + 1, sortedImages.length);
   253→  }
   254→
   255→  const zipBlob = await zip.generateAsync({ type: 'blob' });
   256→  const archiveFilename = buildArchiveFileName();
   257→  downloadBlobAsFile(zipBlob, archiveFilename);
   258→  return { count: sortedImages.length, archiveFilename };
   259→}

   199→  }

   204→function copyUnknownExtras(

   206→  target: GenerationMetadata,

   212→    }

   242→  }
   243→
   244→  metadata.enhanced_prompt = asString(value.enhanced_prompt);
   245→
   246→  const knownKeys = new Set([
   247→    'frame_spacing',

   250→    'locked',
   251→    'context_frames',

1→import { isPastRemovalTarget, type DeprecationPolicy } from '@/shared/lib/governance/deprecationPolicy';
     2→import {
     3→  normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow,
     4→  normalizeAndPresentError,
     5→} from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
     6→
     7→const signaledDeprecations = new Set<string>();
     8→
     9→interface DeprecationSignalOptions {
    10→  alias: string;
    11→  policy: DeprecationPolicy;
    12→  remediation?: string;
    13→  enforcement?: 'warn' | 'throw' | 'auto';
    14→}
    15→
    16→function resolveEnforcementMode(mode: DeprecationSignalOptions['enforcement']): 'warn' | 'throw' {
    17→  if (mode === 'warn' || mode === 'throw') {
    18→    return mode;
    19→  }
    20→
    21→  const metaEnv = typeof import.meta !== 'undefined'
    22→    ? (import.meta as unknown as { env?: Record<string, string | undefined> }).env
    23→    : undefined;
    24→  const nodeEnv = typeof process !== 'undefined' ? process.env?.NODE_ENV : undefined;
    25→  const isTestMode = nodeEnv === 'test' || metaEnv?.MODE === 'test' || metaEnv?.VITEST === 'true';
    26→  const explicit = metaEnv?.VITE_DEPRECATION_ENFORCEMENT;
    27→
    28→  if (explicit === 'throw') {
    29→    return isTestMode ? 'warn' : 'throw';
    30→  }
    31→  if (explicit === 'warn') {
    32→    return 'warn';
    33→  }
    34→
    35→  if (isTestMode) {
    36→    return 'warn';
    37→  }
    38→
    39→  return nodeEnv === 'production' ? 'warn' : 'throw';
    40→}
    41→
    42→/**
    43→ * Emits a one-time runtime signal when a legacy alias is used past its removal target.
    44→ * Returns true when the usage is past target, false otherwise.
    45→ */
    46→export function signalPastRemovalTargetUsage({
    47→  alias,
    48→  policy,
    49→  remediation,
    50→  enforcement = 'auto',
    51→}: DeprecationSignalOptions): boolean {
    52→  if (!isPastRemovalTarget(policy)) {
    53→    return false;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  const key = `${alias}:${policy.removeBy}`;
    57→  if (signaledDeprecations.has(key)) {
    58→    return true;
    59→  }
    60→
    61→  signaledDeprecations.add(key);
    62→  const suffix = remediation ? ` ${remediation}` : '';
    63→  const message = `[deprecation] ${alias} is past removal target ${policy.removeBy} (owner: ${policy.owner}).${suffix}`;
    64→  const mode = resolveEnforcementMode(enforcement);
    65→  const logData = {
    66→    alias,
    67→    owner: policy.owner,
    68→    removeBy: policy.removeBy,
    69→    mode,
    70→  };
    71→
    72→  if (mode === 'throw') {
    73→    normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow(new Error(message), {
    74→      context: 'deprecationEnforcement.signalPastRemovalTargetUsage',
    75→      showToast: false,
    76→      logData,
    77→    });
    78→  }
    79→
    80→  normalizeAndPresentError(new Error(message), {
    81→    context: 'deprecationEnforcement.signalPastRemovalTargetUsage',
    82→    showToast: false,
    83→    logData,
    84→  });
    85→  return true;
    86→}
    87→

1→import { debugConfig } from '@/shared/lib/debug/debugConfig';
     2→import type { TrackableImage, TrackerLimits } from './types';
     3→
     4→const getTrackerConfig = (): TrackerLimits => {
     5→  const isMobile = typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.innerWidth <= 768;
     6→  const hasLowMemory =
     7→    typeof navigator !== 'undefined' &&
     8→    'deviceMemory' in navigator &&
     9→    (navigator as { deviceMemory?: number }).deviceMemory !== undefined &&
    10→    (navigator as { deviceMemory: number }).deviceMemory <= 4;
    11→
    12→  if (isMobile || hasLowMemory) {
    13→    return { maxImages: 100, maxUrls: 150 };
    14→  }
    15→  return { maxImages: 300, maxUrls: 500 };
    16→};
    17→
    18→const loadedImagesById = new Map<string, boolean>();
    19→
    20→const loadedImagesByUrl = new Map<
    21→  string,
    22→  { loadedAt: number; width?: number; height?: number; element?: HTMLImageElement }
    23→>();
    24→
    25→const shouldLogTrackerDebug = (): boolean =>
    26→  import.meta.env.DEV && debugConfig.isEnabled('imageLoading');
    27→
    28→/**
    29→ * Evict oldest entries from a Map until it's under the limit.
    30→ * Maps maintain insertion order, so we delete from the beginning.
    31→ */
    32→const evictOldestEntries = <K, V>(
    33→  map: Map<K, V>,
    34→  maxSize: number,
    35→  name: string
    36→): number => {
    37→  if (map.size <= maxSize) return 0;
    38→
    39→  const toEvict = map.size - maxSize;
    40→  const keys = Array.from(map.keys()).slice(0, toEvict);
    41→
    42→  keys.forEach((key) => map.delete(key));
    43→
    44→  if (shouldLogTrackerDebug()) {
    45→    console.log(
    46→      `[ImageLoadTracker] Evicted ${toEvict} oldest entries from ${name}, new size: ${map.size}`
    47→    );
    48→  }
    49→  return toEvict;
    50→};
    51→
    52→const enforceLoadTrackerLimits = (): void => {
    53→  const config = getTrackerConfig();
    54→  evictOldestEntries(loadedImagesById, config.maxImages, 'loadedImagesById');
    55→  evictOldestEntries(loadedImagesByUrl, config.maxUrls, 'loadedImagesByUrl');
    56→};
    57→
    58→export const setImageLoadStatus = (
    59→  image: TrackableImage,
    60→  isLoaded: boolean = true
    61→): void => {
    62→  const imageId = image.id;
    63→  if (!imageId) {
    64→    return;
    65→  }
    66→
    67→  // Update tracker
    68→  loadedImagesById.set(imageId, isLoaded);
    69→
    70→  // Keep legacy field in sync while older call sites are still present.
    71→  image.__memoryCached = isLoaded;
    72→
    73→  // Enforce limits in coarse batches to avoid per-write overhead.
    74→  if (isLoaded && loadedImagesById.size % 50 === 0) {
    75→    enforceLoadTrackerLimits();
    76→  }
    77→};
    78→
    79→const removeLoadedImages = (imageIds: string[]): number => {
    80→  let removedCount = 0;
    81→
    82→  imageIds.forEach((imageId) => {
    83→    if (loadedImagesById.has(imageId)) {
    84→      loadedImagesById.delete(imageId);
    85→      removedCount++;
    86→    }
    87→  });
    88→
    89→  return removedCount;
    90→};
    91→
    92→export const clearLoadedImages = (images: Array<{ id: string }>): number => {
    93→  const imageIds = images.map((img) => img.id).filter((id) => id);
    94→
    95→  return removeLoadedImages(imageIds);
    96→};
    97→
    98→export const clearAllLoadedImages = (
    99→  reason: string = 'project switch'
   100→): number => {
   101→  const prevSize = loadedImagesById.size;
   102→  loadedImagesById.clear();
   103→  loadedImagesByUrl.clear();
   104→
   105→  if (shouldLogTrackerDebug()) {
   106→    console.log(
   107→      `[ImageLoadTracker] Cleared all for ${reason}, removed ${prevSize} entries`
   108→    );
   109→  }
   110→  return prevSize;
   111→};
   112→
   113→export const hasLoadedImage = (urlOrImage: string | TrackableImage): boolean => {
   114→  if (typeof urlOrImage === 'string') {
   115→    return loadedImagesByUrl.has(urlOrImage);
   116→  }
   117→
   118→  const imageId = urlOrImage?.id;
   119→  if (!imageId) {
   120→    return false;
   121→  }
   122→
   123→  const isLoaded = loadedImagesById.get(imageId) === true;
   124→
   125→  if (isLoaded && urlOrImage.__memoryCached !== true) {
   126→    urlOrImage.__memoryCached = true;
   127→  }
   128→
   129→  return isLoaded;
   130→};
   131→

   133→  urlOrImage: string | TrackableImage,
   134→  metadata?: { width?: number; height?: number; element?: HTMLImageElement }
   135→): void => {
   136→  if (typeof urlOrImage === 'string') {
   137→    loadedImagesByUrl.set(urlOrImage, {
   138→      loadedAt: Date.now(),
   139→      ...metadata,
   140→    });
   141→    if (loadedImagesByUrl.size % 50 === 0) {
   142→      enforceLoadTrackerLimits();
   143→    }
   144→    return;
   145→  }
   146→
   147→  setImageLoadStatus(urlOrImage, true);
   148→};
   149→
   150→export const getLoadTrackerStats = (): {

   152→  byUrl: number;
   153→  limits: TrackerLimits;
   154→} => {

   161→};

     9→// Module-level request deduplication cache for the raw `users.settings` DB fetch.
    10→//
    11→// WHY THIS EXISTS (instead of React Query):
    12→// This hook reads a single key from `users.settings.ui`, but many instances
    13→// mount concurrently for different keys (generationMethods, privacyDefaults,
    14→// theme, etc.). Without deduplication, each mount fires an identical
    15→// `SELECT settings FROM users WHERE id = ?` query.
    16→//
    17→// WHY NOT React Query: The hook's read path has complex per-key logic
    18→// (fallback merging, normalization, auto-backfill of missing DB fields)
    19→// that runs after fetching the raw settings row. Migrating to React Query
    20→// would require either (a) a single shared query that all instances subscribe
    21→// to (losing per-key granularity for loading/error states), or (b) per-key
    22→// queries that each fetch the same row (defeating deduplication). The current
    23→// approach deduplicates at the network layer while keeping per-key logic local.
    24→//
    25→// WRITES already go through useToolSettings' global write queue, so there is
    26→// no write-side duplication -- only this read-side cache is parallel.
    27→interface CachedUserSettingsRow {
    28→  settings?: Json;
    29→}
    30→interface CachedSettingsResult {
    31→  data: CachedUserSettingsRow | null;
    32→  error: unknown;
    33→}

    36→  timestamp: number;

    39→const settingsCache = new Map<string, SettingsCacheEntry>();

1→/**
     2→ * useTaskPlaceholder — Collapse placeholder lifecycle to one call.
     3→ *
     4→ * Every task-creation callsite needs the same 5-step ceremony:
     5→ *   addIncomingTask → create → resolveTaskIds → refetch → removeIncomingTask
     6→ * This hook wraps that into a single `run()` function.
     7→ *
     8→ * Also handles mid-flight cancellation: if cancelAllIncoming() is called
     9→ * while create() is in flight, the newly created tasks are cancelled in DB.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import { useCallback } from 'react';
    13→import { useQueryClient } from '@tanstack/react-query';
    14→import { getSupabaseClient as supabase } from '@/integrations/supabase/client';
    15→import { useIncomingTasks } from '@/shared/contexts/IncomingTasksContext';
    16→import { normalizeAndPresentError } from '@/shared/lib/errorHandling/runtimeError';
    17→import { taskQueryKeys } from '@/shared/lib/queryKeys/tasks';
    18→
    19→interface TaskPlaceholderOptions {
    20→  taskType: string;
    21→  label: string;
    22→  expectedCount?: number;
    23→  context: string;
    24→  toastTitle: string;
    25→  create: () => Promise<unknown>;
    26→  /** Extra work after task IDs are resolved (e.g. invalidateQueries). */
    27→  onSuccess?: (taskIds: string[]) => void | Promise<void>;
    28→}
    29→
    30→/**
    31→ * Extract task IDs from whatever shape the create() function returns.
    32→ *
    33→ * Handles:
    34→ *  - string                        → raw task_id
    35→ *  - string[]                      → array of raw task_ids
    36→ *  - { task_id: string }           → single TaskCreationResult
    37→ *  - Array<{ task_id: string }>    → batch results
    38→ *  - mixed arrays of strings and objects
    39→ *  - void/null/undefined           → [] (graceful degradation)
    40→ */
    41→export function extractTaskIds(result: unknown): string[] {
    42→  if (result == null) return [];
    43→
    44→  if (typeof result === 'string') return [result];
    45→
    46→  if (Array.isArray(result)) {
    47→    return result.flatMap(item => {
    48→      if (typeof item === 'string') return [item];
    49→      if (item != null && typeof item === 'object' && 'task_id' in item) {
    50→        const id = (item as { task_id: unknown }).task_id;
    51→        if (typeof id === 'string') return [id];
    52→      }
    53→      return [];
    54→    });
    55→  }
    56→
    57→  if (typeof result === 'object' && 'task_id' in result) {
    58→    const id = (result as { task_id: unknown }).task_id;
    59→    if (typeof id === 'string') return [id];
    60→  }
    61→
    62→  return [];
    63→}
    64→
    65→/** Cancel specific task IDs in the database (used for mid-flight cancellation). */
    66→async function cancelTasksByIds(taskIds: string[]): Promise<void> {
    67→  if (taskIds.length === 0) return;
    68→  await supabase().from('tasks')
    69→    .update({ status: 'Cancelled', updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    70→    .in('id', taskIds);
    71→}
    72→
    73→export type RunTaskPlaceholder = (options: TaskPlaceholderOptions) => Promise<void>;
    74→
    75→/**
    76→ * Returns a stable `run` function that wraps the full placeholder lifecycle.
    77→ *
    78→ * Usage:
    79→ * ```ts
    80→ * const run = useTaskPlaceholder();
    81→ * await run({
    82→ *   taskType: 'image-upscale', label: 'Upscale 2x',
    83→ *   context: 'useUpscale', toastTitle: 'Upscale failed',
    84→ *   create: () => createImageUpscaleTask(params),
    85→ * });
    86→ * ```
    87→ */
    88→export function useTaskPlaceholder(): RunTaskPlaceholder {
    89→  const { addIncomingTask, removeIncomingTask, resolveTaskIds, wasCancelled, acknowledgeCancellation } = useIncomingTasks();
    90→  const queryClient = useQueryClient();
    91→
    92→  return useCallback(async (options: TaskPlaceholderOptions) => {
    93→    const incomingTaskId = addIncomingTask({
    94→      taskType: options.taskType,
    95→      label: options.label,
    96→      expectedCount: options.expectedCount,
    97→    });
    98→
    99→    try {
   100→      const result = await options.create();
   101→      const taskIds = extractTaskIds(result);
   102→
   103→      // If cancelled while create() was in flight, cancel the newly created tasks.
   104→      if (wasCancelled(incomingTaskId)) {
   105→        if (taskIds.length > 0) {
   106→          await cancelTasksByIds(taskIds);
   107→        }
   108→        acknowledgeCancellation(incomingTaskId);
   109→        return; // finally block still runs for refetch + cleanup
   110→      }
   111→
   112→      if (taskIds.length > 0) {
   113→        resolveTaskIds(incomingTaskId, taskIds);
   114→      }
   115→
   116→      await options.onSuccess?.(taskIds);
   117→    } catch (error) {
   118→      if (wasCancelled(incomingTaskId)) {
   119→        acknowledgeCancellation(incomingTaskId);
   120→        return; // Swallow errors from cancelled tasks
   121→      }
   122→      normalizeAndPresentError(error, { context: options.context, toastTitle: options.toastTitle });
   123→    } finally {
   124→      await queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   125→      await queryClient.refetchQueries({ [REDACTED] });
   126→      // Safe even if already removed by cancelAllIncoming — filter is a no-op
   127→      removeIncomingTask(incomingTaskId);
   128→    }
   129→  }, [addIncomingTask, removeIncomingTask, resolveTaskIds, queryClient, wasCancelled, acknowledgeCancellation]);
   130→}
   131→

1→/**
     2→ * Timeline Frame Calculators
     3→ *
     4→ * Pure functions for timeline frame position calculations:
     5→ * - Gap finding and frame distribution
     6→ * - Normalization (compress gaps, shift to start at 0)
     7→ * - Position calculation for drag-and-drop operations
     8→ *
     9→ * No React hooks or side effects - all functions are stateless.
    10→ */
    11→
    12→import type { ShotGeneration } from '@/shared/hooks/timeline/useTimelineCore';
    13→import { calculateAverageSpacing, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING } from '@/shared/lib/timelinePositionCalculator';
    14→
    15→/** Maximum allowed gap between timeline frames (5s at 16fps). */
    16→const MAX_FRAME_GAP = 81;
    17→
    18→// ============================================================================
    19→// Types
    20→// ============================================================================
    21→
    22→interface FrameUpdate {
    23→  id: string;
    24→  newFrame: number;
    25→  reason: string;
    26→}
    27→
    28→// ============================================================================
    29→// Normalization
    30→// ============================================================================
    31→
    32→/**
    33→ * Normalize a set of final positions: start at 0, compress gaps > MAX_FRAME_GAP.
    34→ * Returns a map of id -> { newFrame, reason } for items that need updating.
    35→ * @internal Used only within this module by buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions.
    36→ */
    37→function normalizePositions(
    38→  allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }>
    39→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
    40→  const normalizedUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
    41→
    42→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return normalizedUpdates;
    43→
    44→  // Sort by frame position
    45→  const sorted = [...allFinalPositions].sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
    46→
    47→  let currentFrame = 0;
    48→
    49→  for (let i = 0; i < sorted.length; i++) {
    50→    const item = sorted[i];
    51→
    52→    if (i === 0) {
    53→      if (item.frame !== 0) {
    54→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, { newFrame: 0, reason: 'Normalized to start at 0' });
    55→      }
    56→      currentFrame = 0;
    57→    } else {
    58→      const prevItem = sorted[i - 1];
    59→      const originalGap = item.frame - prevItem.frame;
    60→      const normalizedGap = Math.min(originalGap, MAX_FRAME_GAP);
    61→      const normalizedFrame = currentFrame + normalizedGap;
    62→
    63→      if (normalizedFrame !== item.frame) {
    64→        normalizedUpdates.set(item.id, {
    65→          newFrame: normalizedFrame,
    66→          reason: originalGap > MAX_FRAME_GAP
    67→            ? `Gap compressed from ${originalGap} to ${normalizedGap}`
    68→            : 'Shifted to maintain sequence'
    69→        });
    70→      }
    71→      currentFrame = normalizedFrame;
    72→    }
    73→  }
    74→
    75→  return normalizedUpdates;
    76→}
    77→
    78→// ============================================================================
    79→// Frame distribution for drag-and-drop
    80→// ============================================================================
    81→
    82→/**
    83→ * Find a ShotGeneration by canonical shot_generations.id.
    84→ */
    85→export function findGeneration(
    86→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
    87→  key?: string | null
    88→): ShotGeneration | undefined {
    89→  if (!key) return undefined;
    90→  return shotGenerations.find(sg => sg.id === key);
    91→}
    92→
    93→interface DistributionContext {
    94→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[];
    95→  draggedItemIds: string[];
    96→  newStartIndex: number;
    97→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>;
    98→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[];
    99→}
   100→
   101→/**
   102→ * Calculate frame positions for dragged items based on their new position in the list.
   103→ * Returns accumulated updates (not yet deduplicated or normalized).
   104→ */
   105→export function calculateDistributedFrames(ctx: DistributionContext): FrameUpdate[] {
   106→  const { draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newStartIndex, allItems, shotGenerations } = ctx;
   107→  const accumulateUpdates: FrameUpdate[] = [];
   108→
   109→  const pushUpdate = (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => {
   110→    const normalizedFrame = Math.max(0, Math.floor(frame));
   111→    accumulateUpdates.push({ id, newFrame: normalizedFrame, reason });
   112→  };
   113→
   114→  const newEndIndex = newStartIndex + draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   115→  const predecessor = newStartIndex > 0 ? allItems[newStartIndex - 1] : null;
   116→  const successor = newEndIndex < allItems.length - 1 ? allItems[newEndIndex + 1] : null;
   117→
   118→  if (newStartIndex === 0 && successor) {
   119→    // Special case: dropping at position 0
   120→    calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   121→      draggedShotGens, draggedItemIds, newEndIndex, allItems, shotGenerations, successor, pushUpdate
   122→    );
   123→  } else if (predecessor && successor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   124→    // Between two items - distribute evenly in the gap
   125→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame - predecessor.timeline_frame;
   126→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   127→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   128→
   129→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   130→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (interval * (i + 1));
   131→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed in gap (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   132→    });
   133→  } else if (predecessor && predecessor.timeline_frame != null) {
   134→    // At end - extend timeline using average spacing of existing items
   135→    const existingFrames = allItems
   136→      .filter(item => item.timeline_frame != null)
   137→      .map(item => item.timeline_frame!);
   138→    const spacing = calculateAverageSpacing(existingFrames, DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING);
   139→
   140→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   141→      const newFrame = predecessor.timeline_frame! + (spacing * (i + 1));
   142→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Extend at end (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   143→    });
   144→  } else if (successor && successor.timeline_frame != null) {
   145→    // At start - distribute between 0 and successor
   146→    const gap = successor.timeline_frame;
   147→    const numItems = draggedItemIds.length;
   148→    const interval = gap / (numItems + 1);
   149→
   150→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   151→      const newFrame = interval * (i + 1);
   152→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Distributed from start (${i + 1}/${numItems})`);
   153→    });
   154→  } else {
   155→    // First items in timeline - start at 0 and space by default
   156→
   157→    draggedShotGens.forEach((sg, i) => {
   158→      const newFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING * i;
   159→      pushUpdate(sg.id, newFrame, `Initial placement (${i + 1}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   160→    });
   161→  }
   162→
   163→  return accumulateUpdates;
   164→}
   165→
   166→/**
   167→ * Handle the special case of dropping items at position 0.
   168→ */
   169→function calculateDropAtPositionZero(
   170→  draggedShotGens: ShotGeneration[],
   171→  draggedItemIds: string[],
   172→  newEndIndex: number,
   173→  allItems: Array<{ id: string; timeline_frame: number | null }>,
   174→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[],
   175→  successor: { id: string; timeline_frame: number | null },
   176→  pushUpdate: (id: string, frame: number, reason: string) => void
   177→) {
   178→  const displacedFirstItem = successor;
   179→  const oldSecondItem = newEndIndex + 2 < allItems.length ? allItems[newEndIndex + 2] : null;
   180→
   181→  // First dragged item goes to frame 0
   182→  pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[0].id, 0, 'First item at position 0');
   183→
   184→  // Calculate new position for displaced first item
   185→  let displacedNewFrame: number;
   186→  if (oldSecondItem?.timeline_frame != null) {
   187→    displacedNewFrame = Math.floor((0 + oldSecondItem.timeline_frame) / 2);
   188→  } else if (displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame != null) {
   189→    displacedNewFrame = Math.max(DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING, displacedFirstItem.timeline_frame);
   190→  } else {
   191→    displacedNewFrame = DEFAULT_FRAME_SPACING;
   192→  }
   193→
   194→  // Update displaced item
   195→  const displacedShotGen = findGeneration(shotGenerations, displacedFirstItem.id);
   196→  if (displacedShotGen?.id) {
   197→    pushUpdate(displacedShotGen.id, displacedNewFrame, 'Displaced first item shifted');
   198→  }
   199→
   200→  // Distribute remaining dragged items between 0 and displaced item's new position
   201→  if (draggedItemIds.length > 1) {
   202→    const numRemaining = draggedItemIds.length - 1;
   203→    const gap = displacedNewFrame;
   204→    const interval = gap / (numRemaining + 1);
   205→
   206→    for (let i = 1; i < draggedItemIds.length; i++) {
   207→      const newFrame = interval * i;
   208→      pushUpdate(draggedShotGens[i].id, newFrame, `Distributed after first (${i}/${draggedItemIds.length})`);
   209→    }
   210→  }
   211→}
   212→
   213→// ============================================================================
   214→// Update deduplication
   215→// ============================================================================
   216→
   217→/**
   218→ * Deduplicate frame updates (last write wins per id).
   219→ */
   220→export function deduplicateUpdates(
   221→  updates: FrameUpdate[]
   222→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   223→  const uniqueUpdates = new Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>();
   224→  updates.forEach(entry => {
   225→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(entry.id);
   226→    if (!existing || existing.newFrame !== entry.newFrame) {
   227→      uniqueUpdates.set(entry.id, { newFrame: entry.newFrame, reason: entry.reason });
   228→    }
   229→  });
   230→  return uniqueUpdates;
   231→}
   232→
   233→/**
   234→ * Build the complete picture of final positions (updated + unchanged) for all positioned items,
   235→ * then normalize and merge back into the updates map.
   236→ */
   237→export function buildAndNormalizeFinalPositions(
   238→  uniqueUpdates: Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }>,
   239→  shotGenerations: ShotGeneration[]
   240→): Map<string, { newFrame: number; reason: string }> {
   241→  const allFinalPositions: Array<{ id: string; frame: number }> = [];
   242→
   243→  for (const sg of shotGenerations) {
   244→    if (sg.timeline_frame == null || sg.timeline_frame < 0) continue;
   245→    const update = uniqueUpdates.get(sg.id);
   246→    const finalFrame = update ? update.newFrame : sg.timeline_frame;
   247→    allFinalPositions.push({ id: sg.id, frame: finalFrame });
   248→  }
   249→
   250→  allFinalPositions.sort((a, b) => a.frame - b.frame);
   251→
   252→  if (allFinalPositions.length === 0) return uniqueUpdates;
   253→
   254→  const normalizedUpdates = normalizePositions(allFinalPositions);
   255→
   256→  // Merge normalized updates into uniqueUpdates
   257→  for (const [id, payload] of normalizedUpdates) {
   258→    const existing = uniqueUpdates.get(id);
   259→    if (existing) {
   260→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, { newFrame: payload.newFrame, reason: `${existing.reason} → ${payload.reason}` });
   261→    } else {
   262→      uniqueUpdates.set(id, payload);
   263→    }
   264→  }
   265→
   266→  return uniqueUpdates;
   267→}
   268→

   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {

   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );
   317→  const segmentRegenerationMode = hasPairShotGenerationId
   318→    ? 'segment_regen_from_pair'
   319→    : 'segment_regen_from_order';
   320→  const generationRouting = params.child_generation_id
   321→    ? 'variant_child'
   322→    : 'child_generation';
   323→
   324→  const familyContract = buildIndividualSegmentFamilyContract({
   325→    segmentRegenerationMode,

   328→    hasEndImage: Boolean(params.end_image_url),

    17→

   116→export function derivePrompt(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
