   204→/**
   205→ * LoRA info extracted from task params
   206→ */
   207→interface LoraInfo {
   208→  url: string;
   209→  strength: number;
   210→  displayName: string;
   211→}
   212→
   213→/**
   214→ * Extract LoRAs from task params (checks multiple locations)
   215→ */
   216→export function extractLoras(parsedParams: Record<string, unknown>): LoraInfo[] {
   217→  const params = parsedParams;
   218→  const orchestratorDetails = asRecord(params.orchestrator_details);
   219→  const orchestratorPayload = asRecord(params.full_orchestrator_payload);
   220→
   221→  // Check for array format (image edit tasks use this)
   222→  const lorasArray = params.loras || orchestratorDetails?.loras || orchestratorPayload?.loras;
   223→  if (Array.isArray(lorasArray) && lorasArray.length > 0) {
   224→    return lorasArray
   225→      .map((lora): LoraInfo | null => {
   226→        const loraRecord = asRecord(lora);
   227→        if (!loraRecord) return null;
   228→        const url = asString(loraRecord.url) ?? '';
   229→        const parsedStrength = toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.strength) ?? toFiniteNumber(loraRecord.multiplier) ?? 1;
   230→        return {
   231→          url,
   232→          strength: parsedStrength,
   233→          displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   234→        };
   235→      })
   236→      .filter((lora): lora is LoraInfo => lora !== null);
   237→  }
   238→
   239→  // Check for object format (video tasks use additional_loras)
   240→  const additionalLoras = params.additional_loras || orchestratorDetails?.additional_loras || orchestratorPayload?.additional_loras;
   241→  if (additionalLoras && typeof additionalLoras === 'object' && Object.keys(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).length > 0) {
   242→    return Object.entries(additionalLoras as Record<string, unknown>).map(([url, strength]) => ({
   243→      url,
   244→      strength: toFiniteNumber(strength) ?? 1,
   245→      displayName: extractLoraDisplayName(url),
   246→    }));
   247→  }
   248→
   249→  return [];
   250→}
   251→
   252→function extractLoraDisplayName(url: string): string {
   253→  const fileName = url.split('/').pop() || 'Unknown';
   254→  return fileName.replace(/\.(safetensors|ckpt|pt)$/i, '').replace(/_/g, ' ');
   255→}
   256→
   257→const TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   258→  'individualSegmentParams',
   259→  'taskViewContract',
   260→  'familyContract',
   261→  'rawParams',
   262→];
   263→
   264→const TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   265→  'taskViewContract',
   266→  'familyContract',
   267→  'orchestratorDetails',
   268→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   269→  'rawParams',
   270→];
   271→
   272→const TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER: TravelPayloadSource[] = [
   273→  'taskViewContract',
   274→  'familyContract',
   275→  'individualSegmentParams',
   276→  'orchestratorDetails',
   277→  'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   278→  'rawParams',
   279→];
   280→
   281→function dedupeTruthyStrings(values: Array<string | undefined>): string[] {
   282→  return Array.from(new Set(values.filter((value): value is string => typeof value === 'string' && value.length > 0)));
   283→}
   284→
   285→function isTravelTaskParams(params: Record<string, unknown>): boolean {
   286→  const familyContract = asRecord(params.task_family_contract);
   287→  return (
   288→    params.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   289→    || familyContract?.task_family === 'travel_between_images'
   290→    || params.orchestrator_details !== undefined
   291→    || params.full_orchestrator_payload !== undefined
   292→    || params.individual_segment_params !== undefined
   293→    || Array.isArray(params.image_urls)
   294→    || Array.isArray(params.input_image_paths_resolved)
   295→  );
   296→}
   297→
   298→function deriveTravelInputImages(params: Record<string, unknown>): string[] {
   299→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   300→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   301→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   302→
   303→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   304→    const segmentInputImages = reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   305→    if (segmentInputImages && segmentInputImages.length > 0) {
   306→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(segmentInputImages);
   307→    }
   308→
   309→    const startImage = reader.pickString('start_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   310→    const endImage = reader.pickString('end_image_url', TRAVEL_SEGMENT_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER);
   311→    return dedupeTruthyStrings([startImage, endImage]);
   312→  }
   313→
   314→  const timelineSources = [
   315→    reader.pickStringArray('input_images', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   316→    reader.pickStringArray('input_image_paths_resolved', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   317→    reader.pickStringArray('image_urls', TRAVEL_TIMELINE_IMAGE_SOURCE_ORDER),
   318→  ];
   319→  for (const candidate of timelineSources) {
   320→    if (candidate && candidate.length > 0) {
   321→      return dedupeTruthyStrings(candidate);
   322→    }
   323→  }
   324→
   325→  return [];
   326→}
   327→
   328→function deriveTravelPrompt(params: Record<string, unknown>): string | null {
   329→  const snapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params);
   330→  const reader = createTravelPayloadReader(snapshot);
   331→  const segmentIndex = toIntegerOrNull(params.segment_index);
   332→  const isSegmentTask = params.segment_index !== undefined;
   333→
   334→  if (isSegmentTask) {
   335→    const enhancedPromptsExpanded = reader.pickStringArray('enhanced_prompts_expanded', [
   336→      'orchestratorDetails',
   337→      'fullOrchestratorPayload',
   338→      'rawParams',
   339→    ]);
   340→    const enhancedPrompt = pickFirstString(
   341→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   342→      segmentIndex === null ? undefined : enhancedPromptsExpanded?.[segmentIndex],
   343→    );
   344→    if (enhancedPrompt) {
   345→      return enhancedPrompt;
   346→    }
   347→
   348→    return (
   349→      pickFirstString(
   350→        reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   351→        reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   352→      ) ?? null
   353→    );
   354→  }
   355→
   356→  return (
   357→    pickFirstString(
   358→      reader.pickString('prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   359→      reader.pickString('base_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   360→      reader.pickString('enhanced_prompt', TRAVEL_PROMPT_SOURCE_ORDER),
   361→    ) ?? null
   362→  );
   363→}
   364→
   365→function toIntegerOrNull(value: unknown): number | null {
   366→  const numeric = toFiniteNumber(value);
   367→  if (numeric === null || !Number.isInteger(numeric)) return null;
   368→  return numeric;
   369→}
   370→
   371→function toFiniteNumber(value: unknown): number | null {
   372→  const numeric = typeof value === 'number' ? value : Number(value);
   373→  return Number.isFinite(numeric) ? numeric : null;
   374→}

    16→interface UseShareActionsReturn {

    25→
    26→export function useShareActions(shareSlug: string): UseShareActionsReturn {
    27→  const navigate = useNavigate();
    28→  const [isAuthenticated, setIsAuthenticated] = useState(false);
    29→  const [isCopying, setIsCopying] = useState(false);
    30→  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);
    31→  const [showProjectSelector, setShowProjectSelector] = useState(false);
    32→
    33→  const checkAuth = useCallback(async () => {
    34→    const { data: { session } } = await supabase().auth.getSession();
    35→    setIsAuthenticated(!!session);
    36→  }, []);
    37→
    38→  const handleCopyToAccount = useCallback(() => {
    39→    if (!isAuthenticated) {
    40→      sessionStorage.setItem('pending_share', shareSlug);
    41→      toast({
    42→        title: "Sign in required",
    43→        description: "Please sign in to copy this to your account"
    44→      });
    45→      navigate('/?action=copy-share');
    46→      return;
    47→    }
    48→    setShowProjectSelector(true);
    49→  }, [isAuthenticated, shareSlug, navigate]);
    50→
    51→  const checkPendingShare = useCallback(() => {
    52→    const pendingShare = sessionStorage.getItem('pending_share');
    53→    if (pendingShare) {
    54→      sessionStorage.removeItem('pending_share');
    55→      handleCopyToAccount();
    56→    }
    57→  }, [handleCopyToAccount]);
    58→
    59→  // Check authentication status and subscribe to auth changes
    60→  useEffect(() => {
    61→    checkAuth();
    62→
    63→    const { data: { subscription } } = supabase().auth.onAuthStateChange((event, session) => {
    64→      setIsAuthenticated(!!session);
    65→      if (event === 'SIGNED_IN') {
    66→        checkPendingShare();
    67→      }
    68→    });
    69→
    70→    return () => {
    71→      subscription.unsubscribe();
    72→    };
    73→  }, [checkAuth, checkPendingShare]);
    74→
    75→  const handleProjectSelected = useCallback(async (projectId: string) => {
    76→    setShowProjectSelector(false);
    77→    setIsCopying(true);
    78→
    79→    try {
    80→      const { error: copyError } = await supabase().rpc('copy_shot_from_share', {
    81→        share_slug_param: shareSlug,
    82→        target_project_id: projectId,
    83→      });
    84→
    85→      if (copyError) {
    86→        console.error('[SharedGenerationView] Failed to copy shot:', copyError);
    87→        toast({
    88→          title: "Copy failed",
    89→          description: copyError.message || "Failed to copy shot to your project",
    90→          variant: "destructive"
    91→        });
    92→        setIsCopying(false);
    93→        return;
    94→      }
    95→
    96→      setCopied(true);
    97→      toast({
    98→        title: "Copied to your account!",
    99→        description: "The shot has been added to your project"
   100→      });
   101→
   102→      setTimeout(() => {
   103→        navigate('/tools/travel-between-images');
   104→      }, 1500);
   105→
   106→    } catch (error) {
   107→      console.error('[SharedGenerationView] Unexpected error:', error);
   108→      toast({
   109→        title: "Something went wrong",
   110→        description: "Please try again",
   111→        variant: "destructive"
   112→      });
   113→      setIsCopying(false);
   114→    }
   115→  }, [shareSlug, navigate]);
   116→
   117→  return {
   118→    isAuthenticated,
   119→    isCopying,
   120→    copied,
   121→    showProjectSelector,
   122→    setShowProjectSelector,
   123→    handleCopyToAccount,
   124→    handleProjectSelected,
   125→  };
   126→}

1→# Auth System
     2→
     3→**Purpose**: Document non-obvious auth behavior -- state management, token lifecycle, route protection, and edge function authentication.
     4→
     5→**Source of Truth**: `src/shared/contexts/AuthContext.tsx`, `src/integrations/supabase/auth/AuthStateManager.ts`, `src/app/Layout.tsx`
     6→
     7→## Architecture Overview
     8→
     9→| Layer | File | Role |
    10→|---|---|---|
    11→| Supabase client | `src/integrations/supabase/client.ts` | Creates client with `autoRefreshToken`, `persistSession`, `detectSessionInUrl` enabled |
    12→| Auth state manager | `src/integrations/supabase/auth/AuthStateManager.ts` | Single `onAuthStateChange` listener on `window.__AUTH_MANAGER__`; fans out to subscribers |
    13→| Auth context | `src/shared/contexts/AuthContext.tsx` | Exposes `{ userId, isAuthenticated }` via `useAuth()` |
    14→| Route guard | `src/app/Layout.tsx` | Redirects unauthenticated users to `/home` |
    15→| Sign-in | `src/pages/Home/HomePage.tsx` | Discord OAuth only (`signInWithOAuth`) |
    16→| Sign-out | `src/shared/components/SettingsModal/SettingsModal.tsx` | `supabase.auth.signOut()` |
    17→
    18→## AuthStateManager (centralized listener)
    19→
    20→Initialized in `client.ts` at startup. Attaches the **only** `onAuthStateChange` listener on the Supabase client. All other consumers (`AuthContext`, `Layout`) subscribe via `window.__AUTH_MANAGER__.subscribe(id, callback)` instead of calling `onAuthStateChange` directly. Each subscriber gets `(event, session)`.
    21→
    22→On `SIGNED_IN`, the manager also:
    23→1. Calls `realtime.setAuth(access_token)` to update the realtime channel token.
    24→2. After a 1s delay, triggers a high-priority reconnect via `ReconnectScheduler` (debounced to 5s to avoid repeated heals).
    25→
    26→Fallback: if `window.__AUTH_MANAGER__` is missing, both `AuthContext` and `Layout` fall back to direct `onAuthStateChange`.
    27→
    28→## AuthContext event debouncing
    29→
    30→`AuthContext` does **not** process auth events immediately. It debounces with a 150ms window (`[AuthDebounce]`), batching rapid duplicate events (common on mobile tab resume). Only the **last** event in a burst is processed, wrapped in `React.startTransition`. Duplicate detection compares `(event, userId)` tuples.
    31→
    32→On unmount, any pending debounced event is flushed synchronously to avoid lost state.
    33→
    34→## Route protection
    35→
    36→- **`Layout` component** is the auth guard. It calls `getSession()` on mount and subscribes to auth changes. Three states:
    37→  - `session === undefined` -- loading spinner (`ReighLoading`)
    38→  - `session === null` -- `<Navigate to="/home" replace state={{ fromProtected: true }} />`
    39→  - `session` exists -- render children via `<Outlet />`
    40→- **`/home` and `/`** are outside `Layout`, so they are public.
    41→- **`authRedirectLoader`** on `/` (web env only): logged-in users are redirected to `/tools/travel-between-images`.
    42→- Other public routes outside `Layout`: `/payments/*`, `/share/:shareId`.
    43→
    44→## Token handling for Edge Functions
    45→
    46→Edge functions receive the JWT via explicit `Authorization: Bearer` header. The pattern (see `src/shared/lib/taskCreation.ts`):
    47→1. Call `supabase.auth.getSession()` to get current session.
    48→2. If no session, throw `AuthError` with `{ needsLogin: true }`.
    49→3. Pass `session.access_token` as `Authorization: Bearer ${token}` in `supabase.functions.invoke()`.
    50→
    51→The Supabase client auto-refreshes tokens (`autoRefreshToken: true`), so `getSession()` returns a valid token as long as the refresh token hasn't expired.
    52→
    53→## Personal Access Tokens (PATs)
    54→
    55→Used by local generators (not for browser auth). Managed via `useApiTokens` hook (`src/shared/hooks/useApiTokens.ts`), stored in `user_api_tokens` table. Generated/revoked via `generate-pat` and `revoke-pat` edge functions.
    56→
    57→## Dev auto-login
    58→
    59→In dev environments, `maybeAutoLogin` (`src/integrations/supabase/dev/autoLogin.ts`) calls `signInWithPassword` using `VITE_DEV_USER_EMAIL` / `VITE_DEV_USER_PASSWORD` env vars.
    60→
    61→## Key Invariants
    62→
    63→1. **One listener rule**: Only `AuthStateManager` should call `onAuthStateChange`. All other code subscribes through `window.__AUTH_MANAGER__`.
    64→2. **Debounce before React state**: Auth events go through 150ms debounce in `AuthContext` to prevent cascading re-renders on mobile.
    65→3. **Realtime token sync**: `AuthStateManager.handleCoreAuth` calls `realtime.setAuth()` on every auth event -- if this breaks, realtime channels silently fail.
    66→4. **Session fetch before edge calls**: Always call `getSession()` fresh before invoking edge functions; never cache the access token.
    67→5. **Layout is the guard**: No per-route auth checks exist. If a route is a child of `Layout`, it is protected. If outside, it is public.
    68→
```

     2→ * PreloadingService - Unified coordinator for all image preloading
     3→ *
     4→ * This is the single source of truth for:
     5→ * 1. Preload queue management (network concurrency)

    35→class PreloadingService {

    42→  private queue: PreloadQueue;
    43→  private config: PreloadConfig;
    44→  private subscribers = new Set<PreloadingSubscriber>();
    45→
    46→  // Singleton
    47→  private static instance: PreloadingService | null = null;
    48→
    49→  static getInstance(): PreloadingService {
    50→    if (!PreloadingService.instance) {
    51→      PreloadingService.instance = new PreloadingService();
    52→    }
    53→    return PreloadingService.instance;
    54→  }
    55→
    56→  private constructor() {
    57→    this.config = getPreloadConfig();
    58→    this.queue = new PreloadQueue(this.config.maxConcurrent);
    59→
    60→    // Subscribe to connection status changes from DataFreshnessManager
    61→    this.subscribeToConnectionStatus();
    62→
    63→  }
    64→
    65→  /**
    66→   * Subscribe to DataFreshnessManager to track connection status.
    67→   */
    68→  private subscribeToConnectionStatus(): void {
    69→    // Get initial status
    70→    const initialDiagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    71→    this.state.isConnected = initialDiagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    72→
    73→    // Subscribe to changes
    74→    dataFreshnessManager.subscribe(() => {
    75→      const diagnostics = dataFreshnessManager.getDiagnostics();
    76→      const isConnected = diagnostics.realtimeStatus === 'connected';
    77→
    78→      if (isConnected !== this.state.isConnected) {
    79→        this.onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected);
    80→      }
    81→    });
    82→  }

    84→  // ===========================================================================
    85→  // LIFECYCLE EVENTS
    86→  // ===========================================================================
    87→
    88→  /**
    89→   * Called when the selected project changes.
    90→   * Clears all preloading state for the old project.
    91→   */
    92→  onProjectChange(projectId: string | null): void {
    93→    if (projectId === this.state.currentProjectId) {
    94→      return;
    95→    }
    96→
    97→    const previousProject = this.state.currentProjectId;
    98→
    99→    // Clear queue
   100→    this.queue.clear();
   101→
   102→    // Clear load tracker (single source of truth for what's loaded)
   103→    const clearedCount = clearAllLoadedImages('project switch');
   104→
   105→    this.state.currentProjectId = projectId;
   106→
   107→    this.emit({
   108→      type: 'project-changed',
   109→      data: { from: previousProject, to: projectId, clearedCount },
   110→    });
   111→  }
   112→
   113→  /**
   114→   * Called when generations are deleted (via realtime or mutation).
   115→   * Removes them from the load tracker.
   116→   */
   117→  onGenerationsDeleted(generationIds: string[]): void {
   118→    if (generationIds.length === 0) return;
   119→
   120→    // Remove from load tracker (the source of truth)
   121→    const clearedCount = clearLoadedImages(
   122→      generationIds.map((id) => ({ id }))
   123→    );
   124→
   125→    this.emit({
   126→      type: 'generations-deleted',
   127→      data: { ids: generationIds, clearedCount },
   128→    });
   129→  }
   130→
   131→  /**
   132→   * Called when connection status changes (from DataFreshnessManager).
   133→   * Could be used to adjust preloading strategy.
   134→   */
   135→  onConnectionStatusChange(isConnected: boolean): void {
   136→    if (isConnected === this.state.isConnected) return;
   137→
   138→    this.state.isConnected = isConnected;
   139→
   140→    // If disconnected, pause aggressive preloading
   141→    if (!isConnected) {
   142→      this.queue.clear();
   143→    }
   144→
   145→    this.emit({
   146→      type: 'connection-changed',
   147→      data: { isConnected },
   148→    });
   149→  }
   150→
   151→  /**
   152→   * Pause all preloading (e.g., when lightbox is open).
   153→   */
   154→  pause(): void {
   155→    if (this.state.isPaused) return;
   156→    this.state.isPaused = true;
   157→    this.queue.clear();
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  /**
   161→   * Resume preloading.
   162→   */
   163→  resume(): void {
   164→    if (!this.state.isPaused) return;
   165→    this.state.isPaused = false;
   166→  }
   167→
   168→  // ===========================================================================
   169→  // PRELOADING API
   170→  // ===========================================================================
   171→
   172→  /**
   173→   * Preload a batch of images.
   174→   * Uses the shared queue to avoid overwhelming the network.
   175→   */
   176→  async preloadImages(
   177→    images: PreloadableImage[],
   178→    priority: number = PRIORITY.normal
   179→  ): Promise<void> {
   180→    if (this.state.isPaused || !this.state.isConnected) {
   181→      return;
   182→    }
   183→
   184→    await preloadImages(images, this.queue, this.config, priority);
   185→
   186→    this.emit({ type: 'queue-updated' });
   187→  }
   188→
   189→  /**
   190→   * Get the current config.
   191→   */
   192→  getConfig(): PreloadConfig {
   193→    return this.config;
   194→  }
   195→
   196→  // ===========================================================================
   197→  // SUBSCRIPTION
   198→  // ===========================================================================
   199→
   200→  subscribe(callback: PreloadingSubscriber): () => void {
   201→    this.subscribers.add(callback);
   202→    return () => this.subscribers.delete(callback);
   203→  }
   204→
   205→  private emit(event: PreloadingEvent): void {
   206→    this.subscribers.forEach((callback) => {
   207→      try {
   208→        callback(event);
   209→      } catch (err) {
   210→        normalizeAndPresentError(err, { context: 'PreloadingService.subscriber', showToast: false });
   211→      }
   212→    });
   213→  }
   214→
   215→  // ===========================================================================
   216→  // DEBUGGING
   217→  // ===========================================================================
   218→
   219→  getDiagnostics(): {
   220→    state: PreloadingServiceState;
   221→    queue: { size: number; active: number };
   222→    tracker: ReturnType<typeof getLoadTrackerStats>;
   223→  } {
   224→    return {
   225→      state: { ...this.state },
   226→      queue: {
   227→        size: this.queue.size,
   228→        active: this.queue.activeCount,
   229→      },
   230→      tracker: getLoadTrackerStats(),
   231→    };
   232→  }
   233→}
   234→
   235→// =============================================================================
   236→// SINGLETON EXPORT
   237→// =============================================================================
   238→
   239→export const preloadingService = PreloadingService.getInstance();

   244→    preloadingService;
   245→}

   230→          await markOrchestratorFailed(supabase, orchestratorTaskId, 1, 1, undefined, logger);
   231→          return;
   232→        case 'unknown':
   233→          logger?.warn('Final-step status could not be classified; waiting before orchestrator completion', {
   234→            orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   235→            final_step_type: config.waitForFinalStepType,
   236→            orchestrator_run_id: orchestratorRunId,
   237→          });
   238→          return;
   239→        case 'complete':
   240→        case 'not_found':
   241→          break;
   242→      }
   243→    }
   244→    await markOrchestratorComplete(
   245→      {
   246→        supabase,
   247→        orchestratorTask,
   248→        orchestratorTaskId,
   249→        allSegments,
   250→        publicUrl,
   251→        isFinalStep: false,
   252→        supabaseUrl,
   253→        serviceKey,
   254→        logger,
   255→      },
   256→    );
   257→  } catch (error) {
   258→    throw toCompletionError(error, {
   259→      code: 'orchestrator_completion_failed',
   260→      context: 'checkOrchestratorCompletion',
   261→      recoverable: true,
   262→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Completion flow failed for task ${taskIdString}`,
   263→      metadata: {
   264→        task_id: taskIdString,
   265→        task_type: completedTask.task_type,
   266→        project_id: completedTask.project_id,
   267→      },
   268→    });
   269→  }
   270→}
   271→/**
   272→ * Find sibling segment tasks using run_id (preferred) or orchestrator_task_id (fallback)
   273→ */
   274→async function findSiblingSegments(
   275→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   276→  segmentType: string,
   277→  projectId: string,
   278→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   279→  orchestratorRunId: string | null
   280→): Promise<SegmentTask[]> {
   281→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   282→    const runIdRows = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   283→      supabase,
   284→      taskType: segmentType,
   285→      projectId,
   286→      select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   287→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   288→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   289→    });
   290→    if (runIdRows.length > 0) {
   291→      return runIdRows;
   292→    }
   293→  }
   294→  const orchestratorRows = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<SegmentTask>({
   295→    supabase,
   296→    taskType: segmentType,
   297→    projectId,
   298→    select: "id, status, generation_started_at",
   299→    orchestratorTaskId,
   300→    contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   301→  });
   302→  return orchestratorRows;
   303→}
   304→/**
   305→ * Check the status of the final stitch task for this orchestrator
   306→ */
   307→async function checkFinalStitchStatus(
   308→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   309→  finalStepType: string,
   310→  projectId: string,
   311→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   312→  orchestratorRunId: string | null,
   313→): Promise<'not_found' | 'pending' | 'complete' | 'failed' | 'unknown'> {
   314→  let finalStepTasks: Array<{ id: string; status: string }> = [];
   315→  if (orchestratorRunId) {
   316→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByRunIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   317→      supabase,
   318→      taskType: finalStepType,
   319→      projectId,
   320→      select: "id, status",
   321→      runId: orchestratorRunId,
   322→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   323→    });
   324→  }
   325→  if (finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   326→    finalStepTasks = await lookupTasksByOrchestratorIdWithFallback<{ id: string; status: string }>({
   327→      supabase,
   328→      taskType: finalStepType,
   329→      projectId,
   330→      select: "id, status",
   331→      orchestratorTaskId,
   332→      contextLabel: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   333→    });
   334→  }
   335→  if (!finalStepTasks || finalStepTasks.length === 0) {
   336→    return 'not_found';
   337→  }
   338→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => isFailureStatus(task.status))) {
   339→    return 'failed';
   340→  }
   341→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Complete')) {
   342→    return 'complete';
   343→  }
   344→  if (finalStepTasks.some((task) => task.status === 'Queued' || task.status === 'In Progress')) {
   345→    return 'pending';
   346→  }
   347→  return 'unknown';
   348→}
   349→/**
   350→ * Mark orchestrator as Failed
   351→ */
   352→async function markOrchestratorFailed(
   353→  supabase: SupabaseClient,
   354→  orchestratorTaskId: string,
   355→  failedSegments: number,
   356→  totalSegments: number,
   357→  errorMessage?: string,
   358→  logger?: {
   359→    warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   360→    error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   361→  },
   362→): Promise<void> {
   363→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   364→    .from("tasks")
   365→    .update({
   366→      status: "Failed",
   367→      error_message: errorMessage ?? `${failedSegments} of ${totalSegments} segments failed`,
   368→      generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   369→    })
   370→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   371→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   372→    .select('id');
   373→  if (updateOrchError) {
   374→    throw new CompletionError({
   375→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_failed_update_failed',
   376→      context: 'markOrchestratorFailed',
   377→      recoverable: true,
   378→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Failed`,
   379→      metadata: {
   380→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   381→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   382→          ? updateOrchError.message
   383→          : String(updateOrchError),
   384→      },
   385→      cause: updateOrchError,
   386→    });
   387→  }
   388→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   389→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   390→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already terminal while marking failed', {
   391→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   392→      failed_segments: failedSegments,
   393→      total_segments: totalSegments,
   394→    });
   395→  }
   396→}
   397→/**
   398→ * Mark orchestrator as Complete and trigger billing
   399→ */
   400→async function markOrchestratorComplete(
   401→  params: {
   402→    supabase: SupabaseClient;
   403→    orchestratorTask: OrchestratorTask;
   404→    orchestratorTaskId: string;
   405→    allSegments: SegmentTask[];
   406→    publicUrl: string;
   407→    isFinalStep: boolean;
   408→    supabaseUrl: string;
   409→    serviceKey: string;
   410→    logger?: {
   411→      warn: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   412→      error: (message: string, context?: Record<string, unknown>) => void;
   413→    };
   414→  },
   415→): Promise<void> {
   416→  const {
   417→    supabase,
   418→    orchestratorTask,
   419→    orchestratorTaskId,
   420→    allSegments,
   421→    publicUrl,
   422→    isFinalStep,
   423→    supabaseUrl,
   424→    serviceKey,
   425→    logger,
   426→  } = params;
   427→  let earliestStartTime: string | null = null;
   428→  for (const segment of allSegments) {
   429→    if (segment.generation_started_at) {
   430→      if (!earliestStartTime || segment.generation_started_at < earliestStartTime) {
   431→        earliestStartTime = segment.generation_started_at;
   432→      }
   433→    }
   434→  }
   435→  const updateData: Record<string, unknown> = {
   436→    status: "Complete",
   437→    generation_started_at: earliestStartTime || new Date().toISOString(),
   438→    generation_processed_at: new Date().toISOString()
   439→  };
   440→  if (isFinalStep) {
   441→    updateData.output_location = publicUrl;
   442→  }
   443→  const { data: updatedRows, error: updateOrchError } = await supabase
   444→    .from("tasks")
   445→    .update(updateData)
   446→    .eq("id", orchestratorTaskId)
   447→    .in("status", ["Queued", "In Progress"])
   448→    .select('id');
   449→  if (updateOrchError) {
   450→    throw new CompletionError({
   451→      code: 'orchestrator_mark_complete_update_failed',
   452→      context: 'markOrchestratorComplete',
   453→      recoverable: true,
   454→      message: `[OrchestratorComplete] Failed to mark orchestrator ${orchestratorTaskId} as Complete`,
   455→      metadata: {
   456→        orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   457→        update_error: updateOrchError instanceof Error
   458→          ? updateOrchError.message
   459→          : String(updateOrchError),
   460→      },
   461→      cause: updateOrchError,
   462→    });
   463→  }
   464→  const transitionedRows = (updatedRows ?? []) as TaskUpdateRow[];
   465→  if (transitionedRows.length === 0) {
   466→    logger?.warn('Orchestrator already in terminal status; skipping billing side effects', {
   467→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   468→    });
   469→    return;
   470→  }
   471→  const billingResult = await triggerCostCalculation({
   472→    supabaseUrl,
   473→    serviceKey,
   474→    taskId: orchestratorTaskId,
   475→    logTag: 'OrchestratorComplete',
   476→  });
   477→  const existingResultData = asObjectOrEmpty(orchestratorTask.result_data);
   478→  const billingDecision = classifyBillingOutcome(billingResult);
   479→  const billingOutcome = buildBillingOutcome(billingResult, billingDecision);
   480→  await persistBillingOutcome(
   481→    supabase,
   482→    orchestratorTaskId,
   483→    existingResultData,
   484→    billingOutcome,
   485→    billingDecision,
   486→    logger,
   487→  );
   488→  if (billingDecision.reconciliationRequired) {
   489→    logger?.warn('Billing requires reconciliation policy follow-up', {
   490→      orchestrator_task_id: orchestratorTaskId,
   491→      billing_decision: billingDecision,
   492→      billing_result: billingResult,
   493→    });
   494→  }
   495→}
   496→

   293→export function buildIndividualTravelSegmentParams(
   294→  params: IndividualTravelSegmentParams,
   295→  finalResolution: string,
   296→): Record<string, unknown> {

   298→  const orchestratorDetails = buildOrchestratorDetails(params, state, finalResolution);
   299→  const sourceSnapshot = buildTaskPayloadSnapshot(params.originalParams);
   300→  const legacyContractTaskId = extractOrchestratorTaskIdParam(params.originalParams);
   301→  const legacyRunId = extractRunIdParam(params.originalParams);
   302→  const orchestratorTaskId = resolveSnapshotOrchestratorTaskId(sourceSnapshot)
   303→    ?? legacyContractTaskId
   304→    ?? resolveStringCandidate(
   305→      asString(state.orchDetails.orchestrator_task_id),
   306→      asString(state.orig.orchestrator_task_id_ref),
   307→    );
   308→  const runId = resolveSnapshotRunId(sourceSnapshot)
   309→    ?? legacyRunId
   310→    ?? asString(state.orchDetails.run_id);
   311→
   312→  const hasPairShotGenerationId = Boolean(
   313→    params.pair_shot_generation_id
   314→    || params.start_image_variant_id
   315→    || params.end_image_variant_id,
   316→  );

Assessment written to `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/.desloppify/subagents/runs/20260307_000014/results/batch-6.json`.

**Summary of findings for abstraction_fitness (score: 72.5/100):**

The codebase has a systemic pattern of "orchestrator field forwarding" -- hooks that assemble 5-15 sub-hooks, manually destructure their returns, and repack every field into new interface shapes without adding behavior, validation, or derived state. This creates multi-layer indirection that a developer must navigate without getting anything in return.

**6 issues identified, all defects:**

1. **useInlineEditState** (469 lines) - Massive field-forwarding orchestrator with 50+ fields repacked across two layers before reaching consumers
2. **useShotEditorLayoutPayloadModel** (340 lines) - Forwards ~90 fields through nested parameter bags with minimal transformation
3. **useVideoEditPanelModel** - Pure field-renaming useMemo with 30-item dependency array and zero computation
4. **useSharedLightboxState** (520 lines) - Triple-layer repacking chain (interaction -> presentation -> final return) that renames fields without adding logic
5. **BatchMagicEditTaskParams** - Duplicates all 17 fields of MagicEditTaskParams instead of using TypeScript intersection
6. **LightboxLayout model indirection** - Packs 6 context values into a model that sub-components immediately destructure, bypassing the direct context access they could use

The root cause is a pervasive pattern of orchestrator hooks that treat field remapping as abstraction. The repository layer (generationMutationsRepository, etc.) was assessed but deemed a legitimate boundary pattern.

**Summary of findings for api_surface_coherence (score: 79.5):**

The codebase has strong API coherence in several areas -- the `OperationResult` pattern is consistently applied across both frontend and edge functions, and complex prop interfaces like `SegmentSettingsFormProps` and `JoinClipsSettingsFormProps` are well-decomposed. However, five defects were identified:

1. **Invalidation parameter shape inconsistency** -- three sibling exports in `useGenerationInvalidation.ts` use three different parameter conventions for the same data (positional args, options object with ID inside, hook-returned callback).

2. **Cache utils vs mutation service param style** -- `cacheUtils.ts` uses positional params while `timelineMutationService.ts` uses options objects at the same layer boundary.

3. **Reference params casing divergence** -- `ReferenceSettingsInput` (snake_case) and `BuildReferenceParamsInput` (camelCase) represent the same conceptual data with opposite conventions in the same file.

4. **Error normalization API proliferation** -- four nearly-identical functions (`normalizeAndPresentError`, `normalizeAndReportError`, `normalizeAndLogError`, `normalizeAndPresentAndRethrow`) with indistinguishable names, where `normalizeAndReportError` accepts toast options it explicitly ignores.

5. **Query key vs fetch nullability mismatch** -- `buildParentGenerationsQueryKey` accepts null projectId but `fetchParentGenerations` requires non-null, creating a contract gap.

Assessment complete. The JSON output has been written to `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/.desloppify/subagents/runs/20260307_000014/results/batch-15.json`.

Key findings for the **initialization_coupling** dimension (score: 79.5/100):

1. **Edge function SDK initialization at module scope** - `ai-prompt` and `ai-voice-prompt` create Groq/OpenAI clients at import time with potentially undefined API keys, logging errors but proceeding anyway.

2. **debugConfig.ts import-time side effects** - Reads 14 env vars at module scope and attaches to `window` at import time, inconsistent with the explicit registration pattern used elsewhere (debugRegistry, DataFreshnessManager).

3. **settingsWriteQueue implicit boot-order dependency** - Requires `setSettingsWriteFunction()` to be called before first use, but silently swallows the error if it hasn't been called.

4. **projectSelectionStore localStorage read at import** - Reads localStorage synchronously during module initialization.

The codebase does several things well: the Supabase client uses a proper lazy singleton with explicit bootstrap, env config uses lazy getters, and most singletons (DataFreshnessManager, RealtimeEventProcessor) have no cross-module ordering dependencies. The issues are localized rather than systemic.

    10→/**

    14→export const GoldSpotlight: React.FC = () => {

The authorization_consistency review is complete. Here is a summary:

**Score: 88.5/100** -- The codebase has strong, well-centralized auth patterns.

**Key strengths observed:**
- All 32 edge functions use the shared `bootstrapEdgeHandler` with centralized `authenticateRequest` from `_shared/auth.ts`
- RLS is enabled on all key database tables
- A shared `taskActorPolicy.ts` provides reusable ownership verification for task-scoped operations
- The `authenticateRequest` function correctly rejects service_role JWTs from the user-auth path

- Service-role-only endpoints consistently use `requireServiceRole: true`

2. **Redundant early auth guards** -- Seven functions check for the authorization header before `bootstrapEdgeHandler`, which already handles this, creating inconsistent error response formats (plain text vs structured JSON)

The review is complete. Here is a summary of what was done:

**Dimension evaluated:** error_consistency (score: 74.5/100)

**Key findings:**

The codebase has a well-designed centralized error handling system (`AppError` hierarchy, `normalizeAndPresentError`, `OperationResult`), but adoption is uneven, resulting in mixed strategies that make error behavior hard to predict.

**6 issues identified:**

1. **dual_toast_systems** - Two toast import paths coexist (19 files on legacy `ui/toast`, 67 on `ui/runtime/sonner`), splitting error presentation across incompatible APIs.

2. **share_actions_bypasses_error_system** - `useShareActions.ts` uses `console.error` + raw `toast()` instead of `normalizeAndPresentError`, losing error categorization.

3. **apply_settings_bypasses_error_system** - `useApplySettingsHandler.ts` has a pointless catch-rethrow wrapper and bypasses `normalizeAndPresentError` in its outer catch.

4. **huggingface_upload_bespoke_result** - `useHuggingFaceUpload.ts` uses an ad-hoc `{success, error}` type instead of the codebase's `OperationResult`, flattening error metadata to bare strings.

5. **silent_auto_topup_errors** - `useAutoTopupState.ts` silently reverts optimistic updates on error with no user notification.

6. **mixed_error_contracts_lightbox_actions** - Lightbox action hooks have inconsistent contracts: some catch-and-rethrow, others return false, others swallow errors silently.

**Output written to:** `/Users/user_c042661f/Documents/reigh/.desloppify/subagents/runs/20260307_000014/results/batch-4.json`

                       {show,queue,reset,reorder,describe,note,skip,unskip,reopen,resolve,focus,cluster,triage,scan-gate,commit-log}
                       ...

Manage the living plan — a persistent layer on top of the work queue.
Track custom ordering, clusters, skips, and per-issue annotations.
Run with no subcommand to generate a full prioritized markdown plan.

positional arguments:
  {show,queue,reset,reorder,describe,note,skip,unskip,reopen,resolve,focus,cluster,triage,scan-gate,commit-log}
    show                Show plan metadata summary
    queue               Compact table of upcoming queue items
    reset               Reset plan to empty
    reorder             Reposition issues in the queue
    describe            Set augmented description
    note                Set note on issues
    skip                Skip issues: temporary (default), --permanent
                        (wontfix), or --false-positive
    unskip              Bring skipped issues back to queue (reopens
                        permanent/fp in state)
    reopen              Reopen resolved issues and move back to queue
    resolve             Mark issues as fixed (shows score movement + next
                        step)
    focus               Set or clear active cluster focus
    cluster             Manage issue clusters
    triage              Staged triage workflow for review issues
    scan-gate           Check or skip the scan requirement for workflow items
    commit-log          Track commits and resolved issues for PR updates

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --state STATE         Path to state file
  --output FILE         Write to file instead of stdout (refuses to overwrite
                        existing files)

typical workflow:
  desloppify scan                       # detect issues
  desloppify plan                       # full prioritized markdown
  desloppify plan queue                 # compact table of all items
  desloppify plan cluster create ...    # group related issues
  desloppify plan focus <cluster>       # narrow scope
  desloppify next                       # work on the next item
  desloppify plan resolve <id> --attest .. # mark as fixed

patterns (used by reorder, skip, resolve, describe, note, etc.):
  Patterns match issues by detector, file, ID prefix, glob, or name.
  Cluster names also work as patterns — they expand to all member IDs.
  Examples: "security", "src/foo.py", "unused::*React*", "my-cluster"

subcommands:
  show       Show plan metadata summary
  queue      Compact table of upcoming queue items
  reset      Reset plan to empty
  reorder    Reposition issues or clusters in the queue
  resolve    Mark issues as fixed (score movement + next-step)
  describe   Set augmented description
  note       Set note on issues
  skip       Skip issues (temporary/permanent/false_positive)
  unskip     Bring skipped issues back to queue
  reopen     Reopen resolved issues
  focus      Set or clear active cluster focus
  cluster    Manage issue clusters
  triage     Staged triage workflow (after review)
  scan-gate  Check or skip scan requirement for workflow items

1→import { useSyncExternalStore } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type Listener = () => void;
     4→
     5→let openCount = 0;
     6→const listeners = new Set<Listener>();
     7→
     8→function notifyListeners(): void {
     9→  listeners.forEach((listener) => listener());
    10→}
    11→
    12→function getSnapshot(): boolean {
    13→  return openCount > 0;
    14→}
    15→
    16→function subscribe(listener: Listener): () => void {
    17→  listeners.add(listener);
    18→  return () => {
    19→    listeners.delete(listener);
    20→  };
    21→}
    22→
    23→export function acquireLightboxOpenState(): () => void {
    24→  openCount += 1;
    25→  notifyListeners();
    26→
    27→  let released = false;
    28→  return () => {
    29→    if (released) {
    30→      return;
    31→    }
    32→    released = true;
    33→    openCount = Math.max(0, openCount - 1);
    34→    notifyListeners();
    35→  };
    36→}
    37→
    38→export function useLightboxOpenState(): boolean {
    39→  return useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, getSnapshot, getSnapshot);
    40→}
    41→
    42→function __resetLightboxOpenStateForTests(): void {
    43→  openCount = 0;
    44→  notifyListeners();
    45→}
    46→

   135→function buildMagicEditTaskParams(
   136→  params: MagicEditTaskParams,
   137→  finalResolution: string

   139→  // Build the task params in the format expected by image_edit
   140→  const taskParams: Record<string, unknown> = {

   145→    qwen_edit_model: params.qwen_edit_model ?? 'qwen-edit',
   146→    enable_sync_mode: params.enable_sync_mode ?? false,
   147→    max_wait_seconds: params.max_wait_seconds ?? 300,
   148→    enable_base64_output: params.enable_base64_output ?? false,
   149→  };
   150→
   151→  // Add optional parameters if provided
   152→  if (params.negative_prompt) {
   153→    taskParams.negative_prompt = params.negative_prompt;
   154→  }
   155→
   156→  if (params.in_scene !== undefined) {
   157→    taskParams.in_scene = params.in_scene;
   158→  }
   159→
   160→  // Add resolution if needed (some edit models may use this)
   161→  if (finalResolution && finalResolution !== "custom") {
   162→    taskParams.resolution = finalResolution;
   163→  }
   164→
   165→  // Always add add_in_position as false for magic edit tasks (unpositioned by default)
   166→  taskParams.add_in_position = false;

   195→async function createMagicEditTask(params: MagicEditTaskParams): Promise<TaskCreationResult> {
   196→  return runTaskCreationPipeline({

   207→

   210→        taskType: "qwen_image_edit",
   211→        params: taskParams,
   212→      });

    37→  | { type: 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG'; config: PhaseConfig }
    38→  | { type: 'UPDATE_PHASE_CONFIG_FIELD'; field: keyof PhaseConfig; value: PhaseConfig[keyof PhaseConfig] }
    39→  | { type: 'UPDATE_PHASE'; phaseIdx: number; updates: Partial<PhaseConfig['phases'][0]> }
    40→  | { type: 'UPDATE_PHASE_LORA'; phaseIdx: number; loraIdx: number; updates: Partial<{ url: string; multiplier: string }> }
    41→  | { type: 'ADD_LORA_TO_PHASE'; phaseIdx: number; url: string; multiplier: string }
    42→  | { type: 'REMOVE_LORA_FROM_PHASE'; phaseIdx: number; loraIdx: number }
    43→  | { type: 'SET_GENERATION_TYPE_MODE'; mode: 'i2v' | 'vace' }
    44→  | { type: 'SET_SUBMISSION_STATE'; isSubmitting: boolean }
    45→  | { type: 'RESET_FORM'; defaultIsPublic: boolean; phaseConfig: PhaseConfig };
    46→function formReducer(state: FormState, action: FormAction): FormState {
    47→  switch (action.type) {
    48→    case 'SET_FORM_FIELD':
    49→      return { ...state, fields: { ...state.fields, [action.field]: action.value } };
    50→    case 'SET_FORM_FIELDS':
    51→      return { ...state, fields: { ...state.fields, ...action.fields } };
    52→    case 'SET_ALL_FORM_FIELDS':
    53→      return { ...state, fields: action.fields };
    54→    case 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG':
    55→      return { ...state, editablePhaseConfig: action.config };
    56→    case 'UPDATE_PHASE_CONFIG_FIELD':
    57→      return {
    58→        ...state,
    59→        editablePhaseConfig: {
    60→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
    61→          [action.field]: action.value,
    62→        },
    63→      };
    64→    case 'UPDATE_PHASE':
    65→      return {
    66→        ...state,
    67→        editablePhaseConfig: {
    68→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
    69→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((phase, index) =>
    70→            index === action.phaseIdx ? { ...phase, ...action.updates } : phase,
    71→          ),
    72→        },
    73→      };
    74→    case 'UPDATE_PHASE_LORA':
    75→      return {
    76→        ...state,
    77→        editablePhaseConfig: {
    78→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
    79→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((phase, phaseIndex) => {
    80→            if (phaseIndex !== action.phaseIdx) {
    81→              return phase;
    82→            }
    83→            return {
    84→              ...phase,
    85→              loras: phase.loras.map((lora, loraIndex) =>
    86→                loraIndex === action.loraIdx ? { ...lora, ...action.updates } : lora,
    87→              ),
    88→            };
    89→          }),
    90→        },
    91→      };
    92→    case 'ADD_LORA_TO_PHASE':
    93→      return {
    94→        ...state,
    95→        editablePhaseConfig: {
    96→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
    97→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((phase, phaseIndex) => {
    98→            if (phaseIndex !== action.phaseIdx) {
    99→              return phase;
   100→            }
   101→            return {
   102→              ...phase,
   103→              loras: [
   104→                ...phase.loras.filter((lora) => lora.url?.trim()),
   105→                { url: action.url, multiplier: action.multiplier },
   106→              ],
   107→            };
   108→          }),
   109→        },
   110→      };
   111→    case 'REMOVE_LORA_FROM_PHASE':
   112→      return {
   113→        ...state,
   114→        editablePhaseConfig: {
   115→          ...state.editablePhaseConfig,
   116→          phases: state.editablePhaseConfig.phases.map((phase, phaseIndex) => {
   117→            if (phaseIndex !== action.phaseIdx) {
   118→              return phase;
   119→            }
   120→            return {
   121→              ...phase,
   122→              loras: phase.loras.filter((_, loraIndex) => loraIndex !== action.loraIdx),
   123→            };
   124→          }),
   125→        },
   126→      };
   127→    case 'SET_GENERATION_TYPE_MODE':
   128→      return { ...state, generationTypeMode: action.mode };
   129→    case 'SET_SUBMISSION_STATE':
   130→      return { ...state, isSubmitting: action.isSubmitting };
   131→    case 'RESET_FORM':
   132→      return {
   133→        ...state,
   134→        fields: {
   135→          name: '',
   136→          description: '',
   137→          created_by_is_you: true,
   138→          created_by_username: '',
   139→          is_public: action.defaultIsPublic,
   140→          basePrompt: '',
   141→          negativePrompt: '',
   142→          textBeforePrompts: '',
   143→          textAfterPrompts: '',
   144→          enhancePrompt: false,
   145→          durationFrames: 60,
   146→        },
   147→        editablePhaseConfig: action.phaseConfig,
   148→      };
   149→    default:
   150→      return state;
   151→  }
   152→}
   153→function createAddPresetTabInitialState(
   154→  editingPreset: AddNewTabProps['editingPreset'],
   155→  isOverwriting: boolean,
   156→  currentPhaseConfig: PhaseConfig | undefined,
   157→  currentSettings: AddNewTabProps['currentSettings'],
   158→  initialGenerationTypeMode: 'i2v' | 'vace',
   159→  defaultIsPublic: boolean,
   160→): FormState {
   161→  const generationTypeMode = editingPreset?.metadata?.generationTypeMode && !isOverwriting
   162→    ? editingPreset.metadata.generationTypeMode
   163→    : initialGenerationTypeMode;
   164→  const editablePhaseConfig = editingPreset?.metadata?.phaseConfig && !isOverwriting
   165→    ? editingPreset.metadata.phaseConfig
   166→    : currentPhaseConfig || DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG;
   167→  return {
   168→    fields: {
   169→      name: generatePresetName(),
   170→      description: '',
   171→      created_by_is_you: true,
   172→      created_by_username: '',
   173→      is_public: defaultIsPublic,
   174→      basePrompt: currentSettings?.basePrompt || '',
   175→      negativePrompt: currentSettings?.negativePrompt || '',
   176→      textBeforePrompts: currentSettings?.textBeforePrompts || '',
   177→      textAfterPrompts: currentSettings?.textAfterPrompts || '',
   178→      enhancePrompt: currentSettings?.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   179→      durationFrames: currentSettings?.durationFrames || 60,
   180→    },
   181→    editablePhaseConfig,
   182→    generationTypeMode,
   183→    isSubmitting: false,
   184→  };
   185→}
   186→export function useAddNewPresetTabController({
   187→  createResource,
   188→  updateResource,
   189→  onSwitchToBrowse,
   190→  currentPhaseConfig,
   191→  editingPreset,
   192→  onClearEdit,
   193→  currentSettings,
   194→  isOverwriting = false,
   195→  generationTypeMode: initialGenerationTypeMode = 'i2v',
   196→  defaultIsPublic,
   197→}: AddNewTabProps) {
   198→  const isEditMode = Boolean(editingPreset);
   199→  const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
   200→    formReducer,
   201→    {
   202→      editingPreset,
   203→      isOverwriting,
   204→      currentPhaseConfig,
   205→      currentSettings,
   206→      initialGenerationTypeMode,
   207→      defaultIsPublic,
   208→    },
   209→    (args) => createAddPresetTabInitialState(
   210→      args.editingPreset,
   211→      args.isOverwriting,
   212→      args.currentPhaseConfig,
   213→      args.currentSettings,
   214→      args.initialGenerationTypeMode,
   215→      args.defaultIsPublic,
   216→    ),
   217→  );
   218→  const { fields: addForm, editablePhaseConfig, generationTypeMode, isSubmitting } = state;
   219→  const sampleFilesHook = usePresetSampleFiles();
   220→  const updatePhaseConfig = useCallback(
   221→    <K extends keyof PhaseConfig>(field: K, value: PhaseConfig[K]) => {
   222→      dispatch({ type: 'UPDATE_PHASE_CONFIG_FIELD', field, value });
   223→    },
   224→    [],
   225→  );
   226→  const updatePhase = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, updates: Partial<PhaseConfig['phases'][0]>) => {
   227→    dispatch({ type: 'UPDATE_PHASE', phaseIdx, updates });
   228→  }, []);
   229→  const updatePhaseLora = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, loraIdx: number, updates: Partial<{ url: string; multiplier: string }>) => {
   230→    dispatch({ type: 'UPDATE_PHASE_LORA', phaseIdx, loraIdx, updates });
   231→  }, []);
   232→  const addLoraToPhase = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, url: string = '', multiplier: string = '1.0') => {
   233→    dispatch({ type: 'ADD_LORA_TO_PHASE', phaseIdx, url, multiplier });
   234→  }, []);
   235→  const removeLoraFromPhase = useCallback((phaseIdx: number, loraIdx: number) => {
   236→    dispatch({ type: 'REMOVE_LORA_FROM_PHASE', phaseIdx, loraIdx });
   237→  }, []);
   238→  const resetForm = useCallback(() => {
   239→    dispatch({
   240→      type: 'RESET_FORM',
   241→      defaultIsPublic,
   242→      phaseConfig: currentPhaseConfig || DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG,
   243→    });
   244→    sampleFilesHook.resetSampleFiles();
   245→  }, [currentPhaseConfig, defaultIsPublic, sampleFilesHook]);
   246→  useEffect(() => {
   247→    if (editingPreset?.metadata?.phaseConfig) {
   248→      if (!isOverwriting) {
   249→        dispatch({ type: 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG', config: editingPreset.metadata.phaseConfig });
   250→        if (editingPreset.metadata.generationTypeMode) {
   251→          dispatch({ type: 'SET_GENERATION_TYPE_MODE', mode: editingPreset.metadata.generationTypeMode });
   252→        }
   253→      } else {
   254→        dispatch({ type: 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG', config: currentPhaseConfig || DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG });
   255→        dispatch({ type: 'SET_GENERATION_TYPE_MODE', mode: initialGenerationTypeMode });
   256→      }
   257→    } else if (currentPhaseConfig) {
   258→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG', config: currentPhaseConfig });
   259→    } else {
   260→      dispatch({ type: 'SET_PHASE_CONFIG', config: DEFAULT_PHASE_CONFIG });
   261→    }
   262→  }, [editingPreset, isOverwriting, currentPhaseConfig, initialGenerationTypeMode]);
   263→  useEffect(() => {
   264→    if (!editingPreset && currentSettings) {
   265→      dispatch({
   266→        type: 'SET_FORM_FIELDS',
   267→        fields: {
   268→          name: generatePresetName(),
   269→          basePrompt: currentSettings.basePrompt || '',
   270→          negativePrompt: currentSettings.negativePrompt || '',
   271→          textBeforePrompts: currentSettings.textBeforePrompts || '',
   272→          textAfterPrompts: currentSettings.textAfterPrompts || '',
   273→          enhancePrompt: currentSettings.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   274→          durationFrames: currentSettings.durationFrames || 60,
   275→        },
   276→      });
   277→      if (currentSettings.lastGeneratedVideoUrl) {
   278→        sampleFilesHook.setInitialVideo(currentSettings.lastGeneratedVideoUrl);
   279→      }
   280→    }
   281→  }, [currentSettings, editingPreset, sampleFilesHook]);
   282→  useEffect(() => {
   283→    if (editingPreset && editingPreset.metadata) {
   284→      const metadata = editingPreset.metadata;
   285→      if (isOverwriting && currentSettings) {
   286→        dispatch({
   287→          type: 'SET_ALL_FORM_FIELDS',
   288→          fields: {
   289→            name: metadata.name || '',

   291→            created_by_is_you: metadata.created_by?.is_you ?? true,
   292→            created_by_username: metadata.created_by?.username || '',
   293→            is_public: metadata.is_public ?? true,
   294→            basePrompt: currentSettings.basePrompt || '',
   295→            negativePrompt: currentSettings.negativePrompt || '',
   296→            textBeforePrompts: currentSettings.textBeforePrompts || '',
   297→            textAfterPrompts: currentSettings.textAfterPrompts || '',
   298→            enhancePrompt: currentSettings.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   299→            durationFrames: currentSettings.durationFrames || 60,
   300→          },
   301→        });
   302→        sampleFilesHook.resetSampleFiles();
   303→      } else {
   304→        dispatch({
   305→          type: 'SET_ALL_FORM_FIELDS',
   306→          fields: {
   307→            name: metadata.name || '',
   308→            description: metadata.description || '',
   309→            created_by_is_you: metadata.created_by?.is_you ?? true,
   310→            created_by_username: metadata.created_by?.username || '',
   311→            is_public: metadata.is_public ?? true,
   312→            basePrompt: metadata.basePrompt || '',
   313→            negativePrompt: metadata.negativePrompt || '',
   314→            textBeforePrompts: metadata.textBeforePrompts || '',
   315→            textAfterPrompts: metadata.textAfterPrompts || '',
   316→            enhancePrompt: metadata.enhancePrompt ?? false,
   317→            durationFrames: metadata.durationFrames || 60,
   318→          },
   319→        });
   320→      }
   321→      sampleFilesHook.resetSampleFiles();

   324→      } else if (!isOverwriting) {
   325→        sampleFilesHook.setInitialVideo(null);
   326→      }
   327→    }
   328→  }, [editingPreset, isOverwriting, currentSettings, sampleFilesHook]);
   329→  const handleFormChange = useCallback((field: string, value: string | boolean | number) => {
   330→    dispatch({ type: 'SET_FORM_FIELD', field, value });
   331→  }, []);
   332→  const handleCancelEdit = useCallback(() => {
   333→    onClearEdit();
   334→    resetForm();
   335→  }, [onClearEdit, resetForm]);
   336→  const handleSubmit = useCallback(async () => {
   337→    if (!addForm.name.trim()) {

   339→      return;
   340→    }
   341→    if (!editablePhaseConfig) {
   342→      toast.error('No phase config available to save');
   343→      return;
   344→    }
   345→    dispatch({ type: 'SET_SUBMISSION_STATE', isSubmitting: true });
   346→    try {
   347→      const uploadedSamples: Array<{ url: string; type: 'image' | 'video'; alt_text?: string }> = [];
   348→      for (const file of sampleFilesHook.sampleFiles) {
   349→        const uploadedUrl = await uploadImageToStorage(file);
   350→        uploadedSamples.push({
   351→          url: uploadedUrl,
   352→          type: file.type.startsWith('video/') ? 'video' : 'image',
   353→          alt_text: file.name,
   354→        });
   355→      }
   356→      const existingSamples = isEditMode
   357→        ? (editingPreset?.metadata.sample_generations || []).filter(
   358→            (sample) => !sampleFilesHook.deletedExistingSampleUrls.includes(sample.url),
   359→          )
   360→        : [];
   361→      const initialSample = ((!isEditMode || isOverwriting) && sampleFilesHook.initialVideoSample && !sampleFilesHook.initialVideoDeleted)
   362→        ? [{ url: sampleFilesHook.initialVideoSample, type: 'video' as const, alt_text: 'Latest video generation' }]
   363→        : [];
   364→      const finalSamples = [...initialSample, ...existingSamples, ...uploadedSamples];
   365→      let mainGeneration: string | undefined;
   366→      if ((!isEditMode || isOverwriting) && sampleFilesHook.initialVideoSample && !sampleFilesHook.initialVideoDeleted) {
   367→        mainGeneration = sampleFilesHook.initialVideoSample;
   368→      } else if (uploadedSamples.length > 0 && uploadedSamples[sampleFilesHook.mainGenerationIndex]) {
   369→        mainGeneration = uploadedSamples[sampleFilesHook.mainGenerationIndex].url;
   370→      } else if (isEditMode && editingPreset?.metadata.main_generation && !sampleFilesHook.deletedExistingSampleUrls.includes(editingPreset.metadata.main_generation)) {
   371→        mainGeneration = editingPreset.metadata.main_generation;
   372→      } else if (finalSamples.length > 0) {
   373→        mainGeneration = finalSamples[0].url;
   374→      }
   375→      const presetMetadata: PhaseConfigMetadata = {
   376→        name: addForm.name,
   377→        description: addForm.description,
   378→        phaseConfig: editablePhaseConfig,
   379→        created_by: {

   382→        },

   421→    isOverwriting,
   422→    editingPreset,
   423→    currentSettings,

   436→    isSubmitting,

   438→    handleFormChange,
   439→    updatePhaseConfig,

1→import { useEffect, useRef, useCallback, RefObject } from 'react';
     2→
     3→type EventType = 'click' | 'mousedown' | 'touchstart';
     4→
     5→interface UseClickOutsideOptions {
     6→  /** Event type(s) to listen for (default: ['mousedown']) */
     7→  events?: EventType[];
     8→  /** Whether the hook is enabled (default: true) */
     9→  enabled?: boolean;
    10→  /** Delay before attaching listeners (ms) - prevents catching the click that opened the element */
    11→  delay?: number;
    12→  /** Use capture phase for event listeners */
    13→  capture?: boolean;
    14→}
    15→
    16→/**
    17→ * Hook that calls a callback when user clicks/touches outside the referenced element.
    18→ *
    19→ * @param callback - Function to call when click outside is detected
    20→ * @param options - Configuration options
    21→ * @returns ref - Attach this to the element you want to detect clicks outside of
    22→ *
    23→ * @example
    24→ * // Basic usage - click outside to close
    25→ * const ref = useClickOutside(() => setIsOpen(false));
    26→ * return <div ref={ref}>...</div>;
    27→ *
    28→ * @example
    29→ * // With options - touch support for iPad
    30→ * const ref = useClickOutside(
    31→ *   () => setSelectedEndpoint(null),
    32→ *   { events: ['touchstart'], enabled: isTablet && selectedEndpoint !== null }
    33→ * );
    34→ *
    35→ * @example
    36→ * // With existing ref
    37→ * const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    38→ * useClickOutside(() => setIsActive(false), { enabled: isActive }, containerRef);
    39→ */
    40→export function useClickOutside<T extends HTMLElement = HTMLDivElement>(
    41→  callback: () => void,
    42→  options: UseClickOutsideOptions = {},
    43→  existingRef?: RefObject<T>
    44→): RefObject<T> {
    45→  const {
    46→    events = ['mousedown'],
    47→    enabled = true,
    48→    delay = 0,
    49→    capture = false,
    50→  } = options;
    51→
    52→  const internalRef = useRef<T>(null);
    53→  const ref = existingRef || internalRef;
    54→  const callbackRef = useRef(callback);
    55→
    56→  // Keep callback ref up to date
    57→  useEffect(() => {
    58→    callbackRef.current = callback;
    59→  }, [callback]);
    60→
    61→  const handleEvent = useCallback((event: Event) => {
    62→    if (ref.current && !ref.current.contains(event.target as Node)) {
    63→      callbackRef.current();
    64→    }
    65→  }, [ref]);
    66→
    67→  useEffect(() => {
    68→    if (!enabled) return;
    69→
    70→    const subscribe = () => {
    71→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    72→        document.addEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    73→      });
    74→    };
    75→
    76→    const unsubscribe = () => {
    77→      events.forEach((eventType) => {
    78→        document.removeEventListener(eventType, handleEvent, { capture });
    79→      });
    80→    };
    81→
    82→    // Delay subscription to avoid catching the event that triggered this state
    83→    const timeoutId = delay > 0 ? setTimeout(subscribe, delay) : null;
    84→    if (!timeoutId) subscribe();
    85→
    86→    return () => {
    87→      if (timeoutId) clearTimeout(timeoutId);
    88→      unsubscribe();
    89→    };
    90→  }, [enabled, events, handleEvent, delay, capture]);
    91→
    92→  return ref;
    93→}
    94→

    59→/** Convert pair_loras format (Array<{path, strength}>) to ActiveLora[] */
    60→function pairLorasToArray(pairLoras: NormalizedLoraPair[]): ActiveLora[] {
    61→  return pairLoras.map((lora) => {
    62→    const filename = lora.path.split('/').pop()?.replace('.safetensors', '') || lora.path;
    63→    return {
    64→      id: lora.path,

    72→function normalizeLegacyLoraRecord(value: unknown): NormalizedLoraPair[] | undefined {
    73→  if (!value || typeof value !== 'object' || Array.isArray(value)) {
    74→    return undefined;
    75→  }
    76→
    77→  const entries = Object.entries(value as Record<string, unknown>);
    78→  if (entries.length === 0) {
    79→    return undefined;
    80→  }
    81→
    82→  return entries.map(([path, strength]) => ({
    83→    path,
    84→    strength: typeof strength === 'number' ? strength : 1.0,
    85→  }));
    86→}

    88→function normalizeLoraPairArray(value: unknown): NormalizedLoraPair[] | undefined {
    89→  if (!Array.isArray(value) || value.length === 0) {
    90→    return undefined;
    91→  }
    92→
    93→  const normalized = value
    94→    .filter((entry): entry is { path?: unknown; strength?: unknown } => !!entry && typeof entry === 'object')

   133→ * Handles multiple legacy formats:

   137→ * - New loras (array format)

   139→export function extractSettingsFromParams(
   140→  params: Record<string, unknown>,
   141→  defaults?: Partial<SegmentSettings>
   142→): SegmentSettings {
   143→
   144→  // Handle nested orchestrator_details (common in task params)
   145→  const orchDetails = (params.orchestrator_details || {}) as Record<string, unknown>;
   146→
   147→  // Extract prompt: base_prompt > prompt > orchestrator > default
   148→  const prompt = (params.base_prompt ?? params.prompt ?? orchDetails.base_prompt ?? defaults?.prompt ?? '') as string;
   149→
   150→  // Extract negative prompt
   151→  const negativePrompt = (params.negative_prompt ?? orchDetails.negative_prompt ?? defaults?.negativePrompt ?? '') as string;
   152→
   153→  // Extract num_frames
   154→  const numFrames = (params.num_frames ?? orchDetails.num_frames ?? defaults?.numFrames ?? 25) as number;
   155→
   156→  // Extract seed/randomSeed
   157→  const randomSeed = (params.random_seed ?? orchDetails.random_seed ?? defaults?.randomSeed ?? true) as boolean;
   158→  const seed = (params.seed ?? orchDetails.seed ?? defaults?.seed) as number | undefined;
   159→
   160→  // Extract motion settings
   161→  const motionMode = (params.motion_mode ?? orchDetails.motion_mode ?? defaults?.motionMode ?? 'basic') as 'basic' | 'advanced';
   162→  const amountOfMotion = params.amount_of_motion != null
   163→    ? Math.round((params.amount_of_motion as number) * 100) // Convert 0-1 to 0-100
   164→    : (orchDetails.amount_of_motion != null
   165→        ? Math.round((orchDetails.amount_of_motion as number) * 100)
   166→        : (defaults?.amountOfMotion ?? 50));
   167→
   168→  // Extract phase config (only if advanced mode)
   169→  let phaseConfig: PhaseConfig | undefined = undefined;
   170→  if (motionMode === 'advanced') {
   171→    phaseConfig = (params.phase_config ?? orchDetails.phase_config ?? defaults?.phaseConfig) as PhaseConfig | undefined;
   172→    if (phaseConfig) {
   173→      phaseConfig = stripModeFromPhaseConfig(phaseConfig);
   174→    }
   175→  }
   176→
   177→  // Extract selected preset ID
   178→  const selectedPhasePresetId = (params.selected_phase_preset_id ?? orchDetails.selected_phase_preset_id ?? defaults?.selectedPhasePresetId ?? null) as string | null;
   179→
   180→  const normalizedLoraParams = normalizeLoraParams(params, orchDetails);
   181→  const loras = normalizedLoraParams
   182→    ? pairLorasToArray(normalizedLoraParams)
   183→    : (defaults?.loras ?? []);
   184→
   185→  const result = {
   186→    prompt,
   187→    negativePrompt,
   188→    motionMode,
   189→    amountOfMotion,
   190→    phaseConfig,
   191→    selectedPhasePresetId,
   192→    loras,
   193→    numFrames,
   194→    randomSeed,
   195→    seed,
   196→    makePrimaryVariant: defaults?.makePrimaryVariant ?? false,
   197→  };
   198→
   199→  return result;
   200→}

   202→// =============================================================================
   203→// BUILD METADATA UPDATE
   204→// =============================================================================
   205→
   206→/**
   207→ * Settings to save to pair metadata.
   208→ * Convention:
   209→ *   undefined = don't touch this field
   210→ *   null = explicitly clear (for nullable fields)
   211→ *   '' = explicitly clear override (for string fields)
   212→ *   value = set the override
   213→ */
   214→interface PairSettingsToSave {
   215→  prompt?: string;
   216→  negativePrompt?: string;
   217→  textBeforePrompts?: string;
   218→  textAfterPrompts?: string;
   219→  motionMode?: 'basic' | 'advanced';
   220→  amountOfMotion?: number;
   221→  phaseConfig?: PhaseConfig | null; // null means clear
   222→  loras?: ActiveLora[];
   223→  // Video settings
   224→  numFrames?: number;
   225→  randomSeed?: boolean;
   226→  seed?: number;
   227→  // UI state
   228→  selectedPhasePresetId?: string | null;
   229→  // Structure video overrides
   230→  structureMotionStrength?: number;
   231→  structureTreatment?: 'adjust' | 'clip';
   232→  structureUni3cEndPercent?: number;
   233→}
   234→
   235→type TextOverrideKey = 'prompt' | 'negativePrompt' | 'textBeforePrompts' | 'textAfterPrompts';
   236→
   237→function setTextOverride(
   238→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   239→  fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[],
   240→  key: TextOverrideKey,
   241→  value: string | undefined
   242→): void {
   243→  if (value === undefined) return;
   244→  if (value === '') {
   245→    fieldsToClear.push(key);
   246→    return;
   247→  }
   248→  overrides[key] = value;
   249→}
   250→
   251→function setNullableOverride<K extends keyof SegmentOverrides>(
   252→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   253→  fieldsToClear: K[],
   254→  key: K,
   255→  value: SegmentOverrides[K] | null | undefined
   256→): void {
   257→  if (value === undefined) return;
   258→  if (value === null) {
   259→    fieldsToClear.push(key);
   260→    return;
   261→  }
   262→  overrides[key] = value;
   263→}
   264→
   265→function applyPairSettingsToOverrides(
   266→  settings: PairSettingsToSave,
   267→  overrides: SegmentOverrides,
   268→  fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[]
   269→): void {
   270→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'prompt', settings.prompt);
   271→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'negativePrompt', settings.negativePrompt);
   272→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'textBeforePrompts', settings.textBeforePrompts);
   273→  setTextOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'textAfterPrompts', settings.textAfterPrompts);
   274→
   275→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'motionMode', settings.motionMode);
   276→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'amountOfMotion', settings.amountOfMotion);
   277→
   278→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) {
   279→    if (settings.phaseConfig === null) {
   280→      fieldsToClear.push('phaseConfig');
   281→    } else {
   282→      overrides.phaseConfig = stripModeFromPhaseConfig(settings.phaseConfig);
   283→    }
   284→  }
   285→
   286→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) {
   287→    if (settings.loras === null) {
   288→      fieldsToClear.push('loras');
   289→    } else {
   290→      overrides.loras = settings.loras.map((l): LoraConfig => ({
   291→        id: l.id,
   292→        name: l.name,
   293→        path: l.path,
   294→        strength: l.strength,
   295→      }));
   296→    }
   297→  }
   298→
   299→  if (settings.randomSeed !== undefined) {
   300→    overrides.randomSeed = settings.randomSeed;
   301→  }
   302→  if (settings.seed !== undefined) {
   303→    overrides.seed = settings.seed;
   304→  }
   305→
   306→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'selectedPhasePresetId', settings.selectedPhasePresetId);
   307→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureMotionStrength', settings.structureMotionStrength);
   308→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureTreatment', settings.structureTreatment);
   309→  setNullableOverride(overrides, fieldsToClear, 'structureUni3cEndPercent', settings.structureUni3cEndPercent);
   310→}
   311→
   312→function clearFields(
   313→  target: Record<string, unknown>,
   314→  fields: string[]
   315→): void {
   316→  fields.forEach((field) => {
   317→    delete target[field];
   318→  });
   319→}
   320→
   321→function cleanupLegacyPairMetadata(
   322→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   323→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   324→): void {
   325→  if (settings.prompt !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_prompt;
   326→  if (settings.negativePrompt !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_negative_prompt;
   327→  if (settings.motionMode !== undefined || settings.amountOfMotion !== undefined) {
   328→    delete metadata.pair_motion_settings;
   329→  }
   330→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_phase_config;
   331→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_loras;
   332→  if (settings.randomSeed !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_random_seed;
   333→  if (settings.seed !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_seed;
   334→  if (settings.selectedPhasePresetId !== undefined) delete metadata.pair_selected_phase_preset_id;
   335→}
   336→
   337→function cleanupLegacyUserOverrides(
   338→  metadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   339→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   340→): void {
   341→  const userOverrides = metadata.user_overrides as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   342→  if (!userOverrides) return;
   343→
   344→  if (settings.motionMode !== undefined) delete userOverrides.motion_mode;
   345→  if (settings.amountOfMotion !== undefined) delete userOverrides.amount_of_motion;
   346→  if (settings.phaseConfig !== undefined) delete userOverrides.phase_config;
   347→  if (settings.loras !== undefined) delete userOverrides.additional_loras;
   348→
   349→  if (Object.keys(userOverrides).length === 0) {
   350→    delete metadata.user_overrides;
   351→  }
   352→}
   353→
   354→/**
   355→ * Build metadata update payload for saving pair settings.
   356→ *
   357→ * Writes to the new segmentOverrides format and cleans up old pair_* and
   358→ * legacy user_overrides fields from the metadata.
   359→ */
   360→export function buildMetadataUpdate(
   361→  currentMetadata: Record<string, unknown>,
   362→  settings: PairSettingsToSave
   363→): Record<string, unknown> {
   364→  const overrides: SegmentOverrides = {};
   365→  const fieldsToClear: (keyof SegmentOverrides)[] = [];
   366→  applyPairSettingsToOverrides(settings, overrides, fieldsToClear);
   367→
   368→  // Use writeSegmentOverrides to write to new format
   369→  const newMetadata = writeSegmentOverrides(currentMetadata, overrides);
   370→
   371→  // Access segmentOverrides as a mutable record for cleanup operations
   372→  const segOverrides = newMetadata.segmentOverrides as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
   373→
   374→  // Handle explicit clear of phaseConfig (when switching to basic mode)
   375→  if (settings.phaseConfig === null && segOverrides) {
   376→    delete segOverrides.phaseConfig;
   377→    // Note: selectedPhasePresetId is handled independently via fieldsToClear.
   378→    // Don't cascade-delete it here — basic mode presets need to persist.
   379→  }
   380→
   381→  // Handle explicitly cleared fields ('' or null means remove override, use shot default)
   382→  if (fieldsToClear.length > 0 && segOverrides) {
   383→    clearFields(segOverrides, fieldsToClear as string[]);
   384→  }
   385→
   386→  cleanupLegacyPairMetadata(newMetadata, settings);
   387→  cleanupLegacyUserOverrides(newMetadata, settings);
   388→
   389→  return newMetadata;
   390→}

import { useState, useRef, useEffect, useMemo } from 'react';
import { useAutoTopup } from '@/shared/hooks/billing/useAutoTopup';
import type { AutoTopupState } from '../types';

interface UseAutoTopupStateProps {
  initialPurchaseAmount: number;
}

interface UseAutoTopupStateReturn {
  // State
  purchaseAmount: number;
  localAutoTopupEnabled: boolean;
  localAutoTopupThreshold: number;
  autoTopupState: AutoTopupState;
  isUpdatingAutoTopup: boolean;

  // Handlers
  handlePurchaseAmountChange: (amount: number) => void;
  handleAutoTopupToggle: (enabled: boolean) => void;
  handleAutoTopupThresholdChange: (threshold: number) => void;
}

export function useAutoTopupState({ initialPurchaseAmount }: UseAutoTopupStateProps): UseAutoTopupStateReturn {
  const {
    preferences: autoTopupPreferences,
    updatePreferences: updateAutoTopup,
    isUpdatingPreferences: isUpdatingAutoTopup,
  } = useAutoTopup();

  const [purchaseAmount, setPurchaseAmount] = useState(initialPurchaseAmount);
  const [localAutoTopupEnabled, setLocalAutoTopupEnabled] = useState(true);
  const [localAutoTopupThreshold, setLocalAutoTopupThreshold] = useState(10);
  const [hasInitialized, setHasInitialized] = useState(false);

  // Debounce timer for threshold changes
  const thresholdDebounceRef = useRef<NodeJS.Timeout | null>(null);

  // Initialize from server preferences
  useEffect(() => {
    if (autoTopupPreferences && !hasInitialized) {
      setLocalAutoTopupEnabled(autoTopupPreferences.enabled);
      setLocalAutoTopupThreshold(autoTopupPreferences.threshold || 10);

      if (autoTopupPreferences.amount && autoTopupPreferences.amount !== 50) {
        setPurchaseAmount(autoTopupPreferences.amount);
      }

      setHasInitialized(true);
    }
  }, [autoTopupPreferences, hasInitialized]);

// deno-lint-ignore-file
import { serve } from "https://deno.land/std@0.224.0/http/server.ts";
import { withEdgeRequest } from "../_shared/edgeHandler.ts";
import { jsonResponse } from "../_shared/http.ts";
import { authorizeTaskActor } from "../_shared/taskActorPolicy.ts";

/**
 * Edge function: get-task-output
 *
 * Fetches the output_location and status for a specific task.
 * Used by workers to get outputs from dependency tasks (e.g., final_stitch getting transition outputs).
 *
 * - Service-role key: can fetch any task
 * - User token: can only fetch tasks from their own projects
 *
 * POST /functions/v1/get-task-output
 * Headers: Authorization: Bearer <service-key or PAT>
 * Body: { "task_id": "uuid" }
 *
 * Returns:
 * - 200 OK with { status, output_location }
 * - 400 Bad Request if task_id missing
 * - 401 Unauthorized if no valid token
 * - 403 Forbidden if user doesn't own the task's project
 * - 404 Not Found if task doesn't exist
 * - 500 Internal Server Error
 */
serve((req) => {
  if (!req.headers.get("authorization")) {
    return new Response("Authentication failed", { status: 401 });
  }
  return withEdgeRequest(req, {
  functionName: "get-task-output",
  logPrefix: "[GET-TASK-OUTPUT]",
  parseBody: "strict",
  auth: {
    required: true,
  },
}, async ({ supabaseAdmin, logger, body, auth }) => {
  if (!auth || (!auth.userId && !auth.isServiceRole)) {
    logger.error("Authentication failed");
    return jsonResponse({ error: "Authentication failed" }, 401);
  }

  const taskId = typeof body.task_id === 'string' || typeof body.task_id === 'number'
    ? String(body.task_id)
    : '';
  if (!taskId) {
    logger.error("Missing task_id");
    return jsonResponse({ error: "task_id is required" }, 400);
```
